'a)〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skoragrub/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngags/454 tu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉paṇ+ḍi/ (she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sla/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ rgya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhudhā/(sro/〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sha sti〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉su bha ni su bha/ (7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉groṇ+ḍapa ya groṇ+ḍi/ci 8)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉 dza lhu hūṃ/ (1)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ma bri/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag nyu nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ukhyi(ṣ+ṭa/ tuge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sngags so/455 4)〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wa3/ ②〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ ri 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/ 4)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste/456 9))〈〈snar 〉〉po'i bsgom/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tor/ 57〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya'i/ co)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdun/(51〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉mi yang /457 hu)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉song /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (251)11wa 460

0325༄7/ /dpal bcom ldan 'das mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ 1 ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī bha ga wa ti a bhi sa ma ya nā ma/ bod skad du / dpal bcom ldan 'das mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa'i dbang phyug gis re zhig dang ngo/ra tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas phung po lnga'i nga rgyal bskyed pa/ra bya ste/ gzugs kyi phung po ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /'du byed kyi phung po ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /mig gnyis la ni 2gti myug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna la ni ser sna rdo rje'o/ /kha la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /reg la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /bya mched thams cad la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams ni ltung bar byed pa'o/ /11—461

chu'i khams ①ni gsod par byed pa'o/ /me'i khams ni 'gugs ④par byed pa'o/ /rlung gi khams ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /nam mkha'i khams ni pad+ma'i zhudra ba can te/ de dag ni phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams kyi lha'i rnam par dag pa'o—/ /de nas rdo rje'i gur bsam par bya ste/ skasum+bha ni sum+bha ni ④hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/chakṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃkṛsnra pa ya kṛsnra pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ska.un ya hoḥbha ga bān badz+ra dhihūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i sngags shar phyogs la sogs par nges par gzhag par bya'o/ /steng du ni mda'i dra ba'o/ /sa gzhi ni yi ge hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin byis brlabs nas de'i 'od kyi snang ba las rdo rje'i ra ba dang rdo rje'i bla re ste/ oṃgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭi ⑥pra duṣ+ṭi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/tī la ya tī ⑦la ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la badz+ra dha ⑧ra k+ṣiṃdz+nyā pa ya ti sarba thaspyo bi nā ya ka ()kā ya bāka bisto badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bus gdab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃbadz+ra mud ga ra badz+ra tī la ⑩k+ṣiṃko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bu brdung ba'i sngags so/ /de nas rang gi snying gar yi ge a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ 'od zer sna tshogs rnam par 'phro bar bsam par byas la/ de'i snang bas mdun du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang /bla ma la sogs pa bltas la phyag bya ste/ mchod par bya'o/ /de nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya'o/ /de nas oṃswa bhā ba shurnyaḥsarba dhas+thāḥswa bhā ba shurnyophohaṃ zhes bya ba brjod la/ yang ni stong par rnam bsam zhing / /sems tsam du yang des gnas bya/ /byang chub sems ni bsgom pa yis/ /mig yor tsam gyi shes pa la/ /khroshu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas langs nas rtenadang brten ⑪pa'i tshul du gnas pa bai ram̐ bha la sogs pa'i 11—462

gnas la gnas pa'i yi ge yo yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa mdog sngon po'i rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du re yongs su gyur pa las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa kha dog dmar po'o/ /de'i steng du yi ge baṃ yongs su gyur pa las chu'i dkyil 'khor rlum po kha dog dkar po bum pas mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du yi ge lo yongs su gyur pa las—/ sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa kha dog ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du yi ge sum̐ yongs su gyur pa las ri'i rgyal po ri rab zur bzhi pa rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can rtse mo brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes par byas pa'o/ /de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng du paṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang ge sar du bcas pa/ de'i dbus su k+ṣiṃli kā li'i 6sbyor ba'o/ /de'i dbus su yi ge hūṃ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin can 'od zer sna tshogs rnam par 'phro bar bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal te ru ka nyi ma la bzhugs shing dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa dur khrod brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de nas dur khrod rnams bshad par bya ste/ rdo rje ra ba'i nang du g.yon skor gyis phyogs thams cad dang / dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams bzhi bzhir brjod par bya ste/ drag tu gtum pa dang / tshang tshing 'khrigs pa dang / 'ur 'ur 'bar bas khyab pa dang / 'jigs su rung ba rnams shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su g.yon skor gyis legs par gnas so/ /dbang ldan gyi marnams su ni ha har dgod pa'o/ /byin za'i mtshams su ni nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /srin po'i spyomatshams su ni mun pa mi bzad pa'o/ /rlung gi marnams su ni shā li khri ④li'i sgra sgogs pa'o/ /rdo rje ra ba'i dur khrod de rnams ni 11—463

'jigs pa'i gzugs kyi ro langs dang 'byung po 'dus pa ce spyang gi sgra sgogs pa'o//rim pa de ltar gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad po der shing dang / phyogs skyong ba dang —/ klu'i dbang po dang / sprin gyi dbang po rnams la shī ①ri ṣa dang / a shwadru dang / ka ka la ②dang / tsū ①ta'i shing ste shar la sogs pa'o/ /ba ta dang —/ ka raspru ⑦ka dang / la tā dza ti dang / parti ba'o/ /de bzhin du dbang po dang / nor bdag dang / klu'i dbang po dang / gshin rje dang /dbang ldan dang / byin za dang / srin po'i dbang po dang / rlung bdag go/ /de bzhin du nor rgyas dang / 'jog po dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang / pad+ma dang /pad+ma chen po dang / hu lun ta dang / rigs ldan dang / dung skyong ngo / /de bzhin du sgra sgogs pa dang / rmugs pa dang / mun pa can dang / kun du 'khyil pa dang / 'khrigs pa dang / drag po dang / 'bab pa dang / gang ba 5sprin gyi bdag po ste/ de rnams de bzhin du bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhi pa/ spyan gsum pa phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng peb 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang pas bzhugs pas 'jigs byed chen po dang / dus mtshan dag zhabs kyis mnan pa/ rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa'i phyag gnyis kyis 7 rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ phyag gzhan gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa na bzar bsnams pa g.yas pa'i phyag gsum pa la ḍam ru/ bzhi pa la dgra sta/ lnga pa la gri gug drug pa la mdung rtse gsum pa bsgreng ba/ g.yon pa'i phyag gsum pa la kha ṭī ga rdo rjes mtshan pa/ bzhi pa khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa la rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa la tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ ral pa'ithor tshugs kyis brgyan pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba'i thod can/ zla ba phyed pa 'dzin pa/11—464

sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbu rgyan can zhal rnam par 'gyur pa/ mche ba gshiXs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/sku mdog mthing ka bzhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i zhal mthing nag zhal g.yas pa shin tu ser ba/ rgyab pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can/ g.yon mar ka ta lta bu'i mdog can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bsnams pa'o/ /mi'i mgo bo byed pa'i phreng ba 'chang ①ba/ rna cha dang / gdu bu dang / mgul rgyan dang /ska rags dang / spyi gtsug nor bus brgyan pa/ mchod phyir thogs pa 'chang ba/thal ba dang / phyag rgya drug ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rnam par dag pa'i phyir phyag rgya drug gis rgyas btab pa'o/ /de'i spyan sngar bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig ma/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag gnyis ma/ skra grol ba/gcer bu dum bu'i ska rags kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon pas ②'khyud nas gdug pa dang bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/g.yas phyogs snethams cad du gdug pa rnams la sdigs mdzub byed cing rdo rje bsnams pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid chen po dang ldan pa khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis 'khyud pa/ bde ba chen po dang thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can no/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dang —/ gzugs can ma rnams ni don thams cad grub par byed pa ste/ pad+ma'i phyogs kyis ④gnas su nag po dang / ljang ku dang dmar po dang / ser po zhal gcig pa/ phyag bzhi pa ste/ phyag g.yon na kha ṭī ga dang thod pa/ g.yas pa ḍa ma ru dang gri gug bsnams pa/ spyan gsum pa skra grol ba/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang bupas bzhugs pa/ zhal mche ba rnam par gcigs pa/ phyag rgya bulngas 11byed465

brgyan pa dgod par bya'o/ /mtshalas rnams su 'dod chags dang gti mug la sogs pa rnam par dag pas sems tshim par byed pa'i mchod pa ste/ byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i snod bzhi po dgod par bya'o/ /dang po thugs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa ste/ mdog sngo nag rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ de'i shar gyi rtsibs la pūlbi ①ra ma la yar/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang / rab tu gtum ma'o/ /byang dzā lan dha rar/ ma hā kang ka la dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /nub u byun du kang ka la dang / 'od ldan ma'o/ /lho ar bu dar/ mche ba rnam par gcigs pa dang / sna chen ma'o/ /me go dā wa ri ra su ra bai ra dang / brtan pa'i blo can ma'o/ /bden bral rā me shwa rar/ 'od dpag med dang / mi'u thung ma'o/ /rlung de bī ②ko ṭar rdo rje 'od dang / lang ka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /dbang ldan spa lnga ④bar/ rdo rje sku dang / shing grib ma ste/ 'di dag ni thugs kyi 'khor lo'o/ /gnyis pa gsung gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad pa dmar po ste/pad+ma'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de'i shar byi rtsibs dukā ma rū par/ saṃ gu ri dang / e ra pa ti'o⑤/ /byang oṭir rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /nub tri sha ku ṣ+per/ dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma'o—/ /lho ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma'o/ /shar lhor ka ling gar rab tu bzang po dang / shā la de bī'orjo/ /lho nub lo pā kar rdo rje bzang po dang —/ shin tu bzang mo'o/ /nub byang kā—ra 'jigs byed chen po dang / rta rna ma'o/ /byang shar nyi shā la ⑦yar mig mi bzang dang / kha shā na ṣ+pe ⑧ste/ de dag ni gsung gi 'khor lo'o/ /gsum pa sku'i 'khor lo ni dkar po ste/ 'khor lo'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de'i shar gyi rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po 11byed466

che dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /byang kṛ ha de ba tār rin chen rdo rje dang | khaṇ+ḍa ro ha'o/ /nub sau rāṣ+ṭar/ rta mgrin dang / shoṇ+ḍi nī'o①/ /lho phyogs su bar+ṇa dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /shar lhor (min ga rar/ dpal he ru ka dang / shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /lho nub sen dhur / pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / stobs chen mo'o/ /nub byang ma rur④/rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor los dusgyur ma'o/ /byang shar ku la tār rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ de dag ni sku'i 'khor lo'o/ /khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams ni zhal gcig la ⑤phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa'i cod pan can—/ phyag gnyis 'khyud pas rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pa na kha ṭī ga g.yas pa na ḍa ma ru/ sku la phyag rgya rnam lnga la sogs pa dang ldan pa/g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa'o/ /rab gtum la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams ni phyag gnyis dang / zhal gcig pa thod pa bsnams pa'i phyag gis 'khyud pa/ gdug pa rnams la sdigs mdzub dang gri gug bsnams pa/ mig gsum pa drag po'i gzugs can skra grol bas rnam par mdzes pa/ gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la brtson pa gcer bu'i mchog gdu bu dang dbu'i nor bu dang / rna cha dang /mgul rgyan dang / tshangs pa'i skud pa thogs pa/ mgo bo'i phreng bas mgul pa brgyan pa/ ska rags sil sel sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /shar dang byang dang nub dang lho'i sgo rnams su khwa gdong ma dang / 'ug gdong ma dang / khye gdong ma dang /phag gdong ma'o/ /shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang dang / byang shar marnams rnams su ya ma dā rnyi dang / gshin rje brtan ma dang / gshin rje pho nya 11—467

mo dang / gshin rje mche ba can ma ①dang / gshin rje 'joms ma ste/ ji ltar mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i tshogs ji lta bar khā gdong ma la sogs pa'i dbye ba yang de bzhin no/ /de bzhin du mtshalas na bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams ni yid 'phrog pa'i gzugs ②gnyis pa ste/ thams cad yi dwags kyi gdan la bzhugs shing sems can gyi don mdzad pa la brtson pa'o/ /dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma 'di dag thams cad ni dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng ba'o/ /de nas gzhan yang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun lha'i sbyor bas sbyar bar bya ste/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ lus rjes su dran pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba rjes su dran pa ni lā ma'o/ /chos rjes su dran pa ni khaṇ+ḍa ①ro he'o/ /sems rjes su dran pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni rab gtum ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'od ldan ma'o/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni sna chen ma'o//dad pa'i dbang po ni brtan pa'i blo can ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni mi'u thung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po ni lang ka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni shing grib ma'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni i dhirā ba ti'o/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni rlung gi shugs can ma'o—/ /dran pa'i stobs ni chang 'thung ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni shā ma de bī'o⑤/ /shes rab kyi stobs ni shin tu bzang mo'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta rna ma'o/ /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni kha shā na ṣ+pe'odhi/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni khaṇ+ḍa ro 11—468

he'o / /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni sngoṇ+ḍi nī'o①/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i go cha'o/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni stobs chen ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni 'khor los sgyur ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni khwa gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi gdong ma'o—/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyed ④pa ni gshin rje brtan ma'o—/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par bsrung ba ni gshin rje pho nya ma'o—/ /mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong ba ni gshin rje'i mche ba can ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed pa ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /de nas gzhan yang sku'i dkyil 'khor mchog gi rim pa'i sbyor bas sa bcu yongs su dag pas gnas la sogs pa yang dag par bshad par bya ste/pū kyidzā o.a go rā/ de mā kā ohri ④ko ka la kā hi/ pre kṛ sau su na se ma ku/byu 5 zhes bya ba ni pūlpi dhir ma la ya ste/ mgo bor ni rab gtum ma'o/ /dzā zhes bya ba ni dzā lan dha ra ste/ spyi gtsug tu gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /o zhes bya ba ni khro ḍān te/ rna ba g.yas par 'od ldan ma'o/ /a zhes bya ba ni ar bu da ste/mgo bo'i rgyab tu sna chen ma rjoste gnas so/ /go zhes bya ba ni go dā ba ri ste/ rna ba g.yon par brtan pa'i blo can ma'o/ /rā zhes bya ba ni rā me shwa ra ste/ m+bin ma'i dbus su mi thung ma'o/ /de zhes bya ba ni de bī khye/ko ṭa ste/ mig tu lang ka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /mā zhes bya ba ni mā la ba ste/ phrag par ni shing grib ma 11byed469

ste| nye ba'i gnas so/ /'di dag ni thugs kyi 'khor lo ste/ nam mkha' la spyod pa'o/ /kā zhes bya ba ni kā ma ru ①pa ste/ mchan khung dag tu ni e rā ba tī'o①/ /khyezhes bya ba ni o ṭi ste/ nub ①ma gnyis su ni 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing ngo / /dri zhes bya ba ni tri sha ku ni ste/ lte bar ni rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /ko zhes bya ba ni ko sa la ste/ sna'i rtse mor chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing ngo / /ka zhes bya ba ni ka ling ga ste khar ni shā ma de bī'o/ /la zhes bya ba ni lam pā ga ste/mgrin par ni shin tu bzang mo ste/ tshasdo duha'o/ /kā zhes bya ba ni kā: na ste/snyeng gar ni rta rna ma'o/ /hi zhes bya ba ni hi mā la ya ste/ 'doms su ni kha gā na ṣ+pe ⑤ste/ nye ba'i tshasdo ha'o/ /'di dag ni gsung gi 'khor lo ste/ sa la spyod pa'o—/ /pre zhes bya ba ni pre ta pu ri ste/ mtshan ma la 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o / /kṛ zhes bya ba ni dza ha de ba ste/ bshang ba'i lam du khaṇ+ḍa ro he ste 'dus pa can no/ /sau zhes bya ba ni sau rāṣ+ṭa ste/ brla gnyis su shoṇ+ḍa nī'odhi/ /su zhes bya ba ni su bar+ṇa dī ⑦pa ste byin pa gnyis la 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste/ nye ba'i 'dus pa can no/ /na zhes bya ba ni na ga ra ste/ sor mo rnams la ni shin tu dpa' mo'o—/ /si zhes bya ba ni sin dhu ste/ rkang pa'i bol la ni stobs chen ma ste/dur khrod do/ /ma zhes bya ba ni ma ru ste/ mthe bong dag la ni 'khor los ①sgyur ma'o—/ /ku zhes bya ba ni ku la ⑨tā ste/ pus mo gnyis la ni brtson 'grus chen mo ste—/ nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /'di dag ni sku'i 'khor lo ste/ sa 'og na gnas so—/ /de yang sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /yi ge gsum gyi ngo bo las/ /mtho ris mi yul sa 'og tu/ /skad cig gcig gis sku gcig 'gyur/ /skad cig tsam gyi rnal 'byor bdag /skad cig gis ni phyag rgya can/ /kun nas kun du 11—470

skad cig ste/ /skad cig gis ni gsang sngags 'don/ /oṃ ā hūṃ/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī nī kā ya bāka tsi: badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shurtaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyophohaṃ/ de nas go cha gnyis shes nas/ /ye shes 'khor lo rnam par bsgom/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i sbyor shes pas/ /dam tshig 'khor lo la myur gzhug /de nas go cha gnyis bshad par bya ste/ snying kar oṃ ha'o/ /mgo bor na ma hi'o/ /spyi gtsug la swā hā hu/ phrag pa gnyis la ni bo ṣaṭa he/ mig gnyis la ni hūṃ rjohūṃ ho / /yan lag thams cad la ni phaṭa phaṭarjohaṃ/ dang po rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /gnyis pa rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs/ /gsum pa pad+ma gar dbang bzhugs/ /bzhi pa dpal ldan he ru ka /rdo rje nyi ma rta mchog ste/ /gdug pa go cha rnams kyis bsrungs1/ /oṃ baṃ rdo rje phag mo'o/ /haṃ oṃ ya mi ni'o/ /hri oṃ rmongs byed ma'o / /hri dī skyod byed ma'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ sgod byed ma'o/ /phaṭa phaṭa ni tsaṇ+ḍi ka ste/yan lag thams cad la mtshon cha yin dute/ lte ba dang snying ga dang de bzhin du kha dang / mgo bo dang / spyi gtsug dag gi mtshon cha nyid do/ /mdzub mo mdud byas gung mo nges par sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan por rab tu sbyar/ /'di ni dpral ba'i dbyengs su rab bzhag nas/ /bskor zhing bskor bas kun du bskor bar bya/ /rkang pa mnan cing gyen du blta/ /gyen du dze gyi sgra sgrogs shing //phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dgug /oṃ yo ga shudhaḥsarba dhas+thā yo ga shurnyophohaṃ/ de nas snying po'i phyag rgya sbyin par bya ste/ lag pa g.yas pa dang g.yon pa bskor zhing mkha' 'gro ma'i dam pa bde bar gzhug par bya'o/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kai hūṃ ⑤hūṃ phaṭa badz+ra ḍā ki be+e dzā la sasbra re swā hā snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ byāḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa nye ba'i snying po'i 11—471

hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃya ma dā sgyi ya ①hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ chi ya ma dū tī ya sdehūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma doṣ+ṭi bhā ya ①hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃya ma ma thā nā ya rjohūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ skaḍā ki smi ya ⑤hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ skalā me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃkhaṇ+ḍa ro he hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi bhā ya duhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ chi na mo bha ga ba te bā re shā ya/ ma hā kalpa ⑦aghi sin+da bhā ya/ dza ṭā ma ku ṭota ka ṭā ya/ rdaṭī ka rā lo gra dh+wa ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya/par shu pā sho r+ya ta shu la kha ṭī ga dh+wa ri ṇi/ byā gh+ra dzi rmā ba ra dha rā ya/ ma hā hūṃ drwan dha ka ra ba puṣā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de dag ni mchod pa'i sngags so/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam byis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ /chi saza ta thā ga ta ⑧a bhe ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje'i thal mo gyen du kha phye la mtshan phyed na gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /skabadz+ra phywa⑨ral+li hoḥdza hūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki rī ⑩sa ma ya hūṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ.oṃphywahūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis lan lnga'i bar du mngon par bsngags par byas la btab par bya ste/ oṃkha kha khā hi khā hi sadze+e yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa sa ⑪da a pasmra ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya i ⑩saṃ pa lo greṇ+ḍan dus ma yi rak+ṣan tu/ ma ma sat+tha sirnyim+bi pra yasgoskyo ya dze+e baṃ ya theṣ+ṭi bye dza tha pi ba tha dzi gh+ra tha mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sabyu kār ta ya sad su ⑫kha bi bridha ④ye sa hā yalaka bha ban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ so dang sen mo dag khaṇ+ḍa ka pā pa'o⑩/ /skra dang spu dag ma hā kang ka la'o/ /pags pa dang dri ma dag kang ka la'o/ /sha ni mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'o/ /rgyus pa ni su ra bai ri'o/ /rus pa ni 'od dpag tu med pa'o—/ /mchin pa ni rdo rje 'od do/ /snying ni rdo rje sku'o/ /mig ni ang ku ri ka'o—/ /mkhris pa ni rdo rje ral pa can no/ /glo ba ni dpa' bo chen po'o/ /rgyu 11—473

ma ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad do/ /gnye ma ni rab tu bzang po'o/ /grod pa ni rdo rje bzang po'o—/ /chu so ni 'jigs byed chen po'o/ /skra mtshalas ni mig mi bzang ngo /bad kan ni stobs po che'o/ /rnag ni rin chen rdo rje'o/ /khrag ni rta mgrin no/ /rdul ni nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /tshil ni dpal rdo rje te ru ka'o/ /mchi ma ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /mchil ma ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /snabs ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ de dag ni dpa' bo'i yan lag rnam par dag pa'o/ /dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags mchog gang / /mchod phyir thogs la sogs pa brtag /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /lus kyi khams la rnam par brtag /go cha'i phyag rgya dpa' bo drug /phyag rgya 'di yis lus mdzes te/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gang yin—/ /mgrin pa mgul dos brgyan pa yin/ /snying po'i sngags kyi dpa' ba ①yi//phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyis brgyan/ /gsang sngags yi ge bdun byis ni/ /rna cha yis ni rna ba brgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /pags pa'i gos ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /rnal 'byor ma drug sngags kyis ni/ /ska rags byas pa rnam par brgyan/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma/ /sngags kyi btung ba'i thod pa yin—/ /bai ro tsa na'i sngags gang yin/ /thod pas mgo bo rnam par brgyan/ /de ltar bdag nyid rnam bsams te/ /tsham ①ngam sngags kyis shin tu bsrung / /tshangs par spyod pa brtag dze+egyur nas/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i gsang sngags mchod/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bdag nyid bsam/ /'khor lo bde mchog sdom pa la/ /blo ldan che gang rnam par spyod/ /rigs lnga dag tu kun spyod pa/ /rigs gcig tu ni rnam par brtag /rnam par mi rtog bdag nyid sems/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spyod/ /dogs dupa thams cad 11—474

rnam spangs te/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /ā li kā li mdun bsams nas—/ /rnal 'byor chen po ngal bso ste/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sdogs pa ni/ /lte ba'i rtsa bar gnas par bsgom/ /yi ge mchog gi gnas gyur pa/ /de yi dbus su rnam par bsgom/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /lha yi sku ni bsgom par bya/ /de ni gzugs las 'das pa ste/ /dngos po med pa'i chos nyid yin//de yang bsam gyis mi khyab bsam/ /sems nyid brtag par mi bya'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab de bsams na①/ /de las gzugs ni tho bar ②'gyur/ /kha ṭī ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍa ①ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor bshad/ /mya ngan 'das byung dpa' bo rnams/ /drug pa sems kyi sprul pa ste/ /dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin/ /shrīr ④yig gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs rnam par spangasarka/ /ru yig tshogs dang bral ba nyid/ /ka ni gang du 'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /sems ni ngal bso rnal 'byor pa/ /myang 'das bstan pa ma yin nyid/ /'pho ba'i tshe na rnal 'byor pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs rnal 'byor/ /me tog sna tshogs lag na thogs/ /sna tshogs rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / /glu yi ⑤mchod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed/ /dpal bcom ldan 'das mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ yul sgo ga la'i slob dpon bsod snyoms pa dngos grub brnyes pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po phru yi pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i mkhas pa shrad ṅgā ka ra barma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin 11—475

chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ slad kyi dpal rdo je slob dpon chen po rje btsun na ba ko ṭi pā da'i donal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lha btsas kyis yul shar phyogs kyi dpe dang bstun te bcos pa'o/ /dus phyis shar phyogs dza ga ta la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dā na shī las 'grel pa dang bstun nas cung zad bcadas pam she /bsdur mchan/461 1macan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mngon rtogs 'a yi pas mdzad pa bzhugs so// 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ni/462 she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgol/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dgug kyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pad+ma/ ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ni/dā〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉r+pā badz+ra rā dza/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dusnye/ ྅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kā/ 'a〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉d+ma/ po7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thami rmā/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dza gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—dang brten/463 sna7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉li/ rī〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bu'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ki li ki/464 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shi/ sdesna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka ko li/ la 7〈〈snar 〉〉tsu/ ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ralca/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ zhwa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje 'phreng / ྅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/465 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'phyang / — sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rkyang / ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rnam pa/466 snasna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pu4/ rka sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tha/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mā la/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 kyi/'a〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rā ba tī'o/ ( sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mā de bi'o/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma dza 8sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga na/467 nya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na'o/ ‘ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lho/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ror/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo/cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/468 sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ma/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—gzugs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṣaṇ+ḍa/ pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉snyesnye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pi'o/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga na'o/11byed476

0326༄7/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa don thams cad grub pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba/①na sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṭītsakra saṃ ba ra sto tra sarba arba sernyi bi shudha tsū ḍa ma ṇi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa/ don thams cad grub pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba/ dpal bde mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje dbyings las bzhengs pa'i sku mchog ni/ /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku brnyes shing / /srid pa sbyor mdzad nyon mongs gdung ba sel / /sgyu ma sprul pas 'gro don sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /'khor lo sdom pa mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso/ /'jigs mdzad dpa' bo bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /sna tshogs phrin las rigs lngas yongs mtshon pa'i/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs sna tshogs rdo rjes mdzes/ /byang chub sems mchog chos rnams rab gsungs pa'i/ sna /spyi bor zla tshes cod pan 'khor los brgyan/ /zhal gdangs khro gnyer smin ma glog ltar 'gyu//skyeshi rtsad gcod keng rus mche ba gcigs⑦/ /tshad med bzhi ldan dpa' bo zhal 11—479

bzhi la/ /mi bskyod rigs mtshon ye shes lnga ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje'i ①phreng dang thod pa lnga lngas brgyan/ /stong nyid snying rje rab tu 'dres gyur pa'i/ /'od zer 'phro ba sna tshogs du ma las/ /sangs rgyas tshogs kyis kun du sprin 'phro ba'i/ /sku gsum dpa' bo ye shes lnga ①bdag nyid/ /sgeg pa la sogs rol pa'i nyams kyis mdzes/ /snying rje'i spyan dmar bcu gnyis me bzhin 'jigs/ /he ru ka dpal bde mchog sprul pa'i sku/ /'chad byed chos dang nyan pa'i tshogs ldan pa'i/ /nyan thos rang sangs bla med rgyal ba dang / /'jig rten rab gnas 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /rang bzhin nyid ni khyod las gzhan ma mchis/ /gsang ba'i bde mchog bdud bral ye shes sku/ /pha rol phyin drug phyag rgya drug gis mdzes/ /a la la zhes dur khrod gar dang ldan/ /tse gyi (kyesgra sgrogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams sdud—/ /'du byed rnam dag mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan/ /drag po kun 'dul stag gi sham thabs can/ /rdo rje'i rta gad khams gsum bsdigs mdzad cing / /ma rig la sogs rten 'byel rnam dag pa/ /byams pa'i thugs mnga' bcu gnyis phyag dang ldan/ /g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje rtse lnga ni/ /ye shes lnga ldan dug lnga rnam par 'joms/ /phyag g.yon dang po dril bu rnam 'dzin pa/ /rtog pa rnam spangs shes rab rang bzhin ldan/ /de 'og phyag gnyis gti mug rnam dag pa'i/ /glang chen ko rlon dpa' bo'i gos su mnabs/ /chos rnams sgogs pa'i ḍa ma ru bsnams shing —/ /lha sku rnam dag kha ṭī rdo rjes mtshon④/ /gri gug 'bar bas nyon mongs 'ching ba gcod/ /'dod chags rnam dag thod pa khrag chen 'dzin/ /thugs rje'i dgra stas drag po'i lha rnams 'joms/ /sdigs mdzub zhags pas bdud dang gshin rje 'dul/ /tri shul durtse gsum skyes bu phug cing 'phyar/ /bdud bzhi 11—480

was rgyal lha chen rnams bsad cing / /tshangs pa'i mgo bcad dpa' bo'i lag na 'dzin/ /rtag chad spangs phyir sna tshogs pad+ma dang / /nyi ma'i dbus na bgegs chen du ma gzir/ /'jigs byed dus mtshan g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis mnan/ /ta ha sgra sgrogs phag mo'i sku la 'khril/ /khros pa'i dpung chen bdud dgra rlag par byed—/ /gsang ba'i mgon po rang nyid la gus shing / /bskyed rdzogs la gnas gsang ba'i mchog la dgyes/ /brtan pa'i blo can brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dngos grub mchog byed he ru ka la 'dud/ /gsang ba kun ldan rdo rje phag mo ni/ /bde mchog 'khor lo 'jigs byed rgyal po'i yum/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro che/ /hi hir bzhad cing bde gshegs sku la 'khril/ /bdud 'dul rgyal mo skal ldan dbang phyug ma/ /sku mdog dmar mo thod pa'i phreng ba can//gri gug sdigs mdzub gdug pa sreg 1mdzad cing / /thod pa khrag can he ru ka la 'khyud/ /mche ba gdags shing drag shul 'jigs ldan ma/ /dman pas 'grub 'gyur mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud③/ /chags ltar rtog med zhal gnyis ldan pa yi/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor stong nyid snying rje che/ /bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ye shes sku/ /gsang ba'i lha mo 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ /ye shes me dpung klong na glog ltar 'gyu/ /mkha' 'gro phag mo 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can/ /'jigs pa'i cha byad bdud bzhi kun skrag byed/ /'khor los dbu rgyan rdo rje'i rna cha can/ /mgul rgyan do shal spyi gtsug nor bu dang / /dpung rgyan lag gdub se ral khar byas shing / /dum bu'i ske rags sil sil sgra dang ldan/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gnyis med 'khril ba'i tshul/ /bde ba'i rang bzhin legs pa'i chos dbyings ldan/ /dbu skra grol zhing thugs rjes kun khyab pas/ /zhi rgyas 11byed481

dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs dang / /grub chen brgyad sogs sgrub po la ster zhing —/ /ye shes spyan gsum dus gsum gdul bya gzigs/ /dang ba'i sems kyis 'jigs dus khyod dran na/ /sdug bsngal kun sel dngos grub mchog sprul zhing —/ /longs spyod sprul pa sna tshogs skur ston pa'i/ /sgrub po'i don mdzod rnal 'byor ma la 'dud/ /bde chen 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma yi/ /'dab brgyad phyogs nas mā ma tī sogs gnas/ /zhal bzhi la phyogs dngos grub ster ba yi/ /gsang ba'i dbang phyug dpa' mo bzhi la 'dud/ /me long ye shes las skyes thod phreng can/ /in+d+ra nī la'i mdog can gtum pa mo/ /gsang ba'i lha mo dpal ldan dbang phyug sku/ /g.yas brkyang dpa' mo ro yi steng na gnas/ /phyag bzhi nag mo 'jigs pa'i glu len ma/ /gri gug thod pa kha ṭī cang te'u bsnams/ /lus rjes dran pa'i ngo bo chu rang bzhin/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes dpal ldan ma/ /sems ma rdo rje dam tshig sgrol ma'i mchog /'khor lo la sogs phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /ḍa cham ru sgras gtso mo skul byed cing //kha ṭī ga bsnams 'jigs pa'i dze sgra sgogs/ /tshor rjes dran pa'i rang bzhin rlung bdag nyid/ /ljang khu'i mdog can gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /las rigs mkha' 'gro lā ma che la 'dud/ /so sor kun rtog ye shes dbyings phyug ma/ /rā ga'i mdog can gar byu stobs ldan ma/ /ḍa ma ru 'khrol kha ṭī g.yon na bsnams/ /gri gug thod khrag dgra bgegs zhal du gsol/ /chos rjes dran pa'i gcer bu spyan gsum ma/ /me yi bdag nyid pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro che/ /sku mdog dmar mo ma rungs gsod pa yi/ /khaṇ+ḍa ro ha ④che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin las skyes shing / /bdud 'dul dpa' mo rus pa'i rgyan 'dzin cing / /me 11—482

dpung nang bzhugs mgo phreng do shal can/ /gri gug gcod mdzad thod pa'i khrag 'thung ma/ /kha ṭī ga bsnams sor ①mo cang te'u 'khrol/ /sems rjes dran pa'i mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso/ /rigs can ②mkha' 'gro sa yi bdag nyid ma/ /rgazugs can dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje'i sems kyi ①bdud bzhi tshar gcod cing / /dam tshig can la dngos grub mchog stsol 0byed/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i sngags pa gsod la brtson/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo//mtshams kyi pad+mar 1rin chen bum pa'i stengs/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnam dag pa'i/ /dngos grub dang ldan mtshan bzang ka pā la/ /bdud rtsi lnga ldan bde ba che la 'dud/ /pul+lī ra mar ④dpa' bo thod dum ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sen mo so la gnas/ /rab tu gtum mo 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang / /gcer bu mgor gnas ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dza ④lan dha rar ma hā shaṃ ka la/ /mkha' la spyod byed skra spu la gnas dang / /gtum pa'i mig can brtson pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang / /spyi gtsug la gnas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /orgyan la gnas dpa' bo shaṃ ka la/ /pags pa dri ma rnam dag sa bla 'dul/ /'od ldan ma ni dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang / /rna g.yas la gnas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo ar bu dar gnas mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /lha rnams 'dul zhing sha la rnam par gnas/ /sna chen ma ni sems kyi rdzu 'phrul rkang / /rgyab la gnas gyur mkha' 'gro spyod phyag 'tshal/ /go dā ba rir su ra bī ri ni/ /rgyus pa rnam dag g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis gnas/ /dad pa'i dbang po brtan pa'i blo can ma/ /rna ba g.yon pa la gnas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'od dpag med ni rus pa'i khams dag cing —/ /brkyang bskums sputshul gyes rā me shwa rir gnas/ /smin ma'i dbus 11—483

gnas brtson dbang mi'u thung ma/ /snyom ①las rab spangs mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mchin pa rnam dag de yī ②ko ṭi ru/ /rdo rje 'od ni 'byung kun 'dul bas gnas/ /dran pa'i dbang po laṅka'i ③dbang phyug ma/ /mig gnyis la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mā la ber gnas dpa' bo rdo rje'i sku/ /snying la rab gnas drag po 'jigs byed 'dul/ /shing grib ma ni ting 'dzin dbang po ste//phrag pa gnyis gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo mkha' la rnam spyod cing / /rnam thar brgyad ldan rtsibs brgyad sngon po ste/ /rdo rje'i rigs mtshon rdo rje'i phreng bas mdzes/ /zhe sdang can 'dul rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /myu gu can ni kā ma rur gnas shing / /mig gnyis rnam dag e ra ba ti mdzes/ /sa srungs ④ma ni shes rab dbang ba ⑤ste/ /mchan khung rnam dag mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /oṭir gnas pa'i rdo rje ral pa can/ /mkhris pa rnam dag rdo rje rol pa'i zhabs/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed chen mo ste/ /nu ma rnam dag mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /tri sha ku ṣ+per dpa' bo chen po chang / /glo ba rnam dag rab tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /rlung gi shugs can brtson 'grus stobs rang bzhin/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor dpa' mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ko sa lar ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad do/ /rgyu ma rnam dag tse gi sgra sgrogs shing / /dran pa'i stobs ni chang 'thung dpa' mo ste/ /sna rtse la gnas dpa' mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ka ling kar gnas rab tu bzang mo ni/ /gnye ma la gnas dngos grub kun ster ba'i/ /ljang lha mo ni ting 'dzin stobs ldan zhing / /kha yi nang gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /lo pā kar gnas rdo rje bzang po ni / /grod pa rnam dag dpa' bo chen po ste/ /shes rab stobs ni shin tu bzang mo yin/ /mgrin pa la gnas mkha' 11—484

'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /kāspyo'i gnas su 'jigs byed chen po ste/ /zhabs kanyis brkyang bskum chu so la gnas shing / /rta rna ma ni ting 'dzin yan lag ste/ /snying ga la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ / hi mā lar ①ni dpa' bo mig mi bzangs①/ /skra mtshams la gnas ha ha'i sgra sgrogs shing / /brtson 'grus yan lag bya gdong chen mo ste/ /'doms bar la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal//gsung gi 'khor lo sa stengs longs spyod cing / /rnam thar brgyad ldan rtsibs brgyad dmar po ste/ /gsung gi rigs mtshan ①pad+ma'i phreng bas mdzes/ /'dod chags can 'dul pad+ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /pre ta pu rir dpa' bo stobs chen ni/ /bad kan rnam dag phyag bzhis ④rnam par brgyan/ /dga' ba byang chub yan lag 'khor lo'i shugs/ /mtshan ma la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gri ha de 5bar rin chen rdo rje ni/ /sna tshogs dag la g.yas brkyang rol pas bzhugs/ /shin tu sbyangs pa'i yan lag dum skyes ma/ /bshang lam la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sau rāṣ+ṭar rta mgrin rgyal ba buni/ /khrag la gnas shing drag po kun 'dul ba/ /chos rnams rab 'byed yan lag glang sna ma/ /brla gnyis la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /su waṇ+ḍi dī nam mkha'i snying po ste/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo rdul tshogs rnam dag cing / /dran pa yan lag 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ /byen pa la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /na ga rar gnas dpal ldan te ru ka /tshil khrag rnam dag phyag rgya drug gis mdzes/ /shin tu dpa' mo btang snyoms yan lag ste/ /sor mo la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sirtsu'i ④gnas su pad+ma gar dbang phyug /mchi ma rnam dag 'jigs mdzad dpa' bo che/ /stobs chen dpa' mo yang dag lta ba ste/ /rkang pa'i bol gnas mkha' 'gro khyod 11—485

phyag 'tshal/ /ma ro'i gnas su rnam par snang mdzad che/ /mchil ma rnam dag dbang phyug chen po'i sku/ /'khor los ①sgyur ma yang dag rtog pa ste/ /mthe bong la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ku lu tār gnas rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon po snabs sogs rnam dag pa/ /brtson 'grus chen mo yang dag ngag ldan zhing / /pus mo la gnas mkha' 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sku yi 'khor lo sa 'og la gnas shing / /rnam thar brgyad ldan rtsibs brgyad dkar po ste/ /sku yi rigs mtshon 'khor lo'i phreng bas mdzes/ /gti mug can 'dul 'khor 'o/ khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'gro ba'i don la thugs rje sprul pa'i gnas/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs ldan nyi shu rtsa bzhi ru/ /sku gsung thugs gnas sgrub la brtser dgongs pa'i//'khor lo'i lha la rtag par phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma rungs 'dul mdzad rnam rgyal la sogs rnams/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis khro mo'i skur ston cing / /sgo mtshams dag na ma rungs phyogs bdag 'dul/ /khwa gdong la sogs sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro gnas/ /bya rog gdong can mkha' 'gro 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /zhal gyi nga ros 'brug stong bdud las rgyal/ /gar byi sbyor ldan gcer bu phyag bzhi ma/ /nag mo 'jigs byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar gyi sgo srung (rduyi dwags gdan 'a/ bzhugs/ /dpa' mo spyan gsum phyag rgya lnga yis mjos/ /kha nas khrag 'dzag a la la zhes sgrogs/ /yang dag las mtha'i dpa' mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'ug pa'i gdong can bgegs tshogs sreg ③mdzad ma/ /kha nas lce 'dril mche ba rnam par gcigs/ /ha ha dgod cing spyan mig glog ltar 'gyu/ /dgra bgegs tshar gcod ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang gi sgo srung peljang dmar 'od ldan ma/ /mkha' 'gro mi srun rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /sku mdog dmar ljang gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /11—486

yang dag 'tsho ba'i dpa' mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /khyi yi gdong can thod pa'i rgyan ldan ma/ /sku mdog dmar mo phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs shing / /spyan gsum sdang mig dus mtha'i me bzhin 'jigs/ /sgrub pa'i don mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub kyi sgo srung dpa' mo stobs ldan ma/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bsgum 'byung po zil kyis gnon/ /mkha' 'gro mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /yang dag rtsol ba'i ngo bo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phag gi gdong can gsang ba'i dbang phyug ma/ /bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro phyag rgya gar gyis skyod①/ /rna cha mgul rgyan spyi gtsug nor bus brgyan/ /'jigs byed khrag 'thung ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho yi sgo srung ①ser mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /zhal nas me 'bar bdud kyi dpung rnams sreg1 /ḍa ma ru 'khrol 4 kha ṭī g.yon na bsgreng / /yang dag dran pa'i dpa' mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /shar lhor dbang sgyur gshin rje brtan ma ni/ /g.yas sngo g.yon ser brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis shi༄rab mdzes mkha' 'gro ma/ /dbang phyug gsang ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro sems can don brtson ma/ /rus pa'i ska rags khrag gi thig le can/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /dge chos yang dag bskyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub dri med gshin rje pho nya mo/ /g.yas ser g.yon dmar mkha' 'gro gzugs mdzes ma/ /ha ha'i sgra sgogs gsed ⑪byed mthu rtsal can/ /mkha' 'gro dgos 'dod skong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam nyid rol pa'i sku/ /bde chen mnyam nyid mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso/ /kha nas khrag 'dzag gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /dge chos yang dag bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang mkha' 'gro gshin rje mche ba mo/ /g.yas dmar g.yon sngo spyan bgrad 'jigs 11—487

pa'i gzugs/ /gsang ba'i lha mo rdo rje'i glu len ma/ /stobs chen mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rus pa'i dum bu khrag gi ①thig les brgyan/ /tshangs skud mgo bo'i phreng bas rab brgyan pas/ /rus pa'i ska rags sil sil sgra dang ldan/ /mi dge yang dag spong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar gsang ba'i gshin rje 'joms byed ma/ /g.yas ljang g.yon sngo 'gying zhing rol pa'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas brkyang gdan la bzhugs/ /mkha' 'gro dbyings phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs 'khrugs ②byed 'bar ba'i 'od ldan ma/ /khro gnyer mche gatshigs dgra bgegs zhal du gsol/ /bsnyen sgrub byed la gsang ba'i dngos grub ster/ /mi dge skyed ①mi byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig 'khor lo mi'am ci sogs 'dul//phyogs bzhi gdong can mtshams bzhi phyed gzugs ma/ /las kyi rigs mtshon sna tshogs rdo rjes mdzes/ /phrag dog can 'dul 'khor lo byed phyag 'tshal/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan 'jig rten gsum/ /phyi nang brtan g.yo'i dngos po byed rang bzhin/ /byed kyi srid gsum rang bzhin lhan cig skyes/ /byed 'dab phyogs bzhir yum bzhi mtshams bum thod/ /rim gsum dpa' bo dpa' mo bzhi bcu brgyad/ /sgo mtshams lha mo brgyad de drug cu gnyis/ /sgrub la brtser dgongs 'khor lo lngar gnas pa'i/ /lha tshogs la ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal gsang ba'i grong khyer mchog /dkyil 'khor bde chen sdig pa rab 'joms pa'i/ /nyon mongs zhi bas pad nyi zlum por gnas/ /mi shes gcod phyir gri gug phreng bas mdzes/ /lha rnams mchod phyir yon tan kun ldan pa'i—/ /bum pa sna tshogs bdud rtsis rab bkang nas/ /'dod yon snam bur lha mo kun ldan zhing / /pañca rā ga rin chen pha gur ldan/ /dra ba dra phyed rin chen nyi 11—488

zla dang / /me tog phreng dang gser gyi dril bu dpyangs/ /brtson 'grus rlung bskyod dam pa'i chos sgra sgogs/ /da ru ka sogs mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /yon tan rgyas phyir gru bzhi sgo bzhis mdzes/ /rin chen rta babs chos 'khor gdugs kyis phug /yid 'ong ri dwags ba dan bcu drug ldan/ /rin chen ka ba twa 1ra ṇa bzhis mdzes/ /ba so pad+ma bkra shis bum pa dang / /thod pa'i phreng ba rdo rje ra bas mdzes/ /legs pa'i sgo khyud dpal ldan phyogs bzhir gnas/ /mi dge rnams bsrung sna tshogs pad+ma'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi ④ra ba bla re gur/ /mda' yi dra ba 'jigs pa'i me dpung 'bar/ /lha klu gnod sbyin srin po gshin rje dang —/ /drag po sreg byed tsha tsha skar khrultar 'phro/ /tshogs brgyad dag phyir dur khrod rab 'jigs byed/ /shi ri ṣa sogs byang chub shing brgyad la/ /khwa gdong la sogs shing lha sprin dang bcas/ /klu dang gnod sbyin lha chen brgyad por ldan/ /dbang po me dang gshin rje srin po dang / /chu bdag rlung lha nor bdag 'byung por ldan/ /sa yi lha mo nyi zla tshangs pa dang / /drag po zhing skyong phyogs mtshams kun na gnas/ /mchod rten brag sogs chu dang me brgyad dang / /nyi shu rtsa bzhi mkha' 'gro gnas pa'i sa/ /'byung po 'dus pa ce spyang sgra sgogs shing / /sha za ro langs 'phra men ma brgyad dang / /u ma dus mtshan dur khrod bdag mor bcas/ /rgyal chen bzhi sogs 'jig rten dbang phyug ldan/ /grub chen brgyad sogs phyag rgya mchog ldan zhing / /grub pa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa rnam mdzes pa'i/ /sgrub pa'i rten gyur bde gshegs kun gyi gnas/ /snod bcud dag la gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /yon tan kun ldan thar pa'i grong mchog la/ /bdag ni rab gus dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhan cig skyes dga' ④rang bzhin bde mchog 11—489

ni| /'khor lo lnga sogs dur khrod bcas bstod pa'i/ /dge ba gang byung des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bde mchog la gnas myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa don thams cad grub pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba rgyal po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa/ slob dpon dā ri ka pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //yul kha che'i mkhan po dhaṭ+wā ①badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges bsgyur ba'o/ /slad kyi rgya gar gyi mkhan po thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta ku mā ra badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma'i rdo rjes rgya gar shar phyogs kyi grong khyer mnga' ldan du bsgyur cing zhus te dag par byas so// //bsdur mchan/479 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa dā ri ka pas mdzad pa bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgos / /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs dā ri ka pas mdzad pa bzhugs so// — lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rdo rjes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //ra / /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ / — yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa rtogs par shog/ // (zhes pa'i chos tshan 'di gnyis deb 'di'i ldeb 492byed547par dpe bsdur byas yod/)①〈〈snar 〉〉rgogo48 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mnga'/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mtshan/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shuka481 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsreg ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsdud/482 ①〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mdzad/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṭā/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉he/483 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ser/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chen/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsol/11—490

0327༄7/ /dpal 'gor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid kyis ba1sa pa zhes bya ba/sna phasngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra sā dha rgo tadh+wa saṃ gra ha nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid kyis bsnyus pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi drin gyi bde chen gnas/ /skad cig nyid la thob 'gyur ba/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu dang //rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma/ /sa gsum gnas la gus btud de/ /de nyid rin chen kun bsdus pa/ /sku gsum po yi cho ga bshad/ /dang por sngags kyis yongs su sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dngen pa'i gnas su dgos pa tshang ba can gyis gnas te/ byang chub tu sems bskyed de / sems can thams cad kyi don 'byung ba dang lha dang bla ma la/ dang po 4dang bla na med pa'i lam la gnas pas dga' bas byang chub chen por nyal bar bya'o/ /de nas tho rangs kyi thun la nam mkha'i khams na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 11byed492

'byor ma thams cad kyi mchog gi sgra dang / ḍā ma rus bskul ba dang langs te—/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ①— rmā kā ya wā ka tsit+ta praṇa me na badz+ra ban+d+ra ram̐ ka ro mi zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis phyag byas te/ lus bde bar gnas pa'i las byas nas/m+bid pa gsum po rnam par dag pa'i gnas keng rus kyi dbus su sa bcu'i rang bzhin du bsams te gnas la/ rnal 'byor bsrung ba'i don du tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas/ phung po dang dbang po dang /khams rnams kyi nga rgyal bskyed par bya ste/ de la gzugs kyi phung po ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /'du byed kyi phung po ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni rdo rje mi bskyod pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni dpal te ru ka'o/ /mig ①la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje'o/ /lce la 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /skye mched kyi bdag po la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ni ltung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams la ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni dgug ①byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la ni gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma'i dra ba can ma'o/ /de dag ni phung po dang dbang po dang khams rnam par dag pa go cha'i lha ste/ bdag bsrung ba'o/ /he ru ka rnam par rgyal ba'i nga rgyal brtan pas/ g.yas pa'i khro bo'i khu tshur snying gar bsgreng ste/g.yon se gol dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub phyogs su bskor zhing / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ ④phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa greṇ+ḍa hūṃ hūṃ ⑪phaṭa/ oṃ kṛsnra ⑥pa ya grerje ñju/pa ya hūṃ hūṃ ⑪phaṭa—/ oṃ un ya hoḥbha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūṃ ⑨phaṭa/ ces brjod cing zhal gyi sgo 11—493

nas 'od zer gyi tshogs du ma spros pas bgegs rnams bskrad cing bsreg par rnam par bsams par byas la/ 'od de nyid dang / oṃ me di ni badzī bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūṃ zhes brjod pas/ 'og rtse gsum pa'i bdag nyid kyi sna tshogs rdo rjer byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ka ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañja ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ bi tā 1na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la tram̐ saṃ tram̐ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/zhes bya ba'i sngags rnams kyis rim 9lde༄bzhin du rdo rje'i ra ba dang / gur dang /bla re dang / mda'i dra ba dang / me ri 'bar ba'i mthar thug par bsams te/las thams cad pa'i khro bor snyespros nas bgegs kyi dbang po rnams bkug ste/ oṃ/ ghaḥghaḥghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti / sarba be+ergyu kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba'i sngags kyis phur bus gdab bo/ /oṃbadz+ra muṅga ra/ badz+ra gī la ya k+ṣiṃko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya bas phur bu rnams brdung ngo / /de nas rang gi snying gar a ༄5las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūṃ sngon po 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba bsams te/ de'i 'od kyis mdun gyi bar snang la bla ma dang sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i tshogs bltas te phyag byas nas/ phyi dang gsang ba dang / de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas yang dag par mchod de/ sdog pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o//thog ma med dus 'khor ba na/ /chags sogs rtog pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sdig bgyis mgon po'i spyan snga ru/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yis/ /nyer bsdus 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /bsod nams tshogs ni ma lus la/ /rtag par bdag ni yi rang ngo / /rdo rje'i ye shes thugs chud nas—/ /shing dbang drung na bzhugs gyur pa'i/ /'gro la nyer brtses thub dbang 11—494

rnams/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rdzogs gyur te//mgon po dbyengs su gshegs bzhed la/ /sems can sdug bsngal bral bar du/ /mya ngan mi 'dar bdag gsol 'debs/ /bdag ni thub dbang ma gyur bar/ /sangs rgyas sngags sogs chos rnams dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs bcas/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor lam la gnas bgye zhing / /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las/ /grol bar bdag gis bsgrub par bgyi/ /rten sogs dge ba de dag gis/ /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bdag gyur nas/ /'gro ba yongs su grol byed shog /de nas dngos po rnams yongs su bsal bar byas nas/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha ba shurnyo3haṃ/ zhes bya bas dag par byas nas nye bar bsdus te nā da tsam gyi ye shes la oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa byed kopho①haṃ zhes brjod pas byang chub kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'o//de las langs te yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla ba bkas pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po g.yung drung gis mtshan pa gru gsum pa'o/ /de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du lo las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du sum̐ las ri rab chen po rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin las grub pa gru bzhi pa rtse mo brgyad kyis nye bar mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje dang / de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma ge sar gyi phreng bas mtshan pa'o/ /de'i dbus su phywali kā li la dag pa rnams uli kā li'i rnam par bsdus la de (9gyur pa las nyi ma dang zla ba'i gzugs 11—495

su bsams te/ de'i bar du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin can bsam par bya'o/ /de'i 'od kyis dag pa dang ma dag pa rnams bsnyus te gyur pa las dpal he ru ka dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pas rdzogs par gyur te gru bzhi lasgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ rdo rje rtse mo can dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ ka ba sum cu rtsa gnyis sam brgyad kyis spras pa/ dar dang zla ba dang nyi ma dang rnga yab dang / 'phan la sogs pas brgyan pa de'i phyi rol na rdo rje'i sa gzhi la dur khrod brgyad gnas pa ste/shar phyogs su drag tu gtum par mdung gis phug pa'i ro dang shīr ṣa ta la glang po'i gdong dang / dbang po dang / lha'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang / nor rgyas dang / sgrogs byed rnams gnas pa'o/ /byang phyogs tshang tshing rnam par 'khrigs par byang chub kyi shing la gnod sbyin ④gdong dang / ku bai ra dang /gnod sbyin gyi tshogs dang / sbrul gyis zos pa ba dang / 'jog po dang / sprin gyi rgyal po ldog byed rnams gnas pa'o/ /nub phyogs 'ur 'ur 'bar bar mya ngan med pa'i shing la chu srin gyi gdong can dang / rul pa ①dang chu lha dang / sprin byi rgyal po dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang / 'jigs par byed pa rnams so/ /lho phyogs mthug pa'i ④dur khrod du bsregs pa'i ro dang / tsu ⑦ta'i shing la me bute'i gdong dang / gshin rje dang gshin rje'i tshogs dang / pad+ma dang 'khor byed rnams so/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams ha har dgod par bgegs ⑦pa'i ro dang /n+ya gro dha'i shing la khyu mchog gi gdong dang dbang ldan dang / yi dwags kyi tshogs dang —/ pad+ma chen po dang / gang ba rnams kyis mdzes pa'o me'i mtshams nags tshal phun sum tshogs par dum bur gyur pa'i ro dang / ka rañja sprika'i shing 11byed496

la ra'i gdong can dang / me lha dang / drang srong gi tshogs dang / hu lun ta dang —/ bgegs byed rnams kyis stigang ba'o/ /bden bral gyi mtshalas su mun pa mi bzad par byis pa shi ba'i ro dang / 'khri shing la yi dwags kyi gdong dang /m+bin po dang srin po'i tshogs dang rigs ldan dang / char 'bebs rnams so/ /rlung du shā li tī li'i ④sgra sgrogs pa ①smyo ba'i ro dang / u dus+thā ra'i shing la/ ri dwags kyi gdong dang / rlung lha dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang / dung skyong dang sprin stug po rnams so/ /de ltar dur khrod chen po der lha brgyad dang gza' brgyad dang / mkha' 'gro ma chen mo brgyad dang / 'byung po'i tshogs dang /ri dang chu dang me dang sku gdung chen po brgyad dang / rnal 'byor pa brgyad dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang smyo byed dang / brjed 9byed dang / yi dwags dang —/ sha za dang / mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gang zhing khwa dang / bya rgod dang /khya dang / 'ug pa dang / mgrin rings dang / wa dang / spyang ki dang / ce spyang 'dus shing sgra 'byin pa'o/ /yongs su sgogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi snying po la bcom ldan 'das sku mdog sngon po/ /shin tu khros pa dang / chags pa dang /zhi ba dang / mnyam pa'i zhal sngon po dang dmar po dang / ljang gu dang /ser po mnga' ba/ zhal re re la yang spyan gsum pa/ rdo rje dang thod pa'i dbu rgyan can ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis mdzes pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang —/ mi bskyod pa gnas pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ brgya phyed pa'i mgo bo dang / sbrul gye tshangs skud can/ phyag bcu gnyis pa rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag gis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa—/ gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa bsnams pa/ g.yas pa'i lhag mas ḍa ma 11—497

ru dang dgra sta dang gri gug dang / rtse gsum 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams na kha ṭī ga dang thod pa dang rdo rje zhags pa dang / tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa/zhabs g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa'o/ /rdo rje phag mo ni sku mdog dmar mo ①zhal mche ba gcigs pa/ khrag la dgyes pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag gis 'khyud pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bde bas dgyes pa/phyag rgya lnga dang thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan par gnas pa'o/ /shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo dang / byang du khā ma ljang gu dang / nub du dum skyes ma dmar mo dang /lho ru gzugs can ma ser mo dang / mtshams su bum pa pad+ma'i snod dang ldan pa/dri chen dang / dri chu dang / rang byung ①dang / klad pa dang / khya bas gang ba'o—/ /de ltar lha lnga'i bdag nyid dam/ thung zhing sgeg pa'i sku rdo rje dang dril bu dang ḍa ma ru dang / kha ṭī ga dang thod pa bsnams pa'i rang bzhin 'khor lo lha skelnga dang bcas pa 'am/ bsdus pa'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gi 'khor lo gnyis bsgom par bya ste/ khwa gdong nag mo dang / ljang gu 'ug gdong dang khyi gdong dmar mo dang / phag gdong ser mo dang / gshin rje brtan ma dang / gshin rje 'joms ma dang / gshin rje pho nya mo dang / gshin rje mche ba ma rnams gzugs gnyis ma'i rang bzhin can te/ zhal gcig pa phyag bzhi ma gri gug dang thod pa dang / ḍa ma ru dang / kha ṭī ga bsnams pa zhabs g.yas brkyang bas ro mnan pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo'i do shal can sgeg pa'i zhal dang 'jigs su rung bar gnas pa'o/ /de ltar sprul pa'i sku'i sgom pa la gnas te/longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cho ga rdzogs par bya ba gsungs pa/ te ru ka la sogs pa'i lha—/ /rtsa yi gzugs kyis yang dag gnas/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor nyams dga' 11—498

ba'i/ /rkang pa'i dkyil du bskyod byed rlung / /gzhu yi dbyebs su yang dag gnas/ /sum mdo'i gnas su me yi dngos/ /gru gsum 'bar bar yang dag gnas/ /lto bar chu ni rlum po ste/ /snying gar sa ni gru bzhi gnas/ /sgal tshigs dbyug pa'i ri rab nyid/ /rang gi yan lag las byung ba'i/ /ka ba brgyad ni nye bar gnas/ /chu zheng kun tu mnyam pa yis/ /gru bzhi par ni rab tu grags/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo yis/ /dkyil 'khor gsum ni nges par gsungs/ /pu dzā o a go rā de mā/ /kā o tri ko ka la kā hi/ /pre kṛ sau sun si ma ku/ /mtshogs ma pul+li ①ma la yar/ /mi phyed rtsa ni so sen 'bab/ /rab gtum thod pa'i dum bu nyid/ /spyi gtsug dzā ladzha ra ra ni/ /skra sru 'bab pa phra rnyigazugs ma/ /keng rus gtum pa'i mig can ma/ /o byun ①rna ba g.yas pa'i stengs/ /pags dang dri ma brtse ba ma/ /keng rus can dang 'od ldan ma'o/ /lag ④pa'i steng na ar pu da/ /g.yon pa mar ni sha yi khams/ /'bab pa mche gatshigs sna chen ma/ /go dā ba ri rna ba g.yon/ /thung ngu ma ni rgyu ma ⑤'bab /lha dgra dang ni dpa' blo can/ /rā me shwa ra smin ma'i dbus/ /rus sbal skyes ma rus pa 'bab/ /'od dpag med dang mi thung ma/ /lha mo'i mkhar ni mig gnyis la/ /sgom pa ma ni mkhal ma 'bab/ /laṅka'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'od/ /dpung pa'i rtsa bar mā la be+e/ /snying gi khams 'bab dbang ma ste/ /rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma/ /mkha' spyod nyid de thugs 'khor lo/ /kā ma rū ⑥ni mchan khung la—/ /mig gi khams 'bab skyon 'byen ma/ /myu gu can dang sa srungs ma/ /nu ma gnyis la otre ste/ /mjug ma mkhris pa 'bab pa nyid/ /ral pa can dang 'jigs byed ma'o/ /tri sha ku ni lte bar te/ /ma mo'i rtsa ni glo ba 'bab /11—499

dpa' bo chen ①dang rlung shugs ma/ /sna yi rtse mor ko sa la/ /mtshan mo'i rtsa ni rgyu ma 'bab/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad chang 'thung ma/ /ka ling ga ni kha la ste/ /bsel sbyin ma ni gnye ma 'bab/ /rab tu bzang dang sngo bsangs mo/ /mgrin pa'i gnas su las+thā ②ka /tsha ba ma ni pho ba 'bab/ /rdo rje 'od dang shin tu bzang / /kāñci snying ga'i gnas su ste/ /gzhol ma'i rtsa ru dri chen 'bab/ /'jigs byed chen po rta rna ma/ /hi mā la mi ④chu so ru/ /shin tu gzugs can mtshan ma 'bab/ /mig mi bzang dang bya rgod ma/ /gsung ste sa spyod bdag nyid kyi/ /mkha' 'gro mar ni shes par bya/ /pre ta pu ri mtshan ma la/ /rangs ma'i rtsa ni mchil ma 'bab/ /'khor lo'i shugs ma stobs po che/ /kṛ ha de ba bshang lam la—/ /dpyi ma'i rtsa ni rnag 'bab la/ /rin chen rdo rje dum skyes ma/ /sau rāṣ+ṭa ste brla gnyis la/ /rgyu sbyin ma ni khrag 'bab ma/ /rta mgrin dang ni chang 'thung ma//gser gling byin pa gnyis la ste/ /sbyor bral ma ni rdul 'bab byed/ /mkha' snying 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ /rkang pa'i sor mo na ga ra/ /sdug gu ma ni tshil bu 'bab/ /shin tu dpa' mo ho ru ka /sin+tu rkang pa'i bol nyid la/ /grub ma'i rtsa ni mchi ma 'bab/ /pad+ma gar dbang stobs chen mo/ /ma ru ④rkang pa'i mthe bo ste/ /'tshed ma kha chu 'bab pa nyid/ /rnam snang 'khor los ⑤sgyur ba mo/ /ku lu tā ni pus mo la/ /yid bzangs ma ni snabs skyed byed/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gtso chen mo/ /sku ste sa 'og spyod ma yi/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' bor shes par bya/ /lte ba'am snying ga'i rtsa bzhi ni/ /'byung lnga'i rlung dang bdud rtsi 'bab/ /bde chen dgu yi bdag nyid bsam/ /phyag brgyad dam ni sgo brgyad du/ /las kyi rlung ngam byed bdag gis/ /khwa gdong gshin rje ma sogs brgyad/ /me long nang gi 11—500

gzugs bzhin du/ /rang gi cha lugs brgyan pa'i tshul/ /ro yi gdan la legs par dgod/ /'od 'phro 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can/ /mdzes shing 'jigs pa'i gzugs can no/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /yi ge gsum gyi ngo bo nyid//mtho ris mi yul sa 'og tu/ /skad cig gis ni sku nyid gyur/ /skad cig gis ni rnal 'byor bdag /skad cig sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan/ /kun nas kun du skad cig ste/ /skad cig gis ①gsang sngags ldan no/ /skastosahūṃ/ oṃsarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ②ya wāka cis badz+ra swa bhā ba ākhya kopho①haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shudhaḥsarba dhamatshobadz+ra shurnyophohaṃrtsi.oṃlngasahūṃ/ ho duyig gis/ phyag rgya bzhis ni rgyas btab bya/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka cis dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kophodze+ehaṃ/ ye shes las byung 'od tshogs kyis/ /rkang pa nas ni gtsug tor mthar/ /lus kun rab tu gsal ⑧byas nas/ /khams gsum khyab par rab tu spro/ /mdzub mo mdud byas gung mo sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rjer brtan byas nas/ /dpral ba'i steng du rab gzhag ste/ /bskor zhing kun du bskor bar bya/ /rkang pa mnan cing steng du blta//gyen du dze ⑨gyi sgra sgogs shing / /phyogs bcu khams na bzhugs pa yi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dgug /sngags dang phyag rgyar rab ldan pas/ /dgug sogs dam tshig ro mnyam bya⑩/ /oṃ yo ga shudhaḥsarba dharmātshohūṃyo ga shurjophohaṃ/ /de nas sngags kyi mtshon cha dgod/ /snying gar oṃ ha'i rnam pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag dgod/ /gnyis pa dpal ldan rnam snang mdzad/ /mtshog ⑫mar na ma hi nyid do/ /spyi gtsug swā hā hu nyid ni/ /mgon po pad+ma gar dbang rgyal/ /bzhi pa dpal ldan te ru ka /phrag pa la ni bo ṣaṭa te/ /mig gnyis la ni hūṃ hūṃ ho—/ /rdo rje nyi ma gzi brjid ldan/ /drug pa rta mchog rgyal po nyid/ /phaṭa haṃ 11—501

tshigs ①kun mtshon pa'o/ /lte bar oṃbaṃ phag mo'i bdag /haṃ oṃ snying gar gsod byed ma/ /hri ②mo kha la rmongs byed ma/ /dpral bar hri hri 1skyong byed nyid| /hūṃ hūṃ spyi gtsug skrag byed ma/ /tshigs dumatha' kun la phaṭa phaṭa te/ /gtum mo'i bdag nyid rnam par bsam/ /bdag ⑤tshogs kun gyis rjogayo ba yi/ /go cha srung ba bla na med/ /lus las khams gsum kun bkang ste/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /nam mkha'i gtos ni bkang byas la/ /'dod pa lnga ni mnyes gyur nas/ /mgon po sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la sprul/ /yid kyis gsol ba legs btab pas/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yin—/ /de bzhin du ni sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shi ye hūṃ/ de ltar sngags de brjod nas su/ /pad+ma'i bum pas dbang bskur bsam//lha rnams lus la bsdus nas kyang / /mchod sprin kun gyis yang dag mchod/ /sna tshogs bstod pas mngon bstod nas/ /bdud rtsi mchog la longs spyod bya/ /dpa' bos lha rnams gsal dmigs nas/ /chos kyi sku la nges par sbyar/ /dpa' bo lhan cig skyes dga'i dngos/ /dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin/ /me long la sogs ye shes bzhi/ /mkha' 'gro ma bzhi pad+mar gnas/ /lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag ④pa ni lā ma'o/ /chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o//sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni rab tu gtum ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gtum pa'i mig go/ /dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'od ldan ma'o/ /sems kyirdzu 11—502

'phrul gyi rkang pa ni sna chen ma'o/ /dad pa'i dbang po ni brtan pa'i blo can ma'o//brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni mi thung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po ni laba'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni shing grib ma'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni sa srungs ①ma'o/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni rlung gi shugs chen ⑤ma'o/ /dran pa'i stobs ni chang 'thung ma'o—/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni sngo bsangs ①ma'o/ /shes rab kyi stobs ni shin tu bzang mo'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta rna ma'o//brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni bya gdong ma'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni khaṇ+ḍa ro ha'o/ /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni shoṇ+ḍa duni'o/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni shin tu stobs chen ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni 'khor los 'a)sgyur ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni brtson 'grus chen mo'o6 / /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni khwa gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa ni gshin rje brtan ma'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams bsrung ba ni gshin rje pho nya ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed ⑦pa ni gshin rje mche ba ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos skye ba ⑧rnams spong ba ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /de dag ni dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams gnyis su 11—503

med pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /k+ṣiṃli kā li mngon bsams nas/ /rnal 'byor chen po ngal bso ste/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ni/ /lte ba'i rtsa bar gnas par bsgom/ /yi ge rnams kyi mchog gyur pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /lha yi sku ni bsgom par bya/ /de ni gzugs las 'das pa ste/ /dngos po med pa'i sems nyid yin/ /sems nyid rtog pas mi bslang ngo / /bsam gyis mi khyab de bsams na/ /de las gzugs ni thob par 'gyur/ /shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te—/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /de ltar sku gsum sbyor ba yis/ /gnas byas dpa' bo de yis ①ni/ /yon tan thob pa gang yin pa/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /kha ni brgya stong du ma yis/ /brjod par nus pa ma yin no/ /de nas sngags kyi dngos grub phyir/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa rab tu brtsam/ /oṃ ṭībadz+ra he he ru ru ke hūṃ 1hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra ④swā hā/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ s+thāḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭarjo/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa byā ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'i sngags so—/ /oṃ sarba budhe ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o//sdig kun las ni rnam grol zhing / /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed yin/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa badz+ra khā ma ye duhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ kṛṭ+wā pa ya kṛ1 pa ya badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ro hi ⑥hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣiṃn ya ho bha ga bān badz+ra rā dza badz+ra byu pi bhā ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃn mo bha ga ba te wi dze+ere shā ya badz+ra kā kā phye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ka la pa asni saṃ ni bhā ya badz+ra u phru ④kā phye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃdza ṭa ⑨ma ku ṭota ka ḍā ya badz+ra shwa nā gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rdaṭī ka rā lo gra dhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya badz+ra sru ka rā gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya ya ma dā d+dhā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/11—504

oṃ pa ra shu pā sho r+ya ta shu la kha ṭī ga d+ma ri be+e badz+ra ya ma dru tī ①hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃbyā s+thā dzi rmā ba ra dha rā ya badz+ra ya ma rdaji ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhuswā na rnya ka ra wa pu ṣā ya badz+ra ya ma ma thā ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rang gi yum dang gnyis su med pa zhal bzhi dang rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags te bcu pa ①sbyin sreg dang bcas pas bzlas so/ /gzhan yang rgyas pa'i tshul la yang / oṃ ka ra ka ra badz+ra pra tsaṇ+ḍi badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa rnams oṃ dang hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar chud pa phreng ba'i sngags dang / dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams 'byel bar bzlas so/ /mda'i 'od dang sgo'i 'od dang / lu gu rgyud dang / sum sgril ni cho ga'i khyad par ro/ /thams cad du'am tshes bcu la/ /rang 'dod las la gtor ma sbyin/ /dang po dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /chang sogs longs spyod kyis mchod nas/ /'bar ba'i phyag rgya rab bcings nas/ /skra sgol gcer bur gyur pa yis/ /lho yi phyogs su kha bltas la/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung nas brtsams nas/ /dur khrod gnas kyi mthar thug par/ /mthon po'i gnas su mchod par bya/ /skye bo dam pa kun 'dus la/ /bde ba thams cad dbul bar bya/ /der ni bza' ba rnams zos la//lhag ma sdod gnyis gzhag par bya/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor bdag /de yis ma mo dga' bar 'gyur/ /de yis ④lag tu 'ongs pa'i dpal/ /gang gis kyang ni 'phrog mi nus/ /skye bo dang ldan kun gyis mchod/ /he ru ka dpal dgyes gyur nas/ /spyod dang grol ba'i 'bras rab gsol/ /oṃ a ral+li ho/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki n+yaḥs ma ya ste dṛ sh+ya hoḥ/ lan gsum lnga yis gyebar du brjod/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen du phye/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rakā sa byu ta—/ pre ta pi shā tsa/ un ma da/ a pasma ⑤ra badz+ra ḍā ka ḍā kit+yā da ya/ i oṃ 11—505

ba lo greṇ+ḍan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sedhi pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the 17baṃ/ ya thesgo rngu / bhuñja tha/ bi ba tha1/ mā ti pra zhwam tha/ ma ma sarba karta ⑤ya sa ta su khaṃ ba zid dha 7ye/ sa te yi kā bha ban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshaṣ+ṭa bhak+ṣa ka swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis gtor ma phul la/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma mchog yin de / /bden pa de dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces brjod la yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya ste/sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dga' bas sems can rnams bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du yang dag par gnas par bya'o/ /bdag don 'gyur dang gzhan la rnam brtse bas/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub pa yi/ /thabs/ dag cung zad bkod la tshul min pa/ /'byung 'gyur nyes pa mkhas rnams bzod par mdzod/ /'di yis bsod nams mtha' med sgrub gyur gang yin des / /mtha' med sems can bde ba'i lam zhugs sangs rgyas shog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs de kho na nyid bsdus pa zhes bya ba/slob dpon chen po rig pa'i brtul zhugs pa dpal dā ri ka pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // baṅga la'i paṇ+ḍi ta ku mā ra badz+ra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rdo rjes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o /11—506
