༷328༄7/ /dpal 'gor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de go na nyid la 'jug pa jes bya ba/shesna༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍa la bi bye ta twa a ba ta ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid la 'jug pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /m+bid las grol zhing yon tan mtha' yas dang ldan 'bras la nyer spyor ba/ /rin chen sgon gyur bla ma mchog ste 'jig rten ston pa rdo rje sems/ /skyon bral zhabs la nyer btud 'gro la rnam brtses 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cher 'byung cho ga mchog ldan gyur pa de nyid la 'jug bshad/ /de nyid dbang bskur sngon 'gro bas / /gsol 'debs slob ma'i mtshan nyid dag /gnas lnga'i yon tan 'dzin pa 'am/ /dad pa yis ni nges 'gro ba/ /theg gsum don las mi 'da' zhing / /theg pa mchog la mngon dga' dang / /slob dbon la ni rab dad cing / /'gro la snying brtse bden par smra/ /mchog 'dod don la spyor nus pa/ /11—509

rab dang snod du yongs shes nas/ /sku gsum po yi cho ga yis/ /dang por lha ni bsnyen par bya/ /dpa' bo lha mo khri phrag gsum/ /stong phrag nyi shus 'khor lo gsum/ /phyi dang nang gi 'khor lo gnyis/ /stong phrag phyed dang drug tu bzlas/ /'bring ngam chung ngu'i tshul gnas na/ /dkyil 'khor dbang po 'bum du ste/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro stong phrag bcu/ /bzlas te lha rnams mnyes par bya/ /ye shes mchog la khri phrag ste/ /sbyin sreg mchog gis nye bar mchod/ /lha rnams mnyes par ma gyur na/ /sgrub po grub la mi ①brten cing / /de yis 'gro ba gzung mi nus—/ /de bas sngon du nges bya ba/ /bsnyen pa gsum po rnam par spyad/ /'khor lo mchog ④sogs phun tshogs nas/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog dang ldan pas/ /lan gsum du ni gsol ba yid/ /cho gas tshul bzhin bsgrub par bya/ /dpa' bo 'byor pa'i dus shes nas/ /brtser ldan yongs su dag pa'i blos/ /'jigs bral dpa' bo'i sems kyis ni/ /'gro ba bsgral zhes rnam bsams te/ /ri bo ri sul tshang tshing phug /sman ljongs rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang ni/ /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod dam/ /phun tshogs 'tshe ba med pa dang / /dbe+en zhing gang du yid 'jug pa/ /der ni dpal chen dkyil 'khor bri/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor gyis/ /zhing skyong gnas kyi bdag po dag /legs mchod khru gang gru bzhi pa'i/ /maṇ+ḍal byas te me tog gtor/ /lha rnams bskyed de mchod pa dang / /bstod sogs las kyi mthar thug par/ /byas nas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i mgon po rnams/ /bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /mgon po rgyal ba sras mchod cing / /slob ma rnams la sman slad du/ /dpal ldan rdo rje ho ru ka'i/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa 'brir 'tshad ba'i/ /dpa' bornal 11—510

'byor ma rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin rlabs mchog gnang mdzod/ /lan gsum du ni nges byas nas/ /dur khrod bdag po rnams bkug ste/ /me tog gtor ma'i mthar thug par/ /mchod nas gsol ba'i tshig dag ni/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin/ /gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ldan zhing —/ /'byung po bstan pa la dga' ba/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang / /sems can kun la phan don du//sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ /ji ltar bsams pa'i las byed na/ /khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /de ltar khyed la bdag gis ni/ /don rnams gsol gyis mi stislu bar/ /rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma dang / /legs nyes ltas rnams bstan du gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum gsol btab nas/ /sa sbyang ba ni brtsam par bya/ /zhi ba 'am drag po ④las byung ba/ /sbyin sreg dag ni byas pa'am/ /las kyi chu yis gtor byas nas/ /dpa' bo las kyi rdo rje yis/ /dngos grub rnam pa gsum gyi phyir/ /pus mo'am lte ba 'am gog ma yi/ /mtshams nub bar du sa brkos ④la/ /sdong dum sol ba gseg ma dang / /gyo mo sderus pa phub 'am thal/ /gos rus rdo dang pha (nyagu rnams/ /bsal byas nas ni legs par brtag /zug rngu'i nyes pa thams cad ni/ /gal te dbyung bar ma nus na7 / /lag pas byab cing gsang sngags bzlas/ /de yi sbyang ba de yin te/ /zug rngu'i nyes pa skye mi 'gyur/ /chu'am sas ni yongs brtags nas/ /ltas ngan pa ni spang bar bya/ /sman 'bru rin chen lnga bcug nas/ /dri yi 'uchu dang rnam ( ḍa/bsres pa'i/ /sas ni khung bu dgang bar bya/ /der ni 'thas par bcag byas 11—51 1

nas—/ /sngags pa rnams kyi dngos grub rgyu/ /shar dang byang du gzhol bar bya/ /dbus su mtho bas rgyal srid dam/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas dag thob/ /byang du mtho bas 'ching ba'amakhyaste/ /nor rnams nges par 'jig ④par byed/ /ji ltar bshad pa'i shar mtho bas/ /myur du rigs rnams zad par byed/ /dbus su dma' bas grub med cing / /sgrub pa po ni 'joms dang ldan/ /de lta'i skyon rnams yongs spangs te/ /khru gang nas brtsams khru stong ngam/ /khru ni bcu gnyis dang ldan par/ /gru bzhi shin tu mdzes par bya/ /mchod pa'i sa dang ldan byas te—/ /shin tu dog par mi bya'o/ /phyi ba sa la ma lhung bas/ /dkyil 'khor sa ni legs par byug /dur khrod kyi ni thal ba dang / /mi 'chi bcu phyed byas pas byug /me tog sil mas legs bkang ste/ /bdag nyid dpal ldan khrag 'thung gi—/ /cha lugs legs par gnas byas nas/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung sbyor ba yis—/ /dang por tshogs ni rab rdzogs pas/ /bhu khaṃ zhes ni mngon brjod nas/ /sa ni nam mkha' bsam par bya/ /hūṃ lo ṣ+pehūṃ las rdo rje yis/ /rnam bskyed rdo rje bsdams pa dag /bkan byas nas ni sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ me di ni badzī bha ba badz+ra ban+ta hūṃ/ de nas bzlas pa'i mthar thug par/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgom byas nas/ /rigs bzhi nga rgyal legs 'chang ba'i/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin las kyi bdag /gsol ba 'debs par dmigs byas te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan med thams cad rnam par spangs/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog 11—512

las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam spyod pa/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de ltar gsol ba'i tshig thos nas/ /rnam rgyal te ru kar byas te/ /mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las byung / /nyi ma zla ba rab bsgoms la—/ /de dbus hūṃ las rdo rje che/ /nag po khro tshogs 'od 'phro bsam/ /rkang mthil aḥlas sna tshogs kyi/ /rdo rje 'od zer dang ldan dgod/ /rdo rje dril bu kha ṭī 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg nas kyang / /rdo rje lta ba dang bcas pas—/ /byang shar byu ni mtshams 'dug ste/ /rdo rje gsor bar mngon brtson pas—/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas deng du bdag la gson/ /nga ni dpal ldan he ru ka /bka' yi 'khor lor 6༄rab sbyor gyis/ /lha klu lha min gsang ba pa/ /brjed /2byed la sogs bgegs kyi tshogs/ /sa 'dir ma gnas gzhan du dengs/ /gal te bdag bsgo las 'das na/ /rdo rje khro bo bzhin 'bar ba'i—/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /mgo ni tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing / /'jig par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung nga ror ldan/ /lan gsum du ni brjod par bya/ /g.yas nas lan gsum bskor ba dang / /hūṃ zhes bya ba rab brjod nas/ /rdo rje gom pas 'gro ba dang / /shar dang lho dang nub dang byang / /g.yon brkyang ba dang g.yas brkyang dang / /rlum po dang ni sa ga rnams/ /lan gsum du ni bsgrims te bya/ /rdo rje khro mo dang ldan pas/ /gom stabs rnam pa brgyad du 'gyur/ /de nas dbus su 'ongs nas kyang / /sor ni bcu gnyis dang ldan zhing / /seng ldeng la sogs dri mar bsgus/ /dar dmar 11—513

me tog phreng btags pa'i/ /phur bu bcu ni byas nas kyang / /bgegs dgrar byin brlabs zhal bzhi pas/ /dgug pas bka' yi 'khor lo spyad/ /dbang ldan la sogs phyogs bcur gdab/ /mtha' yi dbyangs yig las byung ba'i/ /sa ni sna tshogs rdo rjer bya/ /rdo rje lta ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /ra ba dang ni dra ba bya/ /bdag nyid go chas rnam bsrungs nas/ /dpa' bo brtan par gnas pa bya/ /sa'i cho ga ste dang po'o// //de nas nang par sngar langs te/ /mchod pa kun dang rab ldan pas/ /rnal 'byor rnam par rdzogs dmigs te/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su 'dug nas ni//sa gnon pa yi phyag rgya yis/ /ṭak+ki ni hūṃ dzaḥ.oṃ haṃ/ /sngags des gser kyi mdog ldan zhing / /rtag pas ral ba'i tshogs mtshan pa/ /rgyan mdzes gser gyi bum par ldan/ /pad+ma dkar po la gnas shing / /bdag la bka' nod lha mo lha / /mchod yon zhal bsel sogs phul nas/ /spos snod rdo rje dril 'dzin pas / /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis / /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis nya/bdud sde las//rgyal par bya ste — dkyil 'khor bri/ /lan gsum brjod pas rjes gnang ste/ /de nyid du ni thim par bsam/ /de nas/ ga bur la sogs dri yi chus/ /dkyil 'khor kun du snyoms par byug /dri zhim dam tshig dang ldan pas/ /dbus su gru bzhir rang sngags kyis/ /de bzhin kun du rab tu zlum/ /rang rang sngags kyis me tog dgod/ /rang sngags lha yi bdag nyid bsam/ /mar me la sogs mchodapa kun / /lha yi grangs bzhin rnam bkod de/ /bcu las dman pa nyid mi bya/ /11—514

'bad de bskyed pa rdzogs gyur nas/ /'bar ba'i phyag rgya rab bcings te/ /rkang pa mnan cing steng du blta/ /gyen du phe gyi sgra sgrogs shing / /phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs gyur pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams ni/ /spyan drangs dgug gzhug bcing ba dang / /dbang du byas te byen gyis brlab/ /rang rang sngags kyis ①legs mchod nas/ /tha dad dam tshig dam tshig ches/ /mchod de rang rang gsang sngags bzlas/ /dgyes pa che la rnam bkod nas/ /sna tshogs mchod pas rab tu mchod/ /rdzas rnams thams cad bkod nas ni/ /lha rnams snyan gsan dbab par bya/ /g.yas par spos snod rdo rje dang / /g.yon pas dril 'dzin pus btsugs nas/ /he ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag ni bri bar 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de ni gnang ba mdzad pa'i rigs/ /'gro ba'i 'khor lo don mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /sha dang rdo rje'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /te ru ka 'byung dkyil 'khor ni/ /yo byad ci 'byor pas 'dri na//deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byen gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum gsol btab nas/ /ra ba dra ba la sogs pas/ /mtshams 11—515

bcing ba ni brtan byas nas/ /g.yas kyis ci bder nyal te brtag /de nas bum pa bya ba ni/ /rin chen gser ram zangs la sogs/ /yang na sa yi khams las byung / /mgrin mtho lto ba'ang yangs pa dang / /mchu 'phyang kha khyer dang ldan zhing / /rtsa ba nag ①pos legs bskus te/ /bsang bdug bgegs bskrad sngon 'gro bas/ /dri zhim pa yi chus bkang ste/ /'bras kyi so ba mon sran gre'u/ /nas dang gro dang til dag dang / /mu tig gser dang rin chen dang / /byu ru dngul ni dri ma med/ /bya gyi sang 1 ha sa dang / /ha sa de ba ka ṇi ka /me tog kha dog lnga po dang / /ga pur gur kum tsan+dan dang / /tsan+dan dmar po gla rtsi rnams/ /sngags bzlas nas ni blug par bya/ /kha dog lnga yi ⑪srad bu dang / /mgrin pa gos zung mchog gis dkri/ /'dab bcas me tog 'bras ldan pa'i/ /lcug ma yis ni kha brgyan te/ /pad+ma'i dbus su rigs kyi mtshan/ /rang rang bum pa brgyan par bya/ /me tog phreng sogs mdzes byas te/ /brgyad ni sgo mtshams 'a/ bkod de/ /bum pa dgu pa dbus su gzhag /shar sgo yi ni g.yon logs su/ /las kun byed pa rab tu dgod/ /dri yi dung ni rnam rgyal te/ /rgyal ba'i steng du dgod par bya/ /rdo rje spyi bor rab bzhag nas/ /srad bu yis ni kun du sbrel/ /bsangs te stong pa'i rang bzhin las/ /rgyu de)las bum pa gzhal yas gyur / /dang por spyor bas lha bskyed la/ /las kun byed par las bdag nyid/ /dbang bskur mthar thug mchod de bzlas/ /bdud rtsi yis /thani rnam rgyal dag /mthar ni rgyal sogs zhu bar bya/ /las kun khya bar 6bka' bsgo ste/ /brtan pa'i sems su gnas par bya/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas slob marjes bzung ba/ /mtshan nyid bzang dang ldan gyur pa'i/ /mkhas pas slob ma gcig 11—516

dag gam/ /gsum mam yang na lnga 'am ni/ /bdun nam nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /zung du ma them yongs su gzung ①/ /de las lhag pa'i slob ma dag /yongs su gzung bar mi shes so/ /mdor na slob ma phan tshun du/ /nang mi gshin pa mi gzung ②ngo / /tha ma sdom pa lngas gzung nas/ /gzhan rnams lam la gzung bar bya / /bgegs la gtor ma sbyin byas te/ /zhal bzhi pa yi sngags bzlas shing / /chang bu dang ni mar mes sbyang / /gu gul yungs kar gyis bgegs bsal/ /til la sdig pa'i gzugs dmigs nas/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na ①bhasmi ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod g.yas dang g.yon pa yis/ /g.yas g.yon du ni yongs bskor nas/ /me dang chu la blug ④par bya/ /lus /5kun byed pas bkrus nas ni/ /bsam pa bzang la gzhag 6)par bya/ /sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /'di na dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ /de las gzhan pa'i dngos grub 'dod/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i/ /dad pa mang du byed pa yis/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yis/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la—/ /'jig rten pha rol tsa don khru'abyung / /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes—/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu rab tu rgyas/ /slob dpon gyis ni rab tu brjod/ /bsdus byas rang gi lus nang du/ /sbyang bya khang skor maṇ+ḍal bya/ /phul nas gsol ba 'dis btab bo/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsola'-i/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la sprul⑩/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang 11—517

bdag la sprul①/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de ltar lan gsum gsol ba dang / /slob ma'i gtso bo la dmigs te—/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' krubos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas su/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyes shig /de nas slob ma thal sbyar te/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams nas/ /smon lam gyi ni bar du bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon sems dge bas/ /slob ma la ni tshig 'di brjod/ /gong nas gong du sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni gzung bar bya/ /'khor ba las ni bsgral ba yithu / /thabs ni de las gzhan med pas/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /sdom pa rtag tu bskyang bar gyis/ /des ni gnod pa rnams bsal nas/ /byang chub bde ba des thob 'gyur/ /slob ma sdom la gnas nus na/ /lag na d+nghame tog 'dzin pa yis/ /dpa' bo'i spyan sngar dam bcas te/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus ni 'di nas gzung nas su/ /byang chub 11—518

snying por mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla sed pa①/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi②/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang —/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud ①pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por dugazung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bya/ /nam du yang ni mi spong chango / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bkyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi//mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyi 6)nas/ /sems can rnams 9)kyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs phyung ste/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /de ltar sdom pa gzung gnas pa'i/ /snying ga mgrin pa dpral ba ru/ /g.yas pa'i rdo rje khya tshur gyis/ /dri yi thig le byas nas kyang / /yi ge gsum gyis byen gyis brlab/ /las kun byed pas bsrungs nas ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /11—519

mchod pa thams cad dang ldan pas/ /dus kun du ni bde bar mnos/ /rang rang sngags kyis ①me tog sgos/ /mar me dri rnams dbul bar bya/ /so shing sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /srin bus ma zos bug mdzer med/ /drang zhing dri yis ② legs bsgos pa/ /skud dmar me tog phreng gis brgyan/ /las kun byed pa bzlas nas ni/ /shar ram byang share kha bltas pa'i/ /slob ma la ni sbyin par bya//ma gas par bca' skyon dag nas/ /mdun du drang por dor bar bya/ /bdag la blta na mchog yin —te/ /'greng na mkha' spyod mthur zhu/du bltas/ /sa 'og nges 'grub phyogs dang mtshams/ /rang rang gi ni lhar shes ④bya/ /dmar ram dmar ser tshad ldan pa'i/ /srung skud mdud pa gsum ldan pa/ /dpung pa la ni bcings te bsrung / /de nas ngag gi skyon sel ba/ /sngags 'dis khyer chu lan gsum blud/ /oṃ s+thāḥbi shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba bā ba ni tsā gya saṃ sho dha ya/ sarba bi kar+ghaṃn ⑤a pa na ya hūṃ/ de nas slob ma rnar blags te/ /dga' bskyed spro ba'i chos bshad bya/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dusmra ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur na yang mi 'byung ngo //gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/(6) /gang gis mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par 9 nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sdig pa byas par gyur pa gang / /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba/ /mthong bas byang bar 'gyur lags na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas pa smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ⑤ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang dag mchod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros brtan zhing mi g.yo ba/ /de dag gis (peni ngan 'gro'i rgyun/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad/ /11—520

bdag nyigad chen po spyod rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed ①rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin bar/ /de phyir spyod rnams theg chen la//sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong bas na②/ /rang 'byung skal ①ba chen po bas/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur—/ /don bshad bsrung ba byas nas ni/ /sngags kyis sbyangs pa'i ku sha dag/stan dang sngas su sbyin par bya/ /rmi lam dge ba'am mi dge ba/ /nang par ngal 'ang rab tu zlos/ /sdig pa las kun byed pas gzhom/ /slob dpon la ni mi dge ba'i/ /ltas dag mthong na langs nas ni/ /zhing skyong mkha' 'gro thams cad la/ /gtor ma cho ga bzhin du sbyin/ /yi ge brgya pas brtan byas shing / /srung ba'i 'khor los kun du spyad④/ /dpa' bo'i zhal gyi sngags la sogs/ /thams cad kyang ni bzlas byas te/ /go chas bdag nyid bsrung ba dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams la/ /gsol btab rgyan sogs nga rgyal blang / /me yi las la kun brtson pa/ /bgegs rnams thams cad zhi bar bya/ /lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// //dpa' bos nang par sngar langs te/ /khrus byas shugs kyis rgya bcings la /gnas bcas lha ni nam mkhar dgod/ /bum sogs gdan la legs bzhag ⑤nas/ /zhal bzhi pas ni thams cad bsrung / /dri zhim pa yi chus gtor nas/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin kyi/ /grogs dang lhan cig thig gdab po/ /ma nyams ras bal gtsang ma las/ /rang gi shes rab lhan cig tu/ /kha dog lngar 11 —521

bcos srad bu bsgril/ /nyis 'gyur du ni tshad byas te/ /sgo yi nyi shu cha nyid do/ /ma snyoms pa ni rnam bsal te/ /grims dang mdud pa'i skyon bral ba/ /shar dang nub tu kha bltas pa'i/ /sgrub pa pos ni rab tu brkyang / /ye shes lnga las byung ba yi—/ /srad bu lnga lnga ①rnam phye ste/ /rang nyid te ru kar byas pa'i/ /mig gnyis nyi zlar sgo yi 'od/ /'bar ba'i lta bas ye shes dgug /gnyis med gnyis med gsang sngags kyis/ /lnga po legs par bsgril bar bya/ /pad+ma'i snod du bzhag nas kyang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro dang / /dpal chen snying po yongs bzlas nas/ /mchod de spos ni dbul bar bya/ /khrag chen gyis ni spangs pa yi/ /sum sgril skud pa tshad ldan pa/ /bdud rtsi tsan+dan dkar po yis/ /legs par byugs te thig gdab bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su ①tra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/sngags des thig skud legs btang la/ /grogs kyis byedagasum mngon brjod nas—/ /skud pa rab tu brkyang bar bya/ /shar dang nub tu kha bltas la/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis/ /lte ba yi ni phyogs bzung ⑤nas/ /slob dpon rdo rje dang bcas shing / /dang por tshangs pa'i thig gdab bo/ /ltas ngan byung na dngos mi 'grub/ /chad pas slob dpon 'chi 'gyur zhing / /ring thung khyer na nad kyis 'debs/ /phyogs 'khrul ⑥slob ma nyon mongs 'gyur/ /de bas 'debs pa thams cad kyis/ /rab tu bsgrims te gdab par bya/ /byang dang lho yi sgor gnas te/ /tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab par bya/ /ma lus 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas la sogs khyed rnams kyis/ /'gro don mdzad pa'i dus yin te/ /thig gi sgras ni bskul bar bsam/ /g.yon nas bskor ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rnam pa kun du thig gdab bya/ /mtshams kyi cha ni g.yas su ste/ /11—522

pre dang rlung gi phyogs gnas nas/ /mtshams kyi thig ni yang dag brtsam/ /srin po 'byung po'i phyogs 'dug nas/ /gnyis pa yang na ①de bzhin no/ /me yi mtshams nas byang du blta/ /shar gyi thig ni gdab par bya/ /rlung nas lho ru kha bltas te/ /nub du srad bus gdab par bya'o/ /slob dpon rlung gnas shar du blta—/ /byang du thig ni yang dag bri/ /me nas nub phyogs kha bltas pas/ /lho yi thig kyang de bzhin no/ /ye shes thig ni brgyad kyi snerjes/ /mtshan nyid bzang po rnams bsams nas/ /cha ni rnam par dbye bar bya/ /tshangs pa'i thig ni ngos re ru/ /re re lngar bya nyi shu ①gdab/ /pho brang la gnyis ge sar gcig /gsum gsum gyis ni 'khor lo rnams/ /ka ba ④gri gug rdo rje phreng / /pad+ma 'khor lo re re bya/ /gcig gis phyi yi khyams yin te/ /bsdus ba'i tshul la pad+ma dag /pho brang gi ni nyis 'gyur te/ /thams cad snga ma lta bur shes/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad char 'dod/ /sgo khyud khyams dang 'dra ba yis/ /mkhas pas cha yi phyed du bya/ /rtsig pa dang ni ba ku li/ /shir+ṣa ka ni de yi phyed/ /dgu yis rta babs ka bar bcas/ /mdzes par tshon gyi sa bya ste/ /tshon gyi sa yi nyis 'gyur du—/ /phyi rol 'od kyi dkyil 'khor bya/ /'khor lo de yi phyi rol du/ /shing la sogs pa'i dur khrod bya/ /nye 'khor mchod pa'i sar byas te/ /ye shes thig ni de nas kyang / /thig gi rim pa'o/ //rin chen nam ni khams chen nam/ /'bras sogs khams kyi legs sbyangs dang //yang na sa 'am thal ba'am/ /lo ma rnams kyis bri bya ste/ /kha dog lnga po thams cad ni/ /phyag rgya drug pa dang ldan bya/ /thig las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ /lnga po lnga ni rnam sprul te/ /tshon ⑤ni rab tu gnas par bya/ /dpa' 11—523

bos dbus kyi sar gnas te/ /shar du kha bltas g.yon pa yi/ /khu tshur gyis ni bzung nyanas su/ /bden pa brjod cing bri bar bya/ /'di ni me long dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni sgrol byed pa/ /dpal ldan bde chen rgyal po ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ye hūṃ/ /lan lnga ru ni brjod par bya—/ /sor ni bcu gnyis tshad ldan par/ /drang zhing mtho la snyoms pa dang / /nas gang gis khyeni ma 'dres pas/ /ri mo kun du bri bar bya/ /sbom pos nad skyed ①phra bas ni/ /nor rnams rab tu rlag pepar byed/ /'dres pa yis ni rims 'byung zhing / /yo bas rnam 'gras chad pa yis/ /slob dpon dang ni slob ma dag /'chi ba nyid du shes par bya/ /de nas tshad dang ldan pa ru/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /rim pas dkar po ser po dang / /de bzhin du ni dmar dang ljang / /nag po nang du shes bya ste/ /shar phyogs su ni sngon po che/ /lho ni ser te nub ni dmar/ /byang du ljang gus rnam par mdzes/ /lte ba dmar zhing ge sar ser/ /sna tshogs mdog pad gri gug sngo/ /ljang ku dkar dang dmar ba yi—/ /gzhi la sngo dmar dkar ba yi/ /'khor lo gsum ni legs par bri/ /khyams ni shel 'dra dra ba'i sa/ /bai ḍūr+ya ltar sngo bsangs nyid/ /gser ram rnam lngas ba ku li/ /shiste ka ni dkar po ste/ /rta babs kha dog sna tshogs nyid/ /rdo rje 'od sogs pad+ma bzhin/ /rin chen phreng 'dang nyi zla dang / /rnga ma dar dang 'phan la sogs/ /rgyan ni sna tshogs bri bar bya/ /khyams la gzugs sogs mchod pa ni/ /bzhi bcu ru ni tshang bar dgod/ /rdo rje gri gug gri gug dang / /bum pa dkar po pad snod ldan/ /dbus kyi pho brang dag la dgod/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo dag /gri gug dang ni ldan bya zhing / /mthar ni gri gug yang dag 11—524

dgod / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan pas/ /rnam pa kun du mdzes par bya/ /slob dpon gyi ni las mthong nas/ /'di dag kun du spyad par rigs/ /rdul tshon gye rim par phye ba ste bdun pa'o// //rdo rje dril 'dzin dpa' bo yis/ /lan gsum du ni yongs bskor nas/ /dkyil 'khor skyon rnams legs brtags te/ /yi ge brgyas ni kun du sbyang / /rgyan rnams kyis ni mdzes byas pa'i/ /rgyal dang kun byed bum pa dag /shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon dag tu dgod/ /sgo dang mtshams su brgyad po ste/ /rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol du/ /bgegs skyer 'gyur bas mi dgod do/ /ma dag pa ni de las gzhan/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri dang bza' ba rol mo dang / /gos dang ku sha rgyan la sogs/ /nye 'khor du ni dgod par bya/ /chang dang sha rlon gtor ma dang / /'du ba yi ni rdzas rnams kun/ /de yi phyi rol dag du gzhagakhye /dar dang bla re gdugs dang ni/ /rgyal mtshan rnams kyis gnas brgyan te/ /khrag 'thung cha lugs 'dzin pa yi/ /sgo srung 1bzhi ni gzhag rnyipar bya/ /bdag nyid brtul zhugs gnas byas te/ /nub kyi sa la mngon phyogs nas/ /cho ga rab tu sdogs par spyad/ /g.yon gyi srin lag rtse mo yis/ /dam tshig drug po legs sbyar bas/ /bsangs te lha nyid rnam par bsams④/ /nam mkha'i lha rnams phab nas kyang / /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ /drug po ro gcig gyur par bya/ /go cha sogs ⑤kyis byen brlabs nas/ /sngon bzhin lha rnams sbyang byas te/ /he ru ka sogs mchod byas nas/ /dpa' bo gnyis med sngags kyis mchod—/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro kā ka sogs/ /bum sogs lha rnams thams cad la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du nye bar gnas/ /rig byed dang ni me 11—525

lha'i bar/ /thabs dang shes rab yi ge dag /lha yi grangs dang mnyam par bzlas/ /mthar ni myos byed kyis mchod nas/ /slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug par bya/ /dang po phyag ni sngon 'gro bas/ /sems skyed ①nas ni rjes gnang mthar/ /dbang ni rim pa bzhin blangs te/ /slob ma gzhug par byed bdas nyid—/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs ②brjod par bya/ /oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa'i rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpar bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi ①mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag 'gyur mdzod/ /nyes pa med la rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pas/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis 'grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po rgyal mchog gis/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems par bdag mdzod cig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi snying la bzhugs/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod mchog dam tshig mchog gyur pa'i/ /bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs dag dkyil 'khor yin/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ / khyod kyis ④'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal larnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes/ /bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor du/ /11—526

—rgazugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /'an gsum du ni rab brjod nas/ /slob ma 'jug pa'i las rnams bya/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje yis/ /kun byed bum pas bkrus nas kyang / /gos dmar gyis ni gdong yang dgab/ /dkyil 'khor me tog lag 'dzin pas/ /sdom pa rab tu gzung nas su/ /wīshrī he ru kā bol/ bid ma he/ bibyā rā dzā ya/ dhi ma he swā tā—/ sngags de yis ni gdab par gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pa yidze+e/ /lha rnams la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal/ /gsum brjod grogs kyi nang du 'da'/ /bu khyed ④su yin ci la dga'/ /skal bzang bde chen gnas la zhes/ /dris lan yongs su spyad par bya/ /yon gyi mchog ni blang byas te/ /snying gar rdo rje rab bzhag nas/ /oṃ yo ga tsit+ta u da yā mi/ su ra ta sa ma ya ste/ sedhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ de ltar byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /nye bar spyod pa bzhin bya ste/ /ding ④khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba 'dis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag byas nas/ /'bru lnga yis ni gzhug par bya/ /lan gsum bskor ba byas nas kyang / /lha dang tha dad med bdag gis/ /sgo sogs drung na 'khod pa la/ /dam tshig yongs su bsgrag khrupar bya/ /deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci 11—527

dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes babyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du brngod par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ /snying kar rdo rje rab bzhag ste/ /ho ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs//thod pa'i bdud rtsi legs sbyangs te/ /'di ni spyod kyi daskyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi chu yis 'grub/ /longabadz+ra ud ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ deng nas brtsams te/ khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de spyod kyis bya dgos te/ nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /mi bde ba ma spangs par che'i dus byas nas daskyal bar nyung bar ①gyur ta re zhes dam tshig bstan par bya'o//sbyang byas slob mas dpa' bo la/ /ye shes don phyir gsol ba gdab/ /dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs ②la/ dpal te ru ka'i ye shes bdag la dbab du gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum gsol byas nas/ /dur khrod zla mtshan ldan ras dang / /byi la'i ④rtug pa dam tshig dang / /thang chu yi dwags kha las byung / /dur khrod me la gdung bar bya/ /'od kyis ④lha rnams yongs bskul zhing / /rlung me lha dang sa chu srin/ /'bar byas snying po sogs sngags dang / /oṃsarba bī ra yo gi ni badz+ra k+ṣiṃbe+e sha ya/ ta ṣa ya/ ra ra ra ra tsa la ya sdehūṃ ha k+ṣiṃsto rjordo rje dril bu ḍa ma ru/ /bsgyings dang bcas pas bsgrag par bya/ /mtshan ma nye bar mi gnas na/ /ru tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā be+e sha ya hūṃ/ oṃṭīhe ru kā ya ba di ma ho bibyā rā dzā ya ⑦rnyi ma ha ⑧snga hā/ sngags des dpa' bo bskul bar bya/ /ltas rnams thams cad shes byas nas/ /smra la lce ni byin brlabs te/ /11—528

dge sogs don rnams dri bar bya/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan byas nas/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag /bsod rnams ji bzhin de bzhin shog /'dis ni dngos grub gang thob dang / /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di yi bsod nams ci yod las/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ku la bi sho rnya ni swā hā/pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ /sngags des ltos ①pa med par dor/ /rigs kyi ltas ni — yongs shes nas/ /oṃ pra ti greṇ+ḍa swa mi oṃ/ satwa ma hā ba la/ sngags des spyi bor sbyin bya ste/oṃ te ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te/ /rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa ④lo s+thāḥ/ gdong g.yogs ⑪rab tu dgrol bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da rngo snani dad pa rab tu skyed / /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /grub kun khyod la mngon du gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyed pa dang / /sngags kyi dngos grub brtson par gyis/ /me tog gang du lhung la sogs/ /lha rnams gnas dang bcas pa dag /byang sgo nas brtsams thams cad bstan/ /slob ma 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// //dkyil 'khor byas te yul 'khor ram/ /rta dang glang po sogs phul nas/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob mdzad gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /lan gsum du ni gsol btab nas/ /sngags kyi phreng bas dbang bskur zhing / /mi bskyod bsam gtan gsum rdzogs nas/ /dpa' bo rdo rje dril 'dzin pas/ /shar sgo'i 11 —529

bum pa gnyis thogs ①nas/ /bkra shis bum pa sngon 'gro bas/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyes phyag byas pa/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ①rab sbyin pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/bum pa brgyad kyi sngags bzlas te/ /lha rnams lus la legs bcug nas/ /mchod de dag pa sbyin par bya/ /rin chen bsam gtan yongs rdzogs nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste/ /rin chen kun gyi mchog byed pas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba budha ④ḍā ki rtswa ye badz+ra war+ṇa rtswa ye hūṃ ④hūṃ phaṭa swā hā a bhi ṣiñca/ sngar bzhin thams cad spyad par bya/ /chos kyi rnal 'byor rab ldan pas/ /rdo rje cho ga bzhin bskyed nas/ /chos kyi gzugs kyi slob ma la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i da dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ g.yas par rdo rje rab bzhag nas—/ nang gi/ dbang bskur rin chen mchog byin nas/ /dag pa rab tu brjod par bya/ /don yod bsam gtan dang ldan pas/ /rdo rje dril bu sbyin par bya| /sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir/ /dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis dulong / /g.yon du nges par btang ⑦byas nas/ /rdo rje dril bu legs 'khyud nas/ /rdo rje bdag po brtan bya'i phyir/ /sngags 'di rab tu brjod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a bye pa ti hūṃ/a bhi ṣiñca mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya ste/ brtan byas nas ni rnam ⑧dag smra/ /rtag pa'i bsam gtan kun byas te/ /spyi bor rdo rje dril bzhag nas/ /rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /rtag pa'i rdo rje rab zhugs te/ /mi shigs rdo rje ming ldan 11—530

pas| /bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro/ /oṃbadz+ra satwa two/ a nyi ba mi/badz+ra nā ma a rnyi ṣe ka taḥ/ rang rigs ①las byung ming rnams ni/ /dpal dang rdo rje sgra ldan par/ /slob dpon gyis ni lan gsum bod/ /dag pa dang bcas rab tu brjod/ /de ltar slob ma'i dbang thob nas/ /rgyud rnams thos shing man ngag thob/ /las rnams shes te ston nus na/ /rdo rje slob dpon nyid bya'i phyir/ /tshig 'dis gsol ba gdab par bya/ /mi ldog 'khor lo'i ①dbang bskur ba/ /dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsol/ /'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa/ /de ni nga 'dir bshad du gsol/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur ba/ /thugs rje can khyod bka' drin gyis/ /de ring bdag la stsal du gsol/ /yon phul nas ni lan gsum brjod/ /seng ge rdo rje 'khor lo yi/ /khri la gdugs dang mchod bcas 'dug /rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig mchog /gsum ni legs par gzung bar bya/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje ni/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ldan la sbyin/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /te ru ka dpal lag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung ①/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃsarba ta thā ga ta sedhi badz+ra sa ma ya/ tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa two dha ra yā mi tritshohi hi hi hi hūṃ/ sngags des 6)slob ma'i lag tu gtad/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /skam hā badz+ra hūṃ/ dril bu a las rab bskyed de—/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcad/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /11—531

tshig des dril bu sbyin par ①bya/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /rang bzhin gyis ni dngos med byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa'i mchog tu byed par 'gyur/ /oṃbadz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi u/ sngags des rab tu dkrol bar bya—/ /he ru ka dpal brten ④byas te/ /yid kyi lus su bstan byed pa/ /dam tshig phyag rgyar grags pa yi/ /skur ni nye bar gnas gyis la/ /phyag rgya rtag tu brtan par gyis/ /de nas dpa' bo mchog ①de yis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /dbang bskur par ni rab dmigs la/ /rdo rje dril bu legs 'khyud nas/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung shig rdo rjes byin brlabs nas/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis④/ /de ltar dam tshig brtan bya ste/ /rjes su gnang ba sbyin par bya/ /kha ṭī ga dang ḍa ma ru—/ /kha ṭī ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍa 5 ma ru yi sgra/ /kha ṭī rdo rje dang bcas shing —/ /dril bu sil sel sgra sgrogs pa/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen po blang bar gyis/ /spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba'o/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas la brnam rol cing / /rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyes/ /k+ṣiṃsgeg pa'o/ /sgeg dang bcas pa'i phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /de ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /dze+e phreng ba'o/ /lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /khyod kyis glu ni blang bar gyis/ /de yis bde gshegs dngos grub kyis—/ /bde ba myur du myong bar 'gyur/ /gī/ glu'i'o/ /de nyid thal mo gar kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad chags par bya/ /sangs rgyas gdul 7༄ba'i phrin 11—532

las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du sgyur ①bar gyis/ /ho/ gar ro/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /khrubadug pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur nas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par ni/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis—/ /rgyu/ me tog go/ /sems can ma rig ldongs pa la/ /chos kyi me ni legs sbar nas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /chos kyi rnam par 'bar bar gyis—/ /②mar me'o/ /khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos/ /dri'o/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ①ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis kru bsal/ /rgyal rnams kyis ni thur mas so/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste//dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /rang bzhin med cing gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems cad don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye /me long rab tu bstan par bya/ /a yis sbyangs pa'i dril bu ni//rna ba'i drung du bsgrag 6)par bya/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang no mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /ho yis sbyangs pa'i mda' gzhu dag /slob ma'i lag tu byen nas ni/ /phyogs bzhir 'phen pa'i tshul byed la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ( )rjes su chags par gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /rdo rje 11—533

sems dpa' rab bajod pa'i/ /me long slob ma la bstan nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ①ni snying la zhugs1/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid gtso/ /tshig des rang bdag shes par bya| /zhi rgyas dbang dang dgug pa dang / /bskrad pa dang ni gsang la sogs/ /phan dang tshar gcad byed pa yi/ /las rnams khyod kyis sgrub par gyis/ /ral gri sa 'og mig sman dang / /rkang mgyogs bcud len mkha' la 'gro/ /mi snang 'a/ sogs grub pa'i tshogs/ /ci dga' bar ni sgrub par gyis/ /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig sdom pa kun bsrungs te/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /don ldan rtag tu bzla bar bya/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te//zla ba re re mngon bya ba/ /'khor lor gnyis med tshul gnas pa/ /tshes bcu 'a/ ni de rab mchod/ /rkang pas 'khor lo lag g.yas dung / /lag gnyis po ti dril byin nas/ /de nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyes chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyis ④je tshom dog med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su—/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun du gang bar gyis/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga rnams/ /skye bo yongs la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo shes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang —/ /khyod la rtag tu srung lgobar mdzad/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud ni 'dzin gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse bas/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /nan tan bskyed de bri bar bya/ /sgrubapa po rnams rgyud la spyor/ /'khor lo rdo rje sogs byen nas/ /sems can kunal 11—534

phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji ltar tshogs ni 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /las kyi 'khor lo rab tu brjod/ /shar gyi sgo drung rab gnas pa'i/ /lus ni sa la phab pa'i phyag /byas te mgo bo ma bteg par/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags/ /las kyi rdo rjes rab babe+eng nas—/ /gdugs ni gzhan du byas nas kyang / /dpa' bo chos gos 'dzin pa dang / /mchog gam mi 'jigs sbyin pa yis/ /shākya'i gzugs su rab dmigs te—/ /oṃ'adir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje slob dpon de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid dang ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa grub pa sa gsum gyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /gang la tshig 'dir lung bstan pa/ /de la sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /'khor dang bcas pa mgrin gcig tu/ /byang chub chen por lung ston te—/ /phyag rgya sngags 'di'i mthu yin zhes/ /slob ma dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /de nas slob ma gzengs bstod de/ /mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi thub tshugs pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang mi ①'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /gang zhig skyes pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /dam chos smad par mi bya ste/ /nam yang bor bar mi rung ngo / /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa la/ /gsang ba de nyid bstan mi bya/ /11—535

rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs gyur pa'i/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /rang bdag yongs su spangs pa yis①/ /dka' thub kyis ni gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bar bde gzung nas/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /slob dpon gyis ni brjod thos nas/ /slob ma gus par zhabs btud te/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' sprul pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /bsgo ba thams cad khas blangs nas/ /shin tu gus par 'dug pa la//shar sgo yi ni phyogs nyid nas/ /de nyid rab tu bstan par bya/ /thams cad dngos po gcig nyid du/ /sprul sku'i mdzad pa rdzogs gyur pa/ /dur khrod yin te lus su dag /ye shes snang bas kun khyab cing / /bdud bcom 'od dang rdo rje ldan—/ /mi mnyam med pa zur bzhi pa/ /'phags pa'i bden pa ngos bzhi nyid/ /dran nas dbang po sgo bzhi ste/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi rta babs nyid/ /tshon sna lnga po sangs rgyas te/ /dge ba'i spyod pa shiste ka /dra sogs byang chub yan lag bdun/ /ba dan dril bu gsung rab sgra/ /ting nge 'dzin byi kha khyer te/ /gzungs ni 'dod pa'i lha mo'o/ /pad+ma 'dam kyis mi ②gos te/ /gcod byed 'khor lo rnams yin no/ /ye shes thugs dang gsung gi sku'i/ /'khor lo bskor ba phreng ba bzhin/ /rnam thar brgyad kyi ka ba ste/ /sna tshogs chos 'khor rgyal po'i gnas/ /'khor lo gdugs kyis ④rnam par mdzes/ /chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig phyir/ /rtse mo rdo rjes brgyan pa nyid/ /ji ltar lha yi dag pa ni/ /longs spyod chos sku lta bur shes/ /de nyid mthong ba'i slob ma yis/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod pa rnams phul nas/ /dga' bde yis ni gnas par bya/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi phyir/ /mdog dmar maṇ+ḍal legs phul nas/ /sman dang 11—536

khams kyi rin chen dag /ji ltar 'byor ba dbul bar bya/ /'dod pas nye bar mnyes byas pa'i/ /phyag rgya mchog ni nyer brtags nas/ /gdong bcing dra ba'i phyi rol nas/ /gus pas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /mi phyed phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrubs/ /rdo rje sgol 'byor las byung ba/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod bzhin du/ /gtso bos bdag kyang mdzad du gsol/ /'khor ba'i 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /lan gsum du ni gsol btab nas/ /thal sbyar kha sgor 'dug pa la/ /slob dpon phyag rgyar ldan pa yis/ /rnal 'byor brtan par dmigs nas ni/ /ji srid thig le ldan pa ru/ /snyems par zhugs te chos bdag la/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod tshu)chen dbang bskur stsal ba bzhin/ /bzang po byang chub sems kyis ni/ /de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /tshig des lce la gzhag ②par bya/ /phyag rgyas kyang ni de bzhin te/ /yang na tshig gi ①las kyis ni/ /grol ba'i bdag nyid byin par bya/ /a ho su kha zhes brjod nasaske/ /lus kun bde bas gang par bya/ /dag pa yang ni rab tu brjod/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal phyag byas nas/ /nor bu rin chen kun gyi mchog /sngon bzhin gsol ba btab nas ni/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid byas pa la/ /srung ba dag ni byas nas kyang / /lag par lag par ④legs byin te/ /spyi bo nas ni gzung nas su/ /dga' ster gnas te lha mo 'di/ /sna tshogs gzugs ldan yid 'ong ma/ /zung shig zung shig sems dpa' che/ /bzung (5)nas mchod pa rab tu bya/ /thabs gzhan sangs rgyas mi rnyed do/ /'gro ba gsum ni dag byed pa/ /de bas khyod kyis 'di dang ni/ /nam yang 'bral bar mi bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams 11—537

cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /blun po gang gis 'di spangs na/ /de la mchog gi bde ba med/ /slob dpon gyis ni brngod pa dang / /skra bshig gos dang bral byas nas/ /bshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la gus pa dang / /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa/ /bu khyod ji ltar dga' ba sgos/ /de ltar phyag rgyas brjod thos nas/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /khu khrag la sogs bza' ba dang //bud med rnams la rtag gus shing / /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o bgyid do/ /pad+ma rab tu rgyas byas shing / /dri zhim pas ni kha phye ste/ /slob ma la ni mngon bltas nas/e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /ji ste cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga gnas te/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i/ /bya ba thams cad pad+mas byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni yang dag gnas/ /bhañja mo k+ṣa ho/ rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje pad+ma legs sbyangs nas/ /bla mas cho ga brjod byas ste①/ /sbyor stangs drug po sngon 'gro bas/ /phra ba'i ②ye shes bskyed par bya/ /ye shes thig le brtan pa dang / /dam tshig 'di yang bsgrag par bya/ /mtshan ldan bud med mthong ba dang / /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor byas te/ /thal sbyar nas ni gsol ba gdab/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum nas ①ni sdeg med pas/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /nam du yang ni mi bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ /de nas tshul bzhin gnas pa la/ /dag pa yang ni rab tu brjod/ /'brasabu rnams ni phul nas kyang / /zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te/ /khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rinachen 11—538

bzhi pa yang / /bdag la bka' drin rab tu stsol/ /slob mas lan gsum brjod thos nas/ /go rims 1rab tu brjod byas te/ /rin chen tshig gis dbang bskur nas / /'di yis rab tu bstan par bya/ /'di ni rang nyid mdzes ma snaste/ /phyi rol yul ni rnam spangs pa/ /rig 'di bor nas de las ni/ /gzhan pa'i thabs kyis sangs rgyas med/ /rig ma'i — snabartul zhugs spyod cig pu/ /brtul zhugs rnams kyis bla ma'i bla/ /mtshan med bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /'di la rtag tu gnas par gyes/ /de nas dag pa rab tu brjod/ /lam gyi dam tshig 'di yang sbyin/ /khyod kyis 4srog chags gsad par bya/ /gzhan gyi bud med rnams spyad nas/ /ma byen par yang khyod kyis long / /thams cad la yang brdzun tshig smṛs/ /bde ba'i don gyes spro bzhin gnas/ /dkyil 'khor nyi ma ma shar bar5/ /legs par gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /bum pa la sogs rdzas rnams kun/ /ci bde bar no gnas par bya/ /de bas rtog pa thams cad/ kyis/ /dge 'dun rnams ni mchod par bya/ /byis pa rnams kyang tshim pa dang / /skye bo kun la cung zad sbyin/ /de nas dam tshig la gnas pa'i/ /sbyor ba legs par khong chud par/ /slob dpon las ni rab tu blang/ /bsrung dang brten pa bza' ba shis/ /dam tshig 'di ni bla na med/ /de la 'bad pas btsal rtsol 7bya/ /de yis 'bras bu rab sdogs byed/ /dbang bskur ba rim par phye ba ste gsum pa'o// //dkyil 'khor gyi ni las rnams dang / /las kyi dngos grub thams cad la/ /sbyin sreg dang ni bral gyur na/ /'bras bu 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas/ /de bas thams cad dngos grub rgyur/ /las chen brgyad dam bcu gnyis kyis/ /sbyin 11 —539

sreg yang dag cho ga ni/ /rnam pa kun du srud par bya/ /las dang mthun pa'i sa gzhi 'am/ /de yi sa ni yongs bkang ste/ /thab khung mtshan dang ldan par brtag/zhi ba dkar zhing khru gang tshad/ /zlum po pad+ma pad phreng ldan/ /rgyas la khru do ser po ste/ /gru bzhi 'khor lo pad+ma'i phreng / /dbang la zur gsum kha dog dmar/ /khru gang mda' yi phreng bas mjes/ /dgug ①pa nyi shu lcags kyus mtshan/ /dmar zhing zur gsum 'od dang ldan/ /gsang ba bcu gnyis zla gam ste/ /nag po gri gug phreng bas spras/ /dbye ba khru gang ral grir ldan/ /zur lnga pa la kha dog gnag /rmongs pa la drug rengs la brgyad/ /sbrul dang lcags sgog mtshan mar bcas/ /ser po sum cu drug cu'i bdag /dbye ba ji bzhin bskrad pa la/ /rengs bzhin phur bus gdab pa shes/ /dgug pa'i cho gas tsha ba bskyed/ /dug 'joms pa la zhi ba spyad/ /las kun byed la yang de bzhin/ /rigs lnga'i mtshan ma yang dag dgod/ /thab khung de dag kun gyi ni/ /phyed phyed zabs su brkos nas kyang / /bcu gnyis cha na phyir bskyed 2de/ /drug cha steng du brtsig par bya/ /dkar dang dmar dang nag po ste/ /khru do la sogs phyi rol nas/ /rta babs sgo dang ldan pa ru/ /thab kyi dbyibs bzhin bskor byas la/ /sgo ni 'dod pa'i phyogs su bstan/ /thab khung 'dra bar gdan byas te/ /g.yon dang g.yas su mchod yon dang / /gzar ba'i ①stan yang de bzhin no/ /yang na rdul tshon cho gas spyad/ /zhi dang rgyas la 'o ma can/ /dbang dang dgug pa seng ldeng sogs/ /rengs rmongs kha dang bska bas so/ /gsad pa la ni tsher ma'i shing / /tsan+dan sgon shing a ga ru/ /dri zhim 'o ma dang ldan pa/ /las kun byed la bsngagasapa ste—/ /thab kyi dbyebs bzhin brtsig par bya/ /rang gi las las 'byung ba yi/ /11—540

yam shing sor ni bcu gnyis sogs/ /ji ltar rigs par kun du spyad/ /zhi rgyas bram ze'i khyim las skyes/ /dge 'dun khyim las byung ba'ang rung / /bskrad sdang tha mal ①las byung ba/ /dbang dgug rgyal rigs khyem las te/ /smad 'tshong ma dang rje'u rigs dang / /gar mkhan las kyang rab tu brtag /rengs rmongs rje'u rigs rab tu rmongs/ /gsad la gtum byed yugs sa'i khyem/ /rdo'am lcags las skyes pa'ang rung / /yam shing legs par bsregs nas su/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ/ zhes pas/ me ni las kyi phyogs nas spar/ / bsangs te ④me yi lha bskyed bya/ /las kun byed la drur tsaba'i mdog /zhal gcig mig ser gos ljang ser/ /kham nag thor tshugs mi bskyod 'dzin / /rdo rje bgrang phreng dril pad ldan—/ /zhi la dkar zhing pad dkar dang / /shel phreng spyi blugs chu spyod 'dzin/ /rgyas la dkar ser 'khor lo dang / /mu tig phreng pad spyi blugs 'dzin/ /gsad la mdog gnag rus pas brgyan/ /don yod pas ni dbu brgyan cing / /gri gug rtse gsum thod pa dang / /kha ṭī ga ni g.yon na 'dzin/ /bskrad sdang ral gri rtse gsum g.yas/ /thod pa kha ṭī g.yon pa na/ /dbang la mdog dmar mda' dang niske/ /rin chen gzhu dang me long 'dzin/ /'dod chags rin chen 'byung ldan 'chang / /dgug pa lcags kyu rin chen dang / /rdo rje zhags pa me long nyid/ /rmongs la mdog ser sbrul dbyug dang / /'khor lo tho ba rnam snang bskur/ /rengs la lcags sgog tho ba dang / /'khor lo phur bu na stibaza' zer/ /rigs mthun las kyi sa bon las/ /thab khung dbus su bskyed nas kyang / /sngags 'dis bdag po spyan drang bya/ /oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /chen po 'bar 11—541

ba'i stan la bzhugs/ /badz+ra dha ra k+ṣiṃdz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ bsangs te dgug gzhug bcing sogs bya/ /skadang swā hā bar gnas pas/ /mchod yon me tog la sogs pa/ /bzhi yi snod du dbul bar bya/ /mchod sogs rdzas rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi rgyas dri zhim dkar ba nyid/ /dbang dgug dri zhim dmar ba'i rdzas//gsad bskrad dbye la dri nga nag /rengs rmongs ser zhing dri nga ba①/ /zhi la 'o ma rgyas la zho/ /dbang la mngar dmar dgug pa la/ /til mar rab tu shis pa yin—/ /gsad la mchin pa bskrad la sha /rmongs la sran chung rengs pa la nya dang tsa na ka nyid shis/ /zhi la lhor gnas srin por rgyas/ /chu la gsad pa bskrad dbye rlung / /dbang la nor sbyin dbang ldan dgug /me la rengs pa shar du rmongs/ /zhi la nyi ma zla ba rgyas/ /gsad sdang bskrad la spen pa ste/ /pa ba sangs kyis dbang du gyur/ /dgug la phur bu lag la rmongs rengs la mig dmar dus kyi me/ /las rnams thams cad byed par gsungs/ /dngul lam gser ram zangs sam lcags/ /ra gan mi rus las byung ba'i/ / rang rang shing las byung ba yi/ /①mchod sbyin sdod ni legs par brtag /dgang gzar blugs gzar yu ba khru/ /sor drug rdo rje rin chen bcas/ /gru bzhi sor bzhi lte ba rlum/ /sor gnyis sor gcig rdo rjes mdzes/ /pad 'dab mthe bong lto ba'i tshad—/ /sor bzhi rtse gsum mthe'u chung tshad①/ /cho ga mthong bas shes par bya/ /sboms su mthe bo'i tshad byas nas/ /rang rang gi ni dris bsgos te/ /shin tu dag pa'i bdag nyid bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /nam du yang ni bral mi bya/ /rang rang gi ni thab khung dang / /dbyebs 'dra de yi mtshan mar bcas/ /so so'i las la de yang shis④/ /mthe bos mtheb chung mnan pa dang / /11—542

sor mo lnga ni legs gshibs ①pa'i/ /g.yas dang g.yon kyi lag pa'am/ /ci bde bar yang spyad par gsungs/ /spyad 'os par ni gzar bu ste/ /gzhan rnams kun du ⑤lag pas so/ /'jigs sogs g.yeng ba phyir bsal te/ /sems ni las gang sgrub pa yis/ /bsam gtan la ni rtse gcig pas/ /me ni 'bar ba yongs shes nas/ /oṃ.asna ye swā hā/ sngags des mar gyi sreg drugs dag /gsum mam lnga'am bdun du dbul/ /me yi ltas ni yongs shes shing / /bgegs bsal me la sreg drugs dbul/ /oṃ badz+ra a na wa ma hāwā ta ḍa dz+wa la ye/ sarba bha smi ku ru sarba mirgyu stihūṃ phaṭa/ a mu ka mya shādzhai ku ru swā hā/ yam shing legs par dbul bar bya/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya/ sarba pā paṃ shārnyi ku ru swā hā/nyil ni sdig pa zhi phyir dbul/ /yungs kar 'bras chan zho dang zan/ /ku sha drur ba nas dang gro/ /'bras dang ma sha so bar bcas/ /shing tog me tog la sogs pa/ /sngar bzhin sngags kyis dbul bar bya/ /kun byed la sogs 'jam pa yi/ /las la 'di shis bsad sogs gzhan/ /las mthar so so'i sngags shes nas / /so so'i 'dug stangs la sogs pa/ /mkhas pas man ngag ltar shes nas—/ /cho ga kun du spyad par bya/ /chang dang sha rlon bdud rtsi dag /kun la rab tu sbyar bar bya/ /me ni rab tu tshim byas nas/ /mchod de rab tu bsangs 'a7 byas nas/ /'bar ba'i bdag nyid bsam par bya/ /ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga yis/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs bskyed nas/ /las kyi rgyan sogs dang ldan pa'i/ /ye shes me ni spyan drangs te/ /zhabs bsel mchod yon 'thor 'thung sbyar/ /me tog bshos kyi 6mthar thug par/ /dang por rdzogs par spyad de mchod/ /de nas pus mo'i nang chud par/ /lag gnyis rdo rje khya tshur 11—543

gyis / /gzar bu legs par gzung byas la/ /lan bdun du ni dgang blugs dbul / /de nas rtsa ba'i snying po yis/ /stong nas nyi shu gcig gi bar/ /ci nus par ni dbul bar bya/ /de nas nang gi mchod pa dang / /dgang blugs gsum ni dbul bar bya/ /'joms ma yi ni mthar thug par/ /thams cad la yang bdun bdun te/ /sna tshogs mchod pas kun mchod nas/ /yi ge bdun pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /dgang blugs bdun du phul nas kyang / /rol mo rnams ni brdung ba dang / /me tog dor zhing bkra shis brjod/ /bstod de 'dod pa'i don blangs/ nas / /bzod pa gsol te dpa' bo dag /oṃ dang kri 1to ba la sogs/ /muḥyi yi ges gshegs su gsol/ /de nas bsangs te sngar bzhin du/ /rang 'dod las la me yi lha/ /lan bdun du ni mchod par bya/ /dgang blugs dag par phul nas kyang / /mchod bstod gsol ba la sogs bya / /las bcol gtor ma rab tu sbyin/ /gshegs te bdag nyid bsrung bar bya/ /dngos grub kyi ni las rnams la/ /rgyud las ji skad bshad pa yi/ /rdzas dang rang gi sngags shes nas/ /sbyin sreg rab tu spyad par bya/ /sbyin sreg gi rim par phye ba'o// //gzhan yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /las kyi cho ga rnams phye ba/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mchog /'byor pa shes nas bya bar gsungs/ /lha mtshams rgyal la sogs pa yi/ /gza' dang skar ma yongs brtags te/ /bzang pos dad pas mngon bris pa'i/ / ma nyams 4tshad ldan nag nog med/ /lhag chad 'khrul pa spangs pa yi/ /sgu gzugs la sogs legs bltas nas/ /yid 'ong bgegasabra'/ sa gzhi la/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni tshad ldan par/ /khru gang gru bzhi byasanas 11—544

kyang / /bla re gdugs dang me tog phreng / /dung dang rnga chen sogs pas brgyan//ser po'i gos kyis legs g.yogs stite/ /sngon bzhin du ni sbyang bar bya/ /dngos sam yang na gzugs brnyan la/ /ba yi rnam lngas legs bskus te/ /drur laba'i phon gyis rab tu brud④/ /'bru mar gyis ni bskus nas su/ /shing shun ma sha la sogs phyes/ /sku ni rab tu phyi bar bya/ /sgyu ru la sogs 'dag chal lngas—/ /bkrus shing shis pa yang brjod nas/ /skasarba ta thā ga ta kā ya ④bi sho dha no badz+ra swā hā/ sngags de rab tu brjod byas nas/ /phyi dang nang gi khrus bya'o/ /phyis de dri yis byugs nas su/ /mchod pa kun gyis rab mchod nas/ /snying mgrin mtshog ma dpung gtsug tu/ /nye reg dag ni sbyin bya ste/ /sngon bzhin snyan gsan dbab par bya/ /stong sogs gcig gsum bzhi'am ni/ /lnga'i sa rang lha'i bdag nyid bsam/ /sgra rnams gsung gi rdo rje ste/ /lha khang mchod rten sogs sku nyid/ /rdo rje phur bu la sogs thugs/ /mang po de yi cho ga dag /sgrub pos gang zhig mi shes na/ /rdo rje 'chang chen bdag nyid bya/ /phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /mgon po rab bskul dgug sogs bya/ /dbang bskur mchod pa'i mthar byas nas/ /de yi snying po brgya rtsa brgyad/ /ma yengs dga' ba'i sems kyis bzlas/ /de nas gshegs te rab tu bsrung/ /rdzing dang khron pa la sogs pa/ /mdog dkar chu lha'i bdag nyid de/ /srang dang zam pa ri la sogs/ /mdog ser so so'i lhar bskyed bya/ /rdo dang sa gzhi la sogs pa/ /sa yi lha mo ⑤yongs shes bya/ /gnod sbyin sogs gzugs rang nyid shes/ /mchod la sogs pa rang rang tshul/ /mkhas pas yang dag shes par bya /lan mang du ni byur bsal ba/ /rab gnas la ni yongs su bsngags/ /de ltar lhag 11—545

par gnas byas nas/ /snga dro yi ni dus mchog la/ /mchod sogs 'byor pa kun ldan pas/ /dpa' bo ①rnal 'byor rdzogs byas te/ /mchod de lhag ①la gnas par gsol/ /snga ma bzhin du kun spyad nas/ /me tog phreng ba yongs btags te—/ /rgyas pa'i phyir ni sbyin sreg dbul/ /me long la ni khrus byas te/ /gser gyi ④thur ma g.yas thogs nas/ /oṃ tsakhyi tsagru sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha na badz+ra swā hā/rgyal rnams kyi ni spyan phye nas/ /sngags 'dis tshogs kyi rdzas rnams dbul/ /oṃ ṣ+ṭadī bya an rna sa mā bye tsā na thra ④ṇa ṣ+pe swā hā/ de nas slob ma dad ldan pas/ /khyim pa'am larab tu byung ba yi/ /gos dang phreng ba rgyan la sogs/ /mkho ba'i yo byad kun bsogs (9)te/ /shis pa rab tu brjod byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ sngags des brtan par byas nas kyang —/ /tsā ru'i mchod pa meyang dag bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon langs nas kyang / /tsā ru'i bza' ba lag thogs te/ /shis pa rab tu brjod byas nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsol ba yi/ /lhag ma sdeg pa sbyang phyir dang/ /bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs phyir/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis rab tu zo/ /tshig des yongs su bsgo ba dang —/ /longs spyod lha la mchod sogs bya/ /de nas slob dpon sems dge bas—/ /'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dang / /gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams mchod nas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas bya'i ⑧phyir/ /ma lus pa ni rab bsgo zhing —/ /gcig la nges par gtad par bya/ /de nas bkra shis nges byas nas/ /rang rang gi ni gzugs su bya/ /de ltar cho ga kun byas nas/ /dge 'dunal sogs mchod par bya/ /slob dpon yongs su mnyes byas nas/ /lha la rgyas pa'i mchod pa bya/ /rab tu gnas pa mdor bsdus pa ste dgu pa'o// //11—546

bla ma las thos gzhung mang mthong ba dang / /gzhan la rnam brtses 'khor lo sdom payi/ /las gzhung rab sbyar de las dge ba zhig /thob pa des ni 'gro rnams sangs rgyas shog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga de kho na nyid la 'jug pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon rig pa'i brtul zhugs pa dpal dā ri ka pas mdzad pa rdzogs ses / / //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ku mā ra badz+ra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rdo rje dang /spyil cog gi tho gar dge mdzes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o k+ṇi phasnyebaskur mchan/5༷9 37mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 'a7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgo pa sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉taṭ+wā ba/51༷ sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/ 3sna〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉maspyod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yis/511 sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po'i/ sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rkos/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mog5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phug snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rul rdo dang phag 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yis—/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnams/512 nya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'chi ba/ rka 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jigs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rmā/513 bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo/ rka 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rjed/514 rngo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ sna〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byas te/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/515 1sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/516 pa 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgopo la sogs med/ /tsan dan dkar/ ( 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yis/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bum—/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yi/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byed pa/517 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung / 27〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung / —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—na/ ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉blugs/ zhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ 67〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag dz+wa〈〈snar 〉〉yis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉11byed547

mdor bsdus pa jes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra ṣe ka pra kri ya u pa de sha nā ma / bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo rim gsum 2rnal 'byor nyid/ /gang gi sems can khams gsum gnas/ /rdo rje can gyi gnas thob pa'i/ /dbang bskur cho ga'i rim pa bshad/ /dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bar/ /rdo rje 'chang gis bshad pa ste/ /'on kyang dkyil 'khor de rang bzhin/ /ci yin de ni 'di ltar bshad/ /ri mo 4gnas pa'i las dang ni/ /thig las tshon dgye'i rim pas bstan/ /'gro ba 'di nyid rang bzhin gyes / /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o/ /bcos ma nyid kyi ngo bo gang / /de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod / /mkhas pa'i bsgrub bya de min te/ /yang dag don mthong grol phyir ro/ /'khor lo gsum gyi dkyil 'khor grub/ /dkyil 11byed551

'khor lha rnams grub pa'o/ /de yi dbang bskur la sogs rim/ /ci nas ma grub yang grub byed/ /de yi ①rang bzhin mi shes rnams/ /snod du bya bar bzhed pa ste| /dbang bskur sogs rim kun rdzob tu/ /mngon sum du ni sgrub pa po/ /slob dpon la sogs dbye ba yis/ /dbang bskur rnam pa bzhir bshad de/ /chu yi dbang sogs dbye ba yis/ /bzhi po des ni bcu bzhi'o/ /dang por re zhig 'khor lo gsum/ /bdag nyid rdo rje slob dpon rang / /de nas slob ma bdag 'drar bsam/ /de nas thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /'di ni bu khyod bdud rtsi ste—/ /ma bsrungs ④sreg par byed pas dug /bsrungs na dngos grub 'gyur ba ste—/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi ①chus grub pa'o/ /oṃ pañca a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha hūṃ/ thod par gnas pa de la sbyin/ /khyod kyis smad par mi bya zhing / /dam tshig dang 'gal mi bya ste/ /dmyal la sogs par 'gro 'gyur ro/ /de nas dbab par bya ba ste/ /de la 'di yi rim pa ni/ /bshang gci sogs pas yang dag sbags/ /zla mtshan ldan pa mdoms dkris ras/ /byi la'i brun byis sbags pa yi/ /gu gul dang ni bsres te brtagasadhi/ /yi dwags me ni rab blangs la/ /de ni pad+ma'i sgod gzhag ④byas/ /der ni de dag thams cad de/ /rkang pa g.yon brkyang la gnas pas / /'khor lo gsum bdag khro bo 'bebasadu/ /'khor lo gsum bdag de mdun du/ /rdo rje ldan pas bsreg de nas/ /bdugs te 'bab par the tshom med//nyiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha k+ṣiṃbe sha ya hūṃ/ spyohe ru kā tha bid ma bubid ma te bibyā rā dza ya/dhi ma he swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis dpa' bo bskul bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor nye bar bstan par bya ste/ rang bzhin rmis ni dag pa'i bdag /lus kyi rang bzhin dri ma med/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang po'i gnas/ /dkyil 11—552

'khor la ni bu khyod ltos/ /de nas gnas dang nye gnas sogs/ /bdag nyid dkyil 'khor lus dkyil 'khor/ /la gnas byang chub phyogs kyi chos/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rang bzhin te/ /rtsa ni sum cu rtsa bdun po/ /lha yi 'khor lo dkyil 'khor pa'o/ /dpal ni he ru ka yi ni/ /yan lag nying lag nyer bstan bya/ /de nas bdag nyid kun btud de/ /bla ma mgon la gsol ba gdab/ /chos bden bdag nyid bsam mi khyab/ /bdag la dbang ni bskur bar mdzod/ /slob mas gsol ba btab ma thag /rnam rgyal sogs pa'i bum pa blang / /pad+ma'i snod la ①gnas pa'i chu/ /hūṃ yig rdo rje las byung ba/ /mi bskyod pa ni rdo rje yi/ /slob dpon gyis rab bsgom par bya/ /ye shes sems dpa'i rang bzhin gyi / /sa bon 'od zer byis bskul brtson/ /ye shes de nyid gzhug par bya/ /de bzhin rab mchog chu blang bya/ /de nyid mi bskyod gzugs kyis ni/ /rnam shes phung po'i ngo bo ste/ /brtse chen ston pa dpa' bo yi/ /dbang bskur 'di ni spyi bor sbyin/ /oṃ tsakra bī ra two a bhi ṣiñca ya mi zhes bya ba ste chu'i'o/ /bris pa la sogs dbu rgyan yang / /'di ltar rin chen 'dzin sa bon/ /e ④las rdo rje nyi ma zhes/ /bshad par bsgrub cing yang dag mchod/ /de ni snga ma bzhin du'o/ /de nyid dbu rgyan rnam pa ste/ /'di ni tshor ba'i bdag nyid do/ /bsams shing bsgrubs te rdo rje can/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro spyi bor te/ /oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra waḍā nī 4 ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags dang / de bzhin du sngags gzhan yang brjod do/ /dbu rgyan no/ /j-i rtepad rdo rje las byung ba/ /'du shes de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /snang ba mtha' yas rdo rjer bsgrub/ /yang dag gzung bas sbyin par bya/ /lag pa g.yas dang snying gar ro/ /a bye pa ti two a bhi ṣiñca tha 11—553

two bī ra ṭīhe ru ka rnyi tha/ e da rud sarba burtse hūṃ greṇ+ḍi badz+ra su bi dha ye rdo rje'o/ /khaṃ yig ral gri yang dag byung ①/ /don yod grub pa'i gzugs can te/ /'du byed ngo bo dril bu ni/ /lag pa g.yon par sbyin par bya/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /dril bu'i sgra kun rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod nyid kyis ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /dpa' bo'i sdelag tu rdo rje dril—/ /gzung ngo 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag /rang bzhin gyis mdzes dga' ba ni—/ /phyag rgya chen por byen byis brlab/ /bdag po'o/ /slob ma'i spyi bor lag pa sbyin/ /hūṃ ①las rnam snang mdzad kyi gzugs/ /rdo rje can gzugs phung ngo bo—/ /ming gi dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /oṃshrī tsakra a dhi pa ti ṭīhe ru ka bī ra two a rnyi ṣiñca ya ④mi/ khyod ni rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya'o/ /ming ngo / /dbang bskur lnga thob rgyud las ni/ /sangs rgyas lnga po 'di rnams dag /ma rig pa dang bral ba las/ /ye shes lnga ni thob par byed/ /yi ge nyi shu gnyis sngags kyis/ /sngags kyi dbang bskur de nas sbyin/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dpal he ru ka'i phyag na bsnams/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /dpal he ru ka'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sidhi badz+ra sa ma ya nyiṣ+ṭha e ṣa two dha rā ya mi oṃha ha ha tī/ rdo rje brtul zhugs so/ /kha ṭī cang te'u lhung bzed dag /dpa' bos byen pa blangs nas ni/ /dpal he ru ka'i phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag pa/ /rdor bcas lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /chos gos grwa nas bzung nas su/ /g.yas pas mi 'jigs sbyin byas la/ /slob ma dbugs dbyung sbyin par bya/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid khyod/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /te ru ka dpal zhes 11byed554

bya ba'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin no/ /shrī he ru ka ḍā ki bhā na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sernyitshos ma ya two byur ②bhu ba swaḥ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud sogs kun las rnam rgyal zhing //grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /lung bstan pa'o/ /de nas yang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ phyir mi jog pa'i dbang bskur che/ /dpa' bo chen bo bdag la stsol/ /'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa/ /de ni da 'dir mdzad du gsol/ /de nas 'khor lo gsum bdag po/ /ston pa ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyis/ /yang dag bskul bar rim gyis ni/ /bkug ste dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur bzang po yis/ /de bzhin ye shes chus gang ba'i/ /bum gnas de bzhin gshegs de dag /rdo rje 'chang dbang dbang bskur bar/ /dpa' bo rnam par bsam par bya/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /khams gsum pa yis ①phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /dpa' bo dag ni rnal 'byor gnas/ /ji ltar 'dod pas mchod par bya/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /sngags kyang bzlas so/ /de nas mi bskyod pa dbu rgyan du byas te/ dpa' bo dang lha mo rnams de la lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ /zhes bzlas so/ /de nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa rnams kyis kun nas mchod do4/ /dpa' bo chen po dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ji ltar 'dod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje can gyi bka' nod par bya ste/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi bya ba ni cung zad med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bos 'dod pa lnga spyod do/ /bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos/ /bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi 11—555

—dngos/ /de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya/ /bdag nyid he ru ka mchod bya/ /rten cing dbal par 'byung chos can/ /sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ /khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /bya ba byas pa'i slob ma yis/ /de nas gtso la yon phul te/ /skye bo dam pa 'dus pa la—/ /bdag nyid kun gyis bstod phyag bya/ /phyir mi ldog pa'o/ /'khor lo mdun du bya ba byas/ /'khor lo'i spyan ni bla ma che/ /dpa' bo de nyid la phyag 'tshad①/ /de nas gsang ston don gnyer bya/ /skyob med skyob pa skyabs med skyabs/ /dpal ni 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /rgyu med par ni thugs rje che/ /mgon med bdag gi mgon mdzod cig /bdag nyid che khyod ji lta bar/ /gtso bos bdag kyang de 'drar mdzod/ /'khor ba'i 'dam gyi tshogs su ni/ /bying ba bdag la skyabs mdzod cig /de la 'dir phyag rgya'i rim pa ni sa bon lnga'i rigs kyi rang bzhin dag pa'i phyag rgya las ②chos dang chen po dang / dam tshig rnams thams cad ni bud med du 'dod pa'o/ /'di ltar rdo rje slob dpon dpal snying rje chen po'i stobs kyis/ mtshan mo chen mo la gnas khang dben par gang yang rung ba'i mngon par gsang ba'i lha mo dam tshig dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya rnyed pa ni—/ snyoms par zhugs pa las gang yang rung ba skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin te/dpa' bo thams cad yang dag 'dus/ /lha mo thams cad mnyam par phrad/ /kun rdzob pa yi byang chub sems/ /gsang ba gang yin de dbang bskur/ /'di de'i dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ /khams lnga ldan pa ro rtogs byed/ /bde ba de gang myang bar bya/ /pad+mar gnas te yang dag spyad/ /kye ma bde ba chen po zhes/ /ston pa la ni zhu zhing brjod/ /slob mas kyang ni rtog 11byed556

pa bcom/ /ji ltar rdo rje 'chang sogs gyis/ /sngon chad sras ni dbang bsgur ba—/ /de bzhin du ni byang chub sems/ /bzang pos bu khyod dbang bskur ro//gsang ba'o/ /de'i rjes la rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rig ma'am teṣ+pe/ gzhan gyi gzhung ltar gzhan yang dang / /zhes bya ba ste/ ston pas byen te/ de yis dam pa sgrub par byed do/ /lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun du phyag rgya long / /bu yis bla med mchod pa gyis/ /shes rab bo/ /de nas lha mo des/ dpa' bo bla na med pa la bka' gsol bar byed de/ dpa' bo byang chub sems bza' bar/ /khyod ni spro ba yin nam ci/ /rigs lnga las ni rab 'byung ba/ /rig ma mchod pa la gus sam/ /dri chen dri chu stobs dang khrag /sogs bza' da lta yid ches sam/ /rjes su mthun smra dam tshig bzang / /ji ltar dga' ba smros shig bu/ /'di ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig sogs/ /lha mo bdag ni cis mi spro/ /bud med rtag gus cis mi bya/ /pad+ma mchod par cis mi bgyed/ /de nas lha mo de dga' ste/ /skra ni grol zhing gos dang bral/ /pad+ma rgyas par byas nas ni/ /bstan te ghañca pad+ma ho/ /pad+ma'i dbus na gnas pa'i rtsa//bde ba 'bab pa bstan bya ste/ /sor mos so sor bskul ba dang / /lce yi ro myang la gnas te/ /de nyid 1grub par smra ba ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba byed—/ /nyams su myong ba mchog dga' ba/ /'byung ste de yi bde ba myong / /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma de dga' ba ston cing zab pa sngags smra ba mo / /lag nga g.yon pa spyi bor bzhag la/ rjes su gnas par skolung bstan par bya'o/ /deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi 6'drar sems can thams cad kyi/ /don ni bdag nyid kun gyi gyis7/ /shes rab ye 11—557

shes so/ /rim pa gsum po ①de'i bla ma/ /man ngag gis ni 'dir shes bya/ /'di ni rang nyid mjos pa ste/ /phyi rol yul ni spangs pa'o/ /rigs 1'di bor nas de nas ni/ /gzhan pa'i thabs kyis sangs rgyas med/ /rig ma brtul zhugs spyod cig pu/ /brtul zhugs rnams kyi pebla ma'i bla/ /rig ma yi ni brtul zhugs so/ /chu sogs phyir mi sdog pa'i mtha'/ /slob dpon dbang du bshad pa ste/ /'di dag phyi rol bstan pa gang / /thams cad nang du gnas pa'o / /dpa' bo kun spyod rim phye ba/ /man ngag nyid kyis shes par bya//dbang bskur bzhi po bstan pa rnams/ /gang tshe brtul zhugs dbang bskur 'gyur—/ /bsam med chos ni thob phyir te/ /de tshe de nyid ces bya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag bshad/ /phyi dang nang gi rang bzhin bshad/ /chos rnams kun gyi ngo bo ste/ /bsam byis mi khyab ces bshad de/ /snang med rab rdzogs gnas med pa/ /de nyid lnga pa rdzogs pa'i rim/ /lhan cig skyes pa mi zad pa4/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas sogs/ /de ni brtan g.yo 'gro bdag nyid/ /bdag med kyis ni bdag tu gnas/ /dpa' bo bde ba chen po rtogs—/ /'di ni de kho na'i man ngag go/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang bskur bar bya ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa sgogs so// //shrī pha na phi gu ba'i brgyud pa ma nor ba'i bshad pa'o/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta kri: snyedang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ban+de chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //11—558

033༷༄7/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs rmye ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṭītsakra saṃ ba ra sā rngudha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo//'gro kun don la rab gzhol ①ba'i/ /rang rgyud sngags dang rnal 'byor shes/ /phyi rol rnam rtog ④spangs nas ni/ /dam tshig mnyam nyid rnal 'byor che/ /nang bar sad pa dang mal nas langs te/ rnal 'byor dang rgyarjes su mthun pa'i gnas su—/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ bdud rtsi'i ril bu khar bcug la shrī te ru ka zhes bya ba'i don dran par byas te/ snying gar zla ba la dpal mchog dang po'i yi ge ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can 'od zer dang bcas pa'o/ /des sgo gsum gyi dri ma'ang sbyang ngo / /'od zer 'phro bas dngos grub pa/ /bskul nas phyag btsal rang lus gzhug /rkang pa sum mdor ⑥lte snying ga /rlung dang me chu sa yin no / /sgal tshigs ri rgyal de bzhin te/ /lus ni mnyam pa sgo bzhi rlung / /rgyan 11byed561

rnams rab mdzes he ru ka'i/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor du 'dod de/ /in+d+ra nī la mtshungs pa'i mdog /zhal bzhi re re spyan gsum pa/ /rtsa ba'i lus mdog ljang dang dmar/ /gser gyi 'od ltar gatshigs pa po/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs zla bas brgyan/ /thod phreng sna tshogs rdo rje bcas/ /rdo rje dril bus yang dag 'ag/ /gnyis kyis glang po'i pags pa bsnams/ /g.yas kyi lag na ḍa ma ru/ /dgra sta gri gug rtse gsum pa/ /g.yon na kha ṭī ga thod pa/ /zhags pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi gar gyis ni/ /'jigs byed dus mtshan mnyam par mnan/ /stag lpags bsnams dkris mgo phreng can/ /nyams dgu rgyan drug gis btab pa'o/ /baṃ las 'khyud pa'i bcom ldan yum/ /zhal gcig sprun gsum dmar 'bar ba/ /skra grol dum bu'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khyud/ /g.yon pas 'khyud cing thod pa dag /gdug pa bdud kyi khrag gis gang / /g.yas pa rtag tu sdigs mdzub dang / /ma rungs pa yi gri gug bsnams/ /bde chen thugs rje'i rang bzhin can/ /kha sbyor phyi nyid legs shes pas/ /thugs su a wa dhū tī hūṃ/ /ma bcos nang gi bdag nyid do/ /mkha' 'gro khā ma dum skyes ma/ /gzugs can ma ste bzhi rnams kyang / /zhal mdog dang mtshungs kha ṭī snod/ /gri dang phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /mchod pa bzhi yi rang bzhin rtsa/ /phyogs bral bde chen 'khor lo ste/ /oṃ lo paṃ lta hūṃ brgyad kyang —/ /dam tshig cig car bshad pa yin/ / shu dza ①go ldi go/ rāde mā—/ kā/ 6go tri/ ko/ ka la/ kā/ he pre/ gri ②sau/ su/ na ṅga—/ ma ku 'di dag gnas su rnal 'byor ma/ /rtsa yin dpa' bo nyi shu bzhi/ /lus kyi khams su brtag par bya/ /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ go rims ①jilta 11—562

bar/ spyi bor khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li dang rab tu gtum mo/ /spyi gtsug tu ma hā ke ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /rna ba g.yas par kang ka la dang / 'od ldan ma'o / /ltag par mche ba rnam par gcigs pa dang / sna ①chen ma ste gnas so/ /rna ba g.yon par su ra bai ri dang / bstan ⑤pa'i blo can ma'o/ /smin ma'i mtshams su a mi tā bhā bludang mi thung ma'o/ /mig tu rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /phrag par rdo rje'i sku dang / shing grib ni nye ba'i gnas te/ thugs kyi 'khor lo nam mkha' la spyod pa mdog sngon po'o/ /mchan khung du myu gu can dang sa srungs ma'o/ /nu mar rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing ngo / /lte bar dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /sna rtser badz+ra hūṃ ka ra dang / chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing ngo / /khar rab tu bzang po dang shā ma ④de bi'o/ /mgren par rdo rje bzang po dang / shin tu bzang mo ste tshang ha'o/ /snying gar 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma'o/ /mdoms par mig mi bzang dang —/ bya gdong ma ste nye ba'i tshasdo ha ste gsung gi 'khor lo sa la spyod pa mdog dmar po'o/ /mtshan ma la stobs po che dang / tsakra be ge'o/ /bshang lam du rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi ⑤ste 'dus pa can no/ /brlar rta mgrin dang /shoṇ+ḍi ni'o/ /byen par nam mkha'i snying po dang tsakra war mi ṇi ste nye ba'i 'dus pa can no/ /sor mo rnams la ṭīte ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /bol gong du pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod do/ /mthe bong la rnam par snang byed dang tsakra warti ni'o/ /pus mo gnyis la rdo rje sems dpa' dang /brtson 'grus chen mo ni nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /sku yi 'khor lo sa 'og na spyod pa ste mdog dkar po'o/ /khaṇ+ḍa ka pā ( kyel la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams bcom ldan 11—563

'das kyi ①rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin te/ 'on kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams ni rdo rje phag mo'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin te/ sa bcu yongs su dag pa rnams so/ /khā ta dang 'ug pa dang / khyi dang phag gi gdong pa can rnams dang / gshin rje brtan ma dang / pho nya mo dang / mche ba can dang 'joms ma ste/ 'di dag kyang phyogs dang mtshalas su mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa ji lta ba bzhin te/ mtshalas kyi lha mo rnams ni 'on kyang gzugs gnyis ma'o—/ /byang chub phyogs kyi rang bzhin can/ /me long gzugs brnyan bzhin gsal blta/ /de nas go cha gnyis shes nas/ /ye shes 'khor lo rnam par bsgom//snying ga mgo bo spyi gtsug dang / /phrag pa mig dang yan lag la/ /rdor sems snang mdzad gar dbang phyug /khrag 'thung nyi ma rta mchog bsam/ /lte ba snying ga kha spyi bo/ /bye gtsug yan lag thams cad la/ /phag mo gshin rje rmongs byed ma/ /sbyin byed skrag byed gtum ma'o/ /oṃha na ma hiḥswā hā hu bo ṣaṭa he hūṃ hūṃ ho phaṭa ho phaṭa haṃ/ skabaṃ haṃ oṃ ho ②oṃ hro hri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ sngags dang phyag rgya sbyor ba yis/ /spyan drangs mchod nas rang lus gzhug /de bzhin rgyun ni dbang bskur nas/ /cod pan dang ni lhag ba'i lha/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shi ①ye hūṃ/ oṃṭībadz+ra he te ru ru shaṃ hūṃ ④hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra swā hā/ skruhritsho)ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃbadz+ra bai ro tsa nā rngo )ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ wīsasba bud+dhā ④ḍā ki byā ye badz+ra waṇ+ḍi nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i snying po dang / nye ba'i snying po'o/ /rab tu 'bad nas mchod nas ni/ /dung chen phreng ba blang bya ste/ /ji srid skyo bar ma gyur pa/ /de srid du ni rab tu bzlas/ /bsam gtan mi nus rnal 11—564
