'byor pas/ /go cha che la sogs bsrungs te/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas/ /sems can kun las rab brtag bya/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags bzlas shing / /tshangs par spyod pa rtag tu bsam/ /zas kyi rdo rje sems sogs dang / /snying ga'i dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg bya/ /zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs pas/ /rtag pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /dam tshig legs sogs ①legs gnas pas/ /mtshan phyed gyur nas gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ a ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki rī ①sa ma ya ste dṛ sh+ya hoḥ.oṃstosahūṃ ①kha kha khā nyi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa dus bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa du un ma da a pasmra ra/ badz+ra ḍā ka ḍā ki t+yā da ya/ i oṃ ba bo kṛk+ṇi tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma saza sirnyim+bi pra yasgos/ ya the baṃ ya theṣ+ṭi bhuñja thā⑥/ dzi gha thā pi pa thā mā ti kra ma thā ⑦ma ma sarba karta ya sata su khaṃ bi thrad dha ⑧ye sa ha yi ka bha ban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ⑨swā hā/ rtag tu snying la gnas pa yi/ /thig le gcig la 'gyur med de/ /de sgom byed pa'i skye bo la/ /nges par ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /kha ṭī ga ni lha yi sku / /shes rab ḍā ⑩ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mo bshad/ /gnyis med ye shes sems ldan la/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med—/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod—/ /mya ngan 'das byung dpa' bo rnams/ /sdug pa yid kyi sprul pa ste/ /dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin/ /sems la rnam gnas rnal 'byor pa/ /mya ngan 'das pa mi ston to/ /gal te 'pho 'gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /mkha' spyod pa yi gnas su khrid/ /de lta'i dpa' bo chen po dang —/ /rnal 'byor ma ni sa steng dkon/ /cho ga sna tshogs nyams dga' ba/ /bsam pa sna tshogs gzung ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i phyir/ /de 11—565

nyid med na 'ching 'gyur la/ /gang zhig de nyid yod gyur na/ /de dag thams cad grol ①ba'i rgyu/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi man ngagaphyag rgya chen po grub pa/ dpal dril bu zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta pradzha bha dra dang / lo tsā ba mal gyo blo gros grags kyis bsgyur ba'o—// //bskur mchan/561 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugag 1〈〈snar 〉〉gyu ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzhaka du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dag du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—dang /du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mdo/562 ①〈rtepe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pu ske ②rterjope 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyigo dze+e dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rig563 ①〈〈snar 〉〉rna/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtan/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ske ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ha/ du〈〈snar 〉〉pa/564 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgo ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉1 du〈〈snar 〉〉hūṃ/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉trīḥ/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rī/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉burtse/565 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉so/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgosko bu〈〈snar 〉〉rāk+ṣa/rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tson+d+ra/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tha/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tha/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shurtse/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgophaṭa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ḍa566 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dgroka11byed566

༄ / /dpal 'gor lo sdom pa'i rim pa lnga pa/she7༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra pañca kra ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim pa lnga pa/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i byin brlabs tsam gyis ni/ /skad cig nyid la 'byung gang nyid/ /'khor lo sdom par sbas pa yi/ /byin brlab rim pa bshad par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs kun gyi/ /snying po sdom pa bla ma nyid/ /bgrang phreng bzlas pa 'dir med de / /bsam gtan lha mchod yod ma yin/ /tshes grangs med cing nges pa med/ /sbyin sreg yang dag gnas pa med/ /klog dang 'don pa yod ma yin/ /rnam par rtog med 'jigs bral ba'i/ /slob ma gus pas snakun mkhyen gyi/ /spyod yul ye shes gang zhig ni/ /skyes pa tsam gyis mchog tu ni/ /dag pa dang ni ldan gyur zhing / /mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan/ /de nyid sa bcu nyid dang ni/ /11byed568

mkha' la 'gro dang rdzu 'phrul dang / /mi snang khyad par du thob cing / /skye ba dran dang khams gsum pa'i/ /gnas kyi sems dang rig pa yis/ /'das dang ma 'ongs pa dang ni/ /da ltar byung ba shes pa'o/ /mgal ①me bskyod pa'i rnam pa can / /sems ni yul la rab tu rgyug /de ni de la rnam bzlog nas/ /mtshon du med pa mtshon par byed/ /sgra dang thig ler rke ldan pa'i sems/ /snying gar bzhag bya de nas 'di'i/ /rmongs pa'i rab rib 'joms mdzad ni/ /mnga' bdag bcom ldan 'byung 'gyur te/ /drag po 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khyegs / /te ru kar grags cher 'byung nyid/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dur khrod na / /rol cing bdud rnams thams cad 'joms/ /bde ba rnams kyi rnam pa ni / /skad cig de la stsol mdzad pa'o/ /byin brlabs pa yi skad cig la/ /slob ma la yang gang 'pho ba/ /sa bon med 'di skad cig ma/ /gcig la mngon byang chub par mdzod/ /ces bya ba ni 'khor lo sdom par bla ma rnal 'byor ma'i sbas pa las ji ltar rnyed pa'i byin gyis rlob pa nges par bstan pa'o/ /byin brlab kyi rim pa'o// //be+er yang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa gnyis pa brjod do/ /rtag tu snying la gnas pa yi/ /thig le gcig la 'gyur med de/ /de sgom byed pa'i skye bo la/ /nges par ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /'di'i don brjod par bya ste/ mig dang rna ba dang pags pa'i phyogs la gnas pa'i shes pa rnams kyis kun gzhi rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin gyi sems la rnam par shes pa lnga po de dag yang dag par gzhag cing mi g.yo bar byas te/ yid snying gar gzhag nas gnas pa'i thig le'i gzugs su 'gyur ro/ /de mthong ba las ye shes te/ /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes skye 11 —569

bar 'gyur te/ rim kyis sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /da ni sa bon med pa'i rang byen gyis brlab pa'i rim pa brjod par bya'o/ /nyi ma zla ba'i bdag nyid can gyi lam/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' stong pa'i ngo bo gang nas kyang bar chad med par rlung 'jug pa dang / 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i lam der rlung dang lhan cig sbyar te/ gcig tu byas pa'i sems gzung bar bya'o//sems kyi bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung des kyang blo'i gzhi rang rnam du bgyer ro/ /shes rab blo thabs sems dang gcig tu 'gyur te/ gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin nyid du son pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skyed byed kyi rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang nyid sgrub par ①byed pa yin no/ /'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i don shes shing / 'khor ba'i thog ma dang tha ma mya ngan las 'das pa'i rang bzhin gyi lha'i mig gis mthong ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa rnams su sems can rnams kyi sgra rnams thos shing / dri rnams snom/ ro rnams myong / reg bya rnams la longs spyod par byed la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa chen po la rol bar yang byed do/ /rang byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i gzhir gnas pa'i rdo rje dang / rdo rje'i ⑤rtse mo dang po mchog gi spyir gnas pa/ /zla ba lta bur dri med lus ldan thig le ni/ /sgom ①par byed de bdag nyid rdo rje dbang bskur nyid/ /sa bon dang bcas sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa'o—/ /de nas mig la bkod cing sems brtan par gyur pas ni 'jig rten gsum mthong ba'o/ /de bzhin du rna ba dag la gzhag pa'i sems brtan par gyur pas ni 'jig rten gsum na gnas pa'i sgra jos shing 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i skad kyang shes so/ /de bzhin du sna la gzhag pa'i sems brtan par gyur pas ni 4 11—570

'jig rten gsum na gnas pa'i dri snom mo/ /de bzhin du lce la gzhag pa'i sems brtan par gyur pas ni/ 'jig rten gsum na gnas pa'i ro myong bar byed do/ /de bzhin du pags pa la sems brtan par byas pas ni/ 'jig rten gsum na gnas pa'i reg bya la longs spyod do/ /de bzhin du snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la sems brtan par byas pas ni mngon par shes pa drug 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /spyi bo bde ba chen po la sems gzhag pas ni/ lha yi tshogs mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo la sems gzhag pas ni/ bstan bcos thams cad shes so/ /sprul hurapa'i 'khor lor sems gzhag pa la brtan par gyur pas ni lha'i mchog las skyes pa'i bu mo la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa'o/ /da ni sa bon med pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa brjod par bya ste/ mdzod srur dgod ①pa'i sems ni nyi ma'i gzu/ gas su mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i steng du zla ba'i gzugs bkod pa la/ de'i steng du skar ma'i gzugs bkod pa ste/ de ltar sems dmigs pa med pa la brtan par gyur pas ni sangs rgyas nyid 'grub par byed do/ /da ni nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa 2/brjod par bya ste/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang sbyor ba'i cho gas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor byang chub kyi sems son pa bde ba ci 'dra ba zhig skye ba de yang dag par nye bar brtags shing / brtan par ④byas nas de'i bdag nyid du gyur pa la ni tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje 'chang nyid spyad pa med par nges pa nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rim pa gnyis pa yang lag pa zhes bya ba phyag rgya'i sgo nas snga ma nye bar brtags te brtan par gyur pa kun rdzob pa'i rang bzhin gyi byang chub kyi sems don dam pa'i 9ge rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bo nyid du gyur pas na rdo rje 'chang nyid du 11—571

'grub par byed do/ /rim pa gsum pa sngon nyams su stsong ba dran pa bskyed pa/chos kyi phyag rgya yid nas byung ba'i phyag rgya las rab tu byung bar yang dag par brtan pas rdo rje 'chang ba nyid skyed par byed pa'o/ /nor bu 'gengs pa zhes bya ba'i rim pa bzhi pa yang brjod pa/ thams cad du son zhing rten dang bral ba brtan pa dang g.yo ba mtha' dag gi ngo bo nyid du gyur pa'i sems khams gsum pa khyab pa'i stong pa nyid/ phyag rgya chen po dang 'khyud pas bsam kyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin can bla ma'i bka' drin las skyes pa'i brtan par byas pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid sgrub par byed cing / phyag rgya chen po dang 'khyud pa'i bde ba chen po dang thams cad skyed par byed pa'o/ /da ni dzā lan dha ①ra'i rim pa brjod par bya'o / /lte ba chu so'i mtshams su ni/ /mdog lnga ldan pa'i thig le ni/ /sangs rgyas lnga rnams kyis mtshon pa/ /'khor lo gru gsum dkar dmar ni/ /srog 'gog lhan cig bsgom byas nas/ /skad cig de las 'bar gyur pas/ /'jig rten khams su mchod bya ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dngos su 'gyur/ /bu ga gzhan nas 'byung 'gyur zhing / /mkha' gzhan nas ni myur du 'jug /gang tshe bsgom pa brtan gyur pa/ /snang ba dngos su thob par 'gyur/ /'bar ba brtan par gyur pa ni / /lce rtsa nas ni rnam par gnas/ /ji srid 'dod pa de srid du/ /lce ni 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / /dpung pa'i rtsa bar son pa'i rlung / /kun du 'gro bas lus bskyod cing / /khams gsum pa ni thams cad du/ /rnam par lta ba la sogs byed/ /ces bya ba ni dzā lan dha ra'i rim pa'o// //rim pa lnga pa brjod par bya ste/ /gzugs sogs rtsirnams kyi grangs 'gyur te/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gang g.yo ba'i/ /sems ni snying gar brtan byas nas/ /11—572

blo dang lhan cig dbang du bya/ /gzung 'dzin dang ni bral bas na/ /dmigs pa kun dang bral ba'i sems/ /bsam du med pa'i rang bzhin phyir/ /ci yang bsam par mi bya'o/ /sems ni stong nyid la gzhug cing / /stong pa sems su rnam gzhug bya/ /stong dang stong min la sogs pa/ /kun rtog rab spang 1mkha' mnyam 'gyur / /rten dang brten pa yod min dang / /dpe med bzhi ni yod ma yin/ /de nyid lnga pa rdzogs rim ni/ /zag med lhan cig skyes pa ni/ /shing dang tsher ma lcug ma sogs/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyur bcas/ /de bzhin bdag gi de nyid dang / /rjes su mthun pa mdor bsgom bya/ /ngo bo nyid kyis sgom byed kyang / /de rtogs par ni byed ma yin/ /gal te de ni kun rtogs na/ /'gro ba'i spyod pa 'jig par gyur/ /rnal 'byor gnyid dang ldan pa yis4/ /sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'di rtogs mdzad/ /des na rang byung rang nyid ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes brjod pa yin/ /mtha' bzhi las ni grol ba yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rang bzhin nyid/ /sgom pa de ni ring po nyid/ /mi thogs rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /dpal 'khor bo sdom pa'i rim pa lnga pa/ slob dpon chen po mkhas pa rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta kriṇ+ḍa paṇ+ḍi ta 'udang / dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur//phyis bla ma su ma ti tīrti dang / dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bcos pa'o /dpal pham khyamathing pa'i brgyud krupa ma nor ba'i bshad pa'o// //11 —573

568 4 )mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim pa lnga pa pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dubs rim par/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/569 4)〈〈snar 〉skoragal/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spo/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanasol/ (kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sku'ibs/57༷ hu)〈〈pe〉dze〈snar 〉〉wapar/ (7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ (1〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ④ 〈〈pe〉dze〈snar 〉〉wani/571 (3)〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ ( mi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toragod/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wapar/zhi)〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉〉rang bzhin gyi byang chub kyi sems don dam pa'i/572 53)〈〈snar 〉〉wadha/ ②〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi sogs/573 4)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gsungs/ (ge〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyi/ 9)〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉torajigs/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ston/6)〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wapaṇ+ḍi ta/ (9)〈〈snar 〉〉pi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rgyud/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (258)11—574

༄7/ /'gor lo sdom pa'i lus dkyil gyi mngon rtogs bzhugs/nyu༄go/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /rnal 'byer lus kyi dkyil 'khor 2/ /sems can rang bzhin yongs shes shing / /rdzogs pa'i las las ②'jug rnams la'o/ /dang po tshogs pa kun ldan pas/ /bla med don 'byung dga' bas nyal/ /bzhi yis nyer bskul zhal bzhi pa/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo chen po bzhengs/ /khrus byas bde ba'i stan la gnas/ /ri lu khar bcug snying gar ①hūṃ/ /sngon po'i 'od kyis rang lus sbyang / /ba spu la spros kha dog lngas/ /'gro kun lus sbyangs ④sgo gsum dag /sprin 'dra'i 'od kyis rang mdun du/ /mkha' la bla ma'i 'khor lo dang / /phyogs dbang mig gi lha rnams ni/ /gsal gdab rten dang brten par byas/ /phyag dang mchod sogs byas nas ni/ /mdzod spu'i gnas nas rang lus gzhug5 /lus la rten dang brten pa yi/ /'khor lo gsal gdab nye bar dmigs/ /rtog dang spros pa 11—575

dga' 'gyur na/ /chos kyi 'khor lor 'dab ma bzhi/ /mdog gsal hūṃ las lte ba ru/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid bsam/ /phyogs 'dab rigs kyi sa bon las/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi bskyed/ /steng 'og lus kyi cha shas la/ /pu dzā la sogs nyi shu bzhis/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid dran/ /chos 'khor phyi yi 'dab brgyad la/ /ring po'i hūṃ las khro mo brgyad/ /de ltar lha rnams thams cad ni/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor lta bur dmigs/ /mi gsal rtsa yig thams cad la/ /dag pa'i lha nyid mos shing dran / /phyag rgya sngags kyi don ldan pas/ /ye shes spyan drangs legs mchod nasaske/ /yi ge bzhi yis rang gnas 'jug /gnas gsum byin brlabs go cha bcings①/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /thams cad nam mkhar nyer dmigs te/ /dbang bskur yid kyis gsol ba gdab/ /bdud rtsis dbang bskur thams cad la/ /rdo rje mtshan ma 'dzin pa'o/ /gtso bo ma bzhi khro mo dang //sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ /mi bskyod rin chen don yod dang / /rtag pa gar dbang thugs rdo rjes/ /rim pa bzhin du spyi bor mtshan/ /bsdus lam bsdus pa'i dbu rgyan nyid/ /de nas sngags rnams rim gyis mchod/ /bdud rtsis nye bar tshim byas nas/ /dgyes pa sngags kyi sgra byung bsam/ /bdud rtsi myangs la bstod chen bya/ /lha rnams rang gnas thim byas te/ /bsam gtan chen po las kyi lam/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa legs gnas bya/ /de nas gtor ma'i las rim dang / /0na lam btab ste ldang bar bya/ /slob dpon chen po rdorje dril bu pa'i man ngag lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi mngon par rtogs pa rdzogs so// //11—576

0333༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim palnga pa'i 'grel pa/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṭītsakra saṃ ba ra pañca gra ma thrata ti/ bod skad du/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim pa lnga pa'i 'grel pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer spros la a wa dhū tī nas gre bar byung nas sna bug g.yas pa nas byung ste sa la babs pa tsam gyis hūṃ du gyur te/ hūṃ zhu ba las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse ②dbus dang / shar dang / byang dang / nub dang /lho sgo rim bzhin du mthing ka dang sngon po dang / ljang gu dang / dmar po dang /ser po'i rdo rje rtse mo lnga ru gyur par bsgom mo/ /de las 'od zer phyogs bzhir byung bar bsams pas①/ shar dang byang dang nub dang / lhor rim pa bzhin du rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa sngon po dang / ljang gu dang / dmar po dang / ser por thim stipas rlung yang mi thar bar gyur par bsam mo/ /rdo rje de dag gi rtse mo las 'od 'phros pas shar phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / lho 11—578

phyogs kyi steng gi cha rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po dang / ljang gu dang / dmar po dang /ser lor thim ①pas mig mangs ris ②su gnas pas rlung yang mi thar bar gyur par bsams te/ de ni rdo rje'i gur ro/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus kyi lte bar hūṃ de zhu ba las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par bsam/ de'i lte ba ①shar dang byang dang nub dang / lhor shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dus su nyams su myong ba bde ba tsam dang bcas pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le dkar ba/ 'tsher ba/gsal ba/ gzi mdangs dang ldan pa mthing ga budang / sngon po dang / ljang gu dang / dmar po dang / ser po rnams chu las nya 'phar ba bzhin du sran ma sgom po'i tshad tsam pa lnga bsams la/ de zhu ba las he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu mchan khung na kha ṭī ga bsnams pa⑤/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ g.yon bskum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du badze+es pa—/ zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ smin ma kham pa/phyag rgya drug dang ldan par bdag nyid gyur par bsam mo/ /thig le sngon po dang /ljang gu dang / dmar po dang ser po zhu ba las rim pa bzhin badz+ra ḍā ki nī dang /khā ma dang / khaṇ+ḍa ro hādu/ rū pi ṇi rnams sngon po dang / ljang gu dang /dmar po dang / ser po rnams lha mo bzhir gyur par bsam/ lha mo rnams kyang zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du badze+es pa/ zla ba phyed pas dbu brgyan pa/ gcer bu g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yas na gri gug g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa/ lha lnga kar yang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ mtshalas kyi 'dab ma bzhi la rin po che'i bum pa bzhi'o/ /steng du rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi rnam lngas bkang ba'i ka pā la bzhi bzhag 11—579

pa skad cig gis bsgom ste/ de ni gnas dang lus dang / longs spyod phun sum tshogs pas bsdus pas bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang bsgom yang rung / thog mar bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom par bya ste/ de'i rjes la rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la gsum ste/ hūṃ la dmigs pa dang / thig le la dmigs pa dang / nā da skra ris phra mo sor gcig la dmigs pa'o/ /de la hūṃ la dmigs pa bsgom pa ni/ snying khong stong gi nang du/ 'og tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam mo/ /nyi ma dang zla ba'i bar du thig le'i rgyal po yi ge hūṃ rgun 'bru'i sa bon gyi tshad tsam mam/ sran ma'am/ yungs kar sbom po'i tshad tsam shes rab kyi dbang gi dus su nyams su myong ba'i bde ba de nyid dran par bya zhing / 'og gi rlung yang bskum pa dang / rgyu zhabs kyi nang na yar drangs pa dang / lce yang rkan la sbyar ba'i sbyor ba yang bya ste/ thig le'i rgyal po yi ge hūṃ snga ma'i tshad tsam du byas la/ dkar la 'tsher ba bde ba dang bcas pa gzi mdangs dang ldan pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bu gur rgun 'bru'i sa bon gyi tshad tsam mam/ yungs kar sgom po'i tshad tsam du dmigs par bya'o/ /de nas hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas ma dag pa'i snod dang bcud la reg pa tsam gyis lan tshwa la chus phog pa bzhin du 'od kyi gong bur bzhu ste dag pa'i snod bcud la bstem/dag pa'i snod bcud kyang bdag la bsdu/ bdag nyid kyang zhu ste/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bstem/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yang zhu ste/ hūṃ la bstem/ hūṃ yig kyang zhabs kyu la bstem/ zhabs kyu ha la bstem/ ha zla tshes la bstem/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da skra ris tsam phra mo la thim pa'o/ /nā da skra ris phra mo yang nam mkha' la thim mo/ /thim pa de nyid la sems gtadalja11—580

nas/ de nas chu la nya 'phar ba bzhin du'am/ nam mkha' la glog 'gyu ①ba lhar / skad cig tsam gyis snga ma ltar dran te/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i lha'i skur bsams te/ mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang lce dang lus dang / ngag dang / yid dang dzi na dzika dang / badz+ra dṛka dang / rat+na j-ika dang / pradz+nyā byeka dang / badz+ra satwa dang / sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rjer mos pa bya ste/mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i spyod pas gnas par bya'o/ /thig le la gnas pa ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'i gnas dang / lus dang / longs spyod phun sum tshogs pas bsdus pa bsgom pa snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bar du byang chub kyi sems kyi bde ba'i thig le dkar la 'tsher ba gzi mdangs dang ldan pa/ shes rab ye shes kyi dus su myong ba'i bde ba de nyid dran par bya ste/'og gi rlung bskum mo/ /'og gi rlung bskum pa dang / rgyu zhabs kyi sha yar drangs pa dang / lce yang rkan la sbyar ba'i sbyor ba byas nas/ zla ba'i bu gu rgun 'bru'i sa bon tsam mam/ sran ma tsam mam/ yungs kar tsam nas snga ma'i thig le rgun 'bru'i thig le tsam mam/ sran ma'am/ yungs kar tsam la rnam par shes pa'i tshogs lnga char bkug la/ kun gzhi rnam par shes pa las bsdus te gtad ①par bya'o/ /thig le la sems zin cing gzhan du mi 'phro ba'i don dus su rlung 'gags shing bde ba'i ye shes kyang chos nyid kho nas skye bar 'gyur ro/ /nā da skra ris phra mo la dmigs pa ni gnas dang longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pas bsdus pa'i bskyed pa'i rim ④pa snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni snying khong stong 'od gsal ba'i gnas nā da skra ris phra mo sor gcig pa la sbom phra skra'i nyag ma tsam la byang chub kyi sems dkar la 'tsher ba gzi mdangs dang ldan pa 11—581

bde ba dang bcas pa 'og gi rlung bskum pa dang / rgyu zhabs kyi sha yar drangs pa dang / lce rkan la sbyar bas sbyor zhing shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dus su stsong ba'i bde ba de nyid dran par byas la nā da skra ris phra mo la dmigs par bya'o/ /nā da skra ris phra mo la rtsa gnyis gzung ⑨ste/ gnas pa las sna bug gang nas dbugs/ 'byung ba brtags te/ gang nas dbugs rgyu ba zhig nas nā da skra ris la rlung dang sems 'dres pa'i bde ba dang bcas pa dkar la 'tsher ba/ gzi mdangs dang ldan pa phyir byung ba la dmigs so/ /de nyid nang du 'jug pa la dmigs te/'byung ba dang 'jug pa yun bsdu zhing gnas pa la yun ring du sems gtad cing gnas par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la nā da skra ris phra mo dang bcas pa'i chos thams cad cir yang ma grub par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas skad cig tsam gyis kyesgyu ma lta bu'i skur bsams la/ dbang po drug dang lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas drug dang sku gsung thugs su bsam zhing shes par bya ste/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i spyod pas gnas par bya'o/ /de tsam gyis ni bdag byin kyis brlab ④pa'i rim pa'i man ngag bstan zin to// //sna tshogs rdo rje dri med kyi rim pa la gnyis te/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub 5pa'i rim pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub bsgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub — pa'i rim pa la gnyis te/bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la gnyis te/ rten rdo rje'i gur dang pad+ma bsgom pa dang / brten pa lha 3bsgom pa'o / /rten bsgom pa snga ma dang mthun no/ /brten pa lha bsgom pa ni pad+ma'i dbus su hūṃ bsam mo/ /hūṃ zhu ba las rdo rje bsam mo/ /rdo rje zhu ba las he ru ka 11—582

zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dbu skra ser po gyen du brjes pa/ smin ma kham pa/thod pa lnga yis dbu la ①brgyan pa/ zla ba phyed pas dbu la mdzes pa mche ba gshigs pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa/ sku mdog sngon po dang dmar po gang yang rung ba'o/ /dbu la dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang pa/g.yon bskum pa laphyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can nyi ma phyed pa'i 'od dang ldan pa'i rdo rje dbang phyug gi skur bsgom par bya'o/ /de ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ mig stong pa nyid du bsgom pa dang —/ mig gi nang du byang chub kyi sems kyi bde ba'i thig le sran ma tsam dkar la 'tsher ba gzi mdangs dang ldan pa bde ba dang bcas pa la sems gtad kyipar bya'o—/ /de bzhin du rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang lus rnams stong pa nyid du bsgoms la/ rna ba la sogs pa rnams su byang chub kyi sems kyi bde ba'i thig le dkar la 'tsher ba snum la 'dril ba gzi mdangs dang ldan pa bde ba dang bcas pa re re nas yul rnams la sems gtad ④par bya'o/ /snying gar byang chub kyi sems kyi bde ba'i thig le sran ma tsam dkar la 'tsher ba gzi mdangs dang ldan pa bde ba dang bcas pa sran ma sbom po'i tshad tsam la sems gtad ⑤par bya'o/ /mgo bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le gong ma dang 'dra ba la sems gtad napar bya'o/ /mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le snga ma dang 'dra ba la sems gtad ⑫༄par bya'o/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le snga ma dang 'dra ba la sems gtad shepar bya'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rim pa la gnyis te/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa la snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /11—583

rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i mdzod spur bde ba'i thig le dkar po 'tsher ba bde ba dang ldan pa sran ma sbom po'i tshad tsam la sems gtad ①par bya'o/ /de la sems brtan pa thob pa dang / dmar ting pa'i rtags 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de byung ba dang dpral ba'i nang du bde ba'i jig le dkar la 'tsher ba gzi mdangs dang ldan pa sran ma sbom po'i tshad tsam la sems gtad ④par bya'o/ /de la sems brtan pa thob pa'i mtshan ma ni dkar nying ba 'byung ngo / /de'i rjes la mtshog ma'i gnas su bde ba'i thig le gnag la 'tsher ba gzi mdangs dang ldan pa bde ba dang bcas pa sran ma spom po'i tshad tsam pa la sems gtad ④par bya'o/ /de la sems brtan pa thob pa'i mtshan ma ni nag ting ba 'byung ngo / de ni ④rjes la rtog pa dang bral ba'i bde ba chen po rang rig gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ngang gis skyes pa ni yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ste/ de la sras sangs rgyas 'khrungs par de ni sna tshogs rdo rje dri med kyi rim pa ste gnyis pa'o// //nor bu dgang pa'i rim pa la bzhi ste/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya la brten pa dang / las kyi phyag rgya la brten pa dang / chos kyi phyag rgya la brten pa dang /phyag rgya chen po la brten pa'o/ /de la dam tshig gi phyag rgya la brten pa ni legs par brlabs pa'i mi'i yo shi dha'i rigs dang / spyod pas nye ba dang / ma sring ltar snying brtse bas dga' bas gnas pa dang / sngags dang phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa dang / bo bcu gnyis nas nyi shu'i bar smin pa'i lam kyis smin par byas pas dbang bskur dang ldan pa nyer bsdogs byas te/ gnas yid du 'ong bar me tog dmar pos gcal du bkram pa'i bar du lus kyi dri nga ba mi tshor ba tsam du gos mdzes pa gon zhing stan 'jam po la gnas te/ bza' ba'i dam 11—584

tshig zhag bdun gyi bar du 'o ma dang / ka ra gnyis sbyar ba'i btung ba dang /lug gzhon nu ma'i sha sar pa mi drag pa tsam du btang bar byas te/ chags pa'i mig gis ①phan tshun du blta zhing gnas par bya'o/ /de nas mnyam par sbyor ba'i dus su bdag dang shes rab he ru ka dang bdag med mar nga rgyal bskyed la/ shes rab kyi mgo bo dang / sgog ma dang / snying ga dang / lte ba dang / gsang ba dang —/ brla rnams su yi ge dgod do/ /oṃ tshihūṃ ho haṃ k+ṣa swā hā zhes pa rnams bkod la/ rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlabs te/ rol rtsed mchu gzhib pa dang /tsum pa bya ba dang / rtsa rme ba dang / gnas dgur sen mo gdab pa la sogs pa de ltar byas la/ de'i rjes su phan tshun 'khyud cing chags pa'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas gol che ba'i lag pas a wa dhū tī brud cing gsal bar bya'o/ /a wa dhū tī dang gol che ba'i lag pa phrad pa'i dus su bzhin 'gyur ba dang / shes skad 'byen pa dang —/ snying 'dar ba la sogs pa'i rtags blo la bzhag ste/ rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par spyor ba'i dus su sngar gyi rtags lta bur 'byung ba'i dus su rdo rje de nyid sbyar te/ gcer bu kha sbyor gyi sbyor ba 'khor lo lta bu srub pacing bsrub par bya'o/ /thabs dang shes rab kyi thur sel gyi rlung dang / srog dang rtsol ba'i rlung sdom zhing 'khrul 'khor gyi sbyor ba yang bya'o/ /rgyu zhabs nas yar sbyar/ lce yang rkan la spyor ba'i spyor ba yang bya'o/ /tang ku li'i sbyor ba yang bya'o/ /de ni 'khrul 'khor gyi sbyor ba'o/ /sman gye sbyor ba ni tsi tra ka dang / arka dkar po'i rtsa ba dang —/ rdo rje 'o mas 'ju ba mnyam du bsres pa'i ri lu sran ma'i tshad tsam dang mid la/ sems 'byung 'dod pa'i dus su sman gyi ri lu de gsum las mnyam pa gcig kyang med par bya'o/ /rdo rje 'o ma dang ba'i 'o ma gnyis sbyar bas rkang 11—585

mthil gnyis kyang bsku bar bya'o/ /bi nu kan ta'i rtsa ba dang pad+ma dkar po nang na dkar po nar nar po gnyis bsku bar bya ste/ rked pa bcing bar bya'o/ /de ni dha ra a sho ka zhes bya ba sems 'dzin pa'i sman no/ /mnyam par sbyor ba gzud pa'i dus su 'gron bug ①lhugs pa'i nang du dngul chus bkang ba'i ser ka'i phyogs spra tshil gyis bkag ste/ lce rtsar bzhag la sems 'byung 'dod pa'i dus su lkugs/ pa'i lce rtsar sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ni nor bu rin po che lkugs pas sems gzung ba'i thabs so/ /shes rab kyi 'phongs su glong 2gzhug ste/ rang gi rdo rje'i tshad pas sor gcig pas ring ba'i phying ba'i dra ba byas la spra ①tshil gyis gtum par bya'o—/ /shes rab kyi rked pa dar gyes bcing zhing gsang ba'i pad+ma'i nang du 4rdo rje'i gzugs sor gcig tsam bcug la rked pa yar gyi cung zhig bsdam mo/ /sor gnyis tsam zhugs pa dang cung zad kyang bsdam mo/ /de bzhin du rdo rje cung zhig bcug cing rked pa bsdam par bya'o/ /sor gcig lus mus ⑤kyi bar du bcug cing de yang shin tu bsdam mo/ /sor gcig po shes rab nyid kyis gyen du bcug pas pad+ma phyir log ste/ a wa dhū tī sor gcig pas phyir byung bas rdo rje'i bug par bcug cing 'khor lo lta bu'i sbyor thabs kyis bcug ⑥cing gtsub par bya'o/ /man ngag de rnams kyi 7stobs kyis dpe'i lhan cig skyes pa'i me tog lta bu'i bde ba chen po'i rang rig gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i rjes la 'khor lo'am/ thig le'am/ kha spyor ram ma ning gi bzlas pa'am/man ngag de bzhi las gang yang rung ba cig la sems gtad ④cing sngar gye bde ba dran zhing don gyi lhan cig skyes pa'i me tog gi dri lta ⑨bu'i bde ba chen po'i rang rig ⑫gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la bslab par bya'o/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i 11—586

skabs su yang bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i skabs su rang gi sems kyi mtshan nyid bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du ci mthong ba thams cad la mos par bya ste/ nga ma mthong ba 'gro ma mthong / /sa gsum po yang nga las skyes/ /bde ba ser po bde ba dkar/ /bde ba dmar po bde ba ljang / /de bzhin kun du ru skyes bde/ /zhes bya ba'i tshul gyis bslab par bya'o/ /yon tan dang ldan pa'i shes rab dgug par 'dod na 'bras bu gsum dang / bil ba dang / bal po'i se'u dang /star ka dang / po son cha ①dang / da trig dang / ba li ka dang / shu kra rnams gnyis te/ sman sna bcu gcig po cha mnyam par bsres pa'i lde gus bskus pa'i me tog bsnol du gzhug go/ /khye'i rus pa dang / mi rus dang / bya rgod kyi rtug pa gsum sbyar te bdag nyid kyi dpral bar bsku'o/ /gzhan gyi sems mi bsgyur ba'i thabs ni pha wang tshes bzhi'i dgongs ka btags la de'i ril ma btags pas bdag nyid kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje'i rtse mo la bskus nas snyoms 'jug byas na gzhan gyis sems bsgyur bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'khor ba mi spel ba'i man ngag ni lag pa'i mthil dag par bkrus pa'i steng du dngul chu srin lag dag pa la bskus la 'bru mar mi tshe ba bsdus te blangs la lag pa chang gi nang du bcug ste/bskams tsam na dpral ba la bskus te/ yo shi ti ldan du bzhag go/ /yang na mtshal sgrug po zho gnyis zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma snga dro'i dus su chang zhim po dang sbyar la blud do/ /lcags kyi ldug la spu pi ka'i rtsa bas dkris pa thogs su gzhug go//yang spu pi ka'i rtsa bas rked pa dkri ⑤bar bya'o/ /lcags kyi khu bas srod kyi dus su pad+ma bkru bar bya'o/ /bu ram dang til mar dang / lan tshwa dang rgya shug gi 'bras bu dang / 'bras dang / nas rnams 'o ma dang bskol te/ til mar nyi 11—587

tshe lus pa btsags pa'i nang du srin lag bcug ste/ pad+ma'i nang du bcug la yun ring du dkrugs par bya'o/ /ra ①rtsa'i bya ba ni da du dzura'i rtsa ba dang / ga pur dang sbyar ba rdo rje la bsku bar bya'o/ /sha khar dang ba'i mar srang phyed sbyar ba zas/ zos pa'i 'og tu bza'o/ /mchil pa'i sha zhag gcig lon pa mtshams kyi dus su zos la 'o ma bskol ba tshad du btung bar bya'o/ /til mar dang mon sran gre'u'i phye ma 'o ma dang bsres pa bza' bar bya'o/ /go cha dang ba'i 'o ma dang shing mngar rnams mar dang sbyar ba btung bar bya'o/ /ba'am ra'i 'o ma'i nang du dbang ngo/ lag pa'i phye ma dang ka ra'i phye ma zhib tu btags pa btab ste btung bar bya'o/ /dam tshig mi nyams pa'i man ngag ni dge slong gi so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dus su byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims su gyur te gnas so/ /spyir gsang sngags kyi dam tshig nyams na sdom pa gsum 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang / gsang sngags kyi dam tshig gi lugs kyi kha na ma tho ba gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba dang /bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba gnyis so/ /de la yang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba ni srog gcod pa dang / ma byen par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang —/ brdzun du smra ba dang / de bzhi las dang po gnyis dang / tha ma ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod la nyams su blang bar bya ste/ 'di ru ma bshad do/ /'dod pas log par g.yem pa ni rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho bar gtogs khye 7pas nyams su blang bar 'di ru ma bshad do/ /mi tshangs par spyod pa ni bcas pa'i khan ma tho ba yin pas de ni de bzhin nyid kyi bdag nyid can kyis shes par spyod byugadon chen po yod pas gdams ngag yod na mi 'gal bar rtsa ba'i rgyud rnams su 11—588

bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad do/ /'dod pas log par g.yem pa ni rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba yin pa'i phyir dang / gzhan gyi lus bsrungs pa yod pa'i phyir nyams su blang bar bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di ru ma bshad do/ /mi tshangs par spyod pa ni nyams su blang bar gsungs te/ de yang lo bcu gnyis pa'am bcu drug pa'am/ lo nyi shu tshun chad kyi gzhon nu ma zhes gsungs pas ni mi 3'gal lo/ /de yang gzhan gyi dbang ma byas pa dang mnyam par spyor ba snang ngo / /'dir yang don chen po yod pas dus rnam pa bzhir nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /dus bzhi ni byang chub kyi sems kyi bde ba mchod pa'i dus dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha bsgrub 5 pa'i dus dang / slob ma la gsang dbang bskur ba'i dus dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i dus so/ /mchod pas ni lha mnyes pas dngos grub rnam pa gnyis thob pa'i don chen po yod pa'i phyir dang / dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pas ni sku gsung thugs dang / ye shes kyis 'gro ba'i don chen po mdzad pas chos kyi thob pa'i 'gro ba'i don chen po yod pa'i phyir dang / gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas ni slob ma theg pa chen po'i snod du rung ba'i phyir mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i don chen po yod pa'i phyir ro/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bsgur bas ni—/ rang gi sems kyi mtshan nyid bde ba chen po rang rig pa'i ye shes gnyis su med pa'i ye shes spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral bar nyams su myong ba'i phyir don chen po yod pas 'dir dam tshig las mi 'gal bar bsten ① to/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel par shes par bya'o/ /mkhas pa nga rgyal dang ldan pas byas pa la ni ma yin no/ /de ni spros pa dang bcas pa'i spyod pa dang —/ spros pa med pa'i spyod pa'o/ /shin tu spros pa med pa'i spyod pa la ni 11—589

dngos po la reg pa med pas nyes par mi gzhag ⑫go/ /ma dad pa spang ba'i man ngag ni/ ga bur gla rtsi/ gur kum/ tsan+dan/ ma he shukra bsres pa'i sde gus dpral bar bsku bar bya'o/ /de ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya la brten pa'i nor bu dag pa'i mirim pa'o/ /las kyi phyag rgya la brten pa'i nor bu dag pa'i ①rim pa ni gnas kyi dam tshig dang / bza' ba'i dam tshig dang / spyod lam gyi man ngag ni snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /rnal 'byor pa gan rkyal du gnas te/ rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis nam mkha' la bsgrengs te/ gnas pas sor mo lhag ma thur du bskums la gzhag go/ /tang ku li'i spyor ba yang bya ste/ 'og gi rlung bskum pa dang / rgyu zhabs kyi sha yar la drangs pa dang / lce rkan la sbyar ba'i sbyor ba yang byas te/lag pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'i sbyor ba'i bye brag gis brud pa'i sbyor ba byas la bde ba rtog pa med pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar bya'o/ /chos kyi phyag rgya la brten pa'i nor bu dgang ba'i rim pa ni sems kyi snang ba'i lha mo bsams te/ snga ma'i man ngag gis shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dus kyi bde ba dran par byas la/ 'khor lo'am/ thig le'am/ kha sbyor ram/ ma ning gi bzlas pa'i man ngag la sems gtad par bya'o/ /phyag rgya chen po la brten pa'i nor bu dgang ba'i rim pa ni sngar skyes pa'i bde ba de nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du bsgom pa'o/ /de ni nor bu dgang ba'i rim pa'o/ /dzā larnya ra'i rim pa la gnyis te/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa ni sngar dang 'dra'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni rang gi lte ba'i 'og chu so'i gong du chos 'byung gi phyag rgya gru gsum dkar la dmar chags pa bsams la/ de'i nang du 'khor lo dkar la dmar chags pa/ rtsibs bzhi pa dbus kyi lte ba la bsams te/11—590

dbus su bde ba'i thig le dkar po dang phyogs bzhir sngon po dang dmar mo 1dang /ser po dang / ljang gu dang / sran ma'i tshad tsam bsams la/ de nyid sangs rgyas lngar mos pa bya ste/ 'og sgo dang steng sgo'i rlung bkag pas thig le lnga'i 'od zer 'phros te sna'i bu ga'i nam mkha' nas byung nas dbugs gang nas rgyu ba'i sna bug na sor bcu gnyis kyi bar du 'byung ste/ slar nang du bcug ste/thig le lnga la thim/ sgom pa'i dus phyir 'byung ba dang / nang du 'jug pa'i dus na yang je thung je thung la grangs kyang je nyung je nyung du bya zhing / nang na gnas pa la yun yang je ring je ring du sems brtan par bya'o/ /mig gis mthong ba bas thig le lnga gsal bar mthong ba de srid du bsgoms la de nas lce dang dpung pa dang mig dang rna ba dang / sna dang lce la snga ma'i thig le de nyid bsams na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub ji ltar 'dod pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa la gnyis te/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang /sdogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa ni snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni sems yul rnams la bzlog ste/ chos thams cad sems tsam du bsgoms te/ sems de nyid bde ba rtog pa med par bya ste/ shes pa de nyid kyang stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /mnyam par ma gzhag pa'i spyod pa ni snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /slob dbon chen po rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim pa lnga pa'i 'grel pa paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti tīrti dang / lo tsā ba mar pa ban+de chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba sdogs so// //17 —591

bsdur mchan/57/ ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—rtse/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po'i thams/579 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po'i thams/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rigs/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kadhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—pa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ha/58༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstad/581 ①〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'byung / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstad/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rig582 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zug ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstad/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉4 bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabagadhi0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉(kha/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉brten pa 'di 〈〈snar 〉〉rten pa la/583 ①〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstad/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstad/rjorjo⑦⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstad/584 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstad/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstad/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mtshogs/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstad/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉de'i/585 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrub/586 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'gren bu/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉glod/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga tshu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—du/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lus/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gcub/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstad/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dril/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/587 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉so 'aza'/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉bamado588 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ro/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ru/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/589 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/59༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dgang ba'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dgang ba'i/591 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'o/ /11byed592

0334༄7/ /bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ha dza saṃ ba ra sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes bya rnal 'byor cho ga gsum/ /byin gyis rlob dang rab tu rtog /bsam bral gzugs brnyan yongs su rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs rnal 'byor du/ /sems can rdzus te skyes pa bzhin/ /gang zhig skad cig sbyor ba yis sa bon med par rnam par bsgom/ /rang nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gror gyur/ /zla ba phyed pa spyi bor 'dzin/ /dpral bar thod pa'i phreng ba bsnams/ /phyag rgya drug ldan mgo bo'i phreng / /spyan gsum sna tshogs rdo rje can/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi mar gnas/ /'jigs byed dus mtshan bcas par dgod/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis bcibs— / /rdo rje dril bu ral par ldan/ /gnag cing mi bskyod spyi bo'i gtsug /stag gi pags pas yang dag bcings/ /dpa' bo'i 4rdo rje phag mo ni/ /spyan 11—594

gsum dmar zhing mgo phreng ldan/ /rdo rje thod pa khrag gis bkang / /rked rgyan dum bus mtshan pa 'dzin/ /phyogs kyi gos la phyag rgya lnga/ /dbu skra grol zhing sangs rgyas gtsug /'di ltar skad cig gis rdzogs pa'i/ /bdag nyid lus ni bsgom 1 par bya/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gzugs/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer rnam par spro / /spyod yul gcig gi dwa sems kyis su/ /'di nyid kho na yun ring bsam— go 'phang 'di la sems can dgod/ /chos dbyings rgyal mtshan yang dag sbyor/ /gnyis gnyis sbyor ba bde las byung / /dga' ba zag pa'i phun tshogs kyis/ /rang rig dga' bas yongs su khengs/ /zag pas skyed par byed pa gang / /des ni rgya chen yid la byed/ /'dus byas spros pa'i rgyun 'di ni/ /'di ltar rtag tu sgom pa pos/ /'od gsal rjes su dran par bya/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma dang / /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan no/ /sdug ma bdag mo mkha' nor bu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga yi 'og /sku dang yan lag mchog dang ni/ /zla ba thig le nā da rnams/ /'di rnams rim gyis mi snang gzhug /ji ltar me long dbus kyi rlung / /thams cad thim par gyur pa ltar/ /yang dag mtha' ru yang nas yang //de bzhin rnal 'byor rab tu gzhug /grub thob rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa'i/bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje gdan pa niska lo ka'i zhal snga nas/ dpyal lo tsā ba dpal chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //17 —595

༷nan5༄khya/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sgrub pa'i thabs rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ spyobha ga bān tsakra saṃ ba ra sā dha na rat+na dzin tā ①ma ṇi nā ma/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sgrub pa'i thabs rin po che yid bzhin kyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ṭīchu rgya mtsho tha dad med bzhin he 'dus ma byas nam mkha' bzhin/ /ru lha'i rnga ltar gtso 'khor longs spyod ka yi ①yid bzhin ④nor ltar dgos 'dod skong / /rnam par thar zhing dus gsum bdud bzhi rten 'brel bcu gnyis bden gnyis sogs/ /de bzhin ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid bha gar zhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla rjonor ldan pas gsol btab pas/ /'khor lo bde mchog sgrub pa'i thabs/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i don bzhin du/ /bdag gis legs par bshad par bya/ /ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs dang / /chu bo chen po'i ngogs dag dang / /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod du/ /der ni 11—597

dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya/ /rnal 'byor pa nyid bsod nams mchog /das byed sdig pa 'jig byed pa/ /gsang sngags zlos pa'i bzlas brjod dang / /bsam gtan gyis kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /mchod bzhi dpa' bo chen po ni/ /yid la 'dod pa byed pa ste/ /rgyud 'di ru ni dbang bskur na/ /thams cad kyis ni sgrub por gsungs/ /blta ①dang dgod dang lag 'dzin dang / /'khyud dang gnyis sprod la sogs la/ /dbang bskur bar ni gyur pa yin/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi dam pa yin/ /nang par sngar langs sems bdag nyid/ /lus gnas brjod cing lus dag bya/ /rang gi sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /bla ma dang ni dkyil 'khor lha/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems sogs kun/ /nam mkha' kun gang mdun na (kyibalta/ /lus sna tshogs kyis phyag btsal zhing / /de dag 'gro ba'i don du dbul/ /hūṃ gi 'od zer las byung ba'i/ /gzugs ma sgra ma dri ro ma/ /reg ma chos ma zhi ba ma/ /dkar sngo ser dmar ljang dkar mo/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yon thod ṭī/ /g.yas rnams me long pi wang dang / /dri mchog ro mchog na bza' dang / /chos 'byung dang ni ḍa ma ru/ /oṃ t+pabadz+ra k+ṣiṃdar she hūṃ/ oṃ t+pabadz+ra bī ṇi hūṃ/ oṃ tshibadz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ④hūṃ/ oṃ t+pabadz+ra ra ( snase hūṃ/ oṃ ubadz+ra spar she hūṃ/ oṃ tshibadz+ra dharme hūṃ/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i lha mo yis/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis lha yid gang / /snyoms 'jug lhan cig skyes dga' yin/ /lha mo rnams dang mchod pas dgyes/ /sdig pa bshags bsdams rjes yi rang / /dge ba yongs bsngo skyabs 'gro bya/ /chos 'khor bskor bskul bzhugs gsol gdab/ /byang chub smon 'jug sems bskyed bshagasa')/ /khyad 'phags bde sbyor byams pa ste/ /sdug bsngal rgyu bral snying rje che/ /bde ba mi 'bral 'dod dga' ba/ /nyon mongs 11—598

nye bral btang snyoms so/ /chos kun ①ngo bo nyid med pa/ /kun rtog sgyu ma lta bur shes/ /skaswa bhā ④ba shurtseḥ saza dharmātshoswa bhā ba shurnyophohaṃ/ sa bon 'od kyis brtan g.yo sbyangs/ /thig le sngags kyis dmigs pa med/ /oṃ shu n+ya ④tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ/ chos kun rab tu gnas med pa/ /'od gsal nam mkha' dri ma med/ /yi ge e las chos 'byung ste/ /hūṃ gyur bde chen phyag gnyis parka/ /shar sogs lugs dang mi mthun dang / /lugs mthun g.yon mdzub se gol gtogs⑤/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṭ+wā pa ya kṛsnrapa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃphywan ya ho/ bha ga bān bhu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ khwa gdong ma sogs phyag gnyis ma/ /dmar mo g.yon brkyang nyi ma'i gdan/ /rang 'dra stod phur g.yon pa na/ /g.yas pa tho ba thogs pa'o/ /rdo rje ra ba sa gzhi gur / /bla re mda' yi dra ba bya/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ka ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ me di ⑦ni badz+re bha ba badz+ra brnya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi dā na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tram̐ saṃ tram̐ hūṃ gyur dngos ⑧po brgyad nang du/ /bgegs rnams bcug la phur bu gzugs/ /oṃ ghaḥghaḥghā ta ya ghā ta ya saza duṭ+wān hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya san+d+ra pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti kā ya bāka tsit+ta badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra tī la ya k+ṣiṃko ṭa hūṃ phaṭa/ tho bas brdungs te phur pas btab/ /bgegs rnams rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'gyur/ /lha mo 'od gyur lus 'phros las/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo me/ /oṃ badz+ra pā kā ra hūṃ/oṃ pad+ma pā kā ra hūṃ/ oṃ tsakra pā kā ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ba lang gnas dang lteng lding dang / /lhag ma skam po rtsa de nas/ /dung chen po yi rang bzhin bya/ /yang na rus sbal dag gi'o/ /ri rab kyi steng sna tshogs pad+ma'i 11—599

lte bar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje chen po ste/ de'i lte bar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs pa las grub pa'i khang pa brtsegs ma gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /pi wang sogs lha stegs bur 'khod/ /rgyan phreng sogs pa bdun gyis brgyan/ /ba dan bcu gnyis rlung bskyod sgra/ /gnas phyogs shing zhing rlung sprin dang / /mchod rnal dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor①/ /khang nang sna tshogs pad 'dab brgyad/ /mtha' ma gri gug phreng 'khor gsum/ /pad steng 'jigs byed dus mtshan brtsigs/ /snying gar nyin mo'i dbang phyug gdan/ /phyogs 'dab srog song snying ri bong / /mtshams steng zla bum thod bdud rtsi/ /ri steng sna tshogs pad+ma yi/ /ste bar k+ṣiṃli kā li skyes/ /dkar mo bdag po rnam gnon cing —/ /rdo rje dril bus sku la 'khyud/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhis phyed ldan pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs can/ /ṭīte ru ka rgyal po chen po'i/ /go 'phang mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /bcom ldan 'khor lo bde mchog ni/ /sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi pa/ /drug gnyis phyag gis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi ⑤gom pas bzhugs/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni mthing nag 'bar/ /g.yon pa pad+ma rā ①ga'i mdog /g.yas pa gser du 'bar ba ste/ /steng zhal ma ra ka tar 'bar/ /dmar zlum spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs/ /ral pa thor tshugs dar dpyang ④can/ /thod pa lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /zla phyed sna tshogs rdo rje mdzes/ /dus min 'chi ba las rgyal ba/ /yan lag kha ṭī ga dang sbyar/ /thod pa'i mchod yon snod du ni//zhal du mtshon cha nges par sbyar/ /lang tsho gzhon pa 'gying bag can/ /sumacu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang zhing / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan/ /sgegapa 11—600

wa sogs nyams dgu ldan/ /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /phyag rgya drug gis rab tu mdzes/ /mgo phreng do shal chen po can/ /steng nas gdugs dkar legs par 'dzin/ /de mdun gnas pa'i lha mo ni/ /rdo rje phag mo rab 'jigs ma / /te ru ka dpal phyogs byas nas/ /spyan gsum drag mo'i gzugs can ma/ /ka pā li ①ni an tras bkang / /kha nas ru ti ra 'dzag cing / /lha dang lha min mir bcas pa/ /phyogs kun du ni sdigs mdzub byed/ /sku mdog dmar mo cher 'bar ma/ /zhal gcig ma la phyag gnyis ma/ /phyag g.yon thod khrag thabs la 'khyud/ /g.yas pa rdo rje gri gug 'dzin/ /skra grol rnam mdzes rgyan lnga ldan/ /sgeg cing nu ma 'bur la mkhrang (snye/ /g.yon brkyang gom pa thabs dang sbyar/ /g.yas pa yab kyi brla steng 'khyud/ /thugs kar shes rab rab 'gyur nyid/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ①rdor hūṃ/ /sku gsung thugs rdo rjer byin brlab/ /gsum gsum de ni yi ge gsum/ /gapā dag rab sgrub byed pa'i sngags/ /de yi dbye ba rim bzhin bshad/ /phan tshun brgyus pa'i gsang sngags ni/ /yul nyid kyis ni phye ba'o—/ /kha sbyar sbyar bar gyur pa dang / /rdo rje lu gu rgyud bcings pa'o/ /ya sde brgyad pa'i sa bon dang / /de bzhin gug skyed bcu gnyis kyi/ /yi ge bar ma dor byas la/ /yan lag drug he ru kar brjod/ /yi ge re res yang dag gnas//oṃ na ma swā hā bo ṣaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dang yang dag ldan/ /phaṭa hūṃ tre hri haṃ 4oṃ rnams/ /yi ge baṃ dang oṃ dang ni/ /yi ge mo dang hri nyid dang / /hūṃ dang phaṭa ces sbyar ba ni/ /rnal 'byor ma ni drug tu bshad/ /thabs dang shes rab go cha yin—/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni re re yang / /bye ba grangs med pa yis bskor/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can dang 5/ /dngos 11byed601

shegrub thams cad rab sgrub ma/ /pad+ma'i phyogs kyi gnas la dgod/ /sngon mo ljang khu dmar mo ser/ /zhal gcig skra grol phyag bzhi ma/ /g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭī rga/g.yas pa gri gug ḍa ma ru/ /spyan gsum lang tsho gzhon nu rgyas/ /khro mo ral pa mche ba gdags/ /de nas gzhan yang lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa mkha' 'gro ma/tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa lā ma/ chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dum skyes ma/ sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gzugs can ma/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dpal he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dbang bskur lha/ /phyi gsang mchod pa'i lha mo rnams/ /spyan drangs bgegs bskrad mchod yon dbul/ /oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya bas/ dgug dang gzhug dang bcing dang mnyes/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab ①pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i khu bas gang bas/skasasba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya ṭīye hūṃ zhes dbang bskur ba dang / dkyil 'khor gtso la rdo rje sems dpa'i rgya/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mi bskyod pa/ /mkha' 'gro lā ma dum skyes gzugs can ma/ /rtag pa don grub dpag med rin chen 'byung / /lha mo drug dang bzhi rnams kyis/ /phyi dang gsang bas yang dag mchod/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams legs bstod nas/ /rang rang gnas su yud kyis gshegs/ /de nas phyag rgya'i mchod chen dang / /sngags kyi dgod par rab tu grags/ /myur du dngos grub byed par ni/ /phyag rgya'i mchod 'di the tshom med—/ /mtshan ma gnyis la sngags sbyor te/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' mo gnyis med pa/ /snying po sngags kyis de bzhin du/ /sngags pas mkha' 'gro ma la sbyor/ /oṃshām 11—602

—hā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru ka ñcahūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba yis /dkyil 'khor bar bcas mnyes par bya/ /phyi rol shin tu dga' bya la'ang/ /pad rdor byin brlab 1ṣ+pe'adi dag byung / /mdun du yi ge yo las rlung kyedakyil 'khor/ /gzhur snang sngon po mtha' gnyis ba dan ldan/ /de steng yi ge re las me+e dkyil 'khor/ /zur gsum nyid las dmar po 'bar bas mtshan/ /de steng a las pad+ma'i snod/ /dum bu gcig pa nang dmar po/ /hūṃ oṃ khaṃ e dzā⑦/ /dri chu dri chen sha chen po/ /byang chub sems rang byung me tog /dze+e rmā r+pā hūṃ/ ba lang khyi dang glang po che/ /rta sgon kun la sa bon ldan/ /rlung gis me sbar bdud rtsi dmar por zhu/ /hūṃ dkar kha ṭī dkar la bsil/ /ā li kā li thog mtha' ldan brjod pas/ /kha dog sna tshogs bdud rtsi'i steng du 'khod/ /yongs gyur oṃ ldihūṃ gsum gong nas gong / /'od zer tshogs 'phros nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i—/ /bde gshegs thugs kyi ye shes bdud rtsi bkug /yig gsum la thim gsum thim des byin brlab/ /bcom ldan 'das dang rnal 'byor ma rnams lce/ /yi ge hūṃ byung rdo rje rtse gsum pa/ /dkar po nas 'bru tsam bkod sbu gus drangs/ /bdud rtsi gsol bas lha tshogs tshim par blta④/ /rig sngags bzlas brjod bya ste rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / /bzlas brjod bya ba'i sngags kyi snyeyi ge gang dang ⑥yin pa rnams/ /rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /'og nas 'byung ba rang gi rdo rje'i rtse mo las phyag rgya'i bha gar bton nas/ yang lha mo'i zhal ④du zhugs pa rang gi sa bon la zhugs par blta zhing / zhal thams cad dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis kyang zlos par bsgom par bya ste/ khro bo'i bzlas pa yang bya'o/ /rim pa 'dis bzlas brjod kyi nyes pa dang bral bas sems mnyam par gzhag pa ji srid skyo 11—603

bar ma gyur gyi bar du bzlas brjod bya'o/ /bzlas brjod kyi gsang sngags ni 'di dag yin te/ oṃ badz+ra he he ru ru ke hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki byā dzā la saṃ ba ra swā hā/ oṃ trīḥha ha hūṃ hu)hūṃ phaṭa/ lha'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ sasba burnya ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa byā ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃbadz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lha mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khā ma ye 2hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃkhaṇ+ḍa ro hi ①hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃrū pi ṇi ④ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dpa' mo rnams kyi sngags so/ /chisan mo bha ga ba ti wi khrure shā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kal pāghi sam+bi bhā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ skadza ṭa ma ku ṭoṅka ṭā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rdaṭī ka rā lo gra dhī ṣa ṇa myu khā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃs ha sra bhu dza dhibhā su rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho t+yā ta shu la kha ṭī ga dha ④ra ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gyu ⑧dzi rmā ba/ ra dha rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ wīm hā dhus+thān dha ka ra wa puṣā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ mchod pa'i sngags so/ /ka ra ka ra ku ru ku ru ban+dha ban+dha/ tra sa ya tra sa ya/ khyo bha ya k+ko bha ya/ tram̐ tram̐ hraḥhraḥtse phe phaṭa phaṭa da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi rān tra mā khā ba lo be+e ni/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa sap+ta dupā tā la ga ta bhu dze+e ga sarbaswā tardza ya tardza ya/ ukasbyo k+ṣiṃkarje/ hri hri/ rnyi dzhai/ hūṃ rja/ hūṃ hūṃ/ sh+lau tī/ hūṃ hūṃ/ ki li ki li/si li si li/ hi li hi li/ bye li bye li/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /gang tshe bzlas pas skyo bar gyur pa na/ /sa bon 'od kyis shes rab bdag po dang / /'khor lo pa dang khang pa brtsegs ma rnams/ /snang bar byas te 'od gyur rim bzhin bsdu/ /hūṃ de yongs ⑩gyur pa las bdag nyid ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas brkyang gom pas gnas/ /lang tsho gzhon pa 'gying pa ⑪mtshan dang ldan—/ /phyag rgya drug ldan dril busho rje ⑫'chang / /de nas yongs su bsngo ba dang 11—604

smon lam gdab pa dang / yi ge brgya pa brjod pa yang byas la/ lha'i nga rgyal gyes gnas par bya'o/ /gung dang phyi dro'i thun mtshams su/ /bsam gtan khang par stan bder 'dug /bdag nyid 'od zer du gyur pa/ /hūṃ du gyur de yongs gyur las/ /bcom ldan 'khor lo bde mchog gi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo lha lnga yi—/ /khang brtsegs rin chen tshogs las grub/ /dur khrod brgyad bskor gsal dmigs nas/ /dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i cho ga thams cad bya'o/ /thun tha ma la ni sngar bstan pa'i cho ga thams cad spyad la/ bzlas brjod kyi rjes la hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis thams cad 'od du gyur pa dkyil 'khor bdag po la bsdus la/dkyil 'khor gtso bo dang bcas pa phyag rgya dang bcas pa yang / 'od du gyur pa snying ga yi/ /shes rab rab gyur yab yum la/ /de yang snying ga'i nyi bcas hūṃ/ /nyi ma u ha mgo zla tshes/ /thig le nā da'i bar bsdus la/ /der yang dmigs mred gnyid la 'jug /nang par gyi ①dus su rdo rje rnal 'byor mas glus bskul bas sad par mos par byas la/ cho ga thams cad nyi ma snga ma bzhin du bya'o/ /de ltar gus pa dang bcas pas rgyun mi 'chad par bsgoms pas sems brtan par gyur pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i nying nge 'dzin bsgom par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho tshe dpal/ /khrag 'thung sogs pa rnal 'byor pa/ /me tog sna tshogs lag na thogs/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang / /rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / /glu yi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mkha' spyod gnas su khrid par byed/ /'chi ba zhes 'di rnam rtog yin/ /dam tshig ldan zhing bla ma la gus dang —/ /bsgom bsgrub brtson la dngos grub thams cad 'byung / /tshe dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang / /dpal dang gzi brjid dbang phyug las rnams 11byed605

'grub/ /bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas rtsom ①pa chen por 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid myur du thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'khor lo bde mchog gi//sgrub thabs tshul bzhin byas pa las/ /dge ba thob pa gang yin des/ /'gro kun rdor 'dzin rgyal gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs rin po che yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //①rgya gar kyi mkhan po su ma ti tīrti dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/597 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sgrub pa'i nor bu bzhugs/ sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sa / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—bzhin/ ye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgo598 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bltas/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ghaṣ+pe/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rā/phye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gshegs/599 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sku/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bha/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sarba dhamadza ④〈〈co〉〉rgya/rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gtog du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ban/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sdar 〉〉da/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dog6༷༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkod/ khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yis/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ra/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpyangs/6༷1 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mkhreng / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyid/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tram̐ ho/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/6༷2 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gdab/6༷3 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rlabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgogi/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khā+e 7/ chakhā+e rma tram̐/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉/nas rang gi zhal/11byed606

6༷4 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nā hā rgyu/ 90〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉waye/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉gte/ 97〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsā/(nye1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te wī/ ( 9)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mdza/ (྅1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṅgā/ (27〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snalnga/(9 sna 〈〈snar 〉sprosabha/ (7〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 su/ skyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bag (7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wardo rje/6༷5 6)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/606 6)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsod/ (ge)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shog/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (262)11 wa 607

༄7/ /dpal bde mchog phyag gnyis pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i grub thabs/she/༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī dī 37bhu dza saṃ ba ra sā dha rna/ bod skad du/dpal bde mchog phyag gnyis pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gi dge bas khams gsum srid mtha'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /bsal nas bde ba mtha' dag la ni dgod par bya ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas thob par bgyi'o zhes kyang smon pa bskyed nas su/ /gzhan dag 'jug pa'i rang bzhin yang ni yongs su spel bar bya/ /rnal 'byor rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /byin gyis brlab dang rab brtag krudang / /bsam gyis 'umi khyab gzugs rdzogs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags//gang yang skad cig sbyor ba yis/ /rang nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gror gye'agyur/ /rdzus te skyes pa'i sems can bzhin/ /sa bon med par bsgom bya ste/ /dpral bar gnas pa'i thod phreng can/ /zla ba phyed pa spyi bor 'chang / /phyag rgya drug dang 11byed608

mgo phreng can/ /spyan gsum sna tshogs rdo rje can/ /g.yas brkyang gom stabs bkod pa yis/ /sna tshogs chu skyes nyi ma la/ /gnas pa'i 'jigs byed dus mtshan bcas/ /mnan cing stag gi pags pa 'chang / /nag po mi bskyod cod pan can/ /rdo rje dril bu ral par ldan/ /dpa' bo rdo rje phag mo ni/ /rdo rje thod pa khrag bkang bsnams/ /dmar po ska rags dum bus mtshan/ /spyan gsum mgo bo'i phreng ba can/ /phyag rgya lnga ma skra grol ma/ /phyogs gos sangs rgyas dbu brgyan ma/ /de ltar skad cig gis rdzogs par/ /bdag gis lus ni bsgom par bya/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gsal/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer rnam par 'phro—/ /sems kyi spyod yul gcig tu ni/ /de dag kho na yun ring bsam /sems can gnas der bzhag nas su/ /de nas sangs rgyas dga' ba brtsam /chos dbyings rgyal mtshan kun chags las/ /dman min 'dzag pa phun tshogs rnams/ /yang dag rig pa dga' ba'i tshogs/ /'dzag pa can ma 'char ba gang —/ /de ni rgya chen yid byed pa/ /'phro ba 'dus byas rgyun rnams la/ /rtag tu bsgom zhing 'di bzhin du/ /'od gsal rjes su dran par bya/ /sna tshogs mtsho skyes nyi ma dang ni 'jigs byed dus mtshan mo/ /mdzes ma bdag po nam mkha'i nor bu de bzhin gshegs shā yi / /lus dang yan lag mchog dang 'od dkar thig le nā da ste/ /'di rnams sgrib pa med pa'i gnas su rim gyis gzhug par bya//ji ltar dbugs rlung me long la/ /kun nas yal bar 'gyur ba ni/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor yang dag mthar/ /yang dang yang du gzhug par bya/ /thams cad khyab pa snang ba med/ /snying rje ro gcig yid kyis ni/ /bdag po yin bzhin stong pa nyid/ /skad cig kho nar 'khyud par 'gyur/ /rnam bcas rnam pa med 11—609

pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab de yis 'khyud pa po/ /skye 'jig spangs pa mi 'gyur bde ba dgod pa la sogs bde ba spangs pa po/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni skyeng byed sgu gsum ldan pa khams gsum yang dag rig pa po/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan de nyid la phyag 'tshal/ /mi 'gyur bde ba ye shes dus/ /thabs dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid de/ /shes bya'i rnam par 'gro 'khor lo/ /shes rab stong nyid bdag nyid do/ /kai de bde ba rgyu sked blo/ /snying rje ye shes mi 'gyur ba/ /stong nyid pra 1ti se na bzhin/ /dngos po thams cad mthong ba'o/ /kun nas phyag dang zhabs ldan pa/ /kun nas spyan dang dbu dang zhal/ /kun nas dran ldan 'jig rten du/ /thams cad kun du g.yogs nas bzhugs/ /'di ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /stong nyid snying rje gnyis med pa/ /ma ning zhes byar grags pa ste/ /'ga' zhig tu ni zung 'jug ces / /sgrib pa med pa'i chos kyi ḍa ni/ /phung po la sogs 'di na gnas/ /rten dang brten pa'i mtshan nyid 'di/ /thams cad dkyil 'khor nyid yin no/ /dpal bde mchog phyag gnyis pa 7lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/dngos grub brnyes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal rdo rje dril bu pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po lnga rig paṇa chen grub pa brnyes pa rje btsun rat+na rak+ṣi ta'i zhal snga nas dang / chag lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //4 11—610

bsdur mchan/608 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉dpal bde mchog phyag gnyis pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// sri〈〈snar 〉〉de/ (1〈〈pe 〉stanagong / 〈〈snar 〉〉dgrod/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtags/ 6)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toragro/6༷9 6)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa lnga yi 'og61༷ hu )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7bro/ (ge〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)sa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ go〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ri kun gyis sangs rgyas myur thob shog/ //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (263)11 —61 1

nan7༄༅/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa tsakra bi dhi/ bod skad du/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i mdog can dri med rnal 'byor ma la rol/ /khyung rnams sprul pa bkye nas bdud bzhi zil kyis gnon mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs yin te/ /tshogs la dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur/ /de phyir de yi cho ga ni/ /brgyad dang bcu bzhi bco lnga dang / /tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ /dur khrod dam ni shing gcig mchog /skyed mos tshal dang kun dga' dang / /de bzhin rang gi khyem dang ni/ /gzhan yang dbe+en pa'i khyim du bya/ /dang po tshogs kyi yo byad bsags te / de nas bdud rtsis chos 'byung bris la/ de'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga dang thod par sbyar ba bzhag /de nas yon bdag gis phyag byas/ me tog tshogs kyi slob dpon dang / rnal 'byor yon — phul nas gsol ba gdab/ de nas tshogasakyi 11—612

slob dpon gyis/ /oṃm hā ra shudhe ①sarba dharmā hā ra shurnyophohaṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags mang bar bzlas/ de'i rjes la slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud par snyoms par zhugs par bsam/ de nas bdud rtsi sbyang bar byas/ /ye shes bdud rtsi phab la/ ska.a mṛ ta hūṃ ci nus bzlas/ rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas/de nas phyogs bcur sdigs mdzub kyi 1gtor bas byang sems dpal gyis bgegs bskrad/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bya/ de nas oṃ tshihūṃ gis rdzas skyon med par bde bar brlab/ de nas bskyed rim bsgom ste/ bdun rnam dag gi skabs su mchod pa lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas mchod/ ye shes 'khor lo la gcig de nas dbang bskur yan chad rdzogs pa'i rjes la/ rnal 'byor pa lnga'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa gcig mchod/ bdud rtsi dang zhal bsil gyi rjes la dbul/ de nas lha bsdus la tshogs pas sbyang bar byas la①/ rnal 'byor pa rnams la me tog gi phreng ba dang —/ dri bzang po dbul/ de nas nam mkha' khengs pa'i lha mos kyang / ④bkra shis brjod par bya/ de nas skyes pa'i dum bu gcig pa'i thod pa chang gis bkang la tshig 'di brjod la drang bar bya/ ltos shig dam pa'i chos bya ba/ /'di la rnam rtog yod ⑤ma yin/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum/ /rang bzhin gcig pas lhan cig bza'/ /bde gshegs chos ni sdig med cing / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /'dod chags la sogs skyon dang bral/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /der ni bza' rnams gsol byas te/ /lhag ma sgod du gzhag par bya/ /zhes 'byung bas/ tshogs rol nas gcig gis mas yar lhag ma dang / da duci'i me tog bsdus la gtor mar bsam de'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ khru gang pa yi tshad du ni/ /dri ni bzang pos byug par bya/ /de 11—613

phyir dkar po gru gsum yin/ /nya dang sha sogs gtor ma bzhag /me tog la sogs gtor mar bzhag /de mi dmigs par byas la/ mos pas chos 'byung gru gsum bsams la/ rtse mo thur na mo las oṃ las rnam snang / g.yon pa āḥlas snang ba mtha' yas/ /g.yas pa hūṃ las mi bskyod pa/ nang du paṃ ljang gu las sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i steng du sems can rnams yab yum dang / khro bo dang khyung du bsams la gtor ma btang / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs mgron rang rgyud pa spyan drangs la bstem / kā ya bāka gis bstab/ bstod nas bkra shis bya/ de nas yang dag par mchod pa'i cho ga ma tshang ba dang lhag pa rnams/ rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa gdon/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub la 'dod pa'i gsol ba gdab / de nas thal mo sbyar la smon lam gdab/ sems can thams cad sdeg med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad gyur pa'i/ /lam de nyid du zhugs nas kyang / /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams grol bar shog /rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam tshig la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /se gol lan gsum brdab byas la/ /phyi rol lha rnams gshegs su gsol/ /bdag gis tshogs 'khor 'di byas pas/ /dge ba dri med gang thob des/ /tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags nas kyang / /'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin rgyal shog /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //11—614

༄7/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa/37༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra salba ra sto traḥ/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhe sdang tshul gyis zhe sdang 'joms mdzad cing / /chos dbyings rnam dag ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor3 / /zhe sdang rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ gi rdo rje las byung char sprin mdog /dga' ba rnam dag drag po'i zhal bzhir snang / /gar gyi nyams dgus gdul dka' 'dul mdzad pa//hūṃ mdzad rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'byel bcu gnyis dag pas sa rnams rdzogs/ /bcu gnyis phyag gis phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin/ /yul dang yul can 1rnam rtog 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /ngo mtshar mtshon cha bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo / /hūṃ gi nga ros srid gsum skrag mdzad cing / /rngam pa'i rkan sgra phaṭa kyi sgra sgogs pas/ /bdud dang bgegs tshogs gdul dka' ma lus 'dul/ /rnam 11—616

rtog bgegs bdud 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros bral bde mchog pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /stong nyid 'od gsal dus gsum bde gshegs blo/ /rnam rtog dra ba ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rnam par dag /dag pa'i zhal bzhi rigs kyi yum du snang //dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi yi ngo bo nyid/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs yum la phyag 'tshal lo / /sems kyi rnam rtog sa bla'i srid pa sbyong / /zhe sdang rnam dag thugs kyi 'khor lor snang / /thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma la sogs/ /gnas dang nye gnas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi nga ros sa stengs srid pa sbyong / /'dod chags rnam dag gsung gi 'khor lor snang / /myu gu can dang sa srungs ma la sogs/ /zhing dang nye zhing rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi rol bas sa 'og srid pa sbyong / /gti mug rnam dag sku yi 'khor lor snang/ /stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can sogs/ /'dus sogs gnas la bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /yang dag las mtha' 'tsho ba rtsol dang dran/ /bde chen dga' ba mos dang gtso la phyogs/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus srung mdzad pa/ /sgo bzhi ma mor snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtson 'grus rnam dag yang dag spong ba bzhi/ /gshin rje brtan ma la sogs ma mor snang / /phyogs gnyis 'dzin pas sku mdog phyed gzugs ma①/ /rgyal ba'i yum du bstan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs brgyad kyis bstan pa'i snying por bstan/ /bdag med dkyil 'khor dur khrod brgyad du gnas/ /byang chub rkyen du shing brgyad mngon du byung / /'jig rten chos brgyad bsregs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa/rgyal po chen po in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //11—617

sgyu 'phrul sbyin pa jes bya ba/1 ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ maṇ+ḍal de ba sto tra rat+na mā ya dā na nā ma/bod skad du/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bstod pa rin po che sgyu 'phrul sbyin pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshal te/ /gus pas bstod la byin rlabs myur 'byung bdag gis brjod/ /hūṃ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing kun bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor na/ /bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor lo bde mchog ni/ /ye shes rnam par dag pa thams cad tshogs pa'i sku/ /'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa mthing nag rin chen 'od/ /zhal bzhi sngo dang dmar dang ser dang ljang ba'i dbu/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs zla phyed sna tshogs rdo rjes mdzes/ /dmar 'jigs brtson gzigs rab bgrad sdang mig glog ltar 'gyu/ /gtum rngam mche ba gcigs shing 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgogs/ /rol pa chen po'i smin mtshams 11byed6/9

———gnyer rlabs chen 'khrugs/ /ljags 'dril mchog la sa 'od 'phro hūṃ phaṭa 'brug sgra che—/ /lang tsho gzhon pa gar dgu'i nyams ldan 'gying bag can/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang dpe byad brgyad cus rgyan/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'gags pa'i phyag rnams rab tu snang / /dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu yum mchog 'dzin/ /thabs dang shes rab zhal sbyar bde chen mi rtog bzhugs/ /mtha' gnyis glang chen ko sgron mi lpags na bzar brgyangs①/ /g.yon pa'i gnyis pa kha ṭī gsum pas thod khrag bkang / /bzhi pa rdo rje zhags pa lnga pas ⑤tshangs mgo bsnams/ /g.yas pa'i gnyis pas cang te'u gsum pas mdung rtse gsum/ /bzhi pas rdo rje dgra sta lnga pa gri gug bsnams/ /rab tu brjid pa'i mgon po stag lpags sham thabs can/ /spyi gtsug 'khor lo nor bu snyan cha gdub kor dang / /mgur chu phyag rgya sku regs thal bas rab tu brgyan/ /lha yi gdugs dkar mdzes pa steng na 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /brgya phyed khrag 'dzag mi mgo'i phreng ba'i do shal can—/ /'jigs byed dus mtshan ma rungs skrag cing gcigs pa'i zhal/ /nyin mo'i dbang phyug gdan la zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba ma lus bde la sbyar/ /khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad gus pas khyed la 'dud/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang po lha chen tshogs bdag sogs/ /'gro ba'i gtso bo thams cad 'jigs dang gus mchod pa'i/ /rgyal chen he ru ka dpal khrod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ dbus phyogs rnam dag rdo rje'i zhing gi dkyil 'khor na/ /bcom ldan 'das ma mkha' 'gro tshogs kyi gtso bo ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rnam ①par dag pa'i sku/ /byi ru'i 'od 'bar rdo rje phag mo bde gshegs ④skyed pa'i yum/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug skal ldan mkha' 'gro kun gyi 11—620

—rje—/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi khro rgyal phyag rgya chen po'i sku/ /te ru ka dpal yang dag byer ba btsun mo'i rgyal/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar ser me stag 'phro—/ /khro 'dzum zhal gyi mche ba gadzigs shing rol pa mo/ /dbu skra legs grol sked sor sleb ①pa'i lha mo che/ /thod pa skam pos dbu brgyan 'gro ba'i zhe sdang 'joms/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug sdigs mdzub gdug pa 'dul/ /g.yon pa thod pa sdang ba'i khrag gis bkang ba bsnams/ /dbu yi nor bu snyan cha gdub kor mgur chu dang / /phyag gdub sku regs ④phyag rgya lnga yis rab tu brgyan/ /yi dwags phra mo me shel nor bu'i gdan steng na/ /gcer mo rig pa'i rgyal mo zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /rdo rje lha mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma/ /'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen pos 'joms/ /'jig rten gsum phyogs gzhan gyis bsngo bas mi tshugs shing / /bdud kyi 'jigs pa ma lus skem zhing pham mdzad ma/ /rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang byed las rgyal zhing —/ /dngos grub kun 'byung rje btsun ma khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shar phyogs rnam dag sangs rgyas zhing gi dkyil 'khor na/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas rigs kyi gtso mo ni/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes rnam par dag pa'i sku/ /rin chen bai ①ḍūr+ya yi 'od 'bar mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum skra grol mche bzhi gcigs/ /thod pa kha ṭī gri gug cang te'u phyag na bsnams/ /'khor lo snyan cha mgur chu phyag gdub mchod phyir thogs/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan lang tsho rol ba sgeg pa'i sku/ /gcer mo g.yon brkyang srog song zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /chos dbyings las bzhengs 'khor ba grol ba'i khro mo'i rgyal/ /ma mo nam mkha' khyab 'gro 'gro ba'i gti mug 'joms/ /sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs 11—621

sems can don la khyab par 'jug /ye shes chen mo rnal 'byor skal ldan 'char ba mo/ /bdud dang mu stegs mi mthun phyogs rnams rdul du rlog /lam log 'gro ba bde la thabs kyis sbyor mdzad cing / /dngos grub kun ster lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang phyogs rnam dag las mchog zhing gi dkyil 'khor na①/ /bcom ldan 'das ma las kyi rigs kyi gtso mo ni/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa'i sku/ /rin chen ma ra ka ta'i 'od 'bar lā ma ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ①spyan gsum skra grol mche bzhi gcigs/ /thod pa kha ṭī gri gug cang te'u phyag na bsnams/ /'khor lo snyan cha mgur ①chu phyag gdub mchod phyir thogs/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan lang tsho gzhon pa sgeg pa'i sku/ /gcer mo g.yon brkyang srog song zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /chos dbyings las bzhengs 'khor ba sgrol ba'i khro mo'i rgyal/ /ma mo nam mkha' khyab 'gro 'gro ba'i phrag dog 'joms/ /sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs sems can don la khyab par 'jug /ye shes chen po rnal 'byor skal ldan 'char ba mo/ /bdud dang mu stegs mi mthun phyogs rnams rdul du rlog /lam log 'gro ba bde la thabs kyis spyor mdzad cing / /dngos grub kun ster lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub phyogs rnam dag pad+ma zhing gi dkyil 'khor na/ /bcom ldan 'das ma pad+ma rigs kyi gtso mo ni/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa'i sku/ /rin chen pad+ma rā ga 'od 'bar dum skyes ma/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum skra grol mche bzhi gcigs/ /thod pa kha ṭī gri gug cang te'u phyag na bsnams/ /'khor lo snyan cha mgur chu phyag gdub mchod phyir thogs/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan lang tsho gzhon pa sgeg pa'i sku/ /gcer mo g.yon brkyang srog song zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /chos dbyings las bzhengs 11—622

'khor ba sgol ba'i khro mo'i rgyal/ /ma mo nam mkha' khyab 'gro 'gro ba'i 'dod chags 'joms/ /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs sems can don la khyab par 'jug /ye shes chen mo rnal 'byor skal ldan 'char ①ba mo/ /bdud dang mu stegs mi mthun phyogs rnams rdul du rlog /lam log 'gro ba bde ①la thabs kyis sbyor mdzad cing / /dngos grub kun ster lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lho phyogs rnam dag rin chen zhing gi dkyil 'khor na/ /bcom ldan 'das ma rin chen rigs kyi gtso mo ni/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rnam par dag pa'i sku/ /rin chen gtso mo gser 'od 'bar ba gzugs can ma/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum skra grol mche bzhi gcigs/ /thod pa kha ṭī gri gug cang te'u phyag na bsnams/ /'khor lo snyan cha mgur chu phyag gdub mchod phyir thogs/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan lang tsho gzhon pa sgeg pa'i sku/ /gcer mo g.yon brkyang srog song zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /chos dbyengs las bzhengs 'khor ba sgol ba'i khro mo'i rgyal/ /ma mo nam mkha' khyab 'gro 'gro ba'i nga rgyal 'joms/ /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs sems can don la khyab par 'jug /ye shes chen mo rnal 'byor skal ldan 'char ba mo/ /bdud dang mu stegs mi mthun phyogs rnams rdul du rlog /lam log 'gro ba bde la thabs kyis sbyor mdzad cing / /dngos grub kun ster lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar bdag gis rab dad pas/ /dngos grub chen po 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /dkyil 'khor lha la gus bstod pas/ /dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba'i//dge des 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin thob shog /dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bstod pa rin po che sgyu 'phrul sbyin pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa rdzogs so—/ / //11—623

—ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti tīrti dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsnur mchan/619 1mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stanakyil 'khor gyi lha la bstod pa rin po che sgyu 'phrul sbyin pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/62༷ 1 〈〈snar 〉thaza' rgyangs/ (〈〈snar 〉rab/ (sne)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabam/ je)〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 thams cad/621 1 〈〈pe 〉ga sor seb/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sgra sor seb/ na〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rags/ snye3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rab/622 1/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhi/ na 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mgu/623 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorabar/ 2)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (266)7—624

0340༄7/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bstod pa rgyun chags zhes bya ba/she ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra ḍā ka su lho tra 2daṇ+ḍa ka nā ma/ bod skad du / dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bstod pa rgyun chags zhes bya ba/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ut+pal mdog sngon char sprin phreng ba dri med nam mkha' sngon po'i mchog rlung chen me chu sa yi dkyil 'khor steng du gnas pa'i gser gyi ri bo'i steng na pad+ma rgyas pa'i gdan gnas dbang phyug mnan cing dkar mo'i nu ma gnyis po mnyam brdzis zil gyis dbang po nye dbang nyi ma zla ba la sogs lha rnams bsngags snyemadzad lha min du ma skrag par mdzad cing 'jig rten bsrung 4 mdzad dogs pa kun 'phrogs chostag lpags na bzas bkab 5mdzad ngan bsgral brtan zhing zab pa'i yi ge hūṃ dang phaṭa ⑦kyi rnam pa hā hā'i nga ro snanam mkha' kun gang sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyed kyis mtshan gtsug tor dam pa gti mug mun bcom legs par sgol ba dung chen phreng ba'i bar 9 ba'i rdo rje sgrar bcas dril bu rab 11—625

gsal rmyedam pa'i phyag rgya khyanye bar 'khyud pa gnyis med ye shes chags pa'i yan lag rang bzhin btsun mo'i grogs dang ldan pa phyag gnyis glang chen pyos pa chen po'i pags pa'i na bza' bsnams pas byel zhing rnam par 'phro ba'i dgra sta mdung rno gri gug 'bar ba'i rdo rje kha ṭī ga dang zhags pa 'phro ba tshangs pa'i mgo dang cang te'u dang ni thod pa 'phro ba'i phyag rnams kyis mdzes sha dang tshil bu chen po gsol ba bsam gtan ldan pa cod pan ldan pa ye shes ldan pa blo nor ldan pa bcu drug phyed phyed zhal dang ldan pa spyan gsum dag par mdzad pa mi mgo'i 1phreng bas brgyan pa 'jigs su rung ba drag po mi bzad 'khor ba'i dgon pa yang dag sgol ba bdud rnams 'joms pa rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal// //de yi rjes su phyogs kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhir bzhugs mkha' 'gro chen mo lā ma dum skyes gzugs can ma ni yid 'phrog byed ma rnams dang ldan zhing mtshams su kun gnas thod pas bskor cing de nas sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lor bzhugs shing sa 'og sa steng mtho ris spyod pa de nyid gsum las khros pa ④dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug 'khor lo dam pa snye'akhor lo can ni phyogs dang phyogs min dag na gnas pa'i khwa gdong la sogs lha mo brgyad kyis mngon par mchod cing rang gi lha mos mnyam par sbyar ba'i sgeg pa dang ldan bdud kyi sde rnams sngangs par mdzad pa rnam par 'phro ba sems can la ni yang dag chags can sdang la rnam sdang khro la kun khro nyon mongs rnams 'joms 'chi bdag bdud sogs khrag dron btung bas tshim pa'i thugs bde 'jig rten gsum na mdzad pa gcig bzhugs sangs rgyas mdzad brtson rdo rje lha mo'i bde ba reg pa las skyes ba sru langs pa'i tshogs kyis ⑥khyab pa'i sku can spyan gyi rdzi ma g.yo zhing mgur gyi sbubs nas sed ⑦kyi sgrar bcas bzhad cing 11—626
