yid 'ong phyag gi zhags pas mgul 'khyud nu ma gnyis rgyas mkhrang rten las byung rdul gyi thigs pa'i tshogs kyis mchod cing nyi ma bye ba'i 'od kyi snang bas phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs khyab cing /dusnyan chas brgyan pa zla ba gzhon nu phyed pa'i mche ba'i myu gu lham me dpal mdzad blo mdzad tshim pa ster zhing rgyas pa ster ba rgyal srid ster zhing dngos grub ster ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rab ster 'dren pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro la ni rtag tu 'dud// //dpe med thugs rje'i nyams kyis 'jug pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa ma lus rnam par 'phro bas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mi bzad nang song nyon mongs rba rlabs 'phro ba'i phreng ba rnam par 'joms mdzad me 'bar stong pas lhag pa'i 'od 'bar glog 'phro'i 'od gsal ye shes phung po'i 'od zer khyab par yang dag bstan cing mtha' yas dngos po'i rang bzhin dngos bral 2dngos med ngo bo yang dag las byung ngo bo khams gsum rang bzhin gzugs bzang gzugs bral ma lus gzugs bcom tshangs pa'i gnas bzhis nges par gnas pa mtshan gyis brgyan pa dpe byad rnams kyis legs par spras pa chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa sprul pa'i sku gsum po yis khyab pa'i sems can don gyi phrin las de nyid gsum pa chags la chags che ma rungs pa la zhe sdang chen po rmongs la rmongs chen 'dod la 'dod chen brtse ba stong nyid tha dad med pa sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' ni spangs shing 'jig rten gsum po skad cig gis khyab rnam par shes pa mngon du gyur pa dga' ba chen po'i tshogs kyi mchog mdzes sbyin dang tshul khrims la sogs yongs 4dag phyi nang mun pa mi bzad brgal zhing 'gro ba'i mdzad pa byed pa 'phrog byed 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa yang dag sgrol mdzad nyon mongs nyon mongs kun 'phrog gzugs dang ldan zhing gzugs kun sdud 11—627

mdzad gdug pa kun nas skrag par mdzad cing phra mo'i sku chen khyesgom po'i lus chen khyab bdag khyab pa rtag pa skad cig gnas pa brtan pa g.yo ba gsal ba dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug 'jig rten dbang phyug la ni dngos po kun kyis 'dud// //ro brgyas spras shing rmad byung 'jigs rungs du ma'i gzugs can ro bsregs me drag mi mgo rab gtum rus pa dum bu'i tshogs dang skra sogs kyis brgyan bsreg bzhin pa yi yan lag mchog gi 7 klad pa lug cing rkang mar zhag 'thor 'dam ni 'dred pa skra chad pa dang rgyu ma'i phreng ba lang long nar ba mkha' 'gro ma dang 'byung po ro langs ha ha'i nga ro mthon por sgogs shing sgrub pa po ni du ma hūṃ yig gis bsdigs rgyu zhing ce spyang phaṭa kyi rnam pa'i ku co 'don cing lag bteg gar byed keng rus phreng ba 'khrigs pa dpa' bo'i btung ba'i spro ba las byung dga' ba dang bcas glu snyan len cing gar byed g.yo zhing rol pa rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma yi dbang phyug tshogs pa bya rgod mchu yis gnon cing bcad pa'i lus kyi khrag gi rgyun 'dzag mun nag can ni ce spyang gdong las byung ba'i 'bar ba drag po me 'bar tshogs can bdud sde'i tshogs med nag po dus chen 'khrigs pa'i lha rdzas dur khrod brgyad du gar mdzad bla ma he ru ka la bdag gis ngag rnams kyis ni mngon par mchod pa'i 4bsod nams nam mkha'i khams kyi khongs khyab rab skyes 'di yis skye ba 'di rnams nyon mongs dra ba ma lus spangs nas mnyam med bsod nams phung po bsags nas rab skyes dri med ye shes tshogs ni mngon gyur rang rig yang dag gsal ba dam pa'i 'od kyis gsal byas sna tshogs du ma'i gti mug mun nag mtha' yas kun nas bsal ba'i skad cig la ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 11—628

kun gyi sku bzhin kun nas rtag tu gyur// //dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bstod pa rgyun chags zhes bya ba rtog ge pa'i tshogs kyi gtsug gi nor bu slob dpon chen po dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma ①ṇi ka 11dz+nyā na'i zhal snga nas chag lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong dpal gyi mtha' can gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'di'i gzhung tshad ni bla ma'i phyag dpe la tshig rkang pa bzhi'i re re zhing yi ge sum cu rtsa drug du gnas shing rkang pa bzhi ka bsdoms pas yi ge stong sum brgya bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi bzhugs so/ /bod kyi dpe la ni tshig rkang re re la tsheg bar nyis brgya dgu bcu rtsa lnga yod cing / bsdoms pas tsheg bar stong brgya brgyad cu yod do// //bsdur mchan/625 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bstod pa rgyun chags zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bstod pa bzhugs so// nya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sta pa/ kyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dngangs/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srung / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'phrog ༄ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bza' dka'/⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dze/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hā nga ros/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba 'bar/626 sti〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsil/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zung / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mgo bo'i/ githu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i| rjo〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srid/627 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 mtha' yas khyab cing / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dngos dang / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/④〈〈pe 〉〉rgosu/678 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉can/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mchod/629 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mā/11byed629

༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo baje mchog gi sgrub thabs rin po che gtsug gi nor bu jes bya ba/1/༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga bān shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra gya sā dha rna rat+na tsū ḍa ma ṇi nā ma/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs rin po che gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi dwags gdan la gar gyis bzhugs shing zhal bzhi bai ḍūr pad+ma rā 3gser mar gad spyan gsum byi ru bcag 'dra'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis thod khrag cang te'u bsnams pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /zhabs gnyis mnyam 'khril zhal sbyar sku la rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis dril bu rdo rje la sogs 'khyud cing tha ma gnyis kyis glang chen thal kar ko rlon mi lpags khrag gi klong 'khyil brgyangs pa bsnamasaldu/ /lhag ma g.yon pa'i phyag rnams kyis ni rim pa bzhin du mdzes pa'i 'khar gsil thod pa khrag bkang rdo rje zhags pa tshangs pa chen po'i mgo rnams pya 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba legs par bsnams/ /de bzhin g.yas rnams 'khor 11—631

lo rtsibs bcu mdung rtse gsum pa lcags kyu cang te'u bsnams pa rgyal chen ṭīhe ru ka bde mchog 'khor lo bcom ldan rlabs ①kyis 'gro kun rtag tu rgyal gyur cig /dpal ldan bla ma rje btsun dang ni der rjes bcom ldan sgyu ma dang / /chu zla sogs mtshungs rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la'ang gus pas phyag 'tshal lo①/ /bla ma chen po slob ma mkhas pa'i gus pa drin gsol gdab pa yis/ /de yi sgrub thabs myur du dga' ba rgyas byed gsal bar bshad par bya/ /de la dang po rnal 'byor pa dad pa dang thos pa la sogs pas chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu dang nam mkha' lta bur yongs su shes pa/ snying rje dang ldan pa/ sbyin pa dang byams pa la sogs pa 2goms par byas la/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyis ma gos pa/ bla ma rje btsun yang dag par mnyes par bya ba sngon du song bas/ dpal bde mchog gi ④rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin du dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa rim pa bzhin du dbang bskur zhing rjes su gnas pa ⑤dang dam tshig thob pa/ bla ma dang 'dod pa'i lha la tha mi dad par 'dzin pa'i blo can/ spyod pa dang brtul zhugs dang ldan pasarjo/ dur khrod la sogs pa yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i stan la legs par 'dug pas bdud rtsi'i ri lu la yi ge gsum bzlas pas kha dag pa la sogs pa byas nas sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir bdag dpal rdo rje he ru ka nyid du gyur par bya'o snyam rjopa'i bsam pa brtan pas/ rang gi snying gar ram̐ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi lha'i sa bon 'od zer kha dog rnam pa lnga ⑧kun nas rab tu 'phro ba bsam par bya'o/ /de'i 'od zer gyi snang bas rang gi lus kyi nang nas ba sru'i rtse mo'i bar khyab par byas pas ⑨bdag nyid 'dod pa'i lha'i ngo bor gyur par nga rgyal bya zhing / de las 'od zer gyi tshogs ba sru'i bu 11—632

ga nas 'phros pas/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo rigs drug gang 'dod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi ①'khor lo lha bcu bzhi pa'i bdag nyid spro ba dang bsdu ba'i sku/rin po che sna tshogs pa las grub pa'i khang pa brtsegs ①ma dang bcas pa dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba/ shar phyogs kyi dur khrod dbang po'i mdun na bla ma seng ke'i khri rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa'i steng na gser gyi pad+ma kha bye ba la rdo rje sems dpa' ltar 'gying bag tu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas bzhugs pa snang bar gyur pa gsal bar bltas la/ de nas rang gi lus du ma sna tshogs par sprul la / bdag bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub pethob par bya ba'i phyir lus 'di dag dbul bar bkyi'o zhes bya'o/ /de nas de dag la rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i pi wang ma la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug dang / ma tang gi rjol sogs pa bzhi'i tshogs kyis phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod par bya ste/ pi wang gling bu rdza rnga rnga chen ma/ /sngon mo ser mo dmar mo ljang ku (dernams/ /dang bo'i phyag gnyis rang rtags phyag mtshan can/ /de dag mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /bzhad ma sgeg mo glu ma gar ma rnams/ /dmar skya sngon mo ser mo ljang gu ste/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis rang rang rtags mtshan ldan/ /g.yon mtha' thod pa kha ṭī cang te'u g.yas/ /me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri chab ma—/ /dkar mo mthing dmar dmar ser dkar mo rnams/ /g.yon gnyis thod pa kha ṭī g.yas dang po/ /rang ming rjes mthun gnyis pa cang te'u 'dzin/ /11—633

gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos ma rnams/ /dkar mo dmar mo ljang gu dmar mo ste//g.yon g.yas mtha' 'di rnams ni gong dang mtshungs/ /g.yas kyi dang po rang ming mthun rtags can/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma la sgeg /lang tsho gzhon pa rol cing 'gying bag can/ /rin chen rgyan ldan dar kyis rab tu mdzes//dpag med rang sngags brjod cing mgon sogs rje/ /oṃt+pabadz+ra bī ṇi hūṃ/ oṃ snyabadz+ra baṃ se hūṃ/ oṃ.oṃbadz+ra mu ra dze hūṃ/ oṃtshibadz+ra mu kun de hūṃ/ oṃt+pabadz+ra hā phye hūṃ/ oṃ.āḥbadz+ra lā sre hūṃ/ oṃ.āḥbadz+ra gī bye ①hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra nir zute hūṃ/oṃ tshibadz+ra pu྾ hūṃ/ oṃt+pabadz+ra dhū ①pe hūṃ/ oṃ t+pabadz+ra dī pe hūṃ/ oṃ ubadz+ra gadhe hūṃ/bu oṃt+pabadz+ra k+ṣiṃdasgo hūṃ/ oṃt+pabadz+ra rā sre hūṃ/ oṃ t+pabadz+ra spak+ṣe hūṃ/wīlhabadz+ra dharme hūṃ zhes bya'o/ /ma tang ḍom bī ⑤ra dza puk+ka si/ /'og nas 'chad bzhin rang rang zhal sogs ldan/ /rus pa'i rgyan can thod pa bdud rtsis bkang //brjod pa med par 'dren pa 'khor bcas mchod/ /rje btsun nyid phyag rgya dang snyoms par zhugs pas mchog tu dga' ba dam pa'i bde ba chen pos dgyes pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa yang bya'o/ /de nas de dag gi duspyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa 'di ltar bya ste/ bdag gis dusdig pa thams cad bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slan chad kyang sdom par bgyid lags so/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phags pa so so'i skye bo'i dge ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /bdag gis ④dge ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /bdag byang chub kyi bar du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsngus pa'i ngo bo dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /des 11—634

bstan pa'i gsang sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa'i ngo bo chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad bsal ba'i phyir/nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /rgyal ba mya ngan las bda' ①bar bzhed pa rnams 'gro ba kun la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so/ /sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba dang mchog tu mthar phyin pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la dgod pa'i slad du bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi bar du rdo rje'i theg pa la brten par bgyi'o zhes bya ba ste/ de rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya badz+ra satwa te no pa tiṣ+ṭha dri rto me bha ba/ su tostso me ②bha ba/ su postso me bha ba/ a nu raka to me bha ba/ sarba sidhim+bi pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa mre tsi: shri yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ bha ga bān ①sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca badzī ④bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa mdzazhes brjod do/ /mi snang bar gyur pa dang —/ mchod pa bubya ba dang / mchod pa byed pa dang / mchod pa po dbyer med par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas sems can thams cad lha'i bde ba la nye bar sbyar ba'i rnam pa ⑦byams pa dang / snyug bsngal dang srug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya ba'i rnam pa snying rje dang / lha'i bde ba dang 'khor ba ji srid bar mi 'bral bar bya ba'i rnam pa 6)dga' ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon khrongs pa'i gnyen po lam la nye bar sbyar bar bya ba'i rnam pa btang stoms bsgom 11—635

par bya'o/ /de nas chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun du rtog pa tsam sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes nges par byas la/ oṃswa bhā ba shudheḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyophohaṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /sa bon gyis ①ni brtan g.yo sbyangs/ /thig le sngags kyis ①dmigs pa med/ /oṃshān+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ/chos thams cad ni rab tu gnas pa med pa rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ston ka'i nyi ma gung gi nam mkha'i dri ma med pa lta bu snang ba med pa'o/ /de nas stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin las der yi ge e yongs su gyur pa la ①chos 'byung gi gzugs ston ka'i ri bong can ltar dkar ba/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bo/ sna tshogs pa'i ngo mtshar che pa'i ④'od zer gyi tshogs mngon par 'byung ba/ lgego phra ⑤ba steng yangs pa zur gsum pa ༷/ nang stong pa/ de'i dbus su yi ge hūṃ gi bdag nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i he ru ka'i gzugs su mngon par sprul la/ shar phyogs lugs dang mi mthun dang / /lugs mthun g.yon mdzub se gol gtogs/ /o sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ ⑦hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃkṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa hūṃ (kyehūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grerje ⑨pa ya kṛd+dhā ⑫pa ya hūṃ ⑪hūṃ phaṭa/ skaphywan ya ho bha ga bān badz+ra hūṃ ⑫hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes sngags rkang pa re re brjod pa'i tshe/ sngags de dang de kha dog dmar po 'bar ba yig 'bru che ba phyogs ⑫de dang der kha nas 'phros pas/ sngags de dang de las 'phros pa'i lha mo khwa gdong ma la sogs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ kha dog dmar mo cher 'bar g.yas brkyang gom ⑫pas nyi ma'i gdan/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan gtum pa rab tu che zhing gzugs rags pa/ /phyag g.yon ste ba man chad zur gsum stod ni rang 'dra thogs/ /g.yas pa tho ba can rnams rang rang phyogs su spro bar bya/ /de dag gis ni bgegs rnams shin tu thag ring bskrad par bsam/ /de nas sngags de 11—636

dag las grub pa'i rdo rje ra ba gru bzhi pa rab tu 'bar ba/ rgyar sgrub pa po ①ji tsam mngon par 'dod pa bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra pā ②kā ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje ra ba las/ 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /'phros pas dbus su yi ge hūṃ/ /las grub sna tshogs rdo rje bsam/ /de las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi ①sar byas la/ oṃ me di ni badzi bha ba badz+ra brnya hūṃ/ zhes byen kyis brlab po/ /de bzhin du sa dang ra ba las 'od 'phros par gyur to/ /gur las bla re'o/ /bla re las mda'i dra ba phyi rol du steng dang logs kun du ④khyab par bsam zhing de dang de dag tu oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bidā na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la ṭ+wā saṃ ṭ+wā/ zhes bya bas byen gyis brlab bo/ /khwa gdong ma la sogs pa brgyad ni phyi rol du/ kha bltas 'khod pa rnams kyi mdun du hūṃ/ /nag po brgyad bltas de dag yongs gyur las/ /dang 5po kha khyer phan tshun phrad brgyad bsam/ /de nas khwa gdong la sogs pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i tshogs ⑥kyis bgegs rnams dong du chud 0cing / dong (81gi pha rol nas kyang bgegs bros pa rnams 'od zer 'bar ba lcags kyu'i rnam pas drangs shing dong du bcug pa dang / khwa gdong ma la sogs pa dong gi drung na 'khod pa rnams la bdag nyid khro bo'i lta ba dang bcas pas/ oṃ ghaḥghaḥghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṭ+wān hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya badz+ra dha ra k+ṣiṃdz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigha nā na 1ka ya wāka dzisgo badz+ra shī la ya hūṃ phaṭa—/ zhes bya ba brjod de phur pa tshugs shig par bka' bsgo bas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur pa bcugs pa dang / oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra tī la ya ltako ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas ⑩de dag gi rdo rje tho bas phur pa brdungs te/11—637

bgegs rnams la phur pa btab pas bgegs rnams kyis bde ba thob par byas nas—/ khā gdong ma la sogs pa 'od zer 'bar ba'i tshogs su gyur te mda'i dra ba la thim ma thag tu chu la chu brdabs pa'i tshul du slar phyir 'phros pa las/ rdo rje'i ra ba zlum por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra pā kā ra hūṃ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlab bo'-i)/ /de bzhin du de las 'od 'phros pas pad+ma'i ra ba/ de las 'khor lo'i ra ba/ de nas rdo rje me 'bar ba steng dang logs kun du khyab pa g.yon skor skedu 'khyil zhing 'bar bar bsams te/ de bzhin du oṃpad+ma pra ①ka ra hūṃ—/ skatsakra s+thā kā ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na 'u hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes so so'i sngags kyis byen gyis brlabs ④la bdag nyid skad cig gis mi snang bar gyur par bsam mo—/ /de ltar tshangs pa stong gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i gnas der rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgyu ma lta bur bsam par bya ste/ yi ge yi las yang dag byung / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhur snang ngo / /'od zer sngon po 'khrug cing 'khrug /ba dan gyis mtshan bsam par bya/ /de steng re yig las byung ba/ /me yi dkyil 'khor kha dog dmar/ /gru gsum 'bar phreng gis mtshan pa/ /'od zer dmar po 'khrug cing 'khrug /de steng baṃ yig las byung ba/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor zlum zhing dkar/ /bum pas mtshan pa 'od zer gyi/ /phreng ba dkar pos 'khrug cing 'khrug /de steng lo yig las byung ba/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor ser po ste/ /gru bzhi rdo rje yis ⑤mtshan pa/ /'od zer ser po 'khrug cing 'khrug /de steng sum̐ yig las byung ba/ /lhun po rin chen bzhi rang bzhin/ /gra rngo kyebazhi rtse mo brgyad kyis mdzes/ /gzi brjid bzang po mchog gi mchog /de steng baṃ las pad chen po/ /sna tshogs 'dab brgyad 'od zer 'bar/ /de steng hūṃ yig ()las sna 11—638

tshogs/ /rdo rje shar lho nub byang dbus/ /dkar ser dmar ljang mthing rtse gsum/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar zhing 'bar/ /de'i stegs bur yi ge rja 3sna dkar po las byung ba'i khang pa brtsegs ④ma sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa thams cad bsdus pa'i ngo bo thar pa chen po'i pho brang rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin/ rin po che sna tshogs pa las grub pa/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /rtsig pa lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /stegs bu bzhis bskor brgyad gnyis kyis/ /mchod pa'i lha mo mchod 'byel 'gying / /do shal do phyed dar me tog /nyi zla me long rnga yab dang / /rdo rje srad bu bla res mdzes/ /'od las ①sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'phro /ba dan rtse mo g.yo bkra ba'i/ /dril bu phyogs kyi sgo nas 'khrol/ /dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor/ /rdo rje ra ba 'od chen 'bar/ /de'i dbus su sna tshogs pa'i 'dab ma can gyi pad+ma rab tu rgyas pa ste/ de'i lte ba la 'jigs byed chen mo dang dus mtshan mo brtsegs pa'i snyeng gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma rnams la 2ro'i snying gar zla ba'i gdan dang ldan pa/ mtshams bzhir zla la bum steng du/ /bdud rtsis bkang ba'i thod pa bzhi/ /phyogs bral dang sgo rnams su yang / /ro yi snying gar zla ba'i gdan/ /de nas dus mtshan mo'i snying kha'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la a la sogs pa'i dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu drug nyis 'gyur las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long ⑤lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ de'i steng du ka la sogs pa'i gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi ḍa zwa da dha ya la bsnan pa bzhi bcu nyis 'gyur yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ der yi ge hūṃ dngul chu lta bu yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po rab tu 'bar 11—639

ba lte bar yi ge hūṃ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas pa rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi rnam par snang ba 'phros pas 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don byas nas/ de dag bsdu ba'i sbyor bas sa bon la bcug pas de dag ①thams cad gcig tu 'gyur ba ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /de nas de las bdag nyid gtso bo (snyerang gi rig ma dang bcas shing dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas par grub pa ni chos kyi dbyengs shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ sngo zhing drag shul rnam 'gyur drag /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par mdzad/ /mche ba dag kyang gatshigs pa po①/ /gtsug na zla ba byed pa la/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ral pas brgyan/ /jod pa'i phreng bas rnam par bklubs④/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs sgogs shing / /sdang ba thams cad 'dul mdzad pa/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gdan la ni/ /phyed krung byas pas shin tu gnas/ /sred dang rmongs dang phrag dog gyur/ /kā la rā tri 'og tu mnan/ /spyan gsum zhal bzhi mgrin pa bzhi/ /mkha' ltar sngo dang ser dang dmar/ /steng gi zhal ni ljang gu ste/ /phag mo dang ni gnyis med dga'/ /dril bu rdo rje snyoms 'jug cing / /'khar gsil snod zhags mgo bo dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo mdung rtse gsum/ /rdo rje lcags kyu rnge'u chung ste/ /khrag gi rba klong 'khyil pa yi/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /phyag gnyis na ni chos gos so—/ /mi lpags snam bu gnyis kyis 'phyar/ /lang tsho gzhon pa 'gying bag can/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang zhing / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan/ /gar dgu yi ni nyams dang ldan/ /stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs/ /phyag rgya drug gis rab tu brgyan/ /mgo phreng do shal chen po can/ /steng na gdugs 11—640

——dkar legs par 'dzin/ /phag mo mdog dmar gcer bu la/ /spyan gsum skra ni grol ba'o/ /sgeg cing nu ma 'bur la mkhrang ①/ /rgyan rnams thams cad rab 'bar ba/ /g.yon pa ro yi lhung bzed de/ /g.yas pa rnge'u chung chos dbyangs sgogs/ /byin pa gnyis ni mnyam 'khyud cing / /snying rjes dga' ba'i bde ba che—/ /thugs kar shes rab rab gyur nyid/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi rdor hūṃ/ /de'i rjes la mgo bo dang mgrin pa dang snying gar zla ba dang nyi ma'i steng du/ oṃ āXhūṃ dkar po dang dmar po dang sngon po'i 'od 'phro ba bsams la/ de nas lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i nang du brgyad/ phyi rol du la'adab ma lnga bcu rtsa drug pa kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lte ba la yi ge e kha dog sna tshogs pa mgo gyen du bstan pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa kha dog sngon po lte ba la yi ge hūṃ kha dog sngon po mgo bo (be+ethur du bstan pa/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma dbus na bzhi phyi rol na bcu gnyis pa kha dog dmar po lte ba'i yi ge oṃ dmar po mgo gyen du bstan pa/ spyi bor bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa kha dog sngon po ste ba la yi ge haṃ kha dog dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ 'khor lo de dag thams cad kyang yi ge dang bcas shing 'od shin tu gsal ba bsgom mo/ /shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma la/ /ma tang gi dang ḍom+bi ni/ /rā dza ki dang puk+ka sī/ /ser dang sngo dang dmar dud kha/ /'khar gsil dang ni lhung bzed dang —/ /che'u chung dang ni gri gug 'dzin/ /ba dha ki ④sa ha tsa ri rjo / /bhu bye tsa ri sha ba ri( 7/ /skya bo dang ni dmar ba dang / /ljang gu dang ni dkar mo 3ste/ /thod pa dang ni 'khar gsel dang / /gri gug dang ni rnge'u chung 'dzin/ /lugs su 'byung dang lugs las bzlog /bzhad dang zhi dang snying rje dang / /sgeg 11byed641

dang rngam dang mi sdug pa/ /drag shul khro bo'i ①nyams dang ldan/ /sgo bzhir khro mo ④dgod bya ba/ /he ru ka yi 'od ma dang / /rdo rje gtum mo dang rdo rje/ /srin mo rdo rje 'jigs byed ma/ /drag cing gdul dka' kun gsol ma/ /thal kar mdog dang ljang gu dang / /dmar dang sngo ba drag shul 'jigs/ /lang tsho gzhon pa nu ma rgyas/ /lhung bzed kha ṭī 'khar gsel g.yon/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnge chung g.yas/ /phrag pa'i steng na chos gos te/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi maske/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs④/ /ro steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la—/ /bya krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /skra grol gcer bu rgyan lnga 'chang / /bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /thabs dang shes rab ngo bo nyid/ /snying rje chen po stong pa nyid/ /tha mi dad pa'i bdag nyid do/ /bsod snyoms pa dang chos gos gsum/ /phyis mi len dang tsog pu pa/ /stan gcig pa dang bla gab med—/ /shing drung pa dang bas mthar sdeganas/ /dur khrod pa dang phyag dar khrod//phying ba pa dang gzhi ji bzhin/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis te/ /de rnams rnal 'byor ma rnams dag /mdo yi sde dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad/ /lung du bstan dang tshigs su bcad/ /ched du brjod dang gleng gzhi dang / /rtog pa brjod dngade ltar byung ⑤/ /skyes pa rabs dang shin tu rgyas/ /rmad du byung dang gtan la phab/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyang/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ngo bo nyid—/ /de nas hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' dang / dbang bskur ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang / phyi dang gsang ba'i mchod pa byed pa'i lha mo rnams spyan drangs te/ de dag dang lhan cig tu 'ongs pa'i bgegs zhal rnams kyis hūṃ zhes brjod pas bskrad nas/ snying ga'i 11—642

sa bon gyi 'od zer las byung ba'i mchod yon/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes bya bas phul la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya bas ①dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang mnyes par byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i khu bas gang ba bsnams①/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nyi ṣe ka sa ma ya shi ye hūṃ zhes gsung zhing dbang bsgur ba dang chu'i lhag ma las dbu la rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab par bya ste/ de la (kyebacom ldan 'das kyi dbu la rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mi bskyod pa'o/ /ma tang gi la sogs pa bzhi la rim ④bzhin du/ /rtag pa don grub 'od dpag med dang rin chen 'byung / /ba dha tī la sogs pa la ni rtag pa dang / /rin chen dbang dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub/ /he ru ka bha la sogs pa la yang ma tang gi la sogs pa la rtag pa la sogs pa bzhin ⑤no/ /de nas pi wang ma la sogs pa dang / dum tang gi la sogs pa shin tu mdzes shing yid 'phrog pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod par bya'o/ /de nas lha mo de dag gis legs par bstod pa byas nas—/ lha mo de rnams rang rang gi gnas su yud kyis gshegs par bsam mo /de'i rjes la yi ge hūṃ las gsang ba'i rdo rje dkar po byā las nor bu dmar po byu ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ yi ge ā las phyag rgya'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa bye 7las ze'u 'bru dkar po bye 8ser pos bu ga bkag par bsams la/ lte ba la sogs pa la snying po la sogs pa yang bkod nas/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru kai oṃhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes bya bas dga' ba tsam zhig lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba dam pa'i bde bas bdag dang dkyil 'khor par bcas pa rjes su mnyes par bya'o//11byed643

phyi rol shin tu dga' ba'i bya ba la'ang / /pad+ma rdo rje byin rlabs 'di dag bya/ /mdun du yi ge yo las rlung dkyil 'khor/ /gzhur snang sngon po mtha' gnyis ba dan ldan/ /de steng yi ge re las me'i dkyil 'khor/ /zur gsum nyid la dmar po 'bar bas mtshan/ /de steng a las pad+ma'i snod/ /dum bu gcig pa nang dmar po/ /de'i nang du shar nas brtsams te dbus kyi bar du oṃ khaṃ dze+ehūṃ hūṃ/dkar po dang ljang gu dang dmar po dang ser po dang mthing ga rnams las byung ba'i gsang ba'i ①sman dang sha chen po dang / byang chub kyi sems dang rang byung gi me tog dang / rdo rje'i chu rnams la be+er yi ge de dag nyid kyis mtshan pa dang /me dang bden bral rlung dang dbang ldan gyi khruphyogs su dze+e rmā r+pā tsā/ /dkar dang sngo dang dmar dang ljang / /ba lang khyi dang glang po che dang rta'i sgon ma dang / sa bon de dag nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de nas rlung gis me sbar bas/ /de dag thams cad zhu ①bar gyur pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar dmar por 'bar ba snang ba/ de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las kha ṭī ga dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin der lhung bas/ bdud rtsi de shin tu mdog dkar po bsil ba'i rnam par gyur par blta'o/ /de nas uli dang kā li thog mar oṃdang mtha' mar hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dang bcas pa brjod pas/ yi ge de dag nyid kha dog sna tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i steng du gnas par bltas la/ slar yang yi ge de dag nyid wī.oṃhūṃ zhes khya ba'i dhiyi ge gsum dkar po dang dmar po dang mthing ga'i kha dog can gong nas gong du gnas par gyur par bltas te/ de dag las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi cha 11—644

las—/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste yi ge gsum la bsdus pa dang / yi ge gsum yang rim pa bzhin du bdud rtsir lhung bas/ de dag ro gcig tu gyur pa'i bdud rtsi'i mchog tu bltas nas/ yi ge gsum gyis lan gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ bcom ldan 'das dang rnal 'byor ma/ /rnams kyi lce la yi ge hūṃ/ /las byung rdo rje rtse gsum pa/ /dkar po nas 'bru tsam bkod de/ /de yi 'od kyi bu ①gus drangs/ /bdud rtsi gsol bas mchog tshim blta/ /rig sngags bzlas brjod byas ④pas 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa'i phyir bzlas brjod bya ste/de ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / bzlas brjod bya ba'i gsang sngags kyi yi ge gang dag yin pa rnams rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'og nas byung ba rang gi rdo rje'i rtse mo nas phyag rgya'i bha gar bton nas/ yang lha mo'i zhal nas rang gi zhal du zhugs pa rang gi sa bon la zhugs par blta zhing / zhal thams cad dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis kyang sngags zlos par bsgom par bya ste/ khro bo'i bzlas pa yang bya'o/ /rim pa 'dis bzlas brjod kyi nyes pa dang bral bar sems mnyam par gzhag ①pas ji srid skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar du bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de la bzlas brjod kyi sngags ni 'di dag yin te/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he te ru ru rka hūṃ bahūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki ni spyodzā la saṃ ba ra swā hā/ oṃ trīmi ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lha'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra baṇ+ḍi nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dze+e ro tsa be+e ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lha mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ mā tai gī 7hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ḍom+bi nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rā dza tī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ puk+ka sbo hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ ba dha ki ④hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha tsa ri 6hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bu bye tsa ri ⑨hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃsha ba rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lo te ru ka bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭalhospe/ skabadz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī 11—645

hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃbadz+ra rak+ṣa ①sī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃbadz+ra ste ra bi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dpa' bo'i sngags so/ /wīn mo bha ga wa te mgri re shā ①ya/ ma hā kasnyildi saṃ ni bhā ya/dza ṭa ① ma ku ṭoṅka ṭā ya/ rdaṭī duka rā lo gra dhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ sa ha sra bhu ⑤dza bhā su rā ya/ pa ra shu pā sho r+ya ta shu la kha ṭī ga dh+wa ri nirjo/ byuwā dzi nāsbra ④ra dha rā ya—/ ma hā byus+thārnya ka ra wa pu ṣā ya/ ka ra ka ra ku ru ku ru/ brnya brnya/ tā 8 sa ya tā stis ya/ k+ko bha ya khyo bha ya/ — —⑩/ hraḥhraḥphe dze/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sa ru dhi rān tra mā lā ba lo ⑪ṣ+pe/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa sap+ta pā tā la ga ta byu dze+e ga sabaṃ ba ⑫tardza ya tardza ya/ phywakasbyo k+ṣiṃkasbyo hri tri/dzhai dzhai/ smre hūṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ tī ṭī/ hūṃ hūṃ/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li—/ dhi li bye li/ hūṃ spyohūṃ phaṭa/ phreng ba'i sngags so/ /oṃshrī tsit+ta ḍā ka j-ika a khaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra swā hā/ oṃshrī bāka ḍā ka phywaro lika ḍā ki ni ④dzā la saṃ ba ra ⑫hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa⑩/ oṃ ṭīkā ya ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra ⑩ru lu spyo hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lo shrī rat+na ḍā ka ya ⑫wī.ābyuhūṃ ḍā ki ni ⑪dzā la saṃ ba ra ⑥hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā—/ oṃ ṭīkarma ḍā ka a khaṃ hūṃ ḍā ki ni ⑥dzā la saṃ ba ra 3hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gtso bo lnga'i sngags so/ /gang tshe bzlas pas skyo bar gyur pa na/ /sa bon 'od kyis shes rab bdag po dang / /'khor lo pa dang khang pa brtsegs ma rnams/ /snang bar byas te 'od gyur rim bzhin bsdu/ /hūṃ de yongs su gyur las bdag nyid ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas brkyang gom pas gnas/ /lang tsho gzhon pa 'gying bag mtshan dang ldan/ /phyag rgya drug ldan dril bu rdo rje 'chang / /de nas yongs su bsngo ba dang smon lam gdab pa dang / yi ge brgya pa brjod pa yang byas pa ༄ — lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /gung dang phyi dro'i thun mtshams su/ /bsam 11—646

gtan khang par stan bder 'dug /bdag nyid 'od zer du gyur pa/ /hūṃ du byas te yongs gyur las/ /bcom ldan 'khor lo bde mchog gi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo lha bcu bzhi/ /khang brtsegs rin chen tshogs las grub/ /dur khrod brgyad bskor gsal dmigs nas/ /dbang bskur ba la sogs pa cho ga thams cad bya'o/ /thun tha ma la ni sngar bstan pa'i cho ga thams cad spyad la/ bzlas brjod kyi rjes la hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis thams cad 'od du gyur pa bdag la bsdus la/bdag dang phag mo yang 'od du gyur pa sdesnying ga'i shes rab yab yum la/ de yang snying ga'i nyi ma dang bcas pa'i hūṃ la bsdu zhing / nyi ma dang spru 2dang ha dang zla tshes dang / thig le dang nā da'i bar du bsdus la nā da yang dmigs pa med par byas la nyal lo/ /nangs thupar gyi dus su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i glus bskul bas sad par mos par byas la/ cho ga thams cad nyi ma snga ma bzhin du bya'o/ /hūṃ sngon rdo rje las byung ba/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog ni/ /dbang bskur bdag po mi bskyod rgya/ /gzhan ma rnams ni sngar bzhin du/ /oṃ dmar pad+ma las byung ba/ /gsung gi 'khor lo bde mchog ni/ /dmar po g.yon sngo pad+ma bsnams//dbang bdag 'od rgya gzhan sngar bzhin/ / oṃ dkar 'khor lo las byung ba/ /sku yi 'khor lo bde mchog ni/ /dkar po g.yas sngo 'khor lo bsnams/ /dbang bdag rtags rgya gzhan sngar bzhin/ /hūṃ ser rin chen las byung ba/ /yon tan 'khor lo bde mchog ni/ /ser po g.yas sngo rin chen bsnams/ /dbang bdag rin rgya gzhan sngar bzhin/ /4khaṃ ljang sna tshogs shor byung ba'i ye/ /phrin las 'khor lo bde mchog ni/ /ljang gu steng sngo sna tshogs bsnams/ /dbang bdag don rgya 6)gzhan sngar bzhin/ /de ltar gus pa dang bcas pas rgyun mi 'chad par 11—647

bsgoms pas sems brtan par gyur pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po ngal so ba①/ /k+ṣiṃli kā li mdun bsams nas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las rdzogs pa/ /lte ba'i dbus su gnas par ①bsgom/ /de yi dbus su gnas pa yi/ /yi ge dam pa'i gnas bsgom bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /lha yi gzugs su bsgom par bya/ /de ni gzugs las 'das gyur pa/ /sems nyid du yang bsgom mi bya/ /bsam bya min par bsam de yang/ /sems nyid du ni mtshon pa min/ /de yang bsam bya min bsam bya/ /de las gzugs ni thob par 'gyur/ /dang po ri dwags sred bzhin snang ba ste/ /mtshan ma gnyis pa dud ka'i rnam pa can/ /gsum pa srin bu me khyer dang 'dra ba/ /bzhi pa sgon me 'bar ba lta bur ①gsal/ /mtshan ma lnga pa rnam par ma brtags par/ /sprin bral nam mkha' lta bur snang ba yin/ /de lta bu yi mtshan ma thob nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po thob par gyur pa yin/ /ṭīni gnyis med ye shes tedu/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni rtog pa dang bral ba—/ /ka ni gang na'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /sems ni ngal so mernal 'byor pa/ /mya ngan 'das pa bstan pa bumin/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho tshe dpal/ /khrag 'thung dpal sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /me tog sna tshogs lag na thogs/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang / /rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / /glu yi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mkha' spyod gnas su khrid par byed/ /'chi ba zhes 'di rnam rtog yin/ /de ltar rje btsun te ru ka'i/ /sgrub thabs gsal bar byas pa las/ /dge ba thob pa gang yin des/ /'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs/ rin po che gtsug gi nor bu 11—648

〉〉brgya/64/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bso/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bu/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/11byed650
‘sri〈〈snar 〉rabaso/ khye)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stab/649 nyu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga /bsdur 'azas re'u migabyud/ (268)11 —651

༄ / /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga rin po che rab tu gsal ba'i sgon ma zhes bya ba/①༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍa lo pa ka rat+na pra ②dī po bye ta nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin po che rab tu gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdang dang bdud rnams tshar gcad du chags can rjes gzung phyir/ /ma rungs 'jigs pa'i sku dang phyag rgya la 'khyud pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i rol pas gzhan gyi don 'jug pa/ /bcom ldan 'khor lo bde mchog khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga ni/ /gsungs shing mkhas pa'i mdzad pa yod mod kyi/ /slob ma gus pas mang du gsol btab pas—/ /tshul bzhin de nyid gsal bar bshad par bya/ /slob dpon bstan bcos kun shes shing / /tshul khrims ldan zhing snying rje'i bdag /drang zhing bzod la gtsang sbra can/ /dad dang dran ldan snying stobs can/ /smra mkhas mi 11—652

'jigs sran thub pa/ /sgyu rtsal dag la mkhas shing gsal/ /mjos dang ldan pa de bzhin du/ /gus ldan dul la khong bzo ba/ /rtag tu dam pa'i chos la dga'//theg pa che la mos pa can/ /gsang sngags spyod pa la bslabs shing / /dkyil 'khor dag gi bye brag shes/ /slob ma dag gi tshul shes shing / /de bzhin sngags dang rgyud kyang 'dzin/ /rjes su gnang zhing dbang bskur la/ /chog shes bzlas brjod lhur len pa/ /slob dpon rig la bsnyen bkur byas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad khong du chud/ /gsang sngags kun dang bla ma dang / /de bzhin glo bur mgron mchod byed/ /phyag rgya la sogs bcing ba dang / /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las rnams dang / /gsang sngags mchod pa'i spyod pa la/ /slob dpon gyis ni mkhas par bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa ①ji skad gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ bdag nyid dngos grub kyi phyed du'am/ 'jam zhing snyan par sngab dang / /snying rje la sogs phan sems ldan/ /thos dang klog la sogs la brtson/ /gsang ba'i chos la lhag par dang / /rtag par rgyun tu bla ma gus—/ /slob mas me tog yongs su gzung ②/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gzhan gyis lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs pa de rjes su gzung ① ba'i phyir yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas gang yang rung bar dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas / 'khor lo'i bdag po'i 'bum bzlas shing —/ /dkyil 'khor pa yi de bzhin khri/ /zhes ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du bzlas brjod byas pas/ lha'i mtshan ma thob pa 'am/ rang gi sems dag cing brtan par gyur par bya ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas bsgrub ⑤par bya ste/de yang sa'i phyogs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /sa gzhi ci 'dra bzang ba dang / /mi 11—653

bzang ba dag bsgrags pa ni/ /rab tu brtags te spang dang blang / /mtho dman can dang tsher ma can/ /gyo mo'i dum bu can dag dang / /ngam grog rus pa sdong dum khung / /grog mkhar thal ba tsha ①sgo can/ /gseg ma rdo dang rdul dang skra/ /srin bu grog spur la sogs mang / /de lta bu yi sa gzhi ni/ /mkhas pas las rnams kun la spang / /mtho dma' snyoms shing gtsang la snum/ /zug rngu'i nyes pa rnam par spangs/ /shar dang byang du gzhol ba yi/ /sa gzhi las rnams kun la shis—/ /dkyil 'khor sa ni gang dag gi④/ /nye 'khor dag tu chu mod pa/ /des ni shis shing dngos grub thob/ /chu dkon pa ①ni mkhas pas smad/ /ljon shing bzang pos brgyan pa dang / /bdag gi mig yid mgu dub dang / /'tshe med zug rngu spangs pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor gnas su shes pa ste/ /mi yis dngos grub kun 'thob byed/ /de bas sgrub po der gnas bya/ /bcom ldan 'khor lo bde mchog la—/ /mchod par dhisna tshogs rin chen 'dzin/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /phyis 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dang po pus nub tsam brkos nas/ /sa de nyid kyis dgang bar bya/ /gal te lhag par gyur pa ni/ /dngos grub dag ni yod par bshad/ /de las bzlog par gyur na ni/ /sgrub pa po yis las mi brtsam/ /brtsams na sdug bsngal myong 'gyur zhing / /legs pa dag kyang mi 'thob bo/ /zug rngu'i nyes pa thams cad ni/ /gal te dbyung bar mi nus na/ /der ni gsang sngags kho na yis/ /sbyang byab legs par byas par 'gyur/ /drang srong gnas dang ba lang lhas/ /phug ⑦dang ri yi rtse mo dang / /sa gzhi gang na 'thas pa dang / /thog steng dang ni rdo leb dang / /mchod rten drung dang 'bab chu'i gling / /mtsho rnams kyi ni 'gram dag tu/ /sa gzhi sbyang zhing brtag ⑧pa 11—654

dag /nan tan du ni bya mi dgos/ /'thas par bcag ①kyang der mi dgos//mtho dma' la sogs don rnams kyang / /der ni dogs pa skye mi dgos/ /rang bzhin yon tan ldan pa'i phyir/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i sa gzhi la/ /byi dor legs par byas nas su/ /lag pas reg cing gsang sngags bzlas/ /de yi sbyang ba de yin no/ /snang bar gyur pa'i las rnams dang / /gdon rnams tshar gcod la sogs dang / /drag shul spyod pa dag la yang ①/ /sa ni brtag par bya mi dgos/ /stegs bu ni khru gang nas bcu drug gi bar du ste/ shar dang byang du gzhol ba ni/ /sngags pa rnams kyis ①dngos grub 'grub/ /dbus su mtho ba rgyal srid dam/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas budag thob/ /byang mtho 'chi 'am nor 'joms 'gyur/ /shar mtho myur du rigs rnams 'dzad/ /dbus dma' sgrub po 'jig par byed/ /de bas dam tshig rab ldan bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa yid dang mthun cing nyams dga' ba'i gnas su ⑤dkyil 'khor gyis legs par 'dus byas pa dhimachod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs pa dang grogs dang bcas par bdag nyid khrus byas shing dri zhim pos byugs pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pas gtor ma byen nas/ 'dod pa'i ⑦lha'i rnal 'byor gyis oṃbhu khaṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du byas la/ hūṃ lo hūṃ zhes bya bas rdo rje'i bdag nyid kyi nor 'dzin byen gyis brlab ⑧par bya'o/ /de nas dri zhim pos byugs pa ⑨me tog byed par bkram pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'dug ste/ rgyal ba rnams la gsol ba gdab ⑩pa/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /mgon po ⑪bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang chen che ge mo/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor 'dri bar byed/ /bdag gis ⑫bsgrub bya grub bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor byen gyis 11—655

brlab du gsol/ /zhes brjod do/ /bdag nyid ngo bo nyid dag pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi gzugs rdo rje dang dril bus lag pa byel cing 'gying ba la/ rnal 'byor ma lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i na tshod bzhi phyogs kyi lha mo bzhir nga rgyal byas la/rnal 'byor gyi bya ba gcig ②la goms pa'i lha mo de rnams kyis tshigs su bcad pa ( re res gsol ba btab ④par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol/ /mtshan nyid dam pa yongs su rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad lang dag duspangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong dhimadzad/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog / dkyil 'khor ( 7dam pa bstan du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun tu bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol/ /de rnams kyis gsol ba 'debs par rig nas/ /de nas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sor mo sa la bsdun pas/ sa'i lha mo mdog ser ba rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lus kyi phyed phyung ba/ g.yas pa dam 'cha' ba khas len pa lta bu'i lag pa/ g.yon pa bum pa 'dzin pa de spyan drangs la/ me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs pas mchod nas lhag par gnas pa bya ste/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par ni/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lhamo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa—/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /de nas de nyid du thim par bsam mo/ /de dag ni sa lhag par gnas pa'o/ /11byed656

de'i rjes la sems can gyi khams ma lus pa 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pas rnam par 'khrugs par bltas la/ nyon mongs pa rnams la khros te/ yi ge ma las mig g.yon par zla ba/ ṭa las mig g.yas par nyi ma ste/ phyogs thams cad ①'bar bar byed cing khams gsum la blta ba'i rnal 'byor pas rkang pa'i 'og tu rdo rje 'bar ba bsgom zhing / rdo rje gsor bar brtson pa dril bu dkrol zhing 'gying pas/ hūṃ zhes mgrin pa'i sgra sgogs ②shing bgegs kyi tshogs dang lha la sogs pa'i sdang ba ma lus pa bskrad par bya'o/ /oṃbyedahūṃ/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga be+e dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /srung ①ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor byed/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni/ /lus gsum las skyes dgas par bya/ /gal te nga las 'ga' ④'das na/ /de dag shigs bya gzhan du min⑤/ /rdo rje'i gnas su 'khor lo dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang / ral gri la sogs pa bcug la brjod par bya'o/ /rdo rje'i gom pas gar byed cing 'khor los ༷yongs su bskor ro/ /bskal pa'i me lta bu'i 'od zer rkang pa nas byung nas gdug pa rnams bsregs te phan tshun bros par bsam mo/ /mthun pa'i stang stabs g.yas g.yon brkyang / /zlum po ⑦sa ga gyen du 'degs/ /thur du babyed ⑦dang thad logs bskyod/ /gom brgyad g.yas g.yon bskor ⑨gar bya'o / /de ma thag tu bgegs med par bya ba'i phyir phur bus gdab par bya'o/ /de yang / shar phyogs ⑩lugs dang mi mthun dang / /lugs mthun g.yon mdzub se gol gtogs/ /oṃsum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ hūṃ ⑪phaṭa/ oṃshraṇ+ḍa greṇ+ḍa hūṃ hūṃ ⑫phaṭa/oṃkṛ2 pa ya kṛ2 pa ya hūṃ hūṃ ⑫phaṭa/ oṃk+ṣiṃn ya ho bha ga bān badz+ra rā dza hūṃ hūṃ ④ phaṭa—/ ces rkang pa re re brjod pa'i tshe/ sngags de dang de kha dog dmar po 11—657

'bar ba yig 'bru che ba phyogs de dang der stikha nas 'phros pa/ sngags de dang der ②'phros pa'i lha mo khā gdong ma la sogs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ kha dog dmar mo cher 'bar gzhabs 'og gi sa gzhi la gzhagadu /tshangs pa'i gnas la dbu thug dhirab tu che zhing gzugs rags pa/ /phyag g.yon lte ba man chad zur gsum stod ni rang 'dra thogs/ /g.yas pa tho ba can rnams rang rang phyogs su spro bar 0bya/ /de dag gis ni bgegs rnams shin tu thag ring ④bskrad par bsam⑧/ /de nas sngags de dang ⑨de dag las grub pa'i rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa rab tu 'bar ba rgyar sgrub pa po ji tsam 'dod pa bsams ⑫la/ oṃ badz+ra s+thā kā ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ zhes khya ba'i ⑪sngags kyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas rdo rje'i ra ba ⑫las/ /'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /'phros pas dbus su yi ge hūṃ—/ /las sgrub sna tshogs rdo rjer ⑫bsam/ /de las rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'od zer 'bar ba 'phros pas 'og tu sa 'og gi gzhi la thug par sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sar byas la/ oṃme di ni badzī ⑫bha ba brnya hūṃ zhes byin gyis brlab bo—/ /de bzhin du sa dang ra ba las 'od ⑩'phros pas gur ro/ /gur las bla re'o—/ /bla re las mda'i dra ba zhes bya ba phyi rol du steng dang logs kun du khyab par bsam zhing / de dag tu oṃbadz+ra pā kā ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ wībadz+ra bi tā na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/wībadz+ra sa ra dzā la hūṃ saṃ ṭ+wā zhes bya bas byen gyis brlab bo/ /khwa gdong ma la sogs ⑩pa brgyad ni phyi rol du/ /kha bltas 'khod ⑩pa rnams kyi mdun du hūṃ/ /ring po brgyad bltas de dag yongs ⑫gyur las/ /dang po kha khyer phan tshun sprad brgyad bsam/ /de nas khā gdong ma la sogs pa 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis ⑪bgegs bros pa rnams dong du chud cing / dong 0gi pha rol 11—658

nas bgegs bros pa rnams 'od zer 'bar ba lcags kyu'i rnam pas drangs shing dong du bcug pa dang / khā gdong ma la sogs pa dong gi drung na 'khod pa rnams la bdag nyid khro bo'i lta ba dang bcas pas/ oṃ ghaḥghaḥghā ta ya ghā ta ya san+d+ra duṭ+wā na ①hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ tī la ya ②tī la ya sabyu pā paṃ ①hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra shī la ya badz+ra dha ro du.ādz+nyā pa ya ti thabyān ⑤kā ya wāka /sto badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba brjod de phur bu tshugs shig par bka' bsgo bas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur pa btsugs pa dang / oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra tī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas—/ de dag gi rdo rje tho bas phur pa brdungs te/ bgegs rnams la phur pa btab pas bgegs rnams rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byas nas khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rnams 'od 'bar ba'i tshogs su gyur te/ mda'i dra ba la thim ma thag tu chu la chu dubardabs pa'i tshul du slar phyir 'phros pas rdo rje'i ra ba zlum por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra s+thā kā ra hūṃ/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de bzhin du de las 'od zer 'phros pas pad+ma'i dra ba/ de las 'khor lo'i ra ba/ de las rdo rje me 'bar ba steng dang logs kun du khyab pa g.yon skor tsadu 'khyil zhing 'bar bar bsams te/ de bzhin du oṃ pad+ma pā kā ra hūṃ du/ oṃ tsakra pā kā ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dzā ⑨la a na 'a hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes so so'i sngags kyis ⑫ byin gyis brlab par bya'orka/ /de dag ni sa yongs su bzung ba'o/ /de nas yid dang mthun par nyu1byi dor la sogs pa legs par byas pa'i sa'i char bum pa rnams lhag par gnas par bya ste/ de yang gser la sogs pa las grub pa'am/ sa yi rang bzhin nag po dang / /rtsa ba med par ⑫mchu 'phyang ba/ /mgrin pa mtho ba lto che 7rnams/ /legs par bkrus shing rdo rgyus byug④ /gu gul la sogs pas bdugs nas/ /11—659

rnam rgyal bum par sna tshogs pad①/ /lte bar bdag po'i mtshan rtags zi/ /dkyil 'khor pa gzhan ②bum pa rnams/ /rang rang mtshan mas mtshon par bya/ /'on kyang las thams cad pa'i ①bum pa las kyi lha'i mtshan mas mtshon pa/ mgrin pa ras zung gis dkris pa/ gser dang dngul dang mu men dang mu tig dang byi ru dang | nas dang gro dang til dang / 'bras dhiso ba dang mon sran sde'u ma ⑤ dang —/ thra dhiha ti dang kaṇ+ḍa spyoka ri dang / a pa rā dzi ta dkar po dang daṇ+ḍi ta ba la dkar po dang / ha sa de ba rnams dang ldan pa/ chu gtsang ma ④srog chags med pa legs par blangs la/ bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pas ran par bkang ba/shing ha sa ka ra la sogs pa 'bras bu dang bcas shing 'dab ma dang ldan pas kha brgyan pa/ de dag las 'dren pa'i bum pa ni dbus su ste/ gzhan go rims / ji lta ba ⑫bzhin du bzhag la/ de dang de'i steng du mchod yon gyi snod dri zhim po'i chu me tog dkar po dang bcas pa bzhag ste/ de'i steng du me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa'i rdo rje bzhag la/ de nas snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ mchod yon la sogs pa phul nas/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang gcig tu byas te mchod pa byas la/ de dang de'i sngags rnams kyis brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags ⑪pa byas la/ me tog dkar po dang bcas pa'i mchod yon bum par phul bas/ dkyil 'khor kyi bdag po 'dod chags chen pos de'i nang du zhu bar bsam/ 'khor lo ⑪de dag de nyid du ye shes kyi chu'i rnam par gyur par blta'o/ /de nas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyengs ni mkhas chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror ⑫phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba 11—660

dgyes pa che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /'khor lo mkha' 'gror ①phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab⑤/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gror ①phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gror duphyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa'i ngo bo nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gror ⑤phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod pa bya zhing dril bu dkrol bar bya'o/ /de dag ni bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i sgor rigs dang gzugs dang lang tsho dang dad pa dang thos pa dang / gtong ba la sogs pa dang ldan pa/ sngags kyi tshul gyi skal pa can/ nga rgyal la sogs pa'i skyon mtha' dag dang bral ba/ don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams dang / gzhan yang yon tan med pa rnams kyang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ khrus byas te yon phul ba/ maṇ+ḍal byas shing me tog thogs pa/ phyag 'tshal nas pus mo'i lha nga sa la gtsugs pa thal mo sbyar te du gsol ba btab pa/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la brten pa rnams la/ chos bshad pas spro ba bskyed par bya ste/ rang gis bslabs 9)dang ldan pa'i 'khor/ /bzhi ④la rjes su gnang ⑨ba dang / /theg chen blo la yang dag pa'i/ /cho ga de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /gsang sngags dngos grub don gnyer gang / /bsod nams 'dod pa de bzhin gzhan/ /'jig rten pha rol la gzhol ba/ /kha cig dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug byed/ /'jig rten gzhan don 'dod pa yi/ /11—661

blo bzang dad pa cher byas 'jug /'jig rten 'di pa'i 'bras spangs nas/ /'jig rten gzhan don la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /'di las 'jig rten gzhan gyi ming ①/ /de phyir 'jig rten gzhan dag gi/ /dngos grub don du yid brtan ①gyis/ /zhes de dag bsgrags nas/ de rnams kyang blos rang gi lus la bcug ste/ rdo rje dang pad+ma dag par byas nas/ he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par dmigs te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor ma dang zhal sbyor bzhugs/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ⑦ston pa'i rgyal/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum po ni bdag la stsol/ /thar chen mchog gi pho brang du/ /mgon po bdag no gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod nas/ gus pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams las gcig gtso bor byas la/ bu tshur zeg pa chen po yi/ /tshul chen snod ni khyod yin pas/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas dus gsum 'byung ba rnams/ /rdo rje gsang sngags rab bsgoms pas/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /shākya seng ge sogs mchog gis/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pas/ /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde/ /stobs chen lang dag ④de yis bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug mkhyen nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod de bstan par bya'o/ /yang slob mas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs dhimachi/ /11—662

sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid la bzhag /ces brjod pas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rnams dran par bya'o/ /de dag ni dbang bskur ba la sogs pa lnga 'dod pa'i ①slob ma'i thun mong gi sdom pa'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyi sdom pa 'dzin par ② 'dod pa'i slob mas slob dpon gyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas thal mo khong stong du sbyar bas/ 'khor lo mi ldog dbang bskur mchog /sprul nas mgon bo bdag la ni/ /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang —/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gi/ /sdom pa gsang ba bla med pa/ /rtag tu sems can kun don phyir/ /slob dpon khyod kyis ①bdag la gsungs/ /zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ④/gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas gsol ba btab pa'i bla mas rigs thams cad la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing / /dam tshig sdom dang gsang ba yi/ /'khor lo 'dir yang gzhug dhipar 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis brjod par bya ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi⑥/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin pa ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /des kyang bdag ni rab tu 'tshal④/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas bla mas brjod par bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje rin po che/ /pad+ma las kyi rigs mchog gi/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du so sor gzung du/ /rtsa ba'i rtsang ba bcu bzhi yang / /phas pham /bzhi dang mi dge bcu/ /rnam par 'khrul par chang btung ⑪ba/ /de dag kun du spang bar kyisakhyedze+e/ /sems can don min bya min spongs⑫/ /dam pa nyer 11byed663

bsten ①rnal 'byor kun④/ /theg pa dman la 'dod ma ①byed/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba mi spong 'da' mi rjochags/ /lha sogs brnyas min rgya mi 'gong / /'di dag dam tshig ces su bstan/ /sdom brtson khyod kyis bsrung bar gyis/ /de nas slob mas brjod par0 ba ni⑤/ sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus dupa'i sku/ /slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson/ /khyab bdag ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /de nas bla ma'i ngag gis 'di/ /sdom pa legs par blang bar bya/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la⑦/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan par gzung ⑧bar bgyi—/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung ⑨bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spong ⑫ngo//rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i ⑩phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung ⑫bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung ⑫bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi / /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i—/ /pad+ma'i spyorigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa yi/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung ⑩bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po yi/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ⑩ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung ⑫bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /bcu bzhi yi ni rab dbye bas/ /rtsa ba'i rtsang ba spang 11—664

bar bgyi/ /gzhan yang yan lag ltung ba rnams/ /bdag gis rab tu spang bar bgyi / /srog chags gsad par mi bya zhing / /ma byin par ①yang mi blang ngo / /'dod la log ①par mi spyad snekyang / /brdzun du smra bar mi bya'odu/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag gi/ /dge ba dag ni bskyang bar bgyi/ /don min kun gyi rtsa ba yi chang 'thung rnam 'khrul sems pa spang ⑤/ /sems can gdul don ma gtogs par/ /bya min thams cad spang bar bgyi/ /skyes budam pa bsten ⑦bgyi zhing / /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bgyi/ /theg pa dman la 'dod pa yang 'bad pa yis ni spang bar babyi/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bubasgral/ /ma grol ba rnams grol ⑧bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /'khor ba spang bar mi bgyi zhing / /mya ngan 'das la chags mi bgyi/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa⑨/ /gtso bo bdag gis brnyas mi bkyi—/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom ⑩par mi bgyi'o/ /dus 'di nas ni gzung nas ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis ⑪bskyed par bgyi/ /sdom pa dag kyang ma lus gzung / /de dag ni slob dpon gyi sdom pa gzung ⑫ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas zhal bzhi'i sngags kyis de dag la shin tu bsrungs la/ de rnams kyi snying gar yi ge hūṃ las rdo rje/ mgrin par yi ge ulas pad+ma/ mgo bor yi ge oṃlas 'khor lo/ mtshan ma de rnams kyi lte ba'i dbus su sa bon de rnams bsam par bya'o/ /de nas langs te dri zhim po'i chus spyordo rje khu tshur gyis hūṃ u.oṃzhes brjod cing / snying ga dang mgrin pa dang 11—665

mgo bor byug par bya'o/ /de nas de dag gi spyi bor me tog /mdun du spos dang mar me/ snying gar dri/ lag par zas mchog sbyin par bya ste/ thams cad la las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas la sbyin no/ /de nas rdo rje phag mo'i snying po'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags pa'i a shwadru la sogs pa'i so shing mi 'khyog pa srin bu med pa ma gas pa rma med pa/ sor bcu gnyis ①mthe'u chung gi tshad tsam ②rtse mo me tog mdzes pa can dri zhim po'i chus bkrus pa slob ma rnams kha byang du bltas pa'i thal mor sbyin no/ /de rnams shar phyogs su kha bltas nas gnas pa la 'char bcug la/ zur bzhi pa la gru gang ①tsam du ba lang gi lci bas byugs pa'i sa la ltos ④pa med par dor bar bya'o/ /de nas so shing lhung ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas de rnams kyi zhi ba la sogs pa'i dngos grub 'byung ba bstan par bya ste—/ shar dang lho dang nub dang byang du kha bltas nas lhung na/ rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du zhi ba dang drag shul spyod pa dang ④dbang dang / rgyas pa rnams so/ /mtshams rnams su bltas na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'thob bo/ /steng du kha bltas te lhung na rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub 'thob bo/ /'og tu kha bltas te lhung nas 'og gi dngos grub 'thob bo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du lhung na dngos grub med pa yin no/ /de nas yi ge hūṃ las byung ba'i de nyid gsum bzlas pa'i chu 'thor 'thung bya ba'i phyir/ oṃtrīḥbi shudha saza dharma dusabyu pā paṃ ni tsā ④su bi sho dha ⑧ya saza bi kaspyo a pa na ya hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod cing skyor ba gsum 'thung du gzhug go/ /de nas tshad legs pa'i skud pa sum sgril mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa/ rang gi ⑨lha'i sngags bzlas pa byas pa bdag nyid kyis de rnamasakyi dpung pa g.yas pa la bcings pas kun nas bsrung bar bya'o/ /⑩yi ge hūṃ las 11—666

skyes ①pa'i ku sha gsar pa ma nyams pa las las kyi lha mo'i sngags bzlas pa stan la dang sngas su sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas chos bstan pas spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'jig rten du/ /u dus+thā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na'am res 'ga' bzhin/ /'byung 'gyur yang na mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du mar ni//sngon chad sdig paco ba ①gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gro/ /gang dag spyod pa'i mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo ba//de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyu/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung bcad pa yin/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyis/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung nas skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la/ /legs par skyebar 'gyur ba yin/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /gang phyir spyod rnams dong byed pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyurarjo/ /zhes bya ba bstan pa thos par byas nas/de rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑤rtsa ba'i gsang sngags kyis bsrungs te/ nangs du par dri lam nga la smos shig ces brjod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i mthar seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis dge ba'i sems kyis nyal du gzhug go/ /slob dpon yang dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs nas bsrung ba'i don du bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa 11byed667

ba'i gsang sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon kyis nangs ①par sngar gtor ma btang nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa nas byung ste/ slob ma rnams bos te rmi lam dris te/ ri las lhung ba la sogs pa mtshan ma ④mi dge ba rmi lam ngan pa rnams byung na zhal bzhi'i sngags kyis slob ma'i bgegs bzlog par bya'o/ /de dag rig pa'i dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i sdom pa sngon du 'gro ba'i slob ma lhag par ①gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas sa bude la dris nye bar byugs nas me tog rnam pa sna tshogs pa chal par bkram nas lha'i gnas rnams su bdud rtsi lnga'i thig le byas la—/ der ⑤snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis 'khor lo spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol lo/ /oṃ tshibadz+ra pu྾ hūṃ/ oṃt+pabadz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ tshibadz+ra dī pe hūṃ/oṃ.ubadz+ra gadhe hūṃ/ oṃ oṃbadz+ra ṣ+pe bi bye hūṃ/ zhes bya bas me tog dang / bdug pa dang / mar me dang / dri dang / zhal zas rnams kyis yang dag par mchod nas—/ hūṃ mche ba gcigs shing 'jigs chen po/ /rgyu ma'i me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa/ /khrag 'thung dpal la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los ⑥ sgyur//ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo④/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun du rtog pa'i ⑧'ching bcad cing / /'jig rten bya ba la 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bstod pa byas nas/ de nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te lag pa g.yas pas spusgos snod thogs la 'khor lo'i dbang bdag dang sangs rgyas ⑫rnams la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/dpal spemeldan khrag 'thung rdo rje mchog /dam pa rig rgyal khyod phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon po bdag ni dz+re bar 'tshal/ /11byed668

slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas bka' drin mdzad par rigs/ /'gro ba'i tshogs kyi don mdzad pa'i/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams dgongs su gsol/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /gang gzhan sngags kyi lha nyid dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams ①dang / /'byung po rdzogs byang nyer gnas dang / /bstan la mngon dga'i sems can rnams/ /gang zhig rdo rje'i mig can rnams/ /rdo rje can chen che ge bdag /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i yo byad kyis/ /'gro ba'i don phyir 'bri lags pas/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs brtse ba ru dgongs nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bcas pa thams cad kyis / /byin gyis brlab pa mdzad du gsol/ /de skad byas nas 'khor lo de nam mkha' la gdeg ①par bya'o/ /de dag ni lha lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas nangs par nyi ma 'char kas dkyil 'khor ④de dris nye bar byugs la/ de'i rjes la zig skud dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur du ring ba sboms su sgo'i nyi shu cha bdud rtsi lngas brlan pa dri zhim po lngas bsgos pa kha dog lnga byugs pa rtag pa la sogs pa'i ⑤sa bon oṃ khaṃ dze+eṭ+wā dhihūṃ rnams las grub pa'i ④kha dog can snod du bzhag la/ rnal 'byor pa ④yi ge dzaḥlas grub pa'i nyi ma dang zla ba'i mig can gyis rtag pa la sogs pa'i thugs kar gnas pa de dag gi kha dog can gyi 'od zer gyi thig skud bltas la/ oṃdip+ta dṛṣ+ṭi i ku shi dzaḥzhes bya ba 'di dang —/ oṃ.a ⑨pra yats+tsha/ sha sho ta sru tra swā ⑩tsakrā sru tra shā ya hūṃ zhes rtag pa'i gnas su rin chen 'byung ldan ⑪la sogs pa yang sbyar te gsol ba btab pa dang /de rnams kyis btang ba rab tu g.yo zhing 'bar ba'i mig gi rdzi mas 'dren pa'i 11—669

'bar ba'i lta ①bas bkug la/ ye shes kyi thig dang gcig ④tu byas te/ oṃ a byo n+ya a nu ga tā saspru dhas+thā ④a nu pra biṣ+ṭa marba dhas+thā dhihūṃ/ zhes brjod cing lnga po gcig tu bsgril bar bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa thig skud 'dzin pa dang lhan cig tu bla ma rdo rje dril bu 'chang bas ye shes kyi thig skud g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung ste/ dzaḥzhes bya ba gsum gyis slob ma la gtad ⑤la/ slob mas kyang dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod cing 'gro bas song ste/ ste ba'i steng du thig sgud bzung ste/ nub tu gnas pa shar du mngon par phyogs pa dang —/ shar du gnas pa nub tu mngon par phyogs pas gnam thig gdab bo/ /de bzhin du 'og gi thig kyang gdab bo/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya sru tra mā duti kra ma hūṃ/khyed rnams kyis sems can gyi don gyi dus lags te de bas 'dir gshegs su gsol lo zhes thig skud kyi sgras nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bskul la/ shar dang nub tu tshangs pa'i thig gdab par bya'o/ /byang 7du mngon par phyogs pa dang / lhor mngon par phyogs pa dang / thabs gcig tu lho dang byang gi thig gdab par bya'o/ /mer gnas pa duganod sbyin du bltas pa dang —/ dbang ldan du gnas pa yi dwags su bltas pas ni shar gye rtsa ba'i thig go//rlung gi phyogs su gnas pa yi dwags su bltas pa dang / bden bral du gnas pa gnod sbyin du bltas pas ni nub phyogs kyi rtsa ba'i thig gdab bo/ /mer gnas pa klu'i phyogs su bltas pa dang / bden bral du gnas pa dbang por ⑨bltas pas ni lho phyogs kyi rtsa ba'i zig go⑩/ /rlung gi phyogs su gnas pa ⑪dbang por bltas pa dang dbang ldan du gnas pa klur bltas pas ⑫ni byang phyogs kyi rtsa ba'i thig go/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis tshangs thig dag gi ⑫ngos gnyis su thig gsum gsum gdababo//11—670

rtsa ba'i thig rnams kyi phyi rol du cha chen bzhi bzhi gdab bo/ /me'i phyogs dang bden bral du gnas nas mtshalas kyi thig gnyis kyang gdab bo/ /cha chen dang po tshangs ngos dor/ /de nas cha chung gnyis gdab bya/ /cha chen gnyis pa cha bzhir gdab/ /cha chen gnyis ①pa ngos gnyis nas/ /cha chung re re gdab par bya / /cha chen drug po ②tha ma yi/ /ngos nas cha chung gnyis gnyis gdab/ /cha chen bdun pa dang brgyad pa/ /cha chung bzhi bzhir gdab par bya/ /gnyis pa sgo khyud bzhi pa sogs/ /bcu pa ngos dang bcu gnyis 'gram/ /bcu bzhi pa ni ya phubs ①te/ /de dag kun la thams cad du/ /cha lnga mnyam par gzhag pas gdab/ /chos kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa/ /ji ltar mdzes par brtag par bya/ /dkyil 'khor du phur bu btsugs la dbang ldan gyi mtshalas nas rdo rje'i ra ba dang 'bar ba'i ra ba cha chung re res bskor ro/ /de bzhin du lha snam gyi nang du zlum por bskor bar bya'o/ /'dir mtshan ma ngan pa mthong ba las ni dngos grub med do—/ /thig skud chad na bla ma 'chi/ /lhag chad kyi nyes pa las ni nad do/ /phyogs la du'akhrul na slob ma rmongs so/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis mdzes pa ste/ /do shal do shal phyed pas spras/ /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /stegs bu la brten gzungs kyi tshogs/ /mchod dupa rnams kyis 'brel pa ste/ /grwa yi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis brgyan/ / rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bur bcas/ /ba dan rnams kyis phyi yi grwar/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor gdab pa'o/ /de yi nang du pad+ma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa nye bar mjes/ /snying po ge sar dang ldan pa/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor phyed du'o/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas 11—671

yi ge tī las khro bo'i lta bas rnam par dbye bar bya'o/ /①sgo ni dkyil 'khor brgyad cha ru/ /bdag nyid chen pos shes par bya/ /stegs bu chen po dor byas la/ /tshad dang ldan zhing shin du mdzes/ /sgo khyud sgo 'drar shes par bya/ /de bzhin lha yi snam bu ste/ /rdo rje lha mo yang dag ldan/ /glu dang rol mo la sogs gar/ /stegs bu sgo yi byed yin te/ /'gram dang logs zhes bya ba'ang yin/ /zla ba me tog phreng rnams ④nyid/ /rtsa ba'i ①thig sa'i phyi rol du/ /mtshon durtsi'i sa ni de yi phyed/ /rin chen ka ba sogs snam bu/ /rdul tshon sa dang snam bu'i sa/ /rta babs sgo yi bzhi 'gyur te/ /ba dan dril bur ldan pa rnams/ /dril bur bcas pa rlung bskyod pa'i/ /ba dan phyi yi grwa rnams su'o/ /gzhan rnams 'khor lo'i rjes mthun par/ /ji ltar mdzes par rab tu brtag /de ltar rim pa 'dis legs par thig btab la/ de nas rin po che las byung ba'am/ lcags lnga las byung ba'am/ kham pa ①las byung ba'am/ 'bras sā lu las byung ba la sogs pa'i rdul tshon lnga snod lngar bzhag pa nyal rtag pa la sogs pa'i sa bon bkod de/ /ye shes kyi rdul tshon bkug nas/ gzi brjid bskyed nas/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis bla mas mngon par bsngags te/ dkyil 'khor kyi ye shes kyi thig oṃ badz+ra be+e ga mā ti kra ma hūṃ zhes brjod pa'i ⑦yid kyis nam mkha' la bteg nas/'khor lo'i nang du 'dug la kha shar du bltas te/ chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo bde mchog rgyal shechen gyi—/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya/ /zhes brjod de dbang ldan gyi grwa nas g.yas skor ④gyi rim pas g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur gyis ⑩so sor dpal ldan khrag 'thung gi nga rgyal dang ldan pas rdul tshon dgye ⑪bar bya'o/ /phyi nas sgrub pa'i 11—672

grogs mchog gis bya'o/ /pha dang ma dang rgyal po dang / /rgyal rigs gnyis dang brtags ①pa'i chus/ /thod pa bzang po rab tu bkang / /legs byas slob ma la sogs yin/ /nag po dkar po ljang gu dang / /dmar po dang ni ser po sogs//mnyam zhing g.yas skor chayo min dang / /ma chad par ni ri mo dgye(gu/ /sgom por gyur na nad du 'gyur/ /phra mo yis ni nor 'joms byed/ /yon po rnams dang ④chad pa yis/ /bla ma dang ni slob ma 'chi/ /shar phyogs su ni dkar po che/ /byang phyogs ljang gu yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste/ /sgo phyogs ser bar ⑧rab tu gnas/ /dbus kyi sa gzhi'i cha de ni/ /in+d+ra nī la mtshungs pa'i 'od6)/ /'di dag tshon gyi rim pa ste/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /bdag po la sogs rang gnas su/ /phyag rgya chen po lha gzugs rdzogs/ /yang na rtags mtshan la sogs pa/ /gang 'dod ji ltar rigs par bri/ /rdul tshon bri ba zin nas rdul tshon gyi lhag ma'i lha rnams/ oṃ.uhūṃ badz+ra mutshozhes bya bas gshegs su gsol ⑧gnas dbe+en par bzhag 6)go/ /de ni rdul tshon dgye ba'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gnas legs par brgyan pa ⑩dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du ba'i lci bas byugs te/ bye dor byas shing dri zhim po'i chus chag chag btab par bsang gtor la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad rnams dang / bum pa yang gnas gnas su legs par bzhag ste/ de ltar dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bltas la bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su 'dug pas/ khang pa brtsegs ma'i dbus su sgrub thabs las 'byung ba ⑪bzhin dkyil 'khor bskyed la/ nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros nas gnas ji lta bar rang rang gi mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'i sar erang rang gi lha'i sku ji lta bar yongs su rdzogs par bltas la/ 'dren pa la ni sku gsung thugs 11—673

byin kyis brlab pa la sogs pa dang lha mo rnams la ni ngo bo nyid rnam par dag pa dran par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas ①mchod yon la sogs pa phul la/ yi ge bzhis dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du ②byas la/ dbang bskur ba dang mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bdud rtsi myang bar bya ste④/ sgo kun nas ni lag pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po nas brtsams nas/ /rang rang sngags bzlas byin kyis brlab/ /kun kyang brgya rtsa brgyad par bzlas/ /de nas me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod nas/oṃ badz+ra wa ste dhihūṃ zhes bya bas ras zung du sbyar ba lha rnams la phul la/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas dulegs par bstod de yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas la/ sgrub pa'i grogs mchog dkyil 'khor du bzhag ste/ bdag nyid phyir byung nas/ rgya chen po'i ⑦gtor ma gtang bar bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid kyis dhidakyil 'khor la bskor ⑧ba byas la phyag bya'o/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o/ /de nas slob dpon bdag nyid slob ma 'jug pa'i cho gas dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ dbang bskur ba thams cad rdzogs par bya ba dang / rjes su gnang ba la sogs pa thob par bya ba dang / 'dod chags chen po las byung ba'i de kho na nyid bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang gzugs brnyan ltar chos nyid kyis shes par byas nas tshigs su bcad pa gdon te/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /bde mchog 'khor lor ⑨bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog yon tan chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha//rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes 11—674

pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyis ①rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid bdag grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa sku yi mchog /gzod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpar bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid de—/ /'dod chags mchog gi dam tshig mchog /ces so/ /da ni tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyis bden pa'i byin brlab bya ④ste/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /bden pa de yis mgon spyod kyis/ /bdag gi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /de bzhin de kho nyid las byung / /bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni/ /kun kyi dri med mthong bar shog /ces so/ /de nas yol ba'i phyi rol du khrus byas shing dri zhim po la sogs pas gtsang bar gyur pa/ dbang bskur ba'i snod du rung ba'i slob mas yon phul te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /rdo rje 'chang chen ngo bo nyid/ /dmigs med bde chen ston pa po/ /slob dpon chen po la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes phyag byas la/ don dam rnal 'byor smra ba'i seng ge ces bya ba—/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya bskyed pa'i nyon mongs bcom mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid 11—675

grub par mdzod/ /ces sogs ①gsol ba gdab pa dang / de dpal bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i gzugs su bltas la/ a ②khaṃ bī ra hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis me tog gi phreng ba bzung la/ zhal bzhi'i sngags kyis byen gyis brlabs pa'i dar ser po'am dmar pos gdong g.yogs bya ba ste/ slob ma tha ma 'bring ni mi mthong bar/ /mchog ni cung zad mthong bar bcing bar bya/ /de nas las thams cad pa'i chus bsangs te dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i phyir/ kye dga' ba sdug gu khyod su yin/ /zhes dri bar bya'o/ /des kyang kye bde ba chen po kho bo ni skal ba bzang po lags so zhes brjod par bya'o/ /yang bu ci bya/ des kyang ske/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig bgyi 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /de nas de'i mgo bor lag pa bzhag la/ oṃ saza yo ga tsit+ta uta pā da yā 1mi/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis byang chub kyi sems bskyed la/ me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar bzhag ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya hūṃ/ ho sernya badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes bya ba 'dis so—/ /de nas 'di ④/skad brjod par bya stedu/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab dhipar 'gyur gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar ma byed cig /ma dad par yang mi bya'o/ /de nas shar phyogs kyi sgo skyong ma'i sngags kyis slob ma bkug ste/ sngar bstan pa'i yi ge lngas yol ba'i nang du bcug la/ shar phyogs su bzhag ste lag pa nas bzung la 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje le shes babyed par bya yis/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (⑩dngos grub kyang thob par 11—676

'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du brjod par mi bya'o/ / khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re zhes so/ /de nas mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la 'di skad brjod do/ /'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te 'di 'ga' la smra na 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gas par byed do/ /de nas snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas 'di brjod par bya'o//tsa)oṃṭīhe ru ka deng khyed kyi/ /snying la de ring yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /zhes bya ba 'dis mna' bsgags nas/ pad+ma'i sdod na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang / tsan+dan dang gur gum la sogs pa bsres pa'i chus yi ge gsum gyis byin kyis brlabs la/ 'di ni spyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'grub/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig /oṃ badz+ra pañca a mṛ tod ka ṭha ṭha ②hūṃ zhes brjod cing 'thung du gzhug go/ /de nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas gang 'di gyis zhes smras pa de bu khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /brnyas pa byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por thong bar gyur ta re zhes so/ /de dag ni dam tshig gi ①chu sbyin pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol zhes brjod du bcug la/de'i mgo bor yi ge baṃ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po bum pas mtshan pa de la ha/ snying gar lo las byung ba'i dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa ser po rdo rje rtse gsum pas grwa durnams su mtshan pa de la hūṃ/ lte bar re las grub pa'i 11—677

me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa dmar po rno zhing 'bar ba de la a/ rkang pa'i 'og tu yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po g.yo ba gzhur snang ba ba dan gyis zur mtshan pa de la oṃdrag cing bzod par dka' ba 'bar ba'i lus kyi rlung gis ji srid du me'i dkyil 'khor dang phrad pa'i bar du 'bud bzhin ①bar bsams la der yang des sbar te ④shin tu tsha ba ④cher 'bar bas dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor yang 'bar ba na/ de nas chu'i dkyil 'khor la bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i tshogs kyis ngoms shing tshim bzhin pa/ rlung gis kyang slob ma bteg bzhin pa la/ bdag nyid kyang dregs pa dang bcas pa'i khro bo chen po rdo rje khrag 'thung drag po'i lus g.yas pas rdo rje gsor zhing g.yon pas dril bu dkrol bas/ 'bebs pa'i sngags kyis bdug spos byin dbab par bya'o/ /de la sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ shrī badz+ra te te ru ru kai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra swā hā/ lhagabe ⑤ṣā ya stam+bha ya ra ra ra ra tsā la ya hūṃ ha a sgihūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bya ba ste 'dis myur du phebs par 'gyur ro/ /slob ma la babs dupar rig nas de pad+ma'i rigs kyi dze+elha mo'i gzugs su yud tsam gyis dmigs la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes bya ba 'dis babs pa brtan par bya ste/ de'i lce la yi ge a dmar po bsams nas bru hi badz+ra zhes brjod na dge ba dang mi dge ba smra bar byed do/ /oṃ mgon po chen po rdo rje chos/ /'od dpag med pa bde ba che/ /'dod chags chen po ④chos gsungs shing / /dge dang mi dge gang yin dri⑨/ /zhes bya ba 'dis dri ⑩bar bya'o/ /babs pa de yang gang la babs pa las dge mi dge smra bar bya'o/ /sems la babs pa las 'jig rten gsum na gnas pa shes so//lus la babs na nam lgekhar 'phags so⑪/ /gal te ring du 'phags na de'itshe de'i mgo'i steng du lo las byung ba'i dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs rdo rjesalo 11—678

mnan par bsgoms ①na mi g.yo bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni dbab pa'o/ /de nas yang lho phyogs kyi sgor mngon par langs ②la/ r+ṣan maḥste hūṃ/ na mtshomi hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas lan gsum phyag bya ba sngon du 'gro bas/ chisasaza dubī ra yo gi bye dupū dza u paṣ+ṭha dhinā ya āt+pa ram̐ nit+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī āt+pa a ⑦mu kai a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa rmā⑧—/ zhes bya bas lus thams cad kyis phyag byed du gzhug go/ /de nas ⑨ g.yon phyogs su thal mo de ⑩nyid snying gar sbyor du bcug la/ shar phyogs kyi sgo nasaske/ chi saza bī ra yo gi bye ⑪byu dza a bhi ṣe kā ⑫ya/ ā rmā smir+ya ta yā mi saza ⑫keta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni āt+pa a mu rka a nyi ṣiñca tu rmā④/ de nas byang phyogs kyi sgor thal mo de nyid dpral bar bzhag la phyag byed du gzhug go/ /skasaza bī ra yo gi ni bye pū spyodza pra brta nā la ā rmā ⑩nīr+ya ta yā mi saza ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ⑩ āt+pa a mu ka pra brta ya rmāspyo/ de nas nub phyogs kyi sgor thal mo sbyor ba de nyid mgor bzhag ⑪la phyag byed du gzhug ste/ skasabyu bī ra yo gi bye ⑫pū dza karma ṇi ākhya ram̐⑪/ rtswar+ya ta yā mi saza ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni āt+pa ⑫a mu shaṃ ār+ya ⑫karmā ku ru rmā④/ de dag ni phyag go/ /de nas/ ska⑫de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /lha mo rnams kyi chos 'byung nyid/ /rin chen sna tshogs khang brtsigs ⑩ma/ /te ru ka dpal pho brang mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag /bsod nams ji bzhin de bzhin shog /'di yis dngos grub gang 'grub dang / /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di yis bsod nams ci yod las/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces bya bas bden pa'i byin rlabs ⑫byas la/ mig 11byed679
