༄khya/ /dpal 'gor lo sdom pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/phre ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra sā dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi dwags gdan la bzhugs shing zhal rnams kun la spyan gsum dang ni phag mo dmar mo'i lus/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis 'khyud gzhan gnyis kyis ni myur du glang chen gtso bo'i pags pa brgyangs/ /lhag ma g.yon pa'i phyag bzhis kha ṭī ga dang zhags pa mi thod tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'phyang/ /g.yas pas gri gug rtse gsum dgra sta rnge'u chung 'chang ba'i he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo bde mchog 'khor lo gsang ba'i don/ /sgrub pa'i gsang sngags kun bsdus nas/ /brda yi skad kyis sbas pas te/ /sgrub pa'i thabs de bdag gis bshad/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od tshogs kyis/ /mdun du bde gshegs spyan drangs nas/ /mchod pa kun gyis legs mchod de/ /dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa brjod/ /11—709

thams cad stong par rnam bsgoms nas/ /sna tshogs pad nyi hūṃ rdo rje/ /hūṃ 'byung mkha' 'gro'i tshogs spros te/ /blo dang ldan pas phur sogs bya/ /blo dang ldan pas mkha' dbyings su/ /'byung ba thams cad 'dus pa las/ /ji ltar sna tshogs bzhir gyur pa'i/ /'byung ba bzhi yi rnam pa ⑤ bsgom/ /de yi rim pa 'di yin te/ /ba lang gnas kyi lci skam dang / /lhag ma mgo skam de nas su/ /dung chen po yi ngo bo dang / /mi phyed rus sbal dag 'gyur bas/ /phyag bzhi pa dang zhabs bzhi pa/ /de bzhin phyag 'bum bar du ste/ /sku mdog dkar po khro bo che4—/ /rdo rje dril bu lus la 'khyud/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /sku la thal bas nye bar byugs/ /zhal gyi mche ba cung zad gcigs/ /yi dwags chen po gdan du byas/ /rgyal ba'i 'od zer sprin chen po/ /de las kun du rnam par 'phroske/ /phyag rgya drug gis lus la brgyan/ /ral pa yi ni thor tshugs can/ /g.yas kyi zhal ni gnag pa ste/ /g.yon pa dmar ba 'jigs pa can/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni shin tu dkar/ /rgyab ni gser du snang ba'o/ /dus min 'chi las rnam rgyal zhing / /yan lag kha ṭī ga dang sbyar/ /thod pa ar+gha snod kyis ni/ /zhal dang mtshon char nges sbyar ba'o/ /de yi shes rab 'jigs pa ma5 4/ /thod pa'i dum bu'i ske rags can/ /thod pa shin tu gang ba dang / /de yi kha dog lag char 'dzin/ /ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs dang / /rgya mtsho chen po'i ngos dag la/ /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod du/ /der ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /ji ltar chos kyi skur gyur pa'o/ /de ltar sprul dang bsrung bar bya/ /kha spyor kha spyor du gyur pa/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud du brjod/ /rdo rje 'byed byed pad+ma la/ /de tshe bung ba lta bur 'khor/ /brud pa rdo rje nyid du bshad/ /de nas rim bzhin spros byas 11—710

nas—/ /lcags kyu nyid kyis 'khyud bya ste/ /gtun shing gis ni bskyod par bya/ /dbyeg pa'i mda' yis mnyam sbyor te/ /de nas rig ma zhu ①bar gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yi/ /myur ba nyid du bdag la bskul/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa ⑤dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta ste dṛ sh+ya ho/ /①yongs su bskul ba tsam kyis ni/ /'jig rten khams kyi bde ba'i bdag /ji ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa bzhin/ /gnyug ma'i sngags las byung gyur te/ /khu ba'i gzugs las ④ rdo rje can/ /de nas saṃ 4hūṃ gnyis las bzhengs/ /kha dog sngon po 'jigs pa po/ /dmar po 'od kyis dkyil 'khor 'bar/ /zhal bzhi pa ste 'jogs khyebyepa can/ /drug gnyis phyag gis rnam par brgyan/ /u ma u ma'i bdag po mnan/ /nyin byed dbang phyug gdan du banying/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni shin tu gnag /g.yas pa kun+da lta bu ste/ /g.yon pa dmar po 'jigs pa po/ /nub ni gser du 'bar ba'o/ /sngar gyi lag char yang dag ldan/ /spyan gsum gyis kyang yang dag mdzes/ /cung zad khro zhing bzhad pa'i zhal/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi gar gyis bzhugs/ /de yi shes rab phag mo ni/ /dmar mo kha dog cher 'bar ba/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rnam par mdzes/ /rdo rje dang ni mi thod 'phyang / /bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal bzhi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ kluphaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛhā hūṃ hūṃ byephaṭa/ oṃ greṭ+wā pa ya kṛṇ+ḍa pa ya hūṃ hūṃ (spyophaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga bān bibyā rā dza hūṃ hūṃ ⑫phaṭa/de ni lugs las bzlas tugepa'o/ /oṃ dharmā dh+wa ⑫tu swa bhā ba āt+pa kophohaṃ zhes bya ba ni bsnyen pa'o/ /oṃ ha ⑫snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ /oṃ na ma hi spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad do/ /oṃ swā hā ⑫hu spyi gtsug tu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /oṃ bo ṣaṭa te mchan khung gnyis su dpal he ru ka'o/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho mig gnyis su rdo rje 11—711

nyi ma'o/ /wīphaṭa haṃ rta mgrin te/ yan lag thams cad la mtshon cha'o/ /oṃ ཿoṃbaṃ lte bar rdo rje phag mo'o/ /skahaṃ oṃ snying gar gshin rje ma'o/ /oṃ hri mo khar rmongs byed ma'o/ /oṃtre hri ⑧spyi bor skyod byed ma'o/ /oṃhūṃ hūṃ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma'o/ /wīphaṭa phaṭa lha mo'i gnas thams cad la/ nye ba'i sgrub pa'o/ /snying ga'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ ni thugs rdo rje'o/ /oṃ s+thāḥha ha hūṃ ①hūṃ phaṭa sgog mar gsung rdo rje'o/ /oṃ ṭībadz+ra te he ru ru rka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki bhā dzā la saṃ ba ra swā hā ni dpral bar sku rdo rje'o/ /oṃ saza burnya ḍā ki bhā ye badz+ra war+ṇa bhā ye hūṃ ④hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes bya ba ni lha mo'i snying gar ro/ /oṃ tsa haṃ hūṃ phaṭa sgog mar ro/ /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni hūṃ phaṭa dpral bar ro/ /spyi bor yi ge oṃ mo/ /snying gar yi ge hūṃ ngo / /ze 'bru la ni yi ge 26'o/ /rked par ni yi ge swā'o/ /brlar ni yi ge hā'o buzhes bya ba ni sgrub pa'o/ /ye shes dam tshig mnyam gyur pas/ /de phyir 'di ni rdo rjer brjod/ /dbang gi don ni bsgoms byas nas/ /phyis ni mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /liṅga gnyis la sngags bkod la/ /sna rtser a yig rnam par dgod/ /de bzhin liṅga'i lte ba la/ /yi ge baṃ ni rnam par bsam/ /blo ldan rnal 'byor ma la bsrub/ /dag pa'i lus ni dri ma med/ /ces bya ba 'di ni dang po'i rnal 'byor ro/ /oṃ sat+tha ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa āt+pa kophohaṃ/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /bde bar gshegs pa spyan drangs te/ /a wa dhū tī gnas de bzhin/ /smin ma'i bar du nges par gzhug /dang por dbyangs dang yang dag ldan/ /de ni skad cig gis gsal bsgom/ /mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar gnas pa/ /rnal 'byor ma ni de bzhin no/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba du ma ni/ /'khor lo thams cad kyi ni sgo/ /zhal bzhi dpa' bo rnams kyis so/ /dpa'abo 11—712

rnal 'byor mas yongs bskor/ /rtsa ba'i lam ni thams cad du/ /sngags pa ji ltar dbye 'dod pas①/ /de nyid dbye ba tha dad nyid/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni nyis spyor byed/ /chags pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /dgos pa'i phyir ni rab sgrub byed—/ /dam pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /yul dang yul la nges par sbyar/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni/ /gnas la rnam par gnas pa ste/ /shar nas mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya'i 'od can no/ /byang nas lā ma ljang ser ma'o/ /nub nas dum skyes ma dmar ser ro/ /lho nas gzugs can ma dkar ser kyi mdog can te/'di thams cad ni ro'i steng na thod pa dang gri gug lag na thogs pa/ skra gyen du badze+es pa/ rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa zhal gcig pa/ dbu la sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan gyis mtshan cing layang dag par ldan par 1gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o / /thod pa rnams su glang po ④dang ce spyang dang mi dang ba lang rnams rim pa ji lta ba'o/ /mtshams bzhir yang lngar ⑤gcig gis ma tshang ba'i snod do/ /mgo bo pul+li dur ma la ya nas khaṇ+ḍa ⑦ka pā li dang rab tu gtum mo ⑧ste/ so dang sen mo 'bab pa'o/ /spyi gtsug 'bar ba 'dzin pa nas ma hā rka ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma ste/ skra dang spu ⑨'bab pa'o/ /rna ba g.yas pa u khya ⑫na nas shaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma ste/ pags pa dang dri ma 'bab pa'o/ /ltag pa tuge.arbu da nas mche ba rnam par gcigs pa dang / sna chen ma ste sha 'bab pa'o/ /de dag ni shar phyogs la sogs pa nas ⑫lugs dang mthun pa'o/ /rna ba g.yon pa'i mchod sbyin nas dpa' bo bzang po dang / dpa' bo'i blo ⑫ma ste/ thams cad du chu rgyus 6 'bab pa'o/ /smin dbus dga' ba'i dbang phyug nas 'od dpag tu med pa dang —/ mi thung ma ste/ rus pa dang dri ma 'bab pa'o/ /mig gnyis lha mo'i 11—713

mkhar nas rdo rje 'od dang laba'i dbang phyug ma ste/ de ni rtag tu mchi ma 'bab pa'o—/ /dpung pa mā la be nas rdo rje'i lus dang / shing grib ma ste snying ga'i ju ba ①'bab pa'o/ /de dag ni dbang ldan ⑤la sogs pa'i mtshams nas/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i ①mkha' spyod ma rnams snyoms par zhugs pas bzhugs duso/ /de bzhin du mchan khung 'dod pa'i gzugs nas saṃ gu ri dang / e ra ba ti ste/de rtag tu mig 'bab pa'o/ nu ma gnyis po otre nas/ rdo rje ral pa can dang /'jigs byed chen mo ste/ mkhris pa 'bab pa'o/ /ste ba tri sha ku ṣ+pe ⑤nas dpa' bo chen po dang / rlung gi shugs can ma ste/ glo ba 'bab pa'o/ /sna'i rtse mo ko sa la nas/ badz+ra hūṃ ka ra dang chang 'thung ma ste/ rgyu ma'i phreng ba 'bab pa'o/ /de dag ni shar la sogs pa nas so/ /kha ka liṅga nas su bha dra dang / ljang lha mo ste—/ logs kyi 6)rtsa 'bab par bshad pa'o/ /mgrin pa lam pā ka nas rdo rje bzang po dang / shin tu bzang mo ste/ lte ba ⑦'bab pa'o/ /snying kā— thu nas 'jigs byed chen mo dang / rta rna ma ste/ bi sna ma 'bab pa'o/ /mdoms par hi mā la nas mig mi ⑨bzang dang / kha ga na ste/ mtshog ⑫ma'i srubs 'bab pa ste—/ mtshalas su sngar bzhin te/ gsung gi 'khor los spyod ma ste/ de rnams ni snyoms par zhugs pas rnam par gnas so/ /liṅga yi dwags gnas pa nas51 /stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can te/ bad kan 'bab pa'o/ /bshang ba'i lam khyim gyi gnas nas rin chen rdo rje dang / dum skyes ma ste dri ni rtag tu 'bab pa'o/ /brla sau rāṣ+ṭa nas/ rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma ste/ khrag 'bab par rab tu grags pa'o/ /byin pa gnyis ⑫gser gling nas/ nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste/ rdul 'bab par gyur pa'o/ /de dag 11—714

ni shar la sogs pa'i phyogs so/ /sor mo na ga ra nas ni dpal he ru ka dang /shin tu dpa' mo ste/ tshil 'bab pa'o/ /rkang pa'i rgyab sin+tu nas ni pad+ma gar gye dbang phyug dang stobs chen mo ste/ 'di ni rtag tu mchi ma 'bab pa'o mthe bo mya ngam ①nas rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los ④sgyur ma ste/ mchil ma 'bab pa'o/ /pus mo ku lu tā nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ byis pa'i snabs 'bab pa'o/ /sngon bzhin mtshams rnams su ste/ sku'i 'khor lo sa 'og na ①spyod pa rnams stoms par zhugs pas bzhugs so/ /shar gyi sgo nas khā gdong ma'o/ /byang nas ④'ug gdong ma'o/ /nub nas khye gdong ma'o//lho phyogs nas phag gdong can te/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyi kha dog dang mtshan ma dang ldan pa/ ro la zhon cing de las khya'od zer 'bar bas/bzhin kun du rnam par 'gyur zhing sna tshogs su rnam pa bsgyur ba ste/ lugs dang mthun pa'o/ /pho nya mo rnams ni lugs dang mi mthun pas yang dag par rnam par gzhag 6ste/ me'i mtshams nas gshin rje ④pho nya mo'o/ /srin po'i mtshams nas gshin rje brtan ma'o/ /rlung mtshams nas/ gshin rje mche ba gcigs ma'o/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas gshin rje 'joms ma ste/ 'di dag kyang kha dog gnyis gnyis ma'o/ /yid du 'ong ma snga ma lta bur ro la zhon pa'o/ /dpal he ru ka la sogs pa dpa' bo rnams ni rdo rje dang dril bus 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya can no/ /lha mo thams cad kyi phyag na gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum ma mche ba gcigs pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ 'od zer du ma spro zhing 'bar ba/ khro gnyer yon po'i 'amig gis blta ba/ ro mnan cing de las 'od zer 'bar ba/ nyi ma la gar gyis bzhugs 11—715

pa'o—/ /khwa'i gdong can ma la sogs pa bshad pa ni/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ thor tshugs kyi nor bu dang / rna cha dang mgul rgyan dang / gdu bu dang rdo rje'i rked pa dang / thod pa'i phreng bas mgul ba brgyan pa/ de bzhin du rkang pa gnyis la dril bu g.yer khas ①brgyan pa/ shin tu g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa'o/ /gong gi dpa' bo nyi shu bzhi/ /he ru ka dpal rigs byung ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni nyi shu bzhi/ /phag mo'i rigs las byung ba'o/ /ye shes dam tshig mnyam gyur pas/ /de phyir rdo rje zhes su brjod/ /dbang gi don ni bsgom byas nas/ /phyi nang mchod pas mnyes byas te/ /thams cad snga ma lta bu'o/ /da ni byang chub kyi ①phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi lha'i spyor bas rnam par gzhag ①ste/ lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni/ mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya ba nas/mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed pa ni gshin rje brtan ma'o zhes bya ba'i b.rarka/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs te/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi lha'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /snying gi nang song pad+ma 4ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar bcas/ /de yi nang du son pa'i rtsa/ /mar me lta bu'i rang bzhin te/ /chu shing gi ni me tog bzhin/ /'chang zhing kha ni 'og tu'o/ /de yi nang song dpa' bo ni/ /yungs kar sbom phra'i tshad tsam ste/ /gzhom ⑤med hūṃ ste sa bon ni/ /ba mo lta bur rjo'adzag pa nyid/ /lus can rnams kyi snying dga' ba/ /de phyir zhes bya rnam par bshad/ /me ni chen po'i gzugs kyis ni/ /phag mo'i thig le ru ni brjod/ /las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yis/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du ni 'bar/ /dpyid thob pas ni mnyes gyur nas/ /snyoms par 'jug pa rnam par gnas⑦/ /'di ni he ru ka dpal dpa'asge/ /dpyid kyi thig 11—716

ler brjod pa'o/ /stong pa nyid kyi tshul 'dzin ma/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu yang dag gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /sgo ni rnam pa gsum 'byung bar/ /'byung ba 'di ni 'jug pa ste/ /'di dag thams cad lus la gnas/ /lte ba'i a yi tshul gyis ni/ /thung du ru ni yongs su grags/ /snying la hūṃ gi yi ge ni/ /ring po tshad gnyis dag tu gnas/ /mgrin par oṃ gye gzugs kyi ni/ /shin tu ring po tshad gsum pas/ /dpral ba'i haṃ zhes bya ba ni/ /mi shigs pa yi thig le'o—/ /'khor lo bzhi yi dbye ba yis/ /sa sogs 'byung ba bzhi dag dang / /thun bzhis byen gyis brlabs pa yis/ /skad cig bzhi ni 'byung ba dang / /dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin gyis/ /sbyor ba bzhi ni ①sngon du'o/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /bya dang byed pa'i dngos po min/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshul gyis ni/ /'dir ni ji ltar bde bar rol/ /pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi po yang —/ /phyogs bzhir rnam par gnas pa ni/ /'byung ba bzhi yi rtsa yin te/ /mar me lta bu'i rang bzhin no/ /mtshams su rnam par gnas pa'i tshe/ /de ni ④nang song bzhi po yang / /de nas bdud rtsi lnga 'bab pa/ /de nyid rang bzhin mred tshul gyi①/ /'dir ni mchod pa'i tshul gnas pas/ /mchod pa bzhin du yang dag bshad/ /lus kyi snying gi nang na ni/ /rtsa rnams brgyad ni rnam par gnas/ /gzhan yang sku gsung thugs dbye bas/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang dag bshad//gnas sogs dbye ba la brten te/ /gnas dang gnas la rnam par gnas/ /ldang byed la sogs rnam dag pa/ /khwa gdong la sogs sngar ji bzhin/ /zhes bcomaldan 'das rdo rje can gyis rgyas btab pa'i phyir gsungs so/ /rdzas bcu las ni sngar bsam pa/ /yi ge a las byung ba'i snod/ /rlung gi me yi dkyil 11—717

nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ bai ro tsa m+bi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā nye ba'i snying po'o / /oṃ tso rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /rje btsun ma'i rkang pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bo ṣaṭa he/ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ phaṭa haṃ dpa' bo'i go cha drug go/ /oṃ baṃ haṃ oṃ hri oṃ hro tri /7rmyehūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ yi ge oṃ ni thams cad du ste/ rnal 'byor ma drug gi go cha'o/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa sdogs ses// //bsdur mchan/7༷9 1snamatshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs ba(1gas/71༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byung / 72sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mo/711 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tan 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉he ru ka badz+ra swā hā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 zhes bya ba'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yi / zhwa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jigs/ 7 8 9sna7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hūṃ hūṃ/11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzlog mi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dha/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hu/712 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—zhi 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri/ snyekru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hūṃ/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ha'o/713 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/ tsho27gu〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ rī〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 che/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sngar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pul+lī dz+wa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kha / ḍa8—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/ ḍa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spu dang skra/rta 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yo ḍi/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgon/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnams/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bla—/ —〈〈snar 〉〉rgyun/714 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ba/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉 sa/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhugs/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉log gis/ dz+wa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka:/9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—mi/ khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mtshogs/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lhag par gnas so/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉11byed7/9

༄ / /bcom ldan 'das dpal bde mchog 'gor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gaṭ+wā༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga wān ṭītsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍa la bi dhi/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung 'gro ba'i mgon/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnyis med la/ /phyag 'tshal dkyil 'khor spyod pa dang / /brtul zhugs rim pa bsnyen pa bshad/ /lugs su 'byung medang bzlog pa dang / /tha dad phyi ni sbas pa dag /shes nas gang yang cho ga 'di/ /bdag gis 1thams cad bshad par bya/ /sgra dang sgra nyams brda dang ni / /sdeb sbyor mtshan nyid spangs pa yi/ /'khor lo mchod pa'i cho ga gsal/ /de ni bdag nyid dran phyir bya④/ /gar gyi gnas dang mtshungs 'dra ba'i/ /phyi rol bstan bcos sun 'byin pa/ /don la rtogs pa'i ⑤de nyid can/ /spyod dang thar ba'ang rang 'ga' yin/ /legs par brtags pa'i slob ma la/ /slob 11—721

dpon gyis ni dkyil 'khor bri/ /'jam zhing snyan par smra ba dang / /snying rje 'a/ sogs phan sems ldan/ /thos dang klog la mngon par brtson/ /gsang ba'i cho ga lhag par dad/ /rtag par rgyun du bla ma gus/ /slob ma de ni yongs su gzung / /de ni dngos grub ma lus pa/ /sgrub byed ye shes bshad bya ste/ /lha ni mnyes par ma byas na/ /bdag nyid rnam par sun 'byin yin/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs ①'khor lo'i/ /sngags rnams mnyes la (kyi rab dad cing / /dpa' bo'i snying po'i gsang sngags ni/ /khri phrag skegasum du bzlas brjod bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ④'khor lo yi/ /khri phrag gnyis ni bsnyen par bya/ /kā ka'i gdong sogs rnam pa brgyad/ /snying po rnal 'byor ma bzhi yi/ /stong phrag lnga dang lnga brgya ni/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba ste/ /bdag gam yang na dkyil 'khor ni/ /sngon du bsnyen pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang 'dir rjes gnang dbang bskur ba'iske/ /bla ma'i gtso bo bri bya zhing / /'khor lo'i yo byad phun tshogs pa'i/ /slob mas de la gsol ba gdab/ /'khor lo mchod pa'i rim ji bzhin/ /khyod kyis thams cad 'byor gyur te⑤/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma dga' bar/ /gus pa yis ni byed nus sam/ /gal te dpa' bo thams cad du/ /gzi brjid can byed nus spas pa⑥/ /de nas dpa' bo chen pos 'dir/ /shes rab yan lag gnyis med lus/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /'khor lo kun la rnam par bzhugs/ /dang po gnas ni khyad par du/ /de las 'bad pas btsal bar bya/ /sems can don bya'i rgyu ru ni/ /bdag gi ⑦byang chub de la gzhag /da ni dngos grub thams cad kyi/ /yon tan gnas ni bshad bya ste/ /shin tu bgrod par dka' ba yin6)/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas dag tu/ /ro langs 11—722

dang ni srin po rnams/ /mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sgra sgogs pa/ /yi ge dze gi sgras khyab pa'am/ /sgrub pa po dang mtshams phyogs su/ /'jigs bral yongs su dag pa'i blos/ /ma lus rnam rtog rab bsal te①/ /byams dang snying rje'i rgyan gyis ni—/ /'dres med rnal 'byor pa bder ②gnas/ /sems can gcig tu gdug cing gtum/ /sdug bsngal dang ni las kyis gzir/ /stong dang snying rje'i snying po yis / /byang chub la gzhag rngo yid la bya/ /kye ma sems can sdug bsngal zhing / /kun rtog la ni mngon par zhen/ /de yi rtog pa gzhom phyir bdag /dpal ldan te ru ka rang bya/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnas las langs pa nyid dang ni—/ /'jug dang rdzogs pa nyid dag dang / /byin gyis brlabs dang dbang bskur dang / /ting 'dzin mchod pa nye bar bsdu/ /yang dag ye shes rgyud shes shing —/ /he ru ka dpal gsang sngags shes/ /khro ba med cing gtsang la mkhas/ /spyor shes ye shes pha rol 'gro/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs cha lugs/ /bdag nyid sngon du byed bdag ni/ /skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu/ /gsang ba'i ye shes rnam par spangs/ /dman la mos pa'i sems can rnams/ /mthong nas sgob dpon tshul la gnas/ /sems can gdon par bya'o zhes/ /snying rjes non pa'i sems dang ldan/ /de bas he ru ka rnal 'byor/ /bde mchog mgon po bdag ston no/ /dam tshig skyong zhing sten 4byed pa/ /bu khyod ci ga spro gyur tam/ /te ru ka dpal tshul 'di la/ /bza' dang bsrung la brten pa dang / /skye bo mang po'i sdig pa ni/ /bsags pa 'a rnam par 'jig 6byed pa/ /dpa' bo 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /sdom pa so sor bsrung bar bgyi/ /slob mas gsol ba'o/ /de nas 'dir ni dpa' bo ches/ /sngon du spyod pa byas nas ni/ /da ni sems can 11—723

bsgral bya zhes①/ /dga' ba'i sems ni sngon du bya/ /'khor lo bde mchog dpal rnal 'byor/ /rgyud kyi cho gas lha rnams ni/ /mnyes byas dkyil 'khor bri bya zhing / /sa yang yongs su brtag par bya/ /ri dang nags dang sman ljongs dang / /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dang ni/ /sngon nas grub pa'i dur khrod dang / /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs dang / /gang yang sems ni 'jug pa dang / /mdzes shing yid ni dga' ba ru/ /chu dang ba lang phyi bas byug⑤ /me tog sna tshogs rnam par dgram/ /dbugs dbyung mchog dang bar ma dang / /dri ni chu dang bcas par byug de /de la sogs pas mnye ba dang / /kun du rgya cher brdung ba dang / /shar dang byang du gzhol bas ni/ /sngags pa rnams ni dngos grub 'grub/ /dbus su mtho bas rgyal srid dam/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas dag thob/ /byang du mtho bas 'chi 'gyur cing / /nor rnams rab tu 'jig par byed/ /ji skad bshad pa'i ④shar mtho bas/ /rigs rnams rab tu zad par ⑤byed/ /dbus su dma' ba'i rang bzhin gang / /sgrub pa po ni 'joms dang ldan/ /de ltar mtshan nyid bcas pa yis/ /dpa' bo'i dbang po sogs pas mtshan / /sa yi mtshan nyid bstan pa'o// //de ltar sbyor ba 67byas mdzes pa'i/ /sa yi dbus su 'dug nas su/ /mdzes dkar ma mo zhes bya ni/ /bskul ba ⑦'di yis gsol ba gdab/ /dang po 2/sgra la sogs sngon gyis/ /rnal 'byor dmigs pa thams cad du/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /gnyis med ye shes la legs gnas/ /sa la reg pa'i phyag rgya dang / /mi shigs thig ler byas pa yis sor mos lan gsum bsnun nas (/ni/ /bkug nas mdun du 'dug par bsam/ /yan lag 11—724

rgyan rnams thams cad dang / /kha dog ser pos ①legs par mdzes/ /lag na bum pa thogs nas ni/ /bdag gis ci bgyi bka' spyod sga /mchod yon rkang bkru ②sogs byin la/ /gzi brjid can des ①'di ltar bya/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyirjo/ /spyod pa'i byed dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seṅge duskyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi ⑥sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khor bri/ /de skad lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /der ni thim par rnam par bsam/ /sa bslang ba'o/ /mgul rgyan gdu bu rna rgyan dang / /spyi bo'i 7stenor bus rnam par brgyan/ /mchod phyir thogs rgya thal ba yi/ /rgya yis yan lag kun nas brgyan/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /bsgoms 5nas bgegs rnams bsal bar bya/ /de nas rkang pa gnyis su yi ge hūṃ las 'bar ba'i rdo rje bsams ⑨la/ mig gnyis su ma dang ṭa las zla ba dang nyi ma bsams ⑩te/ rdo rje'i ⑪lta bas thams cad du bltas la/ lag pa g.yon gyis dril bu bzung zhing / /g.yas kyis rdo rje gsor ba la 'bad de/ kha ṭī ga la legs par 'khyud nas sa de na ⑫gnas pa 'dis bskrad par bya'o/ /sa phyogs 'dir sems can gyi don rtsom gyis ⑫lha dang / klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang 'byung po dang / yi dwags dang / srin po dang srin mo la sogs pa gang dag gnas pa'i sa'i bdag po myur du song shig /'di ltar dpal he ru ka'i bka' nos la myur ba nyid du song shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de la nga'i ye shes kyi rdo rje dang/ kha ṭī ga ⑫'dis spyi bo nas rnam pa brgyar dgas par bya'o zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs nas brtsams te g.yas nas lan gsum du bskor bar bya'o/ /11—725

bskal pa'i me lta bu'i 'od zer rkang pa'i 'og nas byung nas gdug pa rnams bsregs par gyur nas/ phan tshun byer bar gyur par bsam mo/ /g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba dang / /'khyud dang ku tsa pa yi dang / /ba ri ti dang swa ti ka/brid de ke shig kya la sogs/ /chags bcas tshul gyis sbyor bas ni/ /rol pa rab tu bya ba dang / /rol pa'i gom stabs bcas pa'am/ /gom pa brgyad pas 1gar bya'o/ /rkang pa bskyod dang lag pa bskyod/ /smin ma 'degs dang rab dgas 'brang / /cung zad ngo tsha'i mig zur dang / /brla rgyas blta 3snan sdug pa dang / /mig yangs gar ni byed 'gyur zhing / /kha yi pad+ma 'dzum dang bcas/ /cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'chang / /kun+da ltar dkar so yi phreng/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /sems can sgrol ba rmad du byung / /de la sogs pa'i rigar gyis ni/ /bgegs la sogs pa bskrad par bya/ /zhal bzhi la sogs sngags kyis ni/ /phur bu ra ba dra ba bya/ /mtha' snyedabyangs yig las byung ba yi/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin sa 6/ /yi ge bdun pa'i ྅sngags kyis ni/ /rdo rje'i lta bas bltas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa'i cha/ /nyes dang ldan yang dag par 'gyur/ /bgegs bsal ba'o// //nā da sogs pa'i gzugs las byung / /ri la sogs pa ji bzhin bsam/ /in+d+ra bhā la'i sa gzhi la/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid bsam/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 'jam pa la/ /ji bzhin gnas su rnam par bsam/ /ā li kā li la sogs las//dkyil 'khor du ni rnam par brtag /de la gtso bo'i gnas su ni/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung shes rab kyis 7/ /yan lag gnyis med 'dus gyur pa/ /pho brang mchog dpal rnal 'byor ma/ /gnyis su med par ji bzhin bsam/ /rang 11—726

bzhin mi gnas ye shes 'khor lo ni/ /dam tshig 'khor lor 1'di yis gzhug par bya/ /rkang pa gnon cing gyen du bltas nas ni/ /phe zhes bya ba'i sgra ni bsgrag par bya/ /phyogs bcur gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni dgug pa ste/ /dang por go cha ji bzhin pas/ /legs pa nyid du bsrung bar bya/ /mdzub gnyis mdud cing gung mo gnyis/ /sbyar te mthe bong rdo rje ni/ /brtan par sbyar la dpral ba yi/ /dbus su legs par gzhag khyapar bya/ /phyag rgya ma mo'i tshogs bskul nas/ /bskor zhing bskor zhing nges gzhug par/ /dam tshig 'khor lo bsam par bya/ /mkha' 'gro kun dang gnas bdag ni/ /yid kyis mkhar bsam yid gzhug bsam/ /sa yi 'jig rten dag phyogs gzhug /sa 'og lus ni kun la sbyar/ /rang mdog phyag sogs choyan lag 'khyud pa dang / /thams cad mchod cing phyogs su ma mo rnams/ /mtshams su brgyad po rnams dang sa yi ni/ /bdag po rnams kyang legs par bsam par bya/ /ye shes kyi 5'khor lo spyan drangs pa'o// //rang gi ming brjod gsang sngags rgyal/ /dang po oṃ dang hūṃ gnyis ldan/ /phaṭa dang yang dag sbyar ba ni/ /lha rnams ma lus pa yi yin/ /bar ma dbugs dbyung 6mchog dri chus7/ /mchod par rtag tu brtson pa dang / /cho ga'i rjes mthun thams cad mchod/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs bsam pa rang gnas dbus kyi phyogs su ni/ /yongs su bskor cing bshad pa yi/ /gsang sngags ji bzhin rim dang po/ /g.yon nas bskor zhing rang bdag dang / /tha dad phyi yi ske tog sogs/ / mchod par rtag tu brtson pa dang / /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rjes mthun 'gro/ /ma lus lhag par gnas bya zhing / /gsang sngags 11—727

rgyal po sngon 'gro bas/ /phyogs kun ma lus khyab pa dang / /ku tsa gnyis ni 'khyud pa yis/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs sum cu/ /rtsa bdun rnams bsams cho gas mchod/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ /khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /phag mo lhan cig yang dag ldan/ /gang du phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ kaslob ma la ni phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pa/ /nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi//rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /kun gyis byin gyis brlab du gsol/ /1dri zhim me tog phreng ba dang / /thod pa der ni lnga pa ste/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs kun la/ /bdug spos legs par dbul bar bya/ /de 'og rang gi dbugs dbyung bsam/ /cho gas brtul zhugs can zhugs 'ubya/ /lha la gsol ba gdab pa'o// //slob ma'i gtso bo la sogs pa/ /lhag par gnas bya mchod par bya/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga 'di/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i 1rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag kun gyis ⑩gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos 'a7byang chub shing drung du / /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med de/ /skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /11—728

dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob pa'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /dpa' bo'i ①yan lag las byung ba'i/ /sdom pa la sogs slob ma la/ /byang chub thob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /cho gas 'uthams cad sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo 1dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan ngukhrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa5/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /che ge dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung / /rang gi sro 'uta ni yi rgyun/ /yi ge bdun gyis ⑦ mngon bsngags pas/ /slob ma rnams ⑧ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /thigs pas ⑨kun du dgang bar rmyabya/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gis kun gyiklu/ /kha nas thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa yi cha/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung mchog /dpal chen kun gyi rang lha mo/ /mchod pa'i cho ga rjes su spyad/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can kyis kyang / /dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor lo mchod/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// //shes rab can gyis nang par sngar/ /thig gdab gnyis med ye shes las/ /byung ba'i dkyil 'khor kun bri'o/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid bzang dang ldan/ /yang dag ye shes de nyid shes/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung gsang sngags shes/ /khro 11—729

med gtsang la mkhas pa dang / /sbyor shes ye shes pha rol 'gro/ /thod pa las byas ①spyi bor bcings/ /yan lag thams cad rnam par byugs/ /lus la phyag rgya drug la sogs/ /kha ṭī ga ni lag na thogs/ /brgya byed pa yi phreng bas brgyan//he ru ka dpal ④rang byas te/ /'khor lo la bltas snying gar dgod/ /de ltar bdag nyid go bgos shing/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas brgyan nas ni/ /dngos grub chen po rab sprul ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri bar bya/ /de nas ro yi srad bu la/ /ma hā ru nyi ras brlan pas/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor gyi / /grong khyer dam pa'i thig gdab bo/ /khru gang pa la sogasarja zhing ④/ /ji srid bcu gnyis bcu drug par/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dbang phyug che/ /shes rab can gyis ra6thig gdab bo/ / dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs bsam pa ji bzhin srad bu 8lnga ru ni/ /rnam par phye ste bcos nas su/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung la sogs pa/ /spyan drangs nas ḍapeni de ru gzhug⑫ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtsa ba'i sngags dang gnyis med me⑪/ /pad+ma'i snod du legs gzhag rkoste/ /rang byung me tog dag gis mchod/ /ye shes thig ni bskyed nas su—/ /mkhas pas thig ni gdab par bya/ /sngon chad cho ga mthong gyur pas/ /ye shes thig ni gdab par bya/ /bla mas khu tshur gyis gzung zhing / /gcig gi mtha' ru slob ma yis/ /dbugs 'byen 'gro bar bsams nas su/ /thig gnyis dag ni legs par bsgril/ /gnyis med gnyis su med sngags kyis/ /bsgril nas de ni thig gdab bya/ /dz+dza dz+dza zhes pas legs btang zhing / /blo ldan rgyab nas 'gro bar bya/ /dang por shar dang lho ⑫yi ni/ /sgo dbus ji bzhin gnas nas su/ /lho ru mngon par phyogs nas kyang / /nam mkhar de bzhin thig 11—730

gdab bo/ /g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur gyis/ /lte ba'i phyogs su bzung nas su/ /shar du bltas nas dpa' bo yis/ /sa la tshangs pa'i thig gnyis gdab/ /thig skud dag ni 'debs pa'i tshehuste/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas la sogs 'gro don kyi①/ /khyod kyi (7dus ni yin zhes bskul/ /slob dpon nyid dang grogs kyis ni/ /g.yon nas bskor ba shin tu brtson4/ /rlung dang dbang ldan phyogs gnas dang 6ste/ /me dang bden bral phyogs gnas 9te/ /bla mas mtshalas su thig gnyis ni/ /me yi phyogs nas brtsams te gdab/ /byang du mngon par bltas nas ni/ /me yi phyogs su thig gdab bo/ /nub phyogs su ni kha bltas pas④/ /bden bral du ni srad bus bri/ /rlung gi phyogs su gnas pa dang —/ /lho phyogs su ni bltas pa yis(8)/ /nub kyi thig ni gang yin pa/ /brtul zhugs can gyi ⑨cho gas gdab/ /dpa' bos shar du bltas nas ni/ /byang gi thig ni gdab par bya/ /phyogs la sogs pa'i ⑩dbye shes nas/ /kun nas thig ni thams cad kyang / /man ngag ji ltar thob pa las/ /blo ldan ji bzhin thig gdab bo/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis nyu1ni rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed 'phyang bas mdzes/ /g.yer kha'i phreng ba'i dra ba can//mtshalas kyi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni nang rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis spras pa/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor thig gdab bo/ /de yi nang du pad+ma ste⑫/ /pad+ma'i rgyab tu 'khor lo bya/ /'khor lo gnyis pa de yi rgyab⑫ / /rdo rje phreng bas bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje 'khor lo cha mnyam par/ /rdo rje'i thig gis bskor bar bya/ /ge sar dang ni 'dab mar bcas/ /'dab ma bcu drug dag tu gnas/ /man ngag dag ni thob pa las/ /dkyil 'khor thig gdab kun shes 11—731

nas / /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ste/ /khyams ni de yi phyed du bya/ /sgo khyud dag ni sgo yi tshad/ /lha yi snam bu'i tshad de bzhin/ /mtshams kyi thig nas bskor ba dag /rta babs kyi ni gnas su bshad/ /ba dan dril bu'i 'od zer gyes / /brgyan par thams cad thig gdab bo/ /lcags ri'i mthar thug pa yi bar / /rdo rje'i phreng bas mngon bskor zhing / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor nang du ni/ /rim gnyis thig ni gdab par bya/ /tshon gyi sa ni de yi phyed/ /rtsa ba'i thig ni gdab par bya/ /dang por rdo 1rgyus thig sogs pas/ /thig rnams thams cad nges par bya/ /de yi steng du ye shes thig /kun nas yongs su brkyang bar bya/ /ye shes kyi 2thig gdab pa'o // //dur khrod rus pa'i phye ma dang / /de yi so phag yang dag ldan/ /de yi shing gi 'dab ma ni/ /rnal 'byor pas de'i tshon du sbyar/ /de yi sol ba'i phye ma dang / /ba bla dag dang de bsres te/ /kha dog lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /lnga po lngar 4ni sprul par bya/ /dur khrod sa gnas thams cad ni/ /dbang phyug chen po'i rgya 'di yis/ /ye shes thig ni ji bzhin du/ /brtul zhugs can gyis tshon bskyed bya/ /sems dag nang par langs pa5 nas ni/ /khrus ni ma lus 5byas nas su / /rgyud kyi yan lag ma lus pa'i/ /las ni dkyil 'khor dag tu brtsam/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni sgol byed pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi ྅gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam par grol/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam/ /slob dpon gyis nani dang por dgyeke /phyi nas kun du slob mas so/ /gnas lnga sogs par brtsams nas ni/ /ri mo lnga la rgyab tu'o/ /tshon dang bzo yi las byed pa/ /dmatshika 11—732

dang ni bslab pa sbyin/ /mthe'u chung gi ni sor kyi dpangs/ /drang la mtho bar yang dag bri/ /gal te ri mo mi mnyam pa'am/ /yo zhing dma' dang chad pas kyang / /ri mo dma' bas mi 'grub cing / /yon pos gdung ba skyed sgobyed la/ /chad pas slob dpon slob ma dag37 /gnyis ka 'chi bar shes par bya/ /de bas mtshan ldan ri mo ni/ /mtshan nyid kun gyis mtshan par bya/ /slob ma la sogs 'dir zhugs nas/ /dri yi chus ni rab gang bas/ /lus kun dbang ni bskur bya zhing / /gnod mdzes sngags kyi rig pas blud/ /yig bdun rnal 'byor bdag nyid can/ /skye ba bdun sogs sdig pa can/ /slob ma cho gas bkrus pas ni/ /sems ni shel dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /nang gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma ni / /gser la sogs pa'i phye mas so/ /pad+ma'i rgyab kyi 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad pa yang de dang mnyam/ /rdo rje ka ba'i rtsibs la ni/ /rdo rje'i thig gis bskor bar bya/ /mthing shun la sogs mdog gis ni/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo rab tu grags/ /de bzhin 'khor lo'i rtsibs dag kyang / /pad+ma'i ka bar yang dag ldan / /pad+ma'i thig gis bskor ba ni/ /gsung gi 'khor lo zhes sprul pa/ /byi ru la sogs mdog 'dra'i phyes⑩/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i las bya'o/ /sku yi 'khor lo rnam dgod pa(57/ /rtsibs brgyad snga ma de dang 'dra/ /de bzhin 'khor lo'i ka ba dang / /'khor lo'i thig gi ⑥dbye bar bya/ /mu tig la sogs phye ma yis/ /sku yi 'khor lo bri bar bya/ /ji ltar pad+ma la sogs cha/ /sgo yi cha yi kha dog ste/ /ri mo lnga sogs kha dog mdzes/ /ji ltar mdzes par ‘⑩rab tu brtaga'/ /tshon dgye ba'o// //de ltar sna tshogs zis pa yi(/7/ /gzhal yas khang mchog lha yi gnas/ /cho 11—733

ga mthong bas dang por ni/ /ji srid bshad bzhin rdzogs par bya/ /tshogs rnams kun gyis rab brgyan cing / /bde ba thams cad rab ster ba'o/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung la sogs ni/ /'khor lo gsum bdag nyid can sprul/ /mkha' spyod sa spyod ces bya dang / /sa 'og la sogs mi 'am ci/ /khā gdong la sogs brgyad po ni/ /rang gi stan la bzhugs par dgod / /ri yi rtse mor ge sar dang / /sna tshogs pad+mar ā li dang / /kā li ut+pa ṇi'i bzhi pa/ /thig le sgra las yang dag 'byung / /he ru ka dpal rgyal po che/ /shes rab yan lag gnyis med 'du/ /zhal bzhi zhal re spyan gsum pa/ /mgo dang dum bus rnam par brgyan/ /ljang dang dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /phyag ni bcu gnyis yang dag ldan / /g.yas brkyang nyapa yi rnam pas 37bzhugs/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs dar dpyang dang / /phyag gnyis dag gis 'khyud par mdzad/ /gzhan gnyis glang chen pags pa ste/ /dgra sta rtse gsum gri gug dang / /ḍa ma ru ni phyag g.yas na/ /kha ṭī ga dang de bzhin du/ /thod pa khrag gis bkang ba dang / /phyag na zhags pa dag dang mgo/ /bdud ni bzhi las rnam rgyal ba/ /phyag g.yon dag na bsnams par mdzad/ /yi dwags chen po kun khyab bo/ /pang na gnas pa'i phag mo ni/ /phyag gis 'khyud par mdzad pa las/ /gdug pa bdud kyi khrag 'chang zhing / /zhal nas khrag gi snyergyun 'dzag pa/ /khrag chen gyis byugs sku yan lag /chags dang bcas shing skra grol ba/ /thod pa'i phreng bas bcings pa yin/ /ha ha zhes bzhad spyan gsum sku/ /dum bu dang ni thod pas brgyan/ /g.yas na sdigs 'dzub rdo rje ste/ /bdud sogs kun la bsdigs yepar mdzad/ /mkha' 'grom ni mā ma tī/ /mdun gyi 'dab ma 'don churipar bzhugs/ /phyag bzhi skra ni grolab 11—734

la—/ /rtse mo lnga yis rnam brgyan pa/ /phyag rgya lnga sogs sku la mnga'/ /spyan gsum khro ba'i hūṃ mdzad cing / /sku mdog sngo la 'jigs pa che/ /ha ha zhes ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /thod pa'i cod pan lnga pa ste/ /dbu skra grol zhing 'jigs par mdzad/ /kha ṭī ga brten thod pa rnamasa'-ikye/ /rnal 'byor mtshon cha ḍā mar g.yas/ /phyag bzhi pas ni rnam par brgyan/ /g.yon nas bskor ba'i pad+ma la/ /khā ma zhes bya sgol mdzad ma'o/ /sku mdog ljang gu 'jigs pa che/ /ha ha zhes bzhad gcigs pa'o/ /rtse bran lalngas ni brgyan pa ste/ /dbu skra grol zhing 'jigs mdzad pa/ /spyan gsum pa la hūṃ mdzad cing / /kha ṭī ga brten thod pa bsnams/ /rnal 'byor mtshon dang ḍa ma ru/ /phyag bzhi pas ni rnam par brgyan//khaṇ+ḍa ro ni gos dkar mo/ /byang gi 'dab ma gnon pas bzhugs/ /sku mdog dmar mo shas cher 'bar/ /phyag bzhi 'jigs pa'i hūṃ mdzad pa/ /dbu skra grol zhing 'bar ba la/ /rtse bran lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /rnal 'byor snod dang kha ṭī ga /rnal 'byor mtshon dang ḍā gam ru/ /phyag rgya lngas ni brgyan pa dang / /spyan gsum 'og pag dag gis brgyan/ /nub kyi 'dab mar gzugs can ma/ /spyan ni sra ba'i bdag nyid can/ /sku mdog ser zhing cher 'bar ba/ /ha ha zhes bzhad 'jigs par mdzad/ /skra grol kha ṭī ga dang bcas/ /phyag bzhi dag gis rnam par brgyan/ /srun gsum hūṃ gis 'jigs par mdzad/ /rtse bran lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /phyag rgya lnga sogs sku la mnga'/ /rnal 'byor mtshon snod bsnams pa'o④/ /chu dang me dang rlung dang ni/ /sa yi khams dag tre7nyid yin no//grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'o/ /phyi dang nang na yang dag bzhugs/ /mtshams kyi cha yi pad+ma la/ /ma dang de bzhin pha dag dang / /rgyal po dang ni rgyal rigs 11—735

gnyis/ /mgo bo'i snod ni mchod byed pa/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /bu la sogs pas yang dag drangs/ /bkug ste 'khor lo'i nang du gzhug① /rnal 'byor can gyis rtag tu mchod/ /de la bu skyes rnal 'byor ma'i/ /'khor lo'i gnas ni bshad bya ste/ /pu zhes bya ba ni pukhra ra ma la ya ste/ thod pa'i dum bu can dang / rab tu phu)gtum ma'o/ /dzā zhes bya ba ni dzā lan+ta ra ste/ keng rus chen po dang / gtum mig ma'o/ /o zhes bya ba ni o ḍān te/ keng rus can dang / 'od ldan ma'o/ /a zhes bya ba ni arbu da ste/ mche ba rnam par gcigs pa dang / sna chen ma'o/ /de dag ni gnas so/ /go zhes bya ba ni go dā ba ri ste/ lha dgra dang / brtan pa'i blo can ma'o/ /ra ①zhes bya ba ni ra mi shwa ri ste/ 'od dpag med dang / mi'u thung ma'o/ /de zhes bya ba ni de bi ko ṭi ste—/ rdo rje 'od dang / lo ka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /mā zhes bya ba ni mā la be 5ste—/ rdo rje'i sku dang / shing grib ma'o/ /de dag ni nye ba'i gnas yin la/thugs kyi 'khor lo ste/ nam mkha' la rgyu ba yin no/ /kā zhes bya ba ni kā ma rū pa ste myu gu can dang / sa srung ma'o/ /o zhes bya ba ni oṭi ste/ rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /de dag ni zhing ngo / /tri zhes bya ba ni tri sha ku ṣ+pe ste/ dpa' bo chen po dang / rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /ko zhes bya ba ni ko sa la ste/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma'o/ /de dag ni nye ba'i zhing ngo / /ka zhes bya ba ni ka ling ka ste/ rab tu bzang po dang / mdog ljang ma'o—/ /la zhes bya ba ni lo pā ka ste rdo rje bzang po dang / shin tu bzang mo'o/ / de dag ni tshajo ha'o/ /ka zhes bya ba ni kāñci duste/ 'jigs byed chen po dang /rta rna ma'o/ /hi zhes bya ba ni hi mā la ya ste/ mig mi bzang dang / bya gdong 11—736

ma'o / /de dag ni u pa tshajo ha yin pas gsung gi 'khor lo ste/ sa la rgyu ba yin no / /pre 1zhes bya ba pre ta pu ri ste/ stobs po che dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /kṛ zhes bya ba ni kṛ ha de ba ste/ rin chen rdo rje dang / dum skyes ma'o / /de dag ni 'dus pa zhes bya'o/ /sau zhes bya ba ni sau rāṣ+ṭa ste/ rta mgrin dang / shoṇ+ḍi ni'o/ /su zhes bya ba ni su waṇ+ḍi dī nga/ ste/ nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /de dag ni nye ba'i 'dus pa can no/ /na zhes bya ba ni na gar ste/ dpal he ru ka dang / shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /si 2zhes bya ba ni sen+tu ste/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / stobs chen ma'o/ /de dag ni dur khrod do / /ma zhes bya ba ni ma ru de sha ste/ rnam par snang mdzad dang / /'khor los 4sgyur ma'o/ /ku zhes bya ba ni ku lu tā 5ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang 6/ brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /de dag ni nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /sku'i 'khor lo ste sa 'og na gnas pa yin no/ /sgo rnams ni khwa gdong can ma dang /'ug gdong can ma dang / khyi'i gdong can ma dang / phag gdong can ma'o/ /mtshams rnams su ni gshin rje brten 7ma dang / gshin rje'i pho nya mo dang /gshin rje mche ba ma dang / gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /grub pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /phyogs kun du ni rnam par gnas/ /pha rol phyin bcu dag pa del 7/ /sa bcu la ni rnam par bzhugs/ /te ru ka dpal rgyal po che/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag bzhugs/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /byang chub sems dpa' du ma'o/ /dkyil 'khor du lha dgod pa'o// //mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa dang / /sgo srung brgyad po ma 9gtogs pa/ /'khor lo gsum la thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa rnams ni phyag gnyis pa/ zhal 11—737

gcig pa ral pa'i thor tshugs dang dar gyis brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang spyi gtsug gi nor bu dang ldan pa 'og pag gis brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag gnyis kyis 'khyud pas/ rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ lha mo la gzigs shing sgos 'dzin pa'o/ /rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams ni/ rang gi bdag po'i sku mdog dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa ste/ dbu skra grol bas rnam brgyan pa/ /thod pa dang ni 'khyud pa dang / /gri gug dang ni sdigs mdzub can—/ /spyan gsum hūṃ gis 'jigs par byed/ /rtse bran dum bus rnam par brgyan/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs thams cad kyang / /g.yon nas bskor ba sngon 'gro ba/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gsum/ /'gro kun g.yon nas 'byung ba yin—/ /dkar min dkar dang dmar po ni/ /tha ma mchog dang bar ma ste/ /thams cad ji bzhin dgod pa ni/ /bla ma'i rim gyis drin yin no/ /kha la sogs pa brgyad po ni/ /mkha' 'gro la sogs dbye ba yis/ /zhabs kyis ro la gnon pa dang / /sna tshogs gzugs can bzhi po yin/ /thams cad khro bo rnam rgyal sogs/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad sprul pa yin/ /rdo rjes ①mtshan pa'i kha ṭī ga—/ /pad+ma'i sdod ni lnga can te/ /g.yas pas mtshon cha 'phyar ba ni/ /gdug pa thams cad des gnon pa'o/ /dpal ldan he ru ka sogs kun/ /g.yon gyis 'khyud cing nu ma 'dzin/ /lha rnams kyi phyag dang / sku mdog dang phyag mtshan te/byang chub kyi yan lag sum cu rtsa bdun du byas pa'o/ /nā da'i gzugs sogs sngon du 'gro ba dang / gos dang phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa dang / shes rab kyi yan lag dang / phur bu dang dra ba dang uli kā li zhes brjod nas/ rgyu sogs stong ①pa sngon 'gro ba/ /'jug pa sgra la sogs pa nas/ /ji srid bsdus pa'i rim 11—738

kyis so/ /'bad pa yis te de bzhin du/ /shes rab yan lag stan gyi steng ①/ /mgul rgyan gtsug tor dbu rgyan dang / /rna rgyan tshangs pa'i srad bu dang / /mgul par rgyan bcings mgo bor phreng/ /ska rags dang ni sel khrol sgra/ /ral pa cod pan dar dang ni/ /bcos ma'i sgra yis rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje pad+ma kha ṭī bcas/ /rde'u chung sgra dang hūṃ sgrogs shing / /dpa' mo ②kun dang rnal 'byor ma'i—/ /go cha gsum gyis brgyan pa yin/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rang gi bdag nyid gcig tu byas/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse ba'i/ /blo ldan bum pa mngon par bzlas/ /bum pa mchog ni bcu dag tu/ /de nyid kyi ni mtshan nyid gsungs/ /chu ni 'o mar yang dag bsre/ /chu chen chu chung bum pa dag /dri dang me tog sna tshogs pas/ /dbugs dbyung mchog dang bar ma yis/ /dri yi chus ni yang dag byug /kha ni 'dab mas yang dag brgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun kyis mkha' 'gro ma/ /cho ga bzhin du mngon par bzlas/ /mgul pa gos kyis rnam dkris shing / /rgyan ni mdzes pas rnam par brgyan/ /me tog phreng gis kun bskor ba/ /brgyad po dag ni sgo ru dgod/ /bum pa dgu pa dbus su'o/ /ma dang de bzhin pha dag dang / /rgyal po rgyal rigs gnyis kyis 1ni/ /bum pa chus ni rab tu dgang / /kha dog lnga pa'i gos kyis ni/ /brgyan cing mgul pa dkri bar bya/ /sna tshogs 'dab mas kha dgab cing / /rang byung me tog dag gis mchod/ /lho yi sgo yi logs su ni/ /ri mo'i dbus su gzhag ngapar bya/ /bla re dag ni bre bya zhing / /sna tshogs pa yi gos kyang bre/ /rgyal mtshan gdugs sogs dar rnams kyis/ /gnas dang gnas su rnam par brgyan/ /bum pa gzhag 5nas mchod pa ni/ /ji skad bshad pa bzhin du bya/ /rin chen gser gyis mdzes par 11—739

ni/ /dkyil 'khor kun du gtor bar bya/ /spos snod dag ni brgyad po dang / /mar me'i sdong bu de mnyam bya/ /til mar chen pos ①rab sbar la/ /spos ni lnga po sngon 'gro ba'o/ /sna tshogs me tog 'chang ba dang / /sna tshogs chang dang khu ba dang —/ /rol mo dag gis rab bkang zhing / / sna tshogs zhal zas lha bshos dang —/ /②sna tshogs rnal 'byor ma pang ①na/ /dri bzangs me tog sna tshogs ldan—/ /sna tshogs pa yi glu len cing / /sna tshogs gar gyis ④gar bzang byed/ /bkra shis sgra ni sna tshogs pa'i/ /dga' ston shrī te ru ka yi/ /spyod pa dang ni 'gro ba'i gnas/ /'dod pa rnal 'byor ma yi lam/ /sgo bzhi dag tu rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bo gnyis med dag gis mtshan/ /tshon chen la sogs gos dag gam/ /dar la sogs pa dag gis brgyan/ /phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa'i lus/ /rtse bran lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje dril bu'i yang dag 'khyud/ /sgo brgyad dag tu kha sbyar ⑤ro/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo bdag po kun/ /'khor los khye)sgyur ba'i rnal 'byor yin/ /sngar bshad rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /stan dang gnas ni rnam mdzes par/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dril bu 'phyang / /'khyud cing nu ma 'tshir ba dang —/ / snying ga rngo)mgo bo spyi gtsug dang / /mig sogs go chas rnam par brgyan//rdo rje sems sogs byin brlabs la/ /rnal 'byor chen po gnyis med gnas/ /byang chub yan lag sum cu bdun/ /byas shing go bgos mnyam par gzhag 8 /de ltar go bgos bdag nyid ni/ /sum cu gsum pas kyang mi shigs/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha mo dang dpa' mo rnams la mchod pa'o/ /rang nyid ji ltar grub par ni—/ /ye shes 'khor lo rnam par bsgom/ /bdag nyid kha sbyar byas pa yis/ /dam tshig la ni gzhug par bya/ /dang por spyan drangs phyag rgya yis/ /gyen du 11—740

dze gye sgra bsgrags la/ /mchog dang bar ma'i rnal 'byor ma/ /'jig rten khams la sogs pas dgug /rang nyid sku mdog phyag mtshan dbyibs/ /sngar bshad pa yi rgyan dang ldan/ /rang gi phyag mtshan brgyan bcas la/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs dag dang ldan/ /dam tshig 'khor lor zhugs nas ni/ /gnyis med ye shes bsgom par bya/ /he ru ka dpal la sog/sa kun/ /g.yas brkyang pas ni gdan la bzhugs/ /ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drang ba'o// //te ru ka dpal sogs 'khor lo'i/ /lha rnams phyi dang nang gis mchod/ /lha yi grangs bzhin 17blo ldan pas/ /mdzes pa'i gos kyang dbul bar bya/ /'khor los— sgyur dang dpa' bo ni/ /rang byung me tog gis mchod cing / /gdong ni dag par bkru bar bya/ /lho phyogs sgo nas dag pas so/ /gnyis med gnyis med sngags kyis ni/ /mngon par bzlas la byin gyis brlab/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro mas/ /khyad par du ni mngon par bzlas/ /sgo srung kun gyi rnalnga 'byor mas/ /ji srid brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par/ /sngags pas lha yi grangs bzhin du/ /ā li kā li zhes smra zhing / /byin gyis brlabs la mnyam par mchod/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams mnyes par bya/ /dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab pa'o / / //bya ba'i mchod pa'i khyad par ni/ /bha ra nyis ti ki bri ste/ /ki shig kya dang ar ba ti/ /gar rnams kun gyis gar bya'o/ /chags bcas mngon spyor tshul gyis ni/ /rnam par 'phyar bas rnam rol cing / /sgeg dang bcas pa'i gom stabs 4kyis/ /gom stabs brgyad kyis 5gar bya'o/ /'khyud sogs bya ba kun dang ni/ /'khyud cing nu ma btsir ba dang / / khya ba mchod pa'i khyad par gyis/ / 11—741

dang po rnal 'byor ma mnyes bya/ /nang gi bdag nyid sbyin sreg gis/ /skye bo dam pa kun 'dus bya/ /he ru ka dpal rgyal po che/ /mdza' ba thams cad yang dag 'dus/ /zhi ba'i chu las ①dngos grub ni/ /dam pa'i gnas ni rtag pa 'grub/ /rgyun chags la sogs thams cad dang / /bza' ba zhim po sna tshogs dang —/ /sha rlon dag gis khyad par du/ /sngags dang ldan pas sbyin sreg bya/ /oṃ sarba badz+ra ki bami ni bha k+ṣe sho dha ya gu hra badzī ṇi hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ mngon par bsngags shing byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /lto 9 —ba yis ni sbyin sreg mes/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /dpa' bo'i dbang sogs sum cu bdun/ /pad+ma'i lte ba ge sar la/ /ji bzhin las kyi rjes mthun par/ /lha yi bdag nyid dngos/ byas la/ /cho gas sbyin sreg kun byas na/ /brtag mi dgos par dngos grub 'gyur/ /bza' 'am yang na btung ba dag /brtul zhugs can ni ci za ba/ /mchog dang bar ma'i dbugs dbyung ba/ /bsam pa thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid lha ni lha yi mchog /bdag nyid lha ni lha dam pa/ /bdag gi gzugs la ma chags la/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs lta bur shes/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de las 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchod/ /de ltar 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /dge ba yongs su rgyas par 'gyur/ /las tshogs gang zhig bsams pa rnams/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /dkyil 'khor 4lasakyi nang gi sbyin sreg go/ /drug cu pa sogs bzar bcas pa'i/ /zan dron sha dang nya sha dang / /bar dang mchog gi lnga po yi/ /gtor ma 'bad de dbul bar bya/ /thod pa'i nang du legs bzhag ste/ /dang po phyag rgyas spyan drang ngo / /gyen du phe 11—742

gyi ①sgra sgogs shing / /mig dang gdong dang yan lag bsgyur/ /bkug cing bkug cing kun mchod la/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor mas spyan drangs②/ /rdo rje thal mo spyi bor dbye/ /reg par gyur na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dpa' bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /ji bzhin las la sbyar bar bya/ /mtshan mo skra grol gcer bu yis—/ /brtul zhugs can gyis gtor ma sbyin/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor bdag /des ni rnal 'byor ma rnams mnyes/ /gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /pha rol phyin pa'i rgya drug sogs/ /byang chub sum cu rtsa bdun nyid/ /gnas la sogs pa sa bcu dang/ /che mchog lha yi bdag nyid can/ /gdan du byas pa'i bdag nyid can/ /dbang bskur ba ni dam pa'o/ /dag dang ma dag 'dres pa ste//sgrub pa po ni mngon sum gnas/ /mnyes byed rnam par dag pa dang / /gsal byed yon tan ldan pa'i mi/ /de ltar phyi dang nang gi sbyin sreg bya/ /gtor ma'i bya ba dang / mchod pa'i bya ba'i las ma lus par byas pa'i rnal 'byor gyes gaslob ma ma lus pa'i tshogs kyi bdag ④nyid mngon sum du byas la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni bsrung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyu no de las gzhan/ /thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin/ /gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor bdagakhru /byang chub shes rab yan lag sprul//ma dang de bzhin pha dag dang / /rgyal po dang ni rgyal rigs gnyis/ /thod pa der ni legs bzhag pa/ /slob ma'i sdig pa 'jig byed pa'o/ /slob dpon khas ni dbang bskur ba/ /yig bdun kun mkhyen gyi slob ma/ /bu tshur zhes ni brjod bya zhing / /go cha che la sogs pas bsrung/ /rdo rje sems sogs pas go bskon/ /dar dpyang 0dag kyang bcing bar bya/ /sems can dman dang mchog dang ni/ /11—743

slob ma la sogs yid shes bya/ /dngos grub 'dod pas dngos kun gyis/ /dang por slob dpon mgu bar bya/ /slob ma yongs su brtag pa'o// //de nas slob ma sogs bya ba/ /lag pas lag pa bzung nas ni/ /shrī te ru ka ya bid ma 1te bibyā rā dzā ya rnyi ma he swā hā/ zhes bya bas dpa' bo bskul bar bya'o / /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /slob ma'i gsol ba'o/ /don dam smra ba'i seṅge rnal 'byor che zhes pa/ nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya bskyed pa 2nyon mongs gcod mdzad lha'i/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /de nas lho phyogs kyi sgor mngon du phyogs par byas la/ oṃ na maḥ1 ste hūṃ/ na maḥ④mi hūṃ / ma mo na maḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya bas sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas phyag bya ba sngon du 'gro bas lan gsum phyag byas la/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni pū dzo pa spru na ya āt+pa rgo byār+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni āt+pa dze+e badz+ra ḍā ki ni a dhi tidz+nyā treswā oṃ zhes bya bas lus thams cad kyis phyag byed du gzhug go/ /de nas g.yon phyogs su de snying gar thal mo sbyor du bcug la shar phyogs kyi sgo nas/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya kye.āt+pa ā+oṃ nīr+ya kruta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni āt+pa bye rna badz+ra khā mi rat+na a bhi ṣiñca tu rmā/ de nas byang phyogs kyi sgor thal mo de nyid dpral bar bzhag la phyag byed du gzhug ste/ oṃ sarba bī ra ⑨yo gi ni pū dza pra brta na ya āt+pa rgo nīr+ya ⑩ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni stom rgo nya/ badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ro hir+ya pra 11—744

brta ya rmā/ de nas nub phyogs kyi sgor thal mo de nyid mgor bzhag la phyag byed du gzhug ste/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni pū dza karma ka ra ṇa ya tsam rna rīr+ya ①ta yā mi/sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni tsam badz+ra rū ji nir+ya karma ku ru rmā/ phyag bzhi'o/ /de nas lhor ni phyogs ②byas te/ /slob ma'i lag nas bzung nas ni/ /bde mchog sdom pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /thams cad brjod de sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs 'ongs pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis gzung (kyebar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes grags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis gzung ④bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang lan drug tu / /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba'i jeg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus bzung skye/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi—/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi ni/ /gang phyir rgyud las gsungs pa rnams/ /blo chen khyod kyis rtag tu ni/ /dngos grub phyir ni bsrung bar bya/ /dam tshig bsgrags 6pa'o/ /slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i//byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs 11—745

rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na sed pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng ①nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi gtang ①ngo / /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen pa ①yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po pelas byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag (genyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gye phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma bsgral dub ni bsgral bar babyi/ /ma grol ba ni dgrol bar bgyi—/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /sdom pa gzung ba'o/ /deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis ⑦rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la dpal te ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ he ru ka dpal 11—746

deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /de nas dam tshig blud pa ni/ /ga bur tsan+dan ldan pa dang / /bde ba'i dra tog chur bcas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /slob ma blo gros brtan pa la/ /blangs te rgyun 7gyis de la sbyin/ /thob byāpa legs par sbyangs ༄ 1nas ni/ /gzi mdangs bcas pas d+ngha'adi skad brjod/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'job/ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ tod ka ṭha ṭha ri57 hūṃ/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi du6dpal he ru ka nga nyid yin gyis/ gang 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya'o/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /khyod mi bde ba ma spongs —par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byen gyis rlobs shig dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab ldupar mdzod cig ces smrar gzhug go/ /thang chu lnga rtsi legs sbyar ba'i/ /bskus shing gos ni legs brdungs dang / /bye la'i stug pa nyid dang ni/ /gu gul lhan cig sbyar nas ni/ /pad+ma'i snod du gzhag nas su/ /yi dwags me yis gdung bar bya/ /gnyis med gnyis med sngags kyis ni/ /'gyeng khyabacas 'dug ste gzi ldan pa/ /sngar bshad rgyan dang ldan pa dang / /de bzhin go cha bgos nas ni/ /'khor lo kun gyi dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma rnams de snying gzhug /g.yas brkyang pa la legs bsdams pas/ /gnyis med sngags ni brjod nas ni/ /gdug pa de dang gsang sngags kyis/ /skad cig de nyid dag la 'jug /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā be sha hūṃ/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ⑩ya bid ma he bibyā rā dzā ya bye ma he swā hā/ zhes bya ba 11—747

'dis dpa' bo bskul bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa gzung ①ba yis/ /mig phye nas ni blta bar bya/ /he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi pya / /mig 'byed par ni bsgon par mdzad/ oṃ badz+ra na 1tra ya a ba ha ra pa ṭa lo byāḥ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes//sngags dang phyag rgyas byen gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub phun tshogs khyod mngon 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang //gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyes/ /gang du me tog lhung gyur ba/ /de yi gnas sogs bstan par bya/ /slob ma gzhug pa'o// //sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar gzhug④ /gnyis med gnyis med pang na gnas/ /brtan g.yo kun gye bdag nyid can/ /spyod dang grol ba rab stsol ba/ /kun mkhyen kun mdzad gtso bo ste/ /dpa' bo che la bu khyod ltos/ /rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa'i tshogs/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma lnga po/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs kun—/ /'khor lo mkha' la spyod pas bskor/ /rab gtum mo sogs yang dag 'khyud/ /gnyis po thugs kyi sprul pa yin/ /myu gu can la sogs pa kun/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad gnyis su med/ /gsung ni rnam dag ngo bo yis mi yi 'jig rten dag tu khyab/ /stobs po che sogs pang gnas pa/ /grub pas sa 'og gnas pa yin/ /sku yi sprul par bshad pa ste/ /chags pa kun gyis 'urjes su chags/ /te ru ka dpal sogs 'khor lo⑥/ /g.yon nas 'khyud cing nu ma 'dzin/ /sku gsum zhes bya'i sprul pa ste/ /'bring dang mchog dang tha ma'o khu la sogs pa brgyad po yi/ /gzugs ni sgyu yis yang dag bstan/ /khro bo rnam rgyal la sogs brgyad/ /byang chub sum cu rtsa bdun sprul/ /mkha' la spyod dang sa 11—748

la spyod/ /sa 'og dag gi 37ma mo brgyad/ /brgyad gnyis mchod pa'i lha mo yis / /lha rnams de nyid mtshan pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid do / / //de nas slob mas bla ma yi/ /zhabs la dad pas phyag 'tshal te/ /thal sbyar yon ni phul ba yis/ /dbang bskur don du gsol ba gdab/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bsgur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas sogs/ /de bzhin bdag la de stsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i//dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid/ /'jug pa sgo yi lho phyogs su/ /he ru ka dpal bdag nyid sems/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng du ni/ /seng ge'i khri sogs la bzhag ste/ /slob ma gnyis med sbyor bye ldan pa/ /sna tshogs stan la bzhag nas ni / /gnyis med ye shes sems ldan gyis/ /me tog dbang bskur la sogs pa/ /thams cad cho ga bzhin sbyin zhing / /dkyil 'khor lus nang chud par bya/ /phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa'i lus/ /he ru ka dpal bdag nyid sprul/ /spyod dang brtul zhugs brtan pa dang / /de bzhin gnyis med tshangs spyod bstan/ /steng du gdugs dkar bzung nas ni/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyisangu/ /bkra shis sgra yi snyegang ba yis/ /glu len rol mo snyan pa yi⑥/ /te ru ka dpal bdag nyid sprul/ /rab tu 'bad de mchod par bya/ /dbang bskur bar gsol ba'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yis yungs kar ni/ /cho ga bzhin du yongs bzlas pas/ /gsang sngags brjod cing brdeg pa ste/ /he ru ka dpal sogs gnyis med/ /bzlas nas dkyil 'khor thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor glu yis glu len cing / /gnyis 11—749

med ye shes gzigs pa rnams/ /thams cad cho ga bzhin dbang bsgur/ /yang na sngar gye cho ga yis/ /rnam rgyal bum pa bteg hu)par bya/ /'dab ma'i rtse mos blangs nas ni/ /snga ma bzhin du dbang bskur zhing / /gsang sngags nyi shu gnyis pa dang / /sngar bsnyen pa yi sngags kyis ni/ /te ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /brtag mi dgos par 'grub par 'gyur/ /yang na nus pa med gyur na/ /'khor lo kun gyi lha rnams ni/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes can/ /nam mkha'i khams ni thams cad dgang / /sngon mdzad pa yi shugs gyis ni/ /dgyes pa chen pos legs byon te/ /he ru ka dpal la sogs pa/ /bsgoms nas thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /bkra shis glu yi rnam pa dang / /chang dang sha khu'i dga' ston gyis/ /rnal 'byor ma kun dpa' bo rnams/ /gnyis med ye shes dag gis sprul/ /lha yi rigs kyis mtshan pa yi/ /me tog ji bzhin gtor bar bya/ /me tog lhung ba blangs nas ni/ /slob ma'i mgo la bcing bar bya/ /'dab ma'i rtse dang lag gnyis kyis/ /sngags pas bum pa bteg nas ni/ /lus nang spyogatogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /cho ga bzhin du kun dbang bskur/ /de 'og rnam rgyal bum pa dang —/ /dril bu sgra sgogs glu yis ni/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma sogs kun/ /bsgoms la thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /chu yi skedabang bskur byin pa yis/ /sdig pa thams cad bkru bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje rgya gram mgor/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi④/ /dar dpyang dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃsarba budha ḍā ki byā ye badz+ra waṇ+ḍi m+bi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā—/ zhes brjod la 'khor lo thams cad kyi dpa' bo la sogs pa brjod do/ /sngags kyis ⑤bskul ba'o/ /lag tu rang mtshan de nyid dang / /mtshan ma'i 11—750

dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ / 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod ni dbang bskur ro/ /kyede nas 'dir rang gi mtshan ma'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya ste/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a bye pa ti s+ho a bhe ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya ste/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje stems tshul bdag po'i bdag /rdo rje'o/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /dril bu'o/ /rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud/ /g.yon bsnyems pa dang sgos gnon 'chang / /gnyis med gnyis rnged rnal 'byer bdag /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlab/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis sngags kyis ni/ /sngags kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a bye pa ti ste a bhi ṣiñca mi/ shrī he ru ka nā byem a bye ṣe ka ta zhes bya ba dang / shrī'i sgra dang bcas pas ming gi dbang bsgur ba sbyin par bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /te ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sedhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa two dha ra yā mi hūṃ ha ha ha ha ho/ /rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so// //kha ṭī ga dang ḍa ma ru bzung ste/ te ru ka dpal kha ṭī ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭī rdo rje bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgogs shing / /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /11—751

dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /dbang bskur ba bdun no/ /deng ①nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo'i tshogs/ /shes rab thabs kyi snyems chen gyis/ /gar mchod bde ba'i dga' ston byus/ /gar ro—/ /sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang 6// /sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /des ni (9bral bar mi 'gyur te④ / /phreng ba de ni rgyan yin no/ /phreng ba'o/ /lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /khyod kyis glu ni blang bar bya/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma de dang / /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /glu'o/ /khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi phya/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bsgo/ /dri'o/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par 'gyur/ /spos so//chos kyi mig ni legs gsal ba/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldongs byas pa/ /ye shes sgon mas snang bar gyis/ /mar me'o/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ༄6ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe tra 97a pa ha ra pa ṭa lo dhīḥthur ma'o/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /ngo bo med cing gnas med par/ /de ltar chos 'di shes gyes la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye /me long ngo —/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi83/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /'khor 11—752

lo'o—/ /khyod kyis hu)the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni / /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun du gang bar gyis/ /dung ngo / /de dag ni chos kyi de kho na nyid do/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar byed dang gnod sogs dang / /gsod dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni grub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ④ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar bsgrub par gyis①/ /gnang ba'o/ /nang par sngar langs sems bdag nyid/ /ma lus las ni byas nas kyang / /bsrung dang bza' la sogs pa yi/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid can bsrung ngo / /lus dang srog la ltos jimed par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung / /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzlas par bya—/ /gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'byung po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re bsrung bar ni/ /gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lor gnas/ /tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ /chang dang sha sogs gang ci'ang rung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /thams cad gnyis med pang na gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya//sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang mi spang zhing / /mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom 57par mi bya'o—/ /dam tshig rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing —/ /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang / /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /11—753

bdag gi ma spyod bu yin te/ /ji srid byang chub byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyangs①/ /gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i/ /babe+eb pa blangs pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /nā a+yo da la sogs sngon 'gro bas / /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrung / /dam tshig de la rtag tu bsrung / /de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i gnas/ /spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'byung 'gyur/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /ji ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba'o// //'dir dbang bskur ba'i slob ma ni/ /lag nas bzung nas gzi bcas pas / /gnyis med ye shes bla med pa/ /ma lus don ni kun brjod bya/ /gnyis med ye shes sems ldan la/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /tshangs par spyod la rtag mnos la/ /'dod pa lnga ni spyad par gyis/ /gnyis med la gnas zas la ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs brda/ /gnyis med pa dang thogs med pa / /dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod pa bya/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug legs spyad cing / /tshangs par spyad pa'ang 4de bzhin no/ /khro ba med pa'i rgyun spyad pa/ /sgrub pa pos ni yongs su bsrung / /rtag tu sgrub la gnas nas ni/ /yul kun la ni rnal 'byor pa'i/ /gnyis lachomed grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mi brtan srog ni ji srid par / /bu khyod kyis ni bsgrub par bya/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci dga' bar ni longs spyod ciga'u /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor cher/ /bsams nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang // /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi gnas/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni 11 —75

sdig med pas/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o / /bsrung ba'i dam tshig go// //g.yon pa yis ni chos gos mtha'/ /g.yas kyis mi 'jigs dbugs 'byin pa / /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /'khor lo thams cad rnam par gnas/ /te ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin/ /mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /shrī he ru ka nā ma ta thā ga ta sidhi sa ma ya ste zur bhu ba swaḥ nya—/ /gang la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis don yod par grub pa'i phyag rgyas gnas pa las mchog tu gsang ba'i cho gas mgrin gcig tu rgyal ba rnams kyis lung ston par mdzad do/ /lung bstan pa dang gzengs bstod pa'o// //khams gsum gyi 1ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por bstan pa dang / /deng ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yis/ /deng ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin/ /dbang ni bskur ba tsam kyis ni/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yis/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /dbugs dbyung ba'o / / //rta dang glang po shing rta nor/ /nor bu byi ru mu tig sogs/ /yon gyi mchog ni blangs pa rnams/ /phyag byas nas ni dbul bar bya/ /de nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyod la bdag ni phul ba lags/ /rang gi slob mar gyur pa dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /slob ma gus pa med pa yis/ /dngos 11—755

grub ring bar the tshom med/ /mos pa kun gyis slob ma yis/ /dang ngo/ra yon gyi ①bya ba yin/ /gal te lha ni mnyes 'dod na/ /'bad de bla ma mnyes par bya//dpa' bo ji bzhin rig de bzhin/ /rig pa ji bzhin bla ma 'dra/ /dpa' bo rig dang bla ma la/ /mchod pa'i 'bras bu mnyam pa yis/ /slob dpon gyi ni yon yin no/ /de bas 'dir ni mdor bsdus nas/ /me tog ldan zhing shin tu babe+ebasacha/ /shin tu gsang ba'i sa phyogs ni/ /khams lnga dang ni yang dag ldan//phye mar byas te de thams cad/ /rdo rje lam du byug par bya/ /kun du dga' la sogs pa bzhi/ /'khor lo kun bdag rnal 'byor ldan/ /'dod chags chos las byung ba'i mgon/ /chags pa kun gyis rjes chags pas/ /pad+ma'i snod du lag gzhag ①ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni 'di skad smra/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang —/ /dmangs rigs thar gnas bud med kun/ /gus dang bcas pas mchod pa dang / /gnyis med tshul byis tsum ④pa na/ /dpa' bo khyod ni spror 5gyur tam/ /smras (6)shig dpa' bo bde ba che/ /ci gsungs dam tshig bsten par ni—/ /lha mo bdag gis byed par nus/ / pad+ma rgyas par byas nas ni/ /skra bshigs gos dang bral byas nas(7/ /me tog chun (7ldan dpa' bo yis/ /rnal 'byor ma la rdo rje sbyin/ /deng po)nas brtsams te bu khyod ni/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos 'gro don gyis/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang / /dmangs rigs tha ma dag spyad cing / /bha ga pad+mar tsum pa na/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni bsgrub par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rkang g.yon ni/ /lung bsgo bar ni spyi bor gzhag bla /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpa' bo/ /gnyis med ye shes sems ldan la/ /dpa' bo las byung byang chub sems/ /rgyun gyes dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /'di ni byang 11—756

chub 'grub rnal 'byor/ /khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can/ /he ru ka dpal bdag sbyor bas/ /yang dag bde ba myong bar gyis/ /gnyis med ye shes dbang bskur ni/ /gsang ba kun la sogs par bshad/ /'di dag thams cad gsang stib che/ /dbang bskur ba ni mchog gi gnas/ /yon dang dad pa sngon 'gro bas/ /der ni phyag rgya gtad par bya/ /de nas ji skad bshad pa yi lda7/ /cho gas sbyin sreg las bya zhing / /rnal 'byor ma la gtor ma sbyin/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni mchod 'grub 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing sogs zhing rnams la/ /khyad par du ni sbyin la spyod/ /dmangs rigs stong phrag gnyis dag kyang / /bram ze gtsang ma gcig dang 'dra/ /bram ze stong phrag gnyis dag ni/ /dge slong gcig dang rab tu sbyar/ /dge slong stong phrag gnyis dag ni/ /rdul med pa ni gcig dang mnyam/ /rdul med stong phrag gnyis dag ni/ /ye shes ldan pa gcig dang sbyar/ /ye shes ldan pa stong phrag gnyis/ /slob dpon gcig dang mnyam par brtag /de ltar sbyin pa'i zhing byas nas/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag tu sbyin/ /rnal 'byor rtsa ba'i chos la ni/ /zhing bzang po la sa bon btab/ /mtshams med pa dang sdig can yang / /tshon rtsi mthong bas grol bar 'gyur/ /mngon par zhugs pa tsam gyis ni/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /sbyin bdag bzang po rnal 'byor pa/ /rim gyes myur du byang chub 'thob/ /me tog chu yi dbang bskur dang —/ /cod pan rdo rje bdag po dang / /ming dang gsang sngags brtul zhugs dang —/ /gnang 4dang dam tshig spyod pa dang / /de bzhin lung bstan dbugs dbyung dang / /gsang dang phyag rgya gtang ba dang / /dbang bskur 'di rnams thob pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu mchod/ /dbang bskur ba bcu bzhi 11—757

pa'o / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi logs su ni/ /bskor la de nas 'jug par bya/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa bzung 3snanas ni/ /gnyis med ye shes ngal bso'o/ /tshon la sogs pa'i dngos po kun/ /nang par tho rangs bsdu bar bya/ /bsdus nas/ gser gyi bum par ni/ /bcug nas chu bo chen por dor/ /bum pa thams cad bsdus nas ni/ /sngon bzhin du ni dga' ston bya/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga sogs dang / /sbyar bas sa ni byug par bya/ /sngar gyi rdzas kyi lhag ma rnams/ /gnyis rnged ye shes sbyin sreg bya/ /mdza' bo sdug dang rigs mthun bcas/ /snod gyur skye bo gnyis med dang / /bkra shis glu yi rnam pa dang / /rdo rje dril bus rol nga/ bya / /srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags 'dul bar ldan/ /'od zer rdon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dpar ldan/ /he ru ka dpal sngags pa lhan cig gar byed do/ /ha ha hi hi hu hu ho/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon chen po brtul zhugs spyod pa nag po pas mdzad pa rdzogs so / / //rgya gar gyi mkhan po budha shrī shārnyi dang / lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur/ slad kyis 4paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ga ya 5dha ra dang / lo tsā ba 'gos lhas 6btsas kyis bcos te gtan la phab pa'o// //11—7bye8

'gor gyi cho ga bzhugs/1༄gro/ /bcom ldan 'das ḍa 7rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung 'gro ba'i mgon/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnyis med la/ /phyag 'tshal dkyil 'khor spyod pa yis/ /brtul zhugs rim pa'i bsnyen pa bshad/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog pa dang / /mtha' dang spyi ni sbas pa dag /gang yang shes nas cho ga 'di/ /bdag gis thams cad bshad par bya/ /sgra dang sgra nyams brda dang ni/ /sdeb sbyor mtshan nyid spangs pa yi/ /'khor lo mchod pa'i cho ga gsal/ /de ni bdag nyid dran phyir bya/ /phyi rol bstan chos sun 'byen pa/ /gang gi btad mo 'dra zhing mtshungs / /don la rton pa'i don gnyer ba'i/ /spyod dang thar ba rang dga' yin/ /legs par brtags pa'i slob ma la/ /slob dpon gyis ni dkyil 'khor bri/ /'jam zhing snyan par smra ba dang / /snying rje la sogs phan sems ldan/ /thos dang klog la sogs la rtson/ /gsang ba'i chos 1)1—763

la lhag dang ldan/ /rtag par rgyun du bla lge la stigus/ /slob ma de ni yongs su gzung / /da ni dngos grub ma lus pa'i/ /sgrub byed ye shes bshad bya ste/ /lha ni mnyes par ma byasasde/ /bdag nyid rnam par sun 'byin yin/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs 'khor lo'i/ /sngags rnams mnyes la rab brtson pas/ /dpa' bo'i snying po'i gsang sngags ni/ /khri phrag gsum du bzlas brjod bya/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo'i/ /khri phrag gnyis ni bsnyen byas shing / /bya rog gdong sogs rnam pa brgyad/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma gzhi 'ayi/ /stong phrag lnga dang lnga brgya ni/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba ste/ /bdag gis ye shes dkyil 'khor ni/ /sngon du bsnyen pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang 'dod dbang bskur rjes gnang ba'i/ /bla ma nyid kyis bri bar bya/ /'khor lo'i yo byad phun tshogs pa'i—/ /slob mas de la gsol ba gdab/ /'khor lo mchod pa'i rim ji bzhin/ /spyod kyis thams cad 'byor gyur tam/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma dga' ba/ /gus pa yis ni byed nus sam/ /gal te dpa' bo gzi brjid can/ /thams cad du byed nus smras nas/ /de nas dpa' bo chen por 'dir/ /shes rab yan lag gnyis med 'dus/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /'khor lo kun la rnam par bzhugs/ /dang po gnas ni khyad par du/ /de la 'bad pas btsal bar bya/ /sems can don bya'i rgyu ru ni/ /bdag gis byang chub la rab gzhag /da ni dngos grub thams cad kyi/ /yon tan gnas ni bshad bya ste/ /shin bkod dka' dur khrod chen po'i/ /mi bzad drag shul can/ ro langs dang ni srin po rnams dang yi dwags sgra sgogs pas/ ces spyang pe zhes sgra 'byen pa yis khyab pa'i sa dag gam/ bsgrub pa po'i yid ni brtan par rung ba'i yul gzhan du/11—764

'jigs pa dang bral yongs su dag pa'i blos/ /rnam rtog dra ba ma lus bsal byas te / /byams dang snying rje'i rgyun ①pa'i lus/ /'dres med rnal 'byor pas ni bde bar gnas/ /sems can gcig tu gdug cing drag /sdug bsngal dang ni las kyis gzir/ /stong dang snying rje'i snying po yis/ /byang chub la bzhag yid la bya—/ /kye ma sems can sdug bsngal zhing / /kun rtog la ni mngon par zhen/ /de'i rtog pa gzhom phyir bdag /dpal ldan he ru kar rang bya/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnas dang ldang ba nyer dang ni/ /'jug dang rdzogs pa nyid dag dang —/ /byin gyis brlabs dang dbang bskur dang / /ting 'dze+en mchod pa nye bar bsnyu/ /yang dgo ye shes rgyud shes shing / /he ru ka dpal gsang sngags shesaske/ /khro ba med cing gtsang la brtson/ /sbyor shes ye shes pha rol son/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung yang dag bzhugs/ /bde zhing rang dbang bdag nyid can—/ /skye ba bye ba stong phrag du/ /gsang ba'i ye shes kyis bskul ba/ /dman la mos pa'i sems can rnams/ /mthong na spyod pa'i tshul la gnas/ /sems can de dag gdon bya'o zhes/ /snying rjes non pa'i sems dang ldan/ /khrag 'thung dpal zhes brjod pa'i/ /sdom pa bza' dang ltung ba yi/ /dam tshig skyong zhing sten byed par/ /bu byed ci dga' spro gyur tam/ /skye dang skye bar sdig bgyis pa/ /khyod kyis spyan sngar bshags par bgyi/ /dpa' bo 'khor lo sdom pa'i—/ /sdom pa so sor skyang bar bgyi/ /slob ma'i gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /de nas 'dir yang dpa' bo ches/ /bsnyen phyir sngar sbyar byas nas ni/ /sems can sgol bar byed don du/ /dam pa'i sems ni sngon du bya/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i/ /rgyud chen cho gas lha rnams ni/ /mnyes bya dkyil 'khor 11—765
