bri bya'i phyir/ /sa yang yongs su brtag par bya/ /ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs dang —/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dang ni/ /sngon du grub pa'i dur khrod dam/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /gang kun sems ni 'jug pa dang / /mdzes shing yid ni gang dga' bar/ /sa la ma lhung lci bas byug /sna tshogs me tog rnam par bkram/ /bar ma mchog dang dbugs 'byung dang / /dri dang chu dang bcas pas mchod/ /der ni sa la sogs pa mnye/ /kun tu rgya cher legs par bcag /shar dang byang du gzhol bar ni/ /sngags pa rnams kyi dngos grub 'gyur/ /dbus su mjo bas rgyal srid dam/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas dag thobaske/ /byang du mtho bas 'chir 'gyur ram/ /nor rnams rab tu 'jig par byed—/ /ji skad bshad pa'i shar mtho bas/ /myur du rigs rnams zad par byed—/ /dbus su dma' ba'i mtshan nyid gang / /sgrub pa po ni 'joms par byed—/ /de ltar mtshan nyid bcas pa yis/ /dpa' bo dbang pos sogs pas mtshon/ /sa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de la sbyar ba mdzes byas pa'i/ /sa'i dbus su 'dug nas su/ /nor 'dzin zhes bya'i ma mo ni/ /bsgul la 'di yis gsol ba gdab/ /dang po sgra sogs sngon gyi ni/ /rnal 'byor dmigs la thams cad bsdu//dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /gnyis med ye shes la legs gnas/ /sa la reg pa'i phyag rgya dang / /mi shig thig ler bcas pa yi sor mo lan gsum bsnun nas ni/ /bkug nas mdun du 'dug par bsam/ /yan lag rgyan rnams thams cad dang / /kha dog ser pos legs par mdzes/ /lagan bum pa thogs nas ni/ /bdag gis ci bgyi bka' stsol smra/ /mchod yon bka' bsgo sogs byin la/ /gzi brjid can des 'di ltar bya/ /skyob pa sangasargyas 11—766

thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la//lha mo khyod ni dbang 51du 'gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyobs pa yis/ /ci ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi stobs/ /rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khor bri/ /de skad lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /der ni thim par rnam par bsam/ /sa la gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /mgul rgyan gdu bu rna brgyan dang / /spyi bor nor bus rnam par brgyan/ /mchod phyir thogs bdag thal ba'i/ /phyag rgyas yan lag kun rnams brgyan/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /bsgoms nas bgegs ni bsal bar bya/ /de nas rkang pa gnyis su yi ge hūṃ las 'bar ba'i rdo rje dang / mig gnyis su ma dang ta las zla ba dang nyi ma bsams te/rdo rje'i lta bas thams cad du bltas la/ lag pa g.yon gyis dril bu bzung zhing /g.yas kyis rdo rje gsor ba la 'bad cing khā hūṃ ga legs par 'khyud nas/ sa de na gnas pa 'dis bskul bar bya'o/ /sems can gyi don byed par rtsom gyis/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / 'byung po dang /sha za dang / yi dwags dang / srin po la sogs pa gnas kyi bdag po gang su yang rung ba ༷da byer cig /myur du song shig /'di ltar dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos nas/ myur du song shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de la nga'i rdo rje 'bar ba dang kha ṭī ga 'dis/ spyi bo rnam pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyi bar du brjod do/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs nas brtsams te/ g.yas nas lan gsum bskor bar bya'o/ /bskal pa'i me lta bu'i 'od zer gyis rkang pa nas byung nas/ 'dug pa rnams bsregs par gyur na // phan tshun 'bros par gyur par bsam mo/ /g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba dang / /ku tsa bi ra' 11—767

'khyud pa dang / /ba ra ti dang sa tī kri/ /'bye te k+ṣe shig kya la sogs/ /chags bcas tshul gyi sbyor ba ni/ /rol pas rab tu 'phyang ba dang / /rol pa'i gom stabs bcas pa'am/ /goms pa brgyad pas gar bya'o/ /rkang pa bskyod dang lag pa bskyod/ /smin 'degs rab dga'i rjes su 'brang / /cung zad ngo tsha'i mig zur dang / /brla' rgyas bltas na sdug pa dang / /mig yangs gar ni byed 'gyur zhing / /kha'i pad+mar 'dzum dang bcas/ /cung zad mche ba ma mchu dmar//kun dha khya)zla ltar dri med pa'o/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /sems can sgol ba ①rmad du byung / /de la sogs pa'i gar gyis ni/ /bgegs la sogs pa skrag par byed/ /zhal bzhi la sogs sngags kyis ni/ /phur bu ra ba dra ba bya/ /mtha' yi dbyangs yig las byung ba'i/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin pa/ /yi ge bdun pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /rdo rje lta bas bltas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gyis ni sa'i cha/ /nyes dang ldan yang dag par 'gyur/ /bgegs bsal ba'o/ /sgra'i gzugs la sogs las byung / /re la sogs pa ji bzhin bsam/ /in tra ni la rang bzhin sar/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid bsam/ /sna tshogs 'dab ma 'jam pa la/ /ji bzhin gnas su rnam par bsam/ /a li ka li la sogs las//dkyil 'khor ru ni rnam par brtag /de la gtso bo'i stan la ni/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung shes rab lus/ /gnyis med du gyur gzhal yas khang / /mchog tu dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /gnyis su med par ci bzhin bsam/ /rang bzhin mi gnas ye shes 'khor lo ni/ /dam tshig 'khor lor 'di yis gzhug par bya/ /rkang pa mnan cing gyen du blta/ /gyen du phe zhes sgra sgrogs pa/ /phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams gnas pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dgug /dang 11—768

por cho ga ci lta ba bzhin du sngags dang bcas pas so/ /mdzub mo btud byas gung mo rtser sbyar te/ /maze bong rdo rje brtan por rab sbyar la/ /dpral ba'i phyogs su legs par bzhag byas te/ /phyag rgyas ma mo'i tshogs rnams bsgul bar bya—/ /bskor zhing bskor zhing bsgyur bas bkug nas ni/ /dam tshig 'khor lo mchog la sems kyis bcug /mkha' 'gro ma dang gzhan gyi bdag po'i/ /nam mkha'i yid ni zhugs par legs bsams la/ /sa'i 'jig rten de dag mkha' phyogs bzhugs/ /sa 'og lus skyes kun la sbyang bar bya/ /rang mdog phyag sogs yan lag 'khyud pa dang / /rang gi rigs dang mthun par thams cad mchod/ /phyogs dang 'tshams kyi ma mo brgyad po dang / /gnas gyi bdag po thams cad bsam par bya/ /ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs pa'o/ /rang gi ming brjod gsang sngags rgyal/ /dang por rmā dang hūṃ gnyis ldan/ /phaṭa dang yang dag sbyar ba ni/ /lha rnams ma lus pa yi yin/ /bar ma mchog dang dbugs 'byung dri dang chus/ /cho ga rjes mthun thams cad mchod par bya/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung la sogs rang gis gnas/ /dbus phyogs yongs bskor dkyil 'khor rnams bsams la/ /bshad pa'i sngags kyis rim bzhin dang bor ni/ /g.yon nas bskor zhing rang bdag tha mi dad/ /phyi'i me tog sogs kyis mchod la brtson//dpal ldan khrag 'thung rjes mthun thams cad ni/ /ma lus mgon gnyer sngon 'gros lhag gnas bya/ /phyogs kun ma lus khyab pa dang / /ku tsa pa na 'khyud pa dang —/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs sum cu/ /rtsa bdun rnams bsams cho gas mchod/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ /khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /phag mo lhan cig yang dag 11—769

ldan—/ /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems la sogs pa kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma la ni phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag 'di bzhes pas/ /nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyid/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /nye ba ru ni mdzad pa'i rigs/ /dri zhim me tog me tog 'phreng / /thod pa der ni lnga po ste/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung la sogs kun/ /bdug spos legs par dbul bar bya/ /de 'og rang gi dbugs 'byung bas/ /cho gas brtul zhugs can gzhug bya/ /lha la gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /slob ma'i gtso bo la sogs pa/ /lhag par gnas bya mchod par bya/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga 'di/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin du yang ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i dpa' bo gang / /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag kun kyang gsang ba'i mchog /cho ga mchog bzang 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bo byang chub shes rab kyi/ /'dus dang gnyis med kun mkhyen brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med pa/ /skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /stobs chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen gnyis med ma/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /dpa' bo yan lag las 'byung ba'i/ /sdom pa la sogs slob ma la/ /byang chub 'grub pa'i don gyi phyir/ /cho ga thams cad sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid kun/ /dpa' bo dang dpa'amo 11—770

dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag nyid skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs de kun/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med du ma dag /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /che ge mo bdag la dus 'di nas/ /bzung ste gnyis med mchis kyis bar/ /de'i tshang spyod gnyis med zung / /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par gsungs/ /rang gi sho ni ta'i rgyun/ /yi ge bdun gyis mngon sngags pa/ /slob ma bsrung zhes bsrung ba'i phyir/ /theg pas kun tu dag par bya/ /'jig rten dbang po thams cad kyi / /kha nas thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa'i cha/ /gnyis med ye shes lam 'byung mchog /dpal chen kun gye rang lha mo/ /mchod pa'i cho ga rjes su spyad/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can gyis kyang / /khrag 'thung dpal sogs 'khor lo mchod/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /shes rab can gyis nang par sngar/ /thig gdab gnyis med ye shes las/ /byung bas dkyil 'khor mchog bri bar/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid bzang dang ldan/ /yang dag ye shes de nyid shes/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung gsang sngags shes/ /khro mred gtsang la mkhas pa dang / /spyor shes ye shes pha rol son/ /thod pas skra ni mdzes byas shing / /lus la thal bas rnam par byugs/ /lus la phyag rgya drug sogs btags/ /rus pa'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba ste/ /khā hūṃ kha ni lag na thogs/ /brgya phyed pa'i 'phreng bas brgyan/ /he ru ka dpal rang bya ste/ /'khor lo snying kar dgod par bya/ /de ltar bdag nyid go bgos shing / /sngags dang phyag rgyas brgyan nas ni/ /dngos grub chen po rab stsol ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa 11—771

bri bar bya/ /de nas mṛ tu ka thig gam/ /ma ha ru ti ras brlan pas/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor mchog /grong khyer dam pa'i thig gdab bo/ /khru gang khru do la sogs pa/ /ji srid bcu gnyis bcu drug bri/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po'i grong / /shes rab can gyis thig gdab bo/ /ji srid srad bu lnga po ni—/ /rnam par phye ste btsos nas su/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung la sogs kun/ /spyan drangs nas ni de ru gzhag /sangs rgyas kun gye mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni gnyis med pa/ /pad+ma'i snod du legs bzhag la/ /rang 'byung me tog dag gis mchod/ /ye shes thig ni bskyed nas su/ /thig 'debs pa la mkhas pa yis—/ /sngon chad cho ga mthong gyur pas/ /ye shes thig ni gdab par bya bla mas khya tshur gyis bzung zhing / /gcig ni mtha' ru slob ma yis/ /dbugs 'byin 'gro bar bsams nas su/ /thig gnyis dag be+e legs par bsgril/ /gnyis med gnyis su med sngags kyis/ /bsgril nas der ni thig gdab bya/ /dzā dzā dzā zhes ni legs brjod zhing / /blo ldan rgyab kyis 'gro bar bya/ /dang por byang dang lho yi ni/ /sgo dbus ji bzhin gnas dbus su/ /lho ru mngon par phyogs gyur nas/ /nam mkhar de bzhin thig gnyis gdab/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis/ /lte ba'i phyogs su bzung nas su/ /shar du bltas nas dpa' bo yis—/ /sa la tshangs pa'i thig gnyis gdab/ /thig skud dag ni rdebs pa'i tshe/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas la sogs 'gro don gyi/ /khyed kyi dus ni yin zhes bskul/ /slob dpon slob ma dang bcas pas/ /g.yon nas bskor la shin tu brtson/ /rlung dang dbang ldan phyogs gnas la/ /me dang bden bral kha bltas te/ /bla mas mtshams su thig gnyis ni/ /me'i phyogs nas 11—772

brtsams te gdab/ /byang du mngon par bltas gyur nas/ /me'i phyogs su thig gdab po/ /nub kyi phyogs su bltas nas ni/ /bden bral du ni granguḍa phu bre/ /rlung gi phyogs su gnas byas la/ /lho phyogs su ni bltas pa yis/ /dzub kyi thig ni gang yin pa/ /brtul zhugs can gyis cho gas gdab/ /dpal bo shar du bltas nas ni/ /byang du thig gnyis gdab par bya/ /phyogs la sogs pa'i dbye shes bya/ /kun nas thig ni thams cad kyang / /man ngag ji ltar thob pa las/ /blo ldan gyis ni thig gdab bo/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed 'phyang bas mdzes/ /g.yer ka'i 'phreng ba'i dra ba can/ /grwa'i cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni nang rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis spras par/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor thig gdab bo/ /de'i nang du pad+ma ste—/ /pad+ma'i rgyab du 'khor lo bya/ /rdo rje thig ni gnyis kyi bar/ /rdo rjes 'phreng bas bskor bar bya/ /'khor lo gsum kyi cha chen por/ /rdo rje thig gis bskor bar bya/ /ge sar dang bcas pad+ma ni/ /'dab ma bcu drug dag tu gnas//man ngag dag ni thob pa las/ /dkyil 'khor thig gdab kun shes nas/ /sgo 'khor lo 1༄brgyad cha ste/ /'khyams ni de'i phyed du bya/ /sgo khyud dag ni sgo'i tshad / /lha'i snam bu de bzhin te/ /grwa nas thig ni bskor ba dag /rta babs kyi gnas su brtags/ /ba dan dril bu 'od zer gyis/ /brgyan par thams cad jig gdab cing / /'khor yug gi ni mthar thug par/ /rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mngon bskor cing / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' mar te/ /slob dpon nyis 'gyur du thig gdab/ /mtshon gyi sa ni de'i phyir rtsa ba'i thig gi phyir rol du'o/ /dang por rdo rgyus thig sogs pas/ /thig rnams thams cad nges par bya/ /de'i 11—773

steng du ye shes thig /kun nas yongs su bskyang bar bya/ /ye shes kyi thig gdab pa'o/ /dur khrod rus pa'i thal ba dang / /de'i so phag yang dag ldan/ /de'i shing gi 'dab ma ni/ /de'i mtshon du sbyar bar bya/ /de'i sol ba'i phye ma dang —/ /bab bla ngag dang yang dag ldan/ /kha dog sngon po yongs dag pa/ /lnga por lngar ni sprul par bya/ /dur khrod pa rnams thams cad ni/ /dbang phyug chen po'i rgyan 'di yin/ /ye shes thig ni ji bzhin du/ /brtul zhugs can gyis mtshon bskyed bya/ /nang par sngar langs sems bdag nyid/ /lus las ma lus byas nas su/ /lus kyi yan lag las 'das pa'i/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor nyid du brtsam/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni grol byed pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal bo nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /mtshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam/ /slob dpon gyis ni dang por bkye/ /phyi nas kun tu slob mas so/ /gnas lnga sogs par brtsams nas ni/ /phyi rim (17lnga pa rgyab du'o/ /mtshon dang bzo'i las byed la/ /dam tshig dang ni sbas pa sbyin/ /mje'u chung gi ni sor mo'i dpangs/ /drang 'a/ mtho ba yang dag bri/ /gal te ri mo mi mnyam par/ /yo zhing dma' zhing chad pa'am/ /ri mo dma' bas mi 'grub cing / /yon po gdung ba bskyed byed pa/ /chad pas slob dpon slob ma dag /gnyis ka 'chi bar shes par bya/ /de bas mtshan ldan ri mos ni/ /mtshan nyid kun gyis mtshan par bya/ /slob ma la sogs 'di zhugs pa/ /dri'i chu ni rab bkang bas/ /lus kun la ni gtor bya zhing / /gnod mdzes sngags rigs pa yis glud / /yig/ bdun rnal 'byor bdag nyid can—/ /skye ba bdun sogs sdig pa can/ /slob dpon cho ga 'grub nga/sa/ ni/ 11—774

sems ni shel dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /nang gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma ni/ /gser la sogs pa'i bye ma yis/ /pad+ma'i rgyab kyi 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad pa yang de dang mnyam/ /rdo rje'i ka ba'i rtsibs la ni/ /rdo rje thig gis bskor bar bya/ /shing shun la sogs mdog gis ni/ /thugs kyi 'khor lor rnam par grags/ /de bzhin 'khor lo rtsibs dag kyang / /pad+ma'i ka bar yang dag ldan/ /pad+ma'i thig gis bskor ba ni/ /gsung gi 'khor lo zhes sprul pa/ /byi ru la sogs mdog 'dra'i phyes/ /'khor lo bar ma'i las bya'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i rnam dgod par//rtsibs brgyad snga ma de dang mnyam/ /de bzhin 'khor lo'i ka ba ni/ /'khor lo'i thig gis dbye bar bya/ /mu tig la sogs bye ma yis/ /kun nas sku'i 'khor lo bya—/ /ji ltar pad+ma'i phyogs kyi cha/ /sgo ni cha'i kha dog ste/ /ri mo lnga sogs kha dog phyug /ji ltar mjes par rab tu brtag /mtshon dgye ba'o/ /de ltar cho ga sna tshogs bris pa'i/ /gzhal yas khang mchog lha yi gnas/ /cho ga mthong bas dang por ni/ /ji skad bshad bzhin rdzogs par bya/ /tshogs rnams kun gyis rnam rgyas shing / /bde ba thams cad ster ba'o/ /snying po'i dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs/ /'khor lo gsum bdag nyid can sprul/ /mkha' spyod sa spyod ces bya dang / /sa 'og sogs dang mi'am ci/ /khā'i gdong sogs brgyad po ni/ /rang gi stan la bzhugs par dgod/ /ri'i rtse dang ge sar dang / /sna tshogs pad+ma a li dang / /ka li u sma'i bzhi pa dang / /thig le sgra yang yang dag 'byung //te ru ka dpal rgyal po che/ /shes rab yan lag gnyis med 'dus/ /zhal bzhi zhal de srun gsum mnga'/ /mgo yi dum bus rnam par brgyan/ /ljang dang de bzhin dmar dang gser/ /phyag ni bcu gnyis yang dag ldan/ /g.yas brkyang 11—775

ba yis gdan la bzhugs/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs dar dpyangs can/ /phyag gnyis dag gis de bzhin 'khyud/ /gzhan gnyis glang chen pags pa ste/ /dgra sta rtse gsum gri gug dang / /ḍa ma ru ni phyag g.yas na/ /kha ṭī ga dang de bzhin du—/ /thod pa khrag gis bkang ba dang / /phyag na zhags pa dag dang rol/ /bdud ni bzhi las rnam rgyal ba/ /phyag g.yon dag nas bsnams par bshad/ /yi dwags chen po kun khyab pa'o/ /pang na gnas pa'i phag mo ni/ /sku mdog dmar zhing cher 'bar ma/ /phyag gis 'khyud par mdzad pa la/ /gdug pa bdud sogs khrag 'chang zhing / /zhal nas khrag gis rgyun 'dzag la/ /khrag chen gyis byugs sku yan lag /chags dang bcas shing skra grol ma/ /thod pa'i 'phreng bas bcings pa yin/ /ha ha zhes bshad srun gsum sku/ /dum bu dang ni mgo bos brgyan/ /g.yas na sdigs mdzub rdo rje ste/ /bdud sogs kun la sogs gdug par ldan/ mkha' 'gro ma ni ma ma ki/ /lho'i 'dab ma gnon na bzhugs/ /phyag bzhi skra ni grol ba la/ /rtse bran lnga yis rnam brgyan pa/ /phyag rgya lnga sogs sku la mnga'/ /spyan gsum khro bos hūṃ mdzad cing / /sku mdog sngo la 'jigs pa che/ /gad mo rgyad mdzad gcigs pa ste/ /spyan gsum can la hūṃ mdzad pa/ /kha ṭī ga ste thod pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor mtshon cha g.yas dag nas/ /phyag bzhi pas ni rnam par brgyan/ /g.yon nas bskor ba'i pad+ma la/ /la ma zhes bya sgol mdzad mo/ /sku mdog ljang khu 'jigs pa che—/ /ha ha zhes bzhad gtsigs pa che/ /rtse bran lngas ni brgyan pa ste/ /dbu skra gol zhing 'jigs mdzad pa/ /spyan gsum pa la hūṃ mdzad cing / /kha ṭī ga ste thod pa bsnams/ /rnal 'byer mtshon dang ḍam ru/ /phyag bzhi pas ni rnam par brgyan / /khadharo ha gos 11—776

dkar mo/ /byang gi 'dab ma gnon pas bzhugs/ /sku mdog dmar mo shas cher 'bar/ /phyag bzhi 'jigs pa'i hūṃ mdzad pa/ /dbu skra grol zhing 'bar ba la—/ /rtse bran lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /rnal 'byor snod dang kha ṭī ga /rnal 'byer mtshon dang ḍa ma ru/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /srun gsum 'og pag dag gis brgyan/ /nub kyi 'dab mar gzugs can ma/ /srun de sra ba'i bdag nyid can/ /sku mdog ser zhing shas cher 'bar/ /ha ha zhes bshad 'jigs pa ste/ /skra grol kha ṭī ga dang snod/ /phyag bzhi dag gis rnam par brgyan/ /spyan gsum hūṃ gis 'jigs pa ste/ /rtse bran lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /phyag rgya lnga sogs sku la mnga'/ /rnal 'byor mtshon dang ḍa ma ru/ /chu dang me dang rlung dang ni/ /sa'i khams dag nyid yin no/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi pa'o—/ /phyi dang nang na yang dag bzhugs/ /'tshams kyi cha'i pad+mal/ /ma dang de bzhin pha dag dang / /rgyal po dang ni rgyal rigs gnyis/ /thod pa'i snod ni mchod byed pa/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /pu la sogs pa yang dag drangs/ /bkug ste 'khor lo'i nang du gzhag /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag par mchod/ /de la dpa' skyes rnal 'byor ma'i/ /'khor lo'i gnas ni bshad par bya—/ /pu zhes bya ba ni pu li ra ma la ya ste/ thod pa'i dum bu dang rab tu gtum mo'o/ /dza zhes bya ba ni 'dza' lan dha ra ste/ keng rus chen po dang gtum mig can ma'o/ /u zhes bya ba ni u rgyan de keng rus dang 'od ldan ma'o/ /a zhes bya ni ar bu ta ste/ mche ba rnam par gatshigs pa dang sna chen ma'o/ /de dag ni gnas so/ /gho zhes bya ba ni go dha bar+ya ste/ lha'i sgra dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma'o/ /rā 0)zhes bya ba ni rā mi shwa rā ste/ 'od dpag med dang / mig 11—777

'thung ma'o/ /dhe zhes bya ba ni dhe ba'i ko ti ste/ rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /mā zhes bya ba ni ma la ba ste/ rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma'o/ /de dag ni nye ba'i gnas yin te/ thugs kyi 'khor lo ste/ nam mkha' la rgyu ba yin no/ /ka zhes bya ba ni ka ma ru ste/ myu gu can dang sa bsrungs ma'o/ /khro zhes bya ba ni od ste/ rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /de dag ni zhing ngo / /tri zhes bya ba ni tri sha ku ṣ+pe ste/ dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi phugs can ma'o/ /go ①zhes bya ba ni ko sa la ste/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma'o/ /de dag ni nye ba'i zhing ngo / /ka zhes bya ba ni ka ling ga ste/ rab tu bzang po dang ljang lha mo'o/ /la zhes bya ba ni lam pa ka ste/ rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo'o/ /de dag ni tshan sgo ha'o/ /ka zhes bya ba ni kan tsi ste/'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma'o/ /he zhes bya ba ni te ma la ya ste/ mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma'o/ /de dag ni nye ba'i tshan sgo ha yin la/ gsung gi 'khor lo ste/ sa la rgyu ba yin no/ /pre zhes bya ba ni pre ta pu rī ste/ stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /shrī zhes bya ba ni shrī ha de ba te ste/ rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma'o/ /de dag ni 'du ba can zhes bya'o/ /sngo zhes bya ba ni sau rasta ste/ rta mgrin dang shon ti ni'o/ /su zhes bya ba ni su bar na ti pa ste/nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /de dag ni nye ba'i 'du ba can no//na zhes bya ba ni na ga ra ste/ dpal te ru ka dang shin tu dpa' ma'o/ /si zhes bya ba ni sin 'du ste/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma'o/ /de dag ni dur khrod do/ /ma zhes bya ba ni ma ru ste/ rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma'o/ /ku zhes zhes bya ba ni ku lu te ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang /11—778

brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /de dag ni nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /sku'i 'khor lo ste/sa 'og na gnas pa'i yin no/ /sgo rnams su ni/ khwa gdong ma dang / 'ug gdong ma dang / khyi gdong ma dang / phag gdong ma'o/ /'tshams rnams su ni/gshin rje brtan ma dang / gshin rje pho nya ma dang / gshin rje mche ba ma dang /gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /grub pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /phyogs kun tu ni rnam par gnas/ /pha rol phyin bcu dag pa ste/ /sa bcu la ni rnam par bzhugs/ /te ru ka dpal rgyal po che/ /phyi dang nang nas yang dag bzhugs/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /byang chub sems dpa' du ma'o/ /dkyil 'khor du lha rnams dgod pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa dang / /sgo srung brgyad po ma gtogs pa/ /'khor lo gsum la thod pa yi/ /dum bu la sogs pa rnams la ni/ phyag gnyis pa/ zhal gcig pa/ ral pa dang / thor tshugs dang —/ dar gyis brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang / dbu'i nor bu dang ldan pa/'og pag gis brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa la/ phyag gnyis kyis 'khyud pa/ rdo rje dang / dril bu bsnams pa/ lha mo la gzigs shing / ma mchu 'dzin no/ /rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams ni/ rang gi bdag po'i sku mdog dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa ste/ dbu skra grol bas rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa dang ni 'khyud pa dang / /gri gug dang ni sdigs mdzub can/ /byin gsum hūṃ ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /'og pag dum bus rnam par brgyan/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs thams cad kyang / /g.yon nas bskor bar sngon 'gro bas//rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gsum/ /'gro kun g.yon las byung ba yin/ /dkar min dkar dang dmar po ni/ /mtha' ma mchog dang bar ma ste/ /thams cad ci 11—779

bzhin dgod pa'o/ /bla ma'i rims kyi bka' drin gyis/ /khwa gdong la sogs brgyad po ni/ /mkha' 'gro la sogs dbye bas so/ /zhabs kyis rol la gnon pa dang —/ /sna tshogs gzugs/ can bzhi po yin/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad de dag kun—/ /khro bo rnam rgyal sogs sprul yin/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭī ga /pad+ma'i snod can lnga po ste/ /g.yas pas mtshon cha 'phyar ba ni/ /gdug pa thams cad nges gnon pa'o/ /dpal ldan te ru ka sogs kun/ /g.yon gyis 'khyud cing nu ma 'dzin/ /lha rnams kun gyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan no/ /na dha gzugs sogs sngon 'gro bas/ /byang chub yan lag so bdun bya/ /gos dang phyag rgya lnga la sogs/ /shes rab yan lag phur bu 'dra/ /a li ka li zhes brjod nas—/ /rgyu sogs stong pa sngon 'gro bas/ /'jug pa sgra la sogs pa nas/ /ji srid srub pa'i sbyor ldan pas/ /bde ba'i stan la 'bad pa yis/ /shes rab yan lag stan gyi steng / /mgul rgyan gtsug phud dbu rgyan dang / /rna rgyan tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / /mgul par brgyan cing mgo bo'i phreng / /'og pag dang ni rkang gdub dang / /ral pa'i cod pan dar dang ni/ /bcos ma'i sku la sogs pas brgyan/ /pad+ma rdor bcas kha ṭī ga /ḍa ma ru sgra hūṃ sgrogs shing / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /go cha gsum gyis brgyan pa yin/ /he ru ka dpal rgyal po che/ /rang gi bdag nyid gcig tu byas/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse ba'i/ /blo ldan bum pa mngon par bzlas/ /de nyid mtshan nyid gsungs pa'i—/ /bum pa mchog ni bcu dag du/ /chu dang 'o ma yang dag bsres/ /chu klung 'bab chus bum pa dgang / /dri dang me tog sna tshogs pas/ /dbugs 'byung mchog dang bar ma dang / /dri'i chus ni yang dag byugs/ /kha ni 'dab 11—780

mas yang dag rgyan①/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /cho ga bzhin du mngon par bzlas/ /mgul pa gos kyis rnams dkris shing / /rgyan ni mdzes pa'i rnam par brgyan/ /me tog me tog 'phreng gis dkris/ /brgyad po dag ni sgo ru dgod/ /bum pa rgyu ba dbus su'o/ /ma dang de bzhin pha dag dang / /rgyal po rgyal rigs gnyis yang ste/ /rdo rje chus ni rab tu dag /kha dog lnga pa'i gos kyis ni/ /brgyan cing mgul par dkri bar bya/ /sna tshogs pad+mas kha dgab cing —/ /rang 'byung me tog dag gis mchod/ /lha'i sgo'i logs su ni/ /ri mo'i dbus su gzhag par bya/ /bla re dag ni bye bya zhing / /sna tshogs pa'i gos kyang bre/ /rgyal mtshan gdugs sogs dar rnams kyis/ /gnas dang gnas su brgyan par bya/ /bum pa bzhag sogs mchod pa ni/ /ji skad bshad pa bzhin du bya—/ /rin chen gser gyis mdzes par ni/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu gtor bar bya—/ /spos sdod dag ni brgyad po dang / /mar me mchod sdong de mnyam bya/ /nyil mar chen po de sbar la/ /spos ni lnga po sngon 'gro ba'o/ /sna tshogs me tog 'phyang ba dang / /sna tshogs 'chang dang khur ba kun/ /sna tshogs rol mos rab dga' zhing / /sna tshogs kha zas ston mo dang / /sna tshogs rnal 'byor ma dang ni//dri bzang me tog sna tshogs ldan/ /sna tshogs pa'i glu len cing / /sna tshogs gar gyis gar bzang byed/ /bkra shis sgra ni thams cad pa'i/ /dga' ston khrag 'thung dpal 'byung ba'i/ /spyod dang grol bar 'dod pa'i/ /rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyis ni/ /sgo bzhi dag tu rnal 'byor pa/ /dpa' bo'i lus dang gnyis med bsten/ /mtshon chen sogs pa'i gos dag gam/ /dar la sogs pa dar gyis brgyan/ /phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa'i lus/ /rtse bran lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /11—781

rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud/ /rang stan dag tu kha sbyar ba/ /'tshogs kyi gtso bo bdag po kun/ /'khor lo sgyur ba'i rnam rol yin//sngar bshad rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /stan dang gnas ni rnam mjos pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dril bu 'chang //'khyud cing nu ma 'tshir ba dang / /snying ka mgo bo spyi gtsug dang / /mig sogs go cha gsum gyis brgyan/ /rdo rje sems sogs 'dod pa'i/ /rnal 'byor chen po gnyis med gnas/ /byang chub yan lag sum cu bdun/ /byas shing go bgos rab mnyam gzhag /de ltar go bgos bdag nyid ni/ /sum cu gsum pas kyang mi shig /dkyil 'khor lha mo dpa' bo rnams/ /ji lta ba bzhin mchod pa'i las—/ /rang gi 'khor lo bsgom bsgrub par/ /ye shes 'khor lo rnam par bsgom/ /bdag nyid las sbyar byas pa yis/ /dam tshig thams cad la gzhug bya//sngar bstan pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /gyenari du phe gi sgra bsgrags la/ /mchog dang bar ma'i rnal 'byor ma/ /'jig rten khams la sogs pa dgug /rang gi sku mdog phyag dang dbyibs/ /sngar bshad pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /rang gi phyag mtshan rgyan bcas pa/ /ral pa thor tshugs cod pan can/ /dam tshig 'khor lor zhugs nas ni/ /gnyis med ye shes bsgom par bya/ /he ru ka dpal la sogs kun/ /g.yas brkyang ba yis gdan la bzhugs/ /ye shes 'khor lor spyan drangs pa'o/ /he ru ka dpal sogs 'khor lo yi/ /lha rnams phyi dang nang gis mchod/ /lha'i grangs bzhin blo ldan pas/ /mdzes pa'i gos kyang dbul bar bya—/ /'khor lo sgyur ba dpa' bo ni/ /rang 'byung me tog gis mchod byung / /gdong ni dag par bkru bar bya/ /lho phyogs sgo nas lag pas so/ /gnyis med ye shes sngags kyis ni/ /mngon par bzlas la byin kyis brlab/ /sangasargyas 11—782

kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /khyad par du ni mngon par bzla/ /rnal 'byor ma'i sgo dang sgor/ /ji srid brgya rtsa brgyad par bzla/ /sngags pas lha'i grangs bzhin ni//a li ka li zhes smra zhing / /byin gyis brlabs la yang dag mchod/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams mnyes par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mnyes par bya'o/ /bya ba'i mchod pa'i khyad par ni/ /rgyal byed snying stobs can gyis lugs/ /ko shig kya dang rtsom pa ste/ /gar dang gar gyi lan kun bya/ /chags bcas tshul gyis sbyor ba yis/ /bag ma'i rnam par sgeg pa yis//rol bcas gom pa 'deg pa'i/ /gom stabs brgyad kyis gar bya'o/ /sgeg sogs bya ba kun dang ni/ /'khyud cing nu ma 'tshir ba dang / /bya ba'i mchod pa'i khyad par gyes/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma mnyes bya/ /nang gi bdag nyid sbyin sreg gis/ /skye bo dam pa kun 'dus bya/ /he ru ka dpal rgyal po che/ /mdza' bo thams cad yang dag 'dus/ /zhi ba'i btung bas dngos grub ni/ /rtag pa'i dam pa'i gnas ni 'grub/ /chang dang rgun chang sogs kun la/ /bza' dang btung sogs zhim po dang / /nya dang sha ni khyad par du/ /sngags dang ldan pas sbyin sreg bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ko me shwa re sarba bhak+ṣ-i bi shodha yā/ gubye badz+ra ṇi hūṃ swā hā/ mngon par sngags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'o—/ /lte ba'i ni sbyin sreg me/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad pa ru/ /dpa' po'i dbang sogs sum cu bdun/ /pad+ma'i lte ba ge sar la/ /ji bzhin las kyi rjes mthun par/ /bdag nyid lha'i dngos byas la/ /cho gas sbyin sreg kun byas na/ /brtag mi dgos par 'dir 'grub 'gyur/ /bza' ba'am yang na btung ba dag /brtul zhugs can gyis ci za bar/ /mchog dang bar ma'i dbugs 'byung sogs/ /bsams la thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid lha ni gzhan dag lha/ /11—783

bdag nyid lha ni dam pa yin/ /bdag gi gzugs kyi rang bzhin kun/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs shes par bya/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang //dpa' bo kun gyis gnas yin te/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchod/ /de ltar 'bad par thams cad kyis/ /dge ba yongs su tshim par bya/ /la sogs gang zhig brtsams pa ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /dkyil 'khor gyi las kyi nang gi sbyin sreg go /drug cu la sogs bza' bcas pa'i/ /zan dron sha dang nya sha dang / /bar ma mchog dang lnga po yi//gtor ma 'bad de dbul bar bya/ /thod pa'i nang du legs bzhag ste/ /dang po phyag rgya spyan drangs te/ /gyen du tse gi sgra sgrogs shing / /mig dang gdong dang yan lag bsgyur/ /bkug la dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /sngags kyis yang dag mchod par bya/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen du dbye/ /reg par gyur nas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dpa' bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /ji bzhin las la sbyar bar bya/ /mtshan mo skra grol gcer bu yis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis gtor ma sbyin/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor bdag /des na rnal 'byor ma rnams mnyes/ /gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /pha rol phyin pa phyag rgya drug /byang chub sum cu rtsa bdun nyid/ /gnas la sogs pa sa bcu dang / /che mchog lha'i bdag nyid dang / /go bgos pa'i bdag nyid can/ /dbang bskur ba'i dam pa'o/ /dag dang ma dag 'dres ma ste/ /sgrub pa po ni gsum du gnas/ /mnyes byed rnam par dag pa dang / /gsal byed yon tan ldan pa'i mi/ /de ltar phyi dang nang gi sbyin sreg dang / /gtor ma'i bya ba dang / mchod pa'i yo byad mtha' dag gi cho ga yongs su bsngos pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ slob ma ma lus pa'i tshogs kyi bdag po mngon du byas la/11—784

'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /gong ma gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni bsrung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin/ /gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor bdag /byang chub shes rab yan lag sprul/ /ma dang de bzhin pha dag dang / /rgyal po dang ni rgyal rigs gnyis/ /thod pa der ni legs bzhag la/ /slob ma'i sdig pa 'jig byed pa'o/ /slob dpon kun mkhyen yig bdun gyis/ /slob ma'i khar ni yang dag gtor/ /bu tshur zhes ni brjod bya zhing / /go cha che la sogs pas bsrung / /rdo rje sems sogs pas go bskon/ /dar dag kyang ni bcing bar bya/ /sems can dman dang mchog gi ni//sgob ma la sogs yid shes bya/ /blo dang ldan pas dngos kun gyis/ /dang por slob dpon mnyes par bya/ /slob ma yongs su brtag pa'o/ /de nas slob ma sogs bya ba/ /lag pas lag pa bzung nas ni/ /ā+oṃ dzihe ru kā k+ṣiṃbid ma he/ /bisgye rā dz+dza jo ma te swā hwa/ zhes bya ba 'dis dpa' bo bskul bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /slob ma'i gsol ba'o/ /don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /sred pa'i nyes brgya skye ba nyon mongs bcom mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob mas gzhug par bgyi/ /de nas lho phyogs kyi sgor mngon par phyogs par bsdad la/ /ā+oṃ na ma ste hūṃ/ na ma he hūṃ/na mo na ma hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas lan gsum phyag bya ba 11—785

sngon du 'gro bas/ ā+oṃ sarba bī rā yo gi bye pu dzo pāsba nā ad mā nan ni t+ya ta yā mi1//sarba ta tha ga ta pi ra yo gi ni ad ma dh+wa ki n+ya adhishu swā rmā/ zhes bya bas lus thams cad kyis phyag byed du gzhug go /de nas g.yon phyogs su thal mo de nyid snying kar sbyor du bcug la/ shar phyogs kyi sgo nas/ ā+oṃ sarba bi ra yo gi bye phu dza a nyi she ka ya ang ma nam ni t+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta tha ga ta bi rā ā+o gi ni ad ma la ma t+ya a nyi du rmā/ de nas byang phyogs su thal mo de nyid dpral bar bzhag la phyag byed du gzhug go /ā+oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni bye su dzā bar tā na yā/ ad ma nam ma ni t+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta tha ga ta bi rā sbo gi ni ad ma/ khan dha dzā na t+ya pra bar ta yā oṃ/ de nas nub phyogs kyi sgor thal mo de mgor bzhag la/ phyag byed du gzhug go/ ā+oṃ sarba bi rā ā+o gi bye su dza gar ma ka ra nā yā/ ad ma nam ni t+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta tha ga ta bī rā ā+o gi ni ad ma ru pa ni/ ār+ya kar ma ku ru oṃ/ /phyag bzhi pa'o/ /de nas lhor ni phyogs byas te/ /slob ma lag pas bzung nas ni—/ /bde mchog sdom par gsungs pa bzhin/ /cho gas thams cad sbyin bar bya| /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yin 'ong / /sdom pa brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes grags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re zhing ni lan drug du/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin par rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyangam 11—786

lus gzung / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /sdom pa'o/ /deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas spyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes babyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad gyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ khyod kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du/ smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag bzhugs pa ni/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /de nas dam tshig blud pa ni/ /ga bur tsan dan ldan pa dang / /bde ba'i stan thog chur bcas pa/sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro mas/ /slob ma blo gros brtan pa la/ /blangs te rgyan gyis de la sbyin/ /thod pa legs par gzhag nas ni/ /gza'i ①mdangs bcas par 'di skad brjod/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi chu 'dis 'thung / /ā+oṃ pan tsa a mi to tha tha tha hūṃ/ de nas brtsams te khyod kyis dpal he ru ka nga nyid yin gyis/ ngas gang 'di bsgos shig ces bsgo ba de khrod kyis bya'o/ /khrod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar rtsang bar gyur ta re/ de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byen gyis rlobs shig /dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bdag la dbab par mdzod cig /ces smrar gzhug go /thang chu lnga dang legs 11—787

sbyar ba/ /bskus shing gos ni legs brtungs dang / /bye la'i rtug pa nyid dang ni/ /gu gul lhan cig sbyar nas ni/ /pad+ma'i snod du bzhag nas ni/ /yi dwags me yis gdung bar bya/ /gnyis med gnyis su med sngags kyis/ /bsgyings bcas 'dug ste gzir ldan pa/ /sngar bshad rgyan dang ldan pa dang / /de bzhin go cha bgos nas ni/ /'khor lo kun byi dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma rnams de snying gzhug /g.yas brkyang ba yis gnas pa la/ /gnyis med sngags ni brjod nas ni/ /bdug pa de dang gsang sngags kyis/ /skad cig de nyid dag la'ang 'jug /ā+oṃ tiṣ+ṭa ma ha 'khro ①dha hūṃ a be+e sha hūṃ/ ā+oṃ shri he ru kā bī da ma he bīt+yā tsa ②ya bye ma he swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'dis dpa' bo bskul bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa bzung ba yis/ /mig phye nas ni blta bar bya/ /he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe tra pa sa ha ra pa ta lo hri/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed//khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byen kyis brlab/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub phun tshogs khyod mngon 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /gang du me tog lhung 'gyur ba/ /de'i gnas sogs bstan par bya/ /slob ma gzhug pa'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba bzhugs/ /gnyis med gnyis med pa na gnas/ /brtan g.yog kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /spyod dang grol bar rab brtson pa/ /kun mkhyen kun mdzad gtso bo ste/ /dpa' bo che la bu khyod ltos/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma lnga po/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs kun/ /sems dang sems las byung las sprul/ /'khor lo 11—788

mkha' la spyod pas bskor/ /rab gtum ma sogs yang dag 'khyud/ /gnyis po thugs kyi sprul pa yin/ /myu gu can la sogs pa kun/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad gnyis su med/ /gsung ni rnam dag ngo bo yin/ /mi'i 'jig rten du dag tu khyab—/ /stobs po che sogs bang gnas pa/ /grub pa sa 'og gnas pa yin/ /sku'i sprul par bshad pa ste/ /chags pa kun gyi rjes su chags/ /he ru ka dpal sogs 'khor lo/ /g.yon pas 'khyud cing nu ma 'tshir/ /sku gsum zhes bya ba'i sprul pa ste/ /'bring dang mchog dang mtha' ①ma'o/ /khā la sogs pa brgyad po ni—/ /gzugs ni rgyu yis yang dag bstan/ /khro bo rnam rgyal la sogs brgyad/ /byang chub sum cu rtsa bdun sprul/ /mkha' spyod sa spyod zhes bya gang / /sa 'og dag gis ma mo ste/ /bzhi po mchod pa bzhi yin te/ /lha'i de nyid mtshon pa yin//dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid do/ /de nas slob ma bla ma'i/ /zhabs la dad pas phyag 'tshal te/ /thal sbyar yon dang tshig bshad kyis/ /dbang bskur don du gsol bar gdab/ /nye ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can/ /ci ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal/ /de bzhin bdag la deng gsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol—/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag nyid rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /'jug pa'i lho'i sgo phyogs su/ /te ru ka dpal bdag nyid sems/ /thams cad cho ga bzhin sbyin zhing / /dkyil 'khor lus la chud par bya/ /phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa'i lus/ /seng ge'i khri sogs la bzhag pa/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng du ste/ /slob ma gnyis med sbyor ldan par/ /sna tshogs snan la bzhag nas ni—/ /gnyis med ye shes sems ldan gyis/ /me tog dbang bskur la sogs pa/ /11—789

thams cad cho ga bzhin sbyin phyir/ /dkyil 'khor lus nang chud par bya/ /phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa'i lus/ /he ru ka dpal ngo bor sprul/ /spyod dang brtul zhugs bstan pa dang / /de bzhin gnyis med tshangs spyod do/ /steng du gdugs dkar bkab nas ni/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis/ /bkra shis sgra yis gang ba yis/ /glu len rol mo snyan pa yin/ /he ru ka dpal ngo bor sprul/ /rab tu 'bad de mchod par bya/ /dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yis yungs kar ni/ /cho ga bzhin du mngon bzlas pas/ /gsang sngags brjod cing brtan bya ste/ /te ru ka dpal sogs gnyis med/ /bslang nas dkyil 'khor thams cad ni/ /bkra shis dag gi glu len cing / /gnyis med ye shes gzigs pa rnams/ /thams cad cho ga bzhin dbang bskur/ /yang na sngar gyi cho ga yis/ /rnam rgyal bum pa gdeg par bya/ /'dab ma'i rtse mo can bslangs nas/ /snga ma bzhin du dbang bskur zhing / /gsang sngags nyi shu gnyis pa dang / /sngar bsnyen pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /te ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /brtag mi dgos par 'grub par 'gyur/ /yang na bum pa med gyur na/ /'khor lo kun gyi lha rnams ni/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes can/ /nam mkha'i khams ni thams cad gang / /sngon mdzad brtse ba'i shugs kyis ni/ /dgyes pa chen po legs byon te/ /he ru ka dpal la sogs pa/ /bsgoms nas thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /bkra shis glu'i rnam pa/ chang dang sha yi dga' ston gyis/ /rnal 'byor ma kun dpa' bo rnams/ /gnyis med ye shes dag gis sprul/ /ci ltar me tog dor byas nas/ /lha'i rigs ni mtshon byas pa'i/ /me tog lhung ba blangs nas ni/ /slob ma'i mgo la bcing bar bya/ /'dab ma'i rtse mo lag gnyis kyis/ /11—790

sngags pas bteg pa'i bum pa yis/ /lus nang gtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /cho ga bzhin du kun dbang bskur/ /de 'og rnam rgyal bum pa dang / /dril bu sgra bsgrags glu yis ni/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun/ /bsgoms la thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /chu'i dbang bskur sbyin bya ste/ /sdig pa thams cad bkru bar bya/ /de nas rdo rje rgya gram mgor/ /ral pa'i thor gtsugs kyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis sngags ①pa yis/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /ā+oṃ sarba dbu ④twa da dha ki nī ste badz+ra wa ra ④bhā ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brjod la/'khor lo thams cad kyis dpa' bo la sogs pa sngags brjod kyis bskul ba'o/ /lag du mtshan ma'i de nyid dang / /mtshan ma'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /te ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod ni dbang bskur te/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long / /de nas 'dir rang gi mtshan ma'i dbang bskur ba sbyin par bya ste/ ā+oṃ shri he ru ka a dhi pa ti two/ a bo shin tsā dum tiṣ+ṭa bī ra sa yā two/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /rdo rje'o/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu 'chang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid gyis dag /ngo bo nyid gyis srid bral bya/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dag par byed par 'gyur/ /dril bu'o/ /rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud/ /g.yon bsnyems pa dang mchu 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor bdag /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlab/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis sngags kyis ni/ /sngags kyi 11—791

dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /khroṭī①te ru ka a dhi parnyi tī② ma/ k+ṣiṃbī shin tsa khrumi| dzite ru ka na ma a rnyi she dhika ta/ zhes bya ba dang / ming gi dbang bskur ba'o/ /'di des sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /te ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ /khrod kyis kyang ni rtag tu 'chang / /te ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brten/ ā+oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta sid dhi badz+ra sa ma ye nyiṣ+ṭa e sha ⑤two dhar ya/ mi hūṃ hi hi hi hi ho/ /rdo rje brtul zhugs so/ /kha ṭī ḍam ru bdud rtsi/ /khrag 'thung dpal lus kha ṭī ga/rnal 'byor ma ṇi ḍa ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭī rdo rje bcas/ /dril bu sil sel sgra sgogs shing ske/ /mchod phyir thogs dang rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor snod—/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /dbang bskur ba bdun no/ /de nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang / /shes rab thabs kyis bsnyems chen gyis/ /gar mchod bde ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /gar ro/ /sgeg dang bcas pas 'phreng ba 'phyang / /sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /des ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /'phreng ba nyid brgyan yin no/ /'phreng ba'o/ /lus can rnams la dam chos kyi/ /khyod kyis glu ni blang bar bya/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma de dang / /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /glu'o/ /khyod kyis rgyal la dril bu phul la/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba'i/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bsgo/ /dri'o/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos gtul la/ /brtul zhugs bzang po legs tshims kyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshol par 'gyur/ /spos so//chos kyi mig ni legs sbar la/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig mdongs byas pa/ /ye shes sgron mas snang bar gyes/ /mar me'o/ /jiltar 11—792

mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ge tra ya a pa ha ra sa ta/ lo triḥthur ma'o/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo med cing gnas med par/ /de ltar chos 'di shes gyis la—/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skyes/ /me long ngo / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten kun tu thams cad du/ /bya ba'i spyod tshul gsang ba'i①/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyes/ /'khor lo'o/ /khyod kyis the tsom chadogs med pa/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /chos kyis dung ni bla med par/ /dri med kun tu dgang bar gyis/ /dung ngo / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar byed dang gnod sogs dang / /gsod dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams dang ni bsgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ri lu ste—/ /rnal 'byor pa'i dngosatsob ni/ /gang 'dod pa de bsgrub par gyis/ /gnang ba'o/ /nang par sngar langs sems bdag nyid/ /ma lus lus ni byas nas su/ /btung dang bza' la sogs pa'i/ /sdom pa'i mtshan nyid bsrung ba'o//lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung / /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re zhing ni bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re bsrungs (9ba bya/ /gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lor gnas/ /tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ /chang dang sha sogs gang ci yang rung / /dpa' bo 11—793

rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs/ /thams cad gnyis med pa na gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spong / /rtag tu mya ngan 'das dga' min//dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya'o/ /phyag rgya bzhin pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma bgom par mi bya'o/ /dam tshigs rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing / /spyi bo phyag ni byas nas kyang / /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /bdag nyid ma khyod bu yin te/ /ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma nas/ /byung ba'i rang gi nu mas skyongs/ /gnyis med ye shes spyod pa'i tshul/ /bslab pa blangs pa kun 'gro bas/ /na dha la sogs sngon 'gro ba'i/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrung / /dam tshig de la rtag gnas te/ /de sngon 'gro ba'i sbas pa'i yid—/ /spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' pa pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal//bsrung ba'i dam tshigs so①/ /'dir dbang bskur ba'i slob ma ni/ /lag nas bzung ste gzi' ②bcas pas/ /gnyis med ye shes bla med pa/ /ma lus don ni kun brjod bya/ /gnyis med ye shes sems ldan la/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /tshangs par spyod la rtag gnod la/ /'dod pa lnga ni spyad par gyis/ /gnyis med la gnas zas la ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs brda'/ /gnyis med pa dang thogs med pa/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod pa bya/ /mi mo dbang phyug legs spyad cing —/ /tshangs spyod bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /'khro ba med pa'i rgyud spyad pa//11—794

bsgrub pa pos ni yongs su bsrung / /rtag tu bsgom pa la gnas nas/ /yul kun la ni rnam 'gying ba'i/ /gnyis med grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /byu srid srog ni gnas pa'i bar/ /bu khyod kyis ni bsgrub par bya/ /'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la/ /ci dga' bar ni bsten par bya/ /te ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che—/ /bsams nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor ma rnams kun gyi gnas/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis—/ /he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /'dod chags bral bar lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /bza' bar bya ba'i dam tshig go/ /g.yon pa yis ni cho ba /sa mtha'/ /g.yas kyis mi 'jigs stsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /'khor lo thams cad rnam par gnas/ /da he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin/ /mgrin gcig tu ni de dag kun/ /'di nang ngas khyod lung bstan te/ /khrag 'thung dpal zhes de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa mchod du dag bya'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan song rnams las bton/ /dzihe ru kā nā ma ta thā ga hūṃ sedhi sa ma ya snyi/ bhur bu bā swā hā/ gang la don yod grub pa'i phyag rgya chen po mthon 'phags 'dis/ /mchog du gnas gsang chen du gnas pa las/ cho gas mgrin gcig tu—/ rgyal ba rnams kyis lung ston par mdzad do/ /lung ston mthon 'phags so//khams gsum rgyal ba'i rgyal srid che/ /rgyal po bdag por brtan pa dang / /de ring bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /pho brang mchog tu zhugs pa yis/ /deng ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /spyod rnams 'dir ni dze+e tshom med/ /dbang bskur ba tsama'adi yis ni/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /brtan g.yon kun 11—795

gyi dam tshig gi/ /slob dbon nyid du'ang bde blag 'gyur/ /dbugs 'byung ba'o—/ /yon gyi mchog ni dbul bya ste/ /glang po rta dang shing rta nor/ /nor bu byu ru mu tig sogs/ /phyag byas nas ni dbul bar bya/ /ding nas brtsams te bdag bran sa /khyed la bdag ni phul ba lags/ /slob mar rang nyid bsgyur bcongs pa'i/ /chang gis kyang ni mchod par bya/ /slob ma gus pa med pa yis/ /dngos grub ring bar ze tshom med/ /dngos po kun gyis slob ma yis/ /dang por yon ni bya ba yin/ /gal te lha ni mnyes 'dod na/ /'bad de bla ma mnyes par bya—/ /dpa' bo ji bzhin rig de bzhin/ /rig ma ci bzhin bla ma bzhin/ /dpa' bo rig dang bla ma la/ /mchod pa'i 'bras bu mnyam par yi/ /slob dpon gyi yon dbul ba yin no/ /de nas shes rab ma 'dir ni rnyed pa gang / /me tog ldan zhing shin tu bslabs/ /shin tu gtsang ba'i sa phyogs su/ /khams lnga dag dang yang dag ldan/ /phye mar byas te de dag kun/ /rdo rje la ni byug par bya/ /dga' ba la sogs bzhi po dang / /'khor lo gsum bdag rnal 'byor ldan/ /'dod chags che la 'byung ba'i mgon/ /chags pa kun gyis rjes chags pa/ /pad+ma'i snod du legs gsang ba'i dbang gzhag ①ste/ /rnal 'byor mas ni 'di skad smras//bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang / /dmangs rigs mthar gnas bud med kun—/ /gus pas rtag tu rab mchod dang / /gnyis med 'khyud dang tsum pa na/ /dpa' bo khrod ni spror gyur tam/ /khros shig dpa' bo bde ba che/ /ci gsung dam tshig bsten par ni/ /lha mo bdag gis byed par nus/ /pad+ma rgyas par byas nas ni/ /skra bshig gos kyang bral byas nas/ /me tog chur ldan dpa' bo yis / rnal 'byor ma'i rdo rje sbyin/ /deng nas brtsams te bu khyod ni/ /brtul zhugs 11—/96

bzang pos 'gro don byus/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang / /dmangs rigs mthar skyes mtshan nyid can/ /ba ga pad+ma btsum pa na/ /bdud rtsi rnams ni bsgrub par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rkang g.yon ni/ /lung bsgo bas ni spyi bor gzhag /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpa' mo/ /gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pas/ /dpa' bo las byung byang chub sems/ /rgyun gyis dbang ni bskur ba yin/ /'di ni byang chub 'grub rnal 'byor/ /khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can/ /te ru ka dpal bdag spyor ba/ /yang dag bde la pyong bar gyis/ /gnyis med ye shes dbang bskur lani/ /gsang ba kun la sogs par bshad/ /'di dag thams cad gsang ba che/ /dbang bskur ba ni mchog gis gnas/ /yon dang dad pa sngon 'gro bas/ /deng ni phyag rgya gtad par bya/ /bla na med pa'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas skad ④cig bshad pa'i/ /cho gas sbyin sreg las bya zhing / /rnal 'byor ma la gtor ma sbyin/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni mchog 'grub 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing sogs dag bya'i phyir/ /khyad par du ni sbyin la spyad/ /dmangs rigs stong phrag gnyis dag kyang / /bram ze gtsang ma gcig dang 'dra/ /bram ze stong phrag gnyis dag ni/ /dge slong gcig la rab tu sbyar/ /dge slong stong phrag gnyis dag ni/ /rdul sed pa ni gcig dang mnyam/ /rdul med stong phrag gnyis dag ni/ /ye shes ldan pa gcig la sbyar/ /ye shes ldan pa stong phrag gnyis/ /slob dpon gcig dang mnyam par mchod/ /de ltar sbyin pa'i zhing shes nas/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag tu sbyin/ /rnal 'byor rtsa ba'i chos la ni/ /zhing bzang po la sa bon gdab//mtshams med pa dang sdig ngan yang / /mtshon rtsi mthong bas grol bar 'gyur/ /'dir dbang bskur ba tsam gyis ni/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /11—797

sbyin bdag bzang po rnal 'byor pa/ /rims gyis myur du byang chub thob/ /me tog chu'i dbang bskur dang / /cod pan rdo rje bdag po dang / /ming dang brtul zhugs rjes gnang dang / /bka' dang mthon 'phags nyid dang ni/ /spyod pa'i brtul zhugs bstan pa'i/ /gsang ba phyag rgya gtad pa ste/ /dbang bskur 'di dag thob pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun byis rab tu mchod/ /dbang bskur ba bcu bzhi pa'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon gye logs su ni/ /bskor la de nas 'jug pa dang / /longs spyod rdzogs par bzung nas ni/ /gnyis med ye shes ngal bso'o/ /mtshon la sogs pa dngos po kun/ /nang par tho rangs bsdu bar bya/ /bsdus nas gser kyis bum sogs su/ /bcug nas chu bo chen por dor/ /bum pa thams cad bsdus nas ni/ /don bzhin du ni dga' ston bya—/ /de nas rdzas lnga la sogs dang / /sbyar bsres ba ni byug par bya/ /sngar byi rdzas kyi lhag ma la sogs/ /gnyis med ye shes sbyin sreg bya/ /tsha' sdug dang rigs mthun bcas/ /skye bo dam pa gnyis med dang / /bkra shis glu'i rnam pa dang / /rdo rje dril bu rol par bya/ /srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags 'dul bar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dpar ldan/ /he ru ka dpal sngags pa lhan cig gar byed do/ /ha ha hu hu hūṃ/ sems can kun la phan byed pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga byas pa las/ /bsod nams thob pa de yis ni/ /'gro ba te ru kar gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'bo/ ra gyi cho ga slob dpon nag po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa yin no// //11—798

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ slad nas pan ṭi ta su ma ti kir ti'i zhal snga nas/ bod kyi lots+tsha ba ar+ya mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis zhu chen bgyis pa// //bsdur mchan/763 khya)chos tshan 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉la med pas 〈〈pe 〉〉la gzhir bzung nas 〈〈snar 〉〉dang bsdur ba yin/ mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ dzu〈〈snar 〉〉 dpal/ 3〈〈snar 〉〉chas/764 ①〈〈snar 〉〉mar/ dzu)〈〈snar 〉〉 na/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉bzhi/765 ①〈〈snar 〉〉rgyan gyis brgyan/767 tsho3 〈〈snar 〉〉dpang / ④〈〈snar 〉〉nas/76na ①〈〈snar 〉〉da/ la〈〈snar 〉〉la/773 ①〈〈snar 〉〉ni 'khor lo'i/774 1〈〈snar 〉〉ri mo/777 1〈〈snar 〉〉ru/778 ①〈〈snar 〉〉ko/781 sti〈〈snar 〉〉brgyan/786 ①〈〈snar 〉〉thag787 ①〈〈snar 〉〉gzi/788 ① 〈〈snar 〉〉pro 1〈〈snar 〉〉dzi/789 sti〈〈snar 〉〉tha/791 rmye〈〈snar 〉〉bsngags/ ༷〈〈snar 〉〉bu/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉rgon/ ñju〈〈snar 〉〉ji1792 ①〈〈snar 〉〉4 zhu〈〈snar 〉〉tā/ blu〈〈snar 〉〉ga / ④〈〈snar 〉〉ṣe/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉ṣa/793 ha〈〈snar 〉〉ba yī sti〈〈snar 〉〉tshal/ 1༄〈〈snar 〉〉bsrung /794 lha〈〈snar 〉〉tshig go/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉gzi/11byed799
796 1 〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag797 1 〈〈snar 〉〉skur/ 2 〈〈snar 〉〉 mchod pa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tshon/bsdur 'azas re'u migabyud/ ( 272)71 — 800

༄/ /dpal bde mchog 'gor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra sadza ra ho ma bi byeḥ2sna/ bod skad du/dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngo ser dmar po markata ljang gu'i sku 'chang spyan gsum can/ /dbang chen la sogs phyogs bzhi'i zhal mnga' shes rab dmar spyan gsum/ /phyag gnyis bgegs kyi lpags 'dzin rdo rje dril bu gnyis na 'chang //phyag gzhan phyag mtshan brgyad po 'dzin pa bde ba mchog gis srungs 4/ /thog mar bde mchog 'khor lo yi/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud las ni/ /sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /sbyin sreg rim pa bdag gis bshad/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni sgrub dus su/ /sbyin sreg gis ni tshim par byas/ /gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub la/ /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byung / /las rnams thams cad rab bsgrub phyir/ /sbyin sreg las rnams brtsam par bya/ /sbyin sreg las rnams med 11—801

pa las①/ /dngos grub 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de bas 'dir ni sngags pa yis—/ /brtson pas sbyin sreg las rnams bya/ /bla med nang dang phyi yi ste/ /sbyin sreg dag ni gsum du 'dod/ /gzhan dag zhi ba la sogs la/ /sbyin sreg dag ni bzhi ru 'dod/ /de la bla na med pa dang por brjod par bya ste/ /rnam rtog med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /thab khung sgra yi mtshan ma dag /rnam dben me yi dbus su ni/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po lnga/ /sems las byung ba ma lus pa'i/ /yam shing dag gi sreg blugs bya⑤/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i 'byung ba rnams/ /yam shing du ni rab grags yin/ /pad+ma thab khyang yin par bshad/ /rdo rje blugs gzar yin par grags/ /rtag tu sa bon sreg blugs kyis/ /bla med gnas ni thob par 'gyur/ /bla med rjes su sbyor ba yis/ /phung po ①la sogs bud shing bsregs/ /ye shes me ni skyes gyur pas/ /phyi rol bsreg pa bdag med yinarka/ /dz+nyā na bā da bas bshad pa/ /sbyin sreg cho ga phyi rim pa/ /sems dang sems byung dag yin te/ /phung po la sogs bud shing bsregasadu/ /ye shes 'bar ba bla med 'dod/ /sems kyis ji tsam bsams dupa dag /phyi rol sbyin sreg yin par 'dod/ /ye shes me la phung po yig/ /yam shing sreg pa bla med yin / /de nas yang nang gi brjod par bya ste/ nyon mongs sel dub zhi byed yin—/ /ting nge 'dzin ni rgyas byed phyir/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor bas bdag /ji lta bar ni sems kyis ④bya/ /skye ba'i las las rnam grol zhing / /tshe ni yang dag 'phel ba'i phyir/ /ci 'dod sreg blugs las bya ba/ /nang gi sbyin sreg dag tu bshad/ /ji ltar dus bzhi'i rim pa yis/ /sbyin sreg bzhi yang rab tu bshad/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /dbang dang mngon spyod shes par bya/ /sdig pa 11—802

'jig phyir zhi ba ste/ /bsod nams yongs 'dzin rgyas pa yin/ /chags pa bsgom phyir dbang 'grur te/ /rtog pa zad phyir gsod pa yin/ /de nas yang phyi'i bshad pa ①bya ste/ rgyud so so las slob dpon tha dad pas sbyin sreg gi cho ga ji skad bshad par ④bya/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las bstan te/ bdag gis 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag cung zad tsam ④brjod par bya'o/ /de la thab khung ni/ sems can dbye bas mtha' yas te/ /rigs kyi dbye bas lnga ru 'gyur//las kyi dbye bas bzhi ru 'gyur/ /thab khung rnams ni de ltar bshad/ /zhi ba la no zlum la dkar/ /rgyas la ser po dbang chen te/ /dbang la dmar po gru gsum pa/ /mngon spyod zla ba phyed pa yin/ /khru gang tshad nas brtsams nas ni/ /khru ni bcu drug pa yi bar/ /de yi tshad du brkos (7nas ni/ /rang gi tshad du bya ba yin/ /khru gang tshad kyi ⑤thab khung la/ /sor bzhi dor bar kha khyer sor bzhis bstodadu/ /khru byed brkos la de bzhin du/ /thams cad la yang blta bya ste/ /kun kyang rang gi kha khyer du bya'o/ /thab khung gi dbus su rdo rje dang zangs gri bri'o//thab khung gi nang du phyogs bzhir kha ṭī ga dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag mtshan rnams bri'o/ /kha khyer la pad+ma'i steng du zangs gri'i phreng ba/ thab kyi phyi rol du gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi par dkyil 'khor gyi thig btab ste/ 'khor lo gsum spubyen gyis brlabs la/ sgo bzhi dang ldan pa/ dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa ji ltar 'khor lo gsum gye dkyil 'khor gyi phyag mtshan bzhin du 'dir yang de ltar blta'o/ /shar rmi sgo la sogs par lcags kyu la sogs ⑧mtshan par bya'o/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor la/ pad+ma nags kyi lcug ma dang / /phreng ba dang ni spyi blugs dang //ri spudwags pags pa mdung rtse gsum/ /zla ba phyed pa rgyal mtshan dang / /ral 11—803

pa'i tshogs dang mig dang ni/ /'khor lo dung dang dbyug pa dang / /ral gri phub dang mdung dang ni/ /dril bu ba dan rma bya dang / /ra skyes lnga lnga byas nas ni—/ /shar phyogs snam bu dag la bri/ /de ltar thab thams cad byas nas/ /las dang rjes su mthun pa'i kha khyer bya'o/ /zhi ba la ni rdo rjes mtshan pa'am/'khor los mtshan pa'o/ /rgyas pa la ni rin po ches mtshan pa/ dbang la ni pad+mas mtshan pa/ drag po la ni rtse gsum pas mtshan pa ste/ 'di ltar las dang ①rjes su mthun par rang rang gi mtshan mas mtshan pa'i kha khyer bya'o/ /shar du zhi ba bya/ bar bshad/ /lho phyogs su ni rgyas pa ste/ /dbang gi las ni nub tu bshad/ /gsad pa byang du bya ba yin/ /ji ltar las dang rjes mthun par/ /rdul tshon gyis ni rdzogs par bri/ /yang na me tog dag kyang rung / /thab khung dag ni (mide ltar bya/ /yam shing bud shing rdzas la sogs/ /mtshan nyid me yi rtags rnams ni/ /gzhan du rgya cher bshad pas na/ /'dir ni bdag gis ma bsgrags ①so/ /man ngag gcig pu'i rim pa dag /rnal 'byor durgyud las grags pa rnams/ /mdor bsdus nas ni nges par yang / /ji tsam nus pa bshad par bya/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi ⑤lus khrus byas te/ dri zhim pos bdugs ( )la/ gur gum dang / tsan+dan dang / thal ba bsres pas lus byugs te—/ ji skad bshad pa'i rgyan bgo bar bya ste/ stag gi pags pa bgos shing / /phyag rgya lngas brgyan te/ na ra'i rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pas klu)sems can gyi don rtag tu bya'o/ /phyi rol bzlog tshul 'chang ba ni/ /de ni zhi sogs las rnams la//thugs ni zhi bar shes par bya/ /nyi mas gdungs pa'i rgya mtsho tsha/ /gangs ltar nang grang phyi rol tsha/ /thugs rje chen po'i khro bo yis/ /de bzhin 'gro batshul 11—804

'di gsungs/ /de ltar ①bu'i las dang rjes su mthun par gos kyi bye brag bgo bar bya'o/ /de ni sgrub pa po'i las so/ /de nas rang gi lha'i nga rgyal bskyed de/ji ltar bshad pa'i las dang rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs su byas la/ zhal bzhi pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi phur bu'i sngags dang / de bzhin du gsal byed ni rak+ṣa rak+ṣa dang / hūṃ gsum dang phaṭa ni brjod par bya'o/ /②gsang sngags de las khro bo la sogs pa spros te/ bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad bsreg par byas nas/thal ba ①dang bgegs rnams bsregs te/ phyogs bcur byer bar bsam mo /de bzhin du g.yas brkyang ba la sogs pa'i stang ④stabs kyang bya'o/ /'di ltar bgegs kyi tshogs rnams phur bu dang / rdo rje dra ba dang / ra ba la sogs pas thab khung gi thon khor bgegs med ⑤par bya ste/ thab khung byin gyis brlabs par shes par bya'o/ /yi ge hūṃ ngam rang gi lha'i tshogs kyi yi ge gang yang rung ba las dang rjes su mthun pa las duthab khung bskyed la/ de'i dbus ⑦lte ba la yi ge re pha 'bar ba yongs su gyur pa las gru gsum par byas shing bsgoms la/ de'i grwa gsum la oṃsnyahūṃ yi ge gsum gyis 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang / gzugs med pa'i khams gsum sa ④'og dang sa bla mtho ris kyi gzugs pad+ma dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje gsum bskyed de/ dbus su re pha 'bar ba yongs su gyur pa mjong ba dang —/ mtshan ma'i yi ge gsum dang / re pha yongs su gyur pa las 'bar ba'i dbus su chu'i dkyil 'khor gnas pa la khams gsum gyi bdag po dpal khrag 'thung bar spros te/ zhi ba'i don du pā ba ka'i me bsgoms la zhi ba'i gzugs can dkar po zhal gcig pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i cod pan canaphyag g.yas pa gnyis na dbyug tho dang / mi 'jigs pa/ g.yon pa na 11—805

bgrang phreng dang / spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang gos dkar po bsnams pa/ /mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba/ lus thams cad la bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun 'bab pa—/ ral pa la mkha' 'gro ma gnas par bsgom mo/ /de bzhin du ①rgyas pa la ni khyad par du mdog ser po/ gos ser ②po'i rgyan can/ dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ ye shes kyi mes ①sems can thams cad la mchog byed ba/stobs dang mdog dang dpal rdzogs par mdzad pa cod pan du bsgom mo/ /rim pa gzhan yang dbang dang dgug pa la 'dod pa'i me dmar po me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ gos dmar pos brgyan pa/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha cod pan la gnas pa/khyad par du g.yas g.yon na lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gzhan ni snga ma bzhin no/ /gsad dupa la rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa mdog nag po 'jigs pa spyan rlum po hūṃ gi sa bon las skyes pa gos dang rgyan nag po mi rus kyi phreng bas brgyan pa/ zla phyed lta bur 'bar ba'i dbu skra gyen du badze+es pa/gzugs can ma'i cod pan can/ /g.yas na ral gri 'dzin pa/ 'jigs byed chen po nag po 'bar ba las bya rgod dang khra la sogs pas/ nam mkha' khyab par bkug ste/ gang dang gang byas pa de zos par bsgom mo/ /rlung gi mes 5 ni gsad pa la sogs pa'i las bya'o/ /me lha'i mtshan nyid do/ /de la zhi ba la ni 'o ma can byi shing las byung ba'i me'am/ rgyun bzhag gi me'am/ bram ze tha ma'i mes bya'o/ /rgyas pa la ni rgyal po dang / blon po dang / dgon pa dang /rgyal rigs kyi rnam nas byung ba'i mes bya'o/ /dbang la ni smad 'tshong ma dang /rje'u rigs kyi khyim nas byung ba'i mes bya'o/ /dgug pa la buni gar mkhan dang /rol mo ba dang / lam du bus pa'i mes bya'o/ /gsod pa la ni rdo las byung ba'i 11—806

me'am/ gdol pa'i khyim nas byung ba'i mes bya'o/ /thams cad kyang dur khrod kyi me dang / dur khrod kyi sol bar ldan par bya'o/ /me'i mtshan nyid do/ /de nas mchod yon snod gnyis ni/ /ma chag sdug cing mdzes pa la chang ngam yang na sbyar ba'i chang / /me tog ldan pas dgang bar bya/ /de la bdud rtsi lnga po yis—/ /gnyis ka yang ni blug ①par bya/ /yi ge bdun pa gcig pu dang / /gnyis pa gnod mdzes rgyal po dag /gcig ni brgya rtsa brgyad pa ste/ /gnyis pa dag ni bzhi cha yin/ /gnas la legs par bzhag nas su/ /gos kyis bkab ste mchod par bya/ /mchod yon gyi snod kyi cho ga'o/ /sbyin sreg yo byad thams cad kun—/ /bdag gi ②g.yas su dgod par bya/ /rdo rje de bzhin dril bu dang / /mchod yon snod ni g.yon du gzhag /dgang gzar dang ni blugs gzar dang / /mar ni mdun du gzhag par bya/ /thams cad kyang ni bsangs nas gzhag① /'di ni rdzas gzhag ④pa'o/ /de nas phyi rol gyi me blangs la/ gnod mdzes kyi rgyal po'i gsang sngags kyis ku sha blangs te/ de'i chus lan gsum bsangs la/rtswa skam po gtsang ma dang bcas pas dag par byas te/ bdud rtsi lngas bsres ñjute thab khung du bzhag ste/ oṃ shrī te ru ka ma hā badz+ra dz+wa la ⑥hūṃ hūṃ/ gsang sngags 'di dang bcas par rlung g.yab kyis g.yab ste (pethab tu me sbar ro/ /de'i dbus su dam tshig sems dpa'i me sngar bshad pa'i rnam par bsams te/ ye shes sems dpa'i me sngags dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya 'dis spyan drangs te/ lag pa g.yas pa mi 'jigs par byas la/ mthe bong srin lag gi tshigs la bkug pa'i thabs kyis spyan drang ngo / /e bye hi ma hāzla ta de ba ṛ ④ṣi dī dza satwa ma kṛ ⑨nyi twa yu snye ma hā rasmi a smibe+edz+re ⑩hi to bha ba/ oṃ te ru ka ma hā badz+ra pā ba ka asna ye 11—807

ma ma shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ zhi ba'i'o/ /oṃ he ru ka ma hā badz+ra ma ten+d+ra/ asna ye ma ma puṣ+ṭi ku ru bo ṣaṭa rgyas pa'i'o/ /oṃhe ru ka ma hā badz+ra kā ma asna ye ma ma a mu ke ba shi ku ru ho/ /dbang gi'o/ /skahe ru ka ma hā badz+ra kro dha asna ye dza hi kro dha ya hūṃ a mu ke mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ mngon spyod kyi'o/ /me lha 'ongs pa dang 'jor 'thung dang nye reg byas te bkug la dam tshig gi me lha la gzhug go/ /de nas mchod yon gyi snod blangs la bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres te thugs ka nas zhabs bsel dbul lo/ /skaṭīhe ru ka ma hā badz+ra pra wā ①ra saṭ+wā re pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de nas lag pa gnyis kyis lan gsum asgo 'di dbul te/ oṃm hā ma ma ya tad ma kṛt+na sirnyim+bi pra yats+tsha swā hā/ spyan drang ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas 'khor lo gsum byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ skat+pahūṃ mgo bo dang mgrin pa dang ④snying ga rnams su'o/ /de nas yan lag drug tu dgod par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje sems ma la sogs pas yid kyis dbang bskur ro/ /khā su la snesogs pa brgyad kyis yang dag par mchod de—/ dar dpyangs dang phreng ba la sogs pa bcings te go bskon no/ /de nas me long dang sman la sogs pa khrus kyi yo byad dang / dril bu dkrol zhing spos dang rdzas snga ma dang bcas pa la yi ge brgya pa bzlas te khrus bya'o/ /yi ge ④brgya pa 'di dag ste/ chi he ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi'i gsang sngags dang / yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi gsang sngags kyis btab pa'i bum pa lngas dbang bskur ro/ /zhi ba la ni mkha' 'gro ma'i gzugs can rnam par snang mdzad dbu rgyan du bsam mo/ /rgyas pa la ni lā ma'i tshul can rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan du bsam mo/ /dbang la ni dum skyes ma'i tshul can snang ba mtha' yas dbu rgyan du bsam mo/ /gsang ba la ni 11—808

gzugs can ma'i tshul can don yod grub pa dbu rgyan du bsam mo/ /me lha'i zhal dang dgang gzar kyi kha la rang gi bdag po'i sa bon gyi yi ge dgod do/ /de nas oṃ ḍā ki smi ①dzi ni dzi ka swā hā/ 'dis mar la mngon par bsngags te/ de bzhin du rgyas pa la yang lā ma dang rin chen 'byung ldan la sogs pa'i sngags kyis gdab bo—/ /de ltar me 'bar bar shes nas thog mar blugs gzar gyis 3dgang blugs gsum/ oṃ shrī he ru ka dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ sngags 'di dang bcas par dbul lo/ /de nas me 'bar ba dang mdog dang sgra la sogs pa la sa ①bgegs med par shes nas / bgegs thams cad bcing bar bya ba'i phyir phyogs bzhi nas ku sha dgram mo / /oṃ.i ④me ku sha shu bha dib bya su ra brat+pa pa bi ta/ tri na rat+na tra ya ra ta nyi bye pethra thi bi dza gasgo/ a birgyu ma ma shārnyi ku ru ban+tu 6swā hā/ 'di lta bu'i rim pas rtsa ba dang bcas par phyung ste/ mdog ljang gu'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhi ba dang rgyas pa la sbyor ro/ /gzhan rnams la ni mnyam par gcad dupar bya'o/ /me'i rim pa ni shar ni shar gyi mdun nas te④/ lho ni lho'i mdun nas so/ /nub ni nub kyi mdun nas so/ /byang ni byang gi mdun nas so/ /me thab kyi sa phyogs kun du zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis mchod yon gyi snod la bsngags te bsang ngo /de nas zhal bzhi pa'i sngags sam/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha'i gsang sngags gang yang rung bas mda' dang tshon skud la btab ste/ mda' bzhi phyogs mtshams su btsugs la sna lnga'i skud pas yongs su bskor na rdo rje'i bcing ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /ku sha la sogs pa dgram pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas me'i las dang rjes su mthun par dngul byi sgod dmashe)/ pad+ma'i snod gang yang rung ba mdun du bsams te/ yang mchod yon dang zhabs bsil dang / 'thor 'thung byen la dgang blugs dbul lo/ /11—809

de la rim pa ni 'di yin te/ pus mo gnyis kyi nang du lag pa bzhag ste/ lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje khu tshur rmis dgang gzar blangs la/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung brtan par bzung ste/ sor mo lhag ma rnams yu ba'i steng du bzhag la mar gyis yongs su bkang ba'i dgang blugs bdun nam gsum mam gcig me lha'i sngags kyis me lha'i zhal du dbul lo/ /oṃ he ru ka asna ye a mu ka su shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du thams cad la yang sbyar ro/ /de nas bsreg pa'i rim pa blta bar bya ste/dang por dgang blugs dbul/ de nas yam shing ni 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du'o/ /mar ni zhal du'o/ /de nas til dang 'bras chan ①dang / zho ni ①phyag tu'o/ /de nas ku sha dang drur ba'i myu gu ni spyi gtsug la'o/ /de nas nas dang gro dang 'bras dang mon sran gre'u rnams ni zhal la'o du/ /de bzhin du zhi ba'i rdzas la sogs pa rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /dri ni thugs kar ro/ /me tog ni dbu la'o//bdug spos ni 'od 'bar ba la'o/ /zhabs bsel ni zhabs la'o/ /mchod yon dang 'jor 'thung ni phyag la'o/ /mar me ni mdun du ste/ de dag ni rim pa'o/ /de nas sdig pa bsreg pa'i phyir dang por til gyi sbyin sreg bya ste/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ de nas rdzas thams cad gsang sngags gcig gis bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la ya sadze+e sgyirja ku ru sat+tha birgyu ④ hūṃ phaṭa/ a mo ka mya shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ yang na oṃ he ru kā ya bid ma he bibyā spyorā dzā ya bye ma he tan no bī ra pa ra dzo ta ya ya hūṃ/ a mo ka gya shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ yang na rgyud gzhan las bshad pa so so'i spyi'i gsang sngags kyang rung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra adz+nyā ya swā hā/ yam shing gi'o/ /oṃ asna ye swā hā/ mar gye'o/ /oṃsarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā /zhes bya ba dang / pā paṃ da ha na ༷swā hā/ til dang yungs kar rnams kyi'o/ /11—810

oṃ saza saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho dang zan gyi'o/ /oṃ.a pra ti ha ta badzā ①ya swā hā/ku sha'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra uyuḥṣe swā hā/ drur ba'i myu gu'i'o/ /oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā—/ nas kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ghasma re swā hā/ /gro'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bi dza yā ya swā hā/'bru'i 'o/ /oṃ ma hā ba khā ya swā hā/ ma sha'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/'bras ma grugs ④pa'i 'o/ /oṃ ma hā bye ①bha ya bha ye swā hā/ star ka dang / bla gor zho sha dang / dzā ti pha la rnams kyi'o/ /zhu ba'i rdzas lhag ma rnams kyi ni me'i rang gi gsang sngags rnams kyis sbyin sreg bya'o/ /u dusmra dura'i shing gi yal ga la sogs pa spyolhag ma rnams la ni/ oṃ la sogs pa nas rang gi ming dang mthar swā hā bcas pa'i rim pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /rdzas thams cad la bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres te—/ sbyin sreg bya'o/ /⑥de nas me la 'thor 'thung dang / bsang gtor la sogs pa bya 4ste/ ye shes kyi me lha spyan drangs la/ snying ga nas yi ge hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bskul nas nam mkha' las bkug ste/ las ma lus pa'i gzhi 'jig rten las ⑧'das pa'i ye shes kyi me lha ji skad bshad pa'i las kyi rgyan dang / na bza' dang / ji skad bshad pa'i mdog dang / phyag ji ltar gnas pa'i dpal khyag 'thung gi gzugs byon pa dang / de'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'i sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams dang / rang gi dam tshig gi phyag rgyas ye shes sems dpa' byin drang ngo / /'khyud pa'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra te ru ka e bye nyi bha ga bān⑨ / i ha bākya ⑫sa ma ye ma tsa pañja i ⑪mṛ ta ar+ghaṃ saṃ pra tīts+tsha ⑫swa bu rtsa bi tra si ta me/ 'dis thab khung g.yas kyi drung du bltas te/ oṃ shrī badz+ra te te ru ru rka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki dī dzā la saṃ ba ra ⑫swā hā/ zhabs bsil dang mchod yon dang /'thor 'thung dang / lha bshos dang / khā gye ④la sogs pas yang dag par 11—8 11

mchod de/ rtsa ba'i sngags brgyad kyis bstod do/ /rdo rje bcings la lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang / be+egs sgog dang / dril bu rnams kyis dgug pa dang /gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang / dbang du bya'o/ /rngo sh+ya dzatshohūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya ste sa ma ya ho 'dis me lha'i ④dam tshig sems dpa'i zhal du thams cad kyi bdag nyid rab tu gzhug go/ /de ltar snga ma bzhin du me long gi thog tu khrus byas la dbang lnga gsol te/ dar dpyangs dang / phreng ba bcings te/ ye shes sems dpa' rang gi thugs kar mtshan ma'i dbus su rang gi zla tshes kyi yi ge la dkyil 'khor ma lus pa drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha'i rang bzhin mthong ba la yang mchod yon phul te/snga ma bzhin du sbyin sreg gi yo byad thams cad bsangs te/ de nas dgang gzar blangs la ji tsam nus pa'i dgang blugs me lha'i zhal du dbul lo/ /de bzhin du blugs gzar gyis stong ngam/ brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ phyed dam/ bzhi cha yang rung bsreg go/ /de nas yang dgang blugs gsum dbul te/ 'di ltar dkyil 'khor ma lus pa kun la bcu cha'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /thams cad la dgang blugs dang spos dang / dril bu'i sgra dang yi ge brgya pa gsum mam gcig bzlas te/ me tog la sogs pa dag pa dbul lo/ /sbyin sreg gi yo byad thams cad kyis snga ma bzhin du sbyin sreg bya'o/ /dbyangs skyong gi gsang ①sngags sam yi ge bdun pa'am/ rdo rje phag mo'i nye ba'i snying po'i gsang sngags gang yang rung ba las 'di zhes bya ba shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya ba mthar gdags so/ /rgyas pa'i mthar ni puṣ+ṭing ku ru/ bo ṣaṭa dbang gi mthar ro/ /gsad pa'i mthar phaṭa/ yang dri zhim po las byung ba ci yang rung ste/ thams cad bdag gis kha zas la sogs pa 'byor ba'i don du sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i sbyin sreg byas 11—812

la dngos grub kyi phyir/ rgyud las bshad pa'i rdzas rnams kyis sbyin sreg bya'o/ /ba lang sha dang rta sha dang / /shwa na'i sha dang khyer bya dag /dkyil 'khor gru gsum byas nas ①ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang nges par 'jig /phyir bzlog phreng ba'i gsang sngags kyis/ /zhi ba la sogs las rnams bya/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gnyis kyis/ /dgug pa la sogs bya ba yin/ /de nas ji ltar 'dod pa'i sbyin sreg byas pa'i mthar oṃ dīḥha ha hūṃ ①hūṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po 'di gsum mam / bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig mar gyi sreg blugs kyis sbar la/ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil dang / 'thor 'thung dang / dril bu'i rol mo snga ma bzhin du dbul lo/ /dgang blugs kyi mthar bde legs spyodang rol mo dang / bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dbul lo/ /de nas bstod pa bya ste/ mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub gsol la/ bzod par gsol lo/ /rdo rje bcing ba'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ te ru ka muḥ'adis steng du dgrol te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad / /ces pa la sogs pa brjod do/ /de nas oṃ kha kha khā hi zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis nya dang sha dang / chang dang / zan dron la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i gtor ma byin no/ /me'i dbus nas ye shes sems dpa' chos kyi dbyengs su gyur te gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas me la mchod yon la sogs pa phul te/ sbyin sreg gi yo byad lhag ma rnams kyang sbyin sreg bya'o/ /sreg blugs kyi mthar bsgrub bya bzung la dgang blugs dbul lo/ /mchod yon ④zhabs bsil dang bsang gtor yang bya/ sgrub pa po mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyang gsol te/ oṃ agha ye ya hi ya hi/ sarde rtse khe /3pa ra a rja tsa sa ti dha ma ga tsa ha phyag byug ces bya'o/ /spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las mthe bong phyir bskyed pa'i tshul 11—813

kyis sprul 1pa'i rnge 'bar ba'i gzugs can du blta ba de gshegs su gsol te/rang gi lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma sbyin no/ /rje btsun gyi yi ge brgya pa yang lan bdun gyi bar du bzlas brjod bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra gī li tī khā ༷ ya/ zhes bya bas phyogs kyi phur bu dang / mda' rnams phyung la/las thams cad pa'i chu 'o ma dang bcas pa khaṇ+ḍa ro ha'i rig sngags kyis btab ste/khrus byas la gzhag go/ /de nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ glu dang gar la sogs pa mdun du bya zhing ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o// //dpal sdom rnal 'byor ma rgyud las/ /sbyin sreg rim pa phyung ba 'dis/ /— rnal 'byor pa ni rtag dga' ba'i/ /dngos grub myur du grub par shog /dpal he ru ka'i ming gi rgyud las/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga grub pa'i slob dpon chen po nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dha1 bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rig pa gzhon nus bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// // 71—814

brtsar mchananaX1 ①macan byang 'di gzhung las blangabasate bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bzhugag sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—na ①〈〈snar 〉〉ga bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrungs//༷2 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'ag ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byas/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa'i rtsa rnams ni/ /bzhi po yang de ru son pa'o/ / — kulngatā ni brtson chen sko(zhes pa deb 'di'i ldeb 824nga21byed827nga2par dpe bsdur byas yodaka) ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsreg cha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsam/ ( )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉se/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/8༷3 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—tsam/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byed du bgog 'a)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyig dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsod/ la〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 4 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pag po)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'i 8༷4 6)〈〈pe 〉〉〈rtesnar 〉〉—dngaka ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyang / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub sa/ sti〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 lga⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyig ( ste〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bdug bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lag8༷5 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga cha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—bya'o/ / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ba/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stangs/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnamad/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnalag du 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ga ⑧〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—sa/naX6 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bu/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ser po/ gos ser/ pe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—mes du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsag ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉semag 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas8༷7 ①rte〈pe 〉〉〈rtesnar 〉〉sagag ②〈nape 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gig ①du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉rte〈snar 〉〉bsregadu〈〈pe 〉〉〈rtesnar 〉〉rgodz+wa ka ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉g.yabs te/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byu tar+ya ba ri/ ⑨rte〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gri/ ⑩〈rtepe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnam sanan ni//༷/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉(〈snar 〉〉—dngaka ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈rtesnar 〉〉—la/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ni/naX9 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgo ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhi6)〈〈snar 〉〉dze+e ( )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rbaskyo/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉por bcad/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—te/6ste〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dngaka/1༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉can/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ni/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉go ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsne/11—815

0347༄7/ /daphyid kyi thig le zhes bya ba/17༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba ldusan+ta ti la ka nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpyid kyi thig le zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam bde chen sum cu rtsa bdun byang chub chen po'i phyogs bzhugs phung po chos kyi rang bzhin gnas pa rang lus rtsa yi 'khor lo gtso bo bzhi/ /dbyangs yig lngar bcas bcu gnyis dbyangs yig don gyi phyi mo gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhis brgyan cing sku gsung thugs kyi dbye bas gnas pa'i gnas la sogs/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug kun 'gro 'gro kun rang snying dbus gnas nam mkha'i ngo bo mchog zhi te ru ka dpal dam pa'i de nyid mya ngan 'das rang bzhin/ /rab gsal dpyid kyi thig le 'od 'phros 'bar ba sku gsum rgyas pa legs rtogs 'gro ba'i rang bzhin don bde stsol ba rtsa yi 'khor lo'i mgon la rab btud nas/ /sbyor ba'i gdan las rnam byung ba/ /phyi nang bcas pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /'khor lo bde 11—817

mchog dpal rim las/ /dpyid kyi thig le bshad bya ste/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dpal grub/ /rang gi lus la rnam gnas pa/ /shin tu nyung bar 'dod rnams la//gsal bar go bar bya ①phyir ro/ /bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor spang byas nas/ /bcos ma'i sbyin sreg las dag dang / /bcos ma'i bsgom pa'i las dag dang / /bcos ma'i bzlas pa nyid du ni/ /de la sogs pa'i bcos ma kun/ /rang bzhin rnal 'byor tshul gyis spang / /phyi rol bcos ma rab bya ba/ /rang bzhin rtogs par bya phyir te/ /rang bzhin rtogs par gyur pa na/ /rab tu bya ba byed min nyidaske/ /ji ltar pha rol don gnyer 'gas/ /gzings la legs par sbyor 'gyur ba—/ /pha rol son nas 'dor bar 'gyur/ /rab tu bya ba'ang de bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs pas gang zhig /bcos ma'i bsam pas byed pa dag /thams cad legs te mi legs min/ /de rab sbyar ba gsal ba yin/ /de ru las ni rab 'bad de/ /dngos mchog rig pa'i rgyal ba yis/ /sgra shes bya phyir bstan bcos gang / /drang srong gis ⑤byed ji lta ba'o/ /de ltar las kyi rjes 'brangs pas/ /mi rnams rab bya byed pa ni/ /'bad pas nyon mongs bslang — ba yis/ /rang gi sems ni rnam par 'joms/ /de nas dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i—/ /cho ga'i bya ba'i yan lag la/ /'bad kun rnam par 'dren min nyid/ /ngal bar byed pa 'ba' zhig yin/ /rnam min rtog la sangs rgyas min/ /rnam rtog bcas pas min de bzhin/ /shin tu rnam dag yongs shes pas/ /mkhas pa rnams ni 'gyur ba nyid/ /bya ba rang bzhin nyid du yod/ /byed pa po yang rang bzhin nyid/ /bya dang byed pa'i dngos po yis/ /rang bzhin nyid kyi dngos po spangs/ /dbye ba kun gyi rang bzhin ni/ /a yig yang dag rnam par gnas/ /11—818
