༄7/ /sdom pa bshad pa/17༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ ba ra bya 37khyu/ bod skad du/ sdom pa bshad pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byer ma 'byel las/ /bde mchog bshad pa 'byung ba ste/ /in+d+ra zla ti'i snyegazhung nyid dang / /kun spyod dā ri ka gzhung gis/ /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ru gsungs/ /dpal ldan 'bar ba 'dzin zhabs 4 sam / /ka tso ta yi gzhung rnams kyis/ /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ru grags/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs dpa' zhibor bcas/ /sgo spyong ma dang yang dag ldan/ /khro bo'i gzugs ni hūṃ dang bcas/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /lha mo rab tu gtum sogs bzhin/ /sku mdog sna tshogs khyad par ro/ /brtul zhugs zhal snga nas kyi ra6gzhung / /phyag gnyis dang ni zhal gcig pa/ /sgeg sogs ro ni thams cad kyis/ /de rnams 'gying bas rol bar 11byed1030

'gyur/ /yang na sems ni rnam dag pa/ /sku mdog sngon po rnam pa'i dbyibs/ /dpa' bo lha mor yang dag ldan/ /kha cig gis ①ni gzhung du brjod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /kha dog gsum du yang dag gnas/ /gang phyir 'khor lo gsum gsungs pa/ /de phyir kha dog gsum du 'gyur/ /'di rnams nang nas gang 'dod pa/ /de kun rnal 'byor pas gus bya/ /phyag gnyis la sogs brtsams nas ni/ /ji srid phyag ni 'bum de bzhin/ /phyag dang zhal ni grub phyir minarka/ /bsam yas sbyor bas bsam par bya/ /de ltar blo bzang shes nas ni/ /gnyis med ye shes bsgom par bya/ /dad pa tsam gyis 'jug bya ba/ /dpyad pa nyid du sbyar mi bya/ /mchog tu dga' bas 'di dag kun/ /gang bsgoms 'bras bu mchog phan te/ /lhan cig skyes par thim pa yis/ /he ru ka nyid rnam par bsgom/ /bla ma'i bka' lung blangs nas ni/ /dang por gus pa'i sems kyis su//brten pa'i sems kyis sgom ①byed na/ /dam pa'i phun tshogs thob par 'gyur/ /'bar ba'i phyag rgyar sdom par min/ /slob dpon kha cig smra bar byed/ /he ru ka 'byung rgyud gsung ①yin/ /bde mchog nyid du ma yin pas/ /de phyir bdag gis ma bris te/ /dpal ldan rdo rjes bzod par mdzod/ /man ngag gis ni phag mo yi/ /rgyud du nges par rab tu grags/ /'bar ba yi ni phyag rgya yis/ /dkyil 'khor dgug pa'i don dang ni/ /bde mchog gtor ma'i las rnams kyang //te ru ka ni 'byung rgyud du/ /he ru ka phyag la gnas pa/ /he ru ka yi rgyud du gsungs/ /na bza' dag gi khyad par ni/ /stag gi pags pa mnabs pa ste/ /bdag gi bla mas gsungs pa yang / /lhan cig skyes pas smad dkris na/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi ni gzugs/ /rtag tu du ba mchog gi mchog /dkar ba dang ni 11—1031

khrag gi mdog /khams drug gis ni bsdus pa 'i / /kha dog la sogs mtshungs pa'i gzugs/ /dang po nyi ma lta bu'i zhal/ /lha mo skra ni grol ba nyid/ /gzhung ni 'di gnyis bgros nas ni/ /snying ga ru ni bsgom bya zhing / /ji ltar 'dod pa'i de nyid bya/ /gzhan yang khrag gi rtsa rgyud du/ /shin tu dmar bar 'bab pa yang / /bud med me tog g.yas nas so/ /g.yon du khya ba 'bab pa ni/ /chu yi rgya mtsho lta bu ste/ /de ni dpa' bo'i rang bzhin no/ /rkang dang rus pa rtsa rgyus rlung / /lnga pa khu ba dang ldan pa/ /pha las gyur pa 'di rnams yin/ /ma yi sha pags khrag dang ni/ /chu dang me dang bcas pa nyid/ /de nyid kyis ni gang grub pa / /'di ni mgon po he ru ka /bskyed dang skyed par byed pa po/ /pha ma gnyis ni dbyer med pas/ /dpal ldan bde mchog bshad pa 'di/ /yon tan kun gyi /1 gter gyur pa/ /dngos po kun byi rang bzhin no/ /de ltar shes nas de yi gzugs/ /srid gsum bde ba ster ba ni/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pa yis bsgomasno/ /sgra yi tshul la nges 'byung ba/ /zhes bya ⑤la sogs gang 'dod de/ /de don bdag gis bshad par bya/ /'jug pa yi yang mtshan nyid ni/ /rab tu 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ /phyi rol rjam gcig pyamatshan nyid do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu gsungs/ /ldog pa bdag gis brjod par bya/ /'khor lo sdom par yang dag gnas/ /lhan cig skyes pa rnams kyi gzugs/ /de ni snying gar rtag tu gnas/ /phyi rol nang du mnyam pa nyid/ /dkyil 'khor gyi yang sems kyis ni/ /rnam par dgod pa bshad nas so/ /de ni lus gnas bshad par bya/ /he ru ka yi rol par brjod//rnam dag dang ni te ru ka /yan lag dag dang nying lag dang / /lhan cig skyes 11—1032

pase mnyam bzhag ①pas/ /phyis ni rnal 'byor pa yis 1bsgom/ /go rims ④bzhin du lus skyes ni/ /rdo rje phur bu lhan cig skyes/ /bcings pa thig skud rab tu ldan/ /shin tu mtshams med brtan dupar bcings/ /gur ni rus pa'i phreng ba nyid/ /mchod pa'i cho ga khyad par bzang / /yan lag phyag rgyas brgyan pa dang / /go ⑤mtshams med par dhibacings pa ni/ /de ni go cha chen por ldan/ /gang zhig mi dmigs pa thas brtsebu/ /sems can kun la phan mdzad ma/ /lha dang lha min mi ④rnams la/ /'di dag thams cad de yis khyab/ /rkang pa'i mthil du rtsom pa'i rlung / /yang dag gnas shing lter son par/ /me yi dkyil 'khor gzi brjid 'bar/ /lto bar ches ni dkar ba yi6/ /chu ni mdzes pa nyid kyi gzugs/ /brang du yang ni dbang chen ni/ /kha dog ser pos rnam par spras/ /mgrin pa'i steng du brten pa yi/ /rtse brgyad ldan pa'i ri rab po/ /bdun ldan nyi ma uli zla/ / dri med zla ba'i gzi brjid nyid/ /⑫nang du 'gro dang 'ong ba dang —/ /chu skyes 'dab ma sum cu drug /ldan par rdo rje'i dbus son par/ /phywali kā li las byung grub/ /mdzes pa'i spyi bor hūṃ byas te/ /der gnas gser kyi gnas su ni/ /sna tshogs dbus su dang po'i ming / /zhes bya lhan cig skyes pa yang —/ /dri med zla ba'i gzi brjid nyid/ /yan lag kun gyi mtshams su ni/ /rim gyis ⑪'gro bar byed pad+ma/ /sna rtse dbus kyi gnas su yang / /rim pas skyed par byed pa ni/ /sum cu rtsa drug ror ldan pa'i/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i rtsa rnams kyis—/ /spyi skyes thog ma med pa yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni bskul ⑩bar bya/ /mkha' 'gro bya bzhin rnam dag khams/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi ⑫dra ba zhes/ /'di yi don ni yang dag grags/ /rgya mtsho shin tu sna tshogs pa'i/ /'gram dang ri yi 11—1033

dbang por ldan/ /zab mo sna tshogs snying po yang / /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod nyid/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang / /dril bu do shal shin tu mdzes//gsum gyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /de yi lus su dkyil 'khor nyid/ /srad bu mchog gis shin tu spras/ /rnga yab kyis ni g.yob pa dang / /so phag rnam par dag pa yi/ /rdul tshon dri ma med pa dang / /bum pa la sogs gzhag pa dang —/ /de byung ldan par gang bas ni/ /lhan cig skyes gnas bri bar bya/ /thal ba ro bsregs las byung ba/ /pad ⑫gnas khro ②ba med pa yis/ /sbyor ba'i ye shes shin tu mdzes/ /phag mo gnyis su med pa'i gzugs/ /he ru ka de sems su brjod/ /rgyu lnga zhes bya'i rig pa ni/ /rdo rje zhes ni mngon par brjod//der gnas sa bon rdzogs pa ni/ /de ni te ru ka dpal brjod/ /gnyis med don gyis shrī yi sgra/ /te ni rgyu ni rnam spangs pa/ /ru yi gzugs ni 'jigs pa'i (/don/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /phywali kā li mnyam sbyor bas/ /dkar zhing dmar ba'i rang bzhin can/ /shrī ni yang dag bshad pa ni/ /thams cad skyed par byed pa'i rgyu/ /shrī ni kla klo'i skad kyis ni/ /bha ga'i don du mngon par brjod/ /sems ni he ru ka nyid de/ /dpal he ru kar rab tu bsgrags/ /bha ga'i sgra ni ngag lam 'das/ /ru shatwoni dri ma rnam par spangs/ /he ka ni rgyu ni rnam 'jig pa/ /phag mo'i sgrar ni rab tu grags/ /skyes ⑥par byed pa'i rgyu yi phyir—/ /ral pa'i rtsa ba zhes byar bshad/ /sna tshogs sems can don byed phyir/ /sna tshogs rdo rjer rnam par gnas/ /byang chub sems ni zla bar gsungs/ /dpal ldan bde chen 'khor lor gnas/ /der gnas rtag tu 'dzag pa ni/ /rdo rje pad+mar yang dag gnas/ /cha kun du ni yongs gang bas/ /rgya mtsho yi ni lam 11—1034

rnams su/ /'dzag pa yi ni lam pa ste/ /lte ba'i 'gram gnas bdud rtsi ni/ /sngar gsungs rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams skyes/ /stong pa'i rnam par sbyor ba las/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams ni/ /rang bzhin gcig pas dag pa ni/ /shin tu dag pas bsdigs stipar byed/ /byang chub sems byung thal ba yis/ /yan lag kun la rnam par gnas/ /thal ba'i dag par rtag tu brjod/ /phyi rol nang du yongs dag gnas/ /yan lag bcu gnyis las byung phyir/ /phyag ni bcu gnyis rnams dang ldan/ /zhal bzhi yang dag gsungs pa ni/ /rnam thar bzhi ni dag pa'o/ /lha mo gzugs can mkha' 'gro ma/ /dum skyes ma dang khā mā ḍa27nyid/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnam bzhi/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu skyong bar mdzad/ /gnyis med rnam pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gang tshe dbang sogs 'thungs (9pa ni/ /de tshe bza' ba zhes byar brjod/ /phyag rnams nyid kyi mtshan nyid do/ /rtse gsum sgu gsum dag pa'i phyirarka/ /glang po gti mug rnam par 'jig /lus ngag yid gsum las (chobyung ba'i—/ /skyon ni dgra stas gcod par byed/ /gri gug rnon pos sems can don/ /brtson 'grus yang dag ldan phyir 'phyar/ /rtag tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sgra ni cang te'u (9brtag par bya/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin pas/ /rdo rje stong pa'i mes bsregs pa/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /kha ṭī ga ni yan lag gnas/ /thod 'gro skyong ba thod pa'i sku/ /des na de ni thod par brjod/ /snying rje'i dhiro yis gang ba ni/ /'thungs pa he ru ka nyid rgyal/ /zhags pas skyon ni rnam par bcings/ /lus can ma lus gzhan dbang (pe'agyur/ /mgo bo tshangs pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /dril bu shes rab rang bzhin phyir/ /yig 'bru lnga bcu'i mgo bo rnams/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rnam par mdzes/ /mgul gyi nor bu 11—1035

phreng bas brgyan①/ /grub pa'i gnas ni kun gyi bdag /mche ba bzhi dang rab ldan pas/ /bdud bzhi rnam par dral bar mdzad/ /tshems phreng rtag tu gnyis med pa/ /me stag tshogs dang yang dag ldan/ /pha rol phyin drug rnam dag pa/ /phyag rgya drug gis legs par brgyan/ /nam mkha'i gos kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /stag gi pags pa cha med par/ /kun gyi 'gro ba thams cad ni/ /stong pa'i spyor bas g.yas brkyang pa/ /he ru ka yi khyad par las/ /des na g.yas brkyang ba zhes bshad/ /g.yon pa'i yan lag bskum pa zhes/ /tshig tu brjod pas g.yas brkyang ba/ /mtshan nyid yang dag thob pa yin/ /dpal ldan he ru ka 'byung ba/ /'khor lo tshogs ni kun du'o/ /slob dpon gzhan gyi lugs dag gis/ /g.yas pa'i zhabs ni bskum par 'dod/ /blo bzang kha cig gar yang byed/ /gnyis ka 'dod pa ma yin te/ /g.yon na g.yon pa skye bos mdzes/ /don mchog thams cad sbyin par nus/ /g.yon gyis rtag tu rnal 'byor pa'i/ /gnod pa kun las 'jigs rgyal byed/ /gang phyir sdom pa gtso bo ②yis/ /des par thams cad g.yon las 'byung / /de phyir cho gas nus pa kun/ /las ni g.yon pas rtag tu bya—/ /sems dang sems min 'gog pa'i lam/ /mtsho skyes su ni bus gang mtshon/ /rdo rje mthar ni rnam byung (kyeba'i/ /ro mnyam rtse gcig de yin te/ /phag mo sbyor mchog skyes 'dzin rig /gang phyir gtso bor gnas pa ni/ /lha mo mchog gnas sdom pa ste/ /de phyir g.yon pa'i cho gas brgyan/ /nyi zla rnam dag srid las skyes/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ro mnyam de/ /pad+ma mchog gi gnas su lhung —/ /ri skyes rang byung yang dag ldan/ /ḍi ni mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas khams su rab tu brtags/ /nam mkha' kun du rgyu grub pas/ /11—1036

mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya bar brjod/ /de las skyes pa gzugs ji bzhin/ /gzugs can ma zhes mngon par brjod/ /gzugs las rim pas skyes pa nyid/ /mtshon par yang ni dum skyes ma/ /gang yang mdzes pas yongs gang ba/ /skyes pa bud med las byung ba/ /mtshan ma kun ni ①yongs su rdzogs/ /des na lā mar rab tu grags/ /nga rgyal la sogs kun bral ba/ /des na bla re ru ni grags/ /pad+ma chos kyi dbyings yin te/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun gye gnas/ /'dod chags skyon dang bral ba ni/ /bzhi pa'i gnas skabs dang ldan pas/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /de ni dpa' bo zhes byar brjod/ /de nas thams cad yang dag thob—/ /stong pa snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i ngo bo gang / /de ni dpa' mo'i dbang phyug yin/ /'di ni dga' ba'i brjod med pa/ /'khor lo sdom pa sde tshan mtha'/ /rtag tu kha ni 'og gis ni/ /yan lag kun gyi yid 'phrog 'dzag /'dod chags la sogs rtswa ⑤dang mtshungs/ /ye shes srin bus zos pa ni/ /mi rtog pa yi rang bzhin gyis/ /kun rdzob tu ni de pyong ngo / /nam mkha' pad+ma'i mkha' dbus su/ /mkha' spyod du ni 'gro bar 'dod/ /der gnas shin tu rnam spros pa/ /mkha' spyod 'khor lor (7yang dag bshad/ /sa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas/ /lte ba'i pad+mar skye dang 'chi/ /der gnas shin tu legs par bya/ /sa spyod 'khor lor yang dag bshad/ /sa 'og ces ni gang gsungs pa/ /pad+mar byang chub sems lhung ba/ /dri med yid kyi pha rol tu/ /sa yi 'og tu gnas pa'i sems/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa yis/ /te ru ka yi rnam par gnas/ /k+ṣiṃli kā li mnyam ldan pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bas mdzes/ /k+ṣiṃdukhyu sprul pa'i 'khor lo ④ni/ /pad+ma'i nang du yang ḍa stedag 11—1037

gnas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pa ste/ /'jig rten gsum gyi ①rgyas par brjod/ /oṃ r+ghaṃ byāḥkhaṃ ④pad+ma phyogs phyogs 'dab ma la/ / waṃ rmā bī two ④mtshams cha la/ /dbus su te ru ka sa bon/ /lte ba mchog tu pad rang gnas/ /chos kyi lte ba pad chen por/ /stong pa'i rdo rje 'chang ba gnas/ /der gnas rtag tu 'dzag pa ste/ /'dod pa'i don kun grub par byed/ /de steng ④longs spyod 'khor lo la/ /oṃ gyi yi ges mtshan pa yi/ /kha ni rtag tu gyen tu blta/ /a i lhan cig u e ni/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog dpa' bor ldan/ /de steng mgrin pa'i gnas su ni/ /de ru mkha' 'gro ma gnas pa/ /der ni rtag tu gnas pa niphye/ /mchog tu dga' ba nyid du 'dod/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor hūṃ/ /zla ba'i 'od zer ltar 'dzag 'dod/ /der ni 'gro dang 'ong bar ni/ /mig gis kyang ni mthong mi 'gyur/ /myur ba steng du rnam par bshad/ /rlangs pa ngos su rnam par gnas/ /'ching ba dbus su yang dag gnas/ /dal ba rtag tu rab tu grags/ /rgyu mthun dang ni rnam smin dang / /skyes bu de bzhin mtshan nyid med/ /'dir ni 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi/ /dga' ba rnams su rab tu grags/ /chung ngu 'bring dang chen po dang / /chen po las kyang chen po ste/ /sems kyi dbye ba rnam pa bzhi / /mid ⑥la sogs pa rnam par 'phrul/ /lus la sprul pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /nges par lte ba las skyes te/ /de ni sna tshogs skad cig bshad/ /chos kyi rang bzhin skye ba ni/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal zhi ba'o/ /rnam par smin nyid snying ga las//rtag pa ru ni skyed par byed/ /longs spyod ces ni bya ba la/ /du ma rnams kyi cha shes bya/ /de ni rnam nyed rang bzhin no/ /spyi bor shes dang shes bya gnas/ /yid la rnam par spangs pa ste/ /de ni mtshan nyid bral rang bzhin/ /lhan cig 11—1038

skyes sogs dga' ba bzhi/ /lhan cig skad cig dag las skyes/ /'khor lo'i gtso bor skad cig ni/ /gzhan yang dga' ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /phreng ba tsan+dan bud med sogs/ /gang tshe mthong bas bde 'dzin pa/ /de tshe dga' bar yang dag bshad/ /sems can kun la yang dag gnas/ /rdo rje pad+mar mnyam spyor bas—/ /ji ltar sems ni rnam par gnas/ /de yi sems gang mtshon pa ni/ /de tshe mchog tu dga' bar brjod/ /sbyor ba las ni dga' bral sems/ /bde ba'i mthar ni yang dag gnas/ /de ni dga' bral zhes byar gsungs/ /skye dang 'jig par rab tu grags/ /dga' dang mchog tu dga' ba dang / /dga' bral dang ni rnam gsum mo/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ① rang bzhin 'di/ /brtan g.yo kun sogs rang bzhin te/ /lhan cig skyes pas thams cad gang / /bsam yas su ni rgyal bas gsungs/ /gang phyir brjod med kun 'gro ba/ /ye shes he ru ka ru brjod/ /shes rab gzhan gye gnas su brjod/ /gang gi gnas 'di thabs nyid ②de/ /'di dag gnyis su med pas ni/ /sbyor ba'i gnas su gnas pa yin / /de las byung ba de nyid gnas/ /de dang bral bar gang gnas pa/ /lhan cig skyes zhes yang dag brjod/ /ngag gi lam 'das spyod yul nyid/ /bdag gi de nyid rtag sngags dang / /dkyil 'khor de nyid yang dag ldan/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa 'di/ /'di yi sku la rnam par gnas/ /dmigs pa las ni sangs rgyas yin/ /dmigs pa med pa rdo rje (snye'adzin/ /gnas gnyis dag tu ma brten pasde/ /shes rab gnyis med nye bar gsungs/ /gnas bcu la sogs sa 57dag ni/ /pha rol phyin mchog bcu po de/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir phye ba yis/ /thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /'di rnams rim pa ji lta bar/ /spyi bo spyi 11—1039

gtsug la sogs dang / /ji sred pus mo gnyis dag tu/ /'di rnams kyi ni gnas dag tu/ / bdag po ①la sogs blta bar bya/ /skyed ④pa dang ni gnas pa dang rka/ /rab tu thim pa zhes bya ba/ /pul+lī ①ra ni bdag po ste/ /'bar ba 'dzin par longs spyod gnas/ / rkoḍān ⑦du ni thim par gsungs/ /gnas sogs zhing dang dur khrod du/ /yan lag kun la thim par 'gyur/ /sdom pa zhes bya'i mtshan nyid do/ /sprul pa yis ni gang du skyes/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyu yi gnas/ /chos kyi sku yi rang bzhin gyis/ /thim par 'gyur bar duthe tshom med—/ /de ltar sku yi cha rnams kyi6)/ /dbang dang longs spyod dag dang thim/ /ji ltar gnas su de bzhin du/ /dga' ba rtag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /skye ba dang ni gnas pa dang / /rim pa yis ni rab thim 'gyur/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bskul bas—/ /gnad kyi sgo nas dbye bar bya/ /dpal ldan 'bar 'dzin bu gar ni/ /de yi skad cig bde 'byung bas/ /bde bas thig le skyes me'agyur zhing / /thig le brtan dang g.yo ba'i bdag /de ni phag mo de sangs rgyas/ /dpa' bo gnyis med ldan pa yin/ /phung sogs sangs rgyas de rnams dang / /khams kyi'ang 'byung khyangs rnam par brjod/ /bud med skyes pa gnyis su brtags/ /lhan cig skyes pa rnam pa gnyis/ /thams cad yul du brjod pa ni/ /nam mkhar thim pas bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /de la gang dag spyod pa ni/ /thams cad mkha' la spyod par 'gyur/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyi dra ba yi⑧/ /bde ba dag gi snying po'o/ /'dir ni phreng med sngags bzlas med/ /lhan cig skyes pas thams cad gnas/ /de phyir rnam rtog med pa yis/ /'bad pas gus pa bskyed par bya/ /'jigs dang ngo tsha rtag tu spang ⑪/ /rnal 'byor rol pas gnas par bya/ /'di ldan 11byed1040

bzlas brjod sbyin sreg dang / /mchod sbyin bsam gtan dkyil 'khor sogs/ /bum pa rdul tshon thig cho ga /lus la lhan cig skyes grub pas/ /srub shedang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba las/ /ye shes me ni shin tu 'bar/ /las kyi rlung gis bskul nas ni/ /lte ba'i pad+mar rnam par gnas/ /du ba 'thul ba 'bar ba dang / /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin gsal/ /ye shes 'khor lor son pa yisarngu/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bsregs nas ni/ /longs spyod sgogs pa'i 'khor lor zhugs1/ /thabs la mchod pa byas nas ni/ /mdzod spur yid ni zhugs gyur pas/ / aukhyan pyazhes ni bya ba yi/ /gnad kyi sgo nas 'thon nas kyang / /dzā lan+dha 3rar rab tu zhugs/ /bde gshegs thams cad bsregs nas ni/ /lha mo yid kyi shugs ldan na/ /dmigs kyis mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bskul nas ni/ /bdud rtsi phung por byas nas kyang / /'o ma'i rgyun ltar 'dzag par 'gyur/ /gser gyi sgor ni zhugs par 'gyur/ /longs spyod 'khor lor gnas nas kyang / /sa kyeyi bu gar 'dzag par 'gyur/ /zo chun rgyun klumo lta bu ni/ /sems kyi ngo bor ngal bso nas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bsregs nas kyang / /rgyal ba rnams ni mnyes par byed/ /yang dag las ni rab tu 'byung / /lte ba'i pad+mar yang dag gnas/ /kun nas yang ni 'gro ba dang / /de bzhin du ni rgyun 'o nyid/ /mkha' 'gro rtsa ni kun spyod ni/ /bde mchog 'khor lor bshad pa'o/ /sdom pa bshad pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la zhugs pa nag po pas ldumadzad pa rdzogs so// //dza go ta lar 'or ston chos 'byung gis bsgyur ba'o// //11—1041

༄7/ /yi ge bdun pa'i grub thabs/rmyesngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ sap+ta a k+ṣa ra sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byes pa bud med phal cher ni/ /rgyas par gzung dkar 'gyur bas na/ /mdor bsdus pa'i yang mdor bsdus nas/ /yi ge bdun pa bsdu bar bya/ /mchod sogs stong nyid byang chub kyi/ /sngags kyi mthar thug 'og tu ni/ /brtser ldan lus kyi dbus son pa'i/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rab bsgrub bya/ /yi ram̐ waṃ lo 'byung ba bzhi'i/ /dkyil 'khor steng du sum̐ las byung / /lhun po rin chen sna bdun dang / /rtsemo brgyad pa bsam par bya/ /oṃ me di m+bi rngubadzī bha ba badz+ra brnya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pā kā ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañja cher hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la dzā saṃ ṭ+wāsgo/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa 'ul a na lha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ rdo rje sa sogs drug byas nas / /'khor lo sna tshogs rdo rjer gnas/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor/ /11byed1044

rtsibs drug la ①ni bri bar bya/ /'dir ni hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde chen po/ /phyag drug zhal gsum spyan gsum pa/ /mtshan kun gyis mtshan bsgom par bya/ /dpe byad brgyad cu yang dag ldan/ /khya/ ba bdag ā li kā lis byung —/ /rdo rje dril bus snyoms par zhugs/ /mi yi pags pa rlon pa 'chang / /g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭī ga /phyag g.yas na ni mdung rtse gsum/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan dang / /ral pas sna tshogs rdo rje 'chang / /zla ba phyed pa'i thod dang ni / /phyag rgya drug gis sku la bklubs/ /mthing dang ser dang ljang gu'i zhal/ /stag gi pags pa'i na bza' gsol/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan mo/ /g.yas brkyang ba yis nyi mar mnan/ /mgon po ji lta de bzhin du/ /rdo rje phag mo'ang phyag la sogs/ /lha mo byin pa yang dag 'khyud/ /mchog tu dga' bas pyos pa mo/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥyi ge 'dis/ /ye shes dgug pa la sogs pa/ /rnal 'byor ma drug rtsibs drug la/ /g.yon du bskor bas rnam 3bskor bas/ /dang po lha mo khrag 'thung ma/ /gnyis pa rdo rje 'jigs byed ma/ /gsum pa drag gtum ma dang ni/ /bzhi pa rdo rje snang ①byed ma/ /lnga pa rdo rje drag mo snye④/ /drug pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro yin/ /sngon mo ser mo ljang gu dang / /dmar mo dud ka de bzhin dkar/ /skra bshig ma la drag chen ma⑤/ /spyan gsum ma ste phyogs kyi gos—/ /phyag ni cig shos phyag gnyis ni/ /sgra sgogs ṭuḍa ma ru dril bus mtshan/ /mi yi pags pa bsnams pa ste/ /yi dwags nyi ma'i steng na gnas/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can/ /g.yas brkyang gdan la yang dag bzhugs/ /lha rnams thams cad go rims klubazhin/ /yi ge drug las byung ba bsgom/ / shaṃ rmā spru ྅ 3khaṃ zhes pas/ /khams lnga po ni byin gyis brlab/ /oṃ rmā spu hri ho hūṃ byā zhes/ /11—1045

gzugs sogs phung po la yang ngo / /hūṃ ①hūṃ kha ā ho haṃ gis/ /skye mched rnams ni sbyang bar bya/ /oṃ ha na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bo ṣaṭa he/ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ phaṭa haṃ / brang mgo spyi gtsug phrag pa dang / /mig la sogs par sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ baṃ haṃ oṃ hri mo tre hri ④hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ lte ba snying ga kha dang ni/ /spyi bo spyi gtsug gzhan la dgod/ /lus dang ngag lam sems la ④ni/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ ni dgod par bya—/ /'khor los sgyur ④drug 'khor lor gnas/ /lha mo'i tshogs kyi lag gnas pa'i—/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi khu bas gang / /thod pa rnams kyis dbang bskur bya/ /mchod dang bstod dang bdud rtsi myang / /byas par gyur pas spyad par bya/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /gsang sngags yi ge bdun pa bzlas/ /oṃ byāḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ /bsam gtan bzlas pa gang tshe skyo/ /de tshe dag pa rjes dran bya—/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni khrag 'thung ma'o/ /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rdo rje 'jigs byed ma'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rab ⑤gtum ma'o/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rdo rje snang byed ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rdo rje drag mo'o/ /mgur chu gdu bu rin chen dang / /rna cha gdub kor tshangs skud de/ /de dag pha rol phyin pa drug /phyag rgya'i gzugs su sbyar ba yin / /yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rgyal dka' zla bas btus pa rdzogs so// //11—1046

༄7/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i grub thabs bdud rtsi 'dzag pa zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra saṃ pa ra sā dha na 'u.amṛ ta k+ṣa ra nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'dzag pa zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po dgag dka' glang po mchog /nus pa'i stobs kyi rngulcags kyus 'gugs/ /thig stong sangs rgyas nyid myu gu/ /zla ba'i 'od zer ltar 'phro ba/ /rang snying pad snang dbus gnas pa'i / /zla ba'i gzugs brnyan nang dmigs pa/ /sa chu me rlung mkha' rang bzhin/ /skye ngumed thig le la phyag 'tshal/ /brda 'ba' zhig ni gtsor khrugyur pa/ /tshig gi sdeb 'udang 'byel pa dang / / rtags rnams rang pyadaga' ba yi rgyud/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa mchog /yun ring pa ru rtogs dka' ba/ /'brel med skad ni ma lus gsungs/ /de zab rgya mtsho ltar gnas pa/ /zab mo su yis shes pa yin/ /de phyir bdag gis 2rtsa ba yi khye/ /bshad pa phyi ma yongs shes 11byed1048

pas/ /'khor lo dag pa de ring brtsams/ /ri dang nags tshal phug rnams dang / /chu bo'i 'gram dang bzhi mdo dang / /rgya mtsho chen po nyams dga'i 'gram/ /shing gcig drung dang bde ba'i gnas/ /gnas ni nye bar bstan pa yin—/ /yang na yid dang mthun par te/ /de ru rnal 'byor brtsam par bya/ /'dod pa kun gyi 'bras bu thob/ /snying ga chu skyes dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma thod pa bsgom par bya/ /de ru de nyid mchog lta ba/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin zhi—/ /'od zer sna tshogs rang bzhin mchog /kun nas rnam par 'phro gyur pa/ /sems tsam nyid du gnas pa ste/ /byang chub mchog ni sgrub par byed/ /nam mkha'i dbyengs su bsgom bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor mchog dga' bsgom par bya/ /nyil gong gtams 'dra'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' mchod par bya—/ /'gro ba drug gi sems can rnams/ /bla med go 'phang thob bya'i phyir/ /de ru gsum la skyabs 'gro bya①/ /dam bca' yongs su gzung bya ste/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sangs rgyas he ru ka ru shog /de nas tshangs pa yi ni gnas/ /bzhi po rnams ni bsgom par bya/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa dmigs/ /sems ni mchog ste gcig gyur pas/ /phyi rol nang gi chos rnams ni//thams cad stong par blta bar bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba pha kophohaṃ④/ /rnam shes so sor snang ba tsam/ /sems tsam rnam par brtag par bya/ /sa yi 'og gi mthar thug par/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /yi ge yi las yang dag byung / /kha dog sngon po gzhu rnam pa/ /du ba'i phreng ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /ba dan mtshan pa de bsgom bya/ /de steng yi ge ram̐ las ni/ /me yi dkyil 'khor mchog bsam pa/ /gru gsum kha dog dmar po ni/ /'bar ba'i 11—1049

phreng ba'i tshogs chen po/ /nyi ma bye ba dang mtshungs bsamasde/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa de bsgom bya/ /de yi steng du chu nyid ni/ /rlum po 'od zer phreng ba can/ /ba mo dang ni mtshungs pa nyid/ /baṃ skyes bum pas mtshan pa'o/ /de yi steng du sa bsgom pa①/ /yi ge lo las byung ba mchog /gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa la/ /ser po'i ④'od kyi tshogs kyis bskor/ /de steng bsgom par bya ba nyid/ /ri yi rgyal po ri rab mchog /rin chen bdun gyi rang bzhin mchog /rtse mo brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan/ /yi ge sum̐ las yang dag byung / /'od zer sna tshogs kun du 'khrigs/ /de ru ra ba dra ba dang / /rdo rje sa gzhi bla re dang / /mda' yi dra bar byen kyis brlabasti/ /me yi dra ba phyi rol nyid/ /oṃ me di dī badzī ⑤bha ba ban+ta hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pā kā 6༄ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañja ra hūṃ yo ④hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la trī saṃ trīsnyi/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/dpal ldan (gehe ru ka 'khor lo/ /rtsibs brgyad rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od/ /'dir nyi'i gzugs brnyan la gnas ltar⑪/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /de nas lugs byung lugs min pas/ /khro bo brgyad ni bsgom par ⑪bya//rdo rje gtum po tshenyi ma me/ /rdo rje gtsug tor de bzhin te/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /rdo rje dus dang stobs po che/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba//khro bo 'di dag rnam par dgod/ /sngon po ser po de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu du ba'i 7mdog 'dra dang / /dkar po nag po dmar 'dra ba/ /'jigs pa ske thod pa dang ldan gatshigs/ /de bzhin zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /thams cad mi rus rgyan gyis mdzes/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis gnas/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi dkyil bzhugs/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po rnams/ /zhabs kyis gnon pa 11—1050

rnam par bsgom/ /thod pa kha ṭī ga dag bsnams/ /zhags pa lcags kyu bsnams pa mchog /dril bu cang te'u thams cad la/ /shes rab 'khyud pa dam pa bde/ /skra ser gyen badze+es zhal 'gyur zhing / /mche ba gcigs ldan 'jigs byas pa/ /stag gi pags pa'i na bza' bsnams/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis 'jigs mdzad pa/ /de gyur pa yi bdag nyid las/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad rnam par bsgom/ /drag po khro bo 'bar bas bskor/ /zhal 'gyur gatshigs shing 'jigs mdzad pa/ /rgyan kun gyis ni kun du mtshan/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /dril bu thod pa kha ṭī ga /mgo bo'i phreng bas lus drag po/ /mgo bo'i ske rags drag pos bcings /gdug pa thams cad zhabs kyis mnan/ /shes rab dang ni yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad bsgom par bya/ /steng dang 'og tu gnas bsam pa/ /khro bo gnyis ni rnam par bsgom/ /gtsug tor rdo rje sa 'og ste/ /dkar po mig sman sngon 'dra'i 'od/ /thod mtshan kha ṭī ga bsnams pa/ /phyag na 'khor lo mdung zhags pa/ /lcags kyu rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi gnas pas gnas/ /khro bo'i rnam pa'i phur bu ni/ /phyogs bcu po 'dir dgod par bya/ /oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ shar du'o/ /oṃ greṇ+ḍa dzaṇ+ḍa hūṃ hūṃ ①phaṭa phaṭa/ byang du'o/ /oṃ greṭ+wā pa ya greṭ+wā pa ya hūṃ hūṃ ⑤phaṭa phaṭa/nub tu'o/ /oṃ phywan ya ho①/ bha ga bān badz+ra rā dza hūṃ hūṃ jephaṭa phaṭa/ lho ru'o/ /gsang sngags rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /bgegs rnams kun gyi 5)mgo bo ru/ /lugs su 'byung dang lugs min pas/ /khro bo'i phur bu dgod par bya/ /oṃ gha gha ka 3ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba dubye ))bispyo hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tī la ya tī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃhūṃ hūṃ ⑧badz+ra tī la badz+ra dha ro ta (3ādz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bispyo ⑫kā ya wāka 11—105/

tsit+ta badz+ra tī la ya khri la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃbadz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra tī la uko ṭa ①ya hūṃ phaṭa/rdo rje blo mchog khro tshig gis/ /phyis ni gsang sngags 'di bzlas bya/ /oṃ kha badz+ra j-ika '-i)badz+ra hūṃ ka ra badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ skabadz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ①badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a na 4lha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃbadz+ra nyiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa (snyebadz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ skabadz+ra ka la badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ba la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra : ṣa '-i7na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzo: ṣa tsakra brti badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ta 7la badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ de ltar nga rgyal nyid kyis grub/ /skad cig gis ni bgegs med 'gyur/ /sngon po ser po ljang gu ni/ /rdo rje hūṃ ka ra ru bshad/ /ser po dang ni nag po lngang / /dud kha ser po dang ljang gu/ /dkar po dang ni ser po ljang / /dmar po dang ni ser ljang gu/ /ljang gu ser po dang nag po/ /gzhan rnams kyi ni bdag po bzhin/ /mi bskyod cod pan dam tshig tu/ /bsgoms pas rdo rje 'chang ba dgyes/ /de ltar sgom pa byed gyur pas/ /gal te skyo ba skyes gyur na/ /stong pa nyid kyi ye shes ni/ /dran bya dad pas mnyam par gzhag④ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3⑨haṃ/ oṃ.a ni mi tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kolha⑩haṃ/oṃ a pra ṇi hi tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kopho⑩haṃ/ kun du bzang po kun kyi bdag/yongs su gyur pa mkha' dbyings te/ /mkha' dbyengs de ru bsgom bya ba/ /yi ge oṃ ni rnam par bsgom/ /des ni 'khor lo gnyis ka las/ /rnam par snang mdzad bsgom par bya/ /dkar po phyag bzhi rig mas 'khyud/ /g.yas dang g.yon la 'khor lo dang / /thod pa dang ni cang te'u dang / /kha ṭī ga yang de bzhin no/ /de gyur 'khor lor bcas pa yi/ /gzhal yas khang ni rnam par bsgom/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis brgyan byas pa/ /dra ba dra phyed dag gis 11—1052

mdzes/ /dar dbyangs phreng ba dag gis brgyan/ /zur kun gyi ni cha rnams su/ /rdo rje rin po ches mtshan pa/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de yi nang du 'khor lo la/ /re'u mig dgu ste phyir bcu drug /nang gi re'u mig dbus su ni/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i pad+ma ltar/ /lte ba ge sar nye bar brgyan/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'dab brgyad pa/ /re'u mig rnams la rdo rje ldan/ /sa gzhi rnam pa sna tshogs 'dod/ /'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje yi①/ /phreng bas 'khor lo gsum yongs bskor/ /rin chen phreng bas pad de bzhin/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i 'od gsal ba'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes bskor ba yis/ /dam tshig gi ni 'khor lo bris/ /yi dwags kha dog lnga rnams kyis/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor kun du bskor/ /rdo rje phyed pas sgo zur gyirka/ /ka ba'i rtse mo dbus nas mtshan/ /phyi ru dur khrod 'jigs pa yi/ /kha dog sna tshogs mchog gi mchog /sna tshogs shing rnams nyams dgas mtshan/ /khyi dang ce spyang dag gis 'jigs/ /khā dang 'ug pa bya rgod khra/ /wa dang tsi li ka de bzhin/ /keng rus mdung ①gis phug pa dang / /'phyang ba dang ni phyed bsregs dang —/ /spyi bo ko sko pus mo dang / /lag pa mgo bo rnams kyis brgyan/ /sgra sgogs de bzhin glang mgo dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs sprul gyis dga'/ /seng ge stag dang phag rgod dang / /de bzhin dom dang ra rnams dang / /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'dus pa mchog /thod pa kha ṭī ga ni bsnams/ /gri gug cang te'u de bzhin no/ /gnod sbyin ro langs srin po rnams//de ltar sna tshogs dur khrod do/ /de ru nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor blta/ /k+ṣiṃli kā li rang sa bon/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /stong pa nyid dang chos kyi dbyengs/ /mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /bya ba grub pa bsgom pa dang / /11—1053

shin tu rnam par dag pa dmigs/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni mchog gi mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' rang rig bcas/ /rim pa 'di yis rnam par bsam/ /dkar po ser po de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu dang ni zhal rnam ①bzhi/ /rdo rje dril bus yang dag 'khyud/ /mdung dang dgra sta cang te'u dang / /gri gug thod pa kha ṭī ga /tshangs pa'i pags pa na bzar mnabs②/ /zhags pa tshangs pa'i ①mgo de bzhin//phyag bcu gnyis kyis brgyan byas pa/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ /thod pa'i cod pan byis mi bzad/ /rgyan rnams kun byis yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyis brgyan/ /snying ga ye shes dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje 'chang ba'i cod pan can/ /thabs ji bzhin du shes rab ste/ /phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan byas pa/ /bde chen thabs kyi ④sbyor ba yis/ /sku gnyis yang dag zhu bar gyur—/ /'od zer de las lha mo rnams/ /langs nas sna tshogs glu yis bskul/ /khams gsum bde thob kye gtso bo/ /a la la la ho/ /pad+ma'i bdag po yongs rdo rje—/ /bde chen rgyal ba'i tshogs spro ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bcu'i gtso—/ /rab spangs ⑤a la la la ho/ /gtso bo drug pa sems dpa' snying / /btsun mo rol sbyor srid gsum bdag /a la la la ho/ /dga' bdag spong zhing rab spong ba/ /bde chen rang bzhin rgyal ba'i gtso/ /glu 'di yis ni sbyor ba yis—/ /pad+ma'i rnal 'byor ma thas blang du/ /pad+ma'i tshogs kyis bzhengs pa ni/ /rdo rje ⑦sbyor ba bde dubs so/ /mgon po la ni 'di yis bskul/ /bde ba chen po 'di gnas las/ /bzhengs nas sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /ma lus pa yi rgyal ba spros/ /zhal bzhi phyag ni bcu gnyis pa/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi gnas pas /gnas/ /zhal gyi mche ba gcigs pa dang / /spyan gsum zhal ni rnam par 'gyur/ /11—1054

thod pa'i phreng ba'i rgyan dang ldan/ /sgu la phyag rgya drug gis brgyan/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan gyi/ /mgo bo dang ni nu ma mnan/ /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs mnabs/ / n+ting rje'i tshu)ro yis rnam par khyab/ /rdo rje phag mo la ni 'khyud/ /'khyud pa yi ni phyag gnyis la/ /rtse dgu kha bye rdor dril bu—/ /phyag gzhan gnyis po dag la ni/ /glang chen pags pa'i na bza' 'chang / /g.yas kyi phyag ni gsum pa la/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ②mdung 'dzin pa'o/ /bzhi pa la ni lcags kyu ste/ /lnga pa la ni gri gug ste/ /drug pa la ni cang te'u'o/ /g.yon pa'i phyag ni gsum pa la/ /thod pa rkang gis bkang ba'o/ /mchod phyir thogs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /kha ṭī ga ni bsnams pa'o/ /sna tshogs 'phan ni rab tu 'phyang / /de steng kha bye rtse lnga pa'i/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bus mtshan/ /dbus su sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan/ /'og tu rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ /bzhi pa la ni rdo rje zhags/ /lnga pa la ni tshangs pa'i mgo/ /drug pa la ni sta re'o/ /sngo ser dmar po sneljang gu'i zhal/ /drag po bzhad sgeg dpa' bo dang / /rngam dang ljags ni bskyod pa'i zhal/ /de mdun rdo rje phag mo ni/ /zhal bzhi phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa—/ /kha dog dkar po ske rags ni/ / thod pa'i budum bus mtshan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das zhal kha dog ltar/ /lha mo'i phyag gi kha dog de/ /dmar po ljang gu ser po dang / /shin tu sngo mdog zhal gyi 'od/ /skra grol gcer bu g.yon pa yis⑤/ /phyag 'khyud pa la ma rungs pa'i/ /bdud kyi khrag bkang thod pa'o/ /g.yas pa'i sdigs mdzub phyogs kun du/ /gdug pa bsdigs dushing gri gug 'chang / /cang te'u tshangs pa'i mgo bsnams phyag /zhal nas khrag ni 'dzag pa ste—/ /zhabs gnyis kyis ni yang dag dkris/ /bde chen snying rje'i bdag nyid 11—1055

ma—/ /snying ga'i lcags kyu'i sbyor ba yis/ /ye shes 'khor lo dgug par bya/ /ye shes 'khor lo legs bkug ste/ /mchod bstod byas nas gzhug ①par bya/ /'di nyid kyis ni gnas tshogs rim/ /dgod bya nang gi spyor ba mchog / pul+līr mā ḍa2la yar te/ /spyi bor thod pa'i dum bu dang rab tu gtum ma'o/ /dzā larnya ra ste spyi gtsug tu keng rus chen po dang / gtum mo'i ①mig can ma'o/ /au④ḍān te rna ba g.yas par keng rus chen po dang 'od can ma'o/ arngu da ste rgyab kyi char mche ba gcigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas so/ / go dā pa rī ⑤ste/ rna ba g.yon par su ra be+e ( ri dang / dpa' bo'i blo can ma'o/ /rā me shwa ra ④ste smin ma'i dbus su 'od dpag med dang / mi thung ma'o/ /de bī ko ṭī ste skemig gnyis su rdo rje 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /mā la ba ⑨ste/ dpung mgor rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas so/ /'di dag ni thugs kyi 'khor lo ste nam mkha' la spyod pa'o/ /kā ma rū lapa ste mchan khung dag la myu gu can dang sa srung / ma'o—/ / lo ṭi 'u ste nu ma gnyis su rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing ngo / /tri sha ku ni ste/ lte bar dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma'o—/ /ko sa la ste sna rtser rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing ngo / /ka liṅga ste khar ni rab tu bzang po dang / lha mo sngo bsangs ma'o/ /lasba ⑫ ka ste/mgrin par rdo rje bzang po dang rab bzangs ④ma ste tshasdo ha'o/ /kā— ⑫te snying gar 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma'o/ /hi mā la ya ⑫ste/ mdoms su mig mi bzang dang kha ga na ste nye ba'i tshardo ha ste gsung gi 'khor lo sa spyod ma'o/ /pre ta pu ri ste/ mtshan ma ⑫la stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /kṛ ⑫ha de ba tā /geste bshang ba'i lam du ni rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma ste 'dus pa'o/ /11byed1056

sau rāṣ+ṭa ①ste brla gnyis su rta mgrin dang mchu can ma'o/ /su bar+ṇa dī lapa ste byin pa gnyis la nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'dus pa'o/ /na ga ra ste/ sor mo rnams la dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /sin dhu'i yul te rkang pa'i bol dag la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod do/ /ma ru'i yul te mthe bong gnyis la rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los ①sgyur ma'o/ /ku lu ta ste pus mo gnyis la rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /'di dag ni sa 'og na gnas pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni rdo rje la'o/ /lā ma ni dril bu la'o/ /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma ni glang po che'i pags pa 'dzin pa'i khu tshur ma'o/ /khwa gdong ma ni rdo rje mdung ma'o/ /'ug pa'i gdong can ma ni rdo rje lcags kyu ma'o/ /khyi'i gdong can ma ni rdo rje gri gug ma'o/ /phag gi gdong can ma ni cang te'u ma'o/ /gshin rje brtan ma ni thod mtshan kha ṭī ga la'o/ /gshin rje pho nya ma ni zhags pa la'o/ /gshin rje mche ba can ni tshangs pa'i mgo la'o/ /gshin rje 'joms ma ni sta re la'o—/ /byang chub kyi sems kyi snod rnams ni zhal bzhi la'o/ /pu dzā o a/ go rā de ma④/ kā otri ko/ ka la kā hiske/ bye kṛ sau su na 6si ma ku/ 'khor lo gsum ni yongs dag phyir/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yi ge bzhiphyu/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /byin gyis brlab par bya ba ste/ /gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par snang mdzad kha dog dkar bo oṃlas byung ba'o/ /tshor ba la ni rin chen rgyal po gser bsregs pa'i mdog lta bu oṃ ④las byung ba'o/ /'du shes la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug kha dog dmar po dīḥlas byung ba'o/ /'du byed la rdo rje rgyal po kha dog ljang gu hotsholas byung ba'o/ /rnam shes nyid la rdo rje sems dpa' kha dog dkar po 11—1057

hūṃ las byung ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid dpal he ru ka kha dog nag po hitsholas byung ba'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la ⑤bzhugs pa/ nyi zla'i gzugs brnyan dbus su bzhugs/ /glang po myur 'gro rma bya dang / /rta dang seng ge mkha' lding ste/ /yi dwags la bzhugs rim pa bzhin/ /rigs drug bdag po bsam par bya/ /snying gar rdo rje sa gnon yin/ /gzhan rnams kyi ni ④rim pa bzhin/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje g.yas na'o/ /g.yon na dril bu peng rgyal bcas/ /thams cad la yang srun gsum nyid/ /mig dag la bye gti mug rdo rje dkar po'o/ /rna ba dag la hūṃ zhe sdang rdo rje nag po'o/ /sna la khaṃ ser sna rdo rje ser po'o/ /kha la saṃ /⑤'dod chags rdo rje dmar po'o/ /lus la ho phrag dog rdo rje ljang gu'o/ /skye mched thams cad la haṃ/ dbang phyug rdo rje kha dog dkar po'o/ /sa'i khams la dze+e rjoltung byed ma ser po'o/ /chu'i khams la rmā spu 'ching byed ma nag po'o/ /me'i khams la hūṃ 'gugs bhubyed ma gser byi mdog can no/ /rlung gi khams la r+pā 1)pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma dmar mo'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la khaṃ pad+ma 'bar ma sngo nag go/ /thong byed ma dang 'ching byed ma/ /'gugs byed gar dang ldan de bzhin/ /rang rang dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje pad+ma ral gri dang / /gri gug g.yas kyi phyag na'o/ /thod pa nyid dang kha ṭī ga /'di rnams kyis ni g.yon pa mtshan/ /zhal gsum phyag drug lha mo ni/ /pad+ma yi ni 'bar ma yang / /thod pa de dran kha ṭī ga /zhags pa lcags kyu nyid dang ni/ /tshangs pa'i mgo dang gri gug ni/ /'di yi lag pa rnams la bsam/ /oṃ ha snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ /na ma hi spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad ser po'o/ /swā hā hu spyi gtsug tu pad+ma gar gyi 11—1058

dbang phyug dmar po'o/ /bo ṣaṭa he dpung pa gnyis su ṭīhe ru ka nag po'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ ho mig gnyis su rdo rje nyi ma dmar po'o/ /phaṭa phaṭa ①haṃ lus thams cad la rta mchog ljang gu'o/ /oṃbaṃ lte bar rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ haṃ oṃ snying gar ya mi ni sngon mo/ tri ②mo kha la rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ tre hri ①spyi bor skyong byed ma ser mo/ hūṃ hūṃ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma ljang gu/ phaṭa phaṭa lus thams cad la gtum byed dum mtshon cha du ma'i mdog 'dra ba'o/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rdo rje can—/ /de las gzhan pa phyag bzhi pa/ /rdo rje dril bu thod pa rnamasan/ /kha ṭī ga dang cang te'u mgo /'khor lo la sogs mtshan ma durnams/ /dril bu thod pa nyid dang ni/ /kha ṭī ga dang ⑦cang te'u nyid/ /gzhan gyis phyag gi (shematshon cha yinaske/ /phag mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ /dmar mo sngon po ljang gu zhal/ /gri gug thod pa nyid dang ni/ /zhags pa dang ni kha ṭī ga /lcags kyu de bzhin tshangs pa'i mgo/ /lag pa rnams la 'di bsam bya/ /gzhan ni phyag bzhir bsgom par bya/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gsum pa thas/ /'-i༄gri gug thod pa kha ṭī dang —/ /cang te'u dril bu de bzhin no/ /phag mo rdo rje sems dpa' yin/ /rnam snang ya mi nar ⑩dran bya/ /pad+ma gar dbang rmongs byed ma/ /skyong byed ma ni te ru ka /rdo rje nyi ma skrag byed ma/ /rta yi mchog ni gtum byed ma/ /thugs la hūṃ yig rdo rje yin/ /a ⑪ni ngag gi lam du gnas/ /yi ge oṃ ni sku rdo rje/ /nag po dmar po dkar po rim/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis⑫/ /nam mkha' kun du khyab bltas te/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis yongs gang ba'i/ /thod pas dbang bskur tshig 'di yis/ /dbang bskur ba ni sbyin par bya/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /lha yi chu ni 11—1059

dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nyi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ /phyag rgya rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pas mchod/ /zhing skyes lhan cig skyes lha mo/ /mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma de bzhin/ /rigs skyes ma mo skyes de bzhin/ /mi snang mkha' spyod de bzhin no/ /dma' bar skyes dang mchog de bzhin/ /bar ma rnam pa sna tshogs mchog /sa spyod mkha' spyod de bzhin no/ /sa yi 'og na gnas pa dang / /gnod sbyin mo dang klu mo dang / /dri za mo dang ①mi'am ci/ /rig pa 'dzin pa sngon grub pa/ /gang yang bde gshegs brten pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum la mos gang dang / /de dag thams cad dkyil 'khor lo/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /glu dang gar gyi mchod pa dang / /sna tshogs gang dang 'dod mchog gis/ /he ru ka la mchod pa byed/ /rlung dang me yi dkyil steng du/ /a las grub pa'i thod pa la/ /ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsis bkang / /yi ge bcu drug baṃ dang ni/ /oṃ sogs yi ge gsum byin brlabs/ /'khor gsum yang dag spros bsgom bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /g.yon du bskor zhing rab bskor bas/ /dngos grub thams cad rab sgrub byed/ /shar gyi 'dab mar mkha' 'gro ma/ /de bzhin lā ma byang du yin/ /nub tu dum skyes ma nyid do/ /lho ru gzugs can ma nyid do/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni kha dog nag /lā ma kha dog ser mor 2bshad/ /dum skyes ma ni dmar mo yin/ /gzugs can ma ni ljang gu'o / /zhal gcig phyag rgya lnga yis mtshon/ /bzhi po kun kyang phyag bzhi ma/ /spyan gsum skra ni grol ba dang / /gri gug thod pa kha ṭī ga /cang te'u tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams/ /bdud bzhi zhabs kyis mnan pa'o/ /mtshalas su gser dang 11—1060

dngul sogs kyi/ /bum pa'i steng du gzhag ①bya ba/ /kun+da ②lta bu'i ①bdud rtsi bzhi| /byang chub sems kyi thod pa'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs su/ pul+līr mā rjol yar thod pa'i dum bu dang rab tu gtum mo dkar mo dang / byang du dzā lan dha rar keng rus chen po dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma ser mo/nub tu chaḍān ⑤du keng rus dang 'od can ma dmar mo/ lhor arbu dar mche ba gcigs pa dang sna chen ma ljang gu'o/ /me'i phyogs go dā pa rīr dulha dgra dang / /brtan pa'i du blo can ma sngo skya ma'o/ /bden bral du 2rā me shwa rīr (pedapag med dang mi thung ma dkar ser ro/ /rlung gi phyogs de bī ko ṭīr ⑩rdo rje 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma ljang gu'o/ /dbang ldan du mā la bar rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma pad+ma'i kha dog ste/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /skra grol spyan ni gsum pa'o/ /'khyud pa yis ni thod pa 'dzin/ /gdug pa'i sdigs mdzub rdo rje 'chang / /gtsug rgyan rna rgyan mgul rgyan dang / /rkang rgyan tshangs pa'i srad bu can—/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas mgul du brgyan/ /ske rags sel sil sgra sgogs ⑪nyid / /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa'i⑫/ /dpa' bo zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /rang mtshan ral pa'i cod pan can/ /snying rjes grags shing 'jigs par mdzad/ /'khyud pa yi ni phyag gnyis kyis/ / rde rje dril bu 'dzin par mdzad/ /1nacang te'u kha ṭī lag gzhan la/ /phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan byas pa/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi gnas pas gnas/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo mkha' spyod yin/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar kā ma rū ⑫par myu gu can dang sa srung yim dkar mo'o/ /byang o ṭir rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo dmar mo'o/ /nub tu tri sha ku ṣ+per dpa' bo chen mo spyodang rlung gi shugs can ma nag mo'o/ /lho ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ 11byed1061

mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ljang gu ma'o/ /me'i phyogs ka ling gar rab tu bzang po dang —/ lha mo sngo bsangs ma ser mo'o/ /bden bral lam pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo dkar mo'o/ /rlung gi phyogs kā:ra ①'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma ljang gu ma'o②/ /dbang ldan du nyi wā la yar snemig mi bzang dang khā gdong ma nam mkha' ltar ④sngo bsangs ma'o/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyi ni/ /rdo rje phyag la pad+ma nyid/ /gsung gi 'khor lo sa spyod do/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i shar pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma nag mo'o/ /byang kṛ snyiha de ba tār ⑥rin chen rdo rje dang / dum skyes ma ser mo'o/ /nub sau rāṣ+ṭar rta mgrin dang mchu can ma dmar mo'o/ /lho su bar+ṇa dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang /'khor lo'i go cha ma )dmar mo'o/ /me'i phyogs na ④ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo dmar mo'o/ /bden bral gyi phyogs sin dhur pad+ma gar gye dbang phyug dang stobs chen mo zla ba'i mdog can ma'o/ /rlung gi phyogs ma ror ⑨rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los ⑫sgyur ma du ba'i mdog can ma'o/ /dbang ldan ku lu tār ⑪rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson chen ma dkar mo'o/ /dpa' bo dang ni 7dpa' mo lanyu2/ /dang po'i phyag na 'khor lo'o/ /sku yi 'khor lo sa 'og gnas/ /'khor lo kun gyi dpa' bo dang / /dpa' mo rnams kyi rim ji bzhin/ /dpral bar rdo rje phreng ba dang / /pad+ma'i 'khor lo phreng bas mtshan/ /yang na rang gi 'khor lo yi/ /kha dog gis ni lha rnams kyi/ /kha dog rab tu brtag la par bya/ /shar dang byang phyogs sgo rnams su/ /sgo srung ⑫bzhi ni gnas pa ste/ /khwa gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma/ /khyi gdong ma dang phag gdong ma'o/ /me dang bden bral la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su gshin rje brtan ma dang / gshinarje 11—1062

pho nya ma ①dang / gshin rje mche ba can dang / gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang ma mo dang / /dpa' bo nyid kyang phyag bzhi pa'o/ /phyogs sgo mtshalas gnas ④lha mo rnams/ /yi dwags kyi ni gdan la bzhugs/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /pad+ma'i steng na sgo srung 1rnams/ /mtshams kyi lha mo'ang de kun la/ /skyil krung byed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /de bzhin mtshalas gnas ④lha mo rnams/ /gzugs gnyis ⑤kyis ni yid 'phrog ma/ /g.yas na gri gug lcags kyu zhags/ /lcags sgrog dang ni dril bu'o/ /g.yon na me long pi wang dang —/ /dri ro thod pa kha ṭī ga /khwa gdong la sogs mkha' 'gro ma/ /ming dang mthun par zhal dran bya/ /ma he bong bu rnga mo rta/ /mtshams kyi btsun mo rnams kyi zhal/ /seng ge stag dang glang po rta/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i zhal/ /sgo yi rtsa ba'i zur dag tu/ /mchod pa'i snam bur gnas pa ni/ /pi wang ma dang gling bu ma/ /rnga dung ma dang rdza rnga ma/ /bzhad mo sgeg mo glu gar ma/ /me tog ma dang spos 'chang ma/ /mar me ma dang dri 'chang ma/ /me long ma dang ro 'dzin maske/ /reg bya ma dang chos ldan ma/ /pi wang ma dang sgeg ma sngo/ /gling bu ma dang glu ma ser/ /gar mkhan rnga dung ma ni ljang / /rdza rnga bzhad ma ⑥dkar dang dmar/ /pi wang gling sogs lha mo yi/ /pi wang sogs spangs ⑦phyag rnams la/ /rdor ladril de las gzhan pa la/ /kha ṭī ga dang thod pa'o/ /rdor ⑨dril nga rgyal bcas sgeg mo/ /glu mkhan ma dang rol bcas ma/ /pad+ma kor bcas gar mkhan ma—/ /de ltar thams cad phyag bzhi'o/ /me tog ma dkar spos dud ka'o/ /mar mre ma ni mar me bzhin/ /dri ma me long ma dmar dkar/ /ro 'dzin ma dmar reg bya ljang / /chos ni dkar por shes par bya/ /rang gi phyag rgya'i sbyor dang 11—1063

ldan—/ /me long la sogs mtshan pa la①/ /de las gzhan pa'i lag rnams la/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭī ga /cang te'u sgo na gnas pa yi/ /khwa gdong la sogs bzhi yi'orka/ /gri gug kyang ni de bzhin no/ /dang po'i phyag na mtshan ma'o/ /dkyil 'khor dpa' bo dpa' mo yig/ /sna tshogs pa yi lta stangs kyis①/ /rnam par g.yeng bas bcom ldan bstod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yi ni lam/ /gtso bo ma lus bde chen thob/ /dga' ba'i bde ba chen po'o/ /a la la la ho/ /srid las shin tu grol ba yi④/ /de bzhin gshegs mchog dga' ba yirjo/ /glu 'di bdag ༷ ni blangs pa yisadze+e/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni brtags pa yin/ /sku yi 'khor lo mngal las skyes/ /gsung ni sgo nga las skyes te/ /thugs ni rdzus te byung ba'o/ /thugs ka'i yi ge dam tshig ni/ /bsnyen pa'i spyor ba rab tu brtag /mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs mchog gishe/ /nye ba'i bsnyen pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /dpa' bo'i lus dgod sbyor ba yi / /sgrub pa yang dag bshad par bya/ /dbang bskur yang dag sbyor ba las/ /sgrub pa chen po bstan pa yin/ /oṃ sa ma ya shurnyaḥsarba dharmātshos ma ya shurnyolha⑪haṃ/ /chos kun ro gcig mnyam pa las sems kyis gnas par bya ba yin/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi chu 'thung bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ⑪to da ka hūṃ ṭha ṭha tram̐ u⑫hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /sku yi 'khor lo rnam par bsgom/ /chu gnas gsung gi 'khor lo ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ /me yi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo bde chen po/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i / /dam tshig dkyil 'khor mchog bsgom bya/ /de ru ye shes dkyil 'khor yang / /de bzhin bsgom bya rnam par bsgom/ /mchod bstod yang dag mnyes 11—1064

byas te/ /dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya ba yin/ /ji srid skyo bar ma gyur pa/ /de srid rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom/ /skyo gyur rnam par dag dran bya/ gang chos rnam par dag pa 'di dag ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i 'khor lo ste/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di dag nyid bstan ①par bya'o/ /de la dag pa dang bde ba dang / rtag pa dang bdag rnams kyi phyin ci log bzhi rnams kyi gnyen por gyur pa dran pa nye bar gzhag ④pa bzhi ni 'di lta ste/ lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /dran pa ni nyams su myong ba'i dngos po la sems kyis ma brjod pa'o/ /de'i nye bar 'jog pa ni dran pa nye bar 'jog pa'o/ /de yang brjed ngas pa'i gnyen por gyur pa ste/ sngon nyams su pyong ba'i dngos po la nye bar 'jog pa ni 'dris pa'i yon tan no/ /'byung ba dang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i tshogs ni lus so/ /bde ba la sogs pa nyams su myong ba ni tshor ba'o/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' ni chos so/ /so sor snang ba tsam gyis rnam par shes pa ni sems so/ /de rnams kyi rjes su dran pa ni nye bar gzhag ①pa ste lus la sogs pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /yang dag par ④ 'byung ba mi dge ba'i rjes su mthun pa 'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa dge ba'i mi mthun par gyur pa le lo dang ma dad pa la sogs pa ste/ bdun pa la sogs pa 'di dag dmigs pas spong ba ni/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi yin te/ 'di lta ste—/ mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spang ba dang / mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed ⑤pa dang / dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par bsrung ba dang —/ dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyed (spyo༄pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul ni ting nge 'dzin 11—1065

gyi stobs 'phel ba'o/ /de'i yan lag ni 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa'o/ /de la tsūd pa'i ①'du byed dang ldan pa rnam par 'byed pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / 'gog pa dang /brten ②pa med pa dang / kun du sbyor ba dang / yongs su gyur pa nyid shes pa ni 'dun pa'o/ /de la rnam par 'byed pa ni lam mo/ /nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spang ba ni 'dod chags dang bral ba ste mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /'gog pa ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i dngos po kun du mi sbyor ba'o/ /de rnams mi brten ①pa rnam par 'byed pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / 'gog bupa la brten pa med pa'o/ /kun du sbyor ba ni 'dus byas thams cad kyi dngos po la yang dag par sbyor ba'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa ni de'i bdag nyid du gnas pa'o/ /lta bar byed pa'i shes pa 'di dag ni mig la sogs pa dang mtshungs pa'i dad pa la sogs pa'i dbang po bstan par bya'o/ /de yang rnam pa lnga ste/ 'di lta ste/dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po'o/ /de la dad pa ni/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa la yang dag pa'i lta ba dang las kyi 'bras bu la nye bar longs spyod pa la sems yid ches pa'o sems kyi (5kun du sbyor ba ni brtson 'grus so/ /dad pa'i dbang po la brten nas chos gang ma brjed pa ni brtson 'grus bstan to/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ma brjed cing don ma brjed pa ni dran pa'i dbang ⑥pos chos rnams ma brjed pa gang mngon du byed pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang por bstan to/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis rtse 11—1066

gcig par byas pa'i chos gang khyad par du gyur pa ni shes rab kyi dbang po'o/ /ma dad pa dang le lo dang / brjed ngas pa dang / bag med pa dang / rnam par g.yeng ba la sogs pa mi mthun pa zad pa las khyad par thob pa'i dbang po nyid stobs su bstan te/ 'di lta ste/ dad pa'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs so/ /rang nyid kyis yang dag par khong du chud pa 'di ni byang chub ste/ sems gnyis dang bral ba'o/ /de'i rgyu ni byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /de rnams kyang bdun te/'di lta ste/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / shin tu sbyangs pa ①yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /de la sems can thams cad la phan par byed pa dang / byang chub tu smon pa dang / thos shing khong du chud pa ma brjed pa ni dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /bdag la sogs pa'i chos rnams mi mthun pa'i phyir/ phung po khrul sogs pa 'byed pa ni chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /chos rnams ro gcig pa'i sems ni dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /dga' ba ①mi mthun pa'i phyogs bdag dang bdag gi bag chags bcom pa las/ lus dang ngag dang sems las su rung ba ni shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / stong pa nyid dang chos kyi dbyengs te tshad ma bzhi la sems rtse gcig pa ni ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan 11—1067

lag go/ /so so'i skye bo'i sa las nges par byung ba ni brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen ①po ma yin pa lus dang ngag dang sems kyi 'du byed la ltos pa med pa ni btang snyems yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /sdig pa 'ba' zhig dang rjes su mthun pa'i nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i phyir 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad do/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa spang geba'i sgom pas tshol ba ni lam mo—/ /de'i phyir 'di 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad du bstan te/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de la yang dag pa'i lta ba ni chos thams cad bdag med pa'i mtshan nyid dang /'jig rten pha rol la blta ba'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni blang ba dang dor ba dag sgong ba dang / mngon du byed pa yid kyis ①byed pa dang / dge ba 'ba' zhig la sems pa'o/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni bden pa mthong ba'i don ston par byed do/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi ④mtha' ni/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sprilas gang gong na med pa'o/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni rigs las skyes spyopa'i don to/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni bdag dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa la rjes su sbyor ba lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las so/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni ji ltar khong du chud pa'i chos rnams ma brjed pa'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dmigs pa'i rnam pa mngon du byed pa'i sems so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' cod pan ni/ /rnam dag le shes lnga nyid do/ /dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags nyid ni/ /tshangs pa'i 11—1068

srad bur rab tu brtag /rdo rje phag mo'i sngags kyis ni/ /mgul gyi ①mgul rgyan mtshan pa'o/ /lha yi snying bo gsang sngags ni/ /brgya phyed phreng bas brgyan pa'o—/ /yi ge bdun gyi gsang sngas/sa ni/ /rna ba'i rna cha mdzes pa yin/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma yi sngags/ /pags pa'i na bza' bsnams pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma ni drug gi ②sngags/ /rked pa ska rags brgyan pa'o/ /dpa' bo'i go cha drug nyid ni/ /phyag rgyas sku la brgyan pa'o/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i—/ /sngags ni thod pa'i btung ba'o/ /rnam snang mdzad ma'i sngags gang yin//mgo bor brgyan pa'i thod pa'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / /lus kyi khams su brtags pa yin/ /lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni lā ma'o/ /chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o—/ /sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /ye shes kyi pad+ma'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni rab tu gtum mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'od ldan ma'o/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni sna chen ma'o//dad pa'i dbang po ni brtan pa'i ④blo can ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni mi thung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po ni lang ka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni shing grib ma'o④/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni sa srung dhima'o/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs du byed chen mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni rlung gi shugs can ma'orjo/ /dran pa'i stobs ni chang 'thung ma'o④/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni lha mo sngo bsangs ma'olnga / /shes rab kyi stobs ni shin tu bzang mo'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi tshuyan lag 11—1069

ni rta rna ma'o/ /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni kha ga na ste gsung gi 'khor lo rnam par dag pa'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o①/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni dum skyes ma'o④/ /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni chang 'tshong ma'o/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o①/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni shin tu dpa' mo'o④/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni stobs chen ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni 'khor losasgyur ma'o⑤/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni brtson chen ma ste sku'i 'khor lo'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni rjokhwa gdong ma'o④/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug pa'i gdong can ma'o④/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi'i gdong can ma'o⑨/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gi gdong can ma'o⑩/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal te ru ka'o/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shudhe dharma ⑩dh+wa tu swa bhā ⑫ba āt+pa ko3⑫haṃ/ dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyes ④pa ni gshin rje brtan ma'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par srung ba ni gshin rje'i pho nya ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong ba ni gshin rje mche ba ma'o mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed ⑫pa ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /dam tshig gi 'khor lo rnam par dag pa'o/ /sen mo dang so dag la ⑩jod pa'i dum bu'o/ /skra dang ba ⑩spu dag la keng rus chen po'o/ /pags pa dang dri ma dag la keng rus so—/ /sha la mche ba gcigs pa'o/ /rgyus pa la lha'i dgra'o/ /rus pa la 'od dpag med do/ /kha la rdo rje 'od do/ /snying la rdo rje sku'o/ /mig la myu gu can no—/ /mkhris pa la rdo rje ral pa can no/ /glo ba la dpa' bo chen po'o/ /rgyu ma 11—1070

la rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ /rtse'u chung dag la rab tu bzang po'o/ /lte ba la rdo rje bzang po'o/ /bshang ba'i lam la 'jigs byed do/ /mtshams kyi mtha' dag la mig mi bzang ngo / /bad kan la stobs po che'o/ /rnag la rin chen rdo rje'o/ /khrag la rta mgrin no/ /rdul la nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /tshil la he ru ka'o/ /mchi ma la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /mchil ma la rnam par snang mdzad do/ /ngar snabs la rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /dam tshig mchog gi gyobazlas pa la/ /dung chen mchog la bzlas par bya/ /'khor sogs cho ga rim pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ①sngags mchog bzla/༷ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te yī zhure shā ya hūṃ hūṃ ④phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpa asdi saṃ ni bhā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā ma ku ṭoṅka ṭā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ deṭ+wā ⑤ka rā lo gra dz+nyā ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra ju dza bhā su rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ skapa ra shu pā shor+ya dhita shu la kha ṭī ga jo ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+ra 3)dzi rmā (9ba ra dha rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ wīm hā dhus+thārnya kā ra wa pu ṣā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇ+ḍa ⑨ka pā la ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsaṇ+ḍi ⑩hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā ka ka la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa a ⑪spyi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ brnya brnya kai ka la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃpra bha ba tī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tā sa ya tā sa ya/ bi ka rdasri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃm hā nā se hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khro bha ya gho bha ya su ra be+e ri ṇi ⑩hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/khrolī ra ma tī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ska— hūṃ a mi tā bha ⑫hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kharba ri ye ④hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃhraḥhraḥbadz+ra pra bha ⑫hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lo ke shwa rī ye ⑩hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tse dze badz+ra de ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ wīdru mtshwa ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ /oṃ phaṭa phaṭa saṃ ku ri ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ e ra ba ti ⑩hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha badz+ra dza ṭa le hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bhi ra bī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa ma hā bī re 6snyehūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bā yu be ge 11—1071

hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhak+ṣa rtak+ṣa ba ①sa ru dhi ra an+d+ra mā lā ba lo bi ṣ+pe badz+ra hūṃ kā ④ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭaske/ oṃsu ra rtaspyi ye ①hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa sap+ta pa tā la ga ta bhu rdza ga sabaṃ ba tardza ya tardza ya su bha bra ④hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shā ma de bī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phywakaḍa khye ā kaḍa rgya badz+ra bha dra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha dre hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ s+thā kau dum hā dzhai ra ba hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya kaṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzhai k+ṣiṃ bi rū rjopāk+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kha gā ④na ṣ+pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shaṃ hūṃ ④ma hā ba la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be+e ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ⑨rat+na badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sh+lau sh+lau ha ya spyi ⑩ba hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shoṇ+ḍi byā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ k+ṣiṃkā sha gar+bha ⑪hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra barma bhā ye ⑫hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li te ru ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ se li se li pad+ma narte shwa ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsi li tsi li bai ro tsa na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warti m+bi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa⑫/ oṃ bye li dhi li badz+ra satwa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lo ma hā bī dre hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa④/ oṃ ḍā ki — ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ khā me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṇi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ⑫kā gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ u khru kā phye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa ⑩nā sre hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shā ka ⑩rā gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ po sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /sems can kun gyi snying la bzhugs/ /e dze+e i ā+o sum̐ khru tse oṃ oṃ oṃ ①saṃ dze+e 'di ni bcom ldan 'das nyid de/ /dbang phyug ma dang he ru ka /sgo nga la skyes ①mchog rim pas/ /lte ba'i dbus su bsgom par bya—/ /ṛ dṛ oṃ ā+oṃ/ pad 'dab la gnas mkha' 'gro ma/ /rka khaṃ gi hūṃ baṃ / tsa tsho dze+e dho haṃ/ ṭi oṃ ḍi bye ①rde/ tai dze+e rda snye rna/ paṃ paṃ baṃ r+bha oṃ/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba/ /thod dum la sogs dpa' bo dang / /rab gtum la sogs thams cad kyi/ /yo re lo waṃ shaṃ ṣe saṃ haṃ/ khwa gdong la sogs ma mo'o/ /yi ge k+ṣa ni 'dzag pa nyid/ /khu ba'i gzugs can chen po'o/ /yar dang mar byi bcu pa la/ /rnal 'byor pa yis mchod par bya/ /gtor ma'ang rtag tu sbyin par bya/ /dam tshig gnas pas brda sbyar bya/ /sngon gsungs phyag rgya la sogs pa/ /sngags kyi sbyor ba'i srung ba yis/ /cho ga bzhin du kun du bsrung / /sha dang chang la sogs pas kyang / /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams la/ /myur du 'bad pas mchod par bya/ /lho ru sngon 9bltas rnal 'byor pas/ /mthon po'i gnas su mchod par bya/ /mtshan mo skra grol gcer gyur pa'i/ /brtul zhugs can gyis gtor ma sbyin/ /rkang mnan steng du bltas pa yis/ /gyen du phe gyi ⑤sgra sgogs shing / /phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams 'gugs/ /rdo rje thal mo steng kha phye—/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi sngags/ /sngags kyis yang dag bskul byas te/ /de dus spyan drang ༷ba yang bya/ /mdzub mo mdud byas gung mo nges par sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan por dam bcas te/ /'di ni dpral ba'i dbus su rab bzhag nas/ /bskor zhing bskor bas kun du bskor bar bya/ /g.yas brkyangab 11—1074

yi ①rkang pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dra ba'i phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /dam tshig gi rab bkang ②bya ste/ /gsang sngags nyid ni rjes dran bya/ /oṃ āḥ.a ral+li ④ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki bhā ④sa ma ya ste dṛ rjosh+ya ho/ /de ltar gsum bzhi lnga yi bar/ /dam tshig rdzas sogs gzhag pa dubazla/ /kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa bhū ④ta pre ta pi shā tsa/ u man+d+ra pasma ra ⑧badz+ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya i oṃ ba lo kṛṇ+ḍin+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu sarba sid rnyidz+re pra yaspyos ya dze+e ⑨baṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭi bhuñja tha/ pi ba tha memā ti kra 9/nyem tha ma ma sarba kārta ya sa ta su khaṃ bi brid ⑫dha ye sa ha yi ka bha ban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lag pa g.yon pa'i sbyor ba yis/ / dpa' bos brda rnams bstan par bya—/ /spyodapa' bos brda rnams kyi ni gzhi④/ /brda rnams la ni rab tu 'jug / rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gsum/ /cha'agro ba thams cad g.yon las byung / /'jig rten gsum bcas spyod pa spyod/ /mthe bo gnyis la rdo rje sems/ /mdzub mo la ni rnam snang bzhugs/ /pad+ma gar dbang gung mo la/ /dpa' bo grub stsol srin lag la/ /zad med mkha' ⑫sku mthe chung la/ /sen mo rnams la rta mgrin nyid—/ /dpa' bo thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /g.yon pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin/ /pho nya mo rnams lag mthil la/ /yang dag 'gro bar 'dod pa yi/ /dpa' bos brda lnga rab tu bstan/ /sa ni spyan mar bshad pa ste/ /chu khams mā ma shīr dran byas⑩/ /gos dkar mo dang sgol ma dag /me dang rlung du rab tu grags/ /tsum pa ka ni stong pa nyid/ /pha rol phyin pa de bzhin no/ /dbus ni dpa' bo kun gyi gnas/ /mkhas pas rgyab tu gshegs su gsol/ /de ltar dpa' bos brda bstan nas/ /de snod gcig la bza' bar bya/ /phywali kā li sngon bsams nas—/ /rnal 'byor chen pos ngal bso'ospyo/ /rab mchog zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 11—1075
