༄7/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lag mchod kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ hūṃsngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ s+thā tsakra sadza 2ra hasta pū dzi bidhi nā ma/ bod skad du / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lag mchod kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor ma yi gtso mo ni/ /rdo rje phag mo la btud de/ /bdag gi lag pa'i mchod pa yi/ /cho ga man ngag bzhin du bsnyu/ /de la tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs par dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i sngags pas lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bo dang mdzub mo dang gung mo dang srin lag dang mthe'u chung dang de dag gi sen mo rnams su rdo rje sems dpa' dang rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'od dpag med dang mi bskyod pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin can gyi go rims ji lta bar dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang nag po dang / —ljang gu'i mdog can gyis④/ oṃ ha / na ma hi/ swā hā tūsnye/ bo — 7ṣaṭa he/ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥ/ phaṭa haṃ zhes bya ba'i 11—1153

yi ge rnams dgod do/ /lag pa'i mthil du yang skad cig gis grub pa'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa bsgoms la de'i shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su g.yon skor ①du rim pa ji lta ba bzhin ya mi nī dang rmongs ①byed ma dang skyod byed ma dang 'jigs ①byed ma dang tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i rang bzhin can nag po dang dkar po dang ser po dang ljang gu dang du ba'i mdog dang ldan pa/ haṃ oṃ/ hri ④mo/ hro hri⑤/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge rnams dang / lte ba la ni rdo rje phag mo'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar mo oṃbaṃ zhes bya ba'i sa bon dag blta bar bya'o/ /lag pa'i bol la yang 'di dag nyid kyi gzugs brnyan nam 'khor lo gsum yongs su rdzogs par blta bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa la gnas pa'i 'byung ba sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha' rnams ltung byed ma dang gsod byed ma dang / 'gugs byed ma dang / gar gyi dbang phyug ma dang / pad+ma'i dra ba can gyi rang bzhin du lhag par mos par bya'o/ /de nas lag pa la gnas pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge dag la khu ba'i rdzas kyis byugs te lag mthil de dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'khor lo gsum gyi rang bzhin du lhag par mos par byas nas khu ba la sogs pa'i rdzas de yi ge gsum gyi sngags sam rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas yang dag ju ra mchod nas cho ga lhag pa dang ma tshang ba dag par bya ba'i don du yi ge brgya pa'i sngags bton te/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo byin gyis brlab 0pa'i don du gsol ba btab nas rdzas gzhan nam yang na de ma yin pa gzhan du gzhag ste/ lag pa'i mthil du sbyar ba'i rdzas srin lag gis blangs pa las snying ga dang lte ba dang mgo rnams su yi ge hūṃ dang udang oṃ brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas byugs pa na lha'i tshogs de dag bdag nyid la zhugs par 11—1154

mos par bya'o/ /cho ga 'di yang kun spyod pa'i rgyud dang 'byel pa yin no/ /lag pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /yang na sngar brjod pa'i cho gas sbyangs pa'i lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs pa'i rang bzhin du pu dzā zhe ①bya ba la sogs pa'i yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi ②brjod cing ji ltar sbyangs pa'i chang gis ①gru gsum gnyis byugs nas de'i dbus su yang dkyil 'khor zlum po'o/ /de rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer kyis rten dang ④brten pa'i dkyil 'khor dang ⑤bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das bkug par bsams te/ de la bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i rang bzhin du grub pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba la sogs pa ⑥yi ge gsum mam rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis phul nas pad+ma'i snod la gnas pa'i chang bdud rtsir bsgrubs pa srin lag dang mthe bos blangs te bcom ldan 'das dang bcom ldan 'das ma la rang rang gi snying po dang nye ba'i snying po dag gis dang /mkha' 'gro ma nas brtsams te gshin rje 'joms ma'i mthar thug pa rnams la yang 'di rnams nyid kyi rang rang gi sngags ji lta ba dag gis tshim par bya'o/ /de nas yang dag par mchod nas ma tshang ba dang lhag pa dag par bya ba'i don du yi ge brgya pa bton nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo byen gyis brlab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa'o//oṃ yo ga shudhatshosarba dharmā yo ga shurnyophohaṃ/ zhes brjod bzhin par pad+ma bskor pa'i 8)phyag rgyas mnyes par bya ste phyag rgya de sdud pa na ⑨'khyud pa'i stangs ka sngon du 'gro bas srin lag gis sa la reg cing oṃ badz+ra muḥ/ zhes brjod pas gshegs su gsol te/ 'khor lo de bdag nyid la gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas sa de la gnas pa'i chang lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs nas des snying ga dang lce dang mgo rnams su yi ge hūṃ dang tshidang oṃ brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas byug cing lag pa de la 11—1155

gnas pa'i lha'i 'khor lo yang bdag nyid la gzhug par blta bar bya'o/ /gru gsum dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /mgon po 'khor lo bde mchog la/ /lag pas mchod pa bshad pa 'di/ /rnal 'byor pa la phan byed yin/ /lag pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga dpal pra dz+nyā rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal su ma ti tīrti dang / sgra bsgyur gyi 1lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1153 1mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lag mchod kyi cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs so// —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sisba/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dmar po dang / (༄〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hu/ 'u〈〈co 〉〉bo/1154 1sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskor/ bye 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni dang rmongs/ 〈〈co 〉〉na dang mongs/ gu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jig je〈〈snar 〉〉1/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉trī/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs/1155 rte 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pu dza zhes/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gcig — —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—rten dang / 'a〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—dang / 67〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉shurtse/ 〈〈snar 〉〉shudha/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pad+ma'i skor ba'i/ 77〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btul ba/1156 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—gyi/11byed1156
bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (294)

na68༄7/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mdor brngus pa zhes bya ba/①༄gro/ /rgya kar skad du/ shrī tsakra sasba ra saṃ gra maṇ+ḍa la be+e dhi 'unā ma/ bod skad du / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 1cho ga mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi drin kyis bde chen gnas/ /skad cig gis ni thob gyur pa'i④/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu yi/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los h+phu sgyur / /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyes bu dam pa gzhung 'chang pa'i/ /mchog 'dzin thabs mkhas bdag la med/ /rang nyid dran pa gsal ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad par bya/ /rtsa bshad gsal ba'i rgyud rnams dang / /mkhas pa rnams kyi cho ga dang / /bla ma'i gdams ngag la brten nas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bri bar bya/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid thams cad ldan/ /mtshan nyid min pa kun du spangs/ /yang dag 11—1158

shes shing rgyud shes pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung gsang sngags shes/ /khro med gtsang zhing mkhas pa dang / /sbyor shes ye shes pha rol 'gro/ /thod pas spyi bor rgyan cha sogs/ /gzugs bzang yon tan ldan par bkur/ /snying rje med cing khro la gdug /khengs dang brkam chags bdag nyid bstod/ /mnyam par ma bzhag ①khyim la spyod/ /gshol 'dzugs ②pa dang tshong pa dang / /rmongs pas dam chos 'tshong ba ni/ /tshogs sam dkyil 'khor slob dpon min/ /slob ma rigs bzang chos la spro/ /'jam zhing snyan par smra ba dang / /snying rje la sogs phan sems ldan/ /thos dang klog pa mngon par brtson/ /gsang ba'i chos ①dang bla ma gus/ /slob ma de nyid yongs su gzung rjo/ /snying rje med cing khro la gdug /khengs dang brkam chags rnam g.yeng can/ /drag dang rmongs dang snyoms las can—/ /gzhan gyi srog la snying brtse med/ /gzhan gyi nor la sred pa ni/ /bla mas yongs su spang bar bya/ /yon tan ldan pa'i bla ma la/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob ma yis/ /sems can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /bsgral phyir lan gsum 'di skad brjod/ /thams cad mdon pa'i ston pa po/ /'jig rten rnams kyi 'dren mdzad lha/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /rdo rje bla ma mdzad du gsol/ /bla mas dkyil 'khor mchod pa char/ /yo byad thams cad 'byor gyur ram/ /cung zad cig gam ma yin zhes/ /slob ma'i gtso la dri bar bya/ /mi 'byor zer na gzung bumi nus/ /'dres ma las ni 'dres mar shes/ /thams cad 'byor zhes brjod pa ni/ /de tshe gzung ba'i cho ga brtsam⑦/ /slob ma'i rkang pa'i mthil du ni/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu 'dra bsam/ /lte bar ye shes me 'bar bas/ /de yi 'od zer snying 11—1159

gar 'bar/ /r+pā rmyelas byung ba'i sdig pa'i gzugs/ /mi sdug rid pa mdog sngon po/ /sdig ni sna yi sgo nas babāng / /de nas khro bo'i gzugs bsgoms nas//sdig ni kun nas za bar bsam/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī 1 kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smi zhuku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ slob ma lha mo'i gzugs bskyed nas/ /bsrung ba dag ni dgod par bya/ /slob ma gzung ba'i cho ga'o/ /ri sul tshang tshing phug rnams dang / /chu bo dag gi ngogs ④rnams dang / /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod du/ /der ni dkyil 'khor brtsam /rgyapar bya/ /lha ni mnyes par ma byas na/ /bdag nyid rnam par sun 'byin yin/ /bdag gam yang na dkyil 'khor ni/ /sngon du bsnyen pa byas pas 'grub/ /gnas dang ldang ba nyid dag dang / /'jug dang yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /byin gyis brlab gyedang dbang bskur dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang mchod pa'i mthar/ /cho ga bzhin du 'bum du bzla/ /rang gi lha yang 'bum du bzla/ /'khor los bkas ⑦gnang de bzhin te/ /gzhan ni khri ru bzlas par bya/ /bsnyen pa'o// //de ltar bsnyen pas mthu skyes 1nas/ /rang gi lus su dkyil 'khor bsdu/ /dngos grub mtshan ma mchog thob nas⑨/ /sa ni yongs su brtag par bya/ /grong dang dur khrod tshong dus dang / /tshal dang lha khang grong khyer ni/ /shar dang byang gi sa gzhi shis/ /lho dang nub phyogs de lta min/ /gtsug lag khang dang gnas khang dang / /tshal dang ri rtse rdo leb dang / /khang bzangs kyi /⑩ni steng phyogs dang / /dur khrod dang ni lha yi khyim/ /sa yi cha ni ji snyed pa/ /rgyud rnams kun las bsngags pa yin/ /rus pa thal ba zug rngu rdo/ /bshang bas ma dag gzhan du bgrod/ /dman shā—1sogs dngos grub bye brag gis/ /pus mo chu so lte 11—1160

ba'i bar/ /brkos la sa yis slar la dgang / /lhag na dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /phyi nas mtho gang tsam du brko/ /de ni chu yis rab bkang la/ /shar du bltas te gom brgyar 'gro/ /slar log nas ni brtag par bya/ /chu ni gang bar gnas na shis/ /bskams na sngags pas spang bar bya/ /ston zla tha chungs ①la sogs nas/ /brtsams te zla ba gsum gsum du/ /lto 'phye lho dang nub dang byang / /shar du de yi mgo bo ste/ /g.yon pa'i zur gyis nyal ba yin/ /'di yi lto shes byas nas brko/ /mgo dang rgyab phyogs nas brkos pa'i/ /skyon ni rgyas pa las shes bya/ /legs par bsnyen te bcag par bya/ /byang dang shar du gzhol bas ni/ /sngags pa rnams kyi pyadangos grub 'gyur/ /dbus su mtho bas rgyal srid dam/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas dag thob/ /byang du mtho bas 'chi 'gyur ram / /nor rnams myur du 'jig par byed/ /ji skad bshad pa'i shar mtho na/ /myur du rigs rnams zad par byed/ /dbus su dma' ba'i sa gzhi gang / /sgrub pa po ni 'joms dang ldan/ /sa brtag pa'o// //khang bzangs rdo leb gzhi dang ni/ /gtsug lag khang dang zhabs kyis bcagazhu /ba lang lhas dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /der ni brko sogs bya mi dgos/ /lag pa sa la bzhag nas su/ /rang gi snying po brgya rtsa bzlas/ /de la lci ba ma lhung bas / /dkyil 'khor sa ni nye bar byug /dur khrod thal bar ldan pa dang / /mi 'chi bcu phyed ldan pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor sa ni nyer byugs te/ /der ni dkyil 'khor yang dag brtsam ④/ /oṃ lo hūṃ/ zhes pas kyang /byesbyang ngo / /de ltar sbyangs pa'i sa gzhi la/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni rjes mthun pa'i/ /rin chen la sogs sa gzhi ru/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis bsam par bya/ /sa sbyang 11—1161

ba'o / / //rma gyi sa bon las byung ba'i/ /gos dang rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs①/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /'od zer ser po kun du 'bar/ /sa yi lha mo'i lag pa na/ /gser gyi bum pa thogs pa ni/ /lus byed sa la gnas pa ru/ /bltas te mchod la gsol ba gdab/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi1/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /gnang ba byin nas thim par bsam/ /sa bslang ba'o// //de nas sngar bstan sa'i 1dbus su/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen sbyor ba yis/ /bdag nyid nye bar gnas pa la/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin grogs kyi mchog /mkha' 'gro la sogs gzugs can gyis/ /gsol ba lan gsum gdab par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnams thuspyod pa/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun kyi sems chen po / /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyurace/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung khros nas ni/ /hūṃ badz+reta tiṣ+ṭha brjod pa yis/ /sprul ba'i 11—1162

'khor lo nam mkhar gdeg /mgul rgyan gdu bu rna rgyan dang / /spyi gtsug nor bus rnam par brgyan/ /mchod phyir thogs dang thal bas brgyan/ /rkang pa hūṃ las rdo rje bsam①/ /ma dang ṭa las nyi zla'i mig /las pa rdo rje gsor byed cing —/ /rdo rje'i lta bas kun du blta/ /mche ba gcigs nas hūṃ sgogs shing / /rol pa rdo rje 'gros kyi ④gar/ /g.yas brkyang dang ni g.yon brkyang dang / /zlum po sa ga rdo rje'i 'gros/ /mnyam pa'i stobs dang mi mnyam stobs①/ /rus sngal bung ba'i ④'phur tshogs brgyad/ /rdo rje 'gros kyis kun du bskor/ /gdug pa'i bgegs rnams bskrad par bya/ /blo ldan rdo rje gsor byed cing / /dril bu 'khrol bar brtson pa yis/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba dang / /rab tu gdug pa'i bgegs tshogs bskrad/ /da ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas/ /lus srul la sogs gang yang rung / /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du deng sti/ /ji ste bsgo ba su zhig 'da'/ /rdo rje bdag po sku yis ni/ /lus gsum las byung dges byas te/ /'dir ni brlag 'gyur gzhan du min/ /bdag slob dpon 'di zhes bya bas slob ma 'di zhes bya ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi don du/ sa phyogs 'di ru dpal he ru ka 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bri yis/ 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / srin po la sogs pa gang dag gzhan du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de nga'i ye shes kyi rdo rje 'di dang /kha ṭī ga 'dis spyi bo tshal par bkas par 'gyur/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas kyang bskrad de/ zhal bzhi pa yi sngags rnams dang / /rdo rje phur bu'i sngags kyis kyang —/ /gdug pa'i bgegs rnams bskrad par bya/ /sa ni yongs su bzung byas 11—1163

nas / /dra bas phyogs mtshams bcing bar bya/ /ra ba rnams ni phyogs su dgod/ /'og tu mtshon cha dgod par bya/ /steng du mda' yi dra ba dang / /bdag nyid steng du gur bya ste/ /de ltar go bgos sum cu ni/ /rtsa gsum pas kyang gzhig mi nus/ /sa bsrung ba'o// //de nas ri rab rtse mo yang / /ṭī① garnyar rab bsams khyal/ /dri zhim chu thas byugs pa dang / /me tog sel ma rab bkram la/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ /mchod yon phul la gsol ba gdab/ /bcom ldan khro mchog rdo rje can/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po lhan cig 'byung ba yisacho/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal lags na/ /de bas bcom ldan gus bdag la / /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ /gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub la brten snyepa'i/ /'byung po bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang du hūṃrdo rje spyan ldan kun—/ /dkyil 'khor bde mchog 'byung ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri mebar bgyid lags na/ /bdag dang de bzhin slob ma la/ /rjes su brtse ba bskyed du gsol/ /phyogs bzhir mar me bltams nas ni/ / auḍān duphyogs su ci bder nyal/ /sa gzung 97ba'o// //de nas rin chen gser dang dngul/ /zangs ma'am 'jim pa dag kyang rung / /ji ltar 'byor pa'i rjes mthun par/ /bum pa dag ni bya ba ste/ /rtsa ba nag po la sogs spang ⑩/ /lto yang bum pa bzang po'i dbyebs/ /legs bkru dkar por bya ba dang / /spos kyis bdug cing yungs kar brdeg /bdud rtsi 11—1164

'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsrung / /mtshan ma rnams ni dgod pa dang / /bza' ba kun gyis legs bkang ba'i/ /snod ni steng du gzhag rmyepar bya/ /mgrin pa srad bus dkri ba dang / /kha ni 'dab mas brgyan par bya/ /gos zung gis ni legs dkris par/ /chu bzang 'o ma ldan pas dgang / /byatsū seng hi 3dbyug pa dang //at+pa la gzhan 5mi thub pa/ /ha sa de ba sman lngar bcas/ /oṃ pañca bhe ṣa dz+re thuldihūṃ/ /gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang / /mu men byi ru rin chen lnga/ //oṃ pañca rat+na uhūṃ/ /til dang nas dang gro dang ni/ /mon sran gre dang yungs kar bcas/ /oṃ pañca be+e ga uhūṃ/ /mar dang 'o ma lan tshwa dang / /bu ram thusbrang rtsi snying po lnga/ /oṃ pañca gasgo āḥ'uhūṃ/ /ga pur tsan+dan dri chen chu/ /sman gyi chu yis dgang bar bya/ /oṃ pañca a mṛ 3te āḥhūṃ/ /de ltar byas pa'i bum pa yang /brgyad ni sgo ru dgod pa ste/ /gos zung sogs kyis dkris pa'o/ /bum pa dgu pa dbus su dgod/ /bdag nyid lhar gsal snying ga yi/ /'od zer spyor bas bum pa sbyang / /de nas yi ge hūṃ khyalas ni/ /lha yi gzhal yas khang du bsam/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa ru/ /lha yi 'khor lo rdzogs par yang / /skad cig gis ni bsam par bya/ /gzhan du 'khor lo'i rjes 'brangs pa/ /rigs dang bcas pa gsal bar blta/ /mchod dang bskor bas mnyes pa dang / /snying po rtsa ba'i sngags sogs kyang / /stong ngam brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /bum nang lha rnams zhu bar bsam/ /de nas rol mor bcas pa dang / /bkra shis glu dbyangs sna tshogs kyis/ /ras bzang me tog ldan pa 'am/ /ku sha'i steng du gzhag rngupar bya / /bum pa sta gon no// //de nas skyes bu dam pa yis/ /mngon par rtogs pa gzhung bzhin bsgom/ /11—1165

bdud rtsi lnga ①ni kun du byug /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas rnams su/ /tsan+dan sogs pas gru bzhir bya/ /phal pa yi ni gnas rnams su/ /so sor zlum por byas nas ni/ /lha yi 'khor lo cho ga bzhin/ /me tog be+egs pas mchod par bya//lte bar dgod bya'i dpa' bo ni/ /'jigs byed chen po'i gzugs can ni/ /rab tu 'bar zhing mdangs dang bcas/ /nam mkha'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni/ /yid kyis thams cad mkha' la dgod/ /sa steng mkha' 'gro ma gang yin/ /dkyil 'khor kun du dgod par bya/ /gang yang sa 'og mkha' 'gro ma/ /de ni sa 'og rnams su dgod/ /ma mo thams cad phyogs dang ni/ /phyogs mtshams rnams su dgod par bya/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /dri dang me tog bdug spos dang / /mar me brgya yang dbul bya zhing / /rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /dkar dang gnag dang ser skya dang / /de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang / /me tog phreng ba du ma dang / /bla re dag dang bcas pa yisadzu / /mda' ni shin tu mdzes pa dang / /de bzhin bza' bca' btung ba yis rab mnyam gzhag ste mchod par bya/ /de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid dpal/ /ston pa gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /rdo rje phag mor yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la phan pa dang —/ /dzad rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pa/ /nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyid/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer gedagongs te/ /kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lha la gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /sngar bshad 11—1166

mtshan ldan slob ma ni/ /khrus byas gtsang ma'i gos gyon te/ /me tog phreng thogs phyag btsal nas/ /bla ma mchog la gsol ba gdab/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa①/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsolalde)/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la stsol④/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te / /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol④/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog du/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /slob mas de skad lan gsum brjod/ /slob ma'i gtso bo gcig nyid la/ /dmigs nas bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos ④byang chub shing drung du—/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med gnas/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de—/ /skyob bupa dpal ldan te ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /dpa' bo yan lag las byung ba'i/ /sdom pa la sogs slob ma la/ /byang chub thob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /cho ga thams cad sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub 11—1167

sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bla ma mchod pas de bzhin byams/ /sangs rgyas la gus 'gro la brtse/ /rtsa ba'i thong ba yongs shes shing / /sbom po'i ltung ba rnam par spangs/ /kha na ma tho bcas gyur pa'i/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo / /'dod pa log par mi srud cing / /brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya /sems can gdul phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung nas/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /de bzhin bla med byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag ①gis bskyed par bkyi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /basbab pa yi ni tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang —/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung chabar bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /de ring mchog tu gzung ④bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ / phyag rgya ⑦dril bu phyag rgya yang / /de kho na nyid gzung ⑤bar bya/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung ⑥bar bya/ /rin chen rigs mchog sbyor ba yi⑦ / /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba (gutheg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni rab tu gzung ⑨/ /las kyi ⑫rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /thams cad du ni rab tu gzung lhome/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bkyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla 11—1168

na me+ed/ /dam pa de ni bskyed nas su/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung ①/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung ②zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /de nas slob ma mdun bdar la/ /gnas gsum dri yi thig le yang / /yig gsum bzlas te bsku ①bar bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi lha gsal la/ /spyi bor me tog spos mar me/ /dri yang snying gar zhal zas rnams/ /kun byed bzlas te mchod byas nas/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma phog par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni/ /dus kun du ni bde bar gnos(ge/ /a shwad u dum bā ra yi⑤ / /so shing sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /ma yo ma gas srog chags med/ /rtse mo me tog bcas pa sbyin/ /shar ram byang du kha bltas te/ /bcas nas ltos ⑥ pa med par ni/ /ba ko tsam gyes byugs par dor/ /dngos grub phrin las bar chad gsum/ /dngos grub mchog ni shar phyogs dang / /rang la bltas par shes par bya/ /'bring ni gzhan la tha ma yang / /'og tu bltas par shes par bya/ /oṃ triḥbi shud+dhāḥsarba dharmātsho/sarba pā ba nibya saṃ ⑪sho dha ya/ sarba bi kadze+e ⑨a pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes pas/ skyor chu lan gsum blud par bya/ /srad thu dmar pos khyad par du/ /mdud la gnod mdzes sngags bzlas te/ /dpung par bcings la bsrung bar bya/ /de nas phyir mi ldog bya'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams la spro ba bskyed⑫/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dum bā lhospera'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 8'ga' zhig /'byung gyur ⑫yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis ⑫mnyam med sems can don/ /grags 11—1169

pa mtha' yas spyod pa yis①/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa gang / /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba//mthong bas byang bar 'gyur legs ①na/ /grags pa mtha' yas spyod pa yi/ /tshul la gnas pa smos ci dgos/ /de ltar spro ba bskyed nas kyang / /yi ge bdun pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i/ /ku sha de la rab tu sbyin/ /rmi lam dge dang mi dge brtag /tshogs 'khor byas la bkra shis brjod/ /gtor ma btang ①nas ye shes gshegs/ /dam tshig bsdus la ci bder gnas/ /slob ma sta gon no/ /srad bu ye shes lngar ldan zhing / /nyi shu rtsa lngar rnam phye bas/ /chos kun ngo bo nyid kyis ni—/ /srad bu phan tshun bsgril bar bya/ /oṃ a byo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥspa lgo ra spa ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ.a t+yan ta du.a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ/ dkyus su dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur la/ /sboms su sgo yi nyi shu cha/ /bdud rtsi brgyas ni byug par bya—/ / le shes ④thig ni bskyed nas su/ /dzatshogasum brjod nas ste bar ni/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur kyis bzung nas/ /blo ldan nam mkhar thig gdab bya/ /de bzhin sa la gdab par bya/ /khru phyed la sogs brtsams nas ni/ /ji srid khru ni brgya yi bar/ /dang po tshangs pa'i thig yin te/ /gnyis pa la ni zur thig gdab/ /gsum pa phyogs kyi thig btab la/ /bzhi pa cha chen bcu drug gdab/ /cha phran bzhi bzhir bgos byas pa/ /spyir na cha chung drug cu bzhi/ /ngos gcig la ni sum cu gnyis/ /dkyil 'khor nang la bcu drug las/ /gnyis la gtso bo'i pho brang ste/ /gsum bzhi lnga drug bde chen gyi/ /'khor lo pad+ma 'dab brgyad bya/ /bdun pa gri gug phreng ba la/ /brgyad dang dgu pa thugs 'khor lo/ /bcu pardo rje phreng ba ste/ /bcu gcig bcu gnyis gsung yin te/ /bcu gsum pad+ma'i phreng 11—1170

ba'o / /bcu bzhi bco lnga sku yi sa/ /bcu drug 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor/ /de ni nang gi dkyil 'khor la/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid kyang / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra byed 'phyang ba mdzes/ /g.yer kha'i phreng ba'i dra ba can/ /mtshams kyi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud ①kyi ni nang rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis spras dang / /rdo rje ra ba me 'od bcas/ /dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rol du/ /shing la sogs pa'i dur khrod bya/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo'i rjes mthun par/ /ji ltar mdzes pa rab tu brtag /thig skud chad na slob dpon 'chi/ /dman dang lhag pas nad 'byung ste/ /phyogs la 'khrul na slob ma myos/ /de bas skyon med shes par bya/ /thig gdab pa'o / / //rin chen lnga yi phye ma'am/ /yang na 'bras la sogs pa ste/ /ro bsregs sol ba'i phye ma'am/ /dur khrod so phag ldan pa la/ / hūṃ khaṃ rīl sogs yig 'bru lnga / /yongs 'gyur tshon rtsi lnga ru bsam/ /slob dpon dbang ldan phyogs su ni/ /song ste mnyam par bzhag kyinas su/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis/ /ri mo lnga ni dgye bar bya/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni sgol mdzad pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /mre long la sogs rim brjod nas/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /kun gye nang rol nag po ru/ /tshon kyi cha ni rim bzhin dgye/ /tshon rtsi re re'i zhing du ni/ /sgo yi nyi shu cha yi tshad/ /phan tshun bar du nas re tsam/ /mtho la drang bar bri bar bya/ /gal te tshon rtsi mi mnyam zhing / /yo dang dma' bar gyur na ni/ /ri mo dma' bas dngos mi 'grub/ /yon pos gdung ba skyed byed pa/ /11—1171

de nyid mtho bas nad du 'gyur/ /chad na slob dpon slob ma dag /gnyis ka 'chi bar shes par bya/ /g.yas skor ma yin bris na ni/ /rdul tshon phur bus gdab par 'gyur/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma ni/ /ge sar yang dag ldan pa la/ /mtshams su bum pa thod pas brgyan/ /gser gyi mdog tu zi bar bya/ /mthing shun phye ma la sogs pas/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ /rdo rje 'khor los bskor bar bya/ /byu ru la sogs mdog 'dra bas/ /gsung gi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ /pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor ba bri/ /mu tig la sogs phye mas ni/ /sgu yi 'khor lo bri byas te/ /'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor bar bya/ /ji ltar pad+ma'i kha dog bzhin/ /sgo bzhi'i cha yang de bzhin te/ /shar phyogs su ni dkar po ste/ /lhor ni ser po yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste/ /byang du margad lhosnayang dag ldan/ /dbus kyi sa yi cha nyid ni/ /in+d+ra dī ④la 'od 'bar ba'i—/ /grwa yi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud dukyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis spras pa/ /mnyam par gzhag pas yang dag bri/ /rdo rje ra ba'i nang du ni/ /dur khrod brgyad kyis brgyan pa ste/ /gtum drag de bzhin tshang tshing dang —/ /rdo rje 'bar ba keng rus can/ /dbang ldan du ni mi zad ④gzhan/ /byin za ru ni bkra shis mchog /mun pa drag po bden bral du/ /rlung du tī li tī la'i 5sgra/ /shar du shir+ṣa a shwad shing / /kang ke khyad par tsu 0ta'i shing / /ba da de bzhin ka rañja/ /la da bar ka par thi ka /dbang po de bzhin gnod sbyin dang —/ /klu yi dbang dang gshin rje'i bdag /dbang ldan de bzhin byin za dang / /srin bo'i dbang po rlung gi bdag /ba su ki dang 'jog po nyid/ /pad chen hu lu hu lu dang / /dbang ldan dang ni dung skyong ngo / /sgogs pa dang ni 11—1172

cher sgogs dang / /drag dang yon tan bstan de bzhin/ /gang ba dang ni de bzhin 'bebs/ /gtum po 'di dag sprin ①dbang phyug /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs rnams dang / /dngos grub rdzu 'phrul yang dag par/ /thob pa slob dpon kyi ni tshogs/ /dur khrod dbus su blta bar bya/ /de nyid bsdus dang bde mchog dang / /gsang ba rdo rje 'jigs byed las/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rgyal po 'di—/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /tshon dgye ba'o// //de nas slob dpon mnyam gzhag pas/ /dkyil 'khor dbus nas dur khrod sar / /lhag chad nyes pa'i skyon bsal la/ /bskor 4ba lan gsum brtsam par bya / /bum pa mchod rdzas la sogs pa/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo dang / /sil snyan glu yis spyan drangs la/ /dkyil 'khor gnas su dgod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun du rin chen nam/ /gser rnams kyis ni mdzes par bya/ /de nas slob dpon khrus byas te/ /dri zhim rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /rtse bran rdo rje dril 'dzin pa/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni lho phyogs su/ /bde ba'i gdan la 'dug nas ni/ /bla ma dam pa phru yi pas/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa rnams/ /bsgoms te bzlas pa byas pa'i mthar/ /bcu drug lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dri/ /dkar po dung mdog dmar ba ljang / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rtsa bar rtags/ /ḍa ru snyethod pa kha ṭī ga /gzhan gyi phyag gsum dag na 'dzin/ /pi wang gling bu rnga zlum ma/ /rdza rnga zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ /gnyis kyis rang rang ④brdung bar brtson/ /tha ma rdo rje snyedril bu 'dzin/ /sngo ser dmar po ljang gu'o/ /phreng ba sgeg mo glu gar ma/ /dmar dkar ser mo ljang gu ste/ /phreng ma phyag gnyis phreng ba 'dren/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin sgeg pa mo/ /11—1173

glu ma 'khar ba'i sel khrol te/ /gar ma pad+ma'i gar skyod byed/ /gzhan gnyis thod pa kha ṭī ga /gzugs dang ro dud 1/reg dang chos/ /dkar dmar ljang gu dkar mo ste/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po na/ /me long dad dudri gos chos 'byung / / ḍa ru 1thod pa kha ṭī ga /lhag ma'i phyag na gnas pas mchod/ /rkang pa brgyad kyis bstod byas la/ /bshags dang gsol ba la sogs bya/ /ga ṇa tshogs kyi 4mchod pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor lha kun mnyes byas la/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro ma rnams la/ /ba bo chen po'i gtor ma sbyin/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i don du ni/ /slob dpon rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /zhi dang rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ni/ /slob ma sdig sogs sbyong ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'grub pa'i grangs rnams byas / /me tog phreng 'dzin slob dpon gyis/ /lha 5yi sgo nas zhugs nas kyang / /he ru ka dpal rgyal po la/ /chu dang dbu rgyan la sogs pa/ /rjes gnang mtha' ru rim bzhin no/ /rigs la rjes gnang thob pa dang / /slob ma shis par bya ba'i phyir/ /bden pa 'di ni bsgrag par bya/ /don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes pa bskyed pa nyon mongs bcom mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor don dam de nyid rgyal po grub par mdzod/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o// //kun byed chu yis khrus byas la/ /de yi bu sdug gdong la ni/ /dar gyis legs par dkris nas ni/ /yol ba'i mthar ni drangs pa la/ /bla mas 'di skad dri bar bya/ /sdug pa khyod su ci la dga'/ /des kyang bdag ni skal dub bzang //bde ba che la rtag tu dga'/ /de nas las kun byed pa'i chus/ /yol ba'i phyi ru bsang gtor bya/ /de nas slob mas 'di skad du/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 3rang 11—1174

bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor gnas ①la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par mdzod/ /bla mas kyang ni 'di skad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /te ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snyeng po bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /de nas lho sgor mngon phyogs la/ /oṃ na ma ste hūṃ/ na ma ④mi hūṃ/ na mo na ma hūṃ/ lus ngag yid kyis phyag gsum bya/ /snying gar rdo rje rab bzhag la/ /rnal 'byor sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /oṃ yo ga cis uta pā dā yā mi/ sur ta ①sa ma ya ༈ hoḥsidha ④badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ de yi spro ba bskyed ⑦pa ni/ /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khrod la he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhun lta ci zhig smos kyi bukhyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ /he ru ka dpal deng spyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chu dag ni/ /thod par legs par blugs tso)nas ni/ /mna' chu blud phyir 'di skad brjod/ /'di ni spyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs ⑧na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ /oṃpañca a mṛ tod ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhatshohūṃ/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ngas gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod nga la brnyas par ma 11—1175

byed cig /khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par che'i dus byas nas dmyal bar thong bar gyur ①ta re/ de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byen gyis zlobs la/ dpal te ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzod cig ces smrar gzhug go/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang byi la'i brun/ /gu gul bud med gos kyi mtha'/ /pad+ma'i snod du bzhag nas su/ /dur khrod me la bdug par bya/ /g.yas brkyang ba la legs bsdams te/ /gnyis med gsang sngags bzlas byas nas/ /skad cig nyid la yang dag 'jug /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ shrī te ru ka a 2bid ma te bibyā rā dzā buya bye ma te swā hā/ zhes ni dpa' bo bskul bar bya/ /de nas g.yon thogs grong khyer du/ /bskor ba lan gsum byas nas ni/ /bsnyen nas snyim ḍa4pa'i me tog dor/ /pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ /dkyil 'khor gang du me tog babs/ /de yi rigs ni bstan par bya/ /slar yang de nyid blangs nas su/ /slob ma'i mgo la bcing bar bya/ /te ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig ni 'byed par brtson par mdzad/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /thams cad mig ni phye bar 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe ⑤tra a pa ha ra paṭa lo hri/ /brjod nas gdong g.yogs phud nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rig buskyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byen gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub bu khyod skal ldan 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /gsang sngags la yang brtson bar kyis/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gye de nyid ni/ /dbus kyi pad+ma rin chen 'dzin/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /gsung gi 'khor lo snang mtha' yas/ /skuyi 'khor lo rnam snang mdzad/ /sbubs rnams kun ni don yod la/ /sgo bzhi dran pa 11—1176

nyer gzhag bzhi/ /kha dog lnga ni rigs lnga la/ /gru bzhi tshangs pa'i sgo bzhi gsungs/ /logs bzhi bsdu ba'i dngos po ste/ /ka ba brgyad ni rnam thar brgyad//gdong bzhi ye shes bzhi yi don/ /twa ①ra ṇa la sogs pa kun/ /stobs la sogs pa yin par gsungs/ /rnam shes dag pa dur khrod la/ /phyogs skyong mi dge bcu ngo/ spong / /sangs rgyas brgyad kyi mtshan ma shing / /gdug pa 'joms phyir shing brgyad do/ /thugs rje'i rtags su sprin brgyad do/ /de nas lha yi rnam dag ni/ /dpa' bo che la bu khyod ltos/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med pas/ /yum dang gnyis su med pa yin/ /mthing ga skyon gyis ma gos pa/ /zhal bzhi rnam par thar pa bzhi/ /spyan ni dus gsum mkhyen pa ste/ /rten 'byel dag pas phyag bcu gnyis/ /pha rol phyin pas rgyan drug la/ /'khor lo lnga yi lha rnams ni/ /sum cu rtsa bdun byang chub phyogs/ /yin par mngon rtogs gzhung ltar sbyar/ /slob ma gzhug pa'o// //de nas slob mas bla ma yi/ /zhabs la dad pas phyag bya ste/ /thal sbyar yon ni phal ba yis/ /dbang bskur don du gsol ba gdab/ /byang chub rdo rjes ②sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod ①chen gsol ba ltar/ /bdag kyang drang ba'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag gsol/ /de nas lho sgor pad+ma ni/ /'dab brgyad dbus su khri bshams te/ /slob ma brtag ④pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rgyan gyes bklubs te gzhag snye/par bya/ /chu rnams rnam rgyal bum par bsdu/ /mi bskyod pa ru bskyed nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor lus la btsud nas su/ /slob ma'i spyi bor bkru bar bya/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas/ /gsang gsum gnas las 'byung ⑪ba yi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi chu 11—1177

dbang sbyin/ /oṃ u da ka a rnyi ṣi.ā+oṃ ①mi/ /shing dam rin chen dbu rgyan la/ /rin chen 'byung bar bskyed nas su/ /ye shes 'khor lo lus la gzhug /gsang gsum gnas las 'byung 0ba yi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /dbu rgyan dam pa khyod kyis long / /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rdo rje 'dibye// /'od dpag med du bskyed nas su/ /gsung gi 'khor lo lus la gzhug /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya / /sangs rgyas kun don rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis bzung / /oṃ badz+ra a bye pa ti hūṃ a bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ ④mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya ste/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag / oṃ las skyes 5pa'i dril bu yang / /lag pa g.yon par byin nas ni/ /dam tshig 'khor lo lus la gzhug /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi 'urjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang ⑦/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzheng / /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa zudam pa byed par 'gyur/ /rdo rje dril bu spyi bor ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad sku yi tsakra bsgom/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a bye ༄ snapa ti ste/ a bhi shi.ā+oṃ mi6/ oṃ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣi skyeka ta/ shrī 8sgra dang bcas pa 'dis/ /rigs las drangs te ming dbang bskur/ /chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang / /dril bu dang ni ming dbang bskur/ /bde gshegs lnga yi bdag nyid de/ /phung po lnga dang nyon mongs dag /rigs ⑫pa'i dbang lnga'o / / //11—1178

srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po zhi byed pa/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya/ /yid kyis ①lus ni brtag ④pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces byar brjod/ /dam tshig gsum ni byen nas su/ /de nas sngags kyi dbang bskur sbyin①/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis yi ge mchog /bdag gis bcom ldan 'dir byen lags/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gisakubacom ldan 'dir bzung lags/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas sngags kyi dbang bskur byen/ /gzhan don nus pa'i gtso chen gyis/ /dbang bskur don du gsol ba gdab/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas sogs/ /de bzhin bdag la de gsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i—/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol④/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /de nas brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na bsnams/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan⑥/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sernyi badz+ra sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hūṃ ⑦e ṣahūṃ dha ra yā mi hūṃ ha ha ha ha nyi⑧/ /rdo rje ⑫ rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /kha ṭī cang te'u pad snod sogs/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar bgyi/ /he ru ka yi phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi rol nang na yang dag gnas/ /spyod pa'i brtul zhugs so/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis chos gos mtha'/ /brtul zhugs can gyis bzung ba dang / /g.yas pas mi 'jigs sbyin par bya/ /slob ma lung ni bstan par bya/ /oṃ'adi ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa'i mtha' ni grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 11—1179

'gro kun nas bton/ /oṃshrī he ru ka ke ti na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi sa ma ya ste/bhur bhu ba swatsho/ khyod ni 'khor lo gsum dbang phyug /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin nyid/ /he ru ka dpal zhes bya ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan to/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang //shes rab thabs kyi bsnyems chen gyi②/ /gar chen bde bas dga' ston gyis/ /gar ro/ /sgeg dang bcas pa'i phreng ba 'bar①/ /sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /des ni bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /phreng ba 'di ni rgyan yin no/ /phreng ba'o/ /lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /khyod kyis glu ni blang bar bya/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma de dang / /mchog tu bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /glu'o/ /khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul la/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / / rjam grol 4ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos/ /dri'o/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas⑤/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim kyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par 'gyur/ /spos so/ /chos kyi mar me legs sbar na/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid 'gyur/ /sems can ma rig ldongs rnams la/ /ye shes sgron mes snang bar gyis/ /mar me'o/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi chu7ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe ⑦tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lo triḥnya / thur ma'o/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med⑨/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos 'di shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med gyis/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye/ /11—1180

me long ngo / /khyod ni the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dra ①med kun du dgang bar ①gyis/ /dung ngo / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnas pa dang —/ /bsad dang bskrad pa la sogs te/ /las de rnams ni grub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /shing lham de bzhin ri lu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub rnams/ /ci dga' bar ni sgrub par gyis/ /shes rab thabs dag rang bzhin gyis/ /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin du/ /skyo dub stidogs pa ma byed par—/ /de ④ni sems can don rnams kyis/ /byang chub snying po mthar thug par//ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ /kun nas rab tu bskor bar gyis/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams nas/ /yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu la/ /'bad pas dpa' bo chang sogs kyis/ /rdo rje lha mo rab tu mchod/ /gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mchog tu rab zhugs mthong bas na/ /de khyod sdig pa thams cad las/ /rnam grol bzang por 'gyur bar gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mnyam gsungs pa'i/ /rjes gnang mchog tu dbugs dbyung ba/ /dngos grub mtshan nyid sdom pa ni/ /'di dag rtag tu bsrung bar gyis/ /slob ma dad pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bgyi zhes smra bar bya/ /dbang bskur rjes gnang thob pa yig/ /bya ba byas pas rab dgod cing / /kun du dga' bar byed pa yin/ /'jam pa'i tshig ni brjod par bya/ /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag gi gson pa 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /rtog pa'i mtshon 11—1181

chen rab 'jigs pa/ /nyon mongs 'dam ni rgal ṭ+wādaka' zhing / /mnar med la sogs skye ba 'khrungs/ /mgon po khyod kyis bdag bsgral —/lo/ /bag chags thams cad spangs pa yi/ /byang chub dam pa bdag 'tshal ba/ /khyod zhabs lam gyi bka' drin gyis/ /rdzogs pa nyid du bdag gyur to/ /slob dpon dbang bsgur yang dag rdzogs/ /bum pa las ni byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa gsang ba mchog yin te/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes yin/ /bzhi pa de ltar yang de bzhin/ /dbang bsgur 'di dag yang dag ldan/ /de ni dam tshig can zhes bya/ /bla ma'i ngag las rtogs pa'i phyir/ /mchog dbang gsum po gsal ma byas/ /sdogs so / / //de nas gzhan yang rab gnas kyi/ /cho ga pha rol son pa bshad/ /sngar bshad mtshan nyid ldan pa yi/ /slob dpon du ni rab tu brtag /lugs ma mngon par 'dus byas pa'i/ /sku gzugs la sogs pa rnams ni/ /rab gnas don du sa sbyang zhing / /bla re rgyal mtshan ba dan rnams/ /brgyan cing sa ni yongs su gzung 'u / /sku gzugs sam ni glegs bam mam/ /bris sku yongs su rdzogs pa rnams/ /mdun rol du ni gnas par bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo nam mkhar gnas/ /nyer spyod lnga yis yang dag mchod/ /sa ma ya ste/ sa ma ya ho/ /lan gsum du ni brjod par bya/ /ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /dga' ldan yang dag gzigs nas ni/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin 'dir ni bzhugs ngasu gsol/ /che ge zhes bya'i don du ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs spel phyir/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes te/ /mgon po 'dir ni rtag rngobazhugs mdzod/ /tshig 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /lhag par 11—1182

gnas par ①byas nas ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bstong byas na/ /yungs kar gyis ni bskor nas kyang / /lan gsum du ni sbyang bar bya/ /'dag chal gyis ni khrus kyang bya/ /dri zhim ldan pa'i mar gyis byug /slar yang bum pa so so yi sku gzugs rnams ni khrus kyang bya/ /phyi nas nam mkhar gnas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bcom ldan 'das/ /lugs ma la sogs rab zhugs bya/ /yul chos la sogs ji bzhin du/ /las bcu yi ②ni bya ba bya/ /spyan ni dbye ba byas nas su/ /rdo rje'i spyan du byin gyis brlab/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan/ /sems can don du dbye bar bgyi/ /oṃ tsagru tsakyu sa masnya tsagru bi sho dha ye swā hā/ /dngul gye rna brus snyan phye la/ /rdo rje'i snyan du byin gyis brlab/ /'gro rnams chos kyis phongs ①pa la/ /rgyal bas chos kyi dung bus ltar/ /de bzhin sems can don byi phyir—/ /rgyal ba'i snyan ni dbye bar bya/ /oṃ di bya kar+ṇa ye swā hā/ /gser gyi tseng tses 4shangs phye la/ /rdo rje'i shangs su byin gyis brlab/ /zag bcas phung po dri spangs pa'i/ /'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir/ /rnam par dag pa'i dri bskyed ltar / /rgyal ba'i shangs ni dbye bar bya/ /oṃ byi bya gh+ra ṇa ye swā hā/ /zhal thur gyes zhal phye la/ /rdo rje'i zhal du byin gyis brlab/ /chos kyi ro yi dga' ba yis//'gro ba thams cad tshim mdzad pa/ /ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas rnams/ /dbul phyir rgyal ba'i zhal dbye 'o/ /oṃdi bya mu kha ye swā hā/ tshems shing gis tshems phyis la/ /rgyal ba'i che sa dkar bzhi bcu la/ /mi gtsang rdul gyis ma gos te/ /bkur ⑤ste rin chen ljon shing gis/ /rgyal ba'i tshems ni dbye bar bya—/ /ras kyis pyasku phyis la/ rgyal bas nyes pa'i skyon spangs kyang / /sems can 11—1183

nyes pa sbyang sbad du/ /ras dkar gtsang ma'i pho ldi yis/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sku phyi'o—/ /oṃ kā ya bi sho dha ṣ+pe swā hā/ rab byung yin na gser gyi sru gris dbu skra bzhar la/ ji ltar rang byung mchod rten du/ /rgyal bas khyim pa'i rtags spangs ltar—/ /'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir/ /khyer pa'i rtags ni ①spang bar bya/ /'khor los sgyur ①ba'i cha byad yin①/ /rgyal ba'i dbu skra lcang lo la/ /dug gsum dri mas ma gos te/ /bkur ste dung gi so mangs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i dbu skra bshad par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba na gnas pa rnams la mkho ④ ba'i yo byad rnams phul la/ 'gro ba sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la basbab bya zhes/ /ji ltar thugs dam rgya cher bzhes pa ltar/ /mkho ba'i yo byad rnams ni dbul bar bya/ /oṃ bo bye satwa u pa ⑤yu ka sa pa ri wā 6)ra ye swā hā/ /de nas rdzas kyi mchod pa'am/ /'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa las—/ /spyan la sogs pa'i skye mched la/ /ci rigs par ni mchod par bya/ /de nas mnga' che ba'i rdzas dbul te/ /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis brgyad/ /sman lnga la sogs mkho ba'i rdzas/ /rdo rings glegs thag la sogs dbul/ /rin chen mnga' dbul 'dir mi brjod/ /bkra shis brgyad kyi ④mnga' dbul ba/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /bkra shis dpal be'u g.yung drung 'khyel/ /dge ba'i don du mnga' ba ltar/ /bdag gis dpal be'u dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /gser gyi 'khor lo mu khyud can/ /tshangs pa chen pos phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbul bar bkyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /gdugs dkar gser kyi yu ba can/ /phul ba de bzhin bdag dbul gyis—/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /11—1184

nyon mongs bdud las rgyal ba yi/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ / ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la①/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /bum pa bzang po phul ba ltar/ /bdag gis ci sde bzhin dbul bar bgyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /ji ltar sngon byi sangs rgyas la/ /'dam gyi skyon gyis ma gos pa'i/ /pad+ma dkar po phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /snyan pa phyogs bcur sgogs pa yi/ /bud dung g.yas 'khyil phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /na bza' gser kyi ngang ris can/ /phul ba de bzhin bdag dbul ①kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /de las gzhan pa'i mnga' dbul ba ni/ bde gshegs rnams la 'bru phul bas/ /zas kyi 'byor pa ldan pa dang / /dge ba'i lo tog rgyas gyur cig /rin chen sna lnga phul ba yis/ /bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /dbul ba'i snyug bsngal zhi ba dang / /longs spyod phun sum tshogs gyur cig /bde gshegs rnams la sman phul bas/ /nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /nad kyi sdug bsngal byang gyur nas/ /thugs rje'i sman gyis gdul gyur cig /snying po rnam pa lnga phul bas/ /bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kyis/ /ye shes rnam pa lnga rtogs te/ /yang dag snying po ldan gyur cig /de nas gur gum la sogs chus/ /dri bsgo'i ④phyir na bkru bar bya/ /mchod rten glegs bam la sogs la/ /dbang po skye mched med pa'i phyir/ /spyan dbye la sogs bya mi dgos/ /sku phyi ba dang khrus bya ste/ /rdo rings them skas srog shing dang / /'khor lo char 11—1185

khab lhargyal mtshan dang / /gdugs la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams/ /mchod rten rnams la dbul bar bya/ /gsung gi rten du gnas gyur nasde/ /glegs shing phul la—/ chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bur dag pa la/ /sdom dang mi sdom mtshan ma gnyis rgyamed kyang / /nyi zla lta bu'i glegs shing 'di phul bas/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med 'byel bar shog /glegs thag phul la/ chos dbyings 'gyur med rdo rje'i rang bzhin la/ /bcings dang ma bcings mtshan ma gnyis ④med kyang —/ /rin chen sna lnga'i glegs thag 'di phul bas/ /'gro ba'i don la rgya lag phyed par shog /na bza' phul la/ rin chen 'byung gnas dam chos bdud rtsi la—/ /rin chen sna tshogs rin chen rgyan spras pa'i/ /rin chen brgyan bupa'i na bza' 'di gsol bas/ /chu la sogs pa'i bar chad med par shog /de ltar mnga' dbul byas nas kyang / /sbyin sreg ⑦las kyis rdzogs par bya/ /lha kun zhal ni me yin pas/ /mkhas pas rab tu gnas par bya/ /rab gnas yang dag rdzogs dus su/ /bstod dang bkra shis brjod bya zhing / /bro dang gar sogs sel snyan sgra/ /ji ltar snyed pa rab tu brjod/ /lha mo rnams kyi dam tshig tshad ma dang —/ /des bshad gsung ni ⑦tshad mar gyur pa ste/ /bden pa des na lha mo rnams kyis 'dir/ /rjes su gzung 5ba'i rgyur ni 'gyur bar shog /tsā ru bza' bar ldan pa dang / /cho gar yang dag ldan pa yis/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams legs 'dus tekhye// /tshogs kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor/ /'byung po rnams la gtor ma sbyin/ /ston mo dang ni yon dbul bas/ /skye bo tshim zhing rgyas par bya//lha yi 'jig rten skyong la sogs/ /gang tshe rtag tu gnas gyur pa/ /mchod dang mchod bya mnyam ldan par/ /de tshe da lta yang dag gzhug /nga yis rab tu gnas 11—1186

pa yis/ /gtsug lag khang la sogs pa yi/ /ji srid gnas pa de srid du/ / bsrung zhing ①spyod kyis legs par skyongs/ /brjod nas bzod par gsol bya ste/ /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang / /'di kun bya ba gang nyes pa/ /'di ni khyed la bzod par gsol/ /khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol④/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs 'tshal te/ /slar yang 'byon ①par mdzad du gsol/ /brjod nas ye shes lha rnams gshegs/ /dam tshig bsdus nas shes rab thabs/ /cho ga gnyis kyis rab bsrungs te/ /slob dpon slob ma legs par gnas/ /dbang bskur rab gnas rdzogs nas su/ /ston mo dang ni yon yang dbul/ /skye bo tshim zhing rgyas par bya/ /dmangs rigs stong phrag gnyis dag kyang / /bram ze gtsang ma gcig dang 'dra/ /bram ze stong phrag gnyis dang ni/ /dge slong gcig la rab tu sbyar—/ /dge slong stong phrag gnyis dang ni/ /rdul med pa ni gcig dang sbyar/ /rdul med stong phrag gnyis dang ni/ /ye shes ldan pa gcig dang sbyar/ /ye shes ldan pa stong phrag gnyis/ /slob dpon gcig dang mnyam par bshad/ /de nas bla ma dag la yon/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa dbul/ /gser ni brgya stong dbul ba dang / /rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /ras ni zung 2'gyur brgya nyid dang / /glang po rta dang yul 'khor dang / /rna rgyan dang ni gdu bu dang / /mgul rgyan sor gdub dam pa dang / /gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ /chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid/ /bran pho bran mo sring mo rnams/ /deng nas brtsams te bran du ni/ /de la bdag ni dbul lags zhes/ /blo ldan kun nas dang ba yis/ /bdag nyid kyang ni dbul bar bya/ /de nas de la 11—1187

mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams mnyes par 'gyur/ /tshon la sogs pa'i dngos po kun/ /nang par tho rangs bsdu bar bya/ /bsdus nas gser kyi bum par ni/ /bcug nas chu bo chen por dor/ /bum pa thams cad bsdus nas ni/ /sngon bzhin du ni dga' ston bya/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga sogs ni/ /sbyar bas sa ni byug par bya/ /slob dpon chen po phru yi pa'i/ /mngon rtogs tshad mar rab gzung ba'i/ /lam de'i dkyil 'khor cho ga ni/ /lung la dad pas rab tu blangs/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ /byas pa'i dge ba gang thob pa/ /'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga lag tu blang ba'i rim pa pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa gsal ba sdogs so// //bsdur mchan/1158 rmyematshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor mdor bsdus pa bzhugs so// zu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhī/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—gyi/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur ba'i—/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo/1159 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzhag 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'dzug ṣ+pe7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mchod/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung / snye〈〈pe 〉〉yis/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsams/116༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉baṃ/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉be+e/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rmi 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngos/cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsams/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ 17〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkang / 8sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉bskyed/ 97〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzang gi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sman/1161 nya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chung / gre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ pasnye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcags/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsams/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—kyang /11byed1188
