zhags pa ste/ /drug pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo'o/ /g.yas kyi phyag ni gsum pa na/ /rtse gsum bgegs ni 'joms pa'o/ /bzhi pa na ni dgra sta ste/ /lnga pa na ni ro langs so/ /drug pa mi zad rnge'u chung sgra/ /phyag ni bcu gnyis dag tu 'dod/ /rus pa yi ni rgyan gyis brgyan/ /pad+ma'i ze 'brur ①gnas pa yi/ /lha mo thod pa'i phyag gis ni/ /khrag gis bkang nas mgul nas 'khyud/ /dus gcig tu ni phan tshun 'thung / /gang phyir zhal ni gcig phyir ro/ /g.yas pas rdo rje bsnams pa kru ni—/ /steng du rab tu brkyang ba nyid/ /de ltar lha mo phyag gnyis sama'-i/ /skra grol 'od kyi tshogs dang ldan/ /thal ba spangs pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /lhag ma yi ni tshogs kyis brgyan/ /mi yi rus pa'i ska rags mdzes/ /spyan gsum nam mkha'i gos can no/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi zhabs dang ldan/ /gzhan ni g.yon ni brkyang ba'i zhabs/ /'jigs byed yang dag mnan pa yi④/ /gnyis ni legs par bsgom par bya/ /shar gye 'dab mar mkha' 'gro ma/ /g.yon par khā ma ru ni grags/ /rgyab tu dum skyes ma yin te/ /g.yas su gzugs can ma ru grags/ /pad 'dab de dang de mdog 'od⑤/ /lha mo bzhi ru grags pa yin/ /mtshams kyi pad+mar thod pa rnams/ /dri chen dri chu khya khrag go/ /pad+ma'i phyi rol 'khor lo gsum/ /snying por yongs su brtags pa yin/ /rtsibs ni brgyad brgyad 'khor lo ni/ /de ni 'phar ma sum brtsegs so6/ /dpa' bo mgon po zhabs nas ni/ /rked pa'i bar du gnas pa ste/ /sku yi 'khor lo 'di brjod pasatso/ /stobs po che la sogs brgyad do/ /rked pa'i bar 6nas brtsams nas ni/ /nu ma gnyis par yang dag gnas/ /gsung gi 'khor lo ji lta bar/ /myu gu can la sogs brgyud do—/ /nu ma nas ni brtsams nas su/ /mgrin pa'i bar du gnas pa ni/ /11—1255

thugs kyi 'khor lo ji lta bar/ /thod pa'i dum bu sogs brgyad do/ /keng ①rus che la sogs zhes pa/ /de rnams ming gis g.yon zhes bya/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang / /thams cad phyag bzhi pa nyid do/ /thog ma yi ni phyag nyid kyisasne/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug bzhin du gnas/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na thod pa ste/ /g.yas na de bzhin rnge'u chung ngo / /dpa' bo zhabs ni g.yas brkyang pa/ /bud med zhabs ni g.yon brkyang ba'o①/ /dpa' bo sdernams dang mkha' 'gro rnams/ /sngags dang phyag rgya sngon bzhin no/ /nag po dmar po de bzhin ser/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dang po'i sgor ni khwa gdong ma/ /g.yon du 'ug pa'i gdong ma ste/ /nub tu khyi gdong mar shes bya/ /lho ru phag gi gdong ma ste/ /lhag ma gshin rje brtan ma dang / /gshin rje pho nya de las gzhan/ /gshin rje mche ba nyid dang ni/ /gzhan yang gshin rje 'joms ma ste/ /lha mo de ltar mtshams rnams su/ /lha mo bzhi ru grags pa yin/ /gtso bo yi ni zhal gyi gdong //sgo skyong bzhi yang de mdog go/ /mtshams bzhi yi ni lha mo rnams/ /mdog gnyis nye ba'i rim pas so/ /sum cu rtsa drug lha mo rnams/ /g.yon gyi phyag na thod pa'o//g.yas na gri gug shes bya ste/ /gcer bu skra ni grol ba'o/ /ma lus yang dag brjod pa ni/ /thams cad 'di bzhin bsgom par bya/ /'khor lo gsum po nang byas nas/ /gzhal yas khang pa bsgom par bya/ /dri dang me tog de bzhin spos/ /bzang po'i lha bshos byug pa dang / /bzang po'i mar me phreng ba dang / /bza' dang ston mo'i 'bye brag dang / /sgron ma dang ni bdud rtsi dang / /sna tshogs pa yi btung ba dang / /gling bu pi wang rnga phran sogs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs glu yi sgra/ /gar ma sgeg mo sogs mchod kyis/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag mchod byed cing / /rta 11—1256

babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /dra ba dra ba byed pas ①brgyan/ /dril bu dar dpyangs ba dan sogs/ /rnga yab me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /dur khrod rnams ni thams cad du/ /sngar gsungs de yi khyad par ro/ /bsrung ba'i don du phyi rol du| /ra ba gsum gyis bskor ba ste/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo ni/ /ra ba zhes ni grags pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi mtha' yi bar/ /mkhas pas de ltar shes par bya—/ /sna tshogs thams cad rdzogs par ni/ /dus gcig tu ni bsgom par bya /bye brag mang po spyod pa yi/ /yang dag brtan zhing bsgom par bya/ /de nas gnod mdzes sngags kyis ni/ /mkhas pas bgegs ni bskrad bya ste/ /tshig rkang dag ni bzhi po de/ /zhal bzhi nas ni brjod par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs lha mo bzhi/ /thugs kyi 'khor sogs 'khor lo can/ /khwa gdong la sogs pho nya brgyad/ /so so'i ming ni brjod par bya/ /de nas srung ba'i cho ga'i phyir/ /'di ltar lus kyi go cha bya/ /oṃ ha zhes bya rdzogs pa yi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying gar gnas/ /na ma nyi las mgo bo la/ /rnam par snang mdzad gnas pa'o/ /swā hā hu las spyi gtsug phyogs/ /pad+ma gar kyi dbang phyug go/ /bo ṣaṭa he las phrag gnyis su/ /he ru ka dpal dag tu grags/ /hūṃ hūṃ ho las mig gnyis su/ /de bzhin rdo rje nyi ma yang / /phaṭa haṃ ni lus kun la dgod/ /de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ /rta mchog mtshon cha'i gzugs can ni/ /lus kun la ni rnam par gnas/ /6baṃ rdo rje phag mo ni/ /lha mo'i lte bar gnas pa'o/ /haṃ oṃ zhes bya'i (gesngags kyis ni/ /gshin rje ma ni snying gar gnas/ /de bzhin hri ༄ mo zhes byas ④ni/ /rmongs byed ma ni kha la gnas/ /hro hri thazhes bya mgo bo la/ /skyong byed ma ni rnam buganas pa'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ zhes bya spyi gtsug dbus/ /rnal 'byor ma ni 11—1257

skrag byed gnas/ /yi ge phaṭa phaṭa ces bya bas/ /ma lus lus kun gtum mo yi//mtshon cha yi ni rang bzhin no/ /de ltar yan lag drug dgod pa/ /gnyi ga la yang ①byas par bsam/ /thal mo phye ba'i thod pa yis/ /mkhas pas mchod yon lan gsum sbyin/ /ye shes 'khor lo gzhug pa'i phyir/ /sngags dang phyag rgya yang dag brtsam/ /ji ltar 'khor lo 'dir bstan pa/ /de yang de bzhin gnas pa nyid / /hūṃ yig snying gar bsam bya ste/ /de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /dpa' bo kun du gnas pa yis②/ /ye shes 'khor lo yang dag bskul/ /rkang pa yang dag brkyang bya ste/ /g.yas pa yi ni mtheb chen gyis/ /g.yon pa yi ni mtheb chen mnan/ /pho nya'i phyag rgya lhag ma ste/ /mje'u chung gi chani sor mo dang / /de bzhin rdo rje thal mo brkyang ⑤/ /mtheb mo sngon du kha sbyar nas/ /mtheb rtse 'og tu blta bar bya/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni phan tshun du/ /lcags sgog lta bur bcing ba nyid/ /dpral ba'i steng du yang dag gzhag⑤ /dzi ni lan gnyis brjod pa yis/ /rkang pa g.yo ba'i tshul kyis ni/ /g.yon dang g.yas su de bzhin no/ /rang gi 'khor lo lta bus dubalta/ /'khor lo 'khor lor gzhug par bya / /de nas lha mo'i gnas bzhin nodze+e/ /lte ba snying ga de bzhin du/ /kha yi phyogs dang dpral ba ru/ /phyag brgya bzhi ni yang dag dgod⑧/ /de la sngags ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ sarba budhe ḍā ki m+bi ye badz+ra bar+ṇa nī ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa bhā rngoye swā hā/ oṃ dhīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī badz+ra te he ru ru kai hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ḍā ki byā dz+wa spul sadza re swā hā/ de nas thams cad bsrung ba'i phyir/ /phyi rol mtshams kyi ra ba ni/ /nam mkha' yi ni khongs nyid du/ /rdo rje gur ni bsgom par bya/ /de ltar yongs su rdzogs byas nas/ /rdo rje pad+ma bsgom par bya/ /byā 11—1258

las byung ba'i rdo rje bsam/ /de bzhin pad+ma byā las so/ /de nas ar+gha byin nas ni—/ /dril bu 'bad pas dkrol bar bya/ /phyi nang ①gsang ba la sogs pa'i/ /sgeg mo la sogs yang dag mchod/ /e ma'o chos e ma'o chos e ma'o chos don yang dag byung sne/ /chos don dag pa bdag med pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sku gsung thugs ni legs dag pa/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa'i gnas/ /'gyur ba med cing snang ba med/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi gtso/ /dus gsum lam gyi lam la gnas/ /nam mkha' chen po dbyings byung ba/ /nam mkha' 1lam la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /nam mkha' sku ni yang dag byung / /nam mkha' gsung ni rab 'jug byed/ /nam mkha' thugs ni chos kyi mchog /spyod pa'i go 'phang phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rdo rje sems dpa' theg pa che/ /nam mkha' spyod pa rnam spyod pa/ /kun du bzang po mchod pa'i mchog /rgyal ba mchog gi mchod pa gsungs/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gnyi mug che/ /rdo rje theg pa ston byed pa/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa'i mchog /rgyal bzhi mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /thar pa'i lam la rab 'jug pa'i—/ /theg gsum lam la 'jug pa'i mchog /sangs rgyas skal bzang dag pa'i bdag /mi mchog mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /byang chub sems ni yangs pa'i spyan—/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor rjobyed cing / /sku gsung thugs ni yongs dag pa/ /rdo rje theg pa phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bstod pa yi ni tshig 'di ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis 5thun mong gsungs/ /yang dag bstod nas sngags 'di yis/ /snyim 6pa'i me tog gtor phyag bya/ /oṃsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta/ pra ṇa me na badz+ra brnya dz+wa dze+eka ro mi/ /sgrub po lha nyid sku ldan na/ /gang la bstod cing phyag kyang 11—1259

byed—/ /phyogs lnga de ltar brjod ce na/ /byis pa rnams kyi log rtogs te/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa la/ /phyag byed pa dang stong ①byed ltar/ /nga la nyams pa ci yang med/ /nga la skyon yang byung ba med/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas rgyud kun du/ /kun mkhyen bcom ldan nyid kyis gsungs/ /mchod rten la sogs bzhengs pa ni/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs kyis gsungs/ /'dir ni 'khor gsum dpa' bo dang / /dpa' mo rnams ni yang dag mchod/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang bstod pa ste/ /'di ltar mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug longs spyod kyang / /bdag la bdag gis bstod pa'am/ /yang na dpa' mo dbang phyug gis/ /yang na 'khor lo gsum gyis bstod/ /sngags pa gang zhig yongs rdzogs pas/ /dga' ba bsrung zhing bsngags pa ④brjod/ /ji srid byang chub sems ma rdzogs/ /de srid bde ba chen po med/ /de phyir rgyud kyi de nyid ni/ /phyi ma las kyang phyi ma brjod/ /de skyes pa yi tshigs bcad brjod/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /de la sogs pa sngon byas nas/ /mya ngan 'das la dgod par bgyi/ —/de la thug par nyid smras pa/ /byang chub sems kyi dze+ematshan nyid do/ /de phyir smon pa'i sems kyis ni/ /phyis ni byang chub 'bras bur 'dod/ /rgyu la 'bras bu btags dupa'i phyir—/ /byang chub sems su brjod pa'o/ /rigs lnga la ni sbyor ba la/ /gzhan du sems can 'di don med/ /zab cing rnyed dka' gsang ba 'di/ /cung zad tsam yang gsal ma bstan/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i ⑤rim pa yis/ /dam pa'i don de shes par 'gyur/ /de phyir de nyid rtogs byed pa'i/ /ye shes lnga ni bsgom par bya—/ /'di ltar me long ye shes dang / /yang ni mnyam nyid ye shes dang / /de 11—1260

ni ①so sor rtog bya zhes/ /bya ba nan tan nyid dang ni/ /lnga pa byang chub sems nyid kyang / /gdams ngag las ni shes par bya/ /me long dri med ye shes la/ /sems can thams cad rnam bsgom bya/ /sngags pa ④snying rje chen po yis/ /sems can dmigs pa dang bcas nga/sa// /sems can mgon med sdug bsngal zhing —/ /nus med gzhan gyi 'dren pa med/ /nyon mongs kyis ni 'khrug gyur pa/ /de phyir mkhas pas shes par bya/ /de nas phyis ni chos rnams kun/ /mkhas pas snying rje bcas pas ni/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi bdag med pa/ /dmigs shing bsgom pa dag tu bya/ /dngos 'di rang bzhin med pa ste/ /bdag gzhan yang dag skye ba med/ /sgyu ma dang ni smig rgyu ①bzhin/ /thams cad stong par bsgom bya ste/ /yang ni so sor rtog pa yin/ /chos la dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i/ /smon lam dri ma med byas nas/ /dag pa'i sems kyis bsgom bya ste/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes ni/ /rtag tu gzhan la phan byed pa/ /nyon mongs can sems rnam dag phyir/ /rnal 'byor pa ni de ltar bsgom/ /sems can ④rnams ni sangs rgyas su/ /chos kyi dbyengs la nges gnas pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams su bsgom bya'o/ /cho ga gcig tu 'dir rtogs bya/ /gzhan yang bla ma'i 'dod pa yod/ /me long ye shes phyag rgya che/ /mnyam nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /de bzhin so sor rtog pa nyid/ /chos kyi phyag rgyar bsgom par bya—/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes ni/ /rdo rje pad+ma sbyor ba'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yis skabs 'dir ni/ /dga' ba'i rgyu phyir sna tshogs kyi/ /sbyor thabs la sogs bstan pas ni/ /lha mo bde bas mchod par bya/ /de nas bsgul bskyod skabs su ni—/ /dga' ba rnam gsum dran bya ste/ /dga' ba dang ni mchog dga' dang / /11—1261

rab tu dga' ba nyid dang yang / /shin tu bde ba'i thabs kyis ni/ /bzhi pa mchog tu bde ba'o/ /sems can 'gro ba'i don byed rgyu/ /dga' ba rang nyid dgyes pa'o/ /lha mo bde bas dgyes pa na/ /mchog dga' zhes ni ①brjod pa yinaske/ /dpa' bo rnams dang mkha' 'gro rnams/ /rab tu dga' bar gnas pa'o—/ /shin tu yang dag bde ba'i thabs/ /rang dang gzhan du dbye ba med/ /shes rab thabs kyi rjes la gang / /byang chub sems kyi 'bras bur 'dod/ /'di khye yang 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid/ /dngos su byang chub rgyu nyid do/ /sems can gang rnams myang 'das ched/ /mya ngan 'das pas de 'das phyir/ /thug pa med par thal ba med/ /mkhas pa kha cig spyod yul lam/ / lang dag snethug med 'dod pa na—/ /rab tu bzang bar bya ba ste/ /dgos ⑦med mkhas pas lce yis blang / /'khor lo gsum la gnas pa kun/ /thams can thun mong du bya'o/ /de nas dril bu yang dag blang / /mkhas pa yis ni bstod pa bya/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug rjes 'gro'am/ /dpal mchog dang po bstod pa bya/ /he ru ka dpal ye shes che/ /thub pa chen po thabs chen po/ /mgon po chen po rnam pa che/ /shing rta chen po theg chen po/ /snang ba chen po shes rab che/ /dpa' bo chen po don chen byed/ /nga rgyal chen po gzhi chen po/ /rgyal po chen po che ba'i che/ /mthu chen bde ba chen po ste/ /rol pa chen po rten chen po/ /mtshon cha chen po drag chen po/ /'jigs pa chen po rgod pa che/ /chags pa chen po zhe sdang che/ /gti mug chen po stobs chen po/ /tshal ngam chen mo drag chen po①/ /stobs po che la bsnyems pa che—/ /sku gsum lam gsum cha byad can/ /'khor lo gsum ni srid gsum mchog/dri ma gsum spangs dus gsum gnas/ /spyan gsum sum cu'i dbang phyug ste/ /11—1262

——m+bid las 'das pa srid dam mchog /srid pa ldan zhing srid pa bral/ /yod med srid pa snang ba po/ /srid pa'i dgra yi gtso bo ste/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnal 'byor spyod/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rnal 'byor brtson/ /rnal 'byor las byung rnal 'byor shes/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor 'joms byed pa/ /dpa' bo rdo rje dbang phyug dgyes/ /rdo rje phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje kha ṭī yan lag brten/ /rdo rje chen po rdo rje phyag /rdo rje gar chen brtan ①pa ste/ /rdo rje'i glu ni sgra chen po—/ /rdo rje pad+ma ting 'dzin gnas/ /rdo rje gdan ni dga' bas dga'/ /gus par byed pa ②bde ba thob/ /skye 'gro rgyal bas skyong byed pa/ /khyod la bdag ni gus pas gnas/ /lus ngag yid kyis thams cad du/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba 'dud/ /mkha' 'gro dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid ye shes phyag 'tshad lo/ /stong pa'i yid la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar bstod pa byas nas ni/ /sngags kyi bsnyen pa yang dag brtsam①/ /mkhas pas rtsa ba'i sngags rnams bsam④//snying po'am nye ba'i snying po 'am/ /sgra las skyes pa la sogs pa'i/ /gang zhig de yi mthar thug pa/ /sprul pa'i sku ru bshad pa dang / /gzhan yang longs spyod rdzogs pa'o/ /ji ltar khā gdong la sogs brgyad/ /g.yon nas yongs bskor gsum la ni/ /sngags pa bsam gtan mnyam gzhag ste/ /sku yi 'khor lor gzhug par bya/ /de bzhin sgu yi 'khor lo g.yas/ /gsung gi 'khor lor gzhug par bya/ /de bzhin gsung gi 'khor lo ltagayon/ /thugs kyi 'khor lor gzhug par bya/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha mo bzhi( / /rang gi g.yon nas gzhug par bya—/ /de dag kyang ni ji ltar gnas/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug zhal bzhir ro/ /sngon gsungs pa yi cho ga yis/ /go cha chen po ngo mtshar che/ /mgo bo nas ni 11—1263

brtsam ①nas su/ /brgyad pa gsum gyi yan lag ldan/ /phreng ba lang dag ②blangs nas su/ /mu nyig che ①la sogs par sprul/ /ji srid skyo ba ma skyes bar/ /sngags kyi yan lag ma nyams bzlas/ /gang yang skyo ba skyes gyur na/ /mtshungs par yang dag bsdu bar bya/ /de nyid longs spyod rdzogs sku'o/ /gzhan yang chos kyi sku zhes pa/ /sku gsum yongs su rdzogs ched du/ /tshe dang rang don 'phel bya'i phyir/ /lte ba'i phyogs kyi snying po la/ /pad+ma ge sar bcas pa bsam/ /de steng zla ba'i dkyil gnas pa/ /brtan por hūṃ gi yi ge bsgom/ /hūṃ las k+ṣiṃli phreng ba dang / /de bzhin kā li 'od zer spro/ /de nyid 'byung ba'i rlung spros nas//de bzhin 'jug pa'i rlung dang bsdu/ /ji srid skyo ba ma skyes bar/ /de ltar re zhig yang yang bya/ /'jug pa'i ④rlung gi hūṃ yig la/ /de nyid bsdus pas yang dag bsdu/ /sku gsum po ni rnam gzhag ⑤pa/ /rgyud 'di la ni legs par grags/ /bsdus nas bstod pa ⑥rab tu bya/ /de nas bsod nams yongs su bsngoske/ /sngags pa yang dag langs nas ni/ /phyi rol phyag rgya legs bcas pas/ /lhag dang chad pa'i skyon spangs phyir/ /sngags dang lha la bzod par gsol/ /sngags rnams rdzogs dang zhes bya'i phyir/ /mkhas pa yis ni sbyin sreg bya/ /'dir yang phyi rol sbyin sreg zhar/ /lus kyi sbyin sreg byed pa lhag /bza' dang ston mo la sogs rnams/ /de bzhin mkhas pas bdag tshim bya/ /zas rnams cung zad sbyangs klu pa ni/ /de yi 'og tu 'bar ba med/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni bsgom bya nyid/ /thod pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de bzhin zla ba re'u mig dgu/ /oṃ yig dkyil 'khor re'u mig la/ /byāḥni mdun gyi re'u mig la/ /ha ha lho dang rgyab tu'o/ /g.yon gyi re'u mig hūṃ yin te/ /dbus la yang ni hūṃ yig go/ /11—1264

mtshalas ni bzhi ru phaṭa yig ste/ /de la sngags kyis mngon par bsngags/ /de la 'di'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃsarba badz+ra kā mi ṇi sarba bhakyu ①sho dha ya gu khya (gebadz+ra ṇi hūṃ ṭ+wā hā/ de ltar sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ /sngags dang lha ni tshim par bya/ /tshim par yun ni mi ring par/ /sgrub pa pos ni dngos grub 'grub/ /de bzhin gzhan du yang gsungs pa/ /sngags ni chad dang lhag pa dag /rtag tu kha skong nabyed 'dod pas/ /de phyir sbyin sreg rjorab bsngags so/ /sku gsung rdo rje can mchog gis—/ /'di ltar thun gsum thun bzhi ru/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bla med pa/ /g.yeng ba med pa'i sems kyis su/ /sgrub po mnyam par bzhag thu/ste bya/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka zhes sogs/ /lhag ma yi ge brgya mnyam pa/ /sngags pas ci bder brjod nas ni/ /sangs rgyas gsol btab bsdu bar bya/ /oṃ shrī te ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ shrī duhe ru ka /te no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi rnyo me bha ba/ /su postso mi gebha ba/ su tostso me bha ba/ a ⑧nu ralto me bha ba/ sarba sirnyim+bi pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsitrī dziyi/ ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hotsho)/ bha ga wān 7sarba ta thā ga ta badzā mā ḍa/nyame myuñca badzī ⑫bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya ⑫satwa āḥ/ lha dang gnyis med rnal 'byor pas—/ /sngags ni rtag tu brjod par bya/ /snang ba skye bar gyur na ni/ /de yi dus na dkyil 'khor brtsam/ /dkyil 'khor nye ba'i dus su ni/ /bde mchog cha bla med zhag bdun du/ /gzhal yas khang bcas mthar thug par/ /mkhas pas 'khor lo gsum bsgom bya/ /sngon du bsnyen pa sngags dang bcas/ /nyis brgya dang ni nyi shu'o/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar rung ba yi/ /'dir ni phyogs kyi sa bshad de/ /lha khang dang ni skyed tshal grong / /grong khyer dang ni tshong dus kyi/ /shar gyi phyogs su brtsam ⑫par bya/ /ji srid byang phyogs la sogs pa'i/ /phyogs 11—1265

bdun dag ni spang bar bya/ /shar phyogs dkyil 'khor bris gyur na/ /bzod med pa yang bzod ldan 'gyur/ /lho phyogs char ni dkyil 'khor bri/ / skye 'gro 'chi dang 'tshe ba ⑤'byung / /dkyil 'khor gang la dmigs te 'chi/ /lung rigs sngags ni gzhan du min/ /nub kyi phyogs su slob dbon 'chi/ /byang gi phyogs su zhugs pa 'chi/ /de bzhin me yi phyogs cha ru/ /char chen po ni 'bab 'gyur te//lho dang nub kyi mtshams la ni/ /mu ge chen po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rlung gi phyogs su 'dri ba ni/ /rlung dang char pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mchod rten gnas su 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig klu yis byen brlabs shing / /shing grib 'khrigs pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de rnams ma gtogs byang shar mchog /de ru gnas la gang zhig sa/ /rigs kyi rim pa rnam ④shes bya/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang —/ /dmangs rigs dang ni rnam pa bzhi'o/ /bram ze dkar por shes bya ste/ /ser po rgyal rigs su ni brjod/ /dmar po rje'u rigs shes par bya/ /nag po dmangs rigs su ni grags/ /dkar po yi ④ni sa phyogs su/ /dbang phyug rdo rje spyi gtsug dang / /dbyug pa dang ni bgrang phreng dang / / rigs pa bsgrub rngo7par bya ba min/ /tshad dang ldan zhing snum pa dang / /mtho dang dma' ba'i skyon spangs pa'i/ /shar dang byang du gzhol gyur cing / /sa phyogs yid 'ong sbyang bar bya—/ /thod pa rtsa ba rus pa skra/ /phub ma rdo ba gseg ma dang / /thal ba sol ba srog chags ni/ /khru do tshad tsam brkos te spang / /srog chags bcas na rlung chen 'byung / /rus par bcas na zug rngu 'byung / /gseg mar bcas pas lkugs par 'gyur/ /phub ma sol ba la ni rims/ /skra dang shing rtsa la sogs pa//gnod pa phra mo 'byung ba srid/ /de phyir shis par brjod pa ldis/ /'bad pas 11—1266

sa yi cha sbyang bya/ /rgyal po khru ni brgya la bri/ /blon po la ni de yi phyed/ /gtso bo la ni de'i phyed bajod/ /tshong dpon la ni bcu gnyis so/ /'dir ni sgrub po rnams kyi khru/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni rim par brjod/ /ji ltar lung las gsungs pa'i don/ /rang gi nus pas zi bar bya/ /de la re zhig thog ma ru/ /mkhas pas mngon 'dod phyogs cha ru/ /rus pa'i phye ma dug dang khrag /ske tshe la sogs bcas pa yis/ /sa gzhir gtor zhing rtsa sngags kyis/ /bgegs ni bskrad par bya ba'o/ /yang ni rang gi slob ma la/ /sa yi bdag po phyed btang hu)nas/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg cho ga ni/ /de la gnyis med ldan pas bya/ /gzhal yas khang ni rdzogs pa yi/ /sngar ni zas sogs 'dod pa rnams/ /slob mas ji ltar nus pa nyid—/ /byin sdenas gzhan gyis yang dag brtsam④/ /sa gzhi legs brdungs mnyam byas te/ /sa yi dkyil ni cung zhig bstod/ /gzhal yas khang pa sgo bzhi pa—/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /lugs ma thang ka'i rnam pa sogs/ /me tog rnga yab phreng ba dang / /dri zhim dri dang bdug spos dang / /mar me mang po yi ni shing / /dzā nyi tsam pa su na ka /nā ga ge sar yu ti ga /ma li ka yi phreng ba dang —/ /pad+mo ut+pal pa ta la/ /kaṇi duka la sogs pa dgram/ /sna tshogs gos kyis brgyan byas nas/ /phyi rol rgyal mtshan ba dan rnams/ /chu shing sdong pos rnam par mdzes/ /dung dang zangs dung sna tshogs dang / /sgra ni sna tshogs pa yis brgyan/ /nye bar byug pa la sogs pas/ /phyis ni de kun brgyan par bya/ /de nas brtsam par bya ba ni/ /sa la gsol gdab la sogs bya/ /de nas rgyud gzhan las grags pa'i/ /bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags sam ni/ /dum skyes ma yi gsang sngags kyis/ /dri zhim chu yis bsang gtor bya/ /gnas skabs 'dir ni 11—1267

sa yi char/ /tsan+dan byis ni nye bar byug /lag g.yas sa la reg nas su/ /yi ge hūṃ sngags de bzhin du/ /lan bdun du ni brjod par bya/ /yi ge brgya pa lan bdun no/ /de nas tshes ni bcu gsum la/ /sgom pa'i yid ni brtan gyur cing //sngon du bsnyen pa sgrub pa yis/ /sngags rig pas ni rjes gnang thob/ /'khor lo gsum ni nam mkha' la/ /mngorge surme bzhin rde nges par bsam/ /de yi gzugs brnyan 'dra ba yis/ /phyis ①ni mkhas pas dkyil 'khor brtsam/ /blo ldan slob ma pyayon tan ldan/ /de bzhin yo byad kun tshogs na/ /sngar sbyangs pa yis dbus su①/ /nye bar gnas nas sa la reg /sa yi lha mo gang yin bskul/ /bkug la sa la gsol ba gdab/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug rnal 'byor ldan/ /lag g.yas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /hūṃ yig gsum ni rnam bkod de/ /'od zer bzang po 'khrugs pa spro/ /sor mo'i rjortse mo sa de la/ /mkhas pas lan gsum bsnun par bya/ /de yi sgra yis bskul ba dang / /de bzhin hūṃ gi 'od kyis so/ /sa yi lha mo mdzes ma ni/ /kha dog ser zhing na bza' dkar/ /gus pa dang ni mi 'jigs phyag /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam brargyan pa/ /zhal gcig ma la phyag gnyise ma/ /mdun du gnas par rnam bsams dunas/ /ar+gha la sogs dbul byas la/ /tshigs bcad gnyis ni 'dir brjod bya/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyisabu / /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par ni/ /sa dang pha rol son pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes bya lan gsum brjod par bya/ /de la mchod pa byas nas su/ /mngon par dga' ba'i sems kyis ni/ /zhal gyi pad+mar rab bzhad ⑦cing / /sku 11—1268

phyed 'thon nas lha mo ni/ /mkhas pas mnyam par gzhag bltas nas/ /de ltar bgyi zhes brngod par bsam/ /de la de nyid thim par bsam/ /rdo rje bcing ba'i lag mthil gyis/ /sa de la ni gzhag ①par bya/ /skabadz+re bha wa hūṃ/ de ltar brjod nas gzhan yang ni/ /oṃ badz+ra dṛ bhā tiṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba/ /sngags rig ②pas ni gsang sngags brjod/ /sa de byen gyis brlabs pa ni/ /sa de rung bar 'gyur ba yin—/ /sa la gsol btab cho ga ni/ /tshigs bcad bzhi bcu tham pa'o phyi nas de bzhin slob dpon ni/ /phyag rgya'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /dkar po gtsug tor dang ni gos/ /tsan+dan la sogs thig le gsum/ /legs par bslabs ①pa'i slob bu ni/ /rdo rje dril bu bzung ba gang / /rdo rje drag po rnal 'byor gyis/ /slob ma dpa' bo'i cha byad can/ /dum skyes ma yi rang bzhin du/ /sgrub pa'i grogs mchog sprul bar bya/ /yang ni mchod pa byas nas su/ /mkhas pas bgegs ni bskrad par bya/ /de la slob dpon rim shes bya/ /rkang pa gnyis su a las ni/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsam par bya/ /oṃdulas mig gnyis dag la ni/ /zla ba nyi ma gnyis blta'o/ /oṃ las g.yas su nyi dmigs te/ /rdo rje 'od zer de bzhin spros/ /mig 'bras hūṃ las bskal pa'i me/ /rdo rje gsor bar byed brtson pas/ /rkang pa'i 'gros kyi 'od zer tshogs/ /rdo rje dus kyi me 'od 'dra/ /gdug pa 'bros par blta bar bya—/ /g.yon pa'i zla ba dri med la/ /oṃ las byung ba'i 'od zer ni/ /bdud rtsi yi ni tshogs dang ldan/ /rang gi 'khor tshogs 'thung byed cing / /tshim par byed cing mchod byed ⑤pa'o/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas yang dag brtsam/ /rdo rje bsnyems shing rol bcas pas/ /gtso bo slob ma bcas pa yis/ /brgyan cing rdo 11—1269

rje 'gros kyis bskor/ /gser gyi sa gzhi mthar thug par/ /sa ni rdo rje'i rang bzhin bya/ /g.yon pa dril bu dkrol bya zhing / /g.yas pa yis ni rdo rje gsor/ /hūṃ zhes brjod pa'i zhal dang ni/ /kun du rdo rje lta stangs kyis/ /sa der gnas pa'i gdug pa can/ /mkhas pa yis ni bskrad par bya/ /rgya che ba yi tshigs bcad ni/ /sngags dang 'dra bar sangs rgyas gsungs/ /khyod ni dengs shig bgegs kyi tshogs/ /gang zhig lha'am lha min nam/ /gnod sbyin dang ni srin po dang ske/ /yi dwags dang ni sha za dang / /brjed ①byed dang ni 'byung po dang / /mkha' 'gro dang ni grib gnon po/ /rgan po dang ni rgan mo dang / /rjes su spyod pa'i 'khor rnams ni/ /nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci/ /skyes bu sngags ni grub pa rnams/ /de la sa yi phyogs 'dir ni/ /slob ma che ge mo zhes bya/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub don dang / /sems can bla na med pa yi/ /ye shes 'thob pa'i rgyu yi phyir/ /te ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro yi/ /dra ba'i sdom pa 'khor lo gsum/ /zhes bya ba yi dkyil 'khor 'di/ /de nyid bdag gis bri bar bya/ /rdo rje drag po'i tsobaka' thos nas/ /'di yis myur du 'gro bar byos/ /gal te bka' las 'das pa na/ /te ru ka dpal rdor 'bar bdag /khros pas hūṃ gi zhal dang ni/ /ye shes chen po 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas pa'o—/ /de nyid sngags pas brjod nas su/ /g.yas phyogs nas ni lan gsum bskor/ /de nas gom pa lnga yis ni/ /gnas lnga ru ni 'gro bar bya/ /de skad du yang gsungs pa ni/ /bskal pa'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od/ /rkang pa gnyis las 'od byung ba/ /gdug can 'bros par bsam pa ste/ /bsreg bzhin du ni bsam par bya/ /bskrad pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rim pa'i tshul/ /de 11—1270

phyir gsar du brtsam ①bya ba/ /gal te cho ga rgyas 'dod na/ /bskrad pa yi ni cho ga ste/ /tshigs su bcad pa nyer gcig go/ /de ltar bskrad pa byas nas ni/ /bgegs nyid la ni phur bus gdab/ /'bar ba'i me dang 'bar ④ba'i 'od/ /khro bo hūṃ gi nga rgyal gyis/ /hūṃ gi sgra yis dpa' bo rnams/ /mang po bskal pa'i me lta bus/ /mi bzad pa yi drag po'i lus/ /ji bzhin nam mkha' gang bar spro/ /sum+bha ni yi sngags brjod cing / /dpa' bo te ru ka phyung nas/ /byin kyis brlab ①pa la sogs bya④/ /de nyid mdun du gnas nas ⑤su/ /bgegs kun gyis ni bskor ba yig/ /bgegs kyi bdag po nyid bkug nas/ /nam mkha'i snying po gar dbang phyug /rnam par snang mdzad ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin can/ //seng sdeng gi ni phur pa bzhi/ /de nyid rtse mo yi ni dbyibs/ /rdo rje'i rnam pa shin tu rno/ /sor brgyad pa yi tshad tsam ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni rab tu byas④/ /me yi phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /thams cad du ni phyi rol mtshalas/ /skabadz+ra tī li tī la ya hūṃ/ /zhes bya ba ni brgya rtsa bzlas⑧/ /spyi bo nas brtsams rkang pa'i bar/ /bgegs kyi bdag po phur pas gdab/ /yang na ye shes kyis nus na/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis ⑨phur pas gdab/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag sems tsam mo/ /zhes bya'i tshig gi ⑫'thad pas so/ /phur pas gdab sngags 'di yin te/ /oṃ lha gha ⑪ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba dubye phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā ⑫pa ya ti kā ya wāka tsit+ta ⑫tī la hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bu de yi steng du ni/ /a yig las ni nyi dkyil 'khor//me 'dra 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs④/ /de yi 'od kyis bgegs 'joms pa /sde dang bcas pa ⑫thal bar 'gyur/ /de nyid las ni skyes pa la/ /yang 'byung 11—1271

dogs pa'i bgegs gzhom phyir/ /mkhas pa yis ni stong nyid bsgom/ /de nas ha ya spyi ba gdon/ /gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol gzhag① /mtshon cha yi ni ra ba'i gzugs/ /yongs su gyur pa rnam bsgom bya/ /de nas s+thāḥyig las skyes pa/ /de bzhin nam mkha' khyab pa'o/ /shes rab chos 'byung phyag rgya bsams④/ /de yi steng gi rim pa la/ /a yig las skyes ma lus pa'i/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du①/ /bsams nas rdo rje lta bub yis/ /kun du mnyam par blta bar bya//blo ldan gyis ni hūṃ yig gi⑤/ /sngags ni lan brgyar brjod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ④ni sa nyid dang / /sa gzhi yongs su dag pa'o/ /rtog pa la gnas sngags pa yis/ /sa ni gang zhig spyod byed pa/ /zla gsang byang chub sems spangs pas—/ /sa de dag par mi 'gyur ro/ /sngags pas rdo rje sems dpa' bzlas/ /rdo rje'i ⑦lta bas yang bltas te/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa yi char/ /rkyen dang ldan yang dge ba yin/ /sa sbyang ba yi cho ga ni/ /tshigs su bcad pa bcu dgu pa'o/ /'bad pas de ltar legs sbyangs pas⑧/ /mnyam par gzhag ⑨pas de nyid la/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i cho ga 'dis/ /yongs su gzung ⑩bar bya ba ste/ /rang rang gnas su nyer gnas pa/ /gzhal yas khang pa bsgom par bya/ /sngar brjod pa yi rim pa yis/ /rnal 'byor shes rab phyag rgya gzung ⑪/ /'khor lo gsum ni ma lus pa/ /dbyer med pa yi rnal 'byor brtson/ /slob ma rnal 'byor dbyer med pa'i—/ /de nas rang gi nga rgyal bya/ /lha rnams kyang ni tha mi dad/ /yang ni tha dad brtags pa yi/ /slob mas dpa' bor gsol ba gdab/ /dpa' bos gsol ba btab nas su/ /rang gi bdag nyid legs bsgom bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad bdag bstod nas/ /bdag 11—1272

ni lha yis byin brlabs pa'i/ /mngon sum nga rgyal ldan par bya/ /①kun du nga rgyal ldan gyur kyang / /khengs pa yang dag mi bskyed par/ /mnyam par gzhag ②pa'i sems kyis ni/ /bdag nyid dga' bar byas ①pa ste/ /deng 'di bdag skyes 'bras bu yod/ /bdag 'tsho 'bras bu bcas pa yidhi/ /mi mnyam lha dang mnyam pa ru/ /gyur pa dag ni the tshom min/ /bdag gi ⑤nyi ma dang ni mchog /deng bdag mchod sbyin bla na med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs brtse ba'i /bka' lung dag ni bdag gis bya/ /bdag nyid skyes pa nyid kyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor pa yi 'khor lo gsum/ /sgeg mo la sogs yang dag mchod/ /'bad pas dril bu dkrol nas su/ /'bad pas mchod dang bstod pa dang / /de bzhin phyag la sogs pa bya/ //nye ba'i snying po gsang sngags bzlas/ /sngon gyi nam mkhar bteg rjopa yi/ /ye shes 'khor lo brtan byas te/ /yang ni brtag ⑦par byas la bsgom/ /bar snang la ni rnam gzhag pa/ /de dang mnyam par sbyor bar rbobya/ /sngags kyi cho ga 'dir yang ni/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i rim pa yang thams cad bsdus pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /rdo rje drag dpal rnal 'byor ldan/ /zhags pas rdo rje byen gyis brlab⑨/ /de phyir rol bcas langs nas ni/ /sngar bzhin ma dang ṭa dag las/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba'o/ /ji ltar lta bas der bltas te/ /kun du yang ni blta bar bya/ /gser gyi sa gzhi mthar thug par/ /sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin bya/ /rol bcas gom pas bgom ⑫byas la/ /rdo rje bsnyems pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /sngags pas hūṃ yig brjod bya zhing / /yang ni sa gzhi yongs bskor nas/ /de nyid bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /de nas phyag rgya lhan cig langs/ /thams cad du ni blta ba dang / /bsnyems pas sa gzhi yongs su 11—1273

bskor/ /rdo rje sems dpa' brjod par bya/ /yang ni de dbus bsdad nas su/ /a ni g.yas kyi mig la bsam/ /de las byung ba'i nyi ma la/ /hūṃ yig las ni byung ba yis/ /rdo rje 'bar tshogs 'bar 'khrugs ①pa'i/ /phyogs kun yongs su dag par bya/ /bgegs rnams ma lus bcom par ni/ /de rnams rnal 'byor 'bad pas bsgom/ /'dod pas mtha' yas dpag med kyi/ /'jigs pa'i 'od kyis kun du ni/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs shaṃng drag /zhe sdang ngar ba drag pa ②ni—/ /blo dang ldan pas blta bar bya/ /du mar brtag ①pa de nas ni/ /bgegs tshogs rgyal byed mthug po yi/ /'dod chags ra ba dmigs par bya/ /rlung gis rab tu bskul ba yi/ /ma lus mun pa'i sgrib g.yogs rjosprul/ /gdug can rmongs byed bsgom pa ni/ /de ltar gti mug ra ba'o/ /hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje ni//zhe sdang rdo rje'i rang bzhin brjod/ /a las skyes pa'i pad+ma ni/ /pad+ma 'dod chags rang bzhin brjod/ /oṃ las skyes pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /'khor lo gti mug rang bzhin brjodarngu/ /ra ba gsum ni rnam bkod nas/ /de ltar shes nas bsgom par bya/ /mig g.yas pa ni nyi ma ste/ /de bzhin g.yon du zla ba'o/ /de yi sna rtser oṃ yig ste/ /'di gang rjode yi rim pa'o/ /nang gi thams cad byas nas ni/ /yang ni ra ba gsum bya'o/ /mtshon cha'i dra ba'i rang bzhin bya/ /steng du khro bo rta rang bzhin/ /bskal pa'i me ni 'bar ba yis/ /glog gi mdog ni lce 'gril zhing / /drag po chen po bsam bya ste/ /des ni lhag pa'i bgegs gzhom bya/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pa ni/ /bskal pa'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i phreng ba can/ /nyi ma stong phrag bye ba'i dbus0 / /ma lus bgegs ni 'joms byed pa'o/ /sa gzhi yongs gzung ④cho ga ni/ /11—1274

tshigs bcad nyi shu rtsa dgu'o/ /sa gzhi rjes su bcu bzhi la/ /rang bzhin dri ma med pa yi/ /ye shes rgya mtsho sa yi char/ /slob ma la sogs lhag gnas bya/ /de yang re zhig thog mar ni/ /dka' ba med par don la mkhas/ /gru bzhi byas pa dag pa la/ /dkyil 'khor las ni nyis 'gyur lhag /de nas skud pa dkar po byas—/ /rang dang sgrub pa'i grogs dag gis/ /tsan+dan dmar po dang bsres pa'i//sā lu btags pas spang par bya/ /dkyil 'khor tshad ni gyur pa'o/ /nyis gyur gyis ①ni thig gdab pa/ /dag pa'i tshangs thig gnyis gdab bya/ /de yi phyed 'gyur rtsa thig go/ /sgo ni dkyil 'khor brgyad cha ste/ /sgo khyud dang ①ni de bzhin no—/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi gnas dang ni/ /mtshalas bzhi yang na de bzhin no/ /de yi phyed ni 'gram dang ni/ /logs dang 'dod yon 'od rnams so/ /de yi phyed ni tshon sna'i sa/ /dra ba dra phyed rnams de bzhin/ /rta babs ①sgo yi sum 'gyur te/ /chu srin gdong byung rta babs dang / /'dod yon bum pa dhilas byung ba'i—/ /rta babs kyi ni ka ba'o/ /yang na gru bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i thig ni gnyis bya ste/ /tshangs thig gnyis nas phyogs thig go/ /tshon sna'i sa ru zhes bya ste/ /tshon sna'i snam bu de bzhin no/ /tshon sna'i sa tshad gsum dor la/ /'od ni dhi'akhor lo gsum bya'o/ /grong gi phyi rol 'od tshad dhido/ /nang gi 'od stidu zhugs nas brtsams⑧/ /'khor lo gsum po dag la ni/ /thig bzhi dag ni bskor nas su/ /sgo yi tshad kyis bya ba'o/ /lhag ma pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs las lhag pa ④bya/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo'i phyir⑫/ /thugs kyi 'khor rtsibs mu khyud rnams/ /rdo rje la sogs drag po ni/ /re khā gnyis par bzhi bri'o/ /tshon rtsi snam bu'i phyir ⑩rol du/ /grwa dang sgo ⑫mtshams rnams khya ste⑫//11—1275

rdo rje nyi ma rin tsachen zla/ /yongs su bskor nas 'od 'bar ba'o/ /sgo yi phyed ni dra ba dang / /nyi ma'i snam bu sogs pa'o/ /mchod snam zig la brten nas su//phyi rol thig ni kun du sbyar/ /rta babs chu srin las mtshan pa'i/ /dril bu rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /me tog phreng ba dra rnga yab/ /mda' yab phreng ba la brten nas—/ /rlung gis bskyod bzhin pa yi ni/ /de bzhin ma lus brtag par bya/ /dur khrod kyi ni rnam pa'o/ /'od zer 'bar bas 'khrigs pa ni/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo'o/ /'khor lo gsum ni gang yin dgod/ /tshon rtsi sa gzhi kun du ni/ /rnam pa lnga ru go bar bya/ /thig skud phra ba 'di yis ni/ /dbus su thig bzhi gdab par bya/ /de bzhin ma lus brtag par bya/ /gang dang gang gi ②mtshan ma ni—/ /gnas skabs gang du gsungs pa ste/ /ye shes thig ni btab nas su/ /tshon rtsi dag gis zi bar bya/ /dgongs 'dus ye shes dkyil 'khor ni/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor brtag par bya/ /sgeg mo la sogs ji lta bar/ /nye bar mchod pas yang dag mchod/ /gling bu pi wang rnga bran ①sogs/ /de ltar sgra ni sngon 'gro ba/ /phyi nas yang dag bstod byas te/ /de nas mkhas pas phyag bya'o/ /de la yang dag 'jam stan la/ /gnas de sngar bzhin mdun du ni/ /rdo rje drag po'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dgug par bya/ /ye shes gsang ba'i 'khor lo gang / /'di ni sngar med par ni med/ /deng ④nas bzung ste thams cad dang / /gsang nas gsang ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bkug nas su/ /sa gzhi de la gcig gyur par/ /sngags pas yang dag gcig 'gyur brtag /gnyis kyis yi ges go cha bya/ /de rjes kyang ni bsrung ba ni/ /lha yi nga rgyal bsrung bar bya/ /yi ge gsum gyes bsngags ⑤pa yis/ /bdud rtsi lnga 11—1276

dang tsan+dan bcas/ /mnyam par gzhag ①pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sa gzhi kun du byug par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni lha gnas su/ /sngags ni de dang der gsal bya—/ /wībadz+ra maṇ+ḍa lo hūṃ dzatshodagug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra shī la tsaya guṣ+ṭa ④lam̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bu'i sngags so/ /skabadz+ra tsakra a dhi tiṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha lasidhi ya hūṃ/ byen gyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /wīs+thā༅ ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba la sogs pa lhag ma'o—/ /gtso bo rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /de yang sngar bzhin dkyil 'khor sprul—/ /de nas de la ye shes kyi/ /'khor lo gang du gzhug byas nas/ /yang dang byen brlabs mchod nas su/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rnam rgyal bum zhes pa/ /mdun gyi nam mkha' la sogs sprul/ /rtsa ba nag med mchu 'phyang zhing / /lto ba che la mgrin pa ring / /rang bzhin med par dmigs nas dze+esu/ /mkhas pas paṃ las skyes pa ru/ /byārtsilas pad+ma dmigs nas su/ /de yi lte bar ge sar bcas/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug lha mor ldan/ /de la sngon bzhin bsgom bya ste/ /yongs su rdzogs pa bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu ⑨nas/ /byang chub sems kyi rgyun du ni/ /de nyid du yang bsam par bya/ /de nas dri dang ldan pa'i chu/ /phyis ni der ni cung zad blugs//sman la sogs par ⑩ldan par ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni rab byas te/ /ha sa de ba thra ha ti/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri daṇ+ḍita pal dang / /rnam par rgyal ba dkar po ni/ /sman lnga ru ni dge bar grags/ /mi dge ba ⑪ni 'joms par byed/ /'bru ni gro dang 'bras so ba/ /til dang ma sha nas su brjod/ /rin chen gser dang dngul dang ni / /byu ru mu men mu nyig go/ /dri chen dri chu byang chub sems/ /de bzhin sha chen dang ni khrag /de rnams bdud rtsi lnga zhes bya/ /bla med byang chub rgyu yin no//11—1277

mya ngan med dang byang chub shing / /a mra n+ya gro 4 ma bar①/ /lnga po yal ga lo mar grags/ /bum pa'i kha ni mdzes par bya/ /bum pa dkar po byas nas —/ /pad+ma nyis brtsegs ①bri bar bya/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma gcig la ni/ /rdo rje phyag rgya yang dag bri/ /gos bzangs mgrin pa brgyan nas su/ /yal gas kha ni brgyan par bya/ /dpa' bo kun la so sor ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas byas te/ /brgyad kyis lhag pa'i stong phrag gcig /dpa' bo dbang phyug snying po bzlas/ /oṃ badzo da ka hūṃ zhes pa/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni bzla bar bya/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor phyogs dang ni/ /bum pa la yang de bzhin no/ /thun gsum du ni mngon bsngags te—/ /bdug pa la sogs yang dag mchod/ /dkyil 'khor la ni bskor bar bya/ /dbus kyi bcom ldan mdun du ni/ /bum pa de bzhin gzhag ④par bya/ /gzhan ni las kyi ④thams cad pa/ /ro langs mtshan ma gri gug bya/ /dum skyes ma yis mngon par bsngags⑤/ /shar gyi sgo yi byang du gzhagadu /yang dag mchod la 'di ltar brjod/ /ji srid dkyil 'khor bya ba ni/ /de srid bya ba ma rdzogs par/ /bcom ldan 'das ma khyod kyis ni/ /bdag gi gdug pa bskrad par mdzod/ /de yi rnal 'byor rdzogs nas su/ /yang ni phyogs kyi gtor ma sbyin/ /shar gyi phyogs la brten nas su/ /gtso bo rang gi gtor ma sbyin/ /byang du mngon par phyogs nas su/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po mngon par ldan/ /me tog rnam par bkram ṣ+ṭa par bya/ /'bad pas dkyil 'khor rang gi sngags/ /de nas phyir ni lhag gnas bya—/ /sbyin sreg mchod pa la sogs brtsam/ /slob ma dad cing gus ldan pa/ /mkhas pas cho ga 'di bya'o/ /de la re zhig thog mar ni/ /slob ma me tog thal sbyar bas/ /yang dag spyi bos phyag byas nas/ /bla ma la ni 'di skad brjod/ /11—1278

spyod ni ston pa dga' chen po/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dam tshig de ni bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog du/ /mgon po bdag kyang gzhug tu gsol/ /de smos ①slob ma'i lus sogs ni/ /gzugs ni bral bar bya ba ste/ /de nas rang bzhin med dmigs nas/ /bdag po'i spyor bar 1de rdzogs bya/ /lus la sogs pa byin brlab cing / /sngar bzhin du ni cho ga bya/ /slob ma'i gtso bo mdun byas nas/ /slob dpon rang gis 'di skad brjod/ /bu tshur shog shig theg chen gyi/ /cho ga sngags kyi spyod pa'i tshul/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das kyang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po gang —/ /'gro la phan phyir zhugs pa de/ /de dag kun gyi ①gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i dumatshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /stobs chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis 5blo gros 'di gyis shig /rtog pa de ni spangs nas su/ /bzang po brtson pa'i yid kyis nyon/ /ma lus legs pa'i blo gros kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs dang / /bde gshegs rnams kyis byin gyis brlab pya/ /de ltar 'bad pas spro '-i)bskyed nas/ /gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /de la cho ga 'di yis ni/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs bya/ /slob dpon dag ni dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya 11—1279

ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni rab bzung nas/ /ji srid byang chub snying gnas par/ /bla na med pas yang dag pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sku gsung ①rnam gnas pa'i/ /skyabs su bdag ni mchi bar bgyi/ /bla na med pa'i chos chen po/ /nges 'byung bar du skyabs su mchi/ /bla med phyir mi ldog pa yi/ /byang sems dge 'dun skyabs su mchi/ /de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum brjod/ /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni rab bzung nas/ /bdag gis skye ba thog med nas1/ /'khor ba nas ni 'khor bgyis gebagyid/ /bgyid du stsal dang rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis༄/ /spyan sngar de dag ma lus bshags/ /de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum brjod/ /slob dpon dag ni dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sems med ye shes sems bskyed pa/ /de bzhin dag ( 5kyang sems bskyed do/ /de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum brjod/ /phyogs bcu de bzhin gshegs kun dang / /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las/ /rigs su zhugs pa thams cad dang / /snying po phyag rgya sngags rnams dang / /rig ④pa'i lha rnams dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /phyogs bcu de bzhin gshegs kun dang / /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las/ /rigs bzhugs kun byi spyan sngar dang / /snying po phyag rgya sngags rnams dang / /rig dze+epa'i lha rnams spyan snga ru—/ /bla med sems kyis sdig pa bshags/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan mkhyen/ /chos dbyings yang dag nges bgyis pa'i/ /bla na med pa'i bsod nams kun/ /rjes su yi ni rang bar bgyi/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams/ /rgyas par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /bla med theg chen 'khor lo ni/ /11—1280

bskor phyir gsol ba gdab par bya/ /gang yang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /ji sred sems can khams gnas pa/ /de srid mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /gsol ba dag ni gdab par bya/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las 'di yis/ /'jig rten ma lus sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos bstan pa/ /sems can sdug bsngal jol bar ①shog /ces ni bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /de nas snying po sngags bzlas pa'i/ /dri yi chu yis gang byas pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag gis ni/ /sngags shes pas ni snying gar gtugs/ /de yi rjes su byin brlabs nas/ /sngar bzhin du ni cho ga bya/ /ji ltar mchod pa rnam lnga yis/ /de la so sor mchod par bya—/ /khaṇ+ḍa ro has mngon bsngags pa'i/ /dri zhim chu yis lus la byug /me tog dkar po spyi bor sbyin/ /'o ma dang bcas u dum sogs/ /mngar ba dag gi so shing ni/ /sor du bcu gnyis tshad byas nas/ /de rnams lag par byin nas su/ /shar du phyogs pas dor ba'o/ /khaṇ+ḍa ro has mngon bsngags gupa'i/ /chu yi /1kha bshal sbyin par bya/ /so shing gang du lhung ba yis/ /dngos grub rgyur ni shes par bya/ /sngar bstan stan la bzhag nas su/ /de rnams kyi 4ni lag mthil du/ /yi ge gsum gyis mngon bsngags pa'i/ /yang dag mchod rten ku sha sbyin/ /de nas yang ni sngags 'di yis/ /bsngags pa yis ni dri zhim pa'i/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chu sbyin bya/ /'thungs pas sdig pa nyams phyir ro/ /de la 'di yi 5/gsang sngags ni/ /oṃ dītsho)bi shurnya dharmā sarba pā pa ni tsā saṃ 3sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa a pa na ya hūṃ/ /de rnams bsrung ba'i ched du ni/ /yi ge gsum kyis bsngags pa yi 8 / /mdud pa gsum byas skud pa ni/ /dpung pa g.yon par bcing bar bya/ /dpa' bo drug gi go cha bya/ /gnas gsum yang ni de bzhin no/ /de rnams srung 9ba 11—1281

byas nas ni/ /chos 'di 'di ltar bshad par bya/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i—/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong bas na①//de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /skal ldan rang byung chen po ni/ /'jig rten kun byu 'dren pa bo/ /gang zhig yod dang med las 'das/ /nam mkha' 'dra bar dri ma med/ /rnyog med rtog ge'i yul min pa/ /zab mo rtogs ②par dka' ba'o/ /zab mo brtag par dka' ba ni/ /spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ /spros pa kun gyis ma spros pa/ /las dang bya ba dang bral te/ /bden pa gnyis la mi brten pa/ /ye shes gtso mchog shes par bya/ /gang 'dod pa yi tshul du gnas/ /'khor lo gsum dag chen po ni/ /drag po'i steng du yang dag gnas/ /te ru ka dpal bka' rngudrin gyis/ /srung ④bar byas nas de nas smra/ /ji ltar rmi lam rmis pa ni/ /bdag gi mdun du smra bar gyis/ /zhes bya brjod nas slob ma de—/ /nyal mal dag tu gtang bar bya/ /yon tan ldan pa'i slob ma de/ /dkyil 'khor sa gzhir gzhug bya ste/ /bsgom dang bzlas pa la sogs bya/ /slob ma'i lce la a yig las/ /gsal bar zla ba dpag med bsam/ /rang gi lha mo legs 'khyud phyag /dmigs la khyade snying zla ba la/ /a yi yi ge mjos pa dgod/ /sgrub pa pos ni sngags 'di yis/ /lce la yang dag byen gyis brlab/ /oṃ pad+ma sa ra ta thi ta khwa7 sat+ya/ mā brta ya dīḥ/ zhes ④bya'o/ /ga pur a ga ru bsreg 8pa'i/ /de nas spos ni gzung ⑨bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor pa gang ⑩sangs rgyas dang / /nye ba nyid du snyan gsan dbab/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /sras bcas 'jig rten la grags dang / /rdo rje rin chen rigs dang ni/ /de bzhin pad+ma las kyi rigs/ /snying po phyag rgya rig sngags 11—1282

dang / /gang zhig lha kun kyi ni tshogs/ /chos kyi dbyings la gnas pa ni/ /de ring bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya bas ni/ /ji ltar nus pa'i nyer spyod pas/ /dpal ldan bde mchog dkyil 'khor mchog /kun du bdag gis bri bar bya/ /slob ma rnams la rjes brtse dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs la/ /nye ba nyid du mdzad par rigs/ /zhes bya brjod nas yang dag mchod/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus pa kun ni//'di yis de bzhin dkyil 'khor te①/ /nam mkha' la ni sngar bzhin gzhagatsa /de yi dkyil 'khor pa kun ni/ /dag pa'i shel dang 'dra ba ru/ /rang gi 'od kyis ①'khor lo 'bar/ /dkar po rgyan gyis brgyan pa ni/ /gzhal yas khang bar yang dag dmigs/ /zla ba'i 'od dang mnyam pa'o/ /de bzhin he ru ka dpal zhi/ /legs par bltas la yang dag dgug /rang snying zla ba'i hūṃ 'od ④kyis—/ /de nas rang gi lus la gzhug /kha sbyor sbyar bas yang dag gnas/ /bsrub dang srub ⑤pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rang gi lus la thim gyur nas/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa la nyal/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pa ni/ /slob ma '-igatso bo dang bcas pa/ /bye brag shes pa'i yon tan can/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bltas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni nye bar nyal/ /zhes pa'o/ /lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga ni/ /tshigs su bcad pa bco lnga'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon dgage /lha yis rab tu bskul nas su/ /gnyid las sad (kyepar gyur nas ni/ /rdo rje drag dpal rnal 'byor ldan/ /nam mkha' la gnas dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de bzhin glu dang sgra la sogs/ /bdug spos dag dang mchod byas nas/ /ye shes thig ni gdab par bya/ /gzhon nu mas byas skud pa'am/ /de bzhin dpa' bo rin gyis 11—1283

nyonaḥ/ /skra nyag med cing legs dag pa/ /so so lnga lnga ru ni bya/ /dkar po la sogs kha dog lngar/ /gtso bor byas la yang dag par/ /thig skud lnga ni bsgril bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor las lhag nyis 'gyur bya/ /sngags pa yi ni mthe'u chung tshad—/ /sgo yi nyi shu cha lta bu/ /sbom phra gnyis su dag brjod nas/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni ye shes thig /ji ltar mdud par mi 'gyur phyir/ /shing la sogs par dkri bya ste/ /gser la sogs pa'i snod bzhag nas/ /dri dang me tog yang dag brgyan/ /yi ge gsum dang spel ba yi/ /swā hā'i yi ge ji ltar rim/ / tha ge 2lnga yi tshul gyis ni/ /sangs rgya kun sku rang bzhin no/ /dpal ldan te ru ka dpal dpa'/ /rang gi lha mo yang dag ldan/ /hūṃ gi yi ge brjod tsam gyis/ /thig sgud blo ldan byin gyes brlabs / /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gyes kru/ /thams cad du ni rnam pa gsum/ /thun mong du yang rnam par blta/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin bya/ /de nas dza las mig la ni/ /nyi ma zla ba ⑤mdog ser dgod//oṃ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭa /6saṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ /zhes brjod lcags kyu'i rnam pa yi④/ /sprul ba'i 'od zer tshogs dang ni/ /sngags de yang ni lan cig brjod/ /he ru ka dpal sogs kun mtha'/ /'bar ba'i lta bas blta bar bya/ /de la mchod pa byas nas ni / /brtul zhugs can gyis de ltar bskul/ /dkyil 'khor thig ni bskul ba yi —/ /rdo rje thig tu gdab 'gyur ro/ /'bar ba'i lta ba'i lcags kyus bkug /he ru ka dpal byen brlabs pa'i/ /rang gi snying gar lag pas thig /sgrub pos thig ni rdzogs gdab bya/ /oṃ a byo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥ/ oṃ pa ra spa ra aru pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmāḥ/ oṃ a t+yan+ta a nu rngupra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmāḥ/ /zhes pa brjod de de don ni/ /mngon du byas nas dngos po bzhin/ /g.yog dang bcas pas 11—1284

bsngags te bzlas/ /yid la mi byed nam mkha' la/ /sngags 'di yis ni bsgril bar bya/ /oṃ spyoḥha ha hūṃ ①hūṃ phaṭa/ de skad bzlas te bsgril byas la/ /de la gser sogs snod du ni/ /yang dag me tog spos la sogs/ /sngar bzhin du ni yang dag mchod/ /mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las ni/ /nyi ma zla ba sngar bzhin blta//rdo rje khya tshurashaṃ oṃ ⑤nyid/ /brtan par byas nas sngags bzlas bya/ /sngags ni/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru ①tra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas pa bya/ /yig gsum stong phrag bar du bzla/ /yang ni dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa/ /de la kun du byug par bya/ /me tog legs bkram mchod yon ni/ /rdo rje can kun nam mkha' gnas/ /sgeg mo sogs kyis legs mchod nas/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /de la yi ge bdun bsngags nga ni/ /rang gi yid kyis brjod bya zhing / /te ru ka dpal bdag gyur na(snye/ /dum skyes ma yi rang bzhin gyi6/ /byen gyis brlab pa mngon byas nas/ /sgrub pa'i grogs mchog spro zhing bskul/ /rdo rje khu tshur dag gis su/ /lag pa g.yon pas bzung nas ni/ /grogs po'i lag par byen nas su/ /phyogs kun dag ni mnyam par bya/ /oṃ dza dza dza zhes brjod nas//grogs po la ni gtad par bya/ /des kyang lag g.yon khu tshur gyis/ /yang dag bzung nas de skad brjod/ /thig gnyis rgyab nas bskyed nas su/ /rim pa ji bzhin drang zhing bzung / /dang po nub dang lho yi ni/ /sgo ru sgrub pa po gnas bya—/ /shar dang byang du kha bltas nas/ /lte ba'i phyogs su gzung 7bya zhing / /gang zhing sngags pas las byed pa/ /de bzhin sgrub po grogs kyis bya/ /yang ni g.yon nas bskor nas su/ /sngags de nyid ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ shar du phyogs pas de bzhin du/ /sa yi gzhi ni de nyid la//11—1285

tshangs thig gnyis ni yang dag par/ /mnyam par gzhag ①pas brkyang bar bya/ /sngags pas snethig ni 'debs pa na/ /nam mkha' ma lus khyab pa yi/ /de yi sgra yis dubade gshegs rnams/ /de nyid lan cig bskul ba yis/ /khyed ni sems can don du dbab④/ /'di nyid kyang ni bsam par bya/ /de nas slob dpon sgrub grogs dag /bskor zhing 'gro ba'i bya ba ni/ /g.yon pa'i spyod pa gtso ba'i phyir—/ /kun du g.yon pa'i cho gas bya/ /de lta na yang lhos pa yis (1/ /rtogs par dka' bas g.yas skor du/ /rlung dang dbang ldan mtshams gnas dang / /me dang bden bral mngon phyogs te/ /sngags pas mtshams kyi thig gnyis ni/ /ji lta'i rim pas brkyang lag khyegadab/ /de bzhin me ru gnas pa yis(4/ /byang du bltas pas de lta bar/ /lte ba'i phyogs su gnas pa yeshe/ /de yis dbang po'i phyogs thig gdab/ /de nas de bzhin rlung phyogs kyi/ /sngar bzhin du ni gnas nas su/ /sngags pas lho ru mngon phyogs pas/ /nub kyi phyogs thig gdab par bya / /de nas de nyid du 'dug nas/ /shar du mngon par phyogs gnas te/ /bskor bar 'gro ba'i bya ba yis/ /mkhas pas byang gi phyogs thig gdab/ /me yi phyogs su 'dug nas su/ /de bzhin nub tu mngon phyogs pas/ /lho yi phyogs thig btab nas ni/ /de bzhin grwa bzhi ru ni 'gyur/ /'khor lo gsum brjod dkyil 'khor ni/ /'khor lo thig ni rgyas bstan pa/ /yang dag sdogs par sngar brjod pas/ /'dir ni rgyas par ma byas so/ /ra ba la sogs thig rnams ni/ /ye shes thig ni bsdus 3pa ru/ /de nas phyis ni brtags byas la/ /mkhas pas yang dag mchod la gzhag⑩ /ye shes thig ni gshegs gsol nas/ /sngon po la sogs pa yi tshon/ /gser la sogs pa'i sgod nyid du/ /bkang nas cho ga brtsam 11byed1286

par bya/ /thig gi tshon sna lnga po nyid/ /hūṃ las dkyil 'khor bdag po ni/ /dkyil 'khor kun dang yang dag ldan/ /bsams la de ni rim bsgom bya/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams bsams ①te/ /skani ji ltar 'od ldan pa/ /bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs tshig gis/ /rdul tshon rnams ni 'bar ba'o/ /rdul tshon mang bden gang brjod pas/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ /sems can rjes su chags pa yis/ /bden des tshon rtsi 'bar bar shog /sbyor ba'i stobs ni goms pa yis/ /gang zhing stobs kyis 'bar ba'o/ /de nas yi ge gsum po ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas byas te/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ zhes/ /brgya rtsa brgyad yongs bzlas nas ni/ /bdag po rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /phyis ni yang dag mchod par bya/ /bla med shes rab blangs nas su/ /rang gi dril bu sgra yis ni/ /rang la mtshan ma ngan la sogs/ /rim gyis med par byed pa'o/ /dbus su thig le dkar po'i tshon/ /shar gyi 'dab mar nag bo'o/ /g.yon gyi 'dab mar ljang gu'o/ /de bzhin rgyab kyi 'dab mar 3dmar/ /g.yas kyi 'dab ma ser por dgod/ /de ltar thig le lnga po de/ /yang dag rnyed nas lag g.yon gyis—/ /sngags kyi ③ bskul ba brjod pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra rā ga sa ma ya oṃ 26hūṃ/ khu tshur g.yon pas dbang ldan nas/ /nang nas ri mo lnga bri bya/ /phyi nas slob ma ci bde bar/ /dkyil 'khor nang du gnas nas ni/ /dkar po ljang gu dmar po dang / /de bzhin gzhan ni ser sngon po/ /phyi rol du ni kha dog sogs/ /ra ba rnams su yang dag grags/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshad kyis sdezi/ /de bzhin sbom min phra ba min/ /'khyegs pa ma yin nyams pa min/ /mkhas pas ri mo bri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du ni yang gsungs pa/ /sbom pas nad ni 'byung bar 11—1287

'gyur/ /phra bas nor ni nyams par ro/ /'khyog po yis ①ni 'byed par byed/ /chad pa yis ④ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gzhan du yang ni brjod pa yis/ /sbom pa yis ni khong nad 'byung / /phra bas nad dang nor zad do/ /de la sogs pa'i skyon rnams ni/ /slob dpon slob ma dag la 'byung / /sbom phra mthe'u chung gi ni tshad—/ /dkyil 'khor khru ni drug tu 'dod/ /thun mong gi ni dkyil 'khor gyi/ /sgo yi nyi shu'i (getshad yin no/ /rdul tshon shar dang byang dang ni/ /nub dang lho phyogs nyid du ni/ /de la sogs pa phyogs kyi cha/ /zhal gyi mdog tu bri ba'o/ /dkar po sngon po bsres pa'i mdog /dbus kyi char ni bri bar bya/ /'di nyid du ni gsang dbang bskur/ /gzhan nyid kyang ni brtag pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i dus su ni/ /rlung la sogs pa byung ba na/ /gcig tu dam pa'i don du ni/ /byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ / lang na ral gri'i 'aṣ+pe/rtse mo la phar khyil ba yi mar nag gis/ /snying po sa bon hūṃ phaṭa ni/ /sngags rig pa yis phyi rol bri/ /stobs po che yi 'gying pa'am/ /rdo rje drag dpal rnal 'byor ldan/ /ral gri de ni sprin la sogs/ /rlung la mngon par phyogs nas su/ /lan cig khro bo'i lus kyis su / /phaṭa kyi yi ge brjod bya zhing / /mtshon cha 'debs pa'i tshul byas na/ /sangs rgyas byas kyang rlag par byed/ /de ltar bzlog nas de rjes la/ /snod ni bzang po la sogs su/ /gnas min par ltung ⑦rdul tshon ni/ /de bzhin ras la sogs pa yang (she / /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /bzlas pa'i dri yi chu dag gis—/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams rtenas su/ /phyi dang nang du bsang gtor bya—/ /tsan+dan a ga ru ni spangs/ /chu srin sder mo ga pur dang / /gla rtsi ka ra sbrang rtsir ldan/ /bdug spos mang po rgyun mi 'chad/ /phyogs dang mtshams su 11—1288

snod byas nas/ /mdun du me mar sdong po gzhag① /sna tshogs me tog phreng ba ni—/ /bla re'i steng nas 'phyar bar bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /lag pa g.yon pa reg byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po gsang sngags te/ /lan bdun du ni bzla ④bar bya/ /nyi ma dgongs ka de nyid la/ /gar dang rnga ni lhag pa yi/ /glu dang sgra la sogs pa kun/ /sangs rgyas zhing du rnam gnas pa'i//'khor dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /nam mkha'i phyogs su rnam gnas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor rnams la yang dag mchod/ /gsol btab 'di yis spyan drang bya/ /ma lus phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ming rdo rje can zhes pa/ /dkyil 'khor bdag gis stibartag par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'dir gshegs la/ /dngos grub rnams ni deng stsol cig /de ltar brjod nas phyag byas te/ /thugs kyi ye shes rdor hūṃ las/ /lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i 'od zer tshogs/ /bcom ldan dpa' bo gtso bo ni/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis gnas pa ni/ /kha sbyor gyur pas yang dag gnas/ /de phyir yang dag bskul nas byon/ /de la hūṃ la zhugs par bya/ /dkyil 'khor pa kun bsam byas pa/ /bar snang la gnas lhan cig tu/ /ji lta'i gnas su lhan cig tu / /hūṃ gis byas pas gcig tu bsgom/ /ri mo la sogs rnam bkod la/ /de ltar rang gi dkyil 'khor gzhug /dkyil 'khor dbus byung pad+ma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar bcas/ /pad steng dpa' bo dbang phyug ni/5/ /lha mos 'khyud pas yang dag gnas/ /shar gyi 'dab mar mkha' 'gro ma/ /byang gi 'dab mar lā ma ste/ /nub 'dab dum skyes ma yin la/ /lho ru gzugs can ma gnas so/ /dri chen dri chu khu ba khrag /dung chen bzhi ru gnas pa ni/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma 11—1289

bzhi po la/ /g.yon nas brtsams te dgod par bya/ /de bzhin 'khor lo gsum bstan pa/ /dpa' bo'i rtsibs la de bzhin dgod/ /rgyud nas g.yon gyi rim pa yis—/ /rang rang lha mo yang dag ldan/ /dang po thugs kyi 'khor lo ste/ /gnyis pa gsung gi 'khor lo dang / /gsum pa sku yi 'khor lo ni/ /lugs las bzlog pa dgod par bya/ /dang po'i sgor ni khwa gdong ma/ /de nas 'ug gdong byang du ste/ /khyi gdong nub tu shes par bya/ /lho ru phag gi gdong can no/ /mtshalas su de bzhin gshin rje brtan①/ /gshin rje pho nya gzhan yang ②ni/ /gshin rje mche ba can zhes dang / /de bzhin gshin rje 'joms ma dgod/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams bkod nas su/ /sngags 'di dag ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra phywabe sha ya kra ma hūṃ/ /yang na yi ge gsum dran bya/ /gal te rdul tshon ma nus na/ /dkyil 'khor dang mnyam ras la ni/ /sngar nas tshon gyis bri bar bya/ /gal te yang ni ma nus na/ /de dang de nas sngags bsgom bya/ /he ru ka mchog phyag rgya bzhi/ /nges par bri ba dgongs ④pa'o/ /cung zhig dkyil 'khor ma rdzogs pa/ /de yi dus na yongs rdzogs 'gyur/ /lha yi 'khor lo rnam bkod nas/ /'di ltar spos la sogs pa yang / /dkyil 'khor pa kun mngon byas mchod/ /so so'i skye bo rnal 'byor dmigs/ /me tog phreng bas yang dag gzung ④/ /khros pa'i hūṃ yig brjod par bya/ /hūṃ gi yi ge brjod nas su/ /sngags pas dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug /rnal 'byor g.yas dang g.yon gyis ni/ /blta zhing dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /bskor ⑤ba lan gsum byas nas su/ /bsgyur 0 ba'i me tog phreng blangs nas/ /brtul zhugs can gyis be+er yang ni/ /rang gi mgo la bcing bar bya—/ /khro bo'i du lta stangs yang dag ldan/ /nub la sogs pa'i sgo bzhi ru/ /11—1290

gnas nas yi ge gsum ni brjod/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo bzhir ①ni/ /mkhas pas yid kyis dbye bar bya/ /sgo dbye ba yi ④gsang sngags ni/ /oṃ badzod gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be+e sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga ldan pa'i/ /dri yi chu dang bcas pa yis①/ /he ru ka dpal mdun du ni/ /dung chos dag ni gzhag ④par bya—/ /sngags pa rig ma dang bcas pas/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug /de nas rjes gnang blangs nas su/ /rang nyid byin gyis brlab par bya rang gi ming ni brjod nas su/ /spyi bos kyang ni phyag bya'o/ /'og nas 'byung buba'i cho ga 'dis/ /lha rnams yang dag bskul bar bya/ /mi bzad ma lus bdud kyis gus byas pa'i/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin sngon du byas/ /rang byung mtha' mod srid pa nyid kyi rang bzhin ni/ /sa kun snying po gcig du ⑥'dir spyon cig /de ltar sngags pas bskul nas su/ /mkhas pas yang dag 'jug par bya/ /hūṃ bzhi pa yi sngags dang ni/ /dpa' bo lnga dang bcas pas bya/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa dzaṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ oṃ kṛza pa ya kṛsnra pa ya hūṃ/ oṃ yangan ya hotsho/ bha ga wān tsabadz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'di dag ni brjod pa ni⑨/ /rang snying hūṃ yig las byung ba'i—/ /'od zer rnams kyis ⑩ma lus dgug /rang gi sras bcas 'dir gnas parka/ /nam mkha'i phyogs nas 'ongs pa yis/ /ngal zhing zhal ni bzhad bcas pa—/ /rang gi dngos grub grub 'dod na/ /sems can kun la bde ster ba/ /dkyil 'khor mngon phyogs 'ongs nas su/ /steng du gnas pa bsam par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu blangs nas ni/ /sngar brjod pa yi ⑪bstod pas bstod/ /bcom ldan brtan por bzung byas nas/ /shin tu bshes ni nyer gnas la/ /'di yis bsgoms pas de de kun/ /rang rang gzugs kyis gzhug par bya/ /lha yi 'khor 11—1291

lo kun la ni/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas gdab bya/ /rnam pa kun gyi ①mchog ldan pa'i—/ /rang rang kha dog phyag mtshan 'chang / /sprul pa'i sku yi rang bzhin ni/ /phyag rgya chen po ru ni grags/ /dbang po gnyis kyis snyoms 'jug pa/ /bsgom pa'i bdag nyid de don du/ /shes rab mi mo gzugs 'dzin pa/ /de ni dam tshig tu ni brjod/ /byang chub sa bon skyed byed gang / /zhing du byed pa'i bdag nyid de/ /yang dag mthar ni rnam dag pas/ /chos kyi phyag rgya ru ni brjod/ /sems can phung po ma lus pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyud ched 2/du/ /rdo rje pad+ma snying brtser gang / /las kyi phyag rgya ru ni grags/ /'on kyang de bzhin lha mo rnams/ /dga' rol dam tshig tu ni grags/ /las kyi phyag rgya de bzhin du/ /rang gi bya ba de skad cig /phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas gdab po/ /de bzhin rgyas gdab rim nyid nishashe/ /dpa' dbang rang gi lha mo rnams/ /dpa' bo rnams dang gtso bo ni/ /dbang bskur ba ni rab tu sbyin/ /bsam gtan gyis ni legs mnyam gzhag4 /sems can don la byed brtson pas/ /spro dang de bzhin gzhug par bya/ /phan tshun tha mi dad mi gnas/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po gsang sngags niske/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzla ye)bar bya/ /de las gzhan pa'i lha rnams kyi/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla bar bya/ /des kyang dkyil 'khor grub par ni/ /'gyur ba ru ni ze tshom med/ /gtso bo sngags ni bzlas pa yis/ /rnam rgyal bum pa de nas ni//de yi mdun du gzhag par bya/ /lha mo (6sna rnams kyi sngags kyis bsngags/ /de rnams 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gye/ /phyi rol du ni mkhas pas gzhag7 /ji ltar 'dod pas mtshams bzhi ru/ /mtshan ma yang dag ldan de dgod/ /de nas ar+gha la sogs dbul/ /pus mo g.yas pa sar btsugs nas/ /spos la sogs pas 11— 292

yang dag mchod/ /yang na yi ge gsum bsngags pa'i/ /las kun pa yi bum chu yisarka/ /sdod gcig tu ni bsang gtor bya/ /yang dag blangs te btung la sogs/ /bldag dang gzhib ①dang bca' bar ldan/ /de la yig gsum mngon par bsngags/ /oṃ sarba be+ed pū ra pū ra a brta ya ho zhes bya'o/ /dpa' bo rnams la so sor ni/ /gos zung dag ni dbul bar bya/ /gtso bo la ni dri mchog dang —/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ras yug dbul/ /med na ji ltar nus pa yikhye/ /lnga las nyung bar mi bya'o/ /sngags pas mchod pa rnam lnga yis/ /lha rnams so sor mchod par bya/ /de la 'di yi gsang sngags ni/ /oṃ dhū zu/paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ bhar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ lha dang dbyer med pa yi gzugs/ /sgeg mo la sogs cha lugs kyis/ /sngon du gsang sngags 'di brjod cing / /mkhas pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma 4hā gya lā gya ra ti kṛ deḍā sau khya a nut+ta ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ gal te 'byor na mchod pa ni—/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs/ /glu dang gar dang rnga la sogs/ /dgod dang sgeg la dga' bas spro/ /phyi dang gsang ba'i rnam pa yis/ mchod pa'i rigs kyi tshogs kyis ni/ /lus kun dri yis byugs pa dang / /brtul zhugs can gyis yang dag mchod/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pa ni/ /dam pa'i mchod pa 'di yis ni/ /yid ni dga' ba skyed par byed/ /de phyir kun bdag rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag gzhan kun gyis mchod par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags 'di yis/ /de la lan gsum brjod par bya/ /mchod pa kun gyi 3rang bzhin gyi/ /sna tshogs pas mchod bsgom par bya/ /sngags ni/ /oṃ a nut+ta ra sarba pū dza me gha sa muṅga te tsa ra ti oṃ ga ga na hūṃ phaṭa swā 11—1293

hā—/ de nas lhag dang chad pa yi/ /skyon ni bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bsam gtan bzlas dang bstod byas nas/ /ji ltar de bzhin bzod par gsol/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi byen rlabs ①dang / /dam tshig kyang ni dran pa dang / /sems can kun gyi snying rje yis/ /dngos grub ma lus bsgrub par bgye/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas shar sgo las byung las④/ /bcom ldan 'das dang lhan 'ongs pa'i /dbang po la sogs phyogs bdag kun/ /tshig gis ①nye bar spyan drang bya/ /de la tshig ni 'di yin te/ /kha cig bcom ldan 'das gcig (pe'ongs/ /phyogs kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas/ /gang 'dir gnas pa de dag kun/ /de rnams bdag la rjes dgongs phyir/ /ji ltar yod pa'i dri dang ni/ /me tog sogs kyis gtor bzhes la/ /sems can rnams la byams sems dang / /slob ma yang dag bgegs med mdzod/ /de nas der gnas ar+gha ni/ /chu ni gnyis pas gsum dbul lo/ /mchod pa lnga ni nyer blangs nas/ /bdud rtsi lnga ldan gtor ma ni/ /yi ge gsum gyis mngon bsngags te/ /de nyid brjod pas sbyin par bya/ /mchod pa byas nas de mthar ni/ /de nas phyogs skyong gtor ma sbyin/ /de nas dri zhim yan lag bkru/ /sna tshogs gos kyis brgyan byas na(5// /dang po lha rnams tshim pa'i phyir/ /zhi ba yi ni sbyin sreg bya/ /de la 'di yi cho ga ni/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i btsun mo gzung ( )/ /ra nga gi lha mo'i rnam — )gang bsam/ /dkyil 'khor nang du de dang ni/ /gnas nas dbang nyid snyoms 'jug nyid/ /thugs kar ye shes kyi ni lha/ / gnyi gar ①yang ni yang dag bsam/ /de bzhin hūṃ 3las hom gzar bskyed/ /dbus su me ni 'bar ba yig/ /de bzhin lce ni hūṃ las bskyed/ /zhag chen gyis ni mchod pa'am/ /mar dang bsres pa rnam 4stebasam bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga 11—1294

sogs yang dag ldan/ /blo ldan ston mo'i sbyin sreg bya/ /phan tshun kha yi thab khyang 'dir/ /ma tshim bar du sbyin sreg bya/ /gang gis de ltar mi nus na/ /de la phyi rol sbyin sreg bya/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg cho ga yis①/ /byas nas de ni yang dag bsdu/ /'on kyang gsang ba'i cho ga yis/ /tshim par byas nas nye bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin phyi rol sbyin sreg gis/ /lha rnams nye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyi rol gsang ba yi/ /mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag mchod/ /de ④rjes rang sems brtan bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor ba rnams so so ru/ /bdag gis mngon du byas nas su/ /slob ma rnams la rjes brtse'i phyir/ /gsang ba yi ni rgyud las kyang —/ /ji skad bstan pa'i tshig gsungs so/ /bdag gis de ma thag tu ni/ /ji bzhin gsungs pa'i cho ga rjes gnas/ /de phyir dkyil 'khor nga la ni/ /shin tu yid ni bde ba thob/ /mig rgyas zhal ni 'dzum pa yis/ /byams dang snying rje'i shanabasam pa can/ /gang gis blta zhing gnas pa dang / /bdag dang slob ma rjes brtse ④bas/ /cho ga 'di yis yang dag par/ /de yis ⑤dkyil 'khor kun la ni/ /dga' dang tshim par bsams nas su/ /de yi las kyis de dbang 'gyur/ /de yi rjes su slob dpon ni/ /rang gi rig pa dang ldan pas/ /rang gis bsdus nas bzung ba yi/ /thog mar skyabs gsum la sogs pa/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /de nas dkyil 'khor du zhugs sha gete/ /mkhas pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ /de yi rim 'dir shes par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang —/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung ⑦/ /oṃsarba yo gi kā ya wāka tsit+ta mut+yā da ya mi a shiṣ+ṭa an ba shiṣ+ṭa 6sa ta dh+wa tu hi ta su khot+ta ma sernyi a r+yan+ta ⑨bha ba saṃ 11—1295

sernyi mā hai shwat+yā ①tsa/ me tog phreng ba blangs nas su/ /thal mo gnyis ni yang dag sbyar—/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste/ /sngags 'di dag ni dag par bya/ /phywakhaṃ bī ④ra hūṃ/ zhes sam/ chashrī badz+ra he te ru ru rka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ /ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sasbra ra ①zhes brjod/ /gtso bo slob dpon dag gis ni/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug gzugs bzung nas/ /de nas 'jug pa'i dus su ni/ /slob mas 'di bzhin du brjod de/ /oṃpra be sha ya bha ga bān/ /ma hā mo k+ṣa pu dure/ /sarba sernyi su khaṃ ram̐ rmya pa ra ma su khot+ta ma sirnyi dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hotsho/ pra sedhi bh+yo/ gnyis gzhug nas ni duphyag byed cing / /de yis rol cing dga' bas bskor/ /de ltar phyag byas rjes su ni/ /bskor ④ba gsum ni bya ba yin/ /sngags pas de ltar brjod nas su/ /de nas yang ni mdun gnas te/ /rgyud gzhan las ni grags pa gang //de nyid 'dir ni lan cig brjod/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /rdo rje chen po nor chen po/ /ye shes chen po phrin ④las che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng bdag shog /ces bya'o/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chu 'thungs nas/ /de nas snying gar zla dkyil 'khor/ / bsams la '-i.i yig dmar po las/ /de rjes byed pa'i 'od zer gyes/ /'gro dang 'ong bar rdzogs byas te/ /brtul zhugs can gyis de brjod bya/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug rjes zhugs nas/ /dpa' bo yang dag byen brlabs te/ /de bzhin rdo rje phag mo bzhin/ /btsun mos yang dag byin gyis brlabs⑩/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra bsam bya zhing / /yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya/ /de nas thal mo gnyis bar du/ /phyis ni me tog phreng gnas pa/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bri bya ste/ /sngags 'di dag ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ pa ra ma su kha a sha ya la li ta bī lā sha na mi ti tumer na mā mi bha ga 'gran phywa⑫khaṃ bī ra hūṃ pra tīts+tsha skeku su rmā 11—1296

dza la ni thā ①ho/ /phreng ba bcing ba sogs byas nas/ /he ru ka dpal phyag byas terka/ /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur te/ /kun du lung ni bstan pa dang / /rdo rje brtul zhugs mthar thug pa/ /mdor bsdus nas ni thams cad blang / /'og nas 'byung ba'i rim pa nyid/ /byas la rang rig bcas pa dang / /bya rgyud ④dag ni de rjes bya/ /de nas rang gi 'dod pa bsgom/ /rdo rje gar dang nyer spyod pa'i//mchod pas yang dag mchod par bya/ /de bzhin sgra ni snyan pa yis/ /dam tshig gsum kyi glu blang ba/ /yang dag mchod pa bya ba ste/ /de nas glu ni bla med blang //nam mkha' las byung mtshan nyid phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /rdo rje chen po rang bzhin sems/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng bdag 'grub/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog ni bdag grub shog /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ni/ /'dod chags ma lus rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid grub par mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems ni bdag grub shog /kun gyi mchog ste grub chen po/ /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje bsnyems bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas slob ma gzhug don du/ /mkhas pas 'di ltar brjod bya ste/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/ / he ru ka dpal snoslob dpon che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems kun gyis/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga dag gis ni/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i cho gas ni/ /sems can don ni bdag gis bgyi/ /de la rjes gnang de rjes bdag /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /nye ba ru ni gnas par 11—1297

'gyur/ /de nas rjes su gnang na rung / /bdag gis nye bar bsam bya ste/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di gnyis kyis/ /bden pa'i byen gyis brlab ①brjod bya/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab gcig po/ /mchog gyur dam tshig mchog 'dod pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung 'gyur ba/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /bden pa 'di yis mgon po bdag /khyod kyi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs shog /mkhas pas phyis ni 'di spyad bya/ /chos kyi dbyengs kyi byen rlabs ②dang / /dam tshig kyang ni dran pa yis—/ /snying rje sems can thams cad don/ /ma lus grub par bya phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /de nas slob ma dbang bskur 'os/ /de bzhin rang gi rigs dang bcas/ /sngar brjod pa yi sngags nyid dang / /ho ru ka dpal gzugs kyis ni/ /yi ge gsum gyis byin brlabs shing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /sna tshogs gos ni bskon pa dang / /de bzhin gtsug tor bla gos dang / /mig dang gdong no bcing bya zhing / /rang gi rig ⑨dang bcas pa la/ /yid ni ④legs par phul nas su/ /tha mar phyag ni bya ba ste/ /shar sgor thog mar re zhig ni/ /thal mo yang dag sbyar byas nas/ /de nas brkyang bar byas nas su/ /gus pas 'di ltar brjod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pas+thā nā ya āt+pa rmā nit+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ko bh+yaḥ.a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa rmā/ zhes bya brjod pa de nas ni/ /lus kun gyis ni phyag bya'o/ /snying gar bcom ldan bzhugs 'a)pa ru/ /yid kyis yongs su brtag par bya/ /de bzhin lho sgo nyid du ni/ /thal mo de nyid snying ga ru—/ /de bzhin bcas nas sngags 'di yis/ /rin chen sngags ni brjod par bya—/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta phu dza a bhi ⑥ṣe ka ya 42 ④dzā nit+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga 11—1298

ta rat+na sam+bha ba a ①nyiṣiñca a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa rmā④/ zhes pa brjod pa nyid kyis ni/ /mkhas pas dpral bas phyag bya'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rdo rje yis/ /dbang bskur bar ni rnam brtag bya/ /de nas phyis ni nub kyi sgor/ /de bzhin mgo bor thal mo sbyar/ /'di ni byas nas brjod pa ni/ /tshogs 1kyi mchod pa rab mchod nyid/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta na ya ta ④āt+pa rmā nit+yā ⑤ta yā mi/sarba ta thā ga ta a mi tā bha ⑥pra brta ya rmā/ zhes brjod gdong gtsos phyag bya'o/ /'od dpag med pa'i rang bzhin 'dis/ /de ni nus pa ldan par brtag /de bzhin byang sgor gnas nas su/ /snying gar thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /dngos grub thams cad byed pa yi/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma be+e āt+pa dzā nit+yā ta yā mispri/ /sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha sedhi ku ru rmā/zhes pa (7brjod pa nyid kyis ni/ /mkhas pas spyi bos phyag bya'o/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa nus pa ru/ /don yod ⑨grub pa bsam par bya/ /'khrugs pa med pas mi bskyod pa/ /gtso bo dpa' bo bcom ldan no/ /rin chen thams cad 'byung gnas phyir/ /de nyid rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /mtha' yas chos kyi lam ston phyir—/ /de nyid 'od dpag med du brjod/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster bas—/ /de nyid don yod grub par brjod/ /de ltar 'on kyang mdor bsdus nasarka/ /rig pa thams cad de yang ni/ /mkha' 'gro la sogs mchog ⑩rnams kyis—/ /mngon par byin gyis brlabs ⑪bsam bya/ /me tog lag bzung de yis ni—/ /bla ma la ni phyag bya ste/ /shar sgor mngon par phyogs pa yis/ /gus pas de kyeltar brjod par bya/ /dam tshig de ni bdag la stsol⑫/ /sdom pa yang ni bdag la sprul⑩/ /rdo rje rigs kun bsdus pa yi/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 11—1299

'jug mdzod/ /phyir mi sdog pa dbang bskur ba'i/ /skal ba chen po bdag la stsol—/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub go 'phang mchog /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rjes 'jug pa'i/ /'dom gang 'od sogs yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong stsol/ /mgon po chen po bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur ba ni ngo mtshar che/ /sems can kun gyi don byi phyir/ /rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon mdzod/ /de bzhin slob dpon gnas nas su/ /de yi tshig gi sgo nas ni/ /rigs kun la ni mkhyen gsol gang / /rim pa ji bzhin bya ba ni/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis—/ /byang chub sems ni yongs gzung ①dang / /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug cing / /dam tshig sdom pa nod par 'tshal/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad dpa' bo la/ /gus pa yis ni gsol gdab pa/ /de ltar slob ma la ni brjod/ /de nas gzhan yang slob ma la/ /gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa/ / gsang chen yongs su gzung 2ba ru/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /de ltar bdag ni 'tshal zhes bya/ /de ltar byas nas de rjes su/ /rigs lnga yi bye ni dam tshig brjod/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar gyis—7/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung (nyabar bgyi/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 11—1300

'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu gtang ①/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis gzung rjobar bgyi/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa'i mchog yin no/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung ①bgyi zhing —/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /gzhan yang bcu bzhi 'di dag ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu grags/ /rtsa ba'i thong bar shes bya ste/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /gdugs re zhing ni gdon par bkyi/ /mdza' bshes rdo rje spun dang ni/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /de ltar ci nas spyad par bya/ /theg pa dman la ④'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba spang bar mi bya zhing / /mya ngan 'das la rjodaga' mi bya/ /gsang ba gsum gyi lha rnams la/ /brnyas pa nyid du mi bya'o—/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad ⑨mi bya/ /ma byen par yang mi blang zhing / /'dod las log par mi spyod de/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /sems can kun gyi don gye phyisaspri/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /legs par nye bar bsten bya ste / /rnal 'byor ba rnams bsnyen bkur khyebya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang —/ /ngag gi las ni rnam pa bzhi/ /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su skyong (she)/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ /spyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /des kyang 'di skad brjod bya ste/ /slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /ji bzhin bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /de yi de nyid 'di yis ni/ /mkhas pas phyis ni sdom pa sbyin/ /gang 11—1301

yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon pos ①sangs rgyas rnams dang ni/ /de sras bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba 'di/ /dus 'di nas ni rab bzung ste—/ /byang chub snying po ②mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni babe+eb ①pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khyems gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung tshu bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung 37bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spong ngo / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu pya phyag rgya dag /yang dag nyid du gzung ⑨bgyi zhing / /slob dpon dag kyang gzung 'u7bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba rnams/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'ilnga/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa yi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung rkabar bgyi—/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung ⑪bgye zhing / /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi7/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyi zhing / /sems can kun gye don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung ⑫/ /ma grol ba ni bdag gis dgrol/ /ma bsgral ba ni bdag gis bsgral/ /dbugs ma phyung ba 11—1302

dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ①ta yo gi kā ya 'grika tsit+ta ④mun+d+ra da ya ju mya she ṣa ṇa ba she byu ①sa ta dh+wa tu hi ta su tse④/ta ma sidhi/ a ta ma ta bha wa sirnyi ma he shwa ra a dhi pa t+yā tsar+ya zhes brjod do/ /de yis slob ma byang chub sems/ /bla med par ni bskyed nas su/ /snying gar rdo rje bzhag byas te/ /snying po 'di ni brjod par bgyi/ /su ra te sa ma ya ⑤hūṃ hoḥsidhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ 'di yis slob ma bskul nas ni/ /'dod don thams cad grub khye7par 'gyur/ /sa ma ya ste sngags kyis ni/ /me tog phreng ba 'bad pas gzung (dzobye/ /de ni slob dpon gyis bcug nas/ /yang ni gsol ba gdab par bya/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub ches/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /slob ma rnams ni gzhug par bya/ /snying po dkyil 'khor 'di nyid ni/ /rdo rje ye shes thob pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang du—/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug ldupar bkyi/ /ā khaṃ bī ḍaper hūṃ zhes brjod pas slob ma gzhug par bya'o/ /dam tshig skyod par byed pa 'di/ /de nas 'di skad brjod bya ste/ /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi / ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lco dngos grub thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos / khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la brjod par ma byed cig /dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i rdo rje ni/ /spyi bor bzhag la 'di skad brjod/ /'di ⑫ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /gal te las rab khyod 'di smra—/ /khyod kyi (na spyi bo 'gas par byed/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid ni/ /khyod kyi musnying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na meni/ /de ma thag tu dral 11—1303
