te ①gshegs/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga ldan pa'i/ /chu ni thod par gnas pa la/ /snying po lan cig yongs su bzlas/ /de ni 'thung du gzhug pa'o/ /rdo rje chu la oṃ t+pahūṃ ②baṃḥ/ /blo ldan gyis ni 'di brjod bya/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ste/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig① /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /dkyil 'khor ma zhugs ston 'gyur ram/ /skye bo tshogs kyi nang du ni/ /ma dag dogs ④par brjod mi bya/ /deng phyin chad khyod kyi rdo rje drag po nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di byus shig ces bsgo ba khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /ya nga ba ma spangs par che'i dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar gyur ta re—/ yang slob mas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ rdo rje drag po bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /de nas dam tshig rdo rje 'di/ /rdo rje drag po zhes su brjod/ /ye shes rdo rje bla na med—/ /de ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /de ltar rdo rje dbab ces bya/ /de rnams rtag tu brjod par bya/ /gal te bab bupar ma gyur na/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /de snying zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje drag po kha spyor bsgom/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i nying 'dzin gyis/ /de yi bskul dubaskyod las byung ba/ /a yig dmar po'i 'od zer gyis/ /de yi ⑦lus kun yongs bkang ste/ /de nyid yang dag brjod pa yis/ /sngar bzhin du ni gzhug par bya/ /slob dpon rjes su gzung ⑤ ba ni/ /rig dang bcas pas bsam byas na/ /de nas nges par 'bab pa yi/ /yang dag byen rlabs 'byung ba'o/ /ye shes de nyid de la ni/ /de nyid du ni brjod par bya/ /yang ni lce la bsam bya ba/ /a yig dmar po dgod pa ste/ /11—1304

smos shig rdo rje can nyid kyis/ /dge dang mi dge smra bar gyis/ /de nas 'bab par gyur na ni/ /brgya phyed yi ges brtan byas la/ /de rjes yang dag byen brlabs brtan/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyodṛ rnyo me bha ba/ j-i da ④ya me a bye tiṣ+ṭha sarba sidhim+bi pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsihaṃ sre yañca7ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥzhes bya'o/ /yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ /lha rnams kyi ni rigs kyi rim/ /ji ltar bsod nams de bzhin shog /gang gi ④dngos grub gyur pa yi/ /de yi rigs kyi snod yin na/ /ji ltar bsod nams mthu yis su/ /dkyil 'khor 'di yang de bzhin shog /sngar brjod pa yi tshig gis ni/ /me tog phreng ba dor bar bya/ /'phangs pa'i me tog phreng ba ni/ /lha yi gnas la bab shes bya/ /oṃpra be sha ya ku lo shebye trem hā ba lo/ /'di brjod nas ni phreng ba blang —/ /bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs ( ༄'di ni/ /sngags pa mkhas pa yis ni bya/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /bden pa 'di yis 7dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan lta bur slob ma ni/ /gsal zhing sdig med mthong bar shog /de nas mig gnyis zla ba la/ /oṃ gyis byen brlabs bsgom par bya/ /snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bdag po yang dag dmigs nas su/ /de yi mig gi 'od zer gyis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni lha rnams kyi/ /spyan dang dbyer med ngo bo nyid/ /yang dag dmigs nas phyi nas ni/ /mig gnyis la ni yang dag bsdu(she/ /yang ni 'jug pa'i rnam pa yis/ /de yi bcings pa dgrol bar bya/ /mig 'byed pa yi tshig 'di ni/ /ji lta ba bzhin brjod bya ste/ /oṃrdo rje drag po rang nyid ni/ /mig 'byed pa la brtson par mdzad/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /'di brjod bcings pa bkrol nas su/ /de la lan 11—1305

cig dri bar bya/ /khyod kyis mig gis ci mthong 'gyur/ /ji bzhin du ni smra bar gyis—/ /dkar po ser po de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu nag po nyid dang sngo/ /de ltar dngos grub shes byas la/ /dkyil 'khor bstan phyir 'di brjod bya/ /kye rdo rje ltos shig ces '-i)bya'o/ /de ltar brjod nas 'dir brjod bya/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos②/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rigs su skye/ /mthong bar dngos grub spyor ba dang / /phun sum tshogs kun mchog tu 'gyur/ /dam tshig bskyangs pas ⑦dngos grub dang / /sngags sgrub dupa la brtson par gyis/ /bsod nams dang ba'i stobs bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba de nas ni/ /sna tshogs 'od zer 'phro ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong bar the tshom med/ /de nas he ru ka dpal sogs/ /kun du dkyil 'khor ba kun gyi/ /de nas lha yi de nyid ni/ /gus pa yis ni brjod par bya/ /shrī gang bla na med pa'o/ /te ni rgyu dang bral ba ste—/ /ru ni brjod dang bral ba'o/ /ka ni gang du mi gnas pa/ /he ru ka dpal zhes brjod do/ /rdo rje ye shes dbyer med phyir/ /rtag tu sdig pa 'joms pa dang —/ /gang zhig 'dod chags dman pa sbyong ⑤/ /rdo rje sngon song phag mo'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi ngang tshul gang / /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags/ /gang zhig gdug pa rtag za ba/ /de ni lā mar rab tu bshad/ /nyon mongs dum bur 'joms pas na/ /dum skyes ma zhes rab tu brjod/ /sna tshogs gzugs su 'chang bas na/ /de ni gzugs can ma zhes brjod/ /gdug pa'i thod pa dum byed pas/ /thod pa'i dum bu zhes su brjod/ /gang zhig gdug drag tshar gcod pasaske/ /gtum mo zhes ni rab tu brjod/ /yi dwags chen po 'dra ba gang / /de 11—1306

ni keng rus chen por brjod/ /gang phyir mig gnyis gtum 'bar bas de phyir gtum mig ma zhes brjod/ /dur khrod chen po'i rang bzhin phyir/ /de ni keng rus chen por brjod/ /bla med 'od dang ldan pa ①gang / /ming ni 'od ldan ma zhes bya/ /mche ba gcigs par ston pa gang / /ming gis 'jigs par byed pa'o—/ /gdug la sdigs mdzub byed pas na/ /de ni ②sna chen ma zhes brjod/ /lha rnams yid 'dod pa bzhin phyir/ /lha dgra zhes ni bya bar brjod/ /dpal rnams blo yi rang bzhin pas/ /'di ①ni dpa' bo'i blo mar brjod/ /gang zhig 'dir ④ni dpag med pas/ /'dir ni 'od dpag med par brjod/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi bde sgrub gang / /de ming de spyobyed pa zhes brjod/ /gang gis dbyer med 'od byed pas/ /de ni rdo rje'i 'od du brjod/ /lang ka ru ni skyes pas na/ /lang ka'i dbang phyug ma ru brjod/ /lha rnams kun gyi dumi phyed pas/ /rdo rje lus zhes brjod par bya/ /gang gi shing gi grib mtshungs pas/ /shing grib ma zhes bya bar brjod/ /sdogs pa'i byang chub myur 'byung bas/ /de ni dpa' bo'i myu gur brjod/ /mkha' 'gro glang po zhon 'gro bas/ /sa srung dze+em zhes bya bar brjod/ /rdo rje ral pas 'jigs byed pas/ /rdo rje ral pa zhes su brjod/ /gang zhig gdug rnams rab ston pas/ /'jigs byed chen po zhes byar brjod/ /dpa' rnams nang nas rang bzhin dpa'/ /de ni dpa' bo chen por brjod/ /rlung gi shugs dang mtshungs pas na/ /rlung shugs ma zhes bya bar brjod/ /mu stegs thams cad 'jigs mdzad pas/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad ces ni brjod/ /dam tshig srung la ched byed pas/ /chang 'thung ma zhes brjod par bya/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi gzugs bzang phyir/ /de ni shin tu bzang zhes brjod/ /rnal 'byor 11—1307

rnam brtse'i ①rang bzhin can/ /de ni sngo bsangs ④ma zhes brjod/ /rtag tu bzang po'i rang bzhin phyir/ /rdo rje bzang po zhes su brjod/ /kun du dpal dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /de yang shin tu bzang zhes brjod/ /mu stegs ngan pa skrag byed pas/ /'jigs byed chen po zhes su grags/ /tshig rnams nyan par byed pas na/ /rta rna ma zhes rab tu grags/ /gang phyir lta ①bar dka' dus phyir/ /mig mi bzang zhes bya bar brjod/ /zhal dang zhal du sbyor bas na/ /de ni bya gdong ma zhes brjod/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa'i phyir/ /de ni stobs chen ma zhes brjod/ /gdug can 'khor lo bzhin bskor bas/ /'khor lo shugs ma zhes ni brjod/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal 'phrog /dzupas na/ /de ni rin chen rdo rjer ⑤brjod/ /dum bur byed cing gcod pas na/ /phyis ni dum skyes yid 'ong rjom/ /rta mchog dag gi rang bzhin phyir/ /de ni rta mgrin zhes ni brjod/ /rnal 'byor kun la mdzes pa'i phyir/ /de ni chang 'tshong ma zhes brjod/ /shin tu gzi brjid rang bzhin phyir/ /de ni nam mkha'i snying por brjod/ /'khor lo lta bur chos 'dra bas/ /de ni 'khor lo go cha ma/ /he ru ka dpal 'dra bstan pas//de yi ming yang brjod pas ni/ /dpa' rnams mchog gi rang bzhin phyir/ /shin tu dbang po mchog gi mchog /gar dang bstod pa'i rang bzhin phyir/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'dod/ /rtag tu nyin re bden byed gang / /de yang stobs po che zhes brjod/ /snang dang ldan pa'i rang bzhin phyir/ /de ni rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi 0 'khor lor gnas/ /'khor los sgyur ma zhes ni brjod/ /sems can dbyer med ston pas na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes ni brjod/ /gang la brtson 'grus che mnga' bas/ /brtson 'grus chen po tso 11—1308

zhes ni brjod/ /bya rog lta bu'i ①gdong ldan pas④/ /khā gdong ma zhes bya bar grags/ /'ug pa'i gdong dang yang dag ldan/ /de ni 'ug gdong ma zhes grags//khyi gdong ma dang phag gdong ma/ /de bzhin gzugs ni 'dzin par brjod/ /gshin rje brtan ma pho nya mo/ /gzhan ni gshin rje mche bar 'dod/ /gang zhig gshin rje 'joms byed pas/ /gshin rje 'joms ma zhes ni brjod/ /de rnams lha yi de nyid do/ /ji ltar 'khor lo lnga de nyid/ /yid kyi dkyil nyakhor mchog gyur pas/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu mnyam par brjod/ /gzhal yas khang pa zhes bya ba/ /gru bzhi pa ni yang dag blang / /kun du tshad dang ldan pa yi/ /tshul khyems sdom pa mchog gyur pa'i/ /rgyan gang yin par bshad pa'o/ /dad pa'i dbang po la sogs sems/ / rang rang ①lnga ru yang dag byung / /gang gis rnam par thar pa bzhi/ /sgo bzhi ru ni yang dag bshad/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi nyid ni—/ /rta babs ka ba'i rnam par byung / /dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi ye shes/ /kha khyer bzhi ru brjod pa yin/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi nyid ni/ /sgo khyud bzhi ru brjod pa yin/ /byang chub yan lag bdun phreng ba/ /ba dan me tog phreng bar brjod/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes ni/ /ting 'dzin gnyis su brtags pa yinarka/ /lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni/ /rnga yab tu ni brjod pa yin/ /nyon mongs kun ni zad byed pas/ /de bzhin dra ba zhes su brjod/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs 'joms pa ru/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /nyon mongs skyes pa 'phrog byed pas/ /dra ba phyed par rab tu brjod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po ni/ /rtag tu ka bar 'gyur ba yisde/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi yan lag brgyad/ /ka ba brgyad du brjod pa yin/ /de yi dkyil gyi pad+ma gang / /skyon 11—1309

—gyes ma gos pa ru bstan/ /'khor lo gsum du gnas pa ni/ /sems sogs dri ma gsum bral yin/ /rtsibs su yang dag bshad pa ni/ /nyon mongs nye nyon spangs pa'o/ /rdo rje la sogs phreng ba gang / /glo bur dri ma spangs pa yin/ /sangs rgyas yon tan de dag kun/ /dkyil 'khor du ni brjod pa yin/ /sems can don kun yang dag brtson/ /de nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bstan/ /de nas bdag po rnal 'byor ldan/ /rnam rgyal bum pa chu yis ni/ /oṃ tshihūṃ/badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca rmā①/ /sngags 'di dag ni bton ⑤pa yis/ /yal ga gzung (snye ba'i khu tshur gyis/ /dbang bskur ba ni sbyin par bya/ /de nas de yi mgo bor ni//ral pa'i cod pan mdzes khyab pas/ /rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs bsams te/ /gus pas dbu rgyan dbang bskur bya/ /de nas rang gi mtshan ma'i dbang / /lag pa dag tu sbyin par bya/ /rang gi mtshan ma'i rjes 'gro ba'i/ /sngags 'di nyid ni gang yin brjod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i pedabang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /de ltar gang gi ming yin pa/ /kye ma ⑤sgra ni sngon byas te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ting 'dzin yang / /yang dag ched du byas nas su/ /phyag rgya 37 bzhi yi gdams stingag bstan/ /de nas yang ni slob ma yis/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ /gus pa yis ni phyag byas te/ /me tog bcings pa 8la sogs kun—/ /bzung nas rdo rje brtul zhugs blang / /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi—/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtana'-iste/ /de nas rdo rje bzung nas ni/ /sngags 'di dag ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sidhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha/ e ṣa ste lnga/dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa tītshonyi hi hi hi hūṃ zhes bya'o/ /sngags pas tshigs bcad 'di 11—1310

brjod nas/ /de nas dril bu'i ①brtul zhugs sbyin/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab thabs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed④/ /gang zhig de ltar dbang bskur bas—/ /dngos grub tu 'gyur the tshom med/ /lha gang mngon du bya ba yis/ /de yi grunalas gang sgrub par rnus/ /rig pa'i dbang gi cho ga'o/ /de ltar de nas byas nas su/ /phyis ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i rim/ /bya ba yi ni cho ga yis/ /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor yang dag bstan/ /de nas bdag po rnal 'byor gyi/ /nga rgyal dag rgo byas nas su/ /slob ma'i gtso bo gus pa yi④/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i cho ga 'dis/ /de nas dbang bskur don du ni/ /rang nyid kyis ni gsol ba gdab/ /de nas rang nyid langs nas su/ /slob ma pad zla la gnas bsam/ /de nas rang lha'i bsam gtan kyis/ /byen byus brlab 3pa la sogs byas67/ /de bzhin chu la sogs pa'i dbang / /mkhas pa yis ni sngar bzhin bya/ /'dir ni ji lta'i khyad par gyis/ /gtso bo rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu/ /de yi sngags brjod sngon song bas / /'di ni rgyun mi 'chad dbang bskur/ /ji srid rnam rgyal la sogs pas/ /slob dpon he ru ka 3grub pas/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca zhes/ sngags 'di rang gis brjod par bya/ /shes rab can gyis de yi mgor/ /he ru ka ⑤ldan cod pan ni—/ /rdo rje phreng ba rnams bsams te/ /sngar bzhin du ni de dbang bskur/ /de nas khro bo rdo rje sbyin/ /rdo rje dbang bskur zhes su brjod/ /gang zhig rgyud gzhan du grags 6pa/ /blo dang ldan pas de nyid brjod/ /rtag tu 'dod chags las byung khro/ /rdo rje me yi phung po'i sku/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje sbyor ba che/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun 'bar ba'o/ /byāḥbadag po'i dbang bskur byin nas su/ /dril bu'i 11—1311

sgra ni bsgrag ①par bya/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes ②sogs/ /de nas chos 'di rab bstan bya/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' ①la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad mchog nyid bsgrub ④par bya/ /tī yang na srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' nibu/ /srid pa mchog tu byed par 'gyur/ /de nas ming gi dbang bskur ba'i/ /de bzhin cho ga sbyin byas na⑦—/ /rig dang lhan cig tu gzhag duste/ /sdug bsngal mang po dag pa'i ⑨phyir/ /nyams myong bde ba sla bar rtogs/ /shin tu bde ba rtogs pa'i thabs/ /'di ni dam tshig bde legs te/ /ji ltar yid la 'dod pa yang ⑩/ /'dod pa kun la nyer longs spyod/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar spyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /ji srid 'khor bar gnas bar dutshoste/ /dpa' bo mchog tu gyur pa ste/ /de srid sems can dpag med don/ /mi ldog par ni nus par gyis/ /gsang mchog dam tshig gi ni thabs/ /bsod nams byin rlabs sgrub pa dang / /dngos grub kyi ni dbang phyug 'grub/ /sems can don ni brtan par byed/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig brjod bya ste/ /yid kyi sku ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /gang gis thams cad skur bstan pa/ /de yi phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /de nas de bzhin nyid ⑫'dug la/ /slob ma rig dang yang dag ldan/ /yid dang rjes mthun zas sogs dang / /sna tshogs btung ba 'thungs nas su/ /kha ni ga bur dris bsgo ebya—/ /lus ni dri zhim byug byas te/ /phan tshun dgod dang sgeg la sogs/ /dga' ba'i rol pa rnams byas nas/ /dbang nyid yang dag snyoms 'jug pas/ /de yis ⑫dga' bde yang dag 'char/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kun/ /11—1312

bkra shis glu la sogs pa yis/ /de dag yang dag bskul bar ni/ /bdag gis rnam par bsam ①bya ste/ /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya/ /de ltar brjod nas slob ma'i khar/ /rdo rje nas lhung bdag gnas so —/ /a ho su kha /0zhes kyang brjod/ /des kyang gang zhig bkug pa rnams/ /rdo rje ye shes byung don de/ /shin tu gsang ba chen po'i don/ /dbang bskur ba ni ngo mtshar che/ /rdo rje dril bu yi ni sgra/ /mchog tu dga' ba skyed byed pas/ /de nyid 'dir ni brjod pa yis/ /dbang bskur rang gis sbyin par bya/ /gang de dga' ba'i rang bzhin la④/ /bde byed de yang btags dupa tsam/ /gang zhig chags bral rgyu'am gnyis3)/ /yang ni srid pa'i rtse mo'i rgyu/ /gang ni yid kyis cung zhig brtags2/ /yid kyis spangs pa'i ngo bo'i phyir/ /rnam par mi rtog ⑨mya ngan 'dasabla/ /gzhan du kha cig gnas yul med⑪/ /'di yi de nyid mi shes pa'i—/ /slob ma la ni bshad mi bya/ /blo ldan rtog ⑫pa med pa la/ /'di ni shin tu gsang ba sbyin/ /de nas de nyid la gnas pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams yang dag mchod/ /mnyam par gzhag skepas sngon bzhin du/ /rdo rje dril bu de nas sbyin—/ /de nas brtsams nas rnal 'byor pa/ /rgyud kun las ni gsungs pa ni/ /ma lus lus pa med pa yi④/ /cho ga yis ni dkyil 'khor bri/ /ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa yi/ /rang 'dod lha yi 'jug pa nyid/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ni/ /ji ltar dmigs ⑫pa'i yid kyis su/ /ji ltar nus pa bzhin du bsgrub⑫//phran tshegs la sogs pa yi las/ /de yi dngos grub sgrub pa la/ /rang dang gzhan grags the tshom med/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur ba'o/ /de ltar 11—1313

rdzogs pa'i slob ma la/ /rjes su gnas pa'i dbang bstan bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni phyi rol du/ /khru gnyis dor bar dkyil 'khor bya/ /phyogs kun du ni gru bzhi pa—/ /phyogs kun dra bas brgyan pa ni/ /bya ba kun byed phyogs gcig bya/ /de yi dkyil du pad+ma ni/ /sna tshogs 'dab ma zi bar bya/ /rdo rje drag dpal gzugs su ni/ /'jam pa'i stan la yang dag gnas/ /de ring pad+ma'i stan la ni/ /mnyam par gzhag pa bsgom par bya/ /de nas slob ma gus can gyis/ /yon gyi mchog ni dbul bar bya/ /rig ma mdzes pa dbul bya ste/ /de dang lhan byung byang chub sems/ /mkha' 'gro la sogs rab gtum rnams/ /de dang lhan cig mchod par bya/ /dbang gnyis snyoms par 'jug pa yis/ /slob dpon phyag khya gsol ba ①gdab/ /bdag nyid rdo rje can zhes pa/ /byang chub sems ni sgom 2 byed pa'i/ /dbang bskur don du gsol ba 'debs/ /slob dpon go 'phang ngo mtshar che/ /skal ba chen po bdag la sprulaske/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba—/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub dze+epa/ /gang zhig bdag gis sems can kun—/ /rnyog med don ni bdag gis bgyi/ /sangs rgyas kun gye don byas pa/ /khyod kyis ⑤legs dri brtul zhugs kyis/ /de nas yang ni slob ma la/ /blo ldan 'di ltar gsol ba gdab/ /slob dpon dag gis langs nas su/ /rim 'dis dbang bskur brtag bupa yin/ /slob ma rang lha'i rnam pa ru/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin bskyed bya ste/ /gnas gsum yig 'bru byen brlabs nas/ /pad+ma la gnas bsam par bya/ /slob dpon dpa' bo nus ldan pas/ /de yi dbang bskur grub pa'i phyir/ /sngar bsnyen pa yi gsang sngags sam/ /de bzhin yi ge gsum gyis ④ni/ /sngags pas yungs kar dkar po la/ /lan cig bsngags te 11—1314

brjod pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor la ①ni gtor zhing brdeg /de las ②rang nyid lha yis ni/ /bkra shis glu yi sngags ni brjod/ /langs la rig dang bcas pa yig/ /bum pa'i chu yis dag byed cing / /de nas bla med dbang bskur bya/ /med na bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i/ /bum pa la ni de bzhin brdeg /rgyal ba dag gis gsungs pa ltar/ /rang nyid kyis ni dbang bskur bya/ /gal te nus pa med gyur na—/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rgyal mtshan dang / /gling bu pi wang rnga rnams dang / /④rin chen rgyan gyi ⑤mchod pa rnams/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag ldan/ /nam mkha' gang bar bsgom bupar bya/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /'dod chags chen po zhu ba yi⑦/ /de ltar bum pa'i bdud rtsi lngas/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams la sogs pa/ /bdag nyid yongs su bskor bsams te du/ /rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu yis ni/ /bkra shis glu dang bcas pa yis/ /slob ma 'di ni dbang bsgur zhing / /slob ma la ni 'di brjod bya/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra sa twa a bhi ṣe kai ṣa twa mā bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ gemi sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi pa ti dz+wa dṛ ⑫phyo me bha ba sebye na ma ste/ bha ga bān (nyem hā badz+ra dha ra su ra ta hūṃ ma hā badz+ra satwa/ oṃ oṃhūṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca zhes bya'o—/ /gzhan yang mkha' 'gro dpa' bo yi/ /dbang ni de ltar bskur bzhin par—/ /rjes su mthun par bsams ⑫nas ni/ /dbang bskur bar ni 'dod pa yin—/ /'dir ni bkra shis tshigs bcad ni/ /med pa'i phyir na rgyud gzhan las—/ /rjes su mthun pa yang dag blangs/ /mkhas pa yis ni cho ga bya/ /de nas dbu rgyan dar dbe+engs sogs/ /gsang ba'i mthar thug dang ldan pa'i/ /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur ba'i/ /de ltar cho ga ⑫yis ni sbyin/ /de nas stan la bzhag ⑫nas su/ /phra zhing snyan tshig 'di brjod do/ /'di ni khyod kyis 11—1315

gzung ①ba mchog /rtag tu khyod kyis brtan par bya/ /sngags pa rang gis ④byin brlabs pa'i/ /slob ma la ni phyag rgya gtad/ /de ltar slob ma dbang bskur zhu ba—/ /slob ma yon tan gtso bor 'gyur/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo kun gyi/ /'di ni slob dpon du ni 'gyur/ /deng dhinas brtsams te de yi ni/ /gsang ba mchog gi bshad par bya/ /rgyud kun du ni gang cung zad/ /sbas shing bris pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /de nas stan la rab 'jug go/ /phyi nang ⑤gsang sogs mchod pa yis/ /mchod pa yang dag mchod nas su/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ /de ltar yang dag rim pas mchod/ /de nas nga rgyal me long ni/ /ji bzhin bstan pa 'di bzhin brjod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /srid pa'i mtsho las mngon par rgal4)/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /khyod kyis sems can rnams la shod/ /sgra yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis/ /de ltar pi wang sgra brjod bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi—/ /sgra yi rjes su 'gro ba yi/ /shes rab mngon du rtogs gyur cig /gang gis 'jig rten thams cad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /kun du sgra brnyan lta bu yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi/ /dri yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis—/ /snying gar dri bsku ⑦'di skad brjod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyirka/ /skye med lhag par mos gyur cig /gang gis sangs rgyas zhing kun kyi/ /'jig rten pa ni kun gyis kyang / /rang gi ⑧lus las bla med pa'i/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dri bro shog /ro yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i bdud rtsi lnga/ /yang dag goms ⑨par bya ba'i phyir/ /tshig gis 'di skad brjod par bya—/ /ro kun rang bzhin med pa'i ror/ /rnam pa ⑫mngon du rtogs gyur cig /11—1316

gang gis ①sangs rgyas byang sems kun/ /sems can du gyur thams cad la/ /lha rdzas dpe med ro yi mchog /sprul la dbul bar bgyid par shog /reg pa'i nga rgyal ldan pa yis/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rnal 'byor brtson/ /rang rig reg bya mngon byas nas/ /reg bya'i de nyid brjod par bya/ /khyed kyis reg bya mi dmigs par/ /lhag par mngon du rtogs gyur cig /khyod kyis reg pa 'ba' zhig gi② /khyad par rang gi ①rnam rtog byung / /sna tshogs bla na med pa yi/ /reg bya'i khyad par mngon rtogs shog /rang gi sems ni yongs gyur pa'i/ /lha rnams dag ni thams cad dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sogs/ /yang dag 'byor pa reg bya yi/ /bde ba dag ni 'byor par shog /de ltar mchod pa byas nas su/ /gser gyi thur ma la sogs la/ /yang ni sngags 'di yis ni bsngags④/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe ⑤tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lo byā⑫zhes so/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'dug pa la yang 'di skad brjod/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis⑦/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /ling thog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /de nas slob ma'i mig la ni/ /mig sman bskus chapa'i tshul bya ste/ /sngags pas me long bstan byas la/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid brjod par bya/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung ⑨du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /rang bzhin med cing brjod du med/ /de ltar chos 'di shes bya ste/ /sems can don ni bla med kyis| /skyob pa yi ni rigs skyes so/ /de nas sarba ta thā ga ta a ⑩nu rā ga ya swa zhes brjod do/ /ho yis mda' gzhu sbyin par bya/ /de nas de yis gzhan yang 11—1317

ni/ /de bzhin phyogs bzhir mda' bzhi 'phang / /steng du gcig dang 'og tu ni—/ /mnyam par gzhag pas 'phang bar bya/ /badz+ra satwa phywa①brjod nas/ /de nas me long sbyin par bya/ /rnal 'byor lhur len slob dpon gyis/ /de la de nyid 'di ltar brjod/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ①rang bzhin nyid/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la gnas/ /hūṃ gis chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /de mdun de yi steng du gzhag /cha 1dang ldan pas logs ④g.yas su/ /dung sbyin nas ni 'di skad brjod/ /deng nas brtsams nas 'jig rten du/ /skyob pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /'khor lo bla na med pa bskor/ /dri med 'khor los dgang bar bgyi/ /the tshom med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'di la ⑤yid gnyis med par mdzod/ /chos kyi tshul mchog spyod pa ni/ /mtshungs med kun du bstan par kyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams la byas gzo ka )bar/ /'dug pa nyid du brjod pa yin/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang kun gyis/ /khyod ni bsrung bar rtag tu gnas/ /de nas de bzhin gzhan nyid kyisde/ /blo ldan dam tshig mnyan ⑧par gyis/ /thabs dang shes rab sems kyis naphyo/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /dogs pa med par rtag ⑩byed pa/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spyod—/ /ji lta ji ltar sems can kun/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de lta de ltar sems can don/ /'dod chags sogs kyis dag par byake/)/ /gang yang dam tshig la sdang ba/ /skye bo dam tshig nyams pa dag /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba yis/ /'bad pa yis ni gsad ⑫par bya/ /sems can kun la phan don du—/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sbyor ba yis/ /pha rol sems ni 'phrogs khye—gyur kyang —/ /sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags lta bu bde med pas/ /11byed1318

de ni skye 'gro la rtag sbyin/ /sems can don du gzhan bud med/ /bsten pa las ni bsod nams 'thob/ /sangs rgyas la sogs smod pa la/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rnal 'byor gyis/ /tshig rtsub sbyor ba byas na ①ni/ /bla na med pa'i dngos grub med/ /'od dpag med pa'i brdzun tshig smra/ /don yod grub pa'i nying 'dzin mchog /rgyud gsungs cho ga blo ldan gyis/ /dam tshig dag pa bsten par bya/ /de nas he ru ka dpal zhes/ /sogs pa yang ni rang gis bstod/ /thal mo sbyar nas phyag byas la/ /yang ni slob ma nyid la brjod/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /sems can kun la thams cad du/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje chos 'khor bskor bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal bas rgyal/ /kun gyi bdag po zhes bya ba'i/ /rdo rje 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /zhes pas rjes su gnang ba yin②/ /dbang bskur ba yi cho ga'o/ /de ltar byas nas de rjes su/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du ni zhugs/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni bltas nas su/ /sngags kyis bskyul ba brjod par bya/ /ting 'dzin gsang sngags rgyal po cha ga/ /gsang ba sbyin pa bsam bya ste/ /rgyud 'dir brjod pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bza' bar bya/ /de nas 'di ltar byung ba dang //sangs rgyas kun bdag rnal 'byor brtson/ /rdo rje ming ni dbang bskur ba'i/ /de bzhin gshegs par lung bstan bya/ /de 'dir rim pa zhes bya ste/ /rdo rje drag dpal gzugs su ni/ /de bzhin slob ma nyid kyang gnas/ /rang ni bdag po rnal 'byor ldan/ /lag pa g.yon pa chos gos ni/ /de bzhin 'dzin pa yi ni tshul—/ /mchog sbyin pa yi tshul gyis gnas④ / /mnyam par gzhag pas 'di skad brjod/ /nga yis deng khyod lung bstan yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin 11—1319

gshegs/ /ngan 'gro srid pa dag las bton/ /srid pa shin tu dag ①phyir ro/ /kye dpal rdo rje che ge mo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad grub/ /sa ma ya ste zhes pa'o/ /phyag rgya chen po 'di dang ni/ /gang gis cho ga 'di yis ni/ /lung bstan par ni byas pa gang / /te ru ka la sogs pa ①dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dkyil 'khor gyi ①ni 'khor gnas pa'i/ /dam tshig spyod pas mgrin gcig gis/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub brtan zung dubastan/ /gsang chen mchog gi dhidam pa yi/ /'di ltar phyag rgya chen po yis/ /'di tha byin rmi rlabs ④dang ni/ /stobs nyid dag ni 'di dag la/ /④de ltar brjod nas de rjes su/ /yang dag dbugs dbyung sbyin par bya/ /gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mthong ba dang ni zhugs pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /de ring khyod ni legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi mtshungs pa dang mi shes rjopar/ /'jigs pa med par dga' bar rol/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu dag phyir ro/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa ⑨ni/ /khyod kyis 'dir ni rtag tu bzung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin brjod/ /bka' 'di rtag pa mchog yin no/ /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya gang / /byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /dam pa'i chos ni mi spong zhing / /nam yang gtang ⑩bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis—/ /de yis nongs na bshags par bya/ /rang gi bdag nyid mi spang ⑩zhing / /dka' thub kyis ni gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bas bde ba gzung ⑫/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang gtang ⑫11—1320

bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /gang zhig slob dpon spyod pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun la smad pas na/ /'di yis rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug dang / /mkha' 'gro gza' yi 'tshe ba dang / /bgegs dang log 'dren drag po yis/ /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar skye /de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon bla ma che/ /dge ba rab tu mi spyoms ①pa/ /nam du yang ni mi smad do—/ /bla ma la ni rjes mthun yon/ /gus dang bcas pas dbul bar bya/ /de nas rims sogs gnod pa rnams/ /slar yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rang gi dam tshig slob dpon ni/ /rang srog gis kyang brten bya na/ /sbyin min bu dang chung ma dang / //longs spyod g.yo ba smos ci dgos/ /bskal ba bye ba du mar ni—/ /grangs med par yang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang brtson ldan la—/ /tshe 'di nyid la ster bar byed②/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung / /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ /de byin ④sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de las bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /de ring bdag skyes 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring bdag ni legs par gnas/ /lha dang dam tshig mnyam pa ru/ /gyur par bdag ni je tshom med/ /tshe ldan de ring dbang bskur bas/ /rdo rje 'chang bcas sangs rgyas kun/ /khams gsum gye rjoni rgyal srid che/ /bdag po rgyal por gnas pa'o/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yis—/ /de ring bdud las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de ring sangs rgyas nyid thob par—/ /khyod ni the tshom med pa yin/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad par 'gyur thar 11—1321

ba ni/ /bsten bya yid kyi drin gyis ①rdo rje skye bar gyis/ /shin tu skye sla'i bde ba sangs rgyas kun gzugs sku/ /rtag pa de ni khyod kyis rtogs ④par rab gyur cig /ces bya'o/ /bla ma yi ni zhabs gnyis la/ /slob ma yis ni phyag btsal te/ /ji ltar gsungs pa la sogs kun/ /rjes su bgyid ces bdag ④gis brjod/ /de ltar dam bcas byas pa yi/ /slob ma la ni phan nyid dang / /sngar brjod pa yi ④rim pa yis/ /rdo rje dril bu brtul zhugs sbyin/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi—/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khrod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga dhita sernyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha eṣa ste dha bur yā mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi nyi hūṃ zhes bya'o/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /'di brjod pas ni ⑦dril bu sbyin/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi garjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bsrung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /de nas sgos dang me tog sogs/ /bkra shis spyod pas brgyan byas te/ /mgo bor gdugs ni bzung nas su/ /de nas bla ma rang nyid kyis/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yi/ /slob ma de la skor byed gzhug /sngags pas 'di lta ru ni brjod/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyis bskor ba yis—/ /mnga' bdag mdog sngon rgyal gyur cig /dmar pos ji ltar mdzes ⑨ gyur byug /dam tshig gis brgyan zhes pa rgyal gyur cig /zla phyed mgo bor brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /lha mo'i 'khor los brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /dang po sangs rgyas sku mchog gnas pa rgyal gyur cig /'dod dang thar pa nor dang chos sbyin rgyal gyur cig /rnam pa lnga la dga' rol rang sbyin rgyal gyur cig /phyag na rdo rje bde ba'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig /de nas sgo yi mdun du ni/ /gdugs 11—1322

dang bcas pas phyag bya'o/ /slob ma la ni 'di brjod bya/ /slob ma rgyud 'dzin por 'gyur ro/ /de ltar brjod nas de yi tshe/ /slob dpon lag gis gdugs bsal ①nas/ /slob ma de nyid bslang nas su/ /de nang 'di ni nyan du gzhug /de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon dang / /sngags dang rgyud ni khyod kyis zung ①/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par 'dod//khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /'bad pa yis ①ni bri byas la/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /de la bu khyod kyis bya bas/ /dka' las chen po byung gyur kyang / /sems can rnams la mi phan pa'i/ /bya kun ser sna mi bya'o④/ /zhi ba'i don du mkhas pa yis/ /sbyin sreg gi ni cho ga bya/ /de nas sbyin sreg rdzogs nas su/ /bla ma yis ni yon blangs te/ /gser dang dngul dang rin chen sogs/ /rta dang glang po rgyal srid do/ /slob mas kyang ni de rjes su/ /bcom ldan dam tshig nyid kyis ni/ /he ru ka dpal shes rab che/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sdom/ /zhes bya sems la rjes gnang nas/ /bskor spyob lan gsum byas nas su/ /lus kun yan lag gdugs bubyas te/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyag bya'o—/ /bdag rang bla ma la phul nas/ /mchod pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /ji srid bla ma dgyes par du/ /de srid bla ma mnyes par bya/ /gang gang cung zhig yid 'ong ba/ /shin tu khyad par can de nyid/ /de nyid mi zad 'dod pa yis/ /de dang de ni bla mar dbul/ /gang gis shin tu gtang ⑦dka' ba/ /de byen dpag med yin par 'dod/ /de ltar gang zhig dbang bskur ba/ /de ni slob dpon yin par brjod/ /de la gsang sngags byen pa yis/ /dngos grub 'dir ni the tshom med/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs/ /rdo rje'i glu ni brjod par bya/ /11—1323

rdo rje gar gyi spyor ba yis/ /sgeg mo sogs kyis mchod par bya/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas kyang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab mchod de/ /ci bde bar ni slob ma kun/ /mchod pa byas nas mkhyen par gsol/ /ji ltar rang gi 'dod pa yis—/ /spos la sogs pa mchod par bya/ /ji ltar 'byor par 'gyur ①ba yis/ /zhugs pa'i slob mas bza' bca' dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs ro dang zas/ /bzi bar nus pa'i chang dang ni/ /gang zhig rgyud gzhan grags pa yig/ /glu dang sgra yi mchod pa rnams/ /mchod pa'i sgra ni dbul bar bya/ /bla ma yang dag bde bar mchod/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pa ni/ /chang bcas chang min btung ba dang / /ji ltar 'dod pas longs spyod par/ /ji bzhin rim pas bsgom par bya de nyid gsang ba'i glu chen po/ /bde ba'i sgra dang gar kyang bya/ /dga' ba'i rol pa sna tshogs kyis/ /gtso bo la sogs kun mchod nas/ /de nas mang po bsam bya zhing / /sngar bzhin du ni brjod par bya/ /kun la dam tshig byin nas ni/ /ji ltar dgar 'os der ni gtang ①/ /de nas phyi rol mchod pa dang / /yid kyis mchod pa gtso bo ni/ /sngags pa gus pa yis ni mchod/ /yang ni nyi ma shar dus su/ /he ru ka dpal ye shes che/ /zhes bya la sogs tshig gis ni/ /ji ltar yang dag bstod nas phyis/ /rgyal ba rnams la mkhyen par gsol/ /so so skye bor gyur gang dang / /rnal 'byor ma thob gang gis dang / /nye dang ④mkho ba med pa dang —/ /brjed dang shes bzhin ma yin pas/ /cung zhig cho ga nyer ma tshang / /de dag bkru zhing bzod par 'os/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas ni/ /de nas 'dis ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar 11—1324

yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ masahūṃ badz+ra muḥ de nas tshogs pa rtogs byas la/ /ye shes kyi ni dkyil 'khor gtso/ /zhal ni dgod cing sim ②pa yis/ /slob dpon slob ma'i yon tan brjod/ /rang gi 'od kyis sems can kun/ /rang rang phyogs su bton ①nas su/ /de bzhin ji ltar 'dod pa yi④/ /rang gi 'od kyis gsal bar bsam/ /de nas ji ltar spros pa 'i / /gus pas lha yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /rang gi lus la gzhug par bya/ /de nas mkhas pas phur bu gdon/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya sarba bisnran dhibadz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ④bya'o/ /de la byin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon cha/ /de la spos la sogs pa yis/ /yang ni yang dag mchod nas ni/ /blo ldan gyis ni gshegs su gsol/ /a ka 7kā ro mu khaṃ la sogs pa/ /brjod nas de don mngon du bya/ /mnyam par gzhag pas ⑨mi dmigs bya/ /gtso bo rang gi snying gar gnas/ /mchod nas de bzhin bstod byas la/ /de nas rnal 'byor nye bar bsdu/ /tshon rtsi chu bo'am rgya mtsho'am/ /de nyid du ni dor bar bya/ /de nas sa ni yang dag par/ /ba yi lci bas byugs byas te/ /bdag dang slob ma de bzhin sogs/ /phan pa'i phyir ni sbyin sreg bya/ /de nas yang skeni sngags pas kyang / /de bzhin du ni phur bu gdon/ /legs par khrus ni byas nas su/ /bdag med par ni bsgom par bya/ /de nas phyis ni slob dpon gyis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni yo byad kun/ /rang nyid kyis ni longs spyod bya/ /slob ma la ni mi bgo'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni yo byad kun/ /slob dpon gyi ni rig pa yin//dam tshig can gang slong gyur na/ /slob ma la ni cung zhig sbyin/ /rgyud gang la ni sngon gyi slob dpon gyis/ /'khor lo rgyas pa ru ni ma byas sems/ /des na de la 11—1325

bdag sems zhugs gyur pas/ /lhag dang chad don mkhas pa rnams kyis shes/ /blo ni dman yang gus par gyur pa yis/ /'di dag mdzes par rab tu byas pa yin / /rang gi yul la skyon dang yon tan ni1 / /mi bya dad pa yis ni phye ba yin / /'dir ni mchog gi khur chen dpa' bo dang / /yang ni dpa' bo rnams kyi dpa' bo yang / /de phyir legs bstan dam tshig bcas pa yibye/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bdag la bzod par 'os/ /don dang gzhung 'di mdzes par byas 'di yis/ /bsod nams kyis ni 'gro ba rnams la ni/ /yun ring 'jigs pa med par dga' ba dang / /bdag gzhan bde ba mchog ni skyed gyur cig /de nyid gsal skye rmongs pa rab 'joms shing / /mchog tu mi 'jigs ster ba'i mnga' bdag shog /nor ni ma lus skyed thupa'i gzhi/ /skyes pa'i sa ni lang ka ste / /rgyal ba'i zhabs kyis byas pa la/ /mtha' ni bzang po'i ming gsal byas/ /nyon mongs tshogs ni spangs pa yi/ /legs par brtan ༄5pa'i blo gros kyis/ /yon tan tshogs ni rjes rtogs pas/ /rdzogs par byas kyis bsam par gyis/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga tshigs su bcad pa dgu brgya pa slob dpon rgyal ba bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dpal dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'u// //11—1326

ldu sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī te ru ka sā dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal he ru ka'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das sdud cing / /srid dang mya ngan 'das la bzhugs/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los /3sgyur/ /dpa' bo rmad byung che la 'dud/ /lte ba'i dbus las byung zhing phra/ /chos dang longs spyod sdogs la gnas/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyang sdud mdzad mo/ /gtum mo de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /yang dag rtogs pa'i gnas min zhing / /mkhas pa yis kyang rnyed dka'oce/ /gang gis drin gyis rnyed slar gyur/ /bla ma'i zhal snga rgyal gyur cig /skal ldan sems can don bsgrub phyir/ /man ngag cung zad la brten te/ /dpal ldan (snyehe ru ka yi ni/ /sgrub thabs de ni bdag gis bya/ /dur khrod dag gam chu ngogs sam/ /yang na dgon pa chen por ni/ /he ru kar 11—1335

grags thugs rje che/ /sgrub pa'i dbang pos mnyes par bya/ /langs nas dang por snying ga yi/ /pad+ma ①zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de yi dbus su yi ge ni/ /thugs las byung ba rnam par bsgom/ /de yi lus ngag yid kyis ①ni/ /chos rnams stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /'od kyis bla ma rang lha dang / /sangs rgyas rnams ni rang snang bya/ /nam mkha' khyab par bsams nas ni/ /mchod pa'i lha mo yang dag spro/ /de yis legs par mnyes byas la/ /gus pas pus mo gnyis btsugs te/ /dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa yi/ /tshigs bcad gsum ni lan gsum brjod/ /de rjes byams dang snying rje dang / /dga' ba btang snyoms bsgom ①par bya/ /gang phyir gnyid log sad pa yi/ /bye brag gsal bar mi dmigs pas/ /de phyir sems kyi rnam 'phrul ni/ /'di dag thams cad log pa yin—/ /gcig dang du mas rnam dpyad na/ /phyi yi dngos po dmigs mi 'gyur/ /'di dag sems kyi gzugs su 'ang min/ /de bas 'gro 'di stong pa yin/ /rgyu dang mi rgyur bcas pa ni/ /skye ba'i chos dang rnam bral zhing / /sos ka'i nyi ma phyed dus kyidhi/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bur bsam/ /sems 'di brtan par byed pa yi/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃswa bhā wa shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shustophohaṃ/ wīshā n+ya tā sarba dharmāsaswa bhā ba shurnyophohaṃ/ de nas paṃ byung pad+ma dang —/ /re las byung ba nyi dkyil du/ /hūṃ las khro bo'i rdo rje ni/ /spro ba'i bdag nyid can gyis bsam/ /oṃsum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ hūṃ buphaṭa/ wīgreṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa hūṃ hūṃ ⑦phaṭa/ oṃkṛsnra pa ya kṛ: pa ya hūṃ hūṃ ⑧phaṭa/ oṃphywaṣ+pe ⑨ya hoḥbha ga wān ⑩badz+ra bit+yā rā dzā ya ⑪hūṃ phaṭa/ 'dis ni gdug pa bkug nas kyang / /'og nas bshad pas phur bus gdab/ /oṃ lha gha ⑫ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duspya phaṭa tī la ya tī la ya 11—1336

sarba pā paṃ phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra tī la a ①ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bus gdab cing brdung ba yis④/ /de yis glags skabs mi rnyed phyir/ /rdo rje dra ba bsam par bya—/ /de yi nang du chos dbyings ni/ /bha ga'i dbyings su rnam par bsam/ /rlung dang me chu sa rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni bsam par bya/ /de rnams steng du ri rab ste/ /de yi steng du hūṃ byung bsam/ /rlung sogs yongs su gyur pa las / /gzhal yas khang ni nyid gyur pa/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed chun 'phyang dang / /me long la sogs rnams kyis brgyan/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma yis/ /mdzes byas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ //lte ba la ni 'jigs byed dang / /dus mtshan dag ni rab tu bsgom/ /phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi po la/ /ro ni gdan kyi gzugs can yin/ /'dab ma gzhan la bdud rtsis gang / /snod ni bum pa la gnas bsam/ /de ④rjes cho ga bzhin du ni/ /thugs gsung sku yi dbye ba yis/ /'khor lo gsum po rdo rje dang / /pad+ma 'khor los bskor bar bsam/ /gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du—/ /dur khrod rnam pa brgyad kyis brgyan/ /de yi ming dang mtshan nyid dang / /de bzhin lung gis bshad par bya/ /gtum drag gcig gi dbyengs ④can ni/ /gnyis pa tshang tshing gsum pa yin/ /'bar ba zhes bya bzhi pa ste/ /dmyal sogs zhes bya lnga pa yin/ /mi bzad pa dang ha har dgod/ /brgyad pa g.yer ka can du 'dod/ /dang po tshig par bshad bya ste/ /gnyis pa yang ni ma tshig par/ /gsum pa dum bur gyur pa yin/ /bzhi pa dum bur ma gyur ⑤pa'o/ /lnga pa 'jigs pa zhes bshad de du/ /drug pa 'jigs par byed pa yin/ /bdun pa 11—1337

mdung rtser bskyon pa ste/ /brgyad pa 'gegs ①pa zhes bya'o/ /pa ta li dang pusto li—/ /sā la'i shing dang shri ṣa dang / /u dusmra ⑧ra n+ya gro dha/ /a shwad nā ga ge sar shing / /khra dang byi la 'ug pa dang / /stag dang khyi dang bya rgod phag /sha za'i gdong bcas brgyad po ni/ /shing brgyad la ni yang dag gnas/ /khra dang ce spyang 'ug pa dang / /brtan po khyi dang srin po ①phab/ /ro langs khro bo'i dregs bdo ba/ /brgyad kyis dugatso bo yang dag bskor/ /sred dang sdang ba dag gi steng —/ /zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /phywali kā li gnyis las byung / /sems can zhu ba'i rang bzhin can/ /bsams ⑤nas nga rgyal tsam nyid kyis/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i bdag can bya/ /de nas gzhan don la yang 'bad/ /'dis gnas bya ba ma yin la/ /de ltar shes pa lha mo yis/ /bstod par gyur las yang dag byung / /hūṃ dpa' mo rol cig rol cig hortsi/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje khrod⑦/ /bde chen las byung ro nyid las/ /'di nyid du ni bzhengs su gsol/ /khrod ni bde ba chen po mchog /de bzhin dgyes pa'i bde ba yis/ /bdag kyang de ltar gsol bar mdzod/ /bcom ldan bde chen dgyes pa ho/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' legs dgyes khyod/ /ro dang ro mchog thams cad kyis⑧/ /dgyes pa chen po'i bde rnams la/ /bsgrub bya kun la rtag par yang / /rol cig rol cig dgyes kun la/ /rnal 'byor ma kun dgyes mdzad do/ /bcom ldan rdo rje pad+ma hūṃ—/ /a la la ho/ /bcom ldan 'dod pas legs dgyes khyod/ /chags nang nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma a la la ho/ /rdo rje mchog ni ⑨'dzin pa yis—/ /bde 'byung dra ⑩ba'i rtag pa yang / /pad+ma mchog gi kha 'byed cing / /pad+ma'i dgyes pas slad nas rol/ /rdo rje mchog 'chang da ltar yang / /ngo mtshar 11—1338

bde ba 'di nyid mthong / /shin tu bde ba'i grub pa nyid/ /ji ltar da ltar bsdu bar mdzod/ /byang chub tshogs dang bcas pa dag /da ltar thob mdzad a la la ho—/ /bde chen rol pa dam pa bsgrubs/ /glu 'di yi ni ngor mdzad pas/ /sems can don mdzad par bskyod de/ /baṃ hūṃ gnyis las ①gri gug dang / /rdo rje ltar spros bdag nyid can/ /bsgoms te thams cad yongs gyur las/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal 'gyur/ /sku mdog gnag cing zhal bzhir ldan/ /dbu skra 'bar zhing gyen du badze+es/ /spyan gsum mnga' zhing smin ma ser/ /dbu la thod pa zla bas brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba lnga bcu mnga'/ /sku la thal ba'i rdul gyis bsgos⑤/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku brgyan zhing ①/ /g.yas brkyang pa la gnas pas bzhugs/ /mche ba cung zad gcigs pa dang / /gar gyi nyams ni dgu dang ldan/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba mkhas pa'i phyir/ /lha chen ma hā'i steng na bzhugs/ /gnag dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /zhal bzhi g.yon nas bskor ba mnga'/ /phyag ni bcu gnyis dang ldan zhing / /phag mo yis ni mgul nas 'khyud/ /rdo rje g.yas dang dril bu g.yon/ /phyag gis kun nas 'khyud mdzad pa/ /phyag gnyis brkyang bas glang chen lpags/ /ḍa ma ru dang dgra sta dang / /gri gug de bzhin rtse gsum 'phyar/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis 'dzin par mdzad/ /kha ṭī ga dang pad+ma'i sgod—/ /zhags pa de bzhin tshangs pa'i mgo /g.yon na bsnams shing mgon po niske/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i tshul 'dzin bzhugs/ /rdo rje phag mo zhal gcig dang —/ /spyan gsum ldan pas kun du 'khyud/ /yan lag phyag rgya drug gis brgyan/ /thod dum 'og pags dag gis ④ bzhugs/ /byin pa gnyis kyis legs 'khyud cing / /bde ba chen po'i gnas kyis bzhugs/ /chags pa chen po'i 'od 11—1339

dmar bar/ /rang snang ba yang yang dag byung / /nu rgyas rked dbus phra ba dang //sku smad cha ni rab zheng che/ /dbu skra gnag cing spyan mjos pa⑫/ /sgeg pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa yin/ /g.yas kyis gdug la sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /gri gug rdo rjes mtshan pa dang / /g.yon pa'i phyag gis gdug pa yi / /bdud sogs khrag can thod pa bsnams/ /mi bzad bskal ba'i me 'dra zhing / /khrag 'dzag pa la rnam par dgyes/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma—/ /phyogs kyi pad+mar gtso bo yi/ /zhal dang rjes su mthun par bsam /'dab ma gzhan la cho ga bzhin/ /bshad pa'i snod ni bzhi pa'o/ /'di rnams phyag g.yas gri gug ste/ /g.yon na bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i/ /thod pa nyid dang kha ṭī ga /sku gsung thugs rnams dag rtsol rnams/ /de yi phyi rol thugs 'khor lo—/ /rdo rje phreng ba nag pos bskor/ /phyogs mtshams cha ni brgyad po ru/ /rab gtum mo sogs mkha' grub sprul/ /de'i rgyab gsung gi 'khor lo ni/ /pad+ma dmar po sogs brgyan par/ /sa srung ①mo sogs brgyad po bzhugs/ /de'i rgyab sku yi 'khor lo ni/ /'khor lo dkar po sogs brgyan par/ /'khor lo'i shugs sogs brgyad po bzhugs/ /'khor lo gsum gtogs rnal 'byor ma/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mdog 'drar 'gyur/ /zhal gcig spyan ni gsum pa la/ /rdo rje'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /lha mo gri gug thod pa bsnams/ /rnal 'byor ma ni phag mo 'dra/ /'di rnams thabs gyur dpa' bo ni/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i grangs yin la/ /kun kyang rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /mi mgo yi ni do shal can/ /mi bzad sku 'chang dbu skra mdzes2/ /mche ba cung zad gcigs pa ste/ /sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan/ /thod pa'i dum bus rnam 11—1340

brgyan zhing / /dar dang phreng bas rnam par klubs/ /te ru ka dpal bzhugs tshul ltar/ /g.yas brkyang pa yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi sku mdog ni/ /ci 'dra gdan yang de dang 'dra/ /khwa dang 'ug pa de bzhin khye/ /phag gdong rang gi ming bzhin no/ /sgo yi lha mo'i zhal dang ni/ /mdog sogs mkha' 'gro ma sogs mthun/ /gshin rje brtan ma gnag dang ljang / /gshin rje pho nya ljang dang dkar/ /de bzhin gshin rje mche ba can/ /dmar dang ser bar shes par bya/ /gzhan yang gshin rje 'joms ma ni/ /ser dang nag por rab tu bshad/ /dang po lha mo g.yon skor te/ /de bzhin gzhan dag g.yas skor yin/ /de lta bu yi 'khor lo che/ /bdag nyid dang ni bcas par bsgom/ /rab gtum ma dang gtum pa'i mig /'od ldan ma dang sna chen ma/ /dpa' bo'i blo ma mi'u thung ma/ /lang ka'i dbang phyug shing grib ma/ /sa srung ①ma dang 'jigs chen ma—/ /rlung gi shugs ma chang 'thung ma/ /sngo bsangs ma dang rab bzang ma/ /rta rna ma dang bya gdong ma/ /'khor lo shugs ma dum skyes ma/ /sna chen 'khor lo'i lam mo dang / /shin tu dpa' mo stobs chen ma/ /'khor los sgyur ④ba stobs chen ma/ /jod pa'i dum bu keng rus can/ /keng rus chen po mche ba gatshigs/ /chang dga' dgra ①ni 'od dpag med/ /rdo rje'i 'od dang rdo rje'i sku//myu gu rdo rje'i ral pa can/ /dpal chen rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang / /rab bzang dang ni rdo rje bzang / /'jigs byed chen mo mig mi bzang / /stobs chen rdo rje rin chen dang / /rta mgrin nam mkha'i snying po dang / /he ru ka dpal bdag rang dbang / /rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /mgo dang spyi gtsug rna ba g.yas/ /rgyab dang rna ba g.yon pa dang / /smin ma dbugs dang mig dang ni/ /de bzhin 11—1341

du ni dpung mgo gnyis/ /mchan khung gnyis dang nu ma gnyis/ /lte ba dang ni sna rtse gnyis/ /kha dang sgog mar rnam dgod cing / /snying ga dang ni mtshan nyid dang —/ /gsang gnas gzhang kha de bzhin brla/ /byin pa sor mo rnams dang ni/ /rkang mthil de bzhin mthe bo dang / /pus mo dag la rim bzhin gnas/ /pul+lī ra dang dzā lan dang ①/ /o ḍān de bzhin arngu dang dzu)/ /gtso bo'i gnas su gyur pa yin/ /nga yi sngar bshad bzhi po gzhan/ /mtshams su gnas par gyur pa yang //nye ba'i gnas kyi steng na bzhugs/ /go dā ba rīr gyur pa gcig① /rā me shwa rīr duganas gnyis pa/ /de dze+e ko ṭa mā ⑤la ber/ /lha mo gzhan gnyis gnas pa yin—/ /kā ma rū pa yosaṭir buni/ /zhing gi gtso mo gnyis gnas so/ /ko sa la tso 7tri sha ku ṣ+per sdebacas/ /nye ba'i zhing gtogs gzhan dag gnas/ /ka liṅga dang le bā ⑨ka /tshardo har bshad pa ru gzhan/ / kā: dang ni gangs ⑫/can du'ang / /nye ba'i tshardo har gtogs nas/ /kṛ ha de ba ta de bzhin/ /pre ta pu rir bcas par ni/ /'dus par gtogs pa gzhan gnas so/ /su bar+ṇa dī bar bcas pa'o/ /sau rāṣ+ṭa ni nye ba yi/ /'dus par bshad de gzhan dag gnas/ / na gar sin+tu'i ⑪yul dag ni/ /dur khrod yin te gnyis rtag gnas/ /ma ro nyid dang ku lu tā⑫/ /gang yang lha mo gzhan gnas der/ /nye ba'i dur khrod yin zhes bya—/ /des 'di sa yi dbang phyug ma/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po ni/ /'khor lo'i rnam par rtag tu bzhugs/ /thugs gsung sku yi dbye ba yis⑫/ /'jig rten gsum na rnam par grol/ /mjo ris sa bla sa 'og tu/ /skad cig gis ni sku gcig 'gyur/ /pu dzā snanga.a go rā de ma④/ /kā o tri ko ka la kā nyi/ /pre gra sau su rna ⑫se ma ku/ /gzugs ni rnam snang yin zhes bya/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi 11—1342

ma yin/ /'du shes pad+ma gar dbang phyug /'du byed rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam shes phung por gyur pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rtag tu bzhugs/ /he ru ka dpal mgon rang nyid/ /gsang ba mchog gis dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /'di ni dag par rab tu bshad/ /mig gnyis gti mug rdo rjer 'gyur/ /rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje 'dzin/ /sna ni phrag dog rdo rje ste/ /kha ni 'dod chags rdo rje 'dzin/ /reg pa ser sna rdo rje ste/ /yid ni rdo rje 'dzin dbang po/ /he ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du bzhugs/ /sa ni ltung byed ma zhes bya/ /gsod ma chu yi khams yin te/ /me ni 'gugs ma yin par bshad/ /gar dbang rlung du bshad pa yin/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnal 'byor ma/ /pad+ma'i dra ba yin par bshad/ /phung po khams dang skye mched kyi/ /dag pa yin par 'di bshad do/ /rdo rje gsum la yig gsum dgod/ /ye shes yi ge he badz+ra/ /mdzub mo mdud byas gung mo sbyar/ /mthe bo rdo rje brtan por sbyar/ /de ni dpral ba'i dbus bzhag nas/ /gcu ①zhing bskor bas bskor bar bya/ /rkang pa mnan cing steng du blta'o/ /gyen du phaṭa kyi sgra sgogs shing / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams 'gugs/ /phyag rgya 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /kun spyod cho ga las bshad de/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rnal 'byor pas②/ /'jig rten gsum yang bsgrub par byargya / /oṃ sarba bīr yo gi bhā ngukā ya bāka dziX badz+ra swa bhā ba a kopho⑤haṃ / oṃ badz+ra shudhaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyo3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shudheḥsarba dharmās yo ga shurnyophohaṃ/ oṃ ha dpal rdo rje sems dpa'/ /snying gar rnam par dgod par bya//na ma hi ni rnam snang mdzad/ /mgo bor gnas pa rnam par bsam/ /swā hā hu ni 11—1343

pad gar dbang / /spyi gtsug tu ni yongs su bsgom/ /bo ṣaṭa te ni phrag pa ru/ /dpal ldan he ru kar bsam bya/ /hūṃ hūṃ ho ni rdo rje nyi/ /mig tu rnam par dgod par bya/ /phaṭa haṃ yan lag thams cad du/ /mtshon char rta mchog rnam par bsam/ /dpa' bo thams cad 'di nyid kyis/ /yan lag drug ①gis rab tu dgod/ /oṃbaṃ rdo rje phag mo ni/ /lte ba'i phyogs su bsam par bya/ /haṃ oṃ ya mi ni snying gar/ /hri ②mo rmongs byed ma kha la/ / tre hri ①skyong byed ma spyi bo④/ /hūṃ hūṃ skrag byed ma spyi gtsug /phaṭa phaṭa yan lag kun mtshon char/ /gtum mo yongs su bsgom par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma ni thams cad kyi/ /cho ga 'di nyid yin par bshad/ /de nas dngos grub kun spyod ba'i/ /bde gshegs rnams la dbang bskur spyodarjo/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /de bzhin bdag gis lha yi chu/ /dag pa yis ni khrus bgyi'o/ /skasarba ta thā ga ta a nyi ṣe ka sa ma ya shi ye hūṃ/ rnal 'byor pa ni dbang bskur 'gyur/ /dpal ldan mi bskyod cod pan can/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od lcags kyus—/ /sangs rgyas bkug nas zhu tshul du/ /pad buganas ba spu'i bu ga las/ /mchod pa'i lha mor bdag cag spro/ /de nas rkang pa brgyad sngags kyis/ /dbye ba rnam par spangs te bstod/ /bdag nyid lha yi gzugs can te/ /chos kun de yi bdag nyid can/ /de nas rlung me pad+mar ni/ /rang 'byung dang ni gzhi ④mnyam dang —/ /gla rtsi dang ni ga pur dang / /rta mchog gis ni yang dag brgyan/ /hūṃ gis sgerdo rje dkar legs dpyad/ /a yis rab tu rtogs byas shing / /oṃ gyi 'od kyis 'bar gyur par/ /byen byis brlabs 1nas mngon par bza' rang lce pad+ma'i 'dab ma ru⑩/ /hūṃ byung rdo rje dkar po dgod/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can 11byed1344

gyi gzugs/ /'khor lo de yis rab tshim bya/ /'khor lo bzhir ni rab brtags pa/ /'khor lo ma lus kun dpyad bya/ /dpa' bo sa bon lce ru bsam/ /a wa dhū ① tī'i gnas de la/ /rkan gyi phyogs su lce sbyar la/ /byas nas rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom/ /rkan gyi phyogs su gyur lha mo/ /bzhi pa yi ni gsum pa la/ /brgyad pa'i dang po bcu drug pa/ /dang po'i 'og ma sa bon yin/ /man ngag dag ni 'di nyid kyis/ /spros pa med pa'i gnas rtogs 'gyur/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i gsang sngags ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bzlas par bya/ /mgon po'i snying po'am yang na ni/ /de yi nye ba'i snying po'am/ /lha mo'i snying po gnyis ka ni/ /ji srid mi skyo bar du bzlas/ /de nas rnal 'byor mas lha mo1 / /rnam pa byang chub phyogs su bsgom/ /lus dang tshor ba chos dang sems/ /dran pa nyer gzhag dngos las byung —/ /mkha' 'gro de bzhin khā ma dang / /dum skyes gzugs can ma rnams yin—/ /'dun dang brtson 'grus dpyod pa dang / /sems nyid bzhi par gyur pa ste—/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi po la2/ /rab gtum la sogs bzhir pe'agyur ro/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan/ /de las gzhan pa bzhi yin no/ /dbang po lnga po las 'dir ni/ /sa srung khrumar yang 'gyur ba yin/ /dad dang brtson 'grus de bzhin dran/ /ting 'dzin shes rab bcas pa yi/ /stobs lnga yi 'uni gsung can gyi/ /rnal 'byor pa ni lnga ru 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin brtson 'grus yang dag dga'/ /shin tu sbyangs dang chos rnams 'byed/ /dran dang btang stoms rnams las ni/ /de las gzhan pa'i lha mo bdun/ /yang dag lta ba stobs chen mo/ /'khor los sgyur gem yang dag rtog /yang dag ngag ni brtson chen ma/ /yang dag las ni khā gdong ma/ /yang dag 'tsho ba 'ug gdong 'gyur/ /11—1345

yang dag rtsol ①ba khyi gdong can/ /yang dag dran pa phag gdong yin/ /ting nge 'dzin du bcom ldan bzhugs/ /dge ba'i chos rnams ①bskyed pa la/ /gshin rje brtan ma yang dag bzhugs/ /dge ba'i chos rnams skyes pa rnams/ /gshin rje pho nya srung bar byed/ /sdig pa'i las rnams bskyed pa de/ /spong ba gshin rje pho nya ma/ /sdig pa rnams ni mi 'byung phyir/ /gshin rje 'joms ma bzhugs pa yin/ /de ltar bsgoms ④pa dag gyur nas/ /mnyam par bzhag ste bzlas brjod bya/ /ci nus par ni bzlas byas nasabu/ /de yi 'og tu gtor ma dbul/ /sngar bshad pa yi cho ga yis/ /lha rnams dgod ⑦pa sngon 'gro can/ /dpa' bos khams rnams rnam sbyangs rjonas/ /sngar bshad pa yi phyag rgyas bcing me/ /sen mo so dang skra ba sru/ /pags pa dri ma sha nyid dang / /rtsa dang rgyus pa mkhal ma dang / /snying dang de bzhin mig dag dang / /mkhris pa glo ba rgyu ma dang / /gnye ma de bzhin lto ba dang / /bshang ba mtshan ma bad kan dang / /rnag dang de bzhin khrag dang ni/ /rngul dang de bzhin mchi ma dang / /mchil ma dang ni ngar snabs nyid—/ /khams rnams go rims ⑧ji bzhin du/ /dpa' bo rnams kyis yang dag sbyar—/ /sngar bshad pa yi go rims las/ /de rnams gzhan ni mi bya'o/ /rkang pa brgyad kyis mgon po mchod/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs rang ming lus/ /oṃ dang hūṃ gnyis ming spel la/ /mthar yang hūṃ phaṭa sbyar bar bya/ /'khor lo gsum gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /ka ra ka ra sogs pas mchod/ /'dir ni tshig ni thams cad kyang / /snga ma'i tshul gyis spel bar bya/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te/ bī re shā ya dang por bri/ /ma hā kasprasni'i sgra dang / /sadri bhā ya de rjes bri/ /de nas dza ṭa mu khya ku ṭa/ /gro ṭā yi sgra bri bya/ /rdaṭ+wā ka rā lo gra dang / /bhā ṣa ṇa 11—1346

mu khā ya zi/ /sa ha sra bhu dzā'i sgra rjes①/ /bhā su rā ya bri bar bya/ /par shu pā sho r+ya ta dang / /shu la kha ṭī ga dha ri ṇa/ /byā gh+ra'i sgra dang dzi na'i tshig /asba ra dha rā ya zi/ /ma hā dhusrurnya ka ra/ /de rjes ba pu ṣā ya bri/ /thog mar oṃ dang tha mar phaṭa/ /bar du hūṃ hūṃ nges par sbyar/ /sngags ni rkang pa brgyad ces bya/ /la la tshig re'i mtha' ru sbyar/ /ka ra'i sgra dang de bzhin du/ /ku ru'i sgra yang gnyis su bya/ /brnya tā sa ya gnyis te/ /k+ko bha ya gnyis de bzhin du/ / hūṃ tram̐ (②hraḥhraḥphe phe dang / /phaṭa dang da ha'i tshig gnyis bya/ /pa tsa bhak+ṣa'i tshig gnyis gnyis/ /ba sa thung du nges par sbyar/ /ru dhi rān+t+ra'i ①tshig gnyis dang / /mā khā ba le pi ④ ṣ+pe dang / /kṛṇ+ḍi greṇ+ḍa de bzhin du/ /sap+ta pā tā la ga ta/ /bhu dze+e ga sabaṃ bā brjod/ /tardza 'a)ya yang lan gnyis brjod/ /ā kasbyo ukasbyo dang /tri tri dzhai : ⑥/nges par sbyar/ /khye khye haṃ haṃ dang / hūṃ hūṃ ki li ki li dang / /si li se li hi li gnyis/ /dhi li dhi li hūṃ gnyis phaṭa/ /bcas pas rtsa ba'i sngags su bshad/ /oṃshrī badz+ra he te dang / /ru ru ka yang de nas brjod/ /hūṃ ḍā ki bhā ⑦dzā la saṃ/ /ba ra zhes bya ba yang bri/ /swā hā'i mthar bcas mgon po yi/ /snying po'i yi ge nyi shu gnyis/ /de dang nye ba'i yi ge bdun/ /go bzlog pa yis gzung 'bar bya/ /phaṭa yoṣ+pehūṃ hūṃ ha ha hritshizhi /phag mo'i gsang sngags gnyis ka yang —/ /lugs las bzlog par shes par bya/ /hā swā phaṭa ⑪hūṃ hūṃ ye bhā ṇ+ḍiwa dz+ra ba ye nī ki ḍā dhe bu rbas dze+e /'bum bzlas pa yis 'grub 'gyur te/ /'phral du yid ches byed pa yin/ /mtshams kun du ni gtor ma dag /kun spyod rgyud las bshad bzhin bya/ /oṃ a radze+e tsheho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki bhā ⑫sa ma ya hūṃ dṛ sh+ya ho/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa khyu /sketa pre ta pi shā tsa u da/ a pasma ⑫ra 11—1347

badz+ra ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i mo ba bo kṛr+ghaṃ tu/ sa ma tsa rak+ṣan+tu/ sarba sdedhim+bi/ pra yasgos①/ ya dze+e baṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭi/ bhuji / rwarngo ghan+tu②/ pi ban+tu/ mā ti kra man+tu—/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sah+phu kha bi bṛdhe ①ye sa ha yi ka bha ban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sngags la legs gnas chos bdag nyid/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /rtag tu tshangs par spyod gyur pa/ /he ru ka dpal gnyis pa 'dra/ /'di dag thams cad rab spyad pa/ /de yis du'agrub 'gyur the tshom med/ /bdag gis sdom med rang bzor ni/ /rnal 'byor cung zad ci yang med/ /sngon gyi slob dpon gyis ⑤bshad las/ /sgrub pa'i thabs su gzhag rte pa yin/ /'on kyang 'di las bdag gis ni/ /bsod nams dri med gang theb ⑦des/ /'gro ba 'di kun rtag tu ni/ /sangs rgyas ye shes nyid thob shog /mun nag 'dra ba'i sku 'dzin 'gro ba kun gyi mun pa ⑤shin tu 'joms/ /'jigs pa'i skur mdzad 'jigs pa ma lus myur du sel bar mdzad/ /'khor bar rgyu bar mdzad cing 'khor ba'i nang du gnas mi bzod/ /de ltar ngo mtshar spyod yul bcom ldan gtum chen skur ldan phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal he ru ka'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po k+ṣiṃtsār+ya dharma shrī bha dra dang / lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa(sgo)// //11—1348
