byedam ra/ go ku da ha na/ zhes bya ba stobs dang bcas pa'i bdud rtsi bltas la hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar pos sbyang bar bya'o/ /yi ge as 3ni sad par byas la/oṃ gyis 'bar zhing gsal bar byas nas/ rang gi lce'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rnam par bsgoms te/ sar+bha ta thā ga ta birgyu bi ya hūṃ 2swā hā/ zhes bya bas btung bar bya zhing de nyid kyis 1lus la bskus nas/ gnod sems dang rnam par 'tshe ba dang mi dga' ba dang / 'dod pa la 'dod chags pa'i gnyen por gyur pa byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyems bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar gnas dang bdag dang rnal 'byor srung ba byas nas/rang gi snying gar yi ge a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūṃ mthing shun lta bu'i rnam par bsgoms la/ de'i 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis lus dang tshor ba dang sems dang chos dag stong pa nyid du bsams nas/ mdun du bcom ldan 'das dpal te ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa dang sangs rgyas thams cad dang bla ma blta bar bya'o/ /de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa yid kyis byas la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa brjod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba rang gi lus dang lhan cig stong par bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba byed kopho④haṃ/ /de nas sems gcig pu smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa rnam pa sna tshogs su snang ba'i rang bzhin de nyid kyis so/ /bgegs 'byung bar dogs na yi ge oṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje bsgoms la de'i 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis bgegs thal bar 'gyur bar bsams te rdo rje'i ra ba dang / rdo rje'i bla re dang / rdo rje'i rang bzhin can gyi sa gzhir byen gyis brlab pa'i bar du'o/ /rdo 11— 707

— —byedarje'i ra ba der chos 'byung gi phyag rgya chen po bsgom zhing de'i nang du 'jug pa'i sems nā da tsam bltas la/ 'og tu yo las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu rdo rje gnyis kyis 1mtshan pa dang / de'i steng du ro yongs su gyur pa las 2me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum rdo rjes mtshan pa dang / de'i steng du baṃ las gyur pa'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po rdo rjes mtshan pa dang / de'i steng du lo las gyur pa'i dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi kha dog ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du yi ge sum̐ yongs su gyur pa'i ri rab rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin gru bzhi pa spyog brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa dang /de'i steng du hūṃ las gyur pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje ste ri rab dang 'byung ba bzhi ④3yongs su gyur pa las rdo rjer gyur pa'i sa'i char dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus su rin po che thams cad kyi gzhal yas khang sgo bzhi la sogs par blta bar bya'o/ /de'i nang du 'khor lo gsum dang dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa kha dog sna tshogs pa blta bar bya'o / /lte ba'i steng du dus mtshan ma dang 'jigs byed chen po blta'o/ /de'i steng du phywali kā li las byung ba'i 5zla ba dang nyi ma dang / de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po yi ge hūṃ gi mgon dang bcas pa 'od 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' ston ka'i zla ba'i sprin lta bu phyag drug zhal gsum spyan gsum ste/ ral pa'i cod pan gyis spras pa/ /zla ba phyed pas nye bar mdzes6/ /thod pa'i phreng ba dag gis brgyan/ /zhal dkar sngo dang dmar ba dang / /zhal ni cung zad rnam bzhad pa/ /rdo rje dril bu stoms par zhugs/ /sgeg pa'i ros ni 'phyo mdzad pa/ /sgeg pa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /mchu yis btung ba'i dregs pa dgyes/ /phyag rgya mchod pa 11—1708

byed—— —— —kha ṭī ga /mi mgo dang ni rtse gsum 'chang / /lha mo de mdog phyag gnyis pa/ /gri gug dang ni lhung bzed bsnams/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag 'khyud/ /bde ba chen po'i gnas na bzhugs/ /de nas smon pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal du zhugs par rnam par bsams la byang chub kyi sems 'dod chags kyi mes zhu ba'i gzugs su blta bar bya'o/ /de nas phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sprul pa'i lha mos yongs su bskul bas yi ge hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje yi ge hūṃ gi mgon dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi tshogs rab tu 'phro ba/ sangs rgyas kyi tshogs kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa la bdag nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gzugs can sgu la rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa/ dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor dang ldan pa khro bo sgu mdog nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa g.yas brkyang ba'i bzhugs pas dus mtshan gnon pa rtsa ba'i zhal sngo bsangs/ g.yon ser ngo /rgyab pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ g.yas ljang gu mche ba dang bcas pas 'jigs par mdzad pa smin ma ser ba/ dbu skra gyen du badze+es la 'bar ba/ thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can zla ba phyed pa'i thod can sna tshogs rdo rje dbu rgyan gyis gnon pa/ spyan bcu gnyis pa/ 'khor lo dang / rna rgyan dang / mgul rgyan dang / gdu bu dang / ske rags dang / mchod phyir thogs dang thal bas nye bar spras pa stag gi sham thabs can mi mgo rlon pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa'i phyag gnyis kyis 'khyud pa/ phyag gzhan gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa'i gos 'dzin pa/ g.yas ḍa ma ru dang / dgra sta dang / gri gug dang / rtse gsum 1bsnams pa/ g.yon na tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang / zhags pa dang / kha ṭī ga dang / ka pā la bsnams pa blta bar bya'o/ /phag mo zhal 11—/709

gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal zhi bzhu/ sku mdog dmar mo dum bus brgyan pa'i ske rags can byin pa gnyis kyis yang dag par 'khril ba/bde ba chen po'i gnas na bzhugs pa phyag gnyis kyis 'khyud pa/ bdud sdig to can la sogs pa'i khrag gis bkang pa'i ka pā la bsnams pa/ phyag gcig na gri gug bsnams pa/ yan lag phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar na bcom ldan 'das ni yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin no/ /pad+ma'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma dang / yid 'ong ma dang / dum skyes ma dang /gzugs can ma ni go rims bzhin du sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang / kha ṭī ga dang / gri gug bsnams pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can spyan gsum pa dbu skra grol ba/ gcer bu dum bus brgyan pa'i ska rags can/phyag rgya lnga 'chang ba ste lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni yid 'ong ma'o/ /sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o/ /chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /mtshalas su ni byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i snod bzhi'o/ /rnam par dag pa ni rnam par thar pa bzhi ste/ 'di ltar stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa dang / mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /dang po thugs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa kha dog sngon po rdo rje dra bas brgyan pa/ shar dang lus kyi dkyil 'khor mgo bo pul+lī ra mā 4 la ya la thod pa'i dum bu can dang /rab gtum mo ste 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ /sen mo dang so ni thod pa'i 11—1710

dum bu can no/ /byang dang spyi gtsug dzā ①larnya ra la ni keng rus chen po dang gtum pa'i mig can ma ste brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ /skra dang spu ni keng rus chen mo'o/ /nub dang rna ba g.yas pa auḍān ①la keng rus dang 'od ldan ma ste dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ /pags pa dang dri ma la ni keng rus so/ /lho kyidang mgo bo'i rgyab arbu da la ni mche ba gcigs pa dang sna chen mo ste sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ /sha la ni mche ba gcigs pa'o/ /gnas de bzhi ni ④sa rab tu dga' ba'o/ /me'i phyogs dang rna ba g.yon pa go dā ba rī ⑤la ni chang dgra dang brtan pa'i blo can ma ste dad pa'i dbang po'o/ /rtsa rgyus ni chang dgra ma'o/ /bden bral gyi phyogs dang smin ma'i dbus su rā me shwa ra la ni 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma ste brtson 'grus kyi dbang po'o/ /rus pa la ni 'od dpag tu med pa'o / /rlung gi phyogs dang mig de bī ko ṭī dul rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma ste dran pa'i dbang po'o/ /mkhal ma la ni rdo rje'i 'od do/ /dbang ldan kyi phyogs dang phrag pa gnyis mā la ba la ni ⑦rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po'o/ /snying rje ni rdo rje'i sku'o/ /nye ba'i gnas te sa dri ma med pa'o—/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo ni nam mkha' la rgyu ba'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma'i phreng bas brgyan pa'i shar gyi rtsibs dang mchan khung kā ma rū pa la ni myu gu can dang sa srung ma ste/ shes rab kyi dbang po'o/ /mig ni myu gu can no/ /byang dang nu ma oṭa ⑤la ni rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste dad pa'i stobs so/ /mkhris pa la ⑨ni rdo rje ral pa can no/ /zhing ste sa 'od byed pa can no / /nub dang lte ba tri sha ku ṣ+pe la ni dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma ste brtson 'grus kyi stobs so/ /glo ba la ⑩ni dpa' bo chen po'o/ /lho dang sna'i 11—1711

dbang po ko sa la la ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste dran pa'i stobs so/ /rgyu ma ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad do/ /nye ba'i zhing ste sa 'od 'phro ba can no/ /me'i phyogs dang kha ka liṅka la ni rab tu bzang po dang lha mo sngo bsangs ma ste ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs so/ /gnye ma ni rab tu bzang po'o/ /bden bral gyi phyogs dang mgrin pa lo pa ka la ni rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste shes rab kyi stobs so/ /lto ba ni rdo rje bzang po'o/ /tshajo ha ste sa shin tu sbyang dka' ba'o/ /rlung gi phyogs dang snying ga kāñci 1la ni 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /ldang dzupa ni 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs dang mdoms hi shā la 1ya ni mig ④mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /mdoms bar ni mig mi bzang ngo / /nye ba'i tshajo ha ste sa mngon du gyur pa'o/ /sa la rgyu ba'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor lo'i phreng bas brgyan pa'i shar gyi rtsibs dang mtshan ma pre ta byu ⑤ri la stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma ste dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /bad kan ni stobs po che'o/ /byang dang bshang lam kṛha de btā ra la rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hā ṣ+ṭaste shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /rnag la ni rdo rje rin chen no/ /'dus pa can te sa ring du song ba'o / /nub dang brla gnyis sau rāṣ+ṭa 3 la rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi bhā kyeste chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /khrag spyoni rta mgrin no/ /lho dang byen pa gnyis su war+ṇa dī pa la nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /rdul ni nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /nye ba'i 'dus pa can te sa mi g.yo ba'o/ /me'i phyogs dang rkang pa'i sor mo na ga ra la 11—1712

dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo ste btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /tshol ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /bden bral gyi phyogs dang rkang pa'i bol sen+d+ra la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste yang dag pa'i lta ba'o/ /mchi ma ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /dur khrod de sa legs pa'i blo gros so/ /rlung gi phyogs dang mthe bong ma ru la rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los tsho)sgyur ma ste yang dag pa'i rtog pa'o/ /mchil ma ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /dbang ldan gye phyogs dang pus mo gnyis ku lu tār ②rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste yang dag pa'i ngag go/ /snabs ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /nye ba'i (kyedur khrod de sa chos kyi sprin no/ /sa 'og tu 'gyur ro/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo sku mdog nag po—/ gsung gi 'khor lo sgu mdog dmar po/ sku'i 'khor lo sku mdog dkar po—/ thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa dpa' bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dril bus snyoms par zhugs pa g.yas brkyang pas bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs can phyag rgya lnga 'chang ba'o/ /rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa ni phyag gnyis zhal gcig pa ka pā la dang gdug pa la/ sdigs mdzub gri gug bsnams pas 'khyud/ /spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can ma/ /skra grol bas ni rnam par spros—/ /gnyis med tsūr bas dusnyoms par zhugs/ /nam mkha'i gos mnabs pa la gzhol/ /lha mo phyag rgya lnga 'chang ba/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa'o/ /shar dang byang dang nub dang lho'i sgo rnams la khwa gdong ma dang / 'ug pa'i gdong can ma dang / khyi'i gdong can ma dang / phag gi gdong can ma'o/ /me'i phyogs dang bden bral gyi phyogs dang rlung gi phyogs dang dbang ldan gyi phyogs rnams la gshin rje brtan ma dang / gshin rje pho nya ma rjodang / gshin rje mche 11—1713

ba ma dang ①/ gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /ji ltar mkha' 'gro sogs 'gro ba/ /khā gdong la sogs la sogs dbye/ /de bzhin mtshalas gnas lha mo ni/ /gzugs gnyis yid ni 'phrog pa'o/ /yi dwags gdan ni 'jigs byed po/ /sems can don mdzad pa la brtson/ /dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral ba la rdo rje'i phreng ba'o/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor la lag pa g.yon pa'i rtse mo la khwa gdong ma ste yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'o/ /mkhrig ma la ni 'ug gdong ma ste yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i rtse mo la ni khyi'i ②gdong ma ste yang dag pa'i rtsol ba'o/ /mkhrig ma la ni phag gdong ma ste yang dag pa'i dran pa'o/ /rkang pa g.yas pa'i rtse mo la ni gshin rje brtan ma ste dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyes pa'i ngang tshal can no/ /rkang pa g.yon pa'i rtse mo la ni gshin rje pho nya ma ste dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par bsrung ba'o/ /rkang pa g.yas pa'i long mo la ni gshin rje mche ba ma ste mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spong pa yang dag par sgrub par byed pa'o/ /rkang pa g.yon pa'i long mo la ni gshin rje 'joms pa ste mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams kun nas mi skye bar byed pa'o/ /snying ga'i pad+ma'i lte ba'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das thig le'i gzugs can no/ /phyogs kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /lte ba'i pad+ma la ni rdo rje phag mo phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin no/ /de ltar phyi dang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ro①/ /da ni phung po la sogs pa'i rnam par dag pa ste/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /'du byed kyi phung po ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid 11—1714

ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /mig la ni ①gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o—/ /sna la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /kha la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni ②ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la ni dpal he ru ka'i dbang phyug go/ /sa'i khams ni ltung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi ①khams ni gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la ni rnal 'byor ma'i dra ba ma ④ste de ltar phung po dang khams dang skye mched dag lha dulha nyid kyi nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas mgo bo la yi ge oṃ gyis sku byin gyis brlab po/ /skog ma la ni yi ge āḥs gsung byin gyis brlab po/ /snying ga la ni yi ge hūṃ gis thugs byen gyis brlab po/ /rjosnying ga'i dbus su yi ge hūṃ dugis ye shes sems dpa' byin gyis brlab po/ /de dag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bsam mo/ /oṃsasba bī ⑧ra yo gi bhā ⑨kā ya bāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba stom kophohaṃ⑩ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' las spros pa'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la mdun du bzhag ste yang dag par mchod nas/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la bcug cing myur du ro gcig par bya'o—/ /wīyo ga shurnyaḥsaza dharmā yo ga shurnyopho⑪haṃ/ oṃbadz+ra shudhaḥsasba ⑫dhadrwa badz+ra shurnyopho⑫haṃ/ snying ga la oṃha/ rdo rje sems dpa' bo/ mgo bo la na ma hi rnam par snang mdzad do/ /spyi gtsug la swā hā hu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /phrag pa gnyis la bo ṣa ṭa ④he he ru ka'o/ /mig la hūṃ hūṃ ho rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ rta mchog ste go cha'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i go cha'o/ /lte ba la oṃbaṃ rdo rje phag mo'o/ /snying ga la haṃ oṃ thun mtshams ma'o/ /kha la hri snyemo rmongs byed ma'o/ /mgo bo la tre hri ⑩skyong byed 11—1715

ma'o| /spyi gtsug la hūṃ hūṃ skrag byed ma'o/ /yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa gtum mo ste go cha'o/ /rnal 'byor ma thams cad la nyid kyis dgod par bya'o/ /mdzub mo gnyis ①mdud gung mo sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan por sbyar/ /de ni dpral ba'i dbus bzhag nas/ /gcu zhing bskor bas bskyod par bya/ /rkang pa mnan cing steng du blta/ /kha nas yi ge be+e ②sgrogs shing / /phyogs bcu la sogs ⑦khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dgug /de nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa nam mkha'i dkyil khengs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma phyag na ye shes kyi bum pa bsnams pas ④glu dang gar dang bcas pa'i mchod pas bdag nyid dbang bskur bar bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ saza ta thā ga tā bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ /de nas rang gi rigs cod pan du gyur to/ /de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma de dag thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyi lcags kyus zhal du zhugs nas lha mo'i pad+ma'i dkyil du byang chub kyi sems kyi gzugs su rab tu spro bar bya'o/ /de las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis dam tshig gi 'khor lo mchod de lha'i bstod pa'i mchod pas bstod cing gong du bstan pa'i rim pas bdud rtsi myang bar bya'o/ /lus ngag yid kyi dam tshig gi /sems ni sems kyis ⑤legs mtshon pa / /kun rtog thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bsgom dang ldan pa'i bzlas pa bya/ /dam tshig mchog gi bzlas pa yis/ /de nas gsang sngags brjod par bya/ /hā swā ra rte 7ba shaṃ la dz+wa bhā ljuki ḍā ṭapha hūṃ hūṃ rkyekai ru ru he he dz+rab shrī zhi ṭapha hūṃ hūṃ ⑨ha haḥs+thā dze+e /mgo bo'i lugs las bzlog pa'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o⑪ / /ṭapha hūṃ hūṃ ⑫ye nī tsa ro be+e ⑫dz+rab zhi /hā swā ṭapha hūṃ hūṃ ye nīṇ+ḍi wa ⑫dz+rab ye bhā ki ḍā rngudhabu sbas go lha mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor 11—1716

ma thams cad kyi ni rang gi ming gi yi ge chadang hūṃ gi bar du chud pa'i yi ge hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi mtha' can dag yin no/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi ni ka ra ka ra la sogs pa'i de kho na bzhin du bzlas so/ /bzlas pa yongs su rdzogs nas ni/ /zla ba'i btung mchog btung bar bya/ /chos rnams kun gyi dngos mnyam nyid/ /dam tshig mchog phyir mnyam nyid do/ /chos rnams bdag med lam du ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni gzhug par bya/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rnal 'byor/ /rnal 'byor ngal bas ngal sos bya/ /phywali kā li mnyam byas nas/ /de la re khā nges par sbyar/ /gyen du sbar ba'i tshul dag gis/ /'og tu 'bab pa'i rgyu yin phyir/ /khu ba'i gzugs kyi bdud rtsi ni/ /thig le'i gzugs can 'dzag par 'gyur/ /snang med go 'phang la gnas nas/ /snang med mnyam pa nyid la brten/ /chos rnams spyod pa med pa la/ /chos rnams chos nyid dag kyang med/ /rten 'byung chos rnams nam mkha' ①'dra/ /ngo bo nyid med mtshan nyid med/ /de ltar de nyid gnas dag ①na/ /ye shes mig ni thob par 'gyur/ /langs pa'i dus kyi tshe na ni/ /cho ga bzhin du gtor ma sbyin/ /shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni bkod pa dag dang bral/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /rnal 'byor sems la ngal bso bya'i/ /mya ngan 'das nyid mi zubasten to/ /'pho ba'i tshe na rnal 'byor pa/ /dpal ldan he ru ka la sogs/ /lha yi rnal 'byor ma dag gis/ /lag na me tog sna tshogs thogs/ /sna tshogs rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / /glu yi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog 'di/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed—/ /dpal bcom ldan 'das kyi sgrub thabs rdo rje slob dpon chen po dpal 11—1717

nyin mo mdzad kyis ①mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gye mkhan po shrī subyed ti shārnyi ②dang / shad chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bad ra cing shadas te gtan la phab pacad// //bskur mchan/17༷6 1mdon byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jam dpal rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 de/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hūṃ hūṃ/⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtu hūṃ/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hūṃ rtu/ blu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hūṃ/17༷7 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yi las/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tā na bisna bi ya/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—pho/17 8 ྅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—kyis/ nga 〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—gyi/ kru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ba'i/ du 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/17 9 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgopa/171༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉paral zhi ba/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/1711 lku/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dza/ me〈〈pe 〉〉snar 〉〉32na/ 〈〈co 〉〉yoḍān/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lto/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ni/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ri/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉be+e ko ṭi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ni/ ⑤ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dre/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—la/ ⑫〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—la/1712 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kalca/ /1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ldangs/ zhu〈〈snar 〉〉ma 'di spyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—migapye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pu/ du〈〈pe 〉〉ta ra/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tā ra/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ha/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉so'u raṣ+ṭa—/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉khrab/1713 lku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tar/ /1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ ngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyod pas/'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mo/1714 kye/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—gshin rje mche ba ma dang / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khyi/ 1〈〈snar 〉〉—ro/1715 khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ni/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ni/ zhu〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ma/bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 lkog ma la/ ⑦ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉has/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉tha/11byed1718

༄/ /zam ze nyi mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa'i spyin sreg bzhugs/1༄go/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa gang zhig las dang rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa ni 'bras bu sbyin sreg la rag las pa yin pas/ de'i phyir de'i rjes su spyad par bya'o/ /de la re zhig sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ zhi ba 'ba' zhig gi snyelas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sa sbyang ba byas nas / sa gzung — ba dang spel ba dang ldan par sa byin gyis brlabs te/ dkyil 'khor brtsig pa'am bris pa gang yang sherung ba byas te/ phyi rol khru brgyad pa'i mtha' skor byas pa la/ me thab kyi zabs su khru phyed rgyar khru gang pa byas nas kha khyer de bzhin dor ba dang / sor bzhi gyen du brtsig pa dang / sor bzhi phyi rol du bskor ba'i rim pa gsum byas la/ zhi ba la kun nas zlum po ste phyi rol tha ma ni gru bzhir byas pa la nyes pa med do/ /de la bri ba ni tshon rtsi dkar po'o/ /nang du ye shes kyi 'khor lo la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gri gug gi snyer ba dang bcas 11—1720

pa'o—/ /rim pa gsum pa la thugs gsung sku'i 'khor lo gsum bri'o/ /phyi rol gyi mtshams su zla ba rdo rje dang me 'od kyi phreng ba dang bcas pa bris la/ gri gug dang thod pa'i phyag mtshan dang / mtshalas su bum pa'i ka pā la khrag gis bkang ba bri bar bya'o/ /phyogs su gri gug dang 'khor lo gsum la thod pa dang gri gug nag po dang —/ dmar po dang / dkar po dang / zhi ba'i 'khor lo dkar po/ rdo rje dang pad+ma dang 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor ba/ mtshams dang sgo la gri gug 'bar ba'i nang du dgod par bya'o/ /de nas dzas bsags pa ni/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang bsang ba'i chu bdud rtsi 1bsres pa dang / yon chab dang / zhabs bsel dang —/ sman dang / 'bru dang / chang dang / bdud rtsi dang / me tog dkar po dang bcas pa'o/ /til dang / yungs kar dang / yam shing dang /mar dang / zho dang / 'o ma dang / 'bras chan dang / ku sha dang / drur ba nyadang / nas dang / gro dang / nas so ba dang / ma sha dang / 'bras so ba dang / bil ba dang / star ka dang / dzā ti pha la dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / u dusmra ldu ra'i shing dang / nags kyi lcug ma la sogs pa rim pa bzhin du bzhag la/ shel kyi phreng ba dang / gser dang rin po che lnga dang /dar dkar po dang / khyad par gyi rdzas bdud rtsi lnga dang dpa' bo dang / chang gi bye brag rnams dang / rig ma dang bcas pa'am/ yang na rdzas bsreg 4shing sgom pa dang bcas pa'o/ /bsreg shing dang ku sha dgram pa dang / dgang gzar dang blugs gzar mdun du bzhag la/ sgom 5pas rgyal ba rnams dmigs la mchod par bya'o/ /de la thog ma kho nar 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub pa pos lhor kha bltas la stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ bdud rtsi lnga'i ri lu khar bcug la stoms 11—1721

par 'jug pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas g.yas brkyang pa'i gnas pas byams pa'i sems dang ldan pas gos dkar po gon la/ rus pa'i phreng ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa/thal ba dang rak+ta bsres pa'i thig les gnas gsum du brgyan pa dang / ku sha dang rus pa'i dag byed lag pa g.yon pa'i ming med la bcug la thog mar tshogs bsags pa dang byams pa la sogs bsgom pa dang / gnas srung bas bgegs bsal ba dang / bdag srung ba'i stong pa nyid dang bcas pa ni sgrub pa'i thabs las 'byung ba'am/ rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin du byas la lha'i rnal 'byor bskyed de go cha dang / ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang mchod pa'i bar du byas la/ snying ga'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du ye shes sems dpa'i sngags la sogs pa 'khor lo'i tshul du bkod la sngags kyis skur byas te rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod la/ bzlas brjod kyi mes bdag dang sems can gyi sdig pa bsregs la rang nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bar snang du gnas nas/ hūṃ gis mkhas pas stong par byas nas/ bye 2 ram̐ la sogs pa'i ri rab la thug pa bskyed la/ rang gi mdun du yi ge r+ghaṃ snyelas me thab kyi 'khor lo bsgoms la de'i dbus su ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum/ de'i dbus su baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po/ de'i steng du ram̐ las byung ba'i me gru gsum dbus su ro gyis mtshan pa bsams la zur gsum la khams gsum gyi zhal gyi rtags bum pa oṃ t+pahūṃ bkod de hri 1'od zer dang ldan pa bsam par bya'o/ /de'i nang du bud shing rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'am yi ge bdun pas bsangs la brtsigs te ku shas bag la ba dan dang bcas pa bskyed par bya'o/ /gong gi yi ge de dag gyur pa las pad+ma'i gdan zla ba'i steng na sku mdog dmar ser phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje rtse 11—1722

—gsum pa gnyis pa na dbyig pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na bgrang phreng / gnyis pa na gudhe ①bsnams pa khro bo'i rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa bsams la/ ye shes sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis thab kyi dang 'dra ba dzaḥhūṃ baṃ holngasnobazhi pa dang / lag pa g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin par byas la/ mthe bo srin lag gi rtsa bar btsugs la g.yab ste/ oṃ.e bye hi ma hā bhū ta de ba ṛ ṣi dī dza satwa ma gri ta u 4hūṃ/ ma hā a smi ⑤sam+bi hi to bha ba/ oṃ bha shasdeb ka asna ye swā hā zhes pas spyan drangs la mchod yon phul rkang pa brgyad pas bstod la/ gnod mdzes kyis bgegs bskrad de / dam tshig sems dpa' dang bsres nas dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bltas la re pha 7lce la bkod pa dang / phyag mtshan med pa'i las kyi phyag rgya gar dang bcas pa dang —/ chos kyi phyag rgya gri gug lce la bsam pa dang / phyag rgya chen po sngar bzhin bsams te me lha'i thugs ka nas rang byung la rang gi thugs ka dang nam mkha' la dardo rje mkha' 'gro mas dbang bskur te/ spyi bor thim pas spyi bor rdo rjer gyur par bsams la( / oṃ la/hūṃ gsum gyis byin kyis brlabs te mchod pa lnga dang zhabs bsil dang yon chab phul la/ 'thor 'thung gis bsang gtor byas la ku shas bkab pa'i me rlung yab kyis sbar ba'i nang du me lha bsam par bya'o/ /de nas me lha (temadog dkar po rgyan dang bcas pa la thog mar me gso ba'i phyir/ oṃ badz+ra a na lha ma hā byu ta dz+wa la sarba : rja tshuku ru sarba dubye hūṃ phaṭa ces bya bas mar gyi dgang blugs gsum mam bdun dbul lo/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar gyi khar yi ge gsum dgod par bya'o/ /de nas bgegs yod med brtag par bya'o/ /bgegs yod na gnod mdzes kyis bsang gtor bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa lnga dang sreg rdzas dbul bar bya'o/ /sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir til la o sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā 11—1723

zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra yadz+nyā ya swā hā yam shing gi'o/ /oṃ asna ye swā hā mar gyi'o/ /'o ma dang zho la sogs pa zhu ba'i rdzas la ni ske nyid kyi sngags kyis so/ /oṃ sarba saṃ nyupa de swā hā 'bras chan gyi'o/ /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzā ya swā hā ku sha'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra phywayu k+ṣeṣe swā hā drur ba'i namyu gu'i'o/ /oṃ ma hā be ge jeswā hā nas kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ghasma re swā hā gro'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā nas so ba'i'o/ /oṃ ma hā ba khā ya swā hā ma ldu sha'i'o/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā 'bras so ba'i'o/ /oṃ ma hā sho ba me ⑥swā hā bil ba dang star ka dang dzā 7ti pha la'i yang de nyid do/ /sman dang rdzas lhag ma rnams la ni rang gi ming dang yi ge bdun pa dang yum gyi snying pos dbul bar bya'o/ /de la dbul ba'i gnas ni yam shing 'od la'o/ /mar khu zhal du'o/ /til dang zho dang nas ni phyag tu'o/ /ku sha dang drur ba ni dbu'i gtsug tor la'o/ /nas dang gro dang 'bras so ba dang sran ma ma sha la sogs pa ni zhal du'o/ /zhu ba'i rdzas thams cad ni zhal du'o/ /dri ni thugs kar ro/ /me tog dbu la'o/ /spos 'od la'o/ /mchod yon dang 'thor 'thung phyag tu'o/ /mar ni mdun du'o/ /bdud rtsi ni zhal du'o / /rin po che 9dbu la'o/ /phreng ba phyag tu'o/ /sgu la gos so/ /de nas tha mar yang bsangs la me 'od la zhu bar bya'o/ /de'i dkyil du rang gi dkyil 'khor k+ṣiṃli dang kā li yi ge hūṃ las sprul/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs pa byas nas mchod pa dang bstod pa dang go bskon pa dang / dbang bsgur ba dang / sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'am yang na rang mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyab tu gnas la bskyed pa'i lha drug cu rtsa gnyis bkod la mchod pa bya'o/ /snga ma bzhin du dgang blugs bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig dang brgya rtsa brgyad kyis sreg blugs thams cad snga ma bzhin du dbul/ tha mar yang mchod pa lnga dang / mchod yon dang zhabs bsel phul 11—/724

la 'thor 'thung dang nye reg byas la/ nges par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor las byung ba'i mchod pa dang / gzhan yang bdud rtsi lnga dang / chang dang / dpa' bo lnga dang /cang te'u dang / myang ba dang / bldag pa dang / gzhib pa dang / bza' ba dang /bca' ba dang / tshogs kyi mchod pa dang 'khyud pa la sogs byas la/ bdag dang bsgrub bya'i sdig pa'i gzugs rid pa dang gnag pa dang nyam thag pa dang bcas pas sdug bsngal bar dmigs te til dang bsres la bsreg par bya'o/ /mthe bo dang mdzub mo la hūṃ las rdo rje'i 'od zer dang bcas pa bsams la/ rang ngam gzhan gyi snying gnas sdig pa bskyed la drangs te/ lte ba la hūṃ rdo rje mar me'i 'od lta bus sna'i rtse mor drangs la①/ mtheb mdzub gnyis ②kyis bzung la til bsreg par bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po thugs rje'i rang bzhin can/ /'khor dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol/ /skyabs gsol bzlas brjod sbyin sreg mthus/ /'gro ba'i dngos grub myur du gsol/ /mthong ba dang ni thos pa dang / /dran pa dang ni reg tsam gyis/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /nad rnams kun ni sos gyur cig /ces brjod la rang gi sngags kyis mthar a na la bhasmi ①ku ru dang bcas pas mchod yon phul la④/ 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin gyi mer rjam par rjortog pa'i rang bzhin rnams snang ba med par byas la yang mi skye bar 'gyur ba'i blos/ oṃ ṭībadz+ra he he ru ru kai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ḍā ki nī dudzā la sasbra ra dze+eswā hā/ che ge mo sarba pā baṃ da ha nā ya swā hā/ rkang pa brgyad pa'am yi ge bdun pa dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sngags dang / mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa drug gi sngags kyis mchod pa dang / sdig pa bsreg pa'i phyir til gyi sbyin sreg 11—1725

—brgya rtsa brgyad dam lnga bcu rtsa bzhi dbul bar bya'o/ /yang na stong ngam khri'am ci nus par mchod par bya'o/ /de nas me lha bar snang du bsams la rang gi snying ga nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo bsams la mchod pa lnga dang 'thor 'thung dang mchod yon phul la 'og nas 'byung ba'i bstod pas me lha la bstod la/ sreg blugs ci nus pa ①dbul bar bya'o/ /dgang gzar dang blugs gzar gyi kha dang dkyil dang mabyedas su yig 'bru snga ma dang hūṃ bai bkod la pus mo'i bar du thal mo gnyis mthe bong mthe'u chung sprad nas bzung la me'i zhal du dbul te de rnams kyis ②ma lus pa byed par bsam pa ni thun mong gi cho ga'o/ /de nas yam shing dang mar dang til dang 'bras chan dang / zho dang / ku sha dang / drur ①ba dang / nas dang / gro dang / 'bras so ba dang / sran ma dang / sman la sogs pa ci 'byor pa dbul bar bya'o/ /tha mar yang dgang blugs phul la 'thor 'thung dang nye reg byas te/ ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol lo/ /oṃbyed kyis 'gro ba'i don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub byedadu/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥbaṃ baṃ zhes pas gshegs par bsam mo/ /dam tshig sems dpa' rang gi lus la tha mar rang nyid kyi sngags dang 'thor 'thung dang bsang gtor sngon du 'gro bas rdzas lhag ma bsres la de nas yon bdag g.yon du bzhag la me lha'i zhabs drung gi thal bas dpral bar thig le byas la bstod pa bya ste//'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras/ /dume yi rgyal poṭak+kis rjodabang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg⑦ /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces brjod la gshegs par bsams te/ ska.asna ye e bye haṃ swaṭ+wāñca pa rāj-i/ sernyi ⑧tai gats+tsha maha bya byu ga ⑨zhes brjod do/ /dam tshig gi me 11—1726

lha rmyegadan la thim pa dang / gdan chu'i rgya mtsho la thim pa dang / chu rang gi sa bon la thim pa dang / sa bon me gru gsum la thim par bsams la/ me nyid bcos ma'i tha mal par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i yi ge brgya pa bzlas la rang gi lus la go cha bgos te tsham ngam sngags kyis srung bas bsrung ⑤pa'o/ /lha'i nga rgyal gyis ldang bar bya'o/ /rgyas pa la puṣ+ṭi ku ru dang / dbang la ba shang byeku ru dang / hoḥ zhes pa dang / drag po la mā ra ya phaṭa ces pa/ dgug pa la sogs pa la ci rigs par shes par bya'o/ /bdag gis rgyud dang cho ga gzhan dag las/ /btus nas snyesbyar gyi rang bzor byas pa min/ /slob mas gsol btab ngor byas nga rgyal min/ /sbyin sreg byas pa'i dge rtsas 'gro kun khrag 'thung shog /bram ze chen po nyin mdzad rdo rjes rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/172༷ nyamatshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyin sreg gi cho ga bzhugs/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—gi/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung / py-i〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—yang/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—gi/1721 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsis/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kun+da dang durba/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dum ba/ kru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsres/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/1722 ྅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉be+e/ kru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bye/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hi/1723 ྅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gaṇ+ḍi/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉ho/ 1〈〈co 〉〉dzā/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ska bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ya/6ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ kru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—la/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ཿ/ ⑪〈〈co 〉〉rgosku/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bha smi/ spyo〈〈pe 〉〉badz+ra/1724 nya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sa/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sga 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉durba'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉ge ye/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ga ye / snye〈〈snar 〉〉mi/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉le/ /⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dza/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dur/11—1727

/9/〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ni/1725 217〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa dang / (2/〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi gnyis/ 581〈〈snar 〉〉bha:/ ri7〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wal/(5)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉warnamapar/ (6 )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ (1)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba ma raṃ/1726 (1)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas (42/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ (5)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dur/ (7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasol/chi5)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'jig rten/ (67〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dag gis/ (7)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsreg 87〈〈pe 〉〉〉 sba tsa pa ri the/ sidhi/ 〈〈snar 〉tshog5 tsa pa ri the/ sirnyi/ (9)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ti/ phya phyug1727 17〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spe/ (2)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrung bas bsrungs/ (87〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zheng / (cho 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ (5〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rjes su/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (328)11wa /728

༄/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro jes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las btus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs byang chub kyi sems kun du gzigs pa'i phreng ba jes bya ba/tsho7༄gyi/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhā badz+ra ḍā ki nā ma ma hā tan+t+ra —rā dza ubye yo bo dhi tsit+ta a 1ba lo ka mā la sā dha no pi ka nā 4ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las btus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs byang chub kyi sems kun du gzigs pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mos kun 'khyud pa'i/ /dpa' bo rdo rje can btud nas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rim pa yis / /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid mchog /dang por ro ni bsgom par bya/ /sgrub po de yi steng gnas te/ /te ru ka nyid bsgom par bya/ /zhes bya ba la de la rim pa ni 'di yin te/ rang gi snying gar re pha las/ /byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /de nyid du ni hūṃ zhes pa/ /thabs dang shes rab gzugs can bsam/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje ni/ /kha dog 11—1729

nag po drag chen po/ /de yi lte ba'i dbus gnas par/ /slar yang hūṃ gi de nyid bsgom/ /hūṃ ni yongs su gyur pa las/ /sgrub po zhe sdang bdag nyid bsam/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /rang gi lhag pa'i lha gzugs bya/ /khro la sa bon sngon po ste/ /rdo rje nyi ma de bzhin no/ /zhi ba'i sa bon zla ba'i mdog /zla ba rdo rje la gnas bsam/ /sgrub po lha yi gzugs bzung la/ /de nas lha yi mchod pa spro/ /lha yi mig dang ldan pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad blta bar bya/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rnal 'byor skyed par gsungs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi dngos sa bon/ /rang snying zla bar bsams nas su/ /bde gshegs de yi 'od zer gyis/ /mdun du bkug par blta bar bya/ /ar+gha la sogs lung ①byung ba/ /phyi dang gsang ba'i mchod sogs bya/ /de nas phyag ni byas nas su/ /de 'og bdag nyid 'di ltar dbul/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas bzung ji srid du/ /byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /yang dag byang chub nges mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bla med byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bkyi—/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te—/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng ②nas brtsams te mchog tu gzung / /babe+eb pa yi ni tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdu ba dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis so sor brtan por gzung 1/ /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bgyi zhing / /slob dpon dag kyang bdag gis bzung / /11—1730

rin chen rigs mchog rnal 'byor gyi①/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi stsal bar bgyi/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos yang dag gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /mchod pa ci nus bgyid pa dang / /sdom pa thams cad ldan par bgyi/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyi zhing / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sdom pa ma lus gzung bar bgyi/ /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi / /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /'gro kun mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /byams dang snying rje byas nas su—/ /dge ba la ni dga' ba bsgom/ /mi dge'i chos la btang snyoms bya/ /sdig bshags la sogs de bzhin no/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa dang sdom pa gzung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gshegs gsol nas/ /de 'og 'di ltar bsgom par bya/ /bdag gis mchod pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /gang nas ma byon gar ma gshegs/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /gang yin lha yi rang bzhin nyid/ /rnal 'byor de nyid rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /blo dang ldan pas de nyid bsgom/ /gzugs ni sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma yin/ /'du shes pad+ma gar dbang ste//'du byed rdo rje rgyal po yin/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /'di dag kun dngos rang bzhin ni/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes byar grags/ /yang dag gcig pu chen po'i lha/ /bde ba thams cad rab ster ba/ /sgyu ma chen po'i rang bzhin gyis / /chags bral chags pa zhes byar bshad/ /sa khams lhung byed ma yin te/ /11—1731

de bzhin chu khams gsod ma'o/ /me khams 'gugs byed ma yin te/ /de bzhin rlung ni gar dbang ngo / /nam mkha'i khams ni sgyu ma cher/ /rang nyid 'gro ma zhes byar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni 'bar ba'i mchog /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin gyi①/ /de ni rdo rje gtso mor gnas/ /mig gnyis gti mug rdo rjer bshad/ /nyan pa zhe sdang rdo rjer brjod/ /sna ni ser sna rdo rje ste/ /kha ni 'dod chags rdo rjer gsungs/ /lus ni phrag dog rdo rje ste / /skye mched thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog/bcom ldan rdo rje can kyis gsungs/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyi rnam par dag pa'o/ /oṃ swa bhā ba dāshurnyaḥsarba dharmālngasnyeswa bhā ba shurnyo3zihaṃ/ de nas dngos kun las grol ba'i/ /chos kun bdag med mnyam par blta/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus ba'i/ /'gro ba sgyu ma lta bu yin/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba yi—/ /'gro ba dmigs su med pa ste/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa'i dngos/ /thams cad sgyu ma ji bzhin no/ /gzugs ni ⑤thams cad stong pa nyid/ /stong pa'i tshul gyi mig gis ni/ /dogs pa med par bsgom pa'i dzimachog /rnam par mi rtog pa yis blta/ /nam mkha'i tshul kyi sems kyis ni/ /der ni thams cad nam mkha'i dngos/ /dogs pa med pa'i bsgom par ldan/ /rnam par mi rtog skye bar 'gyur/ /oṃ shu ⑦ n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā ba at+pa ko3 7haṃ/ bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /stong pa nyid po7ni byang chub bo/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i nyi dkyil la—/ /der ni hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /dbus gnas las kyi rdo rje bsgom/ /slar yang hūṃ gi de nyid bsam/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba las/ /mkha' 'gro ma 11—1732

yi 'khor spyo ba/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /sku mdog dmar mo drag chen mo/ /mdung gi dbyibs can 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /spyan dmar kham skra gyen du badze+es/ /lang tsho phun sum tshogs par ldan/ /stag gi pags pa'i na bza' can/ /ljags 'dril bas ni cher 'jigs te/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par mdzad/ /de nas rdo rje sngags spro bya/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛsnra pa ya kṛsnra pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga bān bibyā rā tshodza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ der sngags tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /lha dang lha min mir bcas pa/ /phur bu yis ni btab nas su/ /hūṃ sngags 'od kyi ra ba dang / /khyad par du ni dra ba bya/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /srang ⑤ba'i 'khor lo dang sngags kyi tshig rnams so/ /shes rab mkha' dbyings dbus bsam pa / /rlung dang me yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor de bzhin te/ /'byung ba thams cad bsnyus pa las/ /gzhal yas khang brtsegs bsgom par bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /kha khyer de bzhin rdo rjes mtshan/ /sgud pa bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /dar gyi phreng bas mdzes par byas/ /dkyil 'khor grwa rnams thams cad dang / /sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnam spras pa'i/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /shes rab can gyis de yi nang / /'khor lo'i phreng bas rnam brgyan te / /de yi dbus gyur pad+ma ni/ /dkar pos shin tu mdzes par bya/ /de yi yang ni steng gyur pa/ /pad+ma mdog dmar 'bar dang bcas/ /slar yang de yi dbus gyur par/ /'od ldan pad+ma dmar po bri/ /de nas sngags pa de nang du/ /11—1733

rdo rje phreng ba kun 'khrug zi/ /slar yang pad chen 'dab brgyad pa/ /in+d+ra nī la'i 'od 'bar zi/ /rdo rje ka ba'i nang logs su/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yis rnam brgyan pa/ /ri rab lhun po'i steng du ni/ /sna tshogs pad+ma yid 'ong bsam /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /khang pa brtsegs ①ma'o/ /de dbus stan la rnal 'byor pas/ /dbyangs yi ge bcu drug las byung ba'i/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya②/ /'od zer kun du rnam par spro/ /de steng 1ye shes sa bon las/ /rdo rje nyid du bsgom par bya/ /zla ba rdo rje mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /nyi ma rdo rje'i bsam gtan gyis/ /khro bo'i lus su rnam par bsgom/ /zla ba nyi ma gnyis 'dus pa/ /lha rnams skyed par byed pa'i rgyu'o—/ /de skad du'ang / phywalis zla ba kā lis nyi/ /dbus su sa bon bsgom par bya/ /de nyid sems dpa' zhes byar bshad/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rang lus las byung 'od zer gyis/ /nam mkha' thams cad g.yogs nas ni/ /bsdus te bkug nas btsud pa yi/ /rnal 'byor zhe sdang bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zla ba ltar dkar 'dzum dang bcas/ /'od zer dmar po 'bar ba 'khrug /sangs rgyas phreng ba yang dag ldan/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis yang dag bklubs/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /ral pa dang ni cod pan ldan/ /rig pa bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /spyan gsum 'bar ba chen po ste/ /g.yas pa dkar min shin du zhi/ /g.yon pa dmar zhing 'jigs par byed—/ /rgyab zhal gser dang 'dra ba'i mdog /rdo rje kha ṭī bsnams pa dang / /de bzhin thod pa dril bu bsnams/ /thod pa la bzhugs gar dang ldan/ /dbang gnyis dga' ba'i snyoms zhugs shing / /rgyal ba'i 'od zer kun du 'khrug /11—1734

bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rgyu yi rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /shes rab gnas kyi mthar thug par/ /smon lam rnam par sbyong byed cing / /sems can don brtson sems kyis ni/ /dpa' bo srid pa sbyong bar mdzad/ /rtag tu 'dod pas myos pa yi/ /lha yi bu 'di rnams dang ni/ /gzhan yang skye bo chags can phyir/ /'dod chags thams cad dag par mdzad/ /bde chen shin tu grub bya'i phyir/ /rtog pa rgyas par sbyin pa dang / /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /rtog pa thams cad la sogs bshad/ /'das pa'i dus na sngon byung 1ba/ /rtog pa la sogs bde ba che/ /der ni rdo rje sems chen gyis/ /lhag pa yi ni lha gcig bzhugs/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad kyi/ /sems can kun don 'byung bya'i phyir/ /glu dang rol mo sogs pa'i gar/ /srid pa kun kyi gtso bor gyur/ /sems can thams cad 'byung ba'i phyir/ /dga' ba yang dag bsdus pa'i nga / /de nas sems kyi thu'agyur ba yi/ /'dod pa'i chags pa rnam spangs te/ /des 'dul bar ni mkhyen nas su/ /'dod chags chen po ston par mdzad/ /shes rab thabs kyi spyor nab yis/ /chos kyi sku yi chos nyid do/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs/ /shes rab dang kun du 'khyud pa'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /ri bo ri sul tshang tshing phug /chu bo chen po'i 'gram rnams dang / /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod du/ /der ni dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ bde ba chen po mi g.yo bas na ri bo'o/ /sems can sman par 'jug par dga' bas na ri sul te phug dang ldan pas tshang tshing ngo / /chu bo chen po'i 'gram rnams zhes bya ba ni de dang snyoms par 'jug pa shes rab kyi chu gnas pas na chu bo'i 'gram mo/ /gdod nas grub pa zhes bya ba ni rtag tu grub pa rgyaste 'char ba dang nub pa spangs 11—1735

—shing nam mkha' ltar yongs su grub pa rtag tu bde ba chen po'i tshul gyis dmigs pas de'i rang bzhin du byas pa'o/ /dur khrod ces bya ba ni sems can thams cad kyi rgyud mnyam par gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gnas so/ /lag gnyis kun du 'khyud pa ni/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud bcings brjod/ /kha sbyor lu gu rgyud du bzhed/ /slar yang rnam par grol ba'i lam/ /'bad tupa'i tshogs kyi dga' ba'o/ /rdo rje pad+ma dbye ba dang / /sgro chun sbrang rtsi byed par bshad/ /bskor ba gang phyir bskyod pa dang / /mi 'khrugs 2//rdo rjes dkrug par bya/ /der ni gsal shing zhes byar brjod/ /rdo rje thams cad mid par bya/ /rdo rje zhes bya de bzhin gshegs/ /de yi chags pa lcags kyu ste/ /lcags kyu'i sbyor ba cho gas dgug /rdo rje'i lam nas phyung nas su/ /pad+ma'i mdzod du gzhug par bya/ /dbang bskur ba yi cho ga yis/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du ni zhu/ /gsang ba'i yig gsum sngags kyi mchog /sna tshogs yi ge yang dag spro/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing gdon pa'o/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas—/ /yi ge las byung rnam spangs shing / /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med po/ /dag pa nyid du de nas son/ /de nas sems can sangs rgyas kyi/ /bla med don ni nus med pa'i/ /stong pa nyid la rtag bzhugs pas/ /'gro kun stong pas bcom nas ni/ /thams cad dmyal bar ltung mthong ste/ /slar yang bdag dang gzhan don la/ /mos pas gus pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas 'jig rten khams kun na/ /bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kun bsdus te/ /bdag la myur du bskur bar mdzod/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsu ra te 4ste/ 'dis ni bskul 11—1736

ba tsam kyis kyang / /dag pa'i bde ba kun ster ba/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed cing / /'gro kun bde ba bskyed par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /khu ba'i gtso bo bskul ba'o/ /de nas mkha' dbyengs dbus gyur par1/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams nam mkha' la/ /dpag med rigs kyis 4yongs gang ba'o/ /mkha' dbyings nyi ma de dbus su/ /rang gi sa bon mtshan ma ni/ /nyi ma stong bas lhag pa yi/ /'od zer rnon po 'bar zhing 'khrug /me stag 'phro bas bdud sde bsreg /gang bur bsdus pa'i spyor ba yis/ /zhu ba las ni skur bzhengs pa/ /zhal bzhi pa dang phyag bzhi pa'am/ /ji srid phyag ni 'bum gyi bar/ /gdan dang mdog dang phyag rgya rnams/ /rnal 'byor can gyis rtag tu bsgom/ /phyag rgya chen po'i cho ga yis/ /sgu gsum chos ni ston par mdzad/ /ting 'dzin yan lag shes par bya/ /bsgrub bya sgrub thabs rigs pas so/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin bskyed pa'o/ /nga ni 'dod pa'i gzugs kyi mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /nga nyid chos kyi sgu yi mchog / sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po yin/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi spyor 'phrog cing / /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku chen po/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung snyan pa//sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs chen yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gye mchod pa che/ /sangs rgyas kun gye rgyal po che/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi bdag /'jig rten dbang phyug kun kyi gtso/ /rin chen 'dzin pa kun gye dbang / /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rdo rje can gye yon tan no/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛhā kṛhā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛd+dhā pa ya kṛsnra pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥcebha ga bān 11—1737

bibyā ①rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhal bzhi byen gyis rlob par byed pa'i sngags gsungs te/lugs las bzlog par bya'o/ /oṃ dharma dh+wa ②tu swa bhā ba la kophohaṃ①/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal dang mdog /phyag dang bzhugs tshul de bzhin te/ /sku mdog sngon po cher drag pa/ /'jig pa'i dus kyi me 'od 'dra/ /'bar ba'i sku lus sgra che ba/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par mdzad/ /lhag ger bzhad chen chems kyi 'od/ /lha mo'i dkyil 'khor 'od kyi ni/ /'khor lo bla re dbus gnas shing / /'od ldan phyag ni bzhi bzhi dang / /thong ka sgyu ma chen mos mdzes/ /g.yon pa pad+ma rā ④ga mtshungs/ /shin tu khros pas 'jigs su rung / /sol ba'i phung po 'bar 'dra zhing / /dza ba'i ku su ma dang mtshungs/ /g.yas pa shel dang mtshungs pa ste/ /gangs dang kun+da zla ba 'dra/ /rgyab ni gser bsregs lta bur 'bar/ /nyi ma 'char ka lta bur mdzes/ /rtsa zhal sngon po chen po ste/ /spyan gsum gyis ni mdzes par byas/ /yi dwags chen po mnan nas su/ /nyi ma la bzhugs gar dang bcas/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭī ga /de bzhin gzhan na mda' dang gzhu/ /cho ga'i bya ba de nyid kyis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho bsgom par bya/ /shar ni dkar zhing 'od sngo ste/ /g.yon pa thu7kha ṭī dril bu dang / /gzhan na rdo rje thod pa'o / /byang phyogs margad 9ser skya'i mdog /g.yon na kha ṭī zhags pa dang / /g.yas na rnge'u 7chung thod pa bsnams/ /nub phyogs dmar zhing ser skya'i 'od/ /gzhu dang mda' yi mdog dang ni/ /sna tshogs pad+ma thod pa dag /g.yon dang g.yas kyi phyag tu dgod/ /lho ni dkar zhing ser ba'i 'od/ /g.yon na mdung dang rin chen te/ /g.yas na ba dan thod pa bsnams/ /glang chen ce spyang mi dang ni—/ /glang gi thod pa cho ga bzhin/ /dang po ltung byed ma yin te/ /gnyis pa 11—1738

gsod byed ma yin la/ /gsum pa 'gugs pa zhes bya ste/ /bzhi pa gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /rig ma hūṃde dag gyen skra 'bar/ /rgyan rnams thams cad rnam par bklubs/ /gar dang ldan pas yang dag bzhugs/ /phyogs mtshalas dag ni bzhi po ru/ /thod pa rnam pa bzhi po dgod/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyis ②rnam brgyan pa/ /spyi gtsug gsal bar yang dag ldan/ /bde ba chen po rin chen che/ /'byung ba bzhi yi tshogs dang ldan/ /skye dang gnas dang 'gag pa rnams/ /rtag tu lha mo bzhi yi dngos/ /oṃ ha ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste snying gar ro/ /na ma nyi ni 1rnam par snang mdzad de mgo bor ro/ /swā hā hu ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ste spyi gtsug tu'o/ /bo ṣaṭa he ni dpal he sngeru ka ste phrag pa gnyis la'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ ho ni rdo rje nyi ma ste mig gnyis su'o/ /phaṭa haṃ rta mgrin te yan lag thams cad kyi cho ga'o / /de nas rang gi snying gar rdo rje'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la thugs rdo rje hūṃ gis bskyed par bya'o/ /oṃ dhīḥha ha hūṃ ṭ+wāhūṃ phaṭa kyis ni mgrin par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i gsung rdo rje'o/ oṃ badz+ra he he ru ru ke hūṃ ⑥hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dz+wa 7 la sasbra ra 8swā hā/ zhes bya bas ni dpral ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i sku rdo rje'o/ /de dag ni rdo rje sems dpa' spugo cha dang / sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /lte ba la ni oṃ baṃ ste rdo rje phag mo'o/ /snying gar haṃ oṃ ste gshin rje ma'o/ /khar ni hri bimo ste rmongs byed ma'o/ /mgo bor ni tre hri ⑪ste kun du skyong byed ma'o/ /spyi gtsug tu ni hūṃ hūṃ ste ⑫kun du skrag byed ma'o/ /yan lag thams cad kyi mtshon char ni phaṭa phaṭa te gtum pa mo'o/ /oṃ sarba budhe ḍā ki ⑫nī ye badz+ra laṇ+ḍi bhā ye hūṃ rnguhūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya bas ni lte bar thugs rdo rje lta bu'o / /oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hūṃ 8hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya bas ni snying gar 11—1739

sku zurdo rje lta bu'o/ /oṃ bo ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces bya bas ni/ khar te gsung rdo rje lta bu'o—/ /de ltar gang zhig kun bstan pa/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lus las byung / /shes rab zla ba'i stan la gnas/ /sna tshogs mdog tu bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid kyi las dute nye bar bsgrub 1pa'i sgrub thabs so ye shes dam tshig las byung ba/ /de ni rdo rje can du brjod/ /ces bya ba la ye shes ni —ye shes sems dpa'o/ /dam tshig ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de'i rim pa yang 'di yin te/ rang gi sa bon mtshan ma las/ /snying gar ye shes sems dpa' dgod/ /de yi 'od kyis drangs nas ni/ /ye shes 'khor lo rab mchod bya/ /rdo rje srung 3snaba'i go cha ni/ /mnyam par gzhag pas thams cad bya/ /de 'og dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bdag gi lus la gzhug par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa'o/ /dbang bskur go 'phang bsgoms nas ni/ /de 'og mchod pa brtag par bya/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i rim pa yis/ /mdun du rgyal ba bkug nas ni/ /mchod pa kun gyis mchod nas ni/ /dbang bskur phyir ni gsol ba gdab/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma kun dang / /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon po yis/ /brtse bas bdag la dbang bskur gsol/ /des ni sangs rgyas he ru ka'i/ /tshul du nam mkhar bzhugs nas ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis gang ba yi/ /bum pa kha dog lngar ldan pa'i/ /kun nas dbang ni skur 'ubar mdzad/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi7 / /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /11—1740

rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /rgyal bas dbang ni bskur nas su/ /spyan ma la sogs glu len cing / /mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis kyang / /mchod pa kun gyis rab mchod byed/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /dbang bsgur ba yang 1mchod pa'o/ /mtshan ma gnyis la sngags sbyar bya/ /de yi rim pa 5'di yin te/ /bu mo yi ni sna rtse ru/ /a zhes bya ba dgod par bya/ /rang gi rdo rje'i bu gar ni/ /baṃ zhes bya ba yang dag sbyar / /gang yang gzhan dag 'chad pa ni/ /byā zhes bya ba pad+ma la/ /byā rngoni rdo rje'i rtse mor ro/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyes gsungs/ /shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid dga' ba ste sbyor ba dang po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje pad+ma bye nas su/ /lam gyi tshogs kyi rgyun nas ni/ /slar yang spro zhing gtang bar bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo kun/ /pad+ma'i lte bar nges par sbyar/ /a wa sgru tī'i 4gnas de bzhin/ /smin ma'i bar du gzhag par bya/ /dbyangs yig dang po yang dag ldan/ /bsgoms na skad cig de la 'bar/ /de nas 'bar phreng rgya mtshor ni/ /kun nas sgo yi 'khor lo bsam/ /mgal me 'khor lo la gnas pa/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs ni de bzhin 'khor/ /yid shugs chen pos gsal ba'i mdangs/ /glog lta bur ni gsal ba'i 'od/ /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul gyis ni/ /sa rnams kun du spro bar bya/ /de nyid dbye bas phye nas su/ /rtsa rnams thams cad lam du sbyar/ /sngags pas rang dgar dbye byas te/ /phyin ci log tu nges par sbyar/ /char gcod pa dang phan 'dogs pa'i/ /las kyi mchog tu rnam par bsgom/ /sbyor ba yi ni don rnams la/ /dga' chen rnyed dka' 'di yis bsgrub//11—1741

ye shes ldan pa'i rang skye ①gnas/ /yul dang yul du mngon par skye /mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs 'di dag /rang rang sa la rnam par rol/ /mgo bo pul+lī dur yin te—/ /so dang sen mo rab tu 'bab/ /rab gtum mo dang thod dum gyis/ /shar byi rtsibs su yang dag bzhugs/ /spyi gtsug dzā larnya ra ste/ /skra dang spu ni rab tu 'bab/ /gtum mig keng rus chen po yis/ /lus ngan phyogs su yang dag bzhugs/ /oḍā1na zhes bya'i gnas chen po/ /rna ba g.yas pa'i bla dgas te/ /nub tu pags pa dri ma lags④/ /'od ldan keng rus tshul gyis bzhugs/ /arbu da ni rgyab kyi ⑤phyogs/ /sha chen dag ni 'bab pa las/ /mche ba gcigs dang sna chen ma/ /lho yi phyogs su yang dag bzhugs/ /de dag ni gnas so/ /go dā ba rī 'u rna g.yon te/ /rtag tu rgyus pa 'bab pa las/ /dpa' bo'i blo ma lha yi dgra//dbang ldan mtshams su bzhugs par bsam/ /smin dbus rā me shwa rī ②7ste/ /rtag tu rus pa 'bab pa las/ /mi thung mgon po 'od dpag med/ /rlung gi mtshams su bzhugs par gyur/ /mig gnyis lha mo'i mkha' ⑧ yin te/ /rtag tu mchin pa 'bab pa las/ /lang ka'i dbang mo rdo rje 'od/ /bden bral mtshams su bzhugs par gyur/ /mā la be ni dpung g.yas te/ /rtag tu snying 'phrul 'bab pa las/ /ljon grib ma ni rdo rje'i ⑨sku/ /byin za'i mtshalas su bzhugs par gyur—/ /de dag ni nye ba'i gnas so/ /yul de kun na gnas pa rnams/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo yang dag bzhugs/ /mkha' la spyod pa zhes bya ste/ /snyoms par zhugs pas yang dag bzhugs/ /mtshan khung kā ma rū ⑫pa ste/ /rtag tu mig ni 'bab pa las/ /sa srung ⑫ ma dang myu gu can/ /shar gyi 'dab mar yang dag bzhugs/ /r+ṣaṭi ⑫nu ma gnyis yin te/ /mkhris pa'i khams ni 'bab pa las/ /11—1742

rdo rje ral can 'jigs byed ma/ /lus ngan phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ /zhing ngo / /lte bar tri sha ku ni ste/ /rtag tu glo ba 'bab pa las/ /rlung shugs dpa' bo chen mo ①ni/ /nub kyi 'dab mar brten te bzhugs/ /ko sa la ni sna rtse ste/ /rgyu ma'i phreng ba 'bab pa las/ /chang 'thung rdo rje hūṃ mdzad du/ /lho yi phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ /nye ba'i zhing ngo / /kha ni ka ling ga yin te/ /gnye ma'i khams ni rab tu 'bab/ /sngo bsangs lha mo shin tu bzang / /yi dwags phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ /mgrin pa las+thā ka yin te/ /bong bu'i lto ni 'bab pa las/ /shin tu bzang mo rdo rje bzang / /rlung gi mtshams su bzhugs par gyur/ /rol sa'o/ /snying ga kā: ②yul yin te/ /rtag tu chu so 'bab pa las / /rta rna ma dang 'jigs byed de/ /srin po'i mtshams su bzhugs par gyur / /kha ba can ni chu so ste/ /mtshog ④ma'i srubs ni 'bab pa las bya gdong ma dang mig mi bzang / /me yi mtshams su bzhugs par gyur/ /nye ba'i rol sa'o/ /yul de kun na gang gnas pa/ /gsung gi 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /sa la rgyu ba zhes bya ste/ /snyoms par zhugs pas yang dag gnas/ /mtshan ni yi dwags lha gnas te/ /bad kan khams ni rtag tu 'bab/ /'khor lo shugs ma stobs po che/ /sku yi 'khor lo shar rtsibs bzhugs/ /bshang lam lha yi khyim yin te/ /rnag 'bab khaṇ+ḍa ro hā ④dang / /rin chen rdo rje lus ngan du/ /'du ba can no/ /sau rāṣ+ṭa ni brla gnyis te/ /khrag gi khams ni 'bab pa las/ /glang sna dang ni rta mgrin du/ /nub kyi phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ /byin pa gnyis ni gser gling ste/ /rtag tu rdul ni 'bab pa las/ /'khor lo'i go cha nam mkha'i snying / /lho yi phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ /nye ba'i 'du ba can no//11—1743

sor mo rnams ni grong khyer te/ /tshil ni rab tu 'bab pa las/ /shin tu dpa' mo he ru kar/ /yi dwags mtshams su bzhugs par gyur/ /sen+tu rkang pa'i bol yin te/ /rtag tu mchi ma 'bab pa las/ /stobs chen pad+ma gar dbang phyug /rlung gi mtshalas su dgod par bya/ /dur khrod do/ /mya ngan yul ni mthe bo ste/ /lud pa dag ni 'bab pa las/ /'khor los ①sgyur ma rnam snang mdzad/ /bden bral mtshalas su dgod par bya'o bu/ /ku lu tā ni pus mo ste/ /rtag tu sna chu 'bab pa las/ /brtson chen rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /me yi mtshams su dgod par bya/ /nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /yul ni de dag thams cad nyid/ /sku yi 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /sa 'og gnas pa zhes bya ste/ /snyoms par zhugs pas rab tu bzhugs/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog par ni1 / /pho nya rnams ni yang dag gnas/ /khwa gdong ma ni shar sgor te/ /byang sgor 'ug pa'i gdong pa can/ /nub sgor khyi yi gdong pa can/ /phag gi gdong can lho sgor dgod/ /dbang ldan gshin rje brtan ma ste/ /gshin rje pho nya me mtshalas su/ /bden bral gshin rje mche ba can/ /gshin rje 'joms ma rlung mtshams dgod/ /ma ning yi ge bzhi las ni/ /sgo bzhi rnams su bsgom par bya/ /sha ṣa sa ha las byung ba/ /dbang ldan la sogs yang dag gnas/ /ro la bcibs shing me ltar 'bar/ /nyi ma la bzhugs gar dang bcas/ /spyan gsum mche ba gcigs pa ste/ /phyag na kha ṭī thod pa gri/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par bklubs/ /'od zer sna tshogs rnam par 'phro/ /khro gnyer rim pa ldan la sogs/ /zur mig blta zhing rnam par g.yo/ /khā gdong la sogs gcer bu ste/ /mgul do spyi gtsug dpung rgyan dang / /rna cha tshangs pa'i sbud par bcas/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas mgul par brgyan/ /rkang 11—1744

gnyis khrol khrol sgra dang bcas/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnyis ldan par/ /dpa' bo rdo rje dril bsnams te/ /phyag ni gnyis kun 'khyud pa yin/ /he ru ka ni sku las byung / /mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sku las byung / /dam tshig ye shes las byung ba'i/ /de nas rdo rje can du brjod/ /dbang bskur go 'phang bsgoms nas ni/ /de nas mchod pa yang dag brtsam1/ /de dag thams cad sngon bzhin bya/ /da ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun lha'i sbyor bas rnam par gzhag ②par bya ste/ rtsang byed ma ni lus dran pa nye bar gzhag 1pa'o/ /gsod byed ④ma ni tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /'gugs byed ma ni chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /gar gyi dbang phyug ma ni sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /rab tu gtum mo ni 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa'o/ /gtum mig ma ni brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o / /'od ldan ma ni dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ /sna chen ma ni sems kyi rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa'o/ /dpa' bo'i blo ma ni dad pa'i dbang po'o/ /mi thung ma ni brtson 'grus kyi dbang po'o/ /lang ka'i dbang phyug ma ni dran pa'i dbang po'o—/ /ljon grib ma ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po'o/ /sa srung ma ni shes rab kyi dbang po'o/ /'jigs byed ma ni dad pa'i stobs so/ /rlung shugs ma ni brtson 'grus kyi stobs so/ /chang 'thung ma ni dran pa'i stobs so/ /sngo bsangs lha mo ni ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs so/ /shin tu bzang mo ni shes rab kyi stobs so/ /rta rna ma ni ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /bya gdong ma ni brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /'khor lo shugs ma ni dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /dum skyes ma ni shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang 11—1745

chub kyi yan lag go/ /glang sna ma ni chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /'khoralo'i go cha ma ni dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /shin tu dpa' mo ni btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /stobs chen ma ni yang dag pa'i lta ba'o/ /'khor los sgyur ma ni yang dag pa'i rtog pa'o/ /brtson 'grus chen mo ni yang dag pa'i ngag go/ /khwa gdong ma ni yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'o/ /'ug gdong ma ni yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba'o/ /khyi gdong ma ni yang dag pa'i rtsol ba'o/ /phag gdong ma ni yang dag pa'i dran pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyed pa ni gshin rje brtan ma'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams srung ①ba ni gshin rje pho nya ma'o/ /sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spang ba ni gshin rje mche ba ma'o/ /sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed pa ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun lhas rnam par sbyar ba'o/ /snying ga'i dbus gyur pad+ma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad dang ge sar bcas/ /de yi dbus su gnas pa'i rtsa—/ /mar me lta bu'i gzugs can te/ /chu shing gi ni me tog ltar/ /rtag tu 'phyang zhing 'og tu blta/ /de yi dbus bzhugs dpa' bo ni/ /yungs kar sbom po'i tshad tsam ste/ /hūṃ gi sa bon mi shigs pa/ /kha ba lta bu 'bab pa yin/ /ba san+ta zhes bya ba yin/ /lus can rnams kyi snying dga' byed/ /rgod ma'i khar ni me yi gzugs/ /phag mo'i ti la ⑤kar ni bzhed/ /las kyi rlung gis bskyod nas su—/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas ni 'bar/ /ba san+ta dang phrad pas mnyes/ /snyoms par 'jug pas yang dag bzhugs/ /'di ni ṭīte ru ka yi/ /ba san nyi 11—1746

la tshu)ka ru bzhed/ /gzugs sogs rgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ /stong pa nyid du yang dag gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bye brag gis/ /sgo gsum nas ni yang dag rgyu/ /'gro ba dang ni 'ong ba ru/ /de dag thams cad lus la gnas/ /lte bar a yi gzugs kyi chani/ /thung ngu zhes ni bya bar grags/ /snying gar gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ / /ring po 1cha gnyis tshad du gnas/ /mgrin par gnas pa'i yi ge dze+e /cha gsum pa 4lu ta zhes brjod/ /dpral bar gnas pa'i yi ge haṃ/ /sgra dang thig le mi shigs pa/ /'khor lo bzhi yi bye brag gis/ /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po yin//mtshalas bzhi ru ni lhag par gnas/ /pad+ma bzhi las yang dag byung / /dga' ba bzhi yi tshul gyis ni/ /sbyor ba bzhi las mchog tu gnas/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bya ba dang ni byed pa'i dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'dir ni ji ltar bde bar ro⑤/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni 'dab ma la/ /'byung ba bzhi yi rtsa bzhi ni/ /mar me lta bu'i gzugs can de/ /mtshams kyi cha la gnas nas su/ /rtsa ni gang dag rgyu ba dag /bdud rtsi lnga ni rgyu ba ste/ /mchod pa'i gzugs kyis de la brten/ /de yi gzugs kyi rang bzhin dag /mchod pa bzhi zhes bya bar bshad/ /'di ni lus can snying dbus na/ /rtsa brgyad du ni rnam par gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bye brag gis/ /gzhan yang nyi shu rtsa bzhir brjod/ /gnas sogs sa la brten nas su/ /gnas dang gnas su yang dag brten/ /mgo bo las ni yang dag byung / /rtsa ni mgo la skyes zhes brjod/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa'i gzugs/ /de dbus sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i gtso/ /rim pa dag ni 'di nyid kyis/ /blo dang ldan pas phyag rgya bya/ /khwa gdong la sogs sngon ji bzhin/ /ltung byed la sogs rnam par dag /bcom ldan rdo rje 11—1747

can rmis gsungs/ /phyag rgya rnams ni ①mtshon cha'o/ /a las skyes pa'i thod par ni/ /rdzas bcu dag ni bsam par bya/ /rlung dang me yi dkyil 'khor gyis/ /bsro 3ba dang ni 'bar bar bya/ /dang po'i 1yi ge ldan pa ru/ /bsgoms na skad cig de la 'bar/ /yi ge go bzlog sbyor ba yis/ /rgyud la sngags ni bsgom par bya / /oṃ ni thams cad 'bar byed de/ /de nyid gsum ni yang dag brjod/ /lha mo de ltar bsgoms pa yi/ /rdzas kyis ④dngos grub 'bras bu sprul/ /spyor ba 'di yis byedangos grub kyi/ /yid ches yang dag 'jug par 'gyur/ /thams cad kyis ni mi mthong zhing / /rnal 'byor can ni skad cig mthong / /lha mchog las skyes phrogs nas su/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi bu mo spyad 6/ /gaṅgā'i klung mnyam sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje gsum gyi gnas bzhugs pa/ /lag tu shing tog bzhag pa bzhin/ /rdo rje'i mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i klung mnyam zhing rnams ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan nyid rnams/ /sems kyi rol mo las phyung bar/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid can gyis mthong / /'di ni mchog tu gsang chen te/ /sbyor ba kun gye dam pa yin/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyes gsungs/ /bdud rtsi myang ba ste thu/dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin to/ /yi ge pho nya la sogs sngags/ /mda' yi shugs kyis yongs su 'khor/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /sde tshan brgyad kyis shin tu bskor/ /sngags rnams thams cad 'byung ba ste/ /gzhan yang ci yang rung ba ste/ /sgra lnga dag ni yang dag ldan/ /ya ra la bas rnam par brgyan/ /chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ /lus can rnams kyi snying dga' byed/ /cha rnams bzhi po dag gis ni/ /kun nas yongs su bskor ba ste/ /longs spyod 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ /ro rnams kyi ni rten rang bzhin/ /11—1748

bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo che/ /byang chub sems ni sum cu gnyis/ /zla ba nyi ma zhes bya ba/ /g.yon dang g.yas kyi ngos gnyis su/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi / /'gro dang 'ong ba byed pa'i rgyu/ /gnas gnyis la ni rtag brten nas/ /'og dang steng du yang dag brten/ /g.yon dang g.yas kyi ngos gnyis su/ /de bzhin dbyangs yig bcu gnyis ni/ /rtag tu steng du bltas par bri/ /ka sogs 'og tu bltas pa ni/ /ngos gnyis dag tu spel ba ste/ /dbus su de ni sbyar bar bya / /de ltar bstan pa 'di dag ni/ /rtsa dang sgra yi rang bzhin no/ /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje ste/ /mkha' 'gro sgra yi rang bzhin no/ /nges 'byung sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /gang du skye ba zhes byar grags/ /shin tu rnam dag ye shes che / /lha mo kun gyi rang bzhin gang / /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ste/ /mchog tu bde bar brjod pa yin/ /rang byung gi ni gzugs 'di nyid/ /spro dang sdud par byed pa'o/ /yi ge pho nya la sogs bsngags/ /der ni cha dang bral ba gang / /bha ga'i dbus su gzugs med pa/ /de ni rtag tu gnas pa yin/ /smin dbus thig le'i pad+ma ru/ /bcu drug skud pas bskor ba yin/ /shes rab thabs kyi mnyam spyor gyis/ /kha sbyor zhes byar brjod pa yin/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa ni/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs gang / /'di ni kun mkhyen zhes bya ste/ /kun du 'gro ba mi shigs pa'o/ /pad+ma yi ni sna rtse ru/ /rgyu dang mi rgyur bcas par bsgom/ /yid kyis bzlas dang yang dag ldan/ /ngag dang yi ge rnam par spangs/ /nges pa'i go 'phang rtag tu gnas/ /brtan pa chos dbyengs rang bzhin no/ /shin tu phra ba rdul dang bral/ /ye shes sku ste dri ma med//gsal ba mchog gi rang bzhin te/ /mya ngan 'das pa 'ba' zhig yul/ /phan 11—1749

tshun 'dud pa'i gsang sngags ni/ /yul nyid kyis ni dbye bar bya/ /sa bon phreng ba de nas bsgom/ /hūṃ gi skud pas bcings pa ste/ /bsgrub bya 'gog par gyur na ni/ /gom pa gcig kyang mi 'gro'o/ /sngags dang thig le 'di dag ni/ /kun rdzob byang chub sems bsgom par/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /'di yi shes rab lhan skyes te/ /de yi gzugs su gyur pas gnas/ /las kyi rlung gis bskyod nas su/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di nas 'bar/ /sgyu ma chen mo zhes byar bshad/ /las rnams thams cad ①sgrub pa'o/ /skra rtse brgyar gyur pa yi cha—/ /skad cig glog gi 'od zer can/ /lha yi rnal 'byor lus su ni/ /lte ba'i sgo yi bu ga nas/ /phyogs rnams kun du spros nas ni/ /lha dang lha min kun bsregs te/ /snying ga'i chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /bsregs te longs spyod 'khor lor song / /sna bug g.yas nas byung nas ni/ /slar yang zhugs te smin mtshalas kyi—/ /mdzod spu'i khung nas byung nas ni/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ /sna sgo g.yon du zhugs nas ni—/ /spyi bo'i 'khor lo bsregs nas su/ /sngon gyi lam nas slar byung ste/ /be+er yang spyi gtsug tu ni zhugs/ /bsregs par gyur pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /dga' ba bskyed nas lte ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni song gyur nas— / /sngon bzhin du ni gnas par gyur/ /dga' ba skad cig bye brag gis/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i bsam gtan no/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya—/ /ma hā kalpa aghi sa: bhā ya/ dza geṭā ma ku ṭoṅka ṭā ya/ rdaṭī 4 /ka rā lo gra dhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ sa ha sra bhu dza bha ⑤su rā ya/ pa ra shu bā shobyā ta shu la kha ṭī ga dha 11—1750
