bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (329)11—1759

༷401༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na nyid snang ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra sasba ra sa ha dza tadh+wa ulo ka bod skad du / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na nyid snang ba/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la brten nas rang rig bde chen po/ /stong dang snying rje dbyer med mtshon pa'i gzhi/ /chos dang longs sprul bde ba chen po yi/ /rang bzhin rtsa yi 'khor lo'i mgon btud nas/ /'khor lo bde mchog dpal rim las byung las/ /spyod 'chang mgon po'i zhal snga las rnyed pa'i/ /rang rig bde chen ye shes mtshon pa'i thabs/ /dpyid dang thig le bsgom pa'i man ngag bshad/ /bsam gtan khang pa rnam g.yeng skye bo yi/ /'du 'dzi dang bral rnam par dben pa'i sar/ /yongs su 'dzin pa ma lus rnam spangs te/ /mi g.yo rtse gcig ting 'dzin mchog bsgrub bya/ /bde ba'i stan gnas rdo rje skyil krung dang / /lag gnyis mnyam par gzhag pa'i phyag rgya can/ /lus bsrangs nas ni 11—1760

mgrin pa dgug pa dang / /mig gnyis sna yi rtse mor mnyam sbyar zhing / /gang la rgyan dang cha lugs phyag mtshan dang / /mtshan dang dpe byad ma lus yongs rdzogs pa—/ /rang snang shes rab phag mo dang 'dus pa'i/ /gnyis med bde ba'i rang bzhin rang lha'i sku/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu dri za'i grong khyer dang / /bar ma'i srid dang chu zla lta bu yi/ /lus kyi dbus gnas sa sogs 'byungab bzhi/ /byams dang snying rje dga' dang btang snyoms dang / /spyan ①sogs rig ma bzhi yi bdag nyid dang / /chos dang longs sprul bde ba che rang bzhin/ /e baṃ ma yā rtsa yi 'khor lo la / /dbyangs dang gsal byed byang chub yi ger ldan/ /rdul dang snying stobs myun pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /rtsa gsum gyis ni yang dag bhel byas pa/ /yon tan skyon gyi rang bzhin rtsa gnyis la/ /brten nas steng dang 'og gi sgo gnyis nas/ /'byung dang 'jug pa srog dang rtsol ba yi/ /gang du mi g.yo rtse gcig gyur pa las//dang po ri dwags sred bzhin snang ba dang / /mtshan gnyis pa dang du ba'i rnam pa can—/ /gsum pa srin bu me khyer dang 'dra zhing / /bzhi pa sgon ma 'bar ba lta bu dang / /mtshan ma lnga pa rnam par ma brtags par/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bu 'byung 'gyur zhing / /de tshe gang du ye shes me 'bar ba/ /gsal ①ba glog gi 'od dang mtshungs pa yi/ /steng du 'phro bas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'be+ebs shing / /bde chen rang rig ye shes ster bar byed/ /gang la brten nas skyes pa'i ye shes dang —/ /rang rig las gzhan brjod par mi nus shing / /dngos dang dngos med rtog pa las grol ba/ /bde chen de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig skyes pas thog med 'khor ba nas/ /bsags pa'i sgrib pa ma lus kun spong ba/ /gnyis med bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyi/ /gnyug ma'i ye shes de la bdag phyag 11—1761

'tshal/ /rtog pa gang gis rtog pa kun gcod cing / /sna tshogs snang ba'i dngos kun der mtshon pa/ /bde chen rang rig ye shes gcig pu pa/ /gnyis med rtogs pa'i mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gang la bstod dang gang gis bstod pa dang | /ji ltar bstod cing phyag 'tshal dang bral ba/ /spros tshogs gdags pa'i mtha' las rab 'das pa'i/ /mnyam nyid de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig goms pa mthar phyin pas/ /kun du rtog pa kun spong zhing / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes mchog /tshe 'di nyid la ster bar byed/ /brtul zhugs spyod 'chang bla med pa/ /'bar ba'i gtso bo'i bka' drin las/ /rtog pa'i don gang 'dir bsdus pas/ /'gro kun rdo rje 'chang thob shog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na nyid snang ba slob dpon chen po dpag med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa dri paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta dang / k+ṣiṃtsār+ya mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba'o// //11—1762

04༷2 ༄khya/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgong po'i de kho na nyid bsdus pa/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra sadza ra tadh+wa gar+bha saṃ gra ha/ bod skad du/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i snying po'i de kho na nyid bsdus pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas dag cing gdod nas grol/ /gdod nas zhi ba'i bdag nyid can/ /dngos po kun gyi de bzhin nyid/ /gzung 'dzin bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blta bar dka' zhing rtogs par dka'/ /brjod 'das tshig gis mtshon min par/ /rang gi rig pa'i ye shes ni/ /gnyis med gsal ba'i rang bzhin can/ /gang zhig dri mas bsgribs pa'i sems/ /yul du snang ba'i rjes 'jug pa/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ste/ /chags sdang rnam rmongs las la ni/ /rnam g.yeng sdug bsngal dang bcas pa'i/ /'khor ba mngon par 'grub pa'o/ /gang gis bla ma'i drin thob nas/ /sems kyi de nyid rig pa gang //ri dbang rtse nas lhung ba ltar/ /grol ba'i thabs ni bla na med/ /gzhan du 11—1764

dka' thub mi bzad sogs/ /lus nyon mongs par byed pa yis/ /thar ba'i 'bras bu mi rnyed par/ /slar zhing rnam par 'khor bar 'gyur/ /gang gis sems kyi de nyid rig /de las gzhan du grol ba'i thabs/ /bzlas dang bsam gtan la sogs pa/ /pha rol sgol ba'i gru bzhin 'dor/ /de bas bzlas med bsam gtan dang / /dka' thub med cing sbyin sreg med/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor ba med pa/ /rang rig ye shes gcig pu nyid/ /rnam thar bzhi yi rang bzhin dang / /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid can/ /rten 'byel bcu gnyis dag pa yis/ /zhal phyag rnam pa'i gzugs can nyid/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med sku/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /gcig pu'i nyams ni du ma'i gar/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam pa'o/ /gang gis de yongs shes pa yis/ /rang bzhin de ni rtogs 'gyur na/ /gzhan du spros pa sna tshogs kyang //grol ba'i rgyu nyid kho na'o/ /de phyir rang rig mtshon pa yi/ /thabs kyi spros pa sna tshogs pa/ /gaṅgā'i rgya mtsho'i ro bzhin du/ /spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin byed/ /de bas gang gis thabs rig pas/ /bsam gtan la ni mngon par gzhol/ /gzings la legs par sbyor ba ltar/ /sems kyi de nyid mthong bar 'gyur/ /'dir ni phung po khams rnams dang / /skye mched drug las rnam grol ba/ /sgyu ma'i gzugs la legs gnas pa'i/ /e baṃ rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /bcu drug— thog mar thig ler bcas/ /dro ba rnams kyi bzhi pa la/ /dbyangs kyi drug pa dang ldan pa/ /zla phyed thig les rnam par mdzes/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum thig les brgyan/ /ya tshogs brgyad pa'i mtha' gnas pa/ /gzhom med bde ba che rang bzhin/ /nā da thig le dang bcas pa'o/ /srog dang rtsol ba legs bsdams 11—1765

te/ /sprul par rlung lnga bcings pa yis/ /du ba la sogs rtags mthong nas/ /ye shes me ni rnam par 'bar/ /glog gi 'od dang mtshungs pa yi/ /gsal ba'i gzugs can byen 'gro bas/ /steng nas byang chub sems blangs te/ /'o ma'i rgyun gyi ①rnam par 'bab/ /lte bar gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug las/ /ye shes skyes gang rang bzhin ni/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs shing / /chags dang chags med 'dres gyur pa'i/ /lhan skyes yang dag byang chub nyid/ /zla ba nyi ma'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /nam mkha' sems gcig gyur pa las/ /rlung rnams ma lus der bcings te/ /yid ni ri bong khrultar gnas byed/ /nyin dang mtshan mo rnams spangs shing / /'gro dang 'ong ba las grol ba/ /dus gsum mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bde ba che| /rang bzhin gnyug ma lhan cig skyes/ /dngos po kun rmi de kho na/ /sems kyi de nyid mthong ba po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rnam dag pa/ /gzung 'dzin dri bral mngon sangs rgyas/ /dmigs med snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /'gyur ba med pa'i ngo bos bzhugs/ /rin chen sems las gzhan gyur pa/ /'khor med skya ngan 'das pa med/ /sems kyi de nyid rig pa la/ /'khor nyid skya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /dpal ldan mgon po spyod 'chang ba'i/ /drin gyis rtogs pa de nyid gang / /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i snying po yis/ /'gro ba'i sgrib shes sgrib sel shog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i snying po de kho na nyid bsdus pa slob dpon ku sa ⑧li pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rdo rje slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug dang / k+ṣiṃtsār+ya ④mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba'o// //11—1766

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ sa ha dza tarwa ulo ka bod skad du/ lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na nyid snang ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun ②spyod mngon par 'byung brngod sogs/ /rgyu dze+ernams kun du sbas pa dze+e /zab mo'i de nyid gsang ches pa/ /bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pas ④bshad/ /brtag dka' rtog ge'i yul min zhing / /zab mo spros pa nyer zhi ba/ /lkugs pa yi ni mi lam dang / /gzhon nus myong ba'i bde ba ltar/ /tshig gis mtshon min rang rig pa/ /ser sna med sogs tshul bzhi yis/ /bla ma nye bar bsten pa yi/ /drin thob shes rab ye shes kyi/ /skad cig gsum par gang skyes pa/ /don mtshungs mtshon pas dper nyid de/ /khyim gnas bu ga'i nam mkha' dang / /dmus long glang chen yan lag ltar/ /don mthong ma yin 'bras zan gyis/ /spags pa'i bu ram ro bzhin no/ /cha shas dang ni rdzogs pa dang / /sgrib bcas 11—1768

sgrib pa dang bral ba'i/ /dbye ba las ni rnam rmongs pas/ /chos ma thag dang gang ba yi/ /zla ba sprin gyis bsgribs pa dang / /gsal ba'i bye brag ma shes so/ /de lta na yang der myong ba/ /bla ma'i gsung gis legs mtshon te/ /rgyud du yang dag goms pa lag /dang ba'i chu la zla ba dang / /mig dag pa la gzugs bzhin du/ /gsal bar 'gyur kyi yid ches kyis/ /dngos po sna tshogs snang 'di rnams/ /sems las phyi rol 'gyur rmed kyang / /rang rig bag chags dbang byas nas/ /yul dang dbang por snang ba'i sems/ /dbang po'i lam na rjes 'gro bas/ /yul rnams la ni mngon zhugs te/ /chags sogs nyon mongs rgyur gyur pa/ /las kyi shing rta'i ①'khor lo ltar/ /yun ring srid par yang dang yang / /sdug bsngal dang bcas rnam par 'khor/ /nang du yang dag 'jog pa yi—/ /thabs kyis de las rnam bzlog nas/ /rlung bral mar me lta bu yi/ /rnal 'byor rgyun du goms byas nas/ /ma rnyog lteng ka'i chu bzhin du/ /rang gi de nyid gsal mthong 'gyur/ /shin tu bzhin bzangs mig yangs ma/ /gzugs bzang lang tsho phun tshogs pa/ /khro med rjes su brtse ba dang / /dad dang thos sogs yon tan can/ /sgrub las gzhan du mi blta zhing / /skal bzang byed pa 'ching ba yi/ /sbyor ba la ni rab goms pa④/ /mi mo dngos grub sa gzhi yin/ /de dang lhan cig dbe+en par gnas/ /stobs bzang stsos byed bcas bza' zhing //blta ba dang 2 reg pa dang / /'khyud dang ma mchu'i ro myangs pas/ /rjes su chags par 'gyur ba ni/ /mtshan ma'i dbye bas gsal rtogs bya/ /chags pa chen pos rab rgyas rtsa/ /'tshir dang zlos pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mngon sum lce yi thur mas drangs/ /nor bu'i nang du legs chud pas/ /mun pa la ni mar me 11—1769

ltar| /gsal bar nges kyis gzhan du min/ /de nyid du ni ye shes mchog /sdom bya thun nam nyin gcig gam/ /zla byed zla gcig khyad kor dang / /bskal pa bskal pa stong dag tu/ /de goms pa las mi 'gyur ba'i/ /ye shes dam pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /der ni legs 'du'i dam tshig rdzas/ /rlung gi stobs kyis thob pa'am/ /dman pa'i sems kyis dor min pas/ /phyi rol nas ni lces blang bya| /bla ma'i drin thob dga' ba yis/ /sems kyi ①zab mo'i de kho na/ /legs bkod gang 'dis 'gro ba rnams/ /gnyug ma'i lam gyi ②bgrod grub shog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na nyid snang ba slob dpon ku sa li ①pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //brtsar ma na/176/ ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung lasam sate bkod/ ②rtertepe 〉〉rtertesnar 〉〉sku ③〈‘pe 〉〉rterjosnar 〉〉 ga ④rte〈pe 〉〉rtertesnar 〉〉par/ ⑤〈rtepe 〉〉rtertesnar 〉〉gyig1769 ①rtertesnar 〉〉shi pa'i/ ②rtertepe 〉〉rtertesnar 〉〉nag177 ①rtertepe 〉〉rte〈snar 〉〉kyig ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈rtesnar 〉〉gyig ③nartepe 〉〉〈rtesnar 〉〉su lug11—1770

༄/ /dpal 'gor lo sdom pa'i de go na nyid kyi man ngag①༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra sasbra ra tadh+wa u pa de sha bod skad du/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa'i de nyid mtshon pa yi/ /e waṃ sbyor ba las skyes pa/ /mkha' mnyam dri ma rnam spangs pa'i/ /dbyer med chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyud rnams kun du ches gsang ba/ /bla ma rim brgyud las 1'ongs nas/ /ji bzhin bdag gis nges rtogs pa/ /de 'dir rnam par gsal bar bya①/ /'khor lo sdom pa pad+ma'i tshal/ /spyod 'chang gsung gi nyi zer gyis/ /bye ④bas legs thob snying po mchog /'gro rnams tshims par byed pa 'di'o/ /gang du bskal pa grangs med par/ /'bad kyang 'dod don mi 'thob pa/ /de 'dir tshe 'di nyid sogs kyi⑤/ /dngos grub go 'phang bla med 'gyur/ /lus gdung 'usems ni g.yeng byed me'i/ /dka' thub la sogs rnam spangs te/ /'dod pa nye bar 11—1772

brten pa yi/ /lam gyis ①bde ba'i 'bras bu bsgrub/ /gang zhig brten pas yul kun gyi/ /bde bas yongs su chilas byed cing / /spyod dang grol ba'i 'bras ster ba/ /mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs ldan pa'o/ /'jig rten rtog pas brtags pa yi/ /rigs kyi zhen pa kun spangs nas/ /dbyibs dang kha dog long tsho dang / /na tshod la sogs rjes mthun zhing / /dam tshig spyod pa sogs brten pa'i—/ /yon tan rnams kyi rten gyur pa/ /brten pas sgrub po dbang phyug gi /dngos grub kun gyi gzhi byed pa'o/ /legs brtags shin tu legs rtogs pa/ /brten bya de las gzhan du ni/ /chags sogs 'jig rten dbang gyur pas/ /brten na sa spyod sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /chags can ye shes mngon 'dod pas/ /tshal 'di nyid kyis bgrod bya yi②/ /de las gzhan pa'i lam gyis ni/ /nam yang grub la brten mi 'gyur/ /shin tu dben pa'i sar gnas te/ /'jig rten g.yeng ba kun spangs pas/ /bde ba'i ye shes 'phel byed pa'i/ /rjes mthun longs spyod brten pa dang / /rigs dang yang dag sbyor ba'i sems/ /mi mnyam bde ba'i rten gyur pa/ /de 'dir rang gi stobs kyis sam/ /de bzhin phyag rgya'i stobs kyis kyang / /nor bu'i nang son dbyer med pas/ /bde mchog bla na med goms bya/ /de goms pa yi sbyor ba yis①/ /ras dkar la ni snum dang ni/ /zas la bcud kyis phug pa dang / /chab rom las ni chu nyid dang / /chu rnams las kyang rgya mtsho dang / /chu rlabs las ni chu bzhin 'gyur/ /gang zhig mchog tu goms pa'i mthus/ /sna tshogs snang ba der 'gyur te/ /ji ltar bu ram las byas gzugs/ /sna tshogs mngar ba'i ro bzhin no/ /gang 'dir thun nam nyin gcig gam/ /zla phyed zla gcig khyud kor du/ /goms pas bskal 11—1773

mang bye stong du/ /mi 'gyur ba yi ye shes thob/ /'khor lo sdom dpal gzhung lugs las/ /bla ma'i dran gyis legs thob pa/ /de 'dir bdag gis gsal byas pas/ /dge des 'gro kun bla med shog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ku sa ①li pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i mkhas pa bha dra bo dhi dang / lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1772 7 mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉phro/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7sa/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉snga / rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kus/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉radungs/1773 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra)/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thas/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stan/1774 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (333)11—1774

pa'i bsam gtan gyi man ngag rnal 'byer gyi gtum mo/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṭītsakra sasba ra a dī te ①rtse no pa de sha yo ga 'a ṇ+ḍa smig| bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnyis su med pa'i bsam gtan gyi man ngag rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la dmigs pas srid par 'ching ba yi/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog kun gcod cing / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes mchog 'char ba'i/ /gnyis med rtsa yi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig goms pas sa gsum ma lus pa'i/ /rang bzhin bde ba chen po rtogs 'gyur ba'i/ /rang rig ye shes bde chen gcig pu pa/ /gang la brten nas rtog dze+epa'i man ngag bshad/ /srid pa'i btson rar gzung 'dzin 'ching ba yi/ /bcing bas bcings sdug mgon med gyur pa la/ /snying rje'i rlan gyis nye bar bsgos pa yi/ /yang dag byang chub sems ldan dbang bskur bas| /yid 'ong khang par bde ba'i stan gnas te/ /lha yi bsam gtan mchog 11—1775

la rab gzhol ba'i/ /lus gnas thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin can/ /spyi bo lte bar gnas pa'i rtsa 'khor lo/ /gang la bcu drug thog mar yi ge thig ler ldan//dro ba'i bzhi pa gzhom med rang bzhin can/ /a wa dhū ①tī kun nas sbrel ba yi/ /'khor lo'i dbus gnas byang chub yi ge thig le la/ /rtse gcig yid kyis 'byung dang 'jug spangs te/ /drong dang༄ ba 'thul dang 'bar ba las/ /rlung bral mar me 'bar ba'i rtse lta bu/ /glog gi 'od ltar kun nas gsal ba'i gzugs/ /gyen 'gros steng gi 'khor lo'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /gzhom med sa bon haṃ byeyig bzhu byas te/ /gang la brten nas ye shes lgechog skye ba'i①/ /byang chub rang bzhin 'o ma'i rgyun 'bab pas/ /gang du thabs dang shes rab 'dres gyur pa/ /de du gnyis med ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /rang gis rang rig pa yi ye shes mchog /rtog ge rnams kyis brtag ④pa'i yul min zhing / /brjod bral ye shes lkugs pa'i rmi lam dang —/ /ji ltar gzhon nu ma yi dbang po gnyis/ /'dus las myong ba'i bde ba ji bzhin pa/ /de bzhin rang rig ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe skyes pa'i bde ba che goms pas/ /de las gzhan pa'i dngos po mthong med cing / /sna tshogs snang ba'i dngos 'di ma lus pa/ /rang bzhin bde ba chen por 'char bar 'gyur/ /de tshe mig sogs dbang po'i yul snang ba'i/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i dngos 'di ma lus pa—/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu dri za'i grong khyer dang / /bar ma'i srid dang chu yi zla ba dang / /snang brnyan seng ge zla ba'i grong bzhin du/ /ma lus rang bzhin gcig pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /de tshe thog med srid pa'i btson ra ru/ /bsags pa'i 'ching ba ma lus kun bcad nas/ /gnyis med ye shes bde ba chen po yi/ /go 'phang bla na med pa thob par 'gyur/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnyis su med pa bsam gtan kyi 11—1776

0408༄7/ /khru yi pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i 'grel pa sdom pa 'byung ba jes bya ba/she ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ phru yi pā dā bhi sa ma ya brti sasbra ro r+ya nā ma/bod skad du/ phru yi pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i 'grel pa sdom pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba / dpal ldan phru kruyi pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bā rā rlung dang me dag gis/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo haṃ5/ /gang gis zhu byed bā rā hi thu/ /de la 'khor ba gnas par 'dud/ /'di mnga'i ston pa 'gro ba dag dang gnyis med bdag /shes rab ma yi khams ldan bde ba chen po'i bdag /shes rab thugs rje dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu'i bdag /de nyid sgrub thabs de sgom byed pa bdag gis bshad/ /dang por ri byel la sogs par/ /lho phyogs kha bstan rnal 'byor pa/ /skra grol ro la 'dug nas ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga po khar bcug la/ /shrī he ru ka zhes yig don/ /bsam zhing sdom pa'i tshul du bsgyur/ /ā li kā li'i 'od zer gyis/ /bgegs bsregs tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ /gzugs la rgyal ba rnam snang 11—1778

mdzad/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi mar bsgom/ /'du shes pad+ma gar dbang phyug /rdo rje rgyal po 'du byed la/ /rnam shes phung po rdo rje can/ /thams cad stong nyid he ru ka'o / /rim par dpral ba lte ba mgrin/ /rkang pa snying dang spyi bor ro/ /gti mug rdo rje mig dag la/ /zhe sdang dag byed snyan gnyis la/ /sna la ser sna gsod byed ma/ /kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ste/ /phrag dog rdo rje lus dpral la/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbang phyug sbyin/ /skye mched rnams kyi rang snying la'o/ /sa yi khams ni ltung byed ma/ /chu yi khams ni gsod byed ma/ /me yi khams ni 'gugs byed ma/ /rlung khams gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin pad 'bar ma/ /'di rnams rim pas lte ba snying / /mgrin pa dpral ba gsang gnas su/ /yang na gzugs la sogs pa rnams/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs bzhin du bsam/ /de nas g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis/ /se gol gtogs ①pa sngon btang nas/ /sum+bha la sogs sngags bzhi po/ /rtse gcig rnal 'byor brjod pa yis/ /nag po ljang gu dmar po ser/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su dgod/ /sa 'og tshangs pa'i gnas par du/ /khyab pa'i lus chen 'bar ba rnams/ /sum+bha la sogs 'od zer gyi②/ /ra ba bzhi po de bzhin bsam/ /hūṃ byung nges mtshan rdo rje yige/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin sa/ /'og khyab rdo rje'i 'od rnams kyis—/ /rdo rje rtse lngar gyur pa yi④/ /ra ba rnams steng mda' dra ba/ /de yi 'og tu rdo rje'i gur/ /de 'og rdo rje bla re yang ⑤/ /rang rang sngags kyis bsam par bya—/ /khā gdong ma la sogs pa bzhi/ /gsang sngags bzhi las byung ba dang / /gnyis gnyis phyogs 'od las byung ba/ /gshin rje brtan ma la sogs bzhi/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis de rnams brgyad/ /lte ba man chad phur pa'i gzugs/ /11—1779

de rnams g.yon na phur bu ni/ /de dang de yi ngang tshul can/ /g.yas pa'i lag pa rnams na ni/ /rdo rje'i tho ba chen po 'dzin/ /'phros te song bas phyogs bcu na—/ /gnas pa'i bgegs rnams rab bkug nas/ /hūṃ ring ①brjod 'byung phyogs brgyad kyi/ /khron par de rnams rab bcug nas/ /gdab pa'i sngags kyos phur bus gdab/ /brdung pa'i sngags kyis brdung bya ste/ /gdab dang brdung pa dag gis ni/ /de bzhin nyid du ro gcig 'gyur/ /bgegs kyi lhag ma rnams bskrad nas/ /ra ba la thim lha mo rnams/ /chu la chu ni 'bab pa bzhin/ /mtshams kyi rjobacings pa'i phyi byung ba/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo yi/ ra ba rnams kyang bsam par bya/ /gsang sngags rnams ni 'di lta ste/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ 3phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ hūṃ ④phaṭa/ oṃ kṛd+dhā pa ya kṛ1 pa ya hūṃ hūṃ ④phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hortsi bha ga wā na/ badz+ra rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gha gha ⑦ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭa na ④hūṃ phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bispyo kā ya wā ka tsit+ta ⑨badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra tī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te—/ de yi steng du hūṃ yig 'od zer dang ldan bsam byas nas/ /de yi 'od kyis bkug nas mdun du dkyil 'khor la/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs bdun dang bdag nyid dbul bar bya/ /he ru ka zhes spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga ru/ /rim pas bltas te stong pa nyid bsgom gsang sngags brjod/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥ⑪sarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyopho⑩haṃ/ sngon gye smon lam dbang gis rang sems oṃ sogs gyur/ /de las 'od dang 'khor lo'i 'phro dang 'du ba bsam/ /de nas rang sems de yang rab tu snang ba tsam/ /de yang gsang sngags brjod cing stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /oṃ shu 11—1780

n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ātā kopho①haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las langs te yo yig las byung ba/ /de la rlung gi 'khor lo rnam par bsgom bya ste/ /sngo skya gzhu yi dbyibs can mtha' ma ba dan mtshan/ /de yi steng du re yig las byung me'i dkyil 'khor/ /rtse mo bdun ldan dmar po gru gsum ram̐ gyis mtshan/ /de steng baṃ yig las byung chu yi dkyil 'khor te/ /dkar po shin tu zlum po bum pas mtshan pa'o/ /de steng lo yig las byung sa yi dkyil 'khor te/ /ser po gru gsum 1rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /de steng sum̐ yig las byung ri rab lhun po ste/ /spyog brgyad ldan pa gling la sogs pas bskor ba dang / /grwa bzhi ngos bzhi rin chen bzhi yi rang bzhin can/ /de steng pad+ma'i steng du hūṃ byung sna tshogs rdor/ /de steng baṃ yig las byung sna tshogs pad+ma ste/ /'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar lte ba dang ldan pa'o/ /de steng ā li kā li 1las byung nyi zla'o/ /zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ro/ /de la hūṃ yig rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin can/ /rang gi 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor lo lnga po yis/ /'gro ba'i 'khor lo'i rang bzhin byas nas rnal 'byor mar/ /bcas pa'i 'khor lo be+er yang bsdus te bsgom par bya/ /zhes bya ba rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /hūṃ la sogs pa las bskyed nyi ma'i 'khor lor gnas/ /te ru ka dpal nam mkha' bzhin du rang bzhin med/ /rtag pa'i dbang phyug chad pa'i u ma de wa ④la/ /brkyang bskum g.yas g.yon gnas pa zhal kun spyan gsum ldan/ /'khor lo dur khrod dang ldan gzhal yas khang gi nang / /mthing nag ljang gu dmar po ser po'i kha dog can/ /zhal bzhi dbu la rdo rje phreng ldan phyag bcu gnyis/ /rdo rje dril bu gnyis bcas phyag gis yum la 'khyud/ /gti mug dag phyir glang po'i pags pa phyag gnyis bsnams/ /g.yas pa rim pas 7 ma ru dang dgra sta gri gug rtse gsum 11—1781

'dzin/ /g.yon pas kha ṭī ga dang thod pa zhags pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams/ /dbu la zla ba phyed pa thod pa'i phreng ba sna tshogs rdo rje can/ /mche ba rab tu gatshigs shing zhal 'gyur ral pa'i thor tshugs dag dang ldan/ /blo ldan bsam gtan spyor bas nyams kun dang ldan pa/ /nyon mongs dri ma dag phyir stag gi pags pa bsnams/ /k+ṣiṃli la sogs lnga bcu rnam par dag pa yis/ /mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang ldan pa/ /mgul rgyan snyan rgyan gdub kor spyi gtsug nor bu dang / /tshangs skud dang ldan thal bas byugs pa du ba'i mdog /phag mo mgon po'i bdun gnas nyi ma lta bur ni/ /mdog dmar thod pa skam po'i phreng ba'i do shal can/ /zhal gcig ma dang srun gsum phyag gnyis dang ldan ma/ /gcer bu bde ba'i ngang tshul skra grol rab dgyes ma/ /thod pa'i dum bu las byas ske rags dang ldan ma/ /g.yon pa bdud khrag bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa ste/ /g.yas pa rdo rje sdigs mdzub kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i gdug pa rnams 'joms byed/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid che/ /khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag ma/ /brla gnyis la ni rab tu 'khyud/ /bde chen snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / /khaṇ+ḍa ro te gzugs can ma/ /pad+ma'i phyogs kyi 'dab mar dgod/ /de rnams dngos grub thams cad bsgrub/ /nag mo ljang gu dmar mo ser—/ /zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa rnams/ /g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭī go /ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yas/ /spyan gsum ma la skra grol ba/ /gcer bu brkyang bskum gnas pa rnams/ /phyogs mtshalas rnams su bum steng du/ /byang chub sems sogs snod rnams so/ /dang por thugs 'khor rtsibs brgyad pa/ /mthing nag rdo rje phreng bas bskor/ /de shar pūl+lī 2ra mā lar/ /rab gtum khaṇ+ḍa ka pā lar/ /11—1782

de byang dzā larnya ra ru/ /ma hā kaṅka gtum mig can/ /nub kyi o ḍi ya ①na ru/ /kaṅka la dang 'od ldan ma/ /lho phyogs arngu da ⑦ru ni/ /sna chen mche ba rnam par gcigs/ /me mtshams go dā a ba rīr/ /su ra bai 1ri dpa' blo can/ /bden bral rā me shwa ra ru/ /'od dpag med dang mi thung ma/ /de bī ④ko ṭa rlung mtshams su/ /lang ka dbang phyug rdo rje 'od/ /dbang ldan mtshams su mā la bar/ /rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma/ /gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po ste/ /pad+ma dmar po'i phreng bas bskor/ /shar ngos rtsibs kyi kā ma rūr⑤/ /ad+ku ri dang e ra ba /byang du o ṭar kye'ajigs byed che/ /de dang rdo rje'i ral pa can/ /nub kyi tri sha ku ṣ+pe ru/ /dpa' bo che dang 3rlung shugs ma/ /lho yi ko sa la ru ni/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad chang 'thung ma'o/ /me yi mtshams kyi ka ling gar/ /sh+ya chom de bi rab tu bzang / /bden bral mtshams su laspra kar/ /rdor bzang shin tu bzang mo'o /rlung gi mtshams kyi kāñci ru/ /'jigs byed che dang rta rna ma/ /de bzhin dbang ldan hi mā lar/ /mig mi bzang dang kha ga na'o/ /sgu yi 'khor lo dkar po ste/ /'khor lo'i phreng ba dkar pos bskor/ /shar rtsibs pre ta pu ri ru/ /stobs chen 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ /byang gi kṛ ha de ba tār/ /rin chen rdo rje dum skyes ma / /nub kyi rtsibs la sau ⑪rāṣ+ṭar/ /rta mgrin dang ni khoṇ+ḍi bhā⑫/ /lho ru war+ṇa dī pa ru/ /'khor lo'i go cha nam mkha'i snying / /me yi mtshams kyi na ga rar/ /te ru ka dpal su bī ri/ /lho nub sesnur pad+ma gar/ /dbang phyug dang ni stobs chen mo/ /rlung mtshams ma rur rnam snang mdzad/ /dpa' mo 'khor los sgyur ma'o / /dbang ldan mtshams kyi ku lu tār/ /rdo rje sems dpa' brtson chen mo/ /dpa' bo rnams ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /brkyang bskum rdo rje dril bu bsnams 11—1783

pas 'khyud/ /g.yas dang g.yon na ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭī ga /dpa' bo ral pa'i cod pan spyan gsum ldan/ /rab gtum la sogs lha mo rnams/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /thod pa bsnams pa'i phyag gis 'khyud/ /gdug pa 'jigs byed gri gug bsnams/ /gnyis med sbyor bas snyems par 'jug /dpa' bo dpa' mo 'khor lo bzhin/ /khwa 'ug khyi phag gdong can ma/ /mkha' 'gro sogs bzhin phyogs bzhi ru/ /mtshalas su gshin rje brtan ma sogs/ /gzugs gnyis ldan pa khyelha mo brgyad/ /de rnams zhal gcig ⑤phyag bzhi pa/ /brkyang bskum ro yi gdan la gnas/ /g.yon na thod pa kha ṭī ga /ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yas/ /thams cad sbyan gsum drag mo ste/ /skra grol gcer bu de rnams so / /mgul rgyan gdu bu dpung rgyan dang / /rna rgyan dang ni tshangs skud dang / /thams cad phyag rgya lnga dang ldan/ /dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng bas ①dkris/ /thod pa'i phreng bas mgrin par brgyan/ /ske rags sil sel sgra sgrogs ④pa'o/ /shar dang dbang ldan dbu byas te/ /thams cad phyogs dang mtshams rnams su/ /dur khrod rnal 'byor ma dgod ⑤la/ /g.yon dang g.yas su bskor bar bya/ /shar gyi dur khrod gtum drag na/ /shi ri ṣa yi sdong chen dang / /brgya byin rab brtan la bcibs pa/ /gser mdog rdo rje thod pa bsnams/ /nor rgyas klu yi rgyal po yang / /mdog dkar a la sngon pos mtshan/ /thal mo sbyar bar byas pa yis / /'dud cing mgon po'i mdun na gnas/ /byang du tshang tshing a shwat+thar/ /lus ngan mi la zhon pa ste/ /ṣ+pe'u le rin ⑦chen sgyugs pa dang / /thod pa 'chang ba sku mdog ser/ /klu yi dbang phyug tak+ṣa ka /ban+d+ra ka yi me tog ltar/ /gdengs ka dpal gyi be+e'us mtshan/ /mgos btud thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /nub tu 11—1784

'bar bas khyab pa ru/ /a sho ka yi sdong chen la/ /dkar po gdengs bdun ba ru ṇa/ /chu srin la gnas thod zhags 'dzin/ /lto 'phye'i dbang phyug karko ṭa/ / drur ba ①sngon po lta bu'i mdog /ri mo gsum ni mgrin par gnas/ /'dud nas spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ /lho ru 'jigs rung la a mrar/ /gshin rje ma he zhon pa ste/ /nag po mig dmar lus sbom po/ /drag po be con thod pa 'dzin/ /gdengs ldan dbang phyug pad+ma zhes/ /ston pa yi ni bka' sdod cing / /dkar po thal mo sbyar byas pa/ /dbu la thig le mang pos mtshan/ /ha ha dgod pa dbang ldan du/ /n+ya gro dha yi sdong chen po/ /dbang phyug rtse gsum thod pa thogs/ /dkar po glang zhon stag sham can/ /pad+ma chen po klu yi rgyal/ /zla ba'i 'od dang mnyam pa'i mdog /gdengs ka la ni rtse gsum mtshan/ /mgo la thal mo sbyar bas gnas/ /me mtshalas dpal nags ka ram̐ dzar/ /me lha bong thung ra skyes bcibs/ /sgu mdog dmar po thod pa 'dzin/ /phreng ba spyi blugs bcas pa bsnams/ /mtha' yas rma bya'i mgrin pa bzhin/ /mgo la pad+mas mtshan pa ste/ /bye bor thal mo sbyar gyur nas/ /'dud cing mgon po'i zhabs drung gnas/ /bden bral mun pa mi bzad par/ /srin po gcer bu sngon po'i mdog /ro gnas ral gri thod pa 'dzin/ /mi mgo'i phreng ba'i cod pan can/ /klu rgyal dung mdog rigs ldan ni/ /gdengs ka zla ba phyed pas mtshan/ /spyi bor thal mo sbyar byas te/ /la ta dza ḍa'i shing la gnas/ /rlung mtshams ardzu na yi shing / /rlung lha du mdog sha ba bcibs/ /ba dan ser po thod pa 'chang / /ca co sgogs par gnas pa'o/ /dung skyong ser po thig les mtshan/ /thal sbyar gus dang bcas pa'o / /brgyad po klu rgyal sprin la gnas/ /dkar po rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /11—1785

brgya byin la sogs phyogs bdag brgyad/ /yum dang bcas pa phyag bzhi pa/ /gnyis kyis thal mo sbyar ba ste/ /lhag ma dag gis ①phyag mtshan bsnams/ /sprin rnams rgyal bzang dpal stug dang / /de bzhin char dang shin tu mthug /myur du dbyangs ldan gtum pa dang / /char pa rnying pa tsab khyekrol lo/ /de brgyad dur khrod brgyad rnams na/ /gnas pa'i sprin ni 'jigs byed ldan/ /glog dang 'brug ni sgra rab sgogs/ /gang yang rung ba'i char rgyun 'be+ebs/ /rang rang phyogs bdag gzhom rngupa'i gdong / /srin po rnams ni rang bzhin 'khrug /mi rnams kyi ni sha za zhing / /khrag 'thung zhing rnams la gnas pa/ /'di rnams shing sdong brgyad pa yi/ /ngos dang ngos kyi phyogs kun du/ /nye bar bzang po'i shing rnams gnas/ /me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs/ /seng ge ce spyang khyi sgra sgogs/ /stag dang wa dang phag rnams dang / /byi la rkyang dang bri ka sbrul/ /khwa dang 'ug pa la sogs bya/ /gsal shing bskyon dang mdung gis phug /keng rus phyed mgo rus pa rnams/ /thab tu tshig dang phyed tshig pa/ /sha za dang ni ro sgrub byed / /grub thob gtor ma ster ba dang / /rnal 'byer ma tshogs mchod pa dang //gri gug thod pa kha ṭī ga /rnge'u ④chung kha zas dpag med snod/ /mchod rten dkar po'i ri la gnas/ /grub chen brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rnam shes brgyad kyi dag pa yang / /ston pa 'di yi dur khrod rnams/ /de nas byang chub phyogs rnams dang / /sku yi 'khor lo'i phyogs bshad bya/ /gnas sogs rim pa'i spyor ba yis/ /sa bcu rnam par dag pa'o/ / pū dzā ④o a go rā de mā/ kā o tri ko ka la ki ṭuhi/ pre gri sau su na se ma ku zhes bya ba'o/ /snying la mkha' 'gro lus rjes dran / /tshor dran mgo bor lā bhum ste/ /chos dran mgrin par dum skyes ma/ /lte 11—1786

bar sems dran gzugs can ma'o/ /mgo bo pul+lī ra mā stilar/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul rab gtum mo/ /spyi gtsug grong khyer dzā larnya ra/ /brtson 'grus rdzu 'phrul gtum pa'i mig / dbu rgyan ⑤g.yas pa'i rna ba la/ /dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'od ldan ma/ /mgo yi rgyab kyi arbu dārage/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul sna chen mo/ /gnas de sa rab dga' ba'o/ /go dā ba rī ④ga.ā+on ba'i rnar/ /dad pa'i dbang po dpa' blo ma/ /rā me shwa rī phyesmin mtshams su/ /brtson 'grus dbang po mi thung ma—/ /de bī spyoko ṭar mig dag la/ /laṅka'i dbang phyug dran dbang po/ /mā la bar ni sdong sgrib ④ma/ /ting 'dzin dbang po dri med pa/ /phrag pa dag ste nye ba'i gnas/ /mkha' spyod thugs kyi 'khor lo'o/ /e ra ba ti kā ma rūraldu/ /shes rab dbang po mchan khung gnyis/ /nu ma gnyis la dad pa'i stobs/ /'jigs byed chen mo o tre ru/ /zhing dang sa gsum 'od byed ma/ /brtson 'grus stobs ni rlung shugs ma/ /lte ba tri sha ku de ru/ /dran pa'i stobs ni chang 'thung ma / /ko sa lar ni sna rtse ste/ /sa 'od 'phro ba nye ba'i zhing / /ting nge 'dzin stobs kha ru ni/ /byā ma de bi ka liṅkar/ /shin tu bzang mo laspra kar/ /mgrin par shes rab stobs dang ni/ /sa sbyang dka' ba tshasdo ha/ /byapo chub yan lag nying nge 'dzin/ /rta rna kā— snying gar gnas/ /hi mā ⑨la ya mdoms ⑩su ni/ /brtson 'grus yang dag kha ga na/ /mngon gyur nye ba'i tshang ha/ /gsung gi 'khor lo longs spyod pa/ /dga' ba pre ta pur rtags la/ /'khor lo'i shugs can bshang lam du/ /kṛ ha do ⑪bar shin tu sbyangs/ /khaṇ+ḍa ro hā ⑫ring du song / /sa ste 'du ba can gyi gnas/ /brla gnyis chos rab rnam par 'byed/ /sau rāṣ+ṭa shoṇ+ḍi nī⑫/ /byen gnyis 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ /su laṇ+ḍi dī ④par dran yang 11—1787

dag /mi g.yo'i sa ste nyer 'du can/ /btang snyems byang chub yan lag ni/ /sor mo dpa' mo na ga ra/ /sertse rkang pa'i bol dag la'o/ /yang dag lta ba stobs chen mo/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros sa/ /'khor los ⑨sgyur ma yang dag rtog /mthe bong ma ru bsgon chen mo/ /pus mo ku lu tā ①yang dag① /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ /sku yi sa 'og gnas spyod pa'o/ /las mtha' khā gdong kha la gnas/ /'tsho ba 'ug gdong rna bug g.yon/ /rtsol ba khye gdong rna bug g.yas/ /dran pa phag gdong bshang lam du/ /shrī he ru ka'i ting nge 'dzin/ /gshin rje brtan ma rna ba g.yas/ /dge chos skyed par byed pa'o/ /skyes pa'i dge ba srung byed pa/ /gshin rje pho nya rna ba g.yon/ /mi dge thams cad spong byed pa//mig g.yas gshin rje mche ba ma/ /mi dge ma skyes mi skyed ④pa/ /gshin rje 'joms ma mig g.yon la/ /rkang 'og gnas pa'i rlung 'khor lo/ /bye phyeram̐ pa ni gzhu yi dbyibag /sum mdo'i phyogs su gnas pa ni/ /gru gsum me yang de bzhin no/ /zlum po'i rnam pa'i tshul can gyi/ /chu yi 'khor lo gsum par gnas/ /snying gar sa yi 'khor lo gnas/ /gru bzhi pa ni kun phyogs su/ /sgal tshigs dbyu gu'i tshul du ni/ /de bzhin ri rgyal lhun po ste/ /de yi spyi gtsug dkyil du yang / /pad 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ /dbyangs yig gsal yig yang dag gang / /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu gnyis/ /pad+ma'i dbus na yod pa gang —/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de la brjod/ /mgo bo'i dbus na yod pa gang / /de la klad pa zhes brjod de/ /de yi dbus su haṃ yig ste/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /thig le'i tshul te rang sgra sgogs/ /'jig rten kun gyi rtsa ba ste//brtan dang g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /gnas pa sa bon tshul gyis nipya/ /11—1788

gsal dang mi gsal tshul gyis te/ /'dzag pa bdud rtsi'i tshul nyid kyis/ /rnam par gnas te nyid mtshan mo/ /ting 'dzin ye shes las byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni mdor bsdus nas/ /sangs rgyas byer ba yod min na/ /rnal 'byor sangs rgyas mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir bden dang mi bden yang / /gang gang shin tu goms gyur pa/ /goms pa'i stobs ni rdzogs pa na/ /de gsal mi rtog blo 'bras bu/ /bsam pa gang dang gang gis ni/ /mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor/ /de dang de yi ngo bor 'gyur/ /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin no/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi dbye bas ni/ /yi ge gsum gyi ngo bo las/ /mtho ris mi yul sa 'og gi①/ /skad cig gcig gis sku gcig 'gyur/ /skad cig tsam gyis rnal 'byor bdag /skad cig phyag rgya'i rnam pa can/ /skad cig dkyil 'khor 'khor lor bcas/ /skad cig gis ni gsang sngags gdon/ /dbang bskur sku gsung thugs rgyas gdab/ /oṃ 26hūṃ sarba bī ra yo ga 1byā kā ya wā ①ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ④wa āt+pa kophophyohaṃ / oṃ badz+ra shudhaḥsarba dhadrwa badz+ra shurnyopho⑥haṃ/ de nas go cha gnyis shes nas/ /ye shes 'khor lo rnam par bsgom/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i sbyor shes pas/ /dam tshig 'khor lo la ⑦myur gzhug /oṃ ha rdo rje sems dpa' dkar/ /go cha gnyis kyang snying ga ru/ /rnam par snang mdzad na ma hi/ /mgo la ser po rnam par bsgom/ /swā hā hu pad gar dbang phyug /spyi gtsug tu ni dmar po bsgom/ /bo ṣaṭa ha ⑧ni phrag dag la/ /dpal he ru ka nag po gnyis/ /rdo rje nyi ma hūṃ hūṃ ho/ /mig gnyis la ni dmar po bsam/ /ljang gu tshigs pa thams cad la/ /phaṭa haṃ mtshan ma rta mchog go/ /dpa' bo rnams la 'di kho na'i/ /yan lag drug po yongs su bsgom/ /oṃ baṃ rdo rje phag mo ste/ /lte bar dmar po bsam par bya/ /11—1789

snying gar haṃ oṃ ya mi ni/ /hri mo kha ru rgongs byed ma/ /tre ⑨hri dpral bar skyed — byed ma/ /hūṃ hūṃ skrag byed spyi gtsug tu/ /phaṭa phaṭa lus tshigs 1thams cad la/ /mtshon cha gtum mo 'di dag mdog /sngon mo dkar ④mo ser mo ljang / /du mdog dpa' mo sarnams la yang / /lag pa'i mchod pa'i cho gas kyang / /'khor lo 'di nyid lag par mchod/ /rkad g.yas g.yon gyis mnan nas ni/ /g.yon mig cung dma' gyen du blta/ /lag gnyis mtheb rtse thur bltas te/ /yang dag mnan nas sdigs mdzub gnyis/ /lu gu rgyud kyis rnam par bcings/ /gung mo gnyis ni sprad byas te/ /lhag ma brkyang nas mgo steng du/ /g.yon dang g.yas su bskor bar bya/ /phyag rgya dra ba zhes pa 'dis/ /be+e bu yig brjod pa dang bcas pas / /snying gar nyi gnas ting 'dzin sems/ /hūṃ yig 'od zer gyis bkug pa / /ye shes 'khor lo pi wang sogs/ /mchod nas bdag la gzhug par bya/ /oṃ yo ga shudhaḥsarba dharmā ④ yo ga shusgophozuhaṃ/ gsang sngags brjod cing pad kor gyis / /'khyud pa'i stangs kyis mnyes par bya/ /ye shes dus mnyam byon pa yis / /spyan sogs ḍa ma ru dang ni/ /bdud rtsi'i thod pa thogs nas su/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a d+ngha ṣe ka ta ⑨sa ma ya shri ⑫ye hūṃ/ brjod cing bdud rtsi snod thogs kyis/ /dbang bskur bas ni dgyes par bsam/ /bdud rtsi'i lhag ma las byung ba'i/ /rgyal bas de rjes rgyas gdab bya/ /bde mchog spyi gtsug mi bskyod pa/ /phag mo'i rnam par snang mdzad do/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs rin chen 'byung / /thugs 'khor gnas pa'i mi bskyod pa/ /gsung gi 'khor lo 'od dpag med/ /sku yi 'khor lo 11—1790

rnam snang mdzad/ /dam tshig tu ni don yod grub/ /bdud rtsi ro mas drangs gsol nas/ /rab dgyes rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsung nyid—/ /gzugs brnyan bzhin du lhag par mos/ /de nas rang gi ston pa mchod/ /de la gsang sngags 'di lta ste/ /oṃ bye badz+ra stihe te ru ru ka hūṃ buhūṃ phaṭa//ḍā ki m+bi kyedzā la sasba re swā hā/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ byātshoha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/nye ba'i snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lha mo'i snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra waṇ+ḍi ni ⑤ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lha mo'i nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇ+ḍa kā pa ⑥la pra tsaṇ+ḍi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā shaṃ ka la tsaṇ+ḍa ak+shi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ brnya ban+dha shaṃ ka la pra bha ba tī ye kruhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tā sa ya tā ④sa ya bi ka ṭardastu ṇi ma hā na bhuse hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ khyo bha ya sgo bha ya su ra bai ri ṇa bī ra ma ti ⑪ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tram̐ hūṃ a mi tā bha kharba rā ⑫ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hraḥhraḥbadz+ra pra bha ⑩ba lo ke shwa rī ⑫ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ /oṃ phe phe ⑩badz+ra kā ya dru masgo ya ⑫hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa e ku ri ka e ra wa tī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha badz+ra dzā ⑫ṭi lam hā bye ra bī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa ma hā bī re ⑫bā yu be+e ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru bye rān+t+ra ma ⑩khā ba lam+bi ni badz+ra hūṃ ka ra su ra bhak+ṣu ⑪ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu bu rdza shaṃ sarbas+thā talja ya ⑪tadz+dza ya su bha dre shā 3ma de shī ⑫ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣiṃkasbyo ā kaṣ+ṭha badz+ra bha dra 3su bha dre hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hri hri ⑫ma hā bye ra ba ha ya karte hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ dzo dzo bi byu gyepāk+ṣa kha gā na ṣ+pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khye khye ma hā ba la tsakra be+e ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa / pya oṃ hūṃ hūṃ rat+na badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭī dī sdeha ya spyi ⑫ba shoṇ+ḍi nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ā kā sha gar+bha tsakra bin+d+ra ṇi ⑥ ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li 11—1791

shrī te ru ka su bī ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li ①pad+ma naste shwa ra ma hā ba le hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ hi li hi li bai ro tsa na tsakra wan+ti ni gruye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li badz+ra satwa ma hā bī ra thuye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kā ka phye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ u lu ④kā gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ shwa nā sre hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shu ka rā gye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma da dhī ⑪ ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma drunywa ⑥ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma rdaṣ+ṭi ṇi ⑦ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha rte m+bi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ḍā ki m+bi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lā mā ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū ⑨pi bhā ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bo bye tsit+ta badz+ra ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te byā re shā ya tshehūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kaspraghi san+di bhā ya skye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzā ṭa mu ⑫ku ṭoṅka ṭā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rdaṭī ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra ju dza bha su rā kyeya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho t+yā ta shu ⑫la kha ṭī ga dha ri /peṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+ra dzi dzā ba ra dha rā ⑫ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ ma hā dhus+thān+dha ka ra wa pu ṣā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de dag ni mchod pa'i sngags so/ /khaṇ+ḍa ka pā so sen mor/ /skra spu ma hā kaṅka la/ /pags dang dri mar kaṅka la/ /sha 7la mche ba rnam par gcigs/ /su ra be+e ri rgyus pa la/ /'od dpag med pa rus pa la'o/ /mchin pa la ni rdo rje 'od/ /snying la rdo rje'i sku gnas te/ /mig dag la ni ad+ku ri/ /rdo rje'i ral ldan mkhris pa la/ /dpa' bo chen po glo bar bzhugs/ /rgyu mar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad do/ /rab tu bzang mo gnye ma la/ /rdo rje bzang mo grod par gnas/ /'jigs byed chen po bshang ba la'o/ /smin mtshams la ni mig mi bzang / /bad kan la ni stobs po che/ /rnag rnams rin chen rdo rje'o/ /dpa' bo rta mgrin khrag la'o/ /rdul la nam mkha'i snying po gnas/ /tshil la dpal ldan te ru ka /mchi ma pad+ma gar dbang phyug /mchil ma la ni rnam 11—1792

snang mdzad/ /snabs la rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /de ltar dpa' bo lus la bzhugs/ /phreng ba'i sngags sogs dpa' bo ni/ /tshangs sgud la sogs brtag pa'o—/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /lus kyi khams la rnam par brtag /go cha'i dpa' bo drug gis kyang / /phyag rgya drug gis lus mdzes te/ /phag mo'i phreng ba'i sngags kyis su/ /mgul rgyan phyag rgya'i dag pa'o/ /mgon po'i snying po'i sngags kyis kyang / /mgo bo'i phreng ba brgya yi phyed/ /gsang sngags yi ge bdun gyis ni/ /rna cha yis ni rna ba mdzes/ /sarba budhe'i sngags sogs kyis/ /pags pa'i sham thabs dag pa'o/ /go cha'i lha mo drug gis ni/ /ske rags rgyan gye dag pa'o/ /'khor lo lnga gnas lha mo yi/ /sngags kyis btung ba'i thod pa'o/ /be+e ro tsa na'i sngags kyis kyang / /thod pas dbu la rnam par brgyan/ /kha ṭī ga ni lha yi sku/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i bdag nyid ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin phyir / /shes rab ḍa ma ru yi sgra/ /dmigs pa'i rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyin mor brjod/ /de yi dngos med rang bzhin phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor bshad/ /ji ltar bar do'i sems 'byung ba/ /shes pa tsam de nam mkha' bzhin/ /mngon shes lnga ldan de bzhin tshul/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mtshan dpes spras/ /stong nyid chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo zhes byar rab tu bstan/ /shrī yig gnyis med ye shes te/ /te zhes rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru yig rnam rtog tshogs dang bral/ /ka zhes gang du'ang mi gnas so/ /ngag yul min pa bā yi sgra/ /rā yig rnam pa rnams spangs pa/ /tī yig rgyu yi mi dmigs pa/ /phag mo'i sgrar ni grags pa'o/ /byang chub phyogs kyi rab sbyor gyis/ /thams cad shes pa nyid rab bstan/ /sa dang gnas sogs thrur ba yis/ /'gro ba'i bla ma lam 11—1793

shes nyid/ /go cha la sogs rnam dag mthas/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid kyang ngo //go cha gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /de ltar bdag nyid go bgos nas/ /sum+bha sogs kyis srung byas te/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas spyod par bya/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad la/ /sdom pa nyid du blta bar bya/ /rkang pa brgyad kyis rab bstod de / /'jigs pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /rnal 'byor blo chen rnam par spyod—/ /khams gsum dang ni dbyer med bdag /rigs lnga dag tu kun spyod pa//de rnams ro gcig nyid phyir ro/ /rnam par mi rtog bdag nyid sems/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga longs spyod/ /dogs pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /rnal 'byor seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /ces bya ba ni shin tu rnal 'byor te gsum pa'o/ /ā li kā le 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa ni/ /yang dag bkod cing 'khor lo gsum ni spros nas de/ /sna ①yi bu ga g.yas pa'i rlung dang bcas nas su/ /byung nas 'jig rten thams cad 'khor lo gsum gyur te/ /de nas sna ⑤bug g.yon pa'i rlung gi shugs las ni/ /rab tu zhugs nas lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ /de yi steng du skad cig hūṃ yig bsam byas nas/ /de dag yongs su gyur nas srid pa'i dbang phyug ni/ /mdog dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams//rten med 'ja' tshon ri mo bzhin du blta bar bya/ /rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo dang bcas pa/ /sgyu ma'i dga' ba de sgras 'gro ba ma lus bkug /srid dang dur khrod srung ba sku gsung thugs dang ni/ /bde ba chen po yab yum lte bar gnas pa dang / /bde bas zhu ba las byung dkar dmar hūṃ spru ha/ /mgo dang zla tshes thig le nā da rab tu thim/ /nā da ①tsam yang spangs nas su/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rtog pa'ang spang ④// /de las gzungs ni phyag rgya che/ /des ni rim pas 11—1794

thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen po ste bzhi pa'o/ /de nas myur bar yid kyis dkyil 'khor mos nas ni/ /nā da dkar dmar mdog ldan ①rang gi lte bar bsgom/ /de nas yi ge gsum pa yang dag rjod byed cing / /nā da las ni 'thon nas 'gro ba'i don byas te/ /de nas 'khor lo'i lha rnams rlung dang bcas nas su/ /slar yang phyi nas nang du zhugs nas de bzhin yang / /bla ma dam pa'i gdams pas yang dang yang du ste/ /skyo bar gyur na rdo rje'i bzlas pa rab tu bya/ /snying po nye ba'i snying po'i sngags/ /nā da 'khor lo'i lha tshogs kyi/ /spro dang bsnyu ba dag gis ni/ /de bzhin blo ldan dam tshig bzlas/ /chos rnams mnyam nyid nga rgyal gyis/ /phreng sngags rang gi khar zhugs te/ /rdo rje'i lam nas bha gar zhugs/ /dbu mar zhugs nas kha ru thon/ /lha mo las byung kha ru zhugs//bskor sbyor 'do ②la'i bzlas pa'o①/ /rang lus 'khor lo'i bdag nyid rab tu bsam byas nas/ /yi ge gsum gyis byin brlabs gtor ma phul nas su/ /'bar ba sogs kyis ④bza' ba'i zas ni dag par ⑤bya/ /chos la mnyam nyid nga rgyal ldan pas sngags brjod cing / /oṃ sa ma ya shudhesasarba dharmāḥs ma ya shusbyopho⑦haṃ/oṃ a mṛ to da ka hūṃ hūṃ ṭha ṭha ⑧tram̐ e khaṃ hūṃ hūṃ gis rdo rje dkar po'i rang bzhin ljags byas nas/ /yi ge gsum gyis nā da dgyes par mdzad cing gsol/ /nyin phyed skad cig dkyil 'khor mos/ /cho ga sngar bzhin byas nas spyad/ /mtshan phyed na yang de bzhin bya/ /rang smra uli kā lir rtogs/ /spyon spyon dpa' bo chen po kye//dag pa'i tshig ni ston pa po/ /stong nyid ye shes kho na 'di/ /chags dang 'jig dang gnas pa'o/ /uli la sogs kā yi bar/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dang yang dag sbyor/ /oṃ swā sogs pa'i ⑨sngags brjod de/ /'od gsal mngon du phyogs nas su/ /11—1795

nyal bya thun mtshams thams cad du/ /tha mar yi ge brgya pa brjod/ /khyem nas khyim gzhan 'gro ba bzhin/ /sems nyid dub pa'i ngal so tsam/ /'chi ba de nyid kho nar med/ /'jig rten rnam rtog yin phyir ro/ /'phro ba'i tshe na rnal 'byor de⑫ / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /sna tshogs mchod pa lag thogs te/ /'od gsal gnaso sum̐ 'khrid par byed/ /phan yon no/ /yam̐ dang ram̐ las byung ba'i rlung dang me bsams te/ mgo gsum thab la a las byung ba'i pad snod du/ /zan sogs sngags kyis byen brlabs sgon ma lnga dang ni/ /bdud rtsi lngar mos rlung g.yos mes zhu dmar pa'i mdog /oṃ hūṃ e khaṃ hūṃ lo rmā paṃ tsā zhubaṃ/hūṃ byung bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin thur bstan kha ṭī gas/ /dkrugs ldupas de yang zhu nas kha ba lta bur bsam/ /ā le kā li las byung yi ge gsum las 'thon/ /'khor lo gsum gyis sngar bzhin skye bo'i don byas nas/ /rgya mtsho la sogs gnas nas bdud rtsi bkug 5byas te/ /stoms par zhugs pas zhu nas 'khor lo gsum gyi lha/ / rim pa bzhin du phyeyi ge gsum la rab tu zhugs/ /oṃ sogs rim thim yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ /'bar ba'i phyag rgya be+e bhu sngags kyi/ /mdun du 'khor lo spyan drangs nas/ /ar+ghaṃ ⑦sogs kyis mchod nas su/ /k+ṣiṃle kā li yongs gyur te/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i lag pa gnyis/ /zla ba nyi ma'i rang bzhin gyur/ /de yi nang du hūṃ yig ni/ /sngags 'di brjod cing bsgom par bya/ /oṃ a byo t+yā nu ga tā sarba dharmāḥpa ra 'u sga ra a spunu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ.at+yad+dhā nu pra rmye biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā nyu1hūṃ/ zla ba la sogs yongs gyur pas/ /lag gnyis rdo rje thal mo laspyo/ /bdud rtsi'i thod pa bzhag nas sam/ /yang na lag par bsgoms nas ni/ /lha mo rnams ni tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /de gsung tshig rnams kyang ni 11—1796

mchog tu tshad ma ste/ /bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo 'di rnams kyis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur ni 'gyur bar shog /ces brjod mchod par bya ba sogs/ /dbyer med dmigs shing bdud rtsi'i snod/ /shar phyogs la sogs g.yon du ste/ — /mtshams su g.yas kyis bskor bya ste/ /oṃ ka ra la sogs sngags brjod cing / /hūṃ byung dkar po'i ljags byas pa'i/ /'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams la/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/bhad+dhā rmyeban+ta/ tā sa ya tā sa ya/ khyo bha ya sgo bha ya/ hūṃ tra/ hraḥhraḥ/phe dze/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa khyetsa pa tsa/ /bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sa ru bye rān+t+ra mā lā ba lām+bi ṣ+pe/ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi/ sabe+e pā tā la ga ta bhu j-i shaṃ sarbas+thā/ tardza ya tardza ya/ ukaṣ+ṭha ā kasbyo/ hri hri/ sdo rno/ hūṃ rja1/ hūṃ hūṃ/ tī jedī/hūṃ hūṃ/ ki li ki li/ se li se li/ hi li hi li/ bye li dhi li/ hūṃ hūṃ/phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra a rakhra sogs kyis/ /rnam pa du mar de bzhag la/ /oṃ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥ/ /dzatshohūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ badz+ra ḍā ki bhā hūṃs ma ya ste dṛ sh+ya hoḥ/ /pi wang sogs kyis ⑨mchod byin nas/ /zhal bsel la sogs byas nas su/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam par sbyor gyur kun rtog rlabs bcom pa/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin dngos po mtha' dag de nyid kho nar gzigs/ /shin tu phul byung thugs rje'i chu rgyas sems kyi chu bo'i mgon/ /lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu brtse bar mdzad de mdzod cig /ces bstod mngon par 'dod don gsol/ /phyogs bdag sogs gtor de bzhin du/ /oṃ kha la sogs sngags brjod cing / /gnyis sam gsum gyis bstab par bya/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa byu ⑨ta pre ta pi shā tsod+ma dā pasma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki r+sā da ya i oṃ ba lo kṛṇ+ḍan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+d+ra ma ma sarba sirnyi pra 11—1797

yats+tshan+tu/ yadze+e baṃ ya theṣ+ṭi/ bhuñja tha pi ba tha dzi gh+ra tha mā ti kra ma thā①/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sa ta su khaṃ bi thrad dha ②ye sa hā yi ka bha ban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/gtor ma gsol nas de rnams ni/ /bde ba chen po ldan par bsam pi wang ma sogs rnams kyis mchod/ /go la la sogs dbul ba dang / /rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ /de nas 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ /stso ma'i lag pas se gol gtogs/ /chad lhag bskang bar bya ba'i phyir/ /gsang sngags yi ge brgya pa brjod/ /dril bu dkrol ba sngon btang nas/ /pad kor phyag rgyas dgyes par bya/ /oṃ yo ga la sogs sngags brjod cing / /nam mkha' lta bu'i dngos po nyidaspyo/ /mngon par 'khyud pa'i stangs byas nas/ /srin lag mthe bong se gol gtogs/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes byas nas su/ /rang la 'khor lo gzhug par bya/ /gtor ma'i de kho na nyid do/ /snga dro yang dag langs ①la sa phyogs gtsang ma ru/sum+bha la sogs gsang sngags brjod cing rnal 'byor pas/ /bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pas dkyil 'khor byugs nas su/ /pū ④dza la sogs gnas sogs brjod cing rim pa yis/— /oṃ r+pā ṭha ⑤u pa r+pā ṭha⑥/ k+ṣe tra u pa k+ṣe tra/ tshardo ha u pa tshajo ha/me lā pā ka u pa me lā pā ka /thra shā nā ⑦u pa thra shā na/ de nas skad cig 'byung bzhi ri rab pad+ma la/ hūṃ gzhag de yi 'od zer gyes ni rab bkug pa/ /de la ye shes 'khor lo rjes su bcug nas su/ /de nyid yongs su gyur nas dkyil 'khor rdzogs par blta/ /snying ga'i sa bon las byung pi wang ma sogs kyis mchod dang / /rin chen bdun po phul nas dag par byas pa yis/ /g.yon pas mngon du yi ge gsum kyis me tog dbul/ /de nas lha dang lha mo'i snying po la sogs kyis/ /de yi 'khor la rang rang cho ga rab brjod nas/ /mtshams su g.yas su bskor zhing 11—1798

phyogs rnams g.yon du bskor/ /de nas lag par gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs sogs ①la/ /oṃ ha la sogs sngags kyis me tog phyul nas ni/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis ②g.yon pa'i me tog ni/ /'khor lor dor nas mgo la thal mo sbyar nas des/ /rang la g.yon pa'i 'khor lo rab tu gzhug par bya/ /rkang pa brgyad pas bstod nas sdig pa bshags sogs dang / /smon lam gdab dang bzlas brjod yi ge brgya pa dang / /oṃ yo ga la sogs sngags dang pad kor phyag rgya yis / /dgyes par byas te mngon par 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang / /sa reg tsho ḍa sgoka dang badz+ra muḥzhes pa/ /brjod cing bdag la 'khor lo thams cad rab bcug nas/ /de nas phyi rol dkyil 'khor ri mo bsrub ④par bya/ /phyi rol gyi mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /mthe bo mdzub mo gung mo dang ⑤/ /srin lag mthe chung de rnams khar/ /g.yon par rdo rje can rnam snang / /rdo rje sems dang rnam snang mdzad/ /'od dpag med dang mi bskyod pa/ /rin 'byung don grub go rims bzhin/ /dkar ser dmar dang mthing ga dang / /dmar ser ljang gu'i kha dog ldan / /oṃ ha la sogs byung ba ste/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rdo rje can/ /gzhan rnams zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rnge'u kyechung mgo/ /dril bu thod pa kha ṭī ga /g.yon du'o rdo rje can gyi zhal/ /dkar dang dmar dang mthing ga'o/ /dbus dang g.yas g.yon rim bzhin no/ /gzhan pa rnams kyi ⑦mtshon char brjod/ /'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje rin/ /ral gri gzhan kun ḍa ma ru'o/ /dril bu thod bcas kha ṭī ga /g.yas dang g.yon du go rims bzhin/ /lag mthil pad+ma 'dab ma lnga/ /dmar po 'dab ma g.yon skor sbyar/ /lte bar phag mo sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gsum phyag drug 'od 'bar ma/ /dmar po mthing ga ljang gu'i 11—1799

zhal—/ /thod pa kha ṭī zhags pa g.yon/ /lcags kyu tshangs mgo gri gug g.yas/ /ya mi ni dang rmongs byed ma/ /skyong byed ma dang skrag byed ma/ /gtum mo mthing ga dkar ser mo/ /ljang gu du ba'i mdog can rnams/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung —/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi rang bzhin no/ /thams cad spyan gsum skra grol ma / /gcer bu phyag bzhi lha mo rnams/ /g.yon na thod pa kha ṭī ga /phyag gzhan na ni dril bu bsnams/ /g.yas su rnge'u 1chung gri gug go/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gnas pa rnams/ /dkar po gang de zla bar gnas/ /de gzhan rnams ni nyi ma la'o/ /yang na 'di rnams sa bon nyid/ /dang por brjod pa'i rnam par bsgom/ /de yi mdog dang rang bzhin can/ /sngags dang lha gnyis khyad med phyir/ /'di yi gzugs brnyan 'khor lo'am/ /lag pa'i rgyab tu bsam par bya/ /de nas lag pa'i sa bon rnams/ /zhu ba'i rdzas kyis gdab byas nas—/ /'khor lo gsum gyi rang bzhin bsam/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas byin gyis brlabad // /'di la rdzas ni rkang brgyad kyis/ /dbul ba'am yi ge gsum gyis so//cho ga lhag chad dag bya'i phyir/ /gsang sngags yi ge brgya pa brjod/ /'khor lo'i mgon po la gsol nas/ /rdzas de snod kyi nang du gzhug /lag pa la yod ①rdzas rnams ni/ /g.yon pa'i srin lag gis reg nas/ /snying ga lte dang dpral ba ru/ /hūṃ tshi.oṃ gye sngags brjod cing / /byugs nas lha yi tshogs rnams ni/ /bdag la rab tu bstem par bya/ /lag pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /hūṃ yig dkar po las byung rdo rje'i rang bzhin ljags/ /g.yas pa dgang gzar blugs gzar gyis ni blugs pa gang / /lte ba'i pad+ma rab tu 'bar ba'i 'khor lo ru/ /de ni bza' ba'i dus kyi nang gi sbyin sreg go/ /oṃ tshi.usbyiṣ+ṭa badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha ④i oṃ ba bo hūṃ hūṃ 11—1800

hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'dis zos pa'i lhag ma'i gtor ma bya'o/ /bdag nyid chen po'i khams kyi za ma tog 'di thun mong rnams kyis gzhal bar mi nus te/de phyir 'di la kho bos kyang ni rab tu 'jug par nus par 'gyur ba ma yin mod/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor dbang phyug phru 1yi'i gsung tshig lhug gzung dka' bas goms phyir bzod ma gyur/ /de yi lam gyi rjes su 'gro bar 'dod pas 'di la gnas pa'i tshigs bcad bdag gis byas/ /mtshungs pa med pa yon tan phung po dang po'i mgon po ston pa yi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs kyi don ni rtsod pa'i snyigs ma sel byed bshad pa las/ /mtha' yas dri med bsod nams gang des 'jig rten sangs rgyas nyid gyur dang / /bdag kyang 'gro ba'i don sgrub byed cing 'gro ba gnas par gnas gyur cig /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bu dpal ldan phru ṭ+wāyi pas mdzad pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i 'grel pa sdom pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa sgogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs dza ga ta li'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bi bhū ti tsan+d+ras bod yul gyi dbus drang srong srin po rir sgra rang bsgyur du mdzad pa'o// //11—1801

gtor ma'i las byas nas ci bya zhe na/ dang por ri spyil la sogs zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod de sogs pa'i sgras rtegs stigacig pa'am/ dur khrod dam/khang stong la sogs pa yongs su gzung ngo / /ṭīl sogs pa ni/ dziyig gnyis med ye shes te/ /ho zhes rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru yig rtog tshogs bral ba ste//ka zhes gang du'ang mi gnas so/ /zhes bya ba yi ge bzhi'i don la mngon du phyogs shing —/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i sems kyis shrī he ru kopho②haṃ zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /sdom pa zhes bya ba ni shes rab ma la 'khyud pa phyag gnyis pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sdom par bdag nyid mos par bya'o—/ /ā li kā li la sogs pa ni/ thog mar oṃ yig tha mar hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyi yi ge can gyi k+ṣiṃli kā li'i phreng ba las 'od zer kha dog lnga pa 'phros shing / g.yon skor gyis lte ba'i phyogs su lan gsum yongs su bskor bar gnas pa las/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros pas bgegs kyi tshogs brlag par bsam/ de nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi zhes pa ni/ byams pa snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms rnams te/de la sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa'i brtse ba nyid ni byams par gsungs/sdug bsngal gsum ldan 'jig rten la/ /'khor ba bsgral 'dod snying rje'o/ /rang gi bsod nams gzhan phan la/ /rangs pa'i sems nyid dga' ba ste/ /chags dang sdang ba dang bral bas/ /thams cad don byed btang snyoms so/ /'di yi dgos pa 'chad de rnam par rtog pa thams cad kyi dri ma nyams pa'i phyir/ /te ru ka'i don snyoms pas stong pa nyid du mos pa'o/ /sdom par mos pa ni lus thams cad kyi bya ba'i rnam par dag pa dang / 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i rang 1bzhin du yongs su dag pa'i te ru ka'i tshul nyid kyang shugs kyis bstan 11—1806

noske/ /k+ṣiṃli kā li sgom pa ni gsung gi dag pa'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'phel ba'o/ /da ni rnam par dag pa'i phung po la sogs pa las/ kun nas bslang ba'i mchod pa la sogs pa ni byang chub myur du thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir gsungs te/ gzugs la rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /de la gzugs kyi phung po ni/ dbang po lnga yul ①lnga rnam par rig byed ma yin pa ste gzugs su rung ba yin pa'i phyir gzugs bcu gcig go / /'dir gzugs kyi phung po skye ba'i sa bon gyi rten yin pas/ gzugs kyi gnas gtso bo mgo'i dbus der hūṃ snedakar po'o/ /tshor ba'i phung po ni bde ba dang —/ sdug bsngal ba dang bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin zhes bya ba'i tshor ba gsum yang sems las byung ba'i rang bzhin te/ dbang po drug po la brten pas 'di rnams bco brgyad du 'gyur te/ 'di yang drod la brten pa 'di'i gnas kyi gtso bo lte ba ste de la i ser po'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po ni mig gi rnam par shes pa la sogs pa/ khams bco brgyad kyi khyad par 'dzin pa'i sgo nas ming gi sbyor ba rnams kyis sems las byung ba gang skyes pa de rnams 'du shes so/ / de yang ①mtha' yas pa yin te yul mtha' yas pa'i phyir ro/ /mig la sogs pa dbang po rnams kyi phal cher durtsa bar gyur pa mgrin pa yin pas der s+thārtsidamar po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po zhes bya ba ni/ mig gi rnam par shes pa la sogs pa lnga dang / kun gzhi dang / yid dang nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dang / rnam par shes pa brgyad do/ /'di la rnam par shes pa thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa kun gzhi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi dbang po'i rten srog rlung yin pas de'i gnas ni snying ga ste de la hūṃ dkar po'o/ /bzhi 11—1807

po rnams las gzhan 'du byed kyi phung po zhes bya ba ni sems las byung ba rnams te/de yang ma rig pa the tshom log par lta ba/ 'jig tshogs su lta ba mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba dang / lta ba la mchog tu 'dzin pa dang / tshal khrims dang /brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba dang / 'dod chags nga rgyal phrag dog ser sna khong khro la sogs mang ba'o/ /de'i khongs su chud pa'i sems byung rnams kyi yang rten rlung ste/ de'i gnas rkang pa gnyis kyi (nga mo'i ①'og yin te/ de dag la gzugs brnyan ltar gnyis su gyur pa'i ho0nga gu'o/ /phung po lnga po rnams kyi de bzhin nyid la spyi gtsug s+thāḥmathing ga'o/ /de bzhin du mig la sogs par byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi ②sa bon oṃ ①dkar po dang / hūṃ mthing ga tram̐ ser po/ a dmar po/ haṃ ljang gu/ hūṃ dkar po lte ba la sogs par ltung byed ma la sogs pa'i lo ser po/ oṃ mthing ga paṃ dmar mo/ tai ljang gu/ baṃ dung mdog bsgom par bya'o/ /rgyud gzhan las drangs pa'i mtshan la sogs par tshigs su bcad pas bsnyad pa/ rnam snang rin chen 'byung gnas te/ /'od dpag med dang don yod grub/ /rdo rje sems dang mi bskyod pa/ /'di drug rgyal ba'i khyu mchog yin/ /brkyang bskum spyan gsum ldan pa rnams/ /dkar ser dmar po ljang gu dang / /dkar mthing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /dang po g.yas na 'khor lo 'phyar/ /g.yon pa dril bu dkur brten pa/ /gsum po rin chen pad+ma dmar/ /dusna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar bas rol/ /g.yon rnams dril bu thugs kar bsnams/ /lnga pa thugs kar phyag g.yas na/ /rdo rje g.yon pas dril bu dkur/ /brten pa'o de bzhin g.yon pa gzhan/ /mi bskyod pa ni phyag g.yas kyis / /sa gnon phyag rgyas rdo rje 'dzin/ /sa snying phyag na rdo rje dang / /mkha' 11—1808

snying 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / /sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel ba/ /kun du bzang po rgyal sras rnams/ /dkar po mthing ga ser po dmar/ /sngon po dkar rnams go rims ①bzhin/ /dang po g.yas pas 'khor lo 'phyar/ /g.yon pas thugs kar dril bu bsnams/ /phyag rdor thugs kar rdo rje g.yas/ /g.yon gyi ④dril bu dkur brten pa/ /gzhan gsum g.yas pas rin chen dang / /pad+ma dmar dang rdo rje 'phyar/ /g.yon pa dril bu thugs kar bsnams/ /pad dmar 7sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar/ /drug pa thugs kar rdo rje g.yas/ /g.yon pa dril bu dkur brten pa'o/ /rang rang sa bon las byung ba'i/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ /1nga byed ma la sogs pa yang / /ser dang mthing nag dmar ljang gu/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rnams kyis/ /'khor lo rdo rje pad ral gri/ /g.yas pa'i gzhan na gri gug go/ /g.yon rnams thod pa kha ṭī ga /lnga pa du ba'i mdog can te/ /zhal gsum du mdog dkar dang dmar/ /phyag drug de yi g.yon pa la/ /thod pa kha ṭī zhags pa 'dzin/ /g.yas kyis lcags kyu tshangs pa'i mgo/ /gri gug rnams ni rim pas 'dzin/ /gcer bu skra grol lha mo rnams/ /de dag thams cad srun gsum pa/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yang dag gnas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /ltung byed ma la sogs rnams ni/ /las dang rjes su mthun pa'i ming can te sangs rgyas spyan dang dumā ma tī gos dkar mo dang sgol ma chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma'i rang bzhin no/ /rtsang byed mas ni bdud thams cad ltung bar byed ⑤pas zhi bar byed pa'o/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma ni las kha tshar ba thams cad sgrub par byed pas gar nyid ni las kha tshar ba la dbang phyug ste don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir ro/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi 11—1809

rang bzhin ni rnam par snang mdzad de/ de bzhin du mnyam pa nyid dang / so sor rtog pa dang / bya ba grub pa dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du gzhan de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rim pa bzhin du rtogs par bya'o/ /gti mug rnam par nyams pas gti mug rdo rje'oske/ /gzhan rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /lhag ma go sla'o/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs pa ni yang na phung po lnga go rims ①bzhin du gzugs brnyan dang / chu bur smig rgyu chu shing dang sgyu ma bzhin du nges par bya'o/ /de nas zhes pa ni phung po la sogs pa dag pa'i mjug thogs su bar ma chad par rdo rje'i gur bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin zhes bya ①ba ni nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po'o/ /mnyam pa zhes pa ni de dang dus mnyam pa kho na la'o/ /hūṃ byung zhes bya ba ni hūṃ yig las byung ba dang / hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa'i rdo rje'o/ /oṃ me di nī badzī ①bha ba badz+ra bubarnya hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags brjod nas so/ /'og khyab ni sa 'og gi mtha'i bar du'o/ /oṃbadz+ra pā rjokā ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis rdo rje rtse lnga'i rang bzhin rtsig pa rnams bsam par bya'o/ /oṃbadz+ra sha ra dzā latsā shaṃ ṭ+wā duzhes pa 'dis mda'i dra ba yang ngo / /skabadz+ra pañja ra hūṃ baṃ ④hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis rdo rje'i gur bsgom par bya'o/ /'og ces pa ni rdo rje'i gur gyi 'og tu skabadz+ra bi dā na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis rdo rje'i bla re bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lān lha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes pa 'dis rdo rje'i dra ba 'bar ba yang ngo / /khwa gdong ma la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/sogs pa'i sgras 'ug gdong / khyi gdong / phag gdong ma yongs su gzung ngo / /gsang sngags bzhi zhes pa ni sum+bha la sogs pa zhal bzhi pa'i sngags so/ /gnyis gnyis rang rang phyogs 'od las byung ba zhes pa ni gsang sngags gnyis gnyis kyi 11—1810

'od zer las ①skyes pa rnams so/ /gshin rje brtan ma la logs zhes pa'i sgras ni gshin rje pho nya ma/ gshin rje mche ba ma/ gshin rje 'joms 4 gzung ngo / /khā gdong ma la sogs pa brgyad kyis phyogs mtshalas srung ba kho na bzung na gang gis steng dang 'og srung zhe na/ brjod pa steng dang 'og gi srung ba yang / rgyud 'di la de rnams kho nas byed de/ sa 'og tshangs pa'i gnas bar zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /khron par zhes pa ni rtsig pa'i nye bar byung ba la'o/ /de bzhin nyid du ro gcig gnas/ /zhes pa ni bgegs rnams bsam par bya'o/ /thim zhes pa ni khā gdong ma la sogs pa rnams so/ /chu la chu zhes pa la sogs pa ni khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rab tu zhugs pa'i dus kho nar chu la chu brdabs pas thim ②pa bzhin du byung ba'o/ /de'i dus su rdo rje'i rtsig pa la sogs pa yang bu ga med par gcig tu gyur pa dang / rnam pa thams cad kyi 'gro ba rnams bgegs dang bral bar lhag par mos par bya'o/ /srung ba'i gur la sogs pa'i mjug thogs su ci'i don du 'di la stong pa nyid du sgom zhes pa'i klan ka med de/ gang gi phyir rgyud 'di shes rab chen po dang ldan pa'i dbang gis yin te/ shes rab chen po dang ldan pa'i yang stong nyid kho na srung ba'i mchog go/ /'o na bris pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi phyi rol du rdo rje'i phreng ba yang ci'i phyir zhes pa yang ma brjod cig gang gi tshe kho na bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i tshe kho nar dam tshig 'khor los yongs su bcad pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyi btu ba'i cho ga la/ re khā brgyad brgyad kyis byas pa re'u mig bzhi bcu zhe dgu par 'gyur ba la a yig thog mar ha yig tha mar gnas pa yi ge bzhi bcu zhe dgu bri bar bya'o/ /de la/ bcu gsum zla tshes thig ler bcas/ /zhe brgyad pa 11—1811

la lnga pa'i zhabs/ /zhe gcig pa la bzhi bcu'i gdan/ /so drug pa la gsum par ldan/ /zhe brgyad pa la lnga pa'i zhabs/ /zhe gcig pa la bzhi bcu'i gdan/ /zhe dgu pa la lnga pa can/ /zla tshes thig le dang bcas pa/ /de bzhin yi ge gzhan yang ngo / /so brgyad pa dang nyer bdun pa/ /zhes bya ba ni thog ma'i sngags/ /bcu gsum zla tshes thig le can/ /bcu dgu pa la zhe gsum gdan①/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa dang ldan pa②/ /zhe dgu pa la so drug gdan/ /bcu dgu la sogs yang de bzhin/ /zhe dgu dbyangs yig lnga par bcas/ /zla tshes thig ler ldan pa'o/ /zhe dgu la sogs yang de bzhin/ /so brgyad pa dang nyer bdun pa—/ /bzung bas gnyis pa'i sngags yin no/ /bcu gsum zla tshes thig le can/ /bcu dgu zhe gsum pa yi gdan/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa dang ldan pa/ /zhe dgu pa la so drug ldan/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis pa can/ /so bdun pa dang zhe gnyis pa—/ /bcu dgu la sogs yang de bzhin/ /zhe dgu pa la lnga pa dang / /zla tshes thig ler bcas pa'o/ /zhe dgu pa sogs yang de bzhin/ /so brgyad pa dang nyer bdun pa/ /zhes bya ba ni gsum pa'i sngags/ /bcu gsum zla tshes thig ler ldan/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis pa blang / /so drug zhe gnyis zhe dgu pa/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa yis brgyan/ /bzhi bcu bcu dgu so dgu pa/ /gnyis pa zla tshes thig ler ldan/ /so dgu nyer bzhi zhe gsum gdan/ /zhe dgu pa la lnga pa dang / /zla tshes thig ler ldan pa ste/ /zhe dgu la sogs yang de bzhin/ /so brgyad pa dang nyer bdun pa/ /zhes bya ba ni bzhi pa'i ①sngags so/ /de rnams zhes pa ni srung ba'i gur bsgom pa'i mjug thogs su/ snying gar zhes pa ni srung ba'i gur gyi dbus su gnas pa'i thugs kar ro/ /de steng ④zhes pa ni zla ba'i dkyil 11—1812

'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ yig rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin 'od zer lnga 'phro ba dang ldan pa ste/ ngo bo nyid kyi kha dog kyang hūṃ yig gi dngul chu dang 'dra ba ste dbus sngo ba nyid dang / phyi rol dkar ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /de'i 'od zer rnams kyis bkug pa/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i phyogs su gnas pa 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal ba ①sogs bla na med pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i mchod pa dang bdag nyid dbul bar bya ste/ de la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro khyod la 'dud/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum ldan/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /zhes bya ba phyag 'tshal ba'osne/ /snying gi sa bon 'od byung nas/ /pi wang 'dzin sogs mdzes rnams kyis/ /phyi nang de nyid gsang ba yi/ /mchod pas mchod pa nyid du brjod/ /de la pi wang ma/ gling bu ma/ rnga rlum ma/rdza rnga ma rnams sngo ser dmar ljang gu rnams te rang rang gi rol mo kho na dhidakrol ba'i phyag gtso bo gnyis dang ldan pa rnams dang / phyag gzhan gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rnams so/ /bzhad ma/ sgeg mo/ glu ma/ gar ma rnams dmar ser sngon mo ljang gu rnams so/ /bzhad ma'i gtso mo'i rjophyag gnyis kyis bzhad pa'i stangs dang ldan pa/ sgeg mo gtso bo'i phyag gis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gtso bo gnyis kyis sgeg pa'i stangs dang ldan pa'o/ /glu ma gtso bo'i phyag gnyis kyis pheg rdob 'dzin ma⑤/ gar ma gtso bo'i phyag gnyis kyis pad kor stangs can no/ /'di rnams phyag g.yas dang g.yon dag na thod pa dang kha ṭī ga dang ldan pa'o/ /me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ mar me ma/ dri chab ma rnams dkar mo du ba mar me'i rtse mo lta bu dang dmar mo rnams so/ /'di rnams kyi gtso bo'i g.yas par me tog pog phor mar me'i sdong po dang dri'i dung chos rnams 11—1813

so/ /phyag gzhan gsum rnams na ḍa ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭī ga rnams so/ /gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos ma rnams dkar mo/ dmar mo/ ljang gu/dkar mo rnams te/ gtso bo'i phyag g.yas pa'i phyag gcig gis me long sbrang chang gi snod dang / gos sna tshogs pa dang / chos 'byung 'dzin pa rnams te/phyag gzhan rnams na ḍa ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭī ga rnams so/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa la sogs pa'i dbyangs yig bcu drug gi sa bon las byung ba rnams so/ /de'i rjes su rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod pa bya'o zhes pa ni mchod pa'o/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gi①/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid sgo nasarka/ /sdig bgyis bgyid stsal yi rang gang / /de dag rgyal ba'i mdun du bshags/ /sdig pa bshags pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ni bsod nams gang / /gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag bsten rnams dang —/ /rang sangs rgyas dang ①bla ma dam pa rnams kyi yang / /de dag thams cad bsod nams shin tu rjes yi rang / /zhes bya ba bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas ma lus ①thams cad ni/ /mtha' yas phyogs khyab thugs rje'i yon tan tshogs rab ldan/ /chos bcas skyon bral 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams thams cad la'ang / /shes nas bdag nyid gus pas rab tu skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /rgyal ba'i yongs su dag pa'i yang dag lam bsten dunas/ /tshangs dbang drag po sogs kyis rin thang med mi rnyed/ /'di ltar bdag gis nye bar bsags pa'i bsod nams tshogs las ni/ /byang chub mchog sems de ni rab tu bskyed par bgyi/ /rgyal ba'i lam bsten pa dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'o/ /bdag gis 'gro 11—1814

rnams bsgral bya'i phyir/ /bgrod dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /rang gi bdag nyid skad cig ma/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes bya ba bdag nyid dbul ba'o/ /'di ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs brjod nas he ru ka la sogs pas ni ye shes kyi tshogs brjod de/ mchod pa la sogs pa rten cing 'byel bar 'byung ba la sogs pa'i sems tsam nyid du mos par bya ste/ rang gi mgo dang mgrin pa snying gar te ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge gsum bsgoms te/ chos rnams rgyu dang bral ba de ltar rtog pa dang bral ba gang du'ang mi gnas pa zhes bya bar nges par sbyar nas/ chos rnams kyi tshul ①'di ltar ma sdeshes pas sems can rnams ni bdag dang bdag gi ba la sogs pa bzung nas 'khor bar 'khyams te/ de la bdag gis he ru kar bsgyur nas ①chos rnams tshul 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyis shes par bya'o zhes chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje bskyed par byas nas/ oṃ swa bhā rjob zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags brjod cing / khams gsum stong bar bsam par bya'o/ /de la mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa la sogs pa rnams kyis sems tsam nyid du mngon par bsgom pa la oṃ yig go/ /swa bhā ba shurnyaḥsarba dharmātshozhes bya ba ni/ gzung ba rnam par dag pa'o/ /swa bhā rjob shurnyopho⑦haṃ/ zhes bya ba ni 'dzin pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /yang smon lam gyi dbang gis sems de gong nas gong du gnas pa'i dkar po/ dmar po/ mthing ga /oṃ yasahūṃ gi yi ge'i ⑧tshul du gnas par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ yig las sku'i 'khor lo rnams spros te 'gro ba'i don byas nas snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas zhu bar byas nas ⑨de nyid kho na la rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /de bzhin du tshiyig las gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams dang / hūṃ yig las thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams so/ /de nas oṃ 11—1815

yig yi'uyig la/ yisayig hūṃ yig la/ zhabs kyuha yig la①/ ha yig mgo la/mgo zla tshes la②/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la thim par byas nas skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi char bzhag nas chos nyid ma rtogs na sems can rnams zhes bya ba la sogs pa sngar bzhin du snying rje chen po dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i sa bon du gyur par rnam par bsgoms nas/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags brjod de/ nā da tsam gyis ①rnam par rtog pa yang spang ngo zhes bya'o/ /chung dus ④kyang stong pa nyid kyi sgom pa med par rdo rje'i gur gyi dudabus kho na la/chos kyi dbyengs kyi rang bzhin chos 'byung e yig gi rnam pa steng yangs pa 'og phra ba'i rnam par bsgoms nas/ dbus su gzhal yas khang sgom par byed pa ni kha cig gi'o/ /de'i rjes su stong pa nyid las ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis bhi rjore ba rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i rim pas sna tshogs rdo rje mngon par rdzogs par byas nas—/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma bsgom ste de'i mtshan nyid brjod pa/ shar sogs phyogs su gnas pa'i 'dab ma skya rengs ⑦ltar/ rlung dang me'i phyogs su 'dab ma ser po'i mdog /yi dwags bdag po dbang ldan phyogs su yang drur ⑧ba sngon po sprin mdog nges par sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /'di'i don ni 'di lta ste shar la sogs pa'i phyogs la gnas pa dmar po ste/ rlung mtshams dang me mtshams su ser po/ bden bral mtshams su sngon po/ dbang ldan mtshalas su mthing ga'o/ /de'i lte bar k+ṣiṃli kā li las byung ba'i zhes pa ni g.yon dang g.yas skor du gnas pa'i k+ṣiṃli kā li'i phreng ba yongs su gyur pa las/ ā li kā li'i dbyibs gzugs brnyan du gyur pa'i zla ba dang nyi ma gnyis bsam par bya'o zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ro//de la zhes bya ba ni me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin zla ba dang / mnyam pa nyid 11—1816

kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin nyi ma dag gi ngos phrad pa bde ba chen po kha sbyar ba'i dbus su hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lte ba'i nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i sa bon hūṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin dang po bzhag pa'i nā da las rim pas skyes pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin ni de'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de las byung ba'i kha dog lnga pa'i 'od zer las 'phros pa'i 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams kyis 'gro ba de'i rang ① bzhin du byas te bsdus nas④/ yang phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i grub pa thob pa dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa thams cad shes rab dang thabs kyi nyams mnyam par byer bas bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes kyi ④rang bzhin gyis zhu bar byas nas rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin kyi sa bon de'i dus su mngon du phyogs par byas nas bsgom par bya'o/ /de kho na'i phyir bcom ldan 'das 'di rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin no zhes bya ba rjes su rnal 'byor ro / /hūṃ la sogs pa las bskyed ces pa ni/ zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / phyag mtshan dang sa bon yongs su gyur pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i tshul rdzogs pa dpal he ru ka /oṃ byedahūṃ sarba bīr yo gi nī rjokā ya wāka /sto badz+ra swa bhā ba yi kopho⑤haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shudhaḥsarba dharmātshobadz+ra shurnyo3④haṃ/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags 'di gsum brjod cing / bcom ldan 'das shin tu rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin bsgom par bya'o/ /nyi ma'i 'khor lor gnas zhes pa ni ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i rnam par dag pa'i phyir dang / khro bo'i tshul nyid kyi phyir dang / khro bo rnams kyi yang nyi ma la gnas pa dang 'od dang ldan pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rtag pa zhes pa la sogs pa ni rab tu mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa nyid kyi phyir rtag pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i rang bzhin dbang phyug 11—1817

mnan pa dang / chad pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i rang bzhin u ma de ba mnan pa'o/ /de la dbang phyug ni 'jigs byed de sa bon gyi yi ge oṃ①yongs su gyur pa las mthing nag spyan gsum pa phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa g.yon du bsnyes ②pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa phyag dang po dag gis thal mo sbyar ba/ gzhan gnyis kyis ḍa ma ru dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /u ma de ba ni dus mtshan mo ste sa bon tīḥyongs su gyur pa las dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma phyag dang po dag gis thal mo sbyar ba/gzhan dag gis thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa g.yas su bsnyes ①pa'o/ /'di ni spyan gsum par bshad pa'i rjes su 'jug go/ /'khor lo la sogs pa ni/ de la 'khor lo ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad tshangs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'o/ /dur khrod ni sdug bsngal dang mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i dgra rnams la bde ba'i mngon par zhen pa dang /rtag pa ⑤rgyu med pa rgyu mi mthun pa la sogs pa'i mngon par zhen pa dang / 'khor ba la mngon par zhen pa'am ma yin pa la mngon par zhen pa zad mi shes pa'i mngon par zhen pa/ skye ba'i mngon par zhen pa/ bdag la mngon par zhen pa/de'i rjes su 'gro ba'i mngon par zhen pa/ de kho na nyid la mngon par zhen pa/goms par ma byas pa ste chos bcu'o/ /bcu po 'di rnams kyi rnam par dag pas dbang po la sogs pa phyogs skyong bcu rtogs rjopar bya'o/ /nges pa'i don gyis kyang rtsa'i bu ga nas gyen du rgyu ba'i gtumamo'i ye shes kyi mes de bzhin gshegs pa rnams chos kyi 'khor lor mi snang bar byed pa'i phyir de nyid kho na dur khrod brgyad do—/ /de bas na gzhan du gsungs pa dur khrod ces bya ba ni 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'dus pa'i rnam par shes pa brgyad kyi bdag med pa'i rang bzhin gyis 11—1818

brgyad do/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang zhes bya ba ni gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gnas pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang de yang hūṃ ①yig las byung ba/ rig ma dang bcas pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi bdag nyid dang ④/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang so so'i skye bo dag gi de bzhin nyid du tshul gcig pas mi mnyam pa'i dngos po med pa'i phyir gru bzhi pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa/ yang dag par spong ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po rnam par dag pas sgo bzhi pa'o/ /lam gyi yan lag brgyad rnam par dag pas ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes par byas pa/dpa' bar 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' mdzod dang / dri med phyag rgya dang seng ge rnam par brtse ba'i ting nge 'dzin bzhi'i rnam par dag pas mdo khyams be di ka lha'i snam bu ①bzhis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi rnam par dag pas rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun rnam par dag pas dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / ba dan dang / me long dang rnga yab bo/ /mdor na sangs rgyas kyi yon tan de dang de'i rnam par dag pas mtshan dang ldan pa'o/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba zhes bya ba ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir dpral bar rdo rje lnga las byas pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /shar dang byang la sogs par rim pas mthing nag ljang gu dmar po ser po'i mdog /zhal bzhi pa zhes bya ba ni stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa smon pa med padu/ mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'i mtshan nyid rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi rnam par dag pa'o/ /bcu gnyis zhes pa ni rten 'byel yan lag bcu gnyis 'gog pa'i phyir ro/ /re re la spyan gsum pa zhes pa ni dus gsum rnam pa thams cad kyi sgo nas gzigs pa'i phyir ro/ /brkyang dang bskum pa'i zhabs zhes pa ni 'gro ba thams cad stong pa nyid 11—1819
